product.name: CUDY AC1200 Mesh Wi-Fi System 3 Pack
product.description:
Whole-home Wi-Fi coverage | Seamless mesh roaming | Dual-band speeds up to 867 Mbps | Connects up to 128 devices | Effortless self-install setup

Quick Specs

  • Blanket every room of your home in strong Wi-Fi with three mesh units covering up to 220 m²
  • Enjoy fast, stable dual-band speeds of up to 867 Mbps on 5 GHz and 300 Mbps on 2.4 GHz
  • Stay connected as you move through your home with seamless mesh roaming between units
  • Connect up to 128 devices at once without slowdown thanks to MU-MIMO and beamforming
  • Get online in minutes — set up one unit and the rest auto-sync

Whole-Home Wi-Fi, Without the Dead Zones

The Cudy M1200 AC1200 Mesh Kit is built for households that have outgrown a single router. This 3-pack of compact mesh units works together to blanket up to 220 m² of your home in reliable dual-band Wi-Fi 5, replacing patchy signal in back bedrooms and garages with one seamless network. Setup is simple: plug in the first unit, and the rest auto-sync to extend your coverage, making it a practical upgrade for larger South African homes where a single router just doesn't reach far enough.

Tired of Wi-Fi Dropping Out as You Move Around?

Walking from the lounge to the bedroom shouldn't mean your video call freezes or your stream buffers. Cudy Mesh technology automatically hands your devices off to whichever unit has the strongest signal, switching in milliseconds so you stay connected without lifting a finger. Combined with multi-band simultaneous backhaul, the units talk to each other efficiently in the background, keeping your whole-home network fast and consistent wherever you are.

Speed and Capacity for a Busy Household

With 4-stream dual-band Wi-Fi 5 delivering up to 867 Mbps on 5 GHz and 300 Mbps on 2.4 GHz, plus MU-MIMO and beamforming support, the M1200 kit keeps multiple devices running smoothly at the same time. It's rated to handle up to 128 connected devices, making it well suited to homes with several smartphones, laptops, smart TVs, and smart-home gadgets all online at once. Each unit also includes two Fast Ethernet ports for wiring in a games console, smart TV, or desktop PC directly.

Control and Peace of Mind, Built In

Beyond raw speed, the M1200 gives you tools to manage your network with confidence. Set up a built-in VPN server or client for secure remote access, and use parental controls to schedule offline time or block inappropriate content for the kids. Everything is managed through the Cudy App with cloud control, so you can adjust settings, check connected devices, and keep your home network running the way you want it to.

  • MU-MIMO and beamforming for improved performance across multiple devices

  • Watch your system come alive on a curved pump display showing live stats or custom content

Elite Cooling for Enthusiast Builds

The ASUS ROG Ryuo IV SLC 360 ARGB White Edition is built for PC builders who want serious thermal headroom without compromising on style. Whether you're running the latest AMD Ryzen platforms or Intel Core Ultra processors, this 360mm all-in-one liquid cooler is designed to keep demanding CPUs running cool under sustained load, while giving your build a striking, all-white centrepiece.

A Curved Display That Steals the Show

Tired of AIO coolers that hide their engineering behind a plain plastic shroud? The Ryuo IV SLC's pump is topped with a curved display that turns your cooler into a genuine focal point. Through the ASUS InfoHub software, you can monitor live hardware information or load your own custom images, GIFs, and videos, so your cooling system reflects your build's personality rather than a generic factory look.

Quiet, Synchronised Airflow

Three dedicated ROG ARGB fans work with the radiator to move air efficiently across the fin stack, keeping noise to a controlled 39.6 dB(A) even under load. The fans are daisy-chained, so both the ARGB lighting and fan motors run off a single cable, cutting down on cable clutter inside your case. Aura Sync support means the lighting on the fans and pump can be synchronised with the rest of your Aura-enabled components for a build that feels cohesive rather than pieced together.

Straightforward Fit, Serious Build Quality

Wide socket support for Intel LGA 1851 and LGA 1700, plus AMD AM5 and AM4, means the Ryuo IV SLC fits comfortably into current-generation builds on either platform. A copper cold plate sits beneath pre-applied thermal compound, so there's one less step between opening the box and finishing your build, while the aluminium radiator and 200mm sleeved FEP tubing keep the loop compact and tidy. product.description:
Engineered for extreme durability | 80 PLUS Platinum efficiency | Native ATX 3.1 & PCIe 5.1 support | Fully modular for clean builds | Backed by an 8-year warranty

Quick Specs

  • Achieve up to 30% improved power efficiency with next-generation GaN MOSFET technology
  • Enjoy cooler, quieter running thanks to 80 PLUS Platinum and Cybenetics Platinum certification
  • Power the latest GeForce RTX 50 series and Radeon RX 9000 GPUs with native ATX 3.1 and PCIe 5.1 support
  • Build with confidence through military-grade components tested against drops, vibration, and extreme temperatures
  • Customise your cable routing with a fully modular design and premium embossed cables

Power Your Rig for the Long Haul

The ASUS TUF Gaming 1200W 80 PLUS Platinum Power Supply is built for gamers and PC builders who want a PSU that keeps delivering years after installation, not just on day one. It's designed for demanding builds running high-end CPUs and GPUs, where stable, efficient power delivery matters as much as raw wattage. With military-grade components, extensive durability testing, and full modularity, this is a power supply built to be the dependable foundation of your system for years to come.

Next-Gen Efficiency with GaN MOSFET

At the heart of this PSU sits an innovative GaN MOSFET, delivering up to 30% improved power efficiency alongside faster switching speeds and lower heat generation than traditional silicon designs. This translates directly into less wasted energy and cooler internal temperatures, while its compact size frees up room for larger heatsinks and improved airflow. Combined with 80 PLUS Platinum and Cybenetics Platinum certification, and a Cybenetics Lambda A- noise rating, you get efficient, quiet power delivery whether you're gaming, rendering, or running an all-day workstation load.

Tired of PSUs Failing When You Need Them Most?

A power supply is only as good as its ability to keep working when it counts. The TUF Gaming 1200W Platinum uses TUF 5K military-grade capacitors offering a 52% wider temperature tolerance and up to 2.5x longer lifespan than standard capacitors, backed by a protective PCB coating that guards against moisture, dust, and debris. It's been put through 75cm drop tests, extensive vibration testing, and temperature cycling from -40°C to 85°C, plus corrosion resistance testing at up to 95% humidity with salt fog. A 135mm fan on dual-ball bearings rounds things out, rated to last up to twice as long as a standard sleeve bearing design.

Ready for Next-Gen Graphics Cards

Built to ATX 3.1 standard and fully compliant with PCIe 5.1, this PSU includes a native 12V-2x6 connector engineered to meet the power demands of the latest GeForce RTX 50 series and Radeon RX 9000 graphics cards. It's designed to handle total power excursions up to twice its rated output and graphics card power excursions up to three times rated power, helping keep your system stable through sudden load spikes. A comprehensive set of protection features, together with a fully modular cable set and premium embossed cables, makes this a future-ready choice for serious builds.

product.name: Anycubic PETG-CF Satin Carbon Fiber Filament 1kg – Titanium Grey
product.description:
Carbon fibre reinforced PETG | Satin texture conceals layer lines | Superior impact and weather resistance | Easy to print

The Anycubic PETG-CF Satin Carbon Fiber Filament is designed for FDM makers who need more than standard PETG can offer. Carbon fibre reinforcement delivers greater rigidity and impact resistance than regular PETG, allowing printed parts to handle high pressure and heavy loads without snapping. The carbon fibre infusion also conceals layer lines and imparts a refined satin texture with a subtle luster — well suited to vehicle parts, sci-fi models, and functional prototypes. On top of its structural strengths, PETG-CF offers reliable water and weather resistance, making it a practical choice for parts used in demanding or outdoor-adjacent environments. At 1kg on a standard spool, this Titanium Grey variant gives you a full run of material ready to load and print.

  • Carbon fibre reinforcement provides superior rigidity and impact resistance over standard PETG

product.name: Anycubic TPU 68D filament 1kg – Yellow
product.description:
Flexible 68D TPU filament | Compatible with Anycubic ACE system | Intelligent spool identification | Broad nozzle compatibility | Ideal for functional, impact-resistant prints

The Anycubic TPU 68D Filament in Yellow is a functional-grade thermoplastic polyurethane designed for makers who need parts that flex, absorb impact, and hold up under real-world use. With a tensile strength of 23.5 MPa and an elongation at break of 650%, it handles applications like electronic device cases, toys, and sports equipment parts with ease. It supports printing speeds of 40–250 mm/s at nozzle temperatures between 210–250 °C, and is compatible with all nozzle materials including standard 0.4 mm and above. The spool features intelligent identification support and is reusable, reducing waste. Drying before use is recommended (65–75 °C for 6–8 hours in a convection oven) to ensure optimal print quality and consistent results.

Engineering-grade PC filament | High impact and heat resistance | Smooth, lustrous surface finish | 1kg spool

The Anycubic PC Filament is an engineering-grade polycarbonate filament designed for makers and engineers who need parts that go beyond what standard PLA or ABS can offer. Compatible with FDM printers fitted with a nozzle of 0.2 mm or above, it prints at 270–290°C with a heated bed of 100–120°C, and supports print speeds of 40–250 mm/s. The Anycubic PLA+ Filament is a high-toughness 3D printing material suited to hobbyists, educators, and makers who want better structural results than standard PLA without added complexity. product.description:
Print up to 600 mm/s | Smooth, clog-free output | High toughness, low shrinkage | Compatible with standard and high-speed FDM printers | 1 kg spool

The Anycubic PLA High Speed Filament in Bright White is designed for FDM makers who want to push their printer's limits without sacrificing print quality. Enhanced fluidity and a rapid cooling profile keep material flowing consistently at speeds up to 600 mm/s, while high toughness and low shrinkage deliver smooth, dimensionally stable results on everything from decorative parts to functional toys. A uniform filament diameter eliminates tangles and ensures uninterrupted feeding throughout the print, whether you're running a high-speed machine or a standard FDM printer. Dry the spool at 45–50 °C for 6–8 hours before use for best results. A reliable, high-performance choice for makers who value both speed and surface quality.

product.name: Anycubic Water Wash Resin 2.0 – White
product.description:
Water-washable UV resin | Compatible with 365–405 nm MSLA/LCD printers | White finish for detailed prints | Rinse clean with water — no harsh solvents needed

The ANYCUBIC Water Wash Resin 2.0 White is designed for MSLA/LCD resin printers and makers who want high-detail results without the hassle of solvent-based cleaning. Its hydrophilic group-modified formulation means printed parts can be rinsed clean with plain water (≥5 minutes), cutting out the need for isopropyl alcohol in the wash stage. Compatible with 365–405 nm UV light sources, it suits a wide range of consumer resin printers. Once washed, a 3-minute post-cure at 405 nm locks in the mechanical properties — tensile strength of 38–43 MPa and hardness of 82–85 HD — delivering finished parts that are firm and dimensionally stable. Best printed in an ambient temperature of 20–40 °C for consistent layer adhesion and reliable results.

Features

  • Water-washable formula — rinse printed parts with water (≥5 min), no IPA required during washing
  • Compatible with 365–405 nm MSLA/LCD resin printers
  • White colour for display models, miniatures, and detail-focused prints
  • Cured hardness of 82–85 HD with tensile strength of 38–43 MPa
  • Low volume shrinkage rate of 2.2–5.5% for dimensionally accurate output
  • Post-cure in 3 minutes at 405 nm UV (25,000–30,000 µW/cm²)
  • Post-cured resin disposable as standard plastic waste

Specifications

  • Colour: White (#EFF0F1)
  • Resin Size: 1kg
  • Pre-print preparation: Shake well before use
  • Print environment: 20-40 ℃

product.name: Anycubic Standard Resin V2 - White
product.description:
Enhanced toughness and impact resistance | High-precision prints with minimal shrinkage | Low-viscosity formula for fast, clean results | Compatible with all 405nm LCD/DLP printers

The Anycubic Standard Resin V2 in White is a reformulated photopolymer resin designed for makers and hobbyists who demand both strength and detail from their LCD or DLP 3D printer. Its enhanced toughness means finished models resist drops and impacts, flexing without brittle fracture — making it well suited to figurines, enclosures, snap-fit parts, and functional prototypes alike. A low-viscosity formulation promotes rapid resin flow, faster bubble dissipation, and superior bed adhesion, reducing print failures and delivering smoother surfaces with finer detail reproduction. With a 4.3% volumetric shrinkage rate, dimensional accuracy is kept tight so your prints come out true to your design. The resin is compatible with all 405nm UV-curing LCD and DLP printers on the market, and pairs with Anycubic's Photon Workshop slicer, which ships pre-loaded with optimised settings so you can start printing without manual parameter tuning.

  • 4.3% volumetric shrinkage rate for high dimensional accuracy and deformation resistance

  • Unleash next-gen AMD Ryzen performance with a robust 16+2+2 power stage design rated for up to 80A per stage

  • Build and maintain your system with ease using tool-free M.2 installation and one-touch BIOS controls

Engineered for AMD Ryzen Domination

The ASUS ROG STRIX B850-F GAMING WIFI7 NEO is built for gamers and builders assembling an AM5 platform who refuse to compromise on stability or speed. Supporting AMD Ryzen 9000, 8000 and 7000 series desktop processors on the AMD B850 chipset, this ATX motherboard pairs serious power delivery with next-generation connectivity, giving your build the foundation it needs to handle demanding games and AI-assisted workloads alike.

Power That Doesn't Back Down

Tired of motherboards that throttle under sustained load? The ROG STRIX B850-F GAMING WIFI7 NEO answers with a 16+2+2 power stage design, each stage rated to handle up to 80A, backed by dual ProCool power connectors for a secure, high-current link to your PSU. This robust power solution is built to support the full performance ceiling of AMD Ryzen processors, whether you're pushing frame rates in the latest titles or running local AI workloads.

Connectivity Built for the Future

Onboard Wi-Fi 7 (MediaTek MT7925) 2x2 delivers faster, more stable wireless performance than previous generations, while a dedicated 5Gb Ethernet port keeps wired connections quick and low-latency for online gaming and large file transfers. Round out your connectivity with an extensive rear I/O layout — including 10Gbps and 5Gbps USB ports across Type-A and Type-C — plus full end-to-end PCIe 5.0 support for your graphics card, so every peripheral and expansion card gets the bandwidth it needs.

Smarter Cooling, Faster Storage

With four M.2 slots covered by dedicated heatsinks and a supporting backplate, this motherboard keeps next-generation NVMe drives cool and consistent under sustained transfers, even as you fill out your storage array with PCIe 5.0 and PCIe 4.0 drives. ASUS Q-Design features like tool-free M.2 Q-Latch and Q-Slide mechanisms make installing and swapping drives simple, while onboard Clear CMOS and BIOS FlashBack buttons mean troubleshooting and BIOS updates never require you to dig for jumpers or a spare CPU.

  • AMD Socket AM5 support for Ryzen 9000, 8000 and 7000 series desktop processors on the AMD B850 chipset

product.description:
NVIDIA DGX Spark approved stacking cable | QSFP112 passive DAC | 400G-rated | 40 cm direct-attach copper | No switch required

The PNY DGX Spark Connector Cable is a QSFP112 passive direct-attach copper (DAC) cable purpose-built for connecting two NVIDIA DGX Spark systems — or compatible GB10-based units — directly through their ConnectX-7 QSFP ports, with no switch, transceivers, or additional adapters required. At 40 cm in length, it is the ideal reach for two compact desktop AI systems placed side by side. NVIDIA lists this cable as one of only two approved options for DGX Spark stacking, making it the straightforward, verified choice for a dual-node interconnect. The cable is rated at 400G (4 x 100G lanes) with QSFP112 connectors on both ends; on DGX Spark and OEM GB10 platforms the link operates at up to 200 Gb/s per port, as the ConnectX-7 QSFP port is the determining factor. Plug in and connect — no configuration complexity, no compatibility guesswork.

Features

  • NVIDIA-approved DGX Spark stacking cable — one of only two NVIDIA-listed approved options for dual DGX Spark interconnect.
  • QSFP112 passive DAC construction — no active components, transceivers, or external switch required for a direct node-to-node link.
  • 400G-rated cable (4 x 100G lanes) with QSFP112 connectors on both ends.
  • Operates at up to 200 Gb/s per port on DGX Spark and GB10-based systems via the ConnectX-7 QSFP interface.
  • 40 cm length designed for compact side-by-side desktop deployments.
  • Compatible across the GB10 ecosystem: NVIDIA DGX Spark, HP ZGX Nano AI Station, Dell Pro Max with GB10, and ASUS Ascent GX10.

product.name: PNY Nvidia DGX Spark GB10 128GB Ai Supercomputer
product.description:
Desktop AI supercomputer | 1 petaFLOP FP4 performance | 128 GB unified memory | NVIDIA Grace Blackwell architecture | Prototype, fine-tune and deploy large AI models locally

Quick Specs

  • Achieve up to 1 petaFLOP of AI compute performance at FP4 precision with the NVIDIA Grace Blackwell architecture — data-centre power on your desk.
  • Run large AI models of up to 200 billion parameters locally, backed by 128 GB of unified LPDDR5x system memory and 273 GB/s memory bandwidth.
  • Store massive datasets and model checkpoints on a 4 TB self-encrypting NVMe M.2 drive — fast, capacious, and secure.
  • Connect two DGX Spark units via the ConnectX-7 Smart NIC to tackle AI models of up to 405 billion parameters in a collaborative desktop cluster.
  • Work wirelessly and freely with Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 5.3, while the compact 15 × 15 × 5.05 cm form factor keeps your workspace uncluttered.

A new class of computer for AI builders and researchers

The PNY NVIDIA DGX Spark GB10 redefines what a desktop workstation can do. Designed for developers, data scientists, and AI researchers who need real supercomputer capability without a server room, it delivers up to 1 petaFLOP of AI compute at FP4 precision from a compact, champagne-gold enclosure that weighs just 1.2 kg. Powered by the NVIDIA Grace Blackwell architecture — the same generation driving the world's most advanced data centres — the DGX Spark lets you prototype, fine-tune, and run inference on large language models and generative AI workloads entirely on your desktop, then deploy seamlessly to the data centre or cloud when you are ready to scale.

128 GB of unified memory: no model too large for your desk

Tired of hitting memory walls mid-training and waiting on cloud queues to continue your work? The DGX Spark's 128 GB of LPDDR5x unified system memory — shared coherently between the CPU and GPU — removes that bottleneck entirely. With a 256-bit memory interface delivering 273 GB/s of bandwidth, you can run AI models of up to 200 billion parameters locally in a single system. Link two DGX Spark units together via NVIDIA ConnectX networking and the combined capacity extends to AI models of up to 405 billion parameters, giving your team a compact, high-performance AI cluster without the infrastructure overhead.

Grace Blackwell silicon: 5th-generation Tensor Cores at your fingertips

At the heart of the DGX Spark is the NVIDIA GB10 Superchip, combining a 20-core Arm CPU — ten Cortex-X925 performance cores paired with ten Cortex-A725 efficiency cores — with a Blackwell-generation GPU featuring 5th-generation Tensor Cores and 4th-generation RT Cores. This architecture is purpose-built for the compute demands of modern AI: transformer training, large-scale inference, retrieval-augmented generation, and multi-modal workloads all benefit from the raw arithmetic throughput that previously required a rack of servers. The preinstalled NVIDIA AI software stack — including frameworks, libraries, and pretrained models — means you can be productive from the moment you power on.

Enterprise-grade connectivity in a mini form factor

Despite its compact footprint, the DGX Spark is exceptionally well connected. Four USB Type-C ports (three available for peripherals, one powering the unit), a single HDMI 2.1a output supporting up to 8K displays at 120 Hz with HDR, a 10 GbE RJ-45 port for reliable wired networking, and a ConnectX-7 Smart NIC capable of up to 100 GbE ensure that data moves as fast as your models demand. Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 5.3 keep the unit cable-light when you need flexibility. The 4 TB self-encrypting NVMe M.2 drive safeguards your proprietary models and datasets at rest, meeting the security expectations of professional AI development environments.

Features

  • NVIDIA Grace Blackwell architecture delivers up to 1 petaFLOP of FP4 AI compute performance from a desktop-sized unit.
  • 128 GB of unified LPDDR5x system memory with 273 GB/s bandwidth supports AI models of up to 200 billion parameters in a single system.
  • 5th-generation Tensor Cores and 4th-generation RT Cores accelerate transformer training, inference, and generative AI workloads.
  • ConnectX-7 Smart NIC enables dual-unit networking for AI models of up to 405 billion parameters across two connected DGX Spark systems.
  • 4 TB self-encrypting NVMe M.2 storage keeps proprietary model data and datasets secure and immediately accessible.
  • Four USB Type-C ports, HDMI 2.1a (8K/120 Hz HDR), 10 GbE RJ-45, Wi-Fi 7, and Bluetooth 5.3 for comprehensive desktop connectivity.
  • Preinstalled DGX OS with the full NVIDIA AI software stack — frameworks, libraries, and pretrained models included out of the box.
  • Compact mini form factor (15 × 15 × 5.05 cm, 1.2 kg) in a distinctive champagne-gold finish.

product.name: Xiaomi REDMI Watch 6 - Silver Grey
product.description:
Crystal-clear AMOLED display | Up to 12-day battery life | Built-in GPS & Bluetooth calling | Comprehensive health monitoring | 5ATM water resistance

Quick Specs

  • Enjoy flagship-quality visuals on a crisp 2.07-inch AMOLED display with a 2000-nit peak brightness and 60Hz refresh rate
  • Stay connected with built-in Bluetooth calling and dual L1 5-system GNSS for pinpoint outdoor positioning
  • Track your health around the clock with heart rate, SpO₂, sleep, and stress monitoring — all in one slim watch
  • Power through up to 12 days on a single charge under normal usage, backed by a 550mAh battery
  • Take it into the pool with confidence — 5ATM water resistance keeps it going wherever your day does

Flagship style on your wrist

The Redmi Watch 6 is built for anyone who wants a capable, stylish smart watch without compromise. Its 2.07-inch AMOLED display sits behind ultra-slim 2mm symmetrical bezels, achieving an 82% screen-to-body ratio that makes every glance feel expansive. A high-strength aluminium alloy mid-frame keeps the body slim at just 9.9mm, while the dual-button design — featuring a repositioned raised stainless steel crown and a secondary shortcut button — puts intuitive control right at your fingertips.

Never miss a beat — or a call

Tired of reaching for your phone every time a notification comes in? The Redmi Watch 6's Bluetooth calling lets you manage calls directly from your wrist. Paired with over 20 vibration patterns driven by a linear motor, alerts are crisp and unmissable — whether you're mid-run or in a meeting. Raise-to-wake and an always-on colour display mean the time and your notifications are always within a glance.

Stay on track, wherever you go

Whether you're running through the neighbourhood or hiking further afield, the Redmi Watch 6's dual L1 5-system GNSS keeps your route accurately mapped. The watch automatically selects the antenna with the strongest signal based on how it's worn, delivering a stable connection across complex terrain. With over 150 sports modes and real-time heart rate and energy tracking, every session is recorded with precision.

Health monitoring that works all day

From the moment you wake up to the moment you drift off, the Redmi Watch 6 keeps a close eye on what matters. All-day heart rate monitoring, blood oxygen (SpO₂) tracking, stress monitoring, sleep analysis, breathing exercises, and women's health management combine to give you a well-rounded picture of your wellbeing. The upgraded heart rate sensor even works underwater — backed by a 5ATM water resistance rating, certified in accordance with GB/T 30106:2013. A 550mAh battery keeps all of this running for up to 12 days under normal usage, so you spend less time charging and more time moving.

  • Ultra-slim 9.9mm body with high-strength aluminium alloy mid-frame and dual-button navigation
  • Built-in Bluetooth calling — answer and manage calls directly from the watch
  • Dual L1 5-system GNSS with automatic antenna selection for accurate outdoor positioning
  • 150+ sports modes with real-time heart rate and energy monitoring
  • Comprehensive health tracking: all-day heart rate, SpO₂, sleep, stress monitoring, and women's health management
  • 5ATM water resistance — suitable for swimming and shallow-water activities
  • Up to 12 days battery life (normal usage) from a 550mAh battery
  • Always-on colour display and raise-to-wake for at-a-glance information
  • Compatible with Android 8.0 and above, and iOS 14.0 and above

product.name: Cudy AC1200 Gigabit Dual-Band Wi-Fi 5 Wall-Plate Access Point
product.description:
Dedicated room-by-room Wi-Fi coverage | Single-cable PoE installation | Centralised multi-AP management | Discreet wall-plate design that disappears into any interior

Quick Specs

  • Enjoy dual-band Wi-Fi 5 speeds of up to 1200 Mbps combined, keeping every room connected without lag
  • Cover up to 60 m² per unit and comfortably support up to 40 connected devices in busy spaces
  • Simplify installation with 802.3at/af PoE power, running data and power over a single Ethernet cable
  • Extend power to a VoIP phone or other PSE device downstream with built-in PoE passthrough
  • Manage every access point from one dashboard with the Cudy App or the Cudy AP Controller

Wi-Fi Built Into the Wall, Not Bolted Onto It

The Cudy AP1300 Wall is designed for the spaces where a single router just can't reach every corner - hotel rooms, dormitories, apartments and open-plan offices. Rather than mounting another visible box on the desk or ceiling, this access point fits into a standard electrical wall box, sitting flush against the wall like a light switch or power outlet. For South African hospitality operators, property managers and office IT teams who need dependable, dedicated Wi-Fi in every room without unsightly cabling or clutter, it's a practical, professional solution.

Dedicated Coverage Without the Dead Zones

Tired of guests or staff complaining about patchy Wi-Fi in certain rooms? The AP1300 Wall delivers 4-stream dual-band Wi-Fi 5, combining 867 Mbps on the 5 GHz band with 300 Mbps on 2.4 GHz for a combined 1200 Mbps of throughput. Each unit is built to cover up to 60 m² (650 ft²) and comfortably handle up to 40 connected devices, making it well suited to hotel rooms, meeting rooms or apartment units. With support for up to 8 SSIDs across both bands and VLAN tagging, you can separate guest, staff and IoT traffic on the same hardware while keeping every network secured with WPA/WPA2/WPA3.

One Cable Does It All

Deployment gets significantly simpler when you only need to run a single Ethernet cable. The AP1300 Wall is powered via 802.3at/af PoE or passive PoE straight through its ETH0 port, eliminating the need for a separate power adapter at every install point. A second port offers PoE passthrough, so you can power a downstream VoIP phone, IP camera or other PSE-enabled device from the same access point - ideal for hotel rooms that need both Wi-Fi and a wired handset. In total, five Gigabit Ethernet ports are on hand for wired laptops, IPTV boxes, printers and other devices that benefit from a stable, direct connection.

Installed in Minutes, Managed From Anywhere

The wall-mount bracket is compatible with 86 mm, standard EU and standard US junction boxes, so fitting the AP1300 Wall is a quick retrofit rather than a rewiring job. Once installed, it can be managed individually through the Cudy App, or scaled up with the Cudy AP Controller (model C200P), which handles batch configuration and firmware updates for up to 200 access points from one interface - a real advantage for hotels and offices rolling out coverage room by room. Mesh compatibility means it can also join a Cudy Mesh network over wireless, wired or multi-band backhaul, while watchdog monitoring and scheduled reboots keep the network running reliably with minimal hands-on maintenance.

Features

  • 4-stream dual-band Wi-Fi 5 delivering 867 Mbps on 5 GHz and 300 Mbps on 2.4 GHz
  • Five Gigabit Ethernet ports, including one PoE-in port and one PoE passthrough output
  • Powered via 802.3at/af PoE or passive PoE, removing the need for a separate power adapter
  • Supports up to 8 SSIDs (4 per band) with VLAN support for separating guest, staff and device networks
  • WPA/WPA2/WPA3 security across all wireless networks
  • Cudy Mesh compatible, with wireless, wired or multi-band backhaul options
  • Centralised management of up to 200 access points via the Cudy AP Controller (C200P)
  • Watchdog monitoring and scheduled reboot for consistent, low-maintenance uptime

Cudy is committed to making enterprise-grade networking simple to deploy and manage, from mesh routers to business access points. product.name: Asus Ascent GX10 AI Nvidia Grace Blackwell GB10 128GB DDR5 1TB SSD Ultra-small Super Computer
product.description:
Petaflop AI performance on your desk | 128GB coherent unified memory | Ultra-compact 150 x 150 x 51 mm form factor | NVIDIA ConnectX-7 scalable networking | Preloaded NVIDIA AI software stack

Quick Specs

  • Achieve petaflop-scale AI performance with the NVIDIA GB10 Grace Blackwell Superchip delivering 1 PFLOP of theoretical FP4 tensor performance
  • Experience seamless large-model work backed by 128 GB of LPDDR5x coherent unified system memory — enough to fine-tune models up to 200B parameters
  • Scale your AI infrastructure by linking up to multiple Ascent GX10 systems via the integrated NVIDIA ConnectX-7 NIC at 200 Gbps
  • Develop and deploy immediately with the preloaded NVIDIA AI Software Stack and NVIDIA DGX OS, ready from first boot
  • Fit petaflop-class compute anywhere — the Ascent GX10 measures just 150 x 150 x 51 mm and weighs 1.48 kg

Supercomputer-class AI, sized for your desk

The ASUS Ascent GX10 is a compact desktop AI supercomputer built for AI researchers, developers, data scientists, and machine learning engineers who demand serious compute without a dedicated server room. Powered by the NVIDIA GB10 Grace Blackwell Superchip — the same architecture found in NVIDIA DGX Spark — it delivers up to 1 PFLOP of theoretical FP4 AI performance and 128 GB of LPDDR5x coherent unified system memory in a chassis that measures just 150 x 150 x 51 mm and weighs 1.48 kg. This is petaflop-scale AI development that fits on a standard office desk.

The horsepower to handle your most demanding AI workloads

Tired of offloading every serious workload to the cloud because your local hardware simply cannot cope? The Ascent GX10 changes that equation. Its NVIDIA Blackwell GPU integrates fifth-generation Tensor Cores and fourth-generation RT Cores, while the 20-core Arm CPU — combining 10 Cortex-X925 and 10 Cortex-A725 cores — handles data preprocessing and model orchestration without breaking stride. With 128 GB of unified memory and up to 273 GB/s of memory bandwidth, the system can prototype, fine-tune, and run inference on large language models with hundreds of billions of parameters directly on-premises.

Scale beyond a single unit with NVIDIA ConnectX-7 networking

When a single unit is not enough, the integrated NVIDIA ConnectX-7 NIC at 200 Gbps enables you to link multiple Ascent GX10 systems together, scaling your AI workloads to handle even larger models. NVLink-C2C technology delivers a cohesive CPU and GPU memory model with substantially greater bandwidth than PCIe Gen 5, ensuring low-latency, high-throughput communication across distributed workloads. A dedicated 10 GbE RJ-45 port, Wi-Fi 7 2x2, and Bluetooth 5.4 round out the connectivity picture for everyday lab and office use.

Ready to develop from the moment it powers on

The Ascent GX10 ships with NVIDIA DGX OS and the full NVIDIA AI Software Stack preloaded, so you spend your time building models rather than configuring environments. Security-conscious deployments benefit from OpenShell secured containers and NemoClaw sandboxes, which provide private, on-device inference and governed access control for long-running autonomous agents. The engineered thermal design sustains peak performance across labs, offices, and edge environments alike — high-density compute that runs reliably wherever you need it.

  • 1 PFLOP of theoretical FP4 AI tensor performance via fifth-generation Tensor Cores

product.description:
Vivid AMOLED display | Built-in GPS | 12-day battery life | 5ATM water resistance | Comprehensive health tracking

Quick Specs

  • Enjoy a vivid 2.07-inch AMOLED display with 2000 nits peak brightness and a smooth 60Hz refresh rate for stunning clarity in any light.
  • Stay active with over 150 sports modes and built-in GPS to track your routes without needing your phone nearby.
  • Monitor your wellbeing continuously with heart rate, blood oxygen (SpO₂), sleep, and stress tracking all in one slim watch.
  • Go up to 12 days on a single charge in typical use, or stretch to 24 days in extended battery mode.
  • Wear it anywhere — 5ATM water resistance means it handles swimming and underwater heart rate detection with ease.

A Smart Watch Built for Every Part of Your Day

The Xiaomi Redmi Watch 6 in Glacier Blue is designed for anyone who wants a capable, stylish smart watch without compromise. Whether you're tracking a morning run, keeping tabs on your health throughout the day, or simply glancing at notifications during a meeting, the Redmi Watch 6 brings together a premium AMOLED display, built-in GPS, and multi-dimensional health monitoring in a slim 9.9mm profile with a high-strength aluminium alloy middle frame.

A Display That Commands Attention

The 2.07-inch AMOLED screen delivers a resolution of 432 x 514 pixels, an 82% screen-to-body ratio, and 2mm ultra-narrow equal bezels on all four sides. At 2000 nits peak brightness, the display remains perfectly legible even in direct sunlight. A 60Hz refresh rate keeps everything fluid, and the Colour Always-On Display (AOD) mode lets you check the time at a glance without a full wake gesture.

Track Every Workout, Every Route

Tired of leaving your phone behind on runs and losing your route data? With dual L1 antennas and built-in GPS, the Redmi Watch 6 records your path accurately — no phone required. Choose from over 150 sports modes to match virtually any activity, and benefit from a new heart rate window layout that supports underwater heart rate detection, even during swim sessions backed by 5ATM water resistance.

Health and Battery Life That Keep Pace With You

Multi-dimensional health management covers heart rate, blood oxygen (SpO₂), sleep, and stress monitoring, giving you a rounded picture of your wellbeing throughout the day and night. When it comes to keeping the watch running, the 550mAh battery delivers 12 days of typical use, up to 24 days in extended battery mode, and 7 days in Always-On Display mode — so you spend less time charging and more time doing.

product.name: Asus ZenScreen 16" FHD IPS 60Hz Portable Monitor
product.description:
A full-size second screen that fits in your bag | Plug-and-play USB Type-C connectivity | Two-way 65 W Power Pass-Through | TÜV-certified eye care | 16:10 aspect ratio for more vertical workspace

Quick Specs

  • Extend your workspace with a crisp 16-inch IPS panel delivering 1920×1200 resolution and a taller 16:10 aspect ratio for more vertical screen real estate
  • Connect with a single USB Type-C cable — dual full-function USB Type-C ports handle both power and video simultaneously for true plug-and-play portability
  • Keep your devices charged on the go with two-way Power Pass-Through delivering up to 65 W, so the monitor and your laptop share one power source
  • Enjoy comfortable all-day viewing with TÜV Rheinland-certified Flicker-Free and Low Blue Light technologies built into every session
  • Work in any orientation — auto-rotation via ASUS DisplayWidget Center switches seamlessly between landscape and portrait modes

Your Office, Wherever You Are

The ASUS ZenScreen MB16FC is built for hybrid workers and professionals who refuse to be limited by a single screen. Weighing just 0.9 kg and measuring a slender 1.1 cm thin, this 16-inch portable monitor slips into your bag as easily as a notebook — and sets up just as quickly, giving you a genuine dual-screen workflow at a client site, a coffee shop, or a co-working space.

More Screen Real Estate Where It Counts

Tired of constantly scrolling through long documents or cramped spreadsheets on a single display? The ZenScreen MB16FC's 16:10 aspect ratio delivers 11% more vertical viewing space than a standard 16:9 panel at the same screen size. With a 1920×1200 IPS panel, 300 nits of brightness, a 1000:1 contrast ratio, and 178° wide viewing angles, you see more of your work — in accurate, vivid colour — without sacrificing portability.

One Cable. Power and Picture, Sorted

The MB16FC features dual full-function USB Type-C ports, each supporting DisplayPort Alt Mode, so a single cable to your laptop delivers both the video signal and power to the monitor. The built-in Power Pass-Through goes further: when connected to a USB Type-C power bank or AC adapter, the monitor can simultaneously charge your laptop at up to 65 W — one cable, two devices, zero clutter. A Mini HDMI port provides broad compatibility for devices without USB Type-C.

Designed for Comfort and Versatility

Long sessions are easier on your eyes thanks to TÜV Rheinland-certified Flicker-Free and Low Blue Light technologies, both manageable through the ASUS SPLENDID colour engine. The built-in kickstand props the panel at a comfortable angle, a 1/4-inch tripod socket opens up further height and positioning options, and ASUS DisplayWidget Center software enables automatic screen rotation when you switch between landscape and portrait orientations — all without diving into display settings.

product.name: Anycubic Photon P1 Max Resin 3D Printer
product.description:
Large-format MSLA resin printing | Intelligent levelling and monitoring | Ultra-fine 0.02 mm layer detail | Quiet enough for home or studio use

Quick Specs

  • Print at scale with a massive 285.5 × 214 × 300 mm build volume — 18.3 litres of creative space in a single print cycle
  • Achieve exceptional detail with layer heights as fine as 0.02 mm across the full build area
  • Print with confidence using Leveling-Free 3.0 with automatic self-check, so every session starts right
  • Monitor and control your print remotely via the Anycubic App over Wi-Fi or Ethernet — no babysitting required
  • Enjoy whisper-quiet operation at ≤45 dB, making it suitable for studio, workshop, or home environments

Scale Up Without Compromise

The Anycubic Photon P1 Max is a large-format MSLA resin 3D printer built for creators, professionals, and production users who need serious build volume without sacrificing detail. With a 285.5 × 214 × 300 mm print volume — 18.3 litres of usable space — you can produce genuinely large models, dense batch runs, or tall intricate pieces in a single cycle, eliminating the need to split, glue, and re-align parts.

Precision Engineering, Layer by Layer

Tired of prints that look great in the slicer but disappoint on the platform? The Photon P1 Max is built to close that gap. A precision-ground steel build platform provides a stable, consistent adhesion surface, while the dual linear guide rails and ball lead screws on the Z-axis deliver smooth, repeatable motion with every layer. Layer heights range from 0.02 to 0.15 mm, giving you the flexibility to dial in ultra-fine detail or accelerate through faster, practical prints at up to 15–25 mm/h.

Intelligent Assistance That Gets Out of Your Way

Setting up a large-format resin printer has traditionally been the most frustrating part of the process. The Photon P1 Max addresses this head-on with Leveling-Free 3.0 — a system that combines automatic levelling self-check before each print, levelling feedback with real-time force values at all four corners, and factory calibration so the machine is ready straight out of the box. Power loss resume means an unexpected outage does not mean a wasted print. The integrated camera enables remote print submission and real-time monitoring through the Anycubic App, with dual-network connectivity via Wi-Fi and Ethernet for flexible, secure operation.

Built for the Long Run

The Photon P1 Max supports all Anycubic resins as well as 8000 cps high-viscosity resin, broadening your material options considerably. Dynamic temperature control on the resin vat helps maintain consistent resin viscosity during printing, while the hotbed can reach up to 35°C in ambient conditions of 5°C or above. Operating at ≤45 dB, it is quiet enough for a home workshop or shared studio space. Compatible slicer software includes Photon Workshop, Chitubox, Lychee, and Tango, so you can work in the environment you already know. Control is available via the 4.5-inch resistive touchscreen, the Anycubic App, or USB drive — whichever suits your workflow.

Features

  • Large 285.5 × 214 × 300 mm (18.3L) build volume — print large single pieces or maximise batch output in one cycle
  • MSLA resin printing technology with layer heights from 0.02 to 0.15 mm for fine detail across the full build area
  • Leveling-Free 3.0 with automatic self-check, levelling feedback, and factory calibration — ready to print from first power-on
  • Precision-ground steel build platform paired with dual linear guide rails and ball lead screws on the Z-axis for repeatable accuracy
  • Dynamic temperature control on the resin vat maintains consistent viscosity; hotbed reaches up to 35°C at ≥5°C ambient
  • Integrated camera for remote print submission and real-time progress monitoring via the Anycubic App
  • Dual-network connectivity: Wi-Fi and Ethernet, plus USB Drive support for flexible print submission
  • Quiet operation at ≤45 dB; compatible with Photon Workshop, Chitubox, Lychee, and Tango slicers
  • Power loss resume protects in-progress prints from unexpected interruptions
  • Supports all Anycubic resins and 8000 cps high-viscosity resin

Anycubic has been engineering desktop resin and filament 3D printers since 2015, combining precision mechanics with accessible, intelligent software to help makers, engineers, and artists bring their ideas to life. The Xiaomi Mijia Vacuum Cleaner 4 Pro / 4 Max Filter Kit is a replacement filter set designed to keep your vacuum performing at its best. The kit includes two pre-filters and one H14 HEPA post-filter, working together within the vacuum's multi-stage filtration system to capture particles as small as 0.3μm with up to 99.99% filtration efficiency. The pre-filters intercept larger particles and debris before they can reach the motor or clog the post-filter, helping extend the overall lifespan of your vacuum. This reusable design reduces consumable waste and keeps running costs down over time. Replacement is straightforward: press the dust compartment release button, swap out the old filters, insert the new ones until you hear a click, and you're done. product.description:

Quick Specs

  • Experience up to 35 hours of total playback with the charging case — music that lasts as long as your day
  • Enjoy lossless audio via aptX Lossless and aptX Adaptive codecs with transmission rates up to 2.1 Mbps
  • Block out the world with active noise cancellation and a triple-microphone AI call noise cancellation system
  • Connect seamlessly to two devices at once with multipoint (dual-device) Bluetooth 5.4 connectivity
  • Wear them all day in comfort — each earbud weighs just 4.4 g with an ergonomic semi-in-ear design

Pure Sound, Pure Comfort — Wherever the Day Takes You

The Xiaomi Buds 6 in Nebula Purple are true wireless in-ear headphones built for listeners who refuse to compromise on sound quality or comfort. Whether you're commuting, working from home, or simply unwinding, these earbuds deliver high-resolution lossless audio in a lightweight, ergonomic design that you can wear for hours without fatigue.

Lossless Audio That Lets You Hear Every Detail

At the heart of the Xiaomi Buds 6 is a custom 11 mm triple-magnet gold-plated driver capable of reproducing a frequency range of 16 Hz to 40 kHz. Paired with support for aptX Lossless, aptX Adaptive, LC3, AAC, and SBC codecs — with transmission rates reaching up to 2.1 Mbps via Bluetooth LE Audio — the Buds 6 deliver end-to-end lossless audio quality that rivals a wired listening experience. Harman AudioEFX tuning, developed in collaboration with the Harman Golden Ears team, gives you the choice between two expert-crafted sound profiles, plus additional modes to tailor the sound to your taste.

Tired of Background Noise Ruining Your Focus or Your Calls?

Active noise cancellation on the Buds 6 reduces environmental noise without cutting you off entirely from the world around you — important audio cues like voices and traffic remain audible for safer, more aware listening. For calls, a triple-microphone AI system actively filters ambient noise, delivering stable, clear voice capture even in loud environments. Whether you're in a busy open-plan office or stepping out onto a noisy street, your calls and your music stay clear.

All-Day Battery, Built-In Smarts

Each earbud delivers up to 6 hours of playback on a single charge (ANC off), with the compact charging case extending that to 35 hours in total. Bluetooth 5.4 with multipoint connectivity means you can stay paired to two devices simultaneously and switch between them effortlessly. Customisable gesture controls, compatibility with Apple Find My and Google Find Hub for locating your case, and IP54 water resistance on the earbuds themselves round out a feature set designed for real, everyday use.

  • Active noise cancellation (ANC) for immersive listening without total isolation
  • Triple-microphone AI call noise cancellation for clear voice pickup in noisy environments
  • Up to 6 hours playback per charge (ANC off); up to 35 hours total with the charging case (ANC off)

product.name: Xiaomi Mijia Smart Air Purifier with Humidification Pro
product.description:
Pure, moist air for every room | 2-in-1 purification and humidification | Ultra-quiet 14.6 dB(A) sleep mode | Smart app and voice control | Up to 16 hours continuous humidification

Quick Specs

  • Purify and humidify simultaneously with a 2-in-1 system that tackles dust, bacteria, allergens, and dry air in one pass.
  • Achieve cleaner air in a 24 m² living room in just 10 minutes with a 400 m³/h CADR.
  • Enjoy up to 16 hours of continuous humidification from the 8 L water tank — no mid-night refills needed.
  • Rest undisturbed with sleep mode noise as low as 14.6 dB(A), quieter than a whisper.
  • Control air quality and humidity from anywhere via the Xiaomi Home app, Google Assistant, or Alexa.

Cleaner Air and Comfortable Humidity, All in One

The Xiaomi Mijia Smart Air Purifier with Humidification Pro is designed for households that want more than just filtered air. By combining a HEPA + Carbon purification stage with a high-capacity evaporative humidifier in a single appliance, it tackles dust, allergens, bacteria, and dry indoor air without the need for two separate devices. Whether it is allergy season, a dry winter, or simply the daily grind of indoor pollution in the modern South African home, this purifier adapts to deliver comfortable, breathable air year-round.

Purification First, Then Humidification

Tired of humidifiers that simply recirculate unclean air? The Mijia Smart Air Purifier with Humidification Pro routes air through a dedicated HEPA + Carbon purification filter before it ever reaches the humidification stage, so the moisture delivered into your room is already clean. The result is humidification that hydrates rather than contaminates. A UV-C sterilisation module built into the water circuit continuously works to deactivate bacteria in the water pathway, while the cool evaporative method produces no mist or water marks on furniture. With a rated humidification capacity of 1800 mL/h and an 8 L water tank, it can humidify continuously for up to 16 hours in sleep mode without a refill.

Removes 12 Common Air Pollutants

From fine particulate matter to household bacteria and pet dander, the dual-filter system is tested against a broad range of pollutants. The HEPA + Carbon filter combination targets PM1, PM2.5, and PM10 particles, as well as allergens from cat dander, dog dander, and dust mites. A 400 m³/h CADR rating means a 24 m² living room can be purified in around 10 minutes, while smaller spaces such as a children's room or bedroom are cleared even faster. The air quality sensor monitors PM1, PM2.5, dust, temperature, and humidity in real time, so you always know exactly what you are breathing.

Whisper-Quiet Nights and Smart Daily Control

Sleep mode brings noise down to just 14.6 dB(A) — a level so low it is unlikely to disturb even light sleepers — while the LCD dome display automatically dims its brightness to match the ambient light in your room. During the day, the Xiaomi Home app gives you full remote control: check air quality readings, adjust humidity targets, schedule on/off times, monitor filter life, and create smart home scenes. Voice control via Google Assistant and Alexa means you can make adjustments without touching the unit. The 360° swivel caster wheels make it easy to move the purifier between rooms as needed, so clean air follows you through the home.

Practical Design Built for Everyday Life

Refilling the 8 L water tank requires no bending — simply top up from above or remove the tank entirely using the built-in handle. An illuminated water level indicator keeps you informed at a glance, and a child safety lock prevents accidental changes by little hands or curious pets. The washable humidification filter extends service life and simplifies maintenance, while the anti-backflow water circuit design helps reduce water discolouration and dirt build-up over time. Power consumption in purification-only mode is 36 W, rising to 55 W when humidification is active.

Features

  • HEPA + Carbon dual-filter system removes particulate matter, bacteria, and allergens.

product.name: Xiaomi Robot Vacuum 6 Pro
product.description:
30 000 Pa suction power | AI triple-camera obstacle avoidance | Running-water roller mopping | 85°C self-cleaning omni station | Up to 75 days hands-free

Quick Specs

  • Achieve deep cleaning with extraordinary 30 000 Pa hurricane suction power for dust, hair and debris.
  • Avoid obstacles intelligently with AI triple-camera panoramic recognition of 280+ item types, TÜV Rheinland certified.
  • Enjoy hands-free maintenance with auto-emptying dust bag lasting up to 75 days between changes.
  • Experience spotless floors with constant-pressure running-water roller mopping and 85°C hot-water mop washing.
  • Control cleaning from anywhere via the Xiaomi Home app, or with a simple Google Assistant or Alexa voice command.

Smarter, Deeper Cleaning for Every Corner of Your Home

The Xiaomi Robot Vacuum 6 Pro is built for households that demand more from their cleaning routine. With extraordinary 30 000 Pa suction, AI-powered triple-camera obstacle avoidance, and a constant-pressure running-water roller mop, it tackles dust, debris and stubborn stains across every room — all while taking care of itself so you don't have to. Whether you share your home with pets, children or both, the Robot Vacuum 6 Pro adapts intelligently to your environment, making it the most capable addition to the modern South African home.

Sees Your Home as Clearly as You Do

Tired of robot vacuums blundering into cables, slippers and pet bowls? The Robot Vacuum 6 Pro uses an AI triple-camera panoramic system paired with 360° LiDAR navigation to recognise 280 types of common obstacles — including earphone cables as thin as 3 mm — and navigate around them with ease. Its Xiaomi-customised AI model also identifies 47 types of dry and wet stains, such as cat litter, dog food and spilled milk, adjusting its cleaning strategy automatically to avoid smearing messes across your floor. All recognition is TÜV Rheinland certified.

Running-Water Mopping That Actually Removes Stubborn Stains

Ordinary mop pads drag dirty water back across your floors. The Robot Vacuum 6 Pro's upgraded roller mopping system uses 16 water outlets to keep the mop pad continuously moist, combined with constant-pressure human-like mopping action that effectively lifts semi-dried coffee stains and everyday grime. A built-in scraper continuously removes dirty water from the roller as it works, so you're always mopping with a clean surface. Dual mechanical arms extend the roller mop and side brush along walls, edges and corners for thorough coverage where it matters most.

A Self-Cleaning Base Station That Does the Hard Work for You

After every cleaning session, the Robot Vacuum 6 Pro returns to its omni station for a full self-service cycle. The mop pad is washed at up to 85°C and dried with 50°C hot air — no manual drying or mould-prone wet pads left sitting overnight. Dust is automatically transferred into a sealed disposable bag that only needs replacing once every 75 days. The station handles four levels of mop washing water temperature and three drying duration modes, so maintenance fits around your schedule rather than the other way around.

Navigates Every Corner, Step and Low Space

The Robot Vacuum 6 Pro is designed to reach the areas most robot vacuums simply give up on. Its omnidirectional wheel automatically lifts to climb vertical steps up to 3 cm high, and in vacuum mode it can cross combined dual-step obstacles up to 4 cm high — reaching balconies, bathrooms and kitchens without hesitation. High-precision sensors measure clearances to millimetre accuracy, and the retractable LiDAR allows the robot to clean spaces as low as 9.3 cm, including under sofas and low furniture. All of this is managed through the Xiaomi Home app, where you can set virtual walls, define cleaning zones, enable carpet modes and monitor progress in real time — or simply say the word to Google Assistant or Alexa.

  • Constant-pressure running-water roller mopping with 16 water outlets and a built-in scraper for continuously clean mopping.
  • Dual mechanical arms extend the roller mop and side brush to walls, edges and corners for thorough edge cleaning.
  • Up to 4 cm combined dual-step climbing (3 cm first step + 1 cm second step) in vacuum mode; single-step climb up to 3 cm.
  • Retractable LiDAR enables cleaning in spaces as low as 9.3 cm without the robot getting stuck.
  • 85°C hot-water mop pad washing and 50°C hot air drying at the omni station — no manual drying required.
  • Auto-emptying with sealed disposable dust bag; up to 75 days between manual bag changes.
  • Anti-tangle automatic hair-cutting brush and anti-tangle side brush reduce hair entanglement during cleaning.
  • 5 200 mAh (nominal) battery with 4.5-hour full charge time.
  • App control via Xiaomi Home app (Android 8.0 / iOS 14.0 and above); voice control via Google Assistant and Alexa.
  • Pet-friendly AI monitoring — view your home in real time via the app's HD camera feed.
  • OTA upgrades keep the robot growing smarter over time.

product.description:
Lossless sound in a feather-light fit | Up to 35 hours total battery life | Active noise cancellation | Multipoint Bluetooth 5.4 | IP54 splash resistance

Quick Specs

  • Experience up to 6 hours of playback per charge and 35 hours total with the charging case for worry-free listening all day
  • Enjoy lossless audio quality with aptX Lossless and aptX Adaptive codecs, transmitting at up to 2.1 Mbps for CD-quality sound
  • Tune out the world with active noise cancellation and a triple-microphone AI call noise cancellation system
  • Connect to two devices simultaneously with multipoint (dual-device) connection and switch between them effortlessly
  • Stay protected with an IP54 water and dust resistance rating on the earbuds, so everyday splashes are never a concern

Pure sound, pure comfort — wherever your day takes you

The Xiaomi Buds 6 are true wireless in-ear earbuds designed for listeners who refuse to compromise on audio quality or comfort. Weighing just 4.4 g per earbud and shaped with a biomimetic curved design, they sit gently in the ear without pressure — making them as suited to an extended work-from-home session as they are to a morning commute. With support for aptX Lossless, aptX Adaptive, LC3, AAC, and SBC codecs, the Buds 6 are built for the full spectrum of modern listening.

An 11 mm driver that earns its keep

At the heart of the Xiaomi Buds 6 is an 11 mm triple-magnet gold-plated driver, custom-engineered to deliver powerful bass alongside crisp, refined treble. A 24K gold-plated diaphragm enhances high-frequency sensitivity, while a 16 Hz–40 kHz frequency response ensures you hear every layer of your music, from the deepest sub-bass to the finest high-frequency detail. Two Harman AudioEFX sound modes — developed in collaboration with the Harman Golden Ears team — let you choose between a clear, transparent presentation and a warmer, more enveloping sound signature.

Tired of calls that sound like you're underwater?

The Buds 6 address this with a triple-microphone AI call noise cancellation system that isolates your voice even in environments with up to 95 dB of ambient noise. Active noise cancellation (ANC) runs simultaneously, reducing environmental distractions without cutting you off from important audio cues like voices or traffic. Whether you're taking a call from a busy café or working late in an open-plan office, your conversations stay clear and stable.

Smart features that keep you in control

Bluetooth 5.4 ensures a stable, low-latency connection over up to 10 m in open space, while multipoint connectivity lets you stay linked to two devices at once — your laptop and smartphone, for example — and switch between them without re-pairing. Customisable touch gestures cover playback, volume, calls, and noise cancellation. The earbuds are also compatible with Apple Find My and Google's Find Hub, so you can locate your case quickly if it goes astray. The IP54-rated earbuds handle everyday splashes and light perspiration without concern.

Premium design meets intelligent living

The Xiaomi Watch S5 46mm is crafted for those who refuse to compromise between style and substance. Built from durable 316L stainless steel at just 46g, its slim 10.99mm profile sits comfortably on the wrist all day without weighing you down. The integrated bezel design and ultra-slim 2.6mm bezel frame a 1.48" AMOLED display at 480 x 480 resolution, delivering rich colour and sharp detail whether you're checking a notification at your desk or glancing at your heart rate mid-run.

Battery life that keeps up with your lifestyle

Tired of charging your smartwatch every other night? The Xiaomi Watch S5 46mm's 815mAh Xiaomi Surge Battery delivers up to 21 days of use in light usage mode and up to 14 days under normal usage conditions — so you can wear it through weeks of workdays, gym sessions, and weekend adventures before needing to plug in. Even with Always-On Display enabled, you can expect up to 9 days of runtime, giving you flexibility without sacrifice.

Your personal health companion, always on your wrist

Powered by a new four-LED, four-PD heart rate and blood oxygen sensor, the Watch S5 monitors your heart rate and SpO₂ levels continuously throughout the day, alerting you if blood oxygen drops too low. Advanced sleep monitoring — developed in collaboration with international sleep organisations — tracks sleep stages, onset, and wake patterns with improved accuracy, while the sleep improvement plan offers tailored recommendations to help you rest better. All-day stress monitoring, women's health tracking, and one-tap health checkups round out a comprehensive wellness toolkit that works quietly in the background.

Built for every workout, ready for any terrain

With over 150 sport modes and a dual-band five-system GNSS chip supporting BeiDou, GPS, GLONASS, Galileo, and QZSS, the Watch S5 tracks your routes, pace, and performance with precision outdoors. Full-colour offline maps, route navigation, backtracking, and off-route alerts make it a capable companion for trail runs and hikes. Whether you're heading out for a long weekend hike or a back-to-back week of meetings, the watch keeps going without demanding a mid-day top-up.

Advanced health tracking you can rely on

Equipped with a four-LED, four-PD heart rate and blood oxygen sensor running Xiaomi's proprietary heart rate algorithm 2.0, the Watch S5 46mm monitors your health continuously throughout the day. All-day SpO₂ monitoring alerts you when blood oxygen drops too low, while all-day stress monitoring prompts you to pause and breathe when levels climb. Advanced sleep monitoring — developed in collaboration with international sleep health organisations — tracks sleep stages accurately and delivers personalised improvement plans. Women's health management, breathing exercises, and a one-tap health checkup round out a genuinely comprehensive wellness companion.

Built for the outdoors, ready for everything else

With dual-band five-system GNSS covering GPS, Galileo, GLONASS, BeiDou and QZSS, the Watch S5 46mm delivers accurate, real-time route tracking whether you're cycling, running, skiing, or exploring unfamiliar terrain. Over 150 sport modes cover the full range of activities, while features like route navigation with offline maps, backtracking, and off-route alerts make it a genuine outdoor tool. Rated at 5ATM water resistance, it handles swimming pools and near-shore swimming with ease. When the workout is done, tap to pay with built-in NFC at any Mastercard® or Visa® contactless terminal — no phone needed.

34-inch UWQHD curved gaming display | 180 Hz refresh rate with 1 ms GTG response | FreeSync Premium tear-free technology | HDR 400 with 95% DCI-P3 colour | Fully adjustable ergonomic stand

Quick Specs

Command Every Battlefield on the Xiaomi G34WQi 2026

The Xiaomi Curved Gaming Monitor G34WQi 2026 is built for passionate gamers who refuse to compromise. Combining a sweeping 34-inch ultra-wide UWQHD panel, a 180 Hz high refresh rate, and a 1500R curvature, it delivers the kind of immersive, responsive gaming experience that separates contenders from the rest. Whether you're grinding ranked matches or exploring vast open worlds, this monitor puts every competitive advantage firmly in your hands.

A Panoramic View That Pulls You Into the Game

Tired of feeling like a spectator on a narrow screen? The G34WQi 2026 changes that with its 34-inch VA panel and 21:9 ultra-wide aspect ratio — delivering a field of view 30% broader than traditional 16:9 displays. The 1500R curvature mirrors the natural arc of human vision, maintaining a consistent eye-to-screen distance across the entire panel for a genuinely immersive experience. With UWQHD 3440×1440 resolution, every environment, texture, and enemy position is rendered with exceptional clarity and detail.

Speed and Precision When It Matters Most

In competitive gaming, every millisecond counts. The G34WQi 2026's 180 Hz refresh rate ensures seamlessly smooth visuals even through the most frantic fast-paced action, while the 1 ms GTG response time virtually eliminates ghosting and motion blur. FreeSync Premium synchronises your GPU's output with the display's refresh rate, banishing screen tearing and stuttering at the decisive moments that decide victory or defeat — so your reactions always land where your eyes do.

Vivid Colour, Deeper Contrast, True-to-Life Realism

The G34WQi 2026 goes beyond speed to deliver visuals that are as beautiful as they are precise. HDR 400 expands the brightness and contrast range to reveal deeper shadow detail and crisper highlights, while 95% DCI-P3 and 100% sRGB wide colour gamut coverage reproduces 1.07 billion colours with rich, lifelike accuracy. A peak brightness of 400 nits keeps bright scenes crisp and readable, and the 3500:1 contrast ratio ensures dark areas never lose their depth. TÜV Rheinland low blue light certification and DC dimming further reduce eye fatigue during long sessions, making the G34WQi 2026 as comfortable as it is capable.

Designed to Fit Your Setup, Your Way

The G34WQi 2026 is as thoughtfully engineered off-screen as on it. The versatile stand supports height adjustment, tilt (5° forward, 21° backward), and swivel, so you can dial in your perfect ergonomic position. VESA 100×100 mm wall-mount compatibility (bracket sold separately) gives you the flexibility to mount the display exactly where you need it. Dual DP 1.4 and dual HDMI 2.0 ports ensure you can connect multiple devices without sacrificing bandwidth, and the intuitive joystick control makes navigating on-screen settings effortless.

Stay connected, however you work

Tired of switching mice between your laptop, desktop, and tablet? product.name: Seagate SkyHawk Surveillance 8TB 256MB 3.5" SATA HDD
product.description:
Purpose-built for 24/7 surveillance | Supports up to 64 HD camera streams | 8TB of high-capacity storage | ImagePerfect firmware for uninterrupted recording | 1 million hours MTBF reliability

The Seagate SkyHawk Surveillance 8TB HDD is built for security installers and system integrators who need a drive that can keep pace with the demands of continuous video recording. Engineered specifically for NVR and DVR environments, it supports simultaneous streams from up to 64 HD cameras without frame loss, thanks to ImagePerfect firmware that minimises interruptions during 24/7 operation. A maximum sustained transfer rate of 180 MB/s keeps footage flowing reliably, while built-in rotational vibration (RV) sensors maintain performance stability in multi-bay systems with up to 16 drive bays. With a workload rating of 180 TB per year, a mean time between failures of 1 million hours, and tarnish-resistant components that guard against environmental wear, this drive is designed for the long haul. SkyHawk Health Management adds an extra layer of assurance through prevention, intervention, and recovery tools — including RAID RapidRebuild for faster volume recovery. At 8TB capacity on a standard 3.5-inch SATA 6 Gb/s interface, it slots directly into existing surveillance infrastructure and delivers the dependable, high-capacity storage that serious security systems demand.

The Seagate SkyHawk Surveillance 2TB HDD is built for security installers and system integrators who need a drive that can keep pace with the demands of continuous video recording. Engineered specifically for NVR and DVR environments, it supports simultaneous streams from up to 64 HD cameras without frame loss, thanks to ImagePerfect firmware that minimises interruptions during 24/7 operation. A maximum sustained transfer rate of 180MB/s keeps footage flowing reliably, while built-in rotational vibration (RV) sensors maintain performance stability in multi-bay systems with up to 16 drive bays. product.name: ASUS TUF Gaming GeForce RTX 5090 32GB GDDR7 OC Edition Graphics Card
product.description:
NVIDIA Blackwell architecture at its peak | 32GB GDDR7 for extreme gaming and creative workloads | Military-grade durability with advanced cooling mastery | DLSS 4 Multi Frame Generation and full ray tracing

Quick Specs

  • Dominate at 4K and beyond with the NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 GPU and a blazing 2580MHz OC boost clock
  • Experience ultra-fast 32GB of GDDR7 memory across a 512-bit interface at 28Gbps for uncompromising bandwidth
  • Stay cool under fire with a triple-fan Axial-tech cooling system, 12 heatpipes, and a vapour chamber in a robust 3.6-slot design
  • Connect up to four displays simultaneously via 2 x HDMI 2.1b and 3 x DisplayPort 2.1b outputs
  • Built to last with military-grade components, protective PCB coating, and dual-ball fan bearings rated up to 80,000 hours

The Pinnacle of GeForce RTX Performance

The ASUS TUF Gaming GeForce RTX 5090 32GB GDDR7 OC Edition is built for the most demanding gamers and creators who refuse to compromise. Powered by NVIDIA's Blackwell architecture, it delivers a class-leading 2580MHz OC boost clock, 21,760 CUDA cores, and 32GB of GDDR7 memory running at 28Gbps across a 512-bit bus — the raw horsepower to handle 4K gaming, AI-accelerated creative workflows, and beyond.

AI-Powered Gaming: DLSS 4 and Full Ray Tracing

Tired of choosing between visual fidelity and frame rate? NVIDIA DLSS 4 with Multi Frame Generation, powered by fifth-generation Tensor Cores, uses AI to multiply frame rates while preserving stunning image quality. Fourth-generation RT Cores unlock the full realism of ray tracing — cinematic lighting, reflections, and shadows rendered at unprecedented speeds. NVIDIA Reflex 2 with Frame Warp further sharpens responsiveness, giving competitive players the edge where milliseconds matter.

Cooling Mastery Built for the Long Haul

The TUF Gaming RTX 5090 deploys a comprehensive thermal arsenal: a vapour chamber paired with 12 heatpipes draws heat away from the GPU efficiently, while three Axial-tech fans — spinning on dual-ball bearings rated for up to 80,000 hours — push up to 23% more air than standard fans. The two outer fans spin counterclockwise to reduce turbulence, and all three stop entirely when GPU temperatures drop below 50°C for near-silent operation during lighter tasks. A premium phase-change GPU thermal pad melts to fill microscopic gaps between the GPU die and heatsink, optimising thermal conductivity under sustained loads.

Military-Grade Durability You Can Count On

Every component inside the TUF Gaming RTX 5090 is selected for longevity. Certified military-grade TUF chokes and MOSFETs ensure rock-solid power delivery, while TUF 5K black metallic capacitors offer a 2.5x longer lifespan than standard capacitors. A protective conformal PCB coating guards the board against moisture, dust, and debris. ASUS GPU Guard adhesive secures all four GPU corners to reduce crack risk, and Auto-Extreme automated manufacturing — single-pass soldering with no harsh cleaning chemicals — results in a more reliable, consistently built card. Connect it via the single 16-pin power connector and pair it with at minimum a 1000 W power supply to keep the system stable under full load.

Cooling That Keeps Pace With Your CPU

Tired of watching your CPU throttle under heavy workloads? The Prime LC 360 ARGB White Edition uses a specially designed CPU contact area with a copper block that maximises surface contact, allowing heat to transfer away from the processor more efficiently. The result is a cooler that maintains optimal operating temperatures even when your system is working hard, helping your CPU sustain its performance rather than backing off under load.

A Pump Block Built to Be Seen

Instead of hiding the pump under the radiator, ASUS puts it front and centre with an LCD screen and customisable infinity mirror lens. The LCD display adds a layered visual element to the pump block, while the infinity mirror lens can be swapped out to change the look of your build. Combined with AURA Sync-enabled ARGB lighting, it gives you real control over how your cooler fits into the rest of your rig's aesthetic.

Fans and Lighting, Simplified

The three integrated 120mm ARGB fans on the radiator are wired through a single two-header cable that carries both power and lighting signal, cutting down on the usual tangle of cables inside a case. This keeps your build looking tidy without sacrificing airflow, and with 400mm of sleeved tubing and support for Intel LGA 1851, 1700, 1200 and 115X as well as AMD AM5 and AM4 sockets, it slots into a wide range of builds with plenty of routing flexibility.

Smarter, More Powerful Cleaning for Every Home

The Xiaomi Robot Vacuum 6 is designed for households that refuse to compromise on cleanliness. With a powerful 30,000Pa suction motor, an ultra-slim 90mm body that slips beneath furniture with ease, and roller mopping that uses running water to tackle stubborn stains, it brings professional-grade floor care to the modern South African home — all without lifting a finger.

Tired of Robot Vacuums That Miss Obstacles or Spread Mess?

Mopping That Actually Removes Stains

product.name: Xiaomi Mijia Vacuum Cleaner 4
product.description:
Powerful cordless cleaning | 90-minute runtime | Blue light dust detection | H13 HEPA filtration | Multi-surface attachments

Quick Specs

  • Experience powerful 25 000 Pa suction and 230AW airwatts to lift everyday dust, debris, and hair effortlessly.
  • Enjoy up to 90 minutes of runtime on a single charge — enough to tackle the whole home in one go.
  • Reveal hidden dust with a 180° blue light that makes fine particles under beds and sofas clearly visible.
  • Breathe easier with a 5-stage H13-grade HEPA filtration system capturing 99.99% of particles as small as 0.3μm.
  • Clean every corner with five dedicated attachments covering floors, mattresses, crevices, and hard-to-reach spaces.

Whole-Home Cleaning, Reimagined

The Xiaomi Mijia Vacuum Cleaner 4 is built for households that demand serious performance without the constraints of a cord. Delivering up to 25 000 Pa of suction power and 230AW of consistent airflow, it handles everything from fine dust and pet hair to stubborn debris across multiple floor types — all from a single, lightweight device. Whether you're working through open-plan living areas or navigating the tight corners of a busy South African home, this cordless vacuum is designed to keep pace with your life.

See What You've Been Missing

Tired of vacuuming a room only to spot dust you missed the moment the light catches the floor? The Mijia Vacuum Cleaner 4 addresses this with a 180° blue light dust-revealing system built into the all-flooring brush bar. With a 30 cm illumination range and up to 30x dust magnification, fine particles hiding under sofas, beds, and along skirting boards become clearly visible — so you clean with confidence rather than guesswork.

Smart Suction That Adapts As You Clean

Built-in infrared sensors detect dust levels in real time, and in Auto mode the vacuum automatically adjusts suction power to match what it finds. Heavy debris triggers maximum suction; lighter dust draws less power, conserving battery life. The LED smart display keeps you informed at a glance, showing battery level, cleaning mode, and a colour-coded dirt indicator — blue for clean, yellow for light dirt, orange for heavy dirt — so you always know exactly what's happening.

Anti-Tangle Design and Long-Lasting Filtration

Long hair is the bane of most vacuum brush heads, but the Mijia Vacuum Cleaner 4 tackles it with dual anti-tangle technology. Built-in comb teeth on the all-flooring brush bar detangle hair during vacuuming, while the mini electric brush uses a single-arm floating roller that channels hair directly into the suction airflow. Behind the brushes, 12-cone cyclonic separation keeps airflow stable and extends filter life, feeding into a 5-stage precision filtration system that traps 99.99% of fine particles — including dust mites — and returns cleaner air to your space.

Features

  • 25 000 Pa maximum suction power with 230AW consistent airflow for rapid removal of dust, debris, and hair.
  • Up to 90 minutes of runtime in Eco mode on a single removable, replaceable lithium-ion battery.
  • 180° blue light dust-revealing with 30 cm illumination range and 30x dust magnification for thorough cleaning.
  • Auto mode with real-time infrared dust detection automatically adjusts suction for efficient, energy-conscious cleaning.
