Quick Specs

  • Experience whole-home cleaning power with 27,000 Pa maximum suction and 280AW stable airflow.
  • Reveal hidden dust with 180° wide-angle blue-light detection that illuminates fine particles in dark spaces.
  • Reach every blind spot effortlessly using the bendable tube to clean under sofas, beds, and shelves.
  • Enjoy up to 90 minutes of runtime on a single charge for uninterrupted whole-home cleaning.
  • Achieve 99.99% filtration efficiency with a 5-stage H14-grade HEPA system capturing particles as small as 0.3μm.

Whole-Home Cleaning Power, Reimagined

The Xiaomi Mijia Vacuum Cleaner 4 Pro is built for households that refuse to settle for surface-level clean. Powered by a high-speed brushless motor delivering up to 27,000 Pa of suction pressure and 280AW of airflow, it tackles everything from fine dust and hair to larger debris across hard floors, wooden floors, and carpets. With six specialised attachments, a bendable tube, and smart dirt detection that automatically adjusts suction to the task at hand, the Mijia Vacuum Cleaner 4 Pro is the kind of thorough, versatile clean that the modern South African home deserves.

See the Dust You've Been Missing

Tired of vacuuming under the bed only to find you've missed half of what was there? The 180° wide-angle blue-light dust detection system illuminates fine particles in dark, low-clearance spaces — under sofas, beds, and in dimly lit corners — magnifying dust up to 30 times so you can clean with precision rather than guesswork. Combined with smart dirt sensors that detect dust levels in real time during Auto mode, the vacuum adjusts suction power automatically, so you get thorough cleaning without wasting battery life.

Reach Every Spot Without the Strain

Low furniture shouldn't mean a sore back. The included bendable tube lets you manoeuvre into tight clearance spots — under sofas, bookshelves, beds, and wall-mounted décor — without bending or contorting. The right edge-cleaning design on the brush bar follows skirting boards and corners closely, picking up gap dust in a single pass. Whether you're tackling the main living area or the hard-to-reach nooks, this vacuum is designed to cover every corner of your home with minimal effort.

Deep Filtration, Long-Lasting Performance

The Mijia Vacuum Cleaner 4 Pro's 5-stage precision filtration system captures 99.99% of particles, including those as small as 0.3μm, thanks to an H14-grade HEPA filter at its final stage. The 12-cone cyclone separation technology efficiently separates dust from airflow, minimising filter blockages, reducing suction loss over time, and extending filter life. The dual anti-tangle design on both the all-flooring brush bar and the mini electric brush helps handle up to 200 strands of long hair with minimal tangling, keeping maintenance straightforward. Key accessories are washable and reusable, reducing waste and running costs over the long term.

product.description:

Quick Specs

  • Achieve powerful deep cleaning with up to 26,000 Pa of suction across four versatile operating modes.
  • Enjoy steam cleaning at up to 160°C to sanitise floors without harsh chemicals.
  • Experience tangle-free performance with a roller brush featuring an anti-hair-tangling system and comb teeth.
  • Benefit from effortless maintenance with hot water self-cleaning and roller drying on the cleaning base.
  • Clean freely for up to 40 minutes on a single charge in absorption mode.

Complete Floor Cleaning, Simplified

The Xiaomi Mijia TruClean 5 Pro Wet Dry Vacuum is built for households that demand more than a basic sweep. Whether you're tackling dry crumbs, wet spills, or ground-in grime on hard floors, this cordless vacuum handles it all in a single pass — making it the all-in-one floor care solution for the modern South African home.

Four Modes, One Powerful Machine

Tired of swapping between multiple cleaning tools to get your floors truly clean? The TruClean 5 Pro offers four dedicated operating modes — Standard, Steam, Absorption, and Power — so you can match the cleaning intensity to the task at hand. With a maximum suction power of 26,000 Pa, even stubborn debris doesn't stand a chance, while Steam mode delivers heat up to 160°C for a deeper, more hygienic clean.

A Brush That Battles Tangles So You Don't Have To

Hair — whether pet or human — is one of the most frustrating things to find wrapped around a vacuum's roller. The TruClean 5 Pro's brush system features an anti-hair-tangling mechanism with comb teeth that actively prevent hair from building up around the roller, so your vacuum keeps performing at its best with minimal intervention. The 180° device tilt angle also lets you reach effortlessly under furniture and into low spaces that other vacuums miss.

Maintenance That Practically Does Itself

After a cleaning session, simply return the vacuum to its cleaning base and let it take care of the rest. The base charges the battery, washes the roller with hot water at up to 100°C, and then dries it — all automatically. With a clean water tank capacity of at least 1 litre and a 700 ml dirty water tank, you can cover meaningful floor area before needing to refill or empty. The result is a cleaner that stays fresh and ready for the next clean, without the usual maintenance hassle.

Supporting Intel Core Ultra (Series 2) processors on the LGA1851 socket, it lays a foundation capable of handling the most demanding gaming sessions, creative workloads, and AI-accelerated tasks — all without breaking a sweat. Whether you're pushing frames in a competitive title or stress-testing a new build, this board is engineered for non-stop, 24/7 performance.

Power Delivery That Goes the Distance

Tired of VRM throttling undermining your overclock? The Z890 GAMING WIFI6E features a 12+1+1+1 Duet Rail Power System with dual 8-pin CPU power connectors, MSI Core Boost technology, and a 6-layer server-grade PCB. The Extended Heatsink and 7W/mK MOSFET thermal pads ensure sustained power delivery without heat becoming a bottleneck, so your CPU can run at its best under sustained load.

Connectivity That Keeps Up with Your Build

With Wi-Fi 6E delivering up to 2.4 Gbps across 2.4 GHz, 5 GHz, and 6 GHz bands, combined with Bluetooth 5.3 and a Realtek 2.5Gbps LAN port, you're covered for both wired and wireless at the top of the range. The rear panel includes six USB 5Gbps Type-A ports and a USB 20Gbps Type-C port, while a front USB 20Gbps Type-C header ensures your case's front panel keeps pace. MSI's AI LAN Manager intelligently prioritises gaming traffic for the lowest possible latency online.

Storage and Expansion Ready for Tomorrow

Three M.2 slots give you room to build a genuinely fast storage array: the first M.2 slot runs at PCIe 5.0 x4 directly from the CPU (up to 128 Gbps), while the remaining two run at PCIe 4.0 x4 from the chipset — each protected by M.2 Shield Frozr thermal covers. Four SATA 6G ports add further flexibility, with support for RAID 0, 1, 5, and 10 across SATA drives. The primary PCIe x16 slot runs at PCIe 5.0 and is reinforced with Steel Armor and a dedicated Supplemental PCIe Power connector to support even the most power-hungry graphics cards.

Built Like a Weapon. Cooled Like a Beast.

The Corsair WARTHOG RS Airflow Mid-Tower Case in Olive Drab is engineered for the serious PC builder who refuses to compromise on airflow, durability, or visual impact. Thick-steel construction, integrated carry handles, and slide-on side panels deliver a purposeful, ruggedised aesthetic that stands apart from every generic black box on the market. Whether you're building a high-performance gaming rig or a powerhouse workstation, the WARTHOG RS gives you the structure and flexibility to do it right.

Airflow Engineered for Maximum Thermal Performance

Tired of cases that throttle your build before it even starts? The WARTHOG RS features 3D Y-pattern front and top panels that increase airflow by 12.7% compared to standard flat cutouts, creating a low-obstruction path for cool air to flood your components. Three pre-installed PWM fans — two RS200 200mm fans as front intakes and one RS120 fan as a rear exhaust — arrive ready for action. The InfiniRail™ Fan Mounting System lets you slide and position fans up to 200mm at the front and up to 140mm at the roof, giving you precise airflow control without fixed mounting constraints. With 360mm radiator support across the front, top, and side simultaneously, and the ability to mount up to 13x 120mm fans, keeping your system cool is never a compromise.

A Builder's Case from the Ground Up

The WARTHOG RS is designed to make every stage of your build cleaner and faster. The RapidRoute 2.0 pegboard motherboard tray includes six cinching straps and two wire loom pairs, with the option to 3D print additional accessories for a truly custom cable management setup. A GPU Anti-sag Stabilisation Arm keeps your graphics card — up to 405mm in length — properly supported, while the flexible drive tray accommodates one 3.5" HDD or two 2.5" SSDs.

Structurally integrated top-mounted carry handles let you move the fully built system with confidence. Slide-on side panels attach to fixed securing pegs rather than the tilt-and-clip mechanisms found on typical cases, improving both durability and ease of installation. Rear I/O lighting illuminates the back of the system, making cable connections straightforward even in a dimly lit battle station. Premium Performance, Engineered to the Edge

The ROG Strix GeForce RTX 5070 OC Edition is built for serious gamers and creators who demand the best from every frame. Powered by NVIDIA's Blackwell architecture and armed with 12GB of GDDR7 memory running at 28 Gbps across a 192-bit interface, this card delivers the headroom needed for high-resolution gaming, ray-traced visuals, and AI-accelerated workloads. With 6144 CUDA Cores and a boost clock of 2685 MHz in OC mode, it is ready to tackle the most demanding titles in your library.

Cooling Built for the Long Haul

Tired of your GPU throttling when things heat up? The ROG Strix RTX 5070 takes thermal management seriously. Three Axial-Tech fans — the two outer fans spinning counterclockwise to reduce turbulence — work alongside a vapour chamber heatsink to draw heat away efficiently. ASUS's exclusive phase-change GPU thermal pad melts to fill microscopic gaps between the GPU and thermal module, while the MaxContact design increases heat spreader surface area by 5% for improved thermal conductivity. A vented backplate further assists airflow, and all three fans stop completely below 50°C for near-silent operation during lighter workloads.

Built to Last, Built to Trust

Reliability is engineered into every layer of this card. Digital power control, high-current power stages, and 15K capacitors ensure stable power delivery during extended gaming sessions and overclocking. The PCB is protected by a conformal coating against moisture, dust, and debris, while ASUS Auto-Extreme technology completes all soldering in a single automated pass to minimise thermal strain on components. A reinforced stainless steel bracket, GPU guard adhesive on all four PCB corners, and a structural backplate combine to keep everything rigid and secure.

Personalise, Connect, and Create

Aura Sync ARGB lighting on the card's shroud and right edge puts limitless colour and effect options at your fingertips, and synchronises with other Aura-compatible components for a cohesive build aesthetic. When it comes to display connectivity, the ROG Strix RTX 5070 supports up to four simultaneous outputs via two native HDMI 2.1b and three native DisplayPort 2.1b ports, with a maximum resolution of 7680 x 4320. NVIDIA DLSS 4 with Multi Frame Generation, fourth-gen RT Cores, and NVIDIA Reflex 2 with Frame Warp round out a feature set that keeps you at the cutting edge of gaming and creative performance.

Elite Cooling Meets Next-Level Aesthetics

The ROG Strix SLC IV 360 ARGB LCD is engineered for builders who refuse to compromise — gamers, overclockers, and enthusiasts who demand the highest thermal performance without sacrificing a clean, stunning build. With a 360mm aluminium radiator, a high-performance pump, and three pre-installed ARGB fans, this AIO liquid cooler is built to keep even the most demanding Intel Core Ultra and AMD Ryzen 9000 processors running cool and stable through the longest sessions.

Tired of cable chaos ruining an otherwise perfect build?

The exclusive ASUS AIO Q-Connector changes everything. This innovative module connects directly to compatible ASUS motherboards via metal contact points, delivering both power and signals without a single visible cable between the water block, radiator, and motherboard. The result is an installation that is not only faster and simpler, but genuinely pristine — the kind of clean build that turns heads at every LAN party. For motherboards without Q-Connector support, standard installation is fully supported using the included hardware.

A Living Display at the Heart of Your Build

The 5.08-inch full colour IPS LCD on the pump head is more than a showpiece. Running at 60Hz with support for PNG, JPG, GIF, MP4, and AVI formats, it can display real-time system statistics, custom artwork, or animated content — all managed through the ASUS InfoHub application. The 360° rotatable tubing couplings mean the display can be orientated perfectly regardless of your case layout, while the 250mm centred tubing keeps component obstruction to a minimum for a truly breathtaking visual result.

Precision Engineering from Pump to Plate

Every component in the SLC IV 360 is built for long-term reliability. The copper CPU cold plate features precision micro-channels that maximise heat exchange efficiency, rapidly drawing thermal energy away from the processor. A premium PPS pump housing provides structural strength under sustained heavy workloads, while ceramic bearing technology delivers exceptional resistance to heat, wear, and corrosion. High-density rubber sleeved tubing resists ageing and coolant degradation over the full 6-year warranty period. Thermal paste comes pre-applied, so you can go from box to boot without any additional preparation.

Game Tough. Built to Last.

The ASUS TUF Gaming GeForce RTX 5070 Ti White OC Edition is built for serious gamers and creators who refuse to compromise. Powered by the NVIDIA Blackwell architecture and 16 GB of GDDR7 memory, it delivers the raw muscle needed for high-resolution gaming, full ray tracing, and AI-accelerated workflows — all wrapped in a striking all-white design that commands attention inside any build.

AI-Powered Performance That Changes the Game

Tired of choosing between visual fidelity and frame rates? NVIDIA DLSS 4 with Multi Frame Generation uses fifth-generation Tensor Cores to generate additional frames via AI, dramatically boosting performance without sacrificing image quality. Combined with NVIDIA Reflex 2 and Frame Warp technology for reduced latency, and fourth-gen RT Cores for cinematic ray tracing, the RTX 5070 Ti delivers a level of realism and responsiveness that redefines what your PC is capable of.

Cooling Engineered for the Long Haul

Three Axial-Tech fans — with the two outer fans spinning counterclockwise to reduce turbulence — work alongside a premium phase-change GPU thermal pad and ASUS MaxContact heat spreader to keep temperatures in check even during the most demanding sessions. All three fans stop completely when the GPU temperature drops below 50°C for silent operation during lighter tasks, then ramp back up above 55°C following a curve that balances acoustics and performance. The vented diecast metal exoskeleton and aluminium backplate further dissipate heat while preventing PCB flex.

Military-Grade Components for Uncompromising Reliability

Every TUF Gaming card is built to a higher standard. Certified TUF chokes and MOSFETs deliver rock-solid power delivery, while TUF 5K black metallic capacitors offer a 2.5x longer lifespan and 52% wider temperature tolerance than standard capacitors. A protective conformal coating shields the PCB against moisture, dust, and debris, and dual-ball fan bearings are rated to 80,000 hours of operation. Auto-Extreme automated manufacturing completes all soldering in a single pass, reducing thermal strain and improving long-term reliability. A Dual BIOS toggle lets you switch between Quiet and Performance modes to suit your priorities. Pair with an 850 W PSU for a fully overclocked configuration.

S-Tier Vision. S-Tier Victory.

The ASUS ROG Swift OLED PG27AQDP is built for the discerning South African gamer who refuses to compromise. As the world's first 1440p 480 Hz OLED gaming monitor, it unites cutting-edge panel technology, AI-assisted gameplay tools, and a purpose-built thermal management system in one flagship 27-inch display. Whether you are grinding ranked matches, tearing through AAA titles, or seeking an edge in esports, this monitor is engineered to deliver the decisive advantage.

Uncompromising speed meets stunning clarity

Tired of missing critical moments because your display cannot keep up? The PG27AQDP's native 480 Hz refresh rate and 0.03 ms grey-to-grey response time eliminate ghosting and motion blur so that every frame lands with razor precision. The WOLED panel covers 99% of the DCI-P3 colour space with a 1,500,000:1 contrast ratio and displays 1.07 billion colours at true 10-bit depth — producing absolute blacks and vivid highlights that IPS panels simply cannot match. VESA DisplayHDR 400 True Black and HDR10 support ensure that high dynamic range content is rendered as intended.

AI-powered tools that sharpen your competitive edge

The ROG AI Assistant brings a new dimension to competitive play. Dynamic AI Crosshair adapts to your in-game environment, AI Shadow Boost lifts shadow detail so enemies cannot hide in dark areas, AI Sniper adjusts your field of view at the moment you aim, and MOBA Map Helper provides contextual map awareness — all processed directly on the monitor. Combined with ASUS GamePlus overlays, GameFast Input technology, Shadow Boost, and Extreme Low Motion Blur, the PG27AQDP keeps you one step ahead at every moment.

Built to last — advanced OLED Care+ and custom heatsink

OLED longevity has been engineered into every layer of the PG27AQDP. The custom heatsink and advanced internal airflow design provide exceptional passive cooling, actively reducing the risk of burn-in during long sessions. New ASUS OLED Care+ software manages pixel cleaning, screen savers, and a host of protective settings accessible directly through DisplayWidget Center. ROG-exclusive OLED Anti-Flicker technology minimises flicker during refresh-rate fluctuations, and TÜV-certified flicker-free and Low Blue Light (hardware solution) ratings back up the panel's eye-comfort credentials — all covered by ASUS's 3-year warranty including panel burn-in.

Ergonomic design and versatile connectivity

The PG27AQDP's ergo stand offers 0–110 mm height adjustment, ±30° swivel, +20°/−5° tilt, and ±90° pivot so you can dial in the perfect viewing position. A 100x100mm VESA mount provides wall or arm mounting flexibility, while a 1/4" tripod socket adds further versatility. Connectivity covers every modern source: DisplayPort 1.4 DSC, two HDMI 2.1 (FRL) ports, two USB 3.2 Gen 1 Type-A downstream ports, and a 3.5 mm earphone jack. Aura Sync RGB lighting lets you match the monitor to your entire ROG ecosystem, and the included VESA mount kit, full cable bundle, colour pre-calibration report, and ROG accessories mean you can hit the ground running straight out of the box.

The ASUS ROG Strix OLED XG27AQDPG is the gaming monitor built for the discerning South African gamer who refuses to be held back by their display. Combining a 27-inch QHD QD-OLED panel with a 500Hz refresh rate and a 0.03ms grey-to-grey response time, this monitor is engineered to close the gap between your reflexes and what appears on screen — making it an indispensable weapon for competitive esports players and fast-paced shooter enthusiasts alike.

Visual Clarity That Puts You a Step Ahead

The QD-OLED panel delivers a contrast ratio of 1,500,000:1, ensuring blacks are truly black and colours are vivid and precisely rendered. At 500Hz with a 0.03ms response time, ghosting and motion blur are practically eliminated. ASUS Extreme Low Motion Blur (ELMB) technology further reduces trailing artefacts, keeping your target locked and your crosshair crisp even during the most frenetic firefights. product.name: ASUS ProArt PA32USD 32" 4K UHD 240Hz HDR True Black 400 Display QD-OLED Professional Monitor with 12G-SDI Input
product.description:
31.5-inch 4K QD-OLED panel | 240Hz refresh rate with 0.1ms response | Industry-leading ΔE < 1 colour accuracy | Dual 12G-SDI for uncompressed 4K@60Hz | Thunderbolt 4 with 96W Power Delivery

The professional monitor that sets the standard for colour-critical work

For filmmakers, colorists, game developers, and visual artists, colour accuracy is the bedrock of every deliverable. The ASUS ProArt Display OLED PA32USD is built for professionals who cannot afford to compromise — a 31.5-inch 4K UHD QD-OLED panel that combines 1000-nit peak brightness, 99% DCI-P3 colour coverage, and a factory-calibrated ΔE < 1 colour accuracy guarantee. Whether you are grading 4K HDR footage, reviewing game artwork, or preparing files for print, this monitor ensures that what you see is what your audience will experience.

QD-OLED visuals with absolute black and staggering contrast

Tired of LCD monitors that can never truly render shadow detail? The PA32USD's QD-OLED panel delivers a contrast ratio of 1,500,000:1 with genuine pixel-level black — the foundation of its VESA DisplayHDR True Black 400 certification. Peak brightness reaches 1000 cd/m² (3% area), producing the full tonal range that HDR content demands. True 10-bit colour depth — covering 100% sRGB and 99% DCI-P3 — ensures that gradations are smooth and colour rendering is faithful, frame after frame. Multiple HDR format support, including Dolby Vision, HLG, and HDR10, means the PA32USD is ready for every mastering and production workflow.

Precision calibration you can trust — and verify

Colour consistency over time is what separates a professional reference monitor from everything else. The PA32USD includes a built-in motorised flip colorimeter that enables self-calibration and auto-calibration without requiring an external device or a connected PC — it runs from the OSD menu on any operating system, or can be scheduled during off hours. ProArt Hardware Calibration software stores all colour parameters directly to the monitor's internal scaler chip rather than the host computer, so your calibration travels with the display. Third-party Calman and ColourSpace CMS integration is also supported, and every unit ships with a factory colour pre-calibration report.

Professional connectivity for production and post-production workflows

The PA32USD's connectivity suite is designed to serve the full range of professional workflows. Dual 12G-SDI inputs accept uncompressed 4K@60Hz video signals directly from compatible camera devices with ultra-low latency, and are also compatible with 6G and 3G Level A and B signals — making the monitor equally at home in broadcast, on-set production, and post-production suites. Beyond SDI, dual Thunderbolt 4 ports support up to 96W Power Delivery and daisy-chaining for expanded multi-display setups, while HDMI 2.1 and DisplayPort 2.1 round out the signal inputs. An integrated USB 3.2 hub — comprising one USB Type-C and two USB Type-A ports — keeps peripherals and storage drives connected at the desk. Picture-by-Picture (PbP) mode allows viewing from up to four input sources simultaneously, giving colorists and DITs the flexibility to compare signals side by side.

Features

  • 31.5-inch 4K UHD (3840 x 2160) QD-OLED panel with true pixel-level black and a 1,500,000:1 contrast ratio.
  • 1000 cd/m² peak brightness with VESA DisplayHDR True Black 400 certification for exceptional HDR rendering.

product.name: ASUS ProArt PA32KCX 32" Display 8K UHD Professional Thunderbolt 4 HDR 1000 Monitor with USB Type-C 96W
product.description:
8K UHD Mini-LED IPS panel | VESA DisplayHDR 1000 with Dolby Vision | Hardware self-calibration built in | Thunderbolt 4 daisy chain & 96W USB-C power delivery | Factory colour-calibrated for professional accuracy

Uncompromising colour precision for the serious creative professional

When your work demands that what you see on screen is exactly what the world will see — in print, on screen, or in production — the ASUS ProArt PA32KCX leaves no margin for error. Built around a 32-inch Mini-LED IPS panel with a native 7680×4320 (8K) resolution, it delivers 275 pixels per inch of extraordinary detail alongside a 95% Adobe RGB and 97% DCI-P3 colour gamut. Every unit ships with a colour pre-calibration report, giving you documented confidence from the moment you power it on. This is the bedrock of a professional colour workflow.

HDR that meets the demands of the most exacting standards

Tired of monitors that claim HDR support but fall short when it counts? The PA32KCX carries VESA DisplayHDR 1000 certification and supports Dolby Vision, HLG, and HDR10 natively. Its Mini-LED backlight delivers a typical brightness of 1,000 cd/m² with a peak HDR brightness of 1,200 cd/m², while the contrast ratio reaches up to 1,000,000:1 in HDR mode. Whether you are grading cinematic footage or reviewing HDR deliverables for broadcast, you are working with a display that holds its own against professional reference monitors.

A connectivity hub that keeps your studio tidy and productive

The PA32KCX is more than a display — it anchors your entire workstation. Two Thunderbolt 4 ports support daisy chaining to additional monitors, while USB-C power delivery at up to 96W means your laptop stays charged through a single cable. Two HDMI 2.1 (FRL) ports and a DisplayPort 2.1 input ensure compatibility with the widest range of professional workstations and creative hardware. An integrated USB hub with USB 3.2 Gen 2 Type-C and Type-A ports extends your connectivity further without cluttering your desk.

Built-in calibration tools that protect your investment over time

Maintaining colour accuracy over months of heavy use is where many professional monitors fall short. The PA32KCX addresses this directly with an embedded colorimeter that supports self-calibration, complemented by an ambient light sensor and proximity sensor to adapt intelligently to your working environment. ASUS ProArt Hardware Calibration and the ProArt Palette software suite give you granular control over gamma, colour temperature, and colour space presets — from sRGB and Adobe RGB to DCI-P3, BT.2020, and DICOM — so your display remains a reliable reference point throughout its working life.

Features

  • 32-inch Mini-LED IPS panel with 7680×4320 (8K) resolution at 275 PPI for exceptional detail in professional creative work.
  • VESA DisplayHDR 1000 certified with Dolby Vision, HLG, and HDR10 support — peak brightness of 1,200 cd/m² and up to 1,000,000:1 HDR contrast ratio.
  • 95% Adobe RGB and 97% DCI-P3 colour gamut coverage with factory colour pre-calibration report included.
  • Embedded colorimeter enables self-calibration, with ambient light and proximity sensors for intelligent environment adaptation.
  • Dual Thunderbolt 4 ports with daisy chain support and 96W USB-C power delivery to charge your laptop through a single cable.
  • HDMI 2.1 x2 (FRL) and DisplayPort 2.1 input for broad compatibility with professional workstations.
  • Integrated USB hub: USB 3.2 Gen 2 Type-C and Type-A ports for peripherals and KVM switch functionality.
  • Fully ergonomic stand with height adjustment (0–100 mm), tilt, swivel, and pivot; VESA 100×100 mm wall-mount compatible.
  • Anti-glare, low-reflection (AGLR) display surface and included monitor hood for controlled lighting environments.
  • Built-in 3W×2 speakers and Flicker-free technology for extended working sessions.

product.name: ASUS ROG Strix G18 Ultra 9 RTX 5070 Gaming Laptop 16GB 1TB
product.description:
18-inch flagship gaming power | Intel Core Ultra 9 + RTX 5070 | 300Hz ROG Nebula Display | Wi-Fi 7 connectivity | 12-month warranty

Quick Specs

  • Dominate every title on an expansive 18-inch ROG Nebula Display with 2560 x 1600 WQXGA resolution, 300 Hz refresh rate, 100% DCI-P3 colour, and Dolby Vision HDR support.
  • Unleash next-generation performance with the Intel Core Ultra 9 290HX+ processor — 24 cores boosting up to 5.5 GHz — paired with NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Laptop GPU with 8 GB GDDR7.
  • Connect to anything, instantly — Wi-Fi 7 (802.11be), Bluetooth 5.4, Thunderbolt 4, USB 3.2 Gen 2, and HDMI 2.1 FRL keep you linked to every peripheral and display.
  • Stay in the fight longer with a 90 Wh battery that recharges from 0 to 50% in just 30 minutes via the included 280 W adapter.
  • Communicate and create with confidence — a 1080P FHD IR camera with Windows Hello, built-in array microphone with AI noise-cancelling, and Dolby Atmos speaker system round out a complete battle station.

Command the Battlefield on a Machine Built Without Compromise

The ASUS ROG Strix G18 is engineered for the South African gamer who refuses to settle — a full-sized 18-inch gaming notebook that combines Intel's most potent mobile processor with NVIDIA's latest discrete GPU, all wrapped in an Eclipse Grey aluminium and textured chassis. Whether you're deep in a ranked session or rendering a creative project at midnight, this machine is built to push through without flinching.

Processing Muscle That Never Hits Its Ceiling

Tired of watching your frame rate buckle under a heavy workload? The Intel Core Ultra 9 290HX+ processor — 24 cores and 24 threads, boosting up to 5.5 GHz with 36 MB of cache — eliminates that bottleneck entirely. Paired with the NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Laptop GPU carrying 8 GB of GDDR7 memory, plus ROG's intelligent cooling system with MUX Switch and NVIDIA Advanced Optimus, the ROG Strix G18 delivers raw frame rates that match the ambition of the games you play. The on-board Intel AI Boost NPU adds up to 13 TOPS of dedicated AI performance for intelligent in-game and system enhancements.

A Display That Puts You Inside the Action

The 18-inch ROG Nebula Display is no ordinary panel. Resolving every scene at 2560 x 1600 (WQXGA) in a cinematic 16:10 aspect ratio, it pairs a 300 Hz refresh rate with a 3 ms G2G response time and G-SYNC adaptive sync so tearing and stuttering simply don't exist in your world. With 100% DCI-P3 colour coverage, 500 nits brightness, a 1700:1 contrast ratio, Pantone Validation, Dolby Vision HDR support, and an anti-glare IPS-level surface, this is a display that rewards every hour of play with visual fidelity the competition can't match.

Connectivity Built for the Modern Gaming Setup

The ROG Strix G18 refuses to be the bottleneck in your setup. Wi-Fi 7 (802.11be) with triple-band support and Bluetooth 5.4 keep your wireless world running at peak speed, while a comprehensive port array — Thunderbolt 4 at up to 40 Gbps, USB 3.2 Gen 2 Type-C with DisplayPort and Power Delivery, three USB 3.2 Gen 2 Type-A ports, HDMI 2.1 FRL, and a Gigabit LAN port — means every monitor, peripheral, and storage device finds a home. A 4-Zone RGB backlit keyboard with Aura Sync and a Copilot key rounds out a machine designed to be the centre of any serious gaming setup.

Features

  • Intel Core Ultra 9 290HX+ processor — 24 cores, 24 threads, up to 5.5 GHz boost, 36 MB cache — delivers elite multi-threaded gaming and creative performance.
  • NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Laptop GPU with 8 GB GDDR7 memory, ROG Boost overclocking, MUX Switch, and NVIDIA Advanced Optimus for maximum frame rates.
  • 18-inch ROG Nebula Display: 2560 x 1600 WQXGA, 300 Hz, 3 ms, 100% DCI-P3, 500 nits, G-SYNC, Dolby Vision HDR, Pantone Validated, anti-glare IPS-level panel.
  • 16 GB DDR5-5600 memory across 2 SO-DIMM slots (expandable to 64 GB), with dual-channel support for bandwidth-hungry workloads.
  • 1 TB PCIe 4.0 NVMe M.2 SSD for rapid game loads and file transfers, with a second M.2 slot available for expansion.
  • Wi-Fi 7 (802.11be) triple-band wireless and Bluetooth 5.4 for ultra-low-latency connectivity.
  • 90 Wh 4-cell Li-ion battery with fast charging — 0 to 50% in 30 minutes via the included 280 W AC adapter.
  • 4-Zone RGB Aura Sync backlit chiclet keyboard with Copilot key, 1080P FHD IR camera with Windows Hello, AI noise-cancelling microphone, and Dolby Atmos dual-speaker system.

Colour-critical precision for the professional creator

The ASUS ProArt Display PA32QCV is a 31.5-inch 6K professional monitor designed for content creators, colorists, photographers, and designers who demand unwavering colour accuracy from their display. At the heart of the PA32QCV is a 6K (6016 x 3384) IPS panel with a pixel density of 218 PPI — more than three times that of a standard 32-inch FHD display — so every fine detail in your work is rendered with exceptional clarity. Calman Verified and factory calibrated to Delta E < 2 right out of the box, this is a display you can trust the moment it powers on.

Wide colour gamut that brings your work to life

Tired of a display that clips your creative vision? The PA32QCV covers 98% DCI-P3 and 100% sRGB, with 10-bit colour depth enabling over 1.07 billion on-screen colours for true-to-life image reproduction. HDR10 and VESA DisplayHDR 600 support ensure peak brightness of 600 cd/m² with deep contrast, revealing the full dynamic range in your photos and footage. The LuxPixel anti-glare, low-reflection (AGLR) coating keeps reflections at bay so you see only the colours you intended — not the studio around you. Multiple ProArt Preset modes, including DCI-P3, Display-P3, and the new M Model-P3 mode designed to align colours with macOS devices, give you a flexible colour-accurate workspace across every project.

Thunderbolt 4 connectivity that powers your entire workflow

The PA32QCV features dual Thunderbolt 4 ports with daisy-chaining capability, each capable of delivering up to 96W of Power Delivery to charge your laptop while you work — all through a single cable. Beyond charging, the Thunderbolt 4 ports handle DisplayPort signal and data transfer simultaneously, and the built-in USB hub (1x USB 3.2 Gen 1 Type-C, 2x USB 3.2 Gen 1 Type-A) keeps all your peripherals connected through the monitor. An additional DisplayPort 1.4 DSC input and HDMI 2.1 port round out the connectivity, while the built-in Auto KVM switch lets you control two connected computers with a single keyboard and mouse — a genuine productivity multiplier for multi-machine workflows.

Ergonomic design built for long creative sessions

The PA32QCV's fully adjustable stand supports tilt (+23° to -5°), swivel (+30° to -30°), pivot (+90° to -90°), and height adjustment (0–130mm), so you can position the display exactly where your posture demands. TÜV-certified Flicker-free and Ultra-low Blue Light technologies reduce eye strain during extended working hours. An ambient light sensor automatically adjusts brightness and colour temperature to suit your environment, while a backlight sensor compensates for deviations at startup — so colour accuracy is reliable from the first moment of the day. The VESA 100x100mm mount compatibility gives you the freedom to mount the display on a third-party arm when your studio layout requires it.

The Anycubic Photon Mono M7 Pro is a next-generation resin 3D printer built for makers who refuse to compromise on quality. At its heart sits a crisp 10.1-inch 14K monochrome LCD, resolving fine features down to a razor-sharp 16.8µm on the X/Y axis - so every miniature, prototype and precision part comes off the plate looking exactly as you imagined it.

Speed keeps pace with the detail. Paired with High-Speed Resin, the M7 Pro reaches printing speeds of up to 170mm/h, turning what used to be an overnight wait into a same-session result. And thanks to Auto-Adaptive Technology with dynamic temperature control, the printer keeps your resin in its ideal working range for consistent, repeatable prints - batch after batch.

It's designed to work smarter, not harder. Auto Resin Refill and Withdrawal tops up the vat and draws resin back automatically, so longer prints run unattended without the mess or the guesswork. A generous 223 × 126 × 230mm (6.5L) build volume gives you room for large single models or a full plate of miniatures, while a laser-engraved build plate, dual linear Z-axis rails with 10µm precision and a leveling-free design mean strong adhesion and reliable results straight out of the box.

Versatile by nature, the M7 Pro handles high-speed, water-washable, standard, ABS-like and plant-based resins, and connects your way over USB, Wi-Fi or LAN. With Photon Workshop and Chitubox support, a responsive 4.3-inch touchscreen and full Anycubic App integration, it's a resin 3D printer that fits effortlessly into your workflow - whether you're a hobbyist, a tabletop enthusiast or a professional chasing production-grade accuracy.

The Anycubic Photon Mono M7 Pro - precision, speed and effortless printing, ready for whatever you create next.

  • 10.1-inch 14K mono LCD screen for high-resolution resin printing
  • 170mm/h with High-speed Resin

Large-format multicolour 3D printing | Fully-enclosed CoreXY precision | Up to 16-colour output | Engineering-grade filament support | 350×350×350mm³ build volume

Quick Specs

  • Print large-scale models with a generous 350×350×350mm³ build volume — ideal for ambitious, full-sized creations
  • Achieve vivid multicolour results with up to 16-colour printing capability via ACE 2 Pro units
  • Experience consistent, reliable prints inside a fully-enclosed CoreXY structure built for precision and stability
  • Push material boundaries with a 350°C hardened steel nozzle compatible with engineering-grade and composite filaments
  • Enjoy broad filament compatibility across PLA, PETG, ASA, ABS, TPU, PLA-CF, PETG-CF, and PLA Silk

Large-Format 3D Printing, Unleashed in Full Colour

The Anycubic Kobra S1 Max Combo is built for makers, designers, and engineers who refuse to be limited — by size, by colour, or by material. Combining a fully-enclosed CoreXY printer with the ACE 2 Pro automatic colour-exchange system, this combo delivers a 350×350×350mm³ build volume alongside the capability to print in up to 16 colours in a single run. Whether you're producing functional prototypes, detailed display models, or large creative projects, the Kobra S1 Max Combo gives you the tools to do it at scale.

A Build Volume That Matches Your Ambitions

Tired of splitting large models into multiple prints just to fit your build plate? The Kobra S1 Max Combo's 350×350×350mm³ print volume means you can take on full-scale functional parts, oversized figurines, architectural models, and more — all in a single print session. The fully-enclosed CoreXY construction keeps the motion system rigid and precise across that entire volume, so dimensional accuracy doesn't suffer as your prints grow larger.

Up to 16 Colours, Automatically Managed

The ACE 2 Pro automatic colour exchange units included in this combo take multicolour FDM printing to a new level. With the right configuration of ACE 2 Pro units, the system supports up to 16-colour printing — letting you produce richly detailed, vibrant models without manual filament swaps. The result is creative output that genuinely reflects your designs rather than being constrained by single-material limitations.

Built for Demanding Filaments

The Kobra S1 Max Combo's hardened steel nozzle handles far more than standard PLA. With a maximum nozzle temperature of 350°C, you can print carbon-fibre composites such as PLA-CF and PETG-CF, flexible TPU, weather-resistant ASA, and tough ABS with confidence. The fully-enclosed chamber supports the stable thermal environment that engineering-grade and composite materials demand, giving you consistent results across a wide range of applications.

product.name: Anycubic Kobra S1 Ace 2 Pro Combo 3D Printer
product.description:
16-colour multicolour FDM printing | Up to 600mm/s CoreXY speed | Fully enclosed with active filament drying | AI print monitoring | App and cloud control

Quick Specs

  • Print up to 16 colours simultaneously with the included ACE 2 Pro multi-material unit, expandable from a base of 4 colours
  • Achieve blazing print speeds of up to 600mm/s on a rigid CoreXY motion system with 20000mm/s² acceleration
  • Enjoy a generous 250mm × 250mm × 250mm build volume with fully automatic levelling — no Z-axis compensation needed
  • Print with confidence using built-in AI spaghetti detection, filament runout sensing, and power-loss resume
  • Control and monitor your prints from anywhere via the Anycubic App, AC Cloud, or the 4.3-inch capacitive touchscreen

Serious multicolour printing, straight out of the box

The Anycubic Kobra S1 ACE 2 Pro Combo 3D printer is a fully enclosed CoreXY 3D printer bundled with the ACE 2 Pro multi-material unit, giving makers, hobbyists, and design professionals a complete system for producing vivid multicolour prints from day one. With a base capacity of 4 colours — expandable to 16 — and a 250mm × 250mm × 250mm build volume, it is built for anyone who wants more than a single-colour machine without building a separate setup from scratch.

Speed and precision that keeps up with your creativity

The Kobra S1 uses a CoreXY construction paired with light-rail X and Y axes, a dual-gear short-range extruder, and a maximum print speed of 600mm/s at up to 20000mm/s² acceleration. Layer thickness runs from 0.08mm to 0.28mm, giving you fine detail when you need it and fast rough drafts when you do not. The standard 0.4mm brass nozzle is quick-detachable and compatible with 0.2mm, 0.6mm, and 0.8mm alternatives, while the hotend reaches up to 320°C and the heated bed reaches up to 120°C — covering PLA, PETG, ABS, ASA, and TPU with ease.

Tired of failed prints ruining your filament and your day?

The Kobra S1 ACE 2 Pro Combo 3D printer addresses the most common printing frustrations with a suite of intelligent safeguards. AI spaghetti detection monitors the chamber camera feed and can skip over problem areas before they ruin an entire job. Automatic filament detection and auto-resume handle runouts without manual intervention, and power-loss recovery picks up exactly where it left off after an unexpected outage. Fully automatic levelling with object-skip and area levelling means the printer arrives ready to print — no manual Z-axis compensation required.

Keep filament dry and prints in perfect condition

The ACE 2 Pro unit is more than a multi-material hub — it actively dries your filament during printing at temperatures up to 65°C, helping to prevent moisture-related print defects. A built-in temperature and humidity sensor monitors conditions inside the unit, while a solenoid valve expels moist air during the drying cycle. The enclosed chamber on the Kobra S1 itself houses an activated carbon air filtration system, keeping your workspace clean when printing with materials like ABS and ASA.

Full control, wherever you are

Manage every aspect of your print from the 4.3-inch capacitive touchscreen on the machine, or connect over 2.4GHz Wi-Fi to use the Anycubic App, Anycubic Slicer Next, or AC Cloud for remote monitoring and control. A built-in chamber camera supports time-lapse photography so you can review print progress at a glance. The printer runs on Kobra OS, supports multilingual setup from first boot, and is compatible with both Anycubic Slicer Next and OrcaSlicer. Quiet mode keeps noise at or below 44dB — considerate for home studios and shared workspaces.

  • ACE 2 Pro multi-material unit included — supports 4 colours as standard, expandable to 16 colours

product.name: Anycubic Kobra S1 MAX 3D Printer
product.description:
Large-format CoreXY speed | Engineering-grade filament support | AI-powered print monitoring | Fully automatic bed levelling

Quick Specs

  • Print at speeds up to 600 mm/s across a generous 350 × 350 × 350 mm build volume — tackle large, complex projects with confidence.
  • Achieve precise, repeatable results every time with LeviQ3.0 automatic bed levelling and built-in pressure advance and flow calibration.
  • Print with over a dozen filament types — from everyday PLA and PETG to engineering-grade PA, PC, and carbon-fibre composites — thanks to a 350°C hardened steel nozzle.
  • Stay in control from anywhere: monitor, manage, and start prints via the Anycubic App, slicing software, or the onboard 4.3-inch capacitive touchscreen.
  • Work quietly and confidently — AI spaghetti detection, filament entanglement sensing, and power-loss resume keep long prints on track without constant babysitting.

Big builds, serious speeds — without the compromise

The Anycubic Kobra S1 Max 3D Printer is built for makers, engineers, and creators who need a large-format FDM 3D printer that can keep up with ambition. With a 350 × 350 × 350 mm³ build volume and a CoreXY motion system capable of reaching 600 mm/s (recommended 300 mm/s) at accelerations up to 20,000 mm/s², it handles everything from rapid prototyping to production-scale batch runs — without sacrificing print quality.

Print more materials, solve harder problems

Tired of a 3D printer that locks you into a handful of basic filaments? The Kobra S1 Max supports thirteen filament types, spanning everyday PLA and PETG all the way to demanding engineering materials like PA, PC, PA6-CF, PC-CF/GF, and PET-CF. A hardened steel nozzle rated to 350°C and hardened steel extrusion gears handle abrasive carbon-fibre and glass-fibre composites without wearing down, while a PEI spring steel build plate (max 120°C) gives prints solid adhesion and easy release.

Set it up once, print with confidence every time

Getting the first layer right shouldn't take an hour of fiddling. The Kobra S1 Max integrates LeviQ3.0 automatic bed levelling alongside object-skip and area levelling, so the printer compensates for any surface variation before a single line of filament is laid down. Pressure advance and flow calibration fine-tune extrusion in real time, keeping walls clean and corners sharp across the full build volume.

AI monitoring that keeps long prints on track

Unattended overnight prints carry real risk — but the Kobra S1 Max watches over your work so you don't have to. An onboard AI spaghetti detection system flags failed prints before they waste hours of filament. Filament runout detection, filament entanglement detection, and automatic resume mean a snapped or tangled spool won't ruin a job. Power-loss resume picks up exactly where the printer left off if the power cuts out, and the standard HD camera (720P) lets you check in remotely via the Anycubic App.

Features

  • CoreXY motion system with linear rods on all three axes — speeds up to 600 mm/s with 20,000 mm/s² maximum acceleration.
  • 350 × 350 × 350 mm³ build volume for large-format and batch printing.
  • Hardened steel nozzle (standard 0.4 mm, expandable to 0.25 / 0.6 / 0.8 mm) rated to 350°C — compatible with abrasive filaments.
  • Supports 13 filament types: PLA, PETG, PET, PLA-CF, PETG-CF, PVA, ABS, ASA, PC, PA, PA6-CF, PC-CF/GF, PET-CF.
  • LeviQ3.0 auto-levelling with object-skip, area levelling, pressure advance, and flow calibration for reliable first layers.
  • AI spaghetti detection, filament runout detection, filament entanglement detection, and power-loss resume for unattended printing peace of mind.
  • Built-in 720P HD camera for remote monitoring via the Anycubic App.
  • 4.3-inch capacitive touchscreen with Kobra OS; 10 language interfaces supported.
  • Quiet operation at ≤45 dB in quiet mode; ≤48 dB in standard mode.
  • PEI spring steel build plate with hotbed temperature up to 120°C.

product.name: Anycubic Kobra S1 FDM 3D Printer
product.description:
Fully enclosed CoreXY speed | 250×250×250mm build volume | 320°C hotend | AI print monitoring | Ultra-quiet 44dB operation

Quick Specs

  • Print large, detailed models with a generous 250×250×250mm build volume inside a fully enclosed CoreXY chamber.
  • Achieve fast, precise results with a recommended print speed of 300 mm/s and acceleration up to 10,000 mm/s².
  • Enjoy ultra-quiet operation at as low as 44dB in Quiet mode — print overnight without disturbing the household.
  • Tackle a wide range of materials including PLA, PETG, TPU, ABS, and ASA with a 320°C capable hotend.
  • Print with confidence thanks to AI Spaghetti Detection, filament runout sensing, and power loss recovery.

Serious 3D Printing, Without the Fuss

The Anycubic Kobra S1 is a fully enclosed CoreXY FDM 3D printer built for makers, hobbyists, and professionals who want fast, reliable results without constantly babysitting their machine. Powered by Kobra OS and packed with smart automation features, it brings high-speed printing, broad material compatibility, and intelligent print monitoring together in a single, capable package.

Speed and Precision Locked In by CoreXY

Tired of watching slow, lumbering printers grind through complex models? The Kobra S1's CoreXY construction, driven by linear rod motion on both X and Y axes and a single-motor three-pole Z-axis, delivers smooth, stable movement at a recommended 300 mm/s — with a maximum ceiling of 600 mm/s and up to 20,000 mm/s² acceleration. Pressure advance and flow calibration are built in, so what comes off the bed reflects what you designed, not what the printer could manage.

A Hotend That Handles What You Throw at It

With a maximum nozzle temperature of 320°C and a PEI spring steel heated bed reaching up to 120°C, the Kobra S1 supports a broad material roster — PLA, PETG, TPU, ABS, and ASA — without requiring an upgrade. The standard 0.4mm nozzle handles everyday printing, while compatibility with 0.6mm and 0.8mm nozzles gives you flexibility for faster, rougher or more detail-focused work. The source material notes the hotend is designed for easy disassembly and clog-free performance.

Smart Monitoring Keeps Your Prints Safe

The Kobra S1 watches over every job so you don't have to. AI Spaghetti Detection spots failed prints early and can halt the job before filament becomes a tangled mess. Filament runout detection pauses the print and waits for you to reload, filament entanglement detection flags spool issues before they cause a failure, and power loss resume picks up exactly where it left off after an unexpected outage. A built-in HD camera supporting 480P video monitoring means you can check in remotely via the Anycubic APP over Wi-Fi. LeviQ3.0 auto-levelling and Z-Offset adjustment handle bed calibration automatically, and object-skip with area levelling adds further precision control.

Quiet, Connected, and Easy to Control

At as low as 44dB in Quiet mode, the Kobra S1 is considerate of its surroundings — a real advantage when printing long overnight jobs. The 4.3-inch capacitive touchscreen gives you direct, responsive control on the printer itself, while slicing software, the Anycubic APP, and USB connectivity round out your options. The interface supports nine languages, making it accessible whether you're setting it up for the first time or handing it to a colleague.

product.name: Anycubic Kobra 3 Max 3D Printer
product.description:
Massive 420 × 420 × 500 mm build volume | Speeds up to 600 mm/s | Precise auto-levelling | Wi-Fi, app and cloud control | Power-loss resume

Quick Specs

  • Print ambitious creations with a massive 420 mm × 420 mm × 500 mm build volume — room for truly large-scale single-piece prints
  • Achieve faster results with print speeds of up to 600 mm/s, cutting waiting time without sacrificing quality
  • Enjoy reliable first-layer adhesion every time thanks to precise auto-levelling and a PEI magnetic spring hotbed
  • Stay in control from anywhere — manage prints via the Anycubic App, AC Cloud, or Anycubic Slicer Next over Wi-Fi
  • Print with confidence knowing power-loss resume and filament runout detection protect your long prints from interruption

Scale Up Your 3D Printing

The Anycubic Kobra 3 Max is a large-format FDM 3D printer built for makers, designers, and hobbyists who are ready to stop thinking small. With a 420 mm × 420 mm × 500 mm build volume, it lets you produce genuinely large prints in a single run — from cosplay props and architectural models to functional prototypes and statement display pieces. Pair that with print speeds of up to 600 mm/s and you have a machine that matches ambition with efficiency.

A Bed You Can Trust, Every Single Print

Tired of spending more time levelling your bed than actually printing? The Kobra 3 Max takes that frustration away with its precise auto-levelling system, which probes the hotbed automatically and compensates for any surface variation before each print begins. The PEI magnetic spring board provides reliable adhesion during printing and releases finished parts cleanly once cooled, so you spend less time fussing and more time making.

Intelligent Protection for Long Runs

Long prints on a large machine deserve long-print protection. The Kobra 3 Max includes both power-loss resume and filament runout detection with auto resume. If the power cuts unexpectedly, the printer picks up exactly where it left off when you turn it back on. If your filament spool runs dry mid-print, it alerts you to reload and then continues — keeping hours of print time from going to waste.

Connect, Slice, and Print Your Way

The Kobra 3 Max gives you multiple ways to work. Slice models in Anycubic Slicer or Orca Slicer, send files via USB drive or over Wi-Fi through AC Cloud and Anycubic Slicer Next, and monitor and control print jobs remotely from your phone using the Anycubic App. The onboard touchscreen handles quick adjustments right at the machine, and a dedicated port for cameras and other peripherals is available for expanded monitoring. Supported filaments include PLA, TPU, PETG, and ABS, giving you genuine material flexibility within a single machine.

Features

  • Large 420 mm × 420 mm × 500 mm build volume for oversized single-piece prints
  • FDM printing technology with a single 0.4 mm nozzle and layer thickness range of 0.08–0.28 mm
  • Print speeds up to 600 mm/s for faster turnaround on large projects
  • Precise auto-levelling system for consistent first-layer adhesion without manual adjustment
  • PEI magnetic spring hotbed for reliable adhesion during printing and easy part removal after cooling
  • Power-loss resume automatically continues a print after an unexpected power cut
  • Filament runout detection with auto resume prevents failed prints due to empty spools
  • Wi-Fi connectivity (2.4 GHz) with support for AC Cloud, Anycubic App, Anycubic Slicer Next, and USB drive printing
  • Compatible with PLA, TPU, PETG, and ABS filaments
  • Touchscreen control panel with multilingual support
  • Camera and peripherals port available for optional video monitoring
  • Dual metal spindles on Y-axis and lead screws on Z-axis for stable, accurate motion

product.description:
Glows blue in the dark | Eco-friendly, heavy-metal-free luminescent material | Resilient and clog-free printing | Compatible with all 1.75 mm FDM printers | 1 kg spool

The Anycubic PLA Glow Filament in White (Blue Glow) is designed for FDM makers who want to add a striking luminescent effect to decorative prints — night lights, lampshades, holiday decorations, directional signs, and glow-in-the-dark figurines. A brief charge under sunlight activates up to two hours of continuous blue glow, while the eco-friendly luminescent material is completely free of heavy metals and radioactive particles. The filament prints reliably at 200–230 °C with a heated bed set between 60–70 °C and a recommended speed of 50–250 mm/s, suiting a wide range of FDM printers with a 0.4 mm or larger nozzle. Built to resist bending and tearing, it delivers consistent, clog-free results across decorative applications. Note: this product is available in old and new versions shipped randomly; slight colour variations between batches are possible, and the old-version filament is not recommended for use with the ACE Pro.

product.name: Anycubic Ace 2 Pro - For Kobra X and S1/M
product.description:
4-channel active drying and feeding hub | Print-while-drying workflow | Brushless motors for quiet, reliable operation | Sealed moisture control | Compatible with Kobra X, S1, and S1 Max

Quick Specs

  • Dry and print simultaneously with active 65 °C drying — keep your filament fresh without pausing a single job
  • Feed four colours at once through four independent brushless motors running at under 48 dB for smooth, near-silent operation
  • Switch filaments faster with a next-generation buffer mechanism that doubles loading speed compared to the previous generation
  • Protect every spool with sealed storage, an electromagnetic moisture valve, and real-time temperature and humidity monitoring
  • Built to last with an alumina ceramic filament feeding port that resists wear far longer than standard plastic alternatives

Upgrade Your Multi-Material Workflow

The Anycubic ACE 2 Pro is designed for FDM makers who want a reliable, intelligent hub to manage multiple filaments — drying them, feeding them, and keeping them in peak condition, all at the same time. Compatible with the Kobra X, Kobra S1, and Kobra S1 Max, it connects seamlessly into your existing setup and replaces the guesswork of manual filament management with a fully automated system.

Never Stop Printing to Dry Your Filament Again

Tired of halting your print jobs just to run a separate drying cycle? The ACE 2 Pro supports simultaneous drying and printing, maintaining a chamber temperature of up to 65 °C while your printer keeps running. Built-in temperature and humidity sensors monitor conditions in real time, an electromagnetic valve actively expels moisture, and a silicone sealing ring blocks external humidity from creeping back in. Your filament stays as fresh as the day it came out of the bag.

Faster, Quieter, More Reliable Feeding

Four independent brushless motors — each rated for a lifespan of 5,000 hours or more — drive the next-generation buffer mechanism, delivering smooth and stable filament feed and retraction across all four channels. Operating at under 48 dB during closed-door printing, the ACE 2 Pro keeps your workspace quiet. Filament loading speed is doubled compared to the previous ACE Pro generation, meaning less waiting between colour changes and more time spent actually printing. The alumina ceramic filament feeding port adds another layer of durability, offering superior abrasion resistance over standard plastic ports for reduced long-term maintenance.

Intelligent Monitoring and Jam-Free Maintenance

The ACE 2 Pro keeps you informed and in control. Real-time temperature and humidity readings are displayed on the app, slicer, and printer screen. Filament runout detection and auto-resume printing mean unexpected interruptions are handled automatically. When a jam does occur, the quick-release external feeding channel and buffer mechanism allow rapid disassembly so you can clear the issue and get back to printing in seconds. Intelligent filament identification auto-detects Anycubic filament parameters when connected — eliminating manual profile configuration for supported materials.

Features

  • Print-while-drying support: active 65 °C drying operates simultaneously with printing for an uninterrupted workflow
  • Four independent brushless motors with a rated lifespan of 5,000+ hours ensure stable, jam-resistant filament feeding across all channels
  • Next-generation buffer mechanism doubles filament loading speed compared to the ACE Pro predecessor
  • Sealed storage with electromagnetic moisture valve and silicone sealing ring provides active and passive humidity protection
  • Built-in temperature and humidity sensors with real-time readout on app, slicer, and printer screen
  • Alumina ceramic filament feeding port for superior wear resistance and extended operational lifespan
  • Filament runout detection and auto-resume printing minimise downtime from depleted spools
  • Quick-release external feeding channel for fast jam clearance and easy maintenance
  • Intelligent filament identification automatically detects compatible Anycubic filament parameters (requires internet connection and Anycubic proprietary filaments)
  • Compatible with Kobra X, Kobra S1 Max, and Kobra S1 (this variant)

product.name: ASUS Prime AP202 ARGB mATX White Chassis
product.description:
Panoramic curved glass design | Patented slot vent GPU cooling | Three pre-installed ARGB fans | 20 Gbps front USB Type-C | Broad mATX/Mini-ITX compatibility

Quick Specs

  • Showcase your build through a curved tempered glass panel that wraps seamlessly from front to side for panoramic views.
  • Dominate thermals with a patented slot vent design that actively improves GPU cooling performance.
  • Illuminate your system with three pre-installed 120mm ARGB fans featuring 20 addressable RGB LEDs each, synced via Aura Sync.
  • Connect at blazing speeds with a front USB Type-C port delivering up to 20 Gbps transfer rates.
  • Accommodate your most powerful components — supporting GPUs up to 420mm, CPU coolers up to 175mm, and radiators up to 360mm.

Build Without Limits in the ASUS Prime AP202 ARGB

The ASUS Prime AP202 ARGB is a versatile mATX gaming chassis designed for South African builders who refuse to compromise on aesthetics or performance. A striking curved tempered glass panel stretches seamlessly from the front to the side, putting your components on full display from almost any angle. Whether you are assembling your first gaming rig or upgrading to something worthy of the desk it sits on, the AP202 ARGB delivers the space, airflow, and style to make it count.

Glass That Goes the Distance

Tired of side panels that feel fragile or awkward to remove? The AP202 ARGB's curved tempered glass undergoes a rigorous five-stage process — from raw material selection through cutting, edge grinding, thermal treatment, and safety evaluation — that approaches aerospace standards. The result is a panel of superior strength and durability that snaps in and out via an easy-detach rail with an anti-drop mechanism, making installation and maintenance safe and simple.

Engineered Airflow, Not Just Good Looks

At the heart of the AP202 ARGB is a patented slot vent positioned in the lower section of the chassis. This innovative airflow design draws fresh air directly to mission-critical components, with a particular focus on keeping your graphics card cool under load. Three pre-installed 120mm ARGB fans — one at the rear and two on the side — feature extra-thick 28mm frames for optimal airflow, while an integrated ARGB light band near the base ties the entire lighting scheme together with Aura Sync.

Compatibility That Keeps Up With Your Ambitions

The AP202 ARGB is built around broad compatibility so your build can evolve without outgrowing the chassis. It supports Micro-ATX and Mini-ITX motherboards, graphics cards up to 420mm in length, CPU air coolers up to 175mm tall, and radiators up to 360mm for full AIO support. A 30mm cable management compartment behind the motherboard keeps your build clean, and the unified front I/O header simplifies connecting your front panel to the board. The top I/O panel includes a USB Type-C port rated for up to 20 Gbps, two USB 3.2 Gen 1 ports, and a combined headphone/microphone jack.

Features

  • Curved tempered glass panel wraps from front to side for panoramic component visibility from multiple angles.
  • Easy-detach rail and anti-drop mechanism for safe, tool-friendly panel removal and reattachment.
  • Patented slot vent in the lower chassis provides dedicated airflow to the graphics card for improved GPU cooling.
  • Three pre-installed 120mm ARGB fans (1 x rear, 2 x side) with 28mm frames and 20 addressable RGB LEDs each.
  • Integrated ARGB light band near the base syncs seamlessly with Aura Sync for customisable ambient lighting.
  • Front I/O includes 1 x USB 3.2 Gen 2x2 Type-C (up to 20 Gbps), 2 x USB 3.2 Gen 1, and 1 x headphone/microphone combo jack.
  • Supports GPUs up to 420mm, CPU coolers up to 175mm, and radiators up to 360mm.
  • 30mm cable management compartment behind the motherboard for a clean, tidy build.
  • Colour-coordinated white internal I/O cables to complement the white chassis theme.
  • Removable dust filters at the top and bottom to reduce dust ingress.

More Colour, More Creative Freedom

The Anycubic Kobra X is a feature-rich FDM 3D printer built for makers, hobbyists, and creators who want to push beyond single-colour prints without the complexity of a professional-grade system. Combined with intelligent remote printing capabilities, you can keep tabs on your jobs from wherever you are — whether you're in the next room or out for the day.

The Perfect First Layer, Every Time

A reliable first layer is the foundation of every successful print. The Kobra X's automatic bed levelling system takes the guesswork and frustration out of setup, mapping the build surface so that your print adheres correctly from the very first line of filament. It's the kind of feature that makes a genuine difference, especially for those still building their 3D printing confidence.

Big-screen entertainment without the big-screen price

The Wanbo X5S is a Full HD smart projector built for anyone who wants a genuine home cinema experience without the complexity or cost of a large-format TV. Running on VIDAA OS with access to Netflix, YouTube, Disney+, Prime Video, Apple TV+, and over 1800 apps, it is a complete entertainment system the moment you plug it in. Whether you are mounting it to the ceiling, placing it on a shelf, or setting it up on a table for movie night, the X5S is designed to fit into your living space on your terms.

A picture that fills the room

At 1100 ANSI Lumens and native 1920x1080 Full HD resolution, the X5S delivers a bright, sharp image through its high light transmission glass lens. Project anywhere from 40 to 140 inches at a throw distance of 1.1 to 3.9 metres, and choose from front, rear, front ceiling, or rear ceiling projection modes. HDR10 support brings deeper contrast and richer colour, while the 50%–100% zoom function gives you flexibility in tighter spaces. The light source is rated for over 20,000 hours, so it will be part of your home for years to come.

Setup that takes care of itself

Tired of fiddling with projector alignment every time you move it? The X5S features automatic vertical and horizontal keystone correction (±30°), auto focus, auto obstacle avoidance, and auto screen alignment — so the image is properly framed and sharp within moments of powering on. Cold start takes just 12 seconds, and standby wake-up is as fast as 1.5 seconds. Whether you are setting up for a spontaneous movie session or a regular evening ritual, the X5S gets out of the way and lets you enjoy.

Smart, connected, and voice-ready

The X5S connects to your home network via dual-band 2.4/5GHz Wi-Fi and pairs to speakers or headphones over Bluetooth 5.0. Wireless screen casting is supported through both Miracast and AirPlay, so you can mirror your phone, tablet, or laptop without cables. VIDAA Voice lets you control the projector with your voice, and it is compatible with Google Nest Home and Apple HomePod for seamless smart home integration. The HDMI 2.1 port supports 4K HDR input, eARC output, and higher HDCP versions, while two USB ports and an AUX output round out the connection options. product.name: UGREEN NASync DH2300 2-Bay NAS Storage
product.description:
Your own private cloud — no monthly fees | Up to 64 TB of local storage | Simple app-guided setup | 4K HDMI output | AI-powered photo organisation

Quick Specs

  • Own your data — store up to 64 TB across two drive bays with no recurring cloud subscription fees
  • Experience effortless setup with NFC tap-to-connect and a guided app wizard on iOS and Android
  • Stream and display your media collection in 4K at 60Hz directly via the built-in HDMI port
  • Protect your files with RAID 1 redundancy, encryption, firewall, and two-factor authentication
  • Connect all your devices — compatible with Windows, macOS, Android, iOS, web browsers, and smart TVs

Simple, Smart Storage for the Whole Family

The UGREEN NASync DH2300 is a 2-bay home NAS designed for anyone who wants the convenience of cloud storage without the ongoing cost. Whether you are backing up family photos, streaming a movie collection to your TV, or keeping important documents accessible from anywhere, the DH2300 puts you in control of your own data — stored locally, secured privately, and reachable from any device.

Getting Started Has Never Been This Easy

Tired of tech products that require hours of configuration? The DH2300 is built for beginners with zero NAS experience. Simply download the UGREEN NAS app, tap your phone to the device using NFC to connect, and a guided setup wizard walks you through every step. Most users are up and running in under 15 minutes — no IT background required.

Powerful Hardware, Low Power Draw

At its core sits a Rockchip A72+A53 8-core processor running at 2.2 GHz, paired with 4 GB of LPDDR4X RAM. This combination keeps everyday tasks — photo management, file syncing, and media playback — running smoothly and efficiently, with a TDP of just 10 W. The system also includes 32 GB of eMMC flash memory for the operating system, keeping your drive bays free for your data.

Your Data, Fully Protected

The DH2300 supports JBOD, Basic, RAID 0, and RAID 1 configurations. Set up RAID 1 and one drive mirrors the other, so a single drive failure does not cost you your files. Advanced encryption, a built-in firewall, and two-factor authentication add further layers of security — and because everything is stored on your own hardware, not a third-party server, only you can access your data. The UGOS Pro operating system also provides granular permission management so each household member gets access to exactly what they need.

  • NFC tap-to-connect setup via the UGREEN NAS app — no technical experience needed

  • UGOS Pro operating system with AI photo organisation, remote access, and permission management
  • Advanced security: encryption, firewall, and two-factor authentication
  • Compatible with Windows, macOS, Android, iOS, web browsers, and smart TVs via DLNA

product.name: DeepCool Gamerstorm PQ1000G 1000W 80PLUS Gold Fully Modular Power Supply
product.description:
1000W Fully Modular ATX 3.1 PSU | 80 Plus Gold Certified | Native PCIe 5.1 12V-2x6 Connector | Full Japanese Capacitors | 10-Year Warranty

The GAMER STORM PQ1000G is a 1000W fully modular ATX 3.1 power supply built for demanding modern PC builds that pair high-end GPUs with power-hungry components. Rated 80 Plus Gold, it delivers at least 90% efficiency under typical 50% loads, keeping heat and energy waste to a minimum. Its native PCIe 5.1 12V-2x6 connector provides up to 450W for the latest graphics cards via a sleeved 105°C-resistant 16AWG copper-core cable, while ATX12V V3.1 compliance ensures the unit handles random power spikes — delivering twice total system power headroom and three times the rated 12V-2x6 cable power for 0.1 ms transient events. Reliability is underpinned by full Japanese electrolytic capacitors, an Active PFC + Half-Bridge LLC + DC-to-DC topology, and a hold-up time of at least 16 ms at full load — exceeding ATX 3.1 requirements. The 120 mm FDB fan adjusts speed dynamically based on internal thermal demands, and the compact 140 × 150 × 86 mm chassis fits the vast majority of ATX cases. Eight protection systems — OPP, OVP, SCP, OTP, OCP, UVP, SIP, and NLO — keep your components safe, and a full 10-year limited warranty backs every unit.

product.name: Xiaomi Sound Play Speaker 18W - White
product.description:
18W immersive sound | Beat-synced 3D ambient lighting | Up to 14 hours playtime | IP68 water & dust resistance | Auracast multi-speaker party mode

Quick Specs

  • Experience powerful, room-filling sound from an 18W racetrack-style full-range speaker with dual passive radiators for deep, punchy bass
  • Enjoy up to 14 hours of continuous playback on a single charge — so your music keeps going as long as you do
  • Connect up to 100 Xiaomi Sound Play speakers simultaneously via Auracast technology for perfectly synchronised party audio
  • Take it anywhere with confidence — IP68 water and dust resistance keeps it performing in the moments that matter
  • Light up every beat with a top infinity mirror light and bottom ambient glow ring, synced dynamically to your music

Sound that moves with you

The Xiaomi Sound Play is a portable Bluetooth speaker designed for those who refuse to compromise on audio quality or style. Whether you’re setting the mood at a gathering, soundtracking an outdoor adventure, or simply filling a room with music, its 18W output and flagship-level acoustic design deliver rich, detailed sound with deep bass that you genuinely feel. Compact enough to carry in a bag — weighing just 415 g — but powerful enough to own any space, this is portable audio done right.

Flagship acoustics in a portable form

At the heart of the Sound Play is an 18W racetrack-style full-range speaker paired with both an external and internal passive radiator. Together they produce an expansive soundstage with warm mids and punchy low-end that belies the speaker’s compact dimensions. Bluetooth 6.0 ensures a fast, stable connection with low latency and high-fidelity audio transmission, while a transmission range of up to 25 m keeps the music flowing without interruption.

Light up every beat

Tired of speakers that just sit there? The Sound Play brings a visual dimension to your music with two independent lighting zones: an infinity mirror light on top — inspired by the depth of a time tunnel — and a bottom ambient glow ring that cycles through ripple, beat, and constant modes. Both are synced dynamically to the music, turning any playlist into a light show. WRGB multi-colour output means the mood shifts with you, from quiet evenings to full-on parties.

Built for the party, built to last

With Auracast technology you can link up to 100 Xiaomi Sound Play speakers for synchronised audio and lighting across an entire venue. For a more intimate setup, TWS pairing connects two units as left and right channels for true stereo playback. When you need to step away, the built-in microphone lets you handle calls hands-free without missing a beat. IP68 water and dust resistance means a splash or a dusty environment won’t slow it down, and the 2600mAh battery delivers approximately 14 hours of playback so the music outlasts the occasion.

Features

  • 18W racetrack-style full-range speaker with external and internal passive radiators for deep, powerful bass
  • Bluetooth 6.0 for fast, stable, low-latency wireless connections up to 25 m
  • Auracast multi-speaker mode — connect up to 100 compatible devices for synchronised sound and lighting
  • TWS stereo pairing — link two Sound Play units for true left/right channel playback
  • Beat-synced 3D ambient lighting: top infinity mirror light and bottom glow ring with ripple, beat, and constant modes
  • WRGB multi-colour lighting with 3 dynamic effects
  • Up to 14 hours of playback on a 2600mAh battery (measured at 40% volume, lights off)
  • IP68 water and dust resistance for reliable outdoor and party use
  • Built-in microphone for hands-free calling
  • USB Type-C charging port; charges in approximately 2.5 hours at 5 V / 2 A
  • Soft rubber carry strap and lightweight 415 g body for easy portability

Specifications

  • Output Power: 18w
  • Battery Life: 14 hours
  • Water/Dust Resistance: IP68
  • Bluetooth Version: 6.0
  • Stereo / Party Pairing: Yes
  • Light Show / RGB: Yes
  • Colour: White
  • Warranty: 12 months
  • Product Dimensions: 6.3 x 6.9 x 20.1 cm
  • Product Weight: 415g

What’s in the Box

  • Xiaomi Sound Play Speaker 18W - White x1
  • Charging cable x1
  • User manual x1

Why Xiaomi

Xiaomi has built a global reputation for delivering flagship-level technology at accessible prices, and the Sound Play is a clear expression of that philosophy. With thoughtful acoustic engineering, intelligent connectivity features, and a design that stands out in any room, Xiaomi continues to raise the bar for what everyday audio can be.
