product.name: Xiaomi Mijia Vacuum Cleaner 4C
product.description:
Powerful 20,000 Pa suction | 75-minute cordless runtime | 5-stage HEPA-grade filtration | LED-lit brush bar | Hands-free dust disposal

Quick Specs

  • Experience powerful cyclone-driven suction at 20,000 Pa to lift dust, debris, and hair in a single pass.
  • Enjoy up to 75 minutes of cordless runtime across three adjustable suction levels for whole-home cleaning.
  • Illuminate hidden dust under beds and sofas with the built-in LED light on the all-flooring electric brush bar.
  • Achieve hygienic, hands-free dust disposal with the one-press easy-empty dust compartment.
  • Breathe easier with 5-stage precision filtration capturing 99.97% of particles as small as 0.3μm.

Effortless Whole-Home Cleaning, One Charge at a Time

The Xiaomi Mijia Vacuum Cleaner 4C is built for anyone who wants a genuinely thorough clean without the hassle of cables or constant recharging. Powered by a high-speed brushless motor delivering up to 170AW of turbo suction and 20,000 Pa of vacuum pressure, it handles everyday household messes — from fine dust to pet hair and large debris — quickly and efficiently. With three adjustable suction modes and up to 75 minutes of runtime on a single charge, the 4C has more than enough capacity to take care of the modern South African home in one go.

See What You've Been Missing

Tired of vacuuming under the bed only to find you've left half the dust behind? The all-flooring electric brush bar features a built-in LED light that illuminates dark corners, gaps beneath sofas, and the undersides of furniture, making hidden dust clearly visible so you can clean with confidence and fewer missed spots. Whether you're working across hard floors, tiles, or short-pile carpets, the brush bar adapts to the surface and brings light where you need it most.

Less Tangling, More Cleaning

Hair tangling around brush heads is one of the most frustrating parts of owning a vacuum. The 4C's all-flooring electric brush bar features an integrated anti-tangle comb that actively reduces hair wrap, cutting down on the time you spend pulling strands off the roller and getting back to cleaning sooner. Pair that with the 2-in-1 crevice brush — which switches freely between narrow-gap and surface modes — and you have versatile coverage across furniture gaps, curtains, keyboards, and high surfaces when used with the extension rod.

Cleaner Air, Healthier Home

The 4C's 5-stage precision filtration system works through primary cyclone separation, metal mesh filtration, cone cyclone separation, high-density sponge filtration, and a final high-efficiency filter stage, achieving 99.97% filtration efficiency for particles sized 0.3μm and above. The result is cleaner expelled air with every pass. Filter components are washable and reusable, keeping maintenance costs low over time. When the dust compartment is full, a single button press opens it automatically for quick, hygienic disposal — no contact required.

Features

  • 20,000 Pa cyclone-powered suction with 170AW turbo suction for effective single-pass dust removal.
  • Up to 75 minutes runtime (Eco mode with crevice brush) across three adjustable suction levels — Eco, Standard, and Turbo.
  • All-flooring electric brush bar with built-in LED light to reveal dust in dark corners and under furniture.
  • Anti-tangle comb design on the brush bar reduces hair wrap and minimises manual cleaning of the roller.
  • 2-in-1 crevice brush switches between crevice and surface brush modes; compatible with extension rod for high-reach cleaning.
  • 5-stage precision filtration captures 99.97% of particles as small as 0.3μm for cleaner expelled air.
  • One-press easy-empty dust compartment for hands-free, hygienic dust disposal.
  • Wall-mounted storage bracket included for space-saving storage and always-ready access.
  • LED battery level indicator keeps remaining power visible at a glance.
  • Washable filter components for reusable, cost-effective maintenance.

product.name: Xiaomi Mijia Electric Shaver Pro – Blue
product.description:
Pro-level shaving precision | Up to 90-day battery life | IPX8 fully washable | 360° floating head | Smart colour display

Quick Specs

  • Achieve a smoother, gentler shave with dual-ring corrugated foils and concave stainless steel blades that capture hair efficiently while minimising pulling
  • Enjoy up to 90 days of battery life on a single charge, with Type-C charging supported even while in use
  • Experience confident grooming anywhere with a full IPX8 waterproof rating — rinse under running water for effortless cleaning
  • Adapt to every contour of your face with a 360° omnidirectional floating shaver head that reaches jawlines, sideburns, and corners of the mouth
  • Stay informed at a glance with a smart dynamic colour display showing mode, battery level, and travel lock status

Flagship shaving performance, built for everyday life

The Xiaomi Mijia Electric Shaver Pro is engineered for those who refuse to compromise on their grooming routine. Combining advanced cutting technology with a skin-friendly design, it delivers a consistently close, comfortable shave whether you're at home or on the go. With its sleek blue finish and thoughtful accessories, it's equally at home in your bathroom cabinet or your travel bag.

A smarter cut that's kinder to your skin

Tired of electric shavers that tug and irritate? The Pro's dual-ring corrugated foils — crafted using Metal Injection Moulding (MIM) technology — offer a larger hair-intake area than conventional straight-groove foils, improving capture and cutting efficiency. Paired with dual-ring concave stainless steel blades, the wraparound hair-capture system locks onto facial hair with minimal pulling. The shaver head surface is coated with high-density silicon-based microbeads, forming a smooth, low-friction coating that reduces tightness and discomfort, making it suitable even for sensitive skin.

Power that adapts, precision that delivers

A high-speed motor capable of up to 5 million cuts per minute powers through thick, coarse stubble with ease. A smart chip monitors beard density up to around 100 times per second, dynamically adjusting cutting speed between Standard mode (2,900 rpm) and Turbo mode (3,100 rpm) to optimise performance at all times. The 360° omnidirectional floating shaver head flexes in every direction — vertically, horizontally, and at any angle — so no area of your face gets missed.

Weeks of use between charges, no compromise on hygiene

One full charge powers up to 95 days of shaving in Standard mode or 90 days in Turbo mode, based on one minute of use per day. When you do need to top up, the Type-C connection charges the shaver fully in approximately 2.5 hours and even supports use while charging. The full IPX8 waterproof rating means you can rinse the entire device under running water after every shave, keeping it hygienic and fresh. A smart travel lock, activated with a tap-and-hold, prevents accidental start-up in your bag, while the colour display alerts you to low battery, overheating, or operational issues before they become a problem.

product.name: Xiaomi Robot Vacuum 6 Max
product.description:
35,000 Pa suction power | AI triple-camera obstacle avoidance | Roller mopping with real-time self-cleaning | Bionic legs climb up to 6 cm | Up to 75 days hands-free maintenance

Quick Specs

  • Achieve extraordinary clean with 35,000 Pa of suction power to tackle dust, debris, and hair.
  • Navigate every corner with bionic dual robotic legs that climb obstacles and thresholds up to 6 cm high.
  • Enjoy hands-free maintenance for up to 75 days with auto-emptying, 85°C mop washing, and 50°C hot-air drying.
  • Experience intelligent obstacle avoidance with AI triple-camera recognition of 320+ items and stains.
  • Control your cleaning from anywhere via the Xiaomi Home app, Google Assistant, or Alexa.

Xiaomi's Most Advanced Robot Vacuum

The Xiaomi Robot Vacuum 6 Max is built for homeowners who refuse to compromise on cleanliness. Combining record-breaking suction, a roller mopping system with running water, bionic obstacle-climbing legs, and AI-powered panoramic recognition, it is the most capable robot vacuum Xiaomi has produced. Whether your home has thick-pile carpets, tiled floors, or tricky door thresholds, the Robot Vacuum 6 Max adapts in real time — making it the ideal choice for the modern South African home where no two rooms are quite the same.

Tired of Robot Vacuums That Get Stuck or Miss Spots?

The Robot Vacuum 6 Max eliminates that frustration at every level. Bionic dual robotic legs give it the power to climb single steps and door thresholds up to 6 cm high, so balconies, kitchens, and living rooms are all within reach without manual assistance. When cleaning beneath low-profile furniture, the retractable LiDAR automatically lowers, allowing the vacuum to access spaces as low as 9.3 cm.. An extendable side brush, a mechanical arm roller, and an extendable corner-cleaning mop pad work together to deliver millimetre-level edge cleaning along walls and around furniture legs — leaving no corner overlooked.

Real Running-Water Roller Mopping That Actually Removes Stains

Most robot mops simply drag a damp cloth across the floor. The Robot Vacuum 6 Max does far more. Its all-new roller mopping system features 16 water outlets that keep the mop pad consistently moist, while constant-pressure, human-like mopping action works deep into the surface to remove stubborn, semi-dried stains such as coffee and ketchup. The roller cleans itself in real time during the mopping pass, preventing dirt from spreading back onto the floor. A smart triple-lift design raises the roller and corner-cleaning mop pad automatically when transitioning to vacuuming or returning to the station, so dry and wet cleaning remain completely separate.

AI That Sees Your Home the Way You Do

Powered by an AI triple-camera system, the Robot Vacuum 6 Max recognises over 320 items and stains — including 200 types of household obstacles, 80 types of furniture, and 47 types of dry and wet stains. It can detect wired earphone cables as fine as 3 mm in diameter to avoid tangling, and its stain-recognition AI selects the optimal cleaning strategy for each situation: increasing suction for particles, returning to wash the mop pad before a second pass on liquids, and automatically bypassing complex messes to prevent smearing. TÜV Rheinland verified, this level of recognition is as close to human-eye-level clarity as a robot vacuum gets.

A Self-Maintaining Station That Works as Hard as You Don't

After each clean, the Robot Vacuum 6 Max returns to its omni station, where the mop pad is washed at up to 85°C and dried with 50°C hot air, while dust is automatically sealed into a disposable bag. With a bag that only needs replacing once every 75 days, routine maintenance becomes genuinely effortless. Schedule cleaning sessions, set restricted zones, monitor your home via the HD AI camera, or simply ask Google Assistant or Alexa to get things started — the Robot Vacuum 6 Max keeps working, so you don't have to.

  • Smart triple-lift design separates dry and wet cleaning automatically, raising the roller and mop pad when vacuuming or returning to the station.
  • Auto-emptying omni station washes mop pads at up to 85°C and dries with 50°C hot air — up to 75 days without manual dust emptying.
  • Control via Xiaomi Home app, Google Assistant, or Alexa; supports Xiaomi HyperOS for smart home integration.
  • 6,400 mAh battery for extended cleaning sessions, with a child lock function and OTA updates for ongoing improvements.
  • All-new warm grey finish with a dynamic interactive light ring that responds to commands and status changes.

product.name: Xiaomi Mijia Smart Standing Fan Pro Slim
product.description:
Ultra-slim smart standing fan | 100 speed levels | Whisper-quiet 26.8 dB(A) | Type-C portable charging | Award-winning design

Quick Specs

  • Enjoy whisper-quiet cooling at just 26.8 dB(A) — ideal for bedrooms and studies.
  • Achieve perfectly personalised airflow with 100 speed levels and 8 natural breeze modes.
  • Experience cooling anywhere with Type-C portable charging support — even from a power bank.
  • Control your comfort effortlessly via Bluetooth remote control from up to 30 metres away.
  • Store and move with ease thanks to the ultra-slim design and included EPP storage case.

A Smarter Breeze for Every Corner of Your Home

The Xiaomi Mijia Smart Standing Fan Pro Slim is designed for those who refuse to compromise between comfort, style, and quiet. Whether it's cooling a bedroom overnight, refreshing a home office during the day, or travelling to a campsite over the weekend, this fan adapts to your life with an ultra-slim profile, intelligent app control, and genuinely versatile power options. Its 2025 iF Design Award and Red Dot Design Award are a testament to what a fan can be when form and function are treated equally.

Slim Enough to Live With, Strong Enough to Impress

Tired of bulky pedestal fans that dominate a room even when they're not running? The Mijia Smart Standing Fan Pro Slim measures just 8.7 cm at its thinnest point — 63% slimmer than the Mi Smart Standing Fan 2 — so it tucks neatly into a corner without demanding attention. The 3 mm-thick metal base keeps it stable and slip-free while reinforcing the minimalist aesthetic. When the season changes, the modular design comes apart simply, packs into the included high-strength EPP storage case, and slides easily into a cupboard or car boot.

Natural Breeze Modes That Feel Like the Real Thing

There is a meaningful difference between a mechanical fan cycling on and off and a breeze that actually feels natural. By modelling airflow data from eight real outdoor environments — lakeside, putting green, campsite, terrace, rooftop, wetland, mountaintop, and beach — the fan can recreate those subtle, variable rhythms indoors. In Direct mode, 100 individual speed levels let you dial in exactly the right flow via the Xiaomi Home app, while the DC inverter motor runs smoothly and quietly throughout. Seven aerofoil blades deliver airflow of up to 25 m³/min with a reach of up to 14 metres, so even a larger living space gets proper circulation.

Power Where You Need It, Quiet When You Want It

A universal Type-C input means you are not limited to a wall socket. Plug in the included 18 W adapter at home, or connect a compatible power bank with QC or PD protocol for truly portable cooling — with a 10 000 mAh power bank the fan can run for up to 22 hours at its lowest setting. And at that lowest setting, power consumption drops to just 1.9 W, making it one of the most energy-efficient ways to stay cool. The stepless inverter motor keeps noise to a tested 26.8 dB(A) — barely above a whisper — so you can run it through the night without disturbing your sleep. A child lock function and 90° oscillation round out a thoughtfully designed package.

  • Eight natural breeze modes modelled on real outdoor environments, selectable via the Xiaomi Home app.
  • Seven aerofoil blades deliver up to 25 m³/min airflow with a 14-metre reach and 90° oscillation.

  • Child lock function for added safety around little ones.

Up to 180 minutes of cordless runtime | 6-leaf steel blade for thorough lint removal | Dual-size mesh holes capture fine and coarse lint | Fabric-safe 0.35 mm mesh cover | Transparent lint collector for easy monitoring

The Xiaomi Mijia Lint Remover 2 is built for anyone who wants to keep their knitwear, wool coats, trousers, scarves, and bedding looking fresh without the frustration of ineffective lint brushes or roller tape. A razor-sharp 6-leaf steel blade spins at 6000 rpm to cut through stubborn lint quickly, while the dual-size mesh holes — approximately 1.4 mm and 2 mm — capture both fine and coarse lint in a single pass. A figure-8 cyclone air duct keeps airflow moving in one direction, preventing collected lint from flowing back out, and the transparent lint collector lets you see at a glance when it needs emptying — a simple push-and-pull motion is all it takes. The 0.35 mm-thick protective mesh cover keeps the blade safely separated from your fabrics, so you can remove lint without risking damage to delicate garments. Fully charged in approximately 2 hours via USB Type-C, the high-capacity battery delivers up to 180 minutes of continuous cordless use — enough for months of regular sessions before you need to plug in again. Dual safety protections automatically stop the device if the mesh cover loosens and prevent accidental startup while charging, giving you confident, worry-free use every time.

Installation and removal take just moments, no tools required. Compact enough not to interfere with your ride, it measures 26 x 14 x 11 cm — a tidy, practical upgrade for every journey.

product.name: Seagate Ironwolf Pro 8TB 256MB 3.5" SATA HDD
product.description:
Optimised for demanding 24×7 NAS environments; access your data anytime, anywhere with class-leading dependability.

Quick Specs

  • Experience consistent, industry-leading 24×7 performance with the all-CMR portfolio.
  • Benefit from unmatched TCO with a 550TB/year workload rating and 2.5M hours MTBF.
  • Gain peace of mind with complimentary 3-year Rescue Data Recovery Services.
  • Protect your data proactively with intelligent IronWolf Health Management.
  • Achieve top RAID performance in multi-bay environments with AgileArray optimisation.

The Seagate IronWolf Pro 8TB HDD is your trusted ally for demanding data management in South Africa.

This hard disk drive is engineered for the rigorous needs of professionals and small businesses, offering a robust foundation for your digital assets. Experience unwavering dependability and continuous access to your critical data, whether for essential backups, extensive video libraries, or vital business operations. Its design prioritises data integrity and accessibility, making it an indispensable component for any setup that cannot afford downtime. Optimized for Network Attached Storage (NAS) environments, this high-performance HDD ensures your data is not only stored but also protected and readily available 24×7.

Consistent, industry-leading 24×7 performance

Leveraging an all-CMR portfolio, the Seagate IronWolf Pro 8TB delivers consistent, industry-leading performance. This ensures you can access your data anytime, anywhere, with unparalleled reliability. The drive boasts an exceptional workload rating of up to 550TB per year and a Mean Time Between Failures (MTBF) of 2.5 million hours. These metrics underscore its capability for relentless operation, significantly reducing the risk of interruptions and enhancing the total cost of ownership for your storage infrastructure.

Proactive data protection and peace of mind

Your data’s security is paramount. Every Seagate IronWolf Pro 8TB HDD comes with complimentary 3-year Rescue Data Recovery Services, providing a hassle-free, zero-cost recovery experience in the event of accidental data loss. Complementing this is the intelligent IronWolf Health Management system, which actively monitors drive health and offers actionable recommendations for prevention, intervention, and recovery, thus safeguarding your valuable information.

Optimised for superior multi-bay NAS performance

Engineered for the complexities of multi-bay NAS environments, this 8TB hard disk drive features AgileArray optimisation. This firmware enhances drive performance by ensuring superior vibration mitigation through dual-plane balancing, preventing data corruption in RAID arrays with Time-Limited Error Recovery (TLER), and optimising for rotational vibration (RV) sensors. These advanced features collectively deliver top RAID performance and maintain data integrity even under heavy, continuous loads.

The ultimate hard disk drive for your NAS

Choosing the right hard disk drive is crucial for operational efficiency and data security. The Seagate IronWolf Pro 8TB HDD offers an optimal blend of high capacity, exceptional performance, and advanced features specifically tailored for NAS applications. Its robust construction, comprehensive data protection, and recovery services make it an essential component for businesses and professionals in South Africa seeking a reliable and high-performing storage solution.

FEATURES:

  • High Performance: All-CMR (conventional magnetic recording) portfolio enables consistent, industry-leading 24×7 performance allowing users to access data anytime, anywhere
  • Class-Leading Dependability: Up to 550TB/year workload rating, 2.5M hours MTBF, and 5-year limited warranty for unparalleled total cost of ownership (TCO)
  • Peace of Mind with Data Recovery: Complimentary 3 year Rescue Data Recovery Services for a hassle-free, zero-cost data recovery experience
  • IronWolf Health Management: Helps protect data with prevention, intervention, and recovery recommendations to ensure peak system health
  • Optimized for NAS: AgileArray with dual-plane balancing, time-limited error recovery (TLER), and rotational vibration (RV) sensors to deliver top RAID performance in multi-bay environments

SPECIFICATIONS:

  • Capacity: 8TB
  • Interface: SATA 6Gb/s
  • Spindle Speed (RPM): 7,200
  • Cache (MB): 256
  • Mean Time Between Failures (MTBF, hours): 2,000,000
  • Reliability Rating @ Full 24×7 Operation (AFR): 0.44%
  • Non-recoverable Read Errors Rate, Max: 1 sector per 10E15
  • Power-on Hours: 8,760
  • Bytes per Sector: 512E

Why Seagate?

Seagate has long been at the forefront of storage innovation, providing South African businesses with the reliable, high-performance solutions essential for today’s data-intensive environments. Trust Seagate for enterprise-grade quality and unwavering data integrity with their robust 3.5-inch hard drive offerings.

product.name: UGreen NASync DXP2800 2 Bay NAS with Seagate Ironwolf NAS 16TB SATA Hard Drive V2 Bundle (2x 8TB)
product.description:
Designed to empower seamless collaboration, high-speed access, and enterprise-level data security, the UGREEN NASync DXP2800 2 Bay NAS is a purpose-built solution for professionals and teams managing large, mission-critical files across networked environments.

As a dedicated network-attached storage (NAS) system, this device enables users across the same network, whether in a creative agency, architecture firm, remote working setup, or IT department, to access, store, and collaborate on data continuously and securely. The centralised storage model eliminates file version conflicts and bottlenecks, ensuring that teams operate from a single source of truth.

Built on a powerful 12th Gen Intel® N100 processor with 4 cores and 4 threads, the UGREEN NASync DXP2800 2 Bay NAS delivers responsive multi-user performance. The 8GB DDR5 RAM is expandable to 16GB, allowing smooth operation of multiple applications and services, including private cloud hosting, AI-driven media sorting, and virtualisation environments.

The Seagate IronWolf 8TB NAS Hard Drive is expertly engineered for the demanding workloads of NAS environments, offering superior reliability, endurance, and speed for home, small business, and professional data storage systems. With a powerful combination of CMR technology, AgileArray™ firmware, and IronWolf Health Management, this drive ensures 24×7 operational readiness, optimized RAID performance, and proactive drive monitoring for superior data integrity.

Supporting up to 180TB workloads per year, the IronWolf 8TB delivers sustained transfer rates of up to 202MB/s, making it ideal for file sharing, data backups, media streaming, and collaborative access in multi-user NAS systems. It supports one- to eight-bay enclosures and is tested for compatibility with top NAS brands like Synology, QNAP, and Asustor. With RV sensors, dual-plane balance, and error recovery control, it maintains consistent performance in high-vibration, multi-drive environments, preventing mechanical strain and enhancing system longevity.

  • Supports up to 64TB storage via 2 SATA bays and dual M.2 NVMe slots

product.name: PCBuilder CUBE Intel Core 3-100U 16GB DDR5 512GB Windows 11 Pro Mini PC
product.description:

The PCBuilder CUBE-100U Intel Core 3 Barebone Mini PC is a compact PC designed to deliver high-performance computing in a space-saving form factor. Whether you’re looking for a reliable workstation for office tasks, a powerful solution for digital signage, or an efficient point-of-sale (POS) system, this compact PC is built to handle professional workloads with ease.

The CUBE-100U Intel® Mini PC houses a strong Intel® Core™ 3 100U processor, featuring 6 cores and 8 threads, capable of reaching speeds of up to 4.70GHz. This combination ensures smooth multitasking, fast application performance, and reliable responsiveness across business applications, making it an ideal choice for modern work environments that require efficiency and speed.

Optimized for productivity, this compact PC supports stunning 8K visuals powered by Intel® Graphics, delivering sharp, detailed, and vibrant imagery for professionals who need high-resolution displays. With Type-C, DisplayPort, and HDMI 2.1 outputs, users can create flexible multi-monitor setups – extending or mirroring up to three displays to enhance workflow efficiency. Whether you’re working on spreadsheets, video editing, digital signage management, or client presentations, the CUBE-100U Intel® Mini PC ensures crystal-clear visuals at 8K@60Hz for a truly immersive viewing experience.

Seamless connectivity and next-gen memory performance come standard in the CUBE-100U, making it a future-ready solution for dynamic workflows. Powered by 16GB of dual-channel DDR5 SO-DIMM memory, Intel® Wi-Fi 6, Bluetooth® 5.2, and dual 2.5Gbps Ethernet ports, it delivers blazing speed and rock-solid stability – whether in the office or working remotely. Additionally, the inclusion of ultra-fast USB3.2 and USB4 ports enables high-speed data transfers of up to 40Gbps, allowing users to connect external storage devices, monitors, and high-performance peripherals.

Designed with storage performance and flexibility in mind, the CUBE-100U features a 512GB M.2 PCIe 3.0 NVMe SSD slots for blazing-fast boot and load times. This gives users the freedom to configure up to two high-speed drives – ideal for creative workloads, business operations, or on-the-go computing. Whether you’re accessing critical files, running demanding apps, or expanding long-term storage, this ultra-compact PC adapts effortlessly to your needs.

Designed for a clean, cable-free workspace, the CUBE-100U Intel® Mini PC is VESA-mountable, allowing you to attach it behind a monitor or under a desk to maximise your available space. Its compact yet durable build ensures long-term reliability, making it an excellent choice for business professionals, retail environments, and digital signage setups. Additionally, a built-in Kensington lock slot enhances security in shared office spaces, preventing unauthorised access and keeping your device and work safe.

The PCBuilder CUBE comes pre-installed with Windows 11, which has easy-to-use tools that can help you optimise your screen space and maximise your productivity. It features great tools like Microsoft Edge, the new and improved Microsoft Store, Snap Layouts to arrange your open windows into grids, Desktops for better organisation, as well as Widgets.

Built in-house by our experienced technicians, each build is constructed with care and precision. They’re packaged with protective foam that secures the components while in transit, so every build arrives at its destination ready to use from day one. PCBuilder mini PCs come with a 2-year warranty.

For professionals seeking a compact PC that combines power, efficiency, and space-saving design, the CUBE-100U Intel® Mini PC is a power-packing solution. Whatever your day throws at you, this Intel® mini PC offers the speed, connectivity, and versatility to meet your needs.

product.name: AMD Ryzen™ 7 5800X3D 8-Core 3.4GHz AM4 CPU
product.description:
AMD Ryzen™ 7 5800X3D | 8 Cores / 16 Threads | 3.4GHz Base, up to 4.5GHz Boost | 96MB L3 (3D V-Cache™) | Socket AM4 | DDR4 | PCIe 4.0

Quick Specs

  • Game at the top of the AM4 platform with AMD’s 3D V-Cache™ technology
  • Power through with 8 Zen 3 cores and 16 threads
  • Boost up to 4.5 GHz when your games and apps demand it
  • Tap into a massive 96MB of L3 cache for higher frame rates
  • Drop straight into existing AM4 boards with DDR4 and PCIe 4.0

The Ultimate AM4 Gaming Processor

The AMD Ryzen™ 7 5800X3D is the ultimate gaming processor for the DDR4 platform, and it’s built around AMD’s game-changing 3D V-Cache™ technology. By stacking a huge 96MB of L3 cache onto its 8-core, 16-thread Zen 3 design, it feeds the CPU more game data closer to the cores — delivering higher frame rates in the titles that matter to gamers across South Africa, without needing a brand-new platform.

Zen 3 Performance, Ready to Boost

Built on the proven Zen 3 architecture, the 5800X3D runs at a 3.4 GHz base clock and boosts up to 4.5 GHz with Precision Boost 2, so it stays responsive whether you’re gaming, streaming or tackling everyday productivity. With 8 cores and Simultaneous Multithreading (SMT) for 16 threads, plus a 512KB L1 / 4MB L2 cache hierarchy, it has the muscle for serious multitasking as well as high-refresh gaming.

A Smart, Easy Upgrade for AM4 Builds

One of the 5800X3D’s biggest strengths is its socket AM4 compatibility. It works with X570, X470, B550, B450 and A520 chipsets, making it a superb drop-in upgrade for existing AM4 systems — often with just a BIOS update. It supports dual-channel DDR4 up to 128GB (DDR4-3200), PCIe® 4.0, and even ECC memory with compatible motherboards, so you get modern connectivity without the cost of a full platform change.

Built for Modern Gaming and Cool Operation

Supporting AMD 3D V-Cache™, Windows® 11 gaming and AMD Ryzen™ VR-Ready Premium, the 5800X3D is engineered for today’s most demanding experiences. It’s manufactured on TSMC’s 7nm process with a 105W default TDP and a 90°C maximum operating temperature. No cooler is included in the box, and AMD recommends a liquid cooler for optimal performance — so pair it with a capable AIO to keep it running at its best.

FEATURES:

  • AMD 3D V-Cache™ technology with a massive 96MB L3 cache for higher gaming frame rates
  • 8 Zen 3 cores and 16 threads (Simultaneous Multithreading)
  • 3.4 GHz base clock, boosting up to 4.5 GHz with Precision Boost 2
  • Socket AM4 compatibility with X570, X470, B550, B450 and A520 chipsets
  • Dual-channel DDR4 support up to 128GB (DDR4-3200), with ECC support on compatible boards
  • PCIe® 4.0 connectivity with NVMe boot and RAID 0/1/10 support
  • Supports Windows® 11 Gaming and AMD Ryzen™ VR-Ready Premium
  • Built on TSMC 7nm FinFET process technology
  • Unlocked for tuning, with a broad set of supported instruction extensions
  • Cooler not included; liquid cooler recommended for optimal performance

AMD Ryzen™ processors have earned a loyal following among gamers and creators worldwide for delivering exceptional performance and value. The WINX View Essential Magnetic Phone Holder is built for drivers who want a fuss-free, flexible way to keep their phone in view on the dashboard. The memory soft-aluminium arm bends freely in any direction and adjusts up or down through 90°, so you can dial in the perfect viewing angle without tools or fiddling. A one-click vacuum suction cup base locks firmly onto the dashboard surface and releases just as easily with a single press, leaving no marks and allowing the holder to be repositioned whenever needed. The magnetic head snaps onto MagSafe-compatible phones and magnetic phone cases, and rotates a full 360° so portrait or landscape orientation is always an option. Constructed from ABS, PC, TPU, and aluminium alloy, with a rubberised TPU-over-aluminium arm that feels comfortable to handle, the holder is built to withstand operating temperatures from -20°C to 75°C and has been tested against drop, vibration, salt-spray, and thermal-shock requirements. A practical, durable mount that stays put on every drive.

product.name: Gizzu Hero Pro 2048Wh/2400W UPS Power Station With App
product.description:
2048Wh LiFePO4 power | 2400W continuous AC output | 10ms UPS switchover | Full charge in 2 hours | App-enabled control

Quick Specs

  • Keep the lights on with 2048Wh of LiFePO4 battery capacity — enough to power most household appliances through any outage
  • Deliver up to 2400W of continuous AC power (4800W peak) via pure sine wave output, safe for sensitive electronics
  • Charge back to full in just 2 hours via AC, or harness up to 500W of solar input for off-grid flexibility
  • Stay connected to the grid seamlessly — the built-in UPS function switches to battery power in just 10ms
  • Control and monitor everything from your phone via the Bright EMS app, with Bluetooth and Wi-Fi connectivity

Power That Keeps Up With South African Life

The Gizzu Hero Pro 2048Wh UPS Power Station is built for households and home offices that refuse to be held hostage by load shedding. With 2048Wh of Lithium Iron Phosphate (LiFePO4) battery capacity and a 2400W continuous AC output, it can keep your fridge running, your router online, your coffee machine brewing, and your workstation humming — all at the same time. Whether you're working from home or simply keeping the essentials going, the Hero Pro delivers the headroom you need.

Zero Downtime When the Grid Goes Down

Tired of that jarring flicker when the power cuts? The Hero Pro's built-in UPS function switches from mains to battery power in just 10ms — fast enough that your connected devices never even notice. Simply plug the Hero Pro between your wall socket and your appliances, switch the AC output on, and it operates in bypass mode during normal grid power. The moment grid power fails, it seamlessly takes over. No restarting your router. No losing your work. No interruptions.

Charge Fast, Charge Anywhere

A full recharge from 0 to 100% takes just 2 hours via AC — so even a short window of grid power is enough to top it up completely. When the grid isn't available, the Hero Pro accepts up to 500W of solar input (11.5–50V via the XT90 port), letting you recharge from solar panels when the sun is out. You can also recharge from your car's 12V or 24V outlet using the included cigarette lighter to XT90 cable. Multiple recharge paths mean you're never without options.

Ports for Every Device, Control From Your Phone

The Hero Pro's output array is designed to charge everything simultaneously: two 220V AC outlets, two USB-A 18W QC3.0 ports, three Type-C 20W PD ports, one Type-C 100W PD port, two DC5521 ports (12V/3A), one car socket port (12V/10A), and one XT60 port (12V/25A). Manage it all from the Bright EMS app — available via Bluetooth and Wi-Fi — where you can monitor battery status, control individual outputs, set scheduled charging, configure standby times, and enable silent charging mode. The onboard LCD display keeps you informed at a glance, and the 1W LED torch adds a practical backup light when you need it.

Built to Last the Long Game

The LiFePO4 battery chemistry at the heart of the Hero Pro is rated for 3500 charge cycles to 80% capacity — delivering years of daily use before any meaningful degradation. A built-in Battery Management System proactively monitors the battery's health, while comprehensive protection features — including short-circuit, over-current, over-voltage, under-voltage, overload, and temperature protection — keep both the unit and your connected devices safe. Backed by a 24-month warranty, the Hero Pro is a long-term investment in reliable power.

Features

  • 2048Wh LiFePO4 battery capacity — powers household appliances and home office equipment through extended outages
  • 2400W continuous AC output (4800W peak) via pure sine wave inverter — safe for sensitive electronics
  • Built-in UPS function with 10ms switchover time — zero downtime when grid power fails
  • Full AC recharge from 0 to 100% in 2 hours; accepts up to 500W solar input (11.5–50V) and 12V/24V car charging
  • Comprehensive port array: 2x AC outlets, 2x USB-A QC3.0 18W, 3x Type-C 20W PD, 1x Type-C 100W PD, 2x DC5521 12V/3A, 1x car socket 12V/10A, 1x XT60 12V/25A
  • App-enabled via Bluetooth and Wi-Fi (Bright EMS app) — monitor, control, and schedule charging from your phone
  • Rated for 3500 cycles to 80% capacity with built-in Battery Management System
  • Protection features: short-circuit, over-current, over-voltage, under-voltage, overload, and temperature protection
  • Onboard LCD display and 1W LED torch included

product.description:
Hall Effect precision meets premium craftsmanship | Tri-mode wireless freedom | Rapid Trigger at 0.1 mm sensitivity | Full 100% layout with hot-swap switches | Aluminium and wood Special Edition build

Quick Specs

  • Dominate every session with Gateron Double-rail Magnetic Switches featuring Rapid Trigger and 0.1 mm sensitivity for unmatched input precision.
  • Connect wirelessly via 2.4 GHz, Bluetooth, or wired Type-C — tri-mode flexibility for any setup.
  • Enjoy up to 120 hours of wireless working time from the 4000 mAh rechargeable battery.
  • Customise your actuation points from 0.2 – 3.8 mm and swap switches instantly with full hot-swap support.
  • Experience the full 100% layout with North-facing RGB backlighting through PBT OSA Double-shot keycaps.

Where Competitive Edge Meets Crafted Design

The Keychron K10 HE Special Edition is built for the discerning South African gamer who refuses to compromise between performance and aesthetics. Combining an aluminium and wood body with Gateron Double-rail Magnetic Switches, this full-size 100% wireless gaming keyboard delivers Hall Effect technology in a chassis worthy of any serious battle station. Whether you are grinding ranked matches or powering through creative work, the K10 HE Special Edition is engineered to keep up — and to look remarkable doing it.

Rapid Trigger Gives You the Competitive Advantage

Tired of keyboards that hold you back with fixed actuation points? The Gateron Double-rail Magnetic Switch technology in the K10 HE introduces Rapid Trigger with a sensitivity of 0.1 mm, meaning the keyboard reacts the instant your fingers move — not when they reach an arbitrary threshold. Adjustable actuation points from 0.2 to 3.8 mm let you dial in exactly how responsive each keypress feels, and Dynamic Keystroke 4-in-1 action keys give you added programmability to match your playstyle. With N-Key Rollover across both wired and wireless modes and a 1000 Hz polling rate over 2.4 GHz and wired connections, every input registers with precision.

Tri-Mode Wireless — No Strings Attached

The K10 HE Special Edition connects however you need it to. Switch seamlessly between 2.4 GHz wireless (via the included Type-A receiver), Bluetooth, and Type-C wired — all without missing a beat. The 4000 mAh rechargeable li-polymer battery delivers up to 120 hours of wireless working time, so extended sessions never catch you unprepared. Whether you are at your desk, on the couch, or moving between workspaces, the K10 HE keeps you connected and in control.

Built to Last, Built to Customise

The Special Edition body pairs aluminium and real wood for a construction that feels as premium as it performs. PBT OSA Double-shot keycaps resist shine and fade over years of heavy use, while the North-facing RGB backlighting delivers vivid, even illumination across every key. Hot-swap support means you can pull and replace switches without soldering — ideal for anyone who wants to experiment with feel or simply replace a switch over time. The included plate-mounted stabilisers, sound-absorbing foam, EPDM foam, and silicone bottom pad all work together to produce a refined, dampened typing sound that is easy to appreciate across long sessions. Compatible with Windows, macOS, and Linux, the K10 HE Special Edition adapts to your ecosystem.

product.name: Keychron K10 HE 100% Hot-Swap Gateron Dbl-Rail Nebula Switch RGB Wireless Keyboard - Black
product.description:
100% Full-Size Layout | Gateron Double-Rail Magnetic Nebula Switch | 0.1 mm Sensitivity | 2.4 GHz / Bluetooth 5.2 / USB Type-C | North-Facing RGB | Hot-Swappable | 4000 mAh

Quick Specs

  • Dominate fast-paced games with adjustable actuation from 0.2 mm to 3.8 mm and pinpoint 0.1 mm sensitivity
  • Switch instantly across three devices via 2.4 GHz, Bluetooth 5.2 or USB Type-C wired
  • Type for days on the 4000 mAh battery, lasting up to 120 hours on a single charge
  • Customise every key with hot-swappable magnetic switches and open-source QMK firmware
  • Enjoy a thocky, refined sound built from layered EVA foam, EPDM foam and a silicone acoustic pad

Magnetic Precision Meets Classic Mechanical Feel

Transform your gaming and typing experience with the Keychron K10 HE. This fully customisable 100% layout wireless keyboard pairs a familiar mechanical feel with cutting-edge Hall effect magnetic switch technology, delivering exceptional performance in a sleek, understated black finish. Instead of fixed physical contacts, magnetic sensors measure exactly how far you press each key — putting you in total control of every keystroke.

Super-Sensitive, Lightning-Fast Response

At the heart of the K10 HE sits the pre-lubed Gateron Double-Rail Magnetic Nebula Switch, engineered for ultra-stable, industry-leading response with precise control over every press. The double-rail structure keeps each keystroke smooth and wobble-free, while 0.1 mm sensitivity and an adjustable actuation range from 0.2 mm to 3.8 mm let you tune shallow presses for instant actions and deeper ones for deliberate engagement — reducing accidental inputs without sacrificing speed.

Tuned for Competitive Gaming

The K10 HE is loaded with features built for the win. Rapid Trigger activates and resets keys based on how far they travel rather than fixed points, enabling faster repeated keystrokes. Last Key Priority (LKP) and Snap Click keep directional changes clean in titles like Valorant, while Dynamic Keystrokes (DKS) assign up to four distinct actions to a single key by press depth. Analog Mode brings controller-like variable input to racing and simulation games, and a 1000 Hz polling rate with class-leading 3.4 ms latency keeps everything razor-sharp.

Wireless Freedom Without Compromise

Powered by a capable ARM core MCU with 256 KB and QMK open-source firmware, the K10 HE holds a 1000 Hz polling rate in both USB Type-C wired and 2.4 GHz modes. Connect via Bluetooth 5.2 to as many as three devices and switch between your computer, phone and tablet on the fly, then keep going for up to 120 hours on the 4000 mAh rechargeable battery.

Built to Look and Sound the Part

The full-size aluminium-framed body houses Cherry profile double-shot shine-through PBT keycaps that resist oil and wear while letting the north-facing RGB glow through cleanly. With 22+ backlight presets plus Per-key RGB and Mix RGB, you can paint the board exactly to your taste. Inside, pre-lubed switches, 3.5 mm EVA acoustic foam, EPDM foam and a silicone pad deliver that soft, thocky, satisfying sound.

  • Last Key Priority (LKP) and Snap Click for cleaner directional control in competitive titles
  • Dynamic Keystrokes (DKS) assign up to four actions per key by press depth
  • Analog Mode delivers controller-like variable input for racing and simulation games
  • Triple connectivity via 2.4 GHz, Bluetooth 5.2 and USB Type-C wired

  • Cherry profile double-shot shine-through PBT keycaps resist wear and oil
  • 4000 mAh battery delivering up to 120 hours of wireless use

product.name: Keychron Q0 Max QMK Gateron Jupiter Banana RGB Wireless Custom Number Pad Shell White
product.description:
Professional-grade custom numpad | Tri-mode wireless freedom | Hot-swappable Gateron Jupiter Bananas | Full QMK/VIA programmability | Premium aluminium build

Quick Specs

  • Dominate your workflow with tri-mode connectivity — 2.4GHz wireless, Bluetooth 5.1, and USB Type-C wired, all in one compact numpad.
  • Experience tactile, gentle keystrokes with hot-swappable Gateron Jupiter Banana switches — swap them out without soldering.
  • Customise every key to your preference with full QMK/VIA support and five dedicated macro keys.
  • Enjoy up to 50 hours of wireless working time on a single charge, keeping you productive through marathon sessions.

The Custom Numpad Built for Those Who Demand More

The Keychron Q0 Max is a premium wireless custom number pad engineered for professionals, enthusiasts, and gamers who refuse to compromise on feel, function, or flexibility. Built into a full aluminium body and loaded with QMK/VIA programmability, it brings desktop-grade customisation to a compact numpad form — a genuinely capable addition to any modern South African setup.

Connect Your Way, Every Time

Tired of being tethered to a single device? The Q0 Max offers true tri-mode connectivity — switch seamlessly between 2.4GHz wireless, Bluetooth 5.1, and USB Type-C wired at the press of a button. The 1800mAh rechargeable Li-polymer battery delivers up to 50 hours of wireless working time with RGB at its lowest brightness setting, so you can stay productive across long sessions without hunting for a cable.

A Typing Experience You Can Make Your Own

At the heart of the Q0 Max are Gateron Jupiter Banana switches — tactile, gentle actuators that register effortlessly. Because the board is fully hot-swappable, you can replace every switch without soldering if your preferences change over time. The KSA double-shot PBT keycaps are built to resist shine and wear, while south-facing RGB LEDs illuminate the legends cleanly from below. Five dedicated macro keys (M1–M5) and a rotary knob let you map shortcuts, media controls, or workflow commands exactly as you need them — all configurable through QMK or VIA firmware.

Built to Last, Tuned to Sound Great

The Q0 Max is constructed from aluminium at a 5.2° typing angle, with a steel plate and screw-in PCB stabilisers for a solid, rattle-free foundation. Multiple acoustic layers — including sound-absorbing foam, IXPE foam, PET film, a latex bottom pad, and bottom case acoustic foam with a PET film layer — work together to dampen unwanted resonance and produce a deep, satisfying sound profile. The result is a numpad that feels and sounds as premium as it performs.

  • Hot-swappable Gateron Jupiter Banana switches — tactile, gentle, and replaceable without soldering.

  • Five dedicated macro keys (M1–M5) plus a rotary knob for custom shortcut control.
  • Up to 50 hours wireless working time from an 1800mAh rechargeable li-polymer battery.
  • KSA double-shot PBT keycaps — durable, non-shine-through legends built for longevity.
  • South-facing RGB LED backlighting with per-key illumination.
  • Premium aluminium body with steel plate and screw-in PCB stabilisers for a sturdy, resonance-free build.
  • Multi-layer acoustic dampening: sound-absorbing foam, IXPE foam, PET film, latex bottom pad, and bottom case foam.
  • N-Key Rollover (NKRO) on both wireless (2.4GHz) and wired modes.
  • Compatible with macOS, Windows, and Linux.

product.name: Cudy 4 Port Gigabit PoE 1x PoE Input 60W Switch
product.description:
The Cudy POE40 is a 4-channel Gigabit PoE++ Extender built for installers and network administrators who need to push both power and data beyond the standard 100-metre Ethernet limit. Connect a single 802.3bt/at/af PoE input on Port 5 and split it into four Gigabit PoE outputs — each capable of delivering up to 30W — to run IP cameras, access points, VoIP phones, and access readers from a single upstream source. In standard mode the four output ports reach up to 100 metres at full Gigabit speeds; switch to Extend mode and transmission stretches to 250 metres, though port speed is capped at 10 Mbps in that configuration. VLAN mode keeps downlink ports isolated from one another for improved network security, while the Watchdog switch monitors connected clients and automatically restores them if they become unresponsive. Up to three POE40 units can be daisy-chained for even greater reach. The all-metal housing supports desktop or wall-mount installation, keeping cabling tidy in any environment.

Features

  • 1× Gigabit PoE input (802.3bt/at/af) powers 4× Gigabit PoE outputs (802.3at/af)
  • Max power output of 2× 30W or 4× 12.95W across the four output ports
  • Extend mode stretches transmission to 250 metres (at 10 Mbps) using Cat 5e or higher cable
  • VLAN mode isolates downlink ports from each other for improved network security
  • PoE Watchdog monitors clients and automatically recovers unresponsive devices
  • Daisy-chain up to 3 extenders for extended network reach
  • Comprehensive protection: polarity, overvoltage, short-circuit, automatic voltage regulation, 6kV lightning/surge, 6kV ESD contact, 8kV ESD air
  • Desktop or wall-mount installation; durable all-metal casing

In the heat of battle, where milliseconds determine victory, the G3 stands apart. This is not simply a peripheral; it is a high-performance instrument designed for players who understand that control and agility are paramount. At the core of the Keychron G3 lies the state-of-the-art PixArt 3950 Optical Sensor. Coupled with an astonishing tracking speed of up to 750 IPS, the G3 maintains accuracy even during the most frenetic gameplay. The true differentiator, however, is the ability to adjust the polling rate from 125 Hz all the way up to an incredible 8,000 Hz. This translates to a latency as low as 0.41ms on the 2.4 GHz wireless connection at 8,000 Hz, effectively eliminating any perceptible delay between your action and the on-screen response. For gamers in South Africa, this means a level of real-time control previously unattainable with a standard Bluetooth gaming mouse or any ultra light gaming mouse.

The 500mAh battery provides substantial gaming time, offering up to 37 hours on the demanding 2.4 GHz wireless at 8,000 Hz, and even longer in Bluetooth or lower polling rate modes, ensuring your wireless gaming mouse is ready when you are.

Seamless integration across your gaming ecosystem

Connectivity is paramount, and the G3 offers true tri-mode flexibility. Connect via the reliable 2.4 GHz wireless for maximum performance, utilise the power-efficient Bluetooth 5.3 for versatile pairing, or opt for the stable wired USB Type-C connection. This adaptability ensures the G3 integrates seamlessly into any South African gaming setup, offering the convenience of a Bluetooth gaming mouse when desired. Every aspect of the Q3 Max is designed to bend to your preferences. product.name: MSI B650M Gaming Plus WiFi AM5 M-ATX Gaming Motherboard
product.description:
AMD B650 Chipset | AM5 Socket | DDR5 up to 7200+(OC) MHz | 2× M.2 PCIe 4.0 | Lightning Gen 4 PCIe x16 | 2.5Gbps LAN | Wi-Fi 6E | Bluetooth 5.3 | USB 3.2 Gen 2 10Gbps | 7.1-Channel Audio Boost | Micro-ATX

Quick Specs

  • Build on the latest AMD AM5 platform with support for Ryzen™ 9000, 8000, and 7000 Series desktop processors.
  • Unleash DDR5 performance with four UDIMM slots supporting up to 256GB at 7200+(OC) MHz with AMD EXPO™.
  • Connect at speed with 2.5Gbps LAN, Wi-Fi 6E (6GHz), Bluetooth 5.3, and extensive USB 3.2 Gen 2 ports.
  • Install high-speed NVMe storage on two M.2 slots with PCIe 4.0 x4 and M.2 Shield Frozr cooling.
  • Game with confidence on a 10+2+1 Duet Rail power design, 6-layer 2oz copper PCB, and Lightning Gen 4 PCIe x16 with Steel Armor.

A rock-solid AM5 foundation for South African gamers and builders who demand DDR5 performance, fast connectivity, and room to grow.

The MSI B650M Gaming Plus WiFi is the AM5 motherboard that delivers where it counts — combining AMD B650 chipset support for the latest Ryzen™ 9000, 8000, and 7000 Series processors with DDR5 memory speeds up to 7200+(OC) MHz and AMD EXPO™ compatibility. Its compact Micro-ATX form factor fits a wide range of cases without sacrificing the features serious builders need: dual M.2 NVMe slots, Lightning Gen 4 PCIe, Wi-Fi 6E, 2.5Gbps Ethernet, and a comprehensive USB layout including USB 3.2 Gen 2 10Gbps. Whether you’re assembling a gaming rig, a content creation workstation, or a high-performance everyday PC, this DDR5 motherboard provides the stable, feature-rich platform to make it happen. For the South African enthusiast who wants MSI quality without the flagship price, this gaming motherboard is the smart choice.

Robust power delivery and thermal engineering for sustained performance.

At the heart of the B650M Gaming Plus WiFi sits a 10+2+1 phase Duet Rail Power System with Core Boost and Memory Boost technology, ensuring clean, stable voltage delivery to your CPU and RAM under heavy loads. The 6-layer PCB with 2oz thickened copper improves signal integrity and heat dissipation across the board. An extended heatsink and heavy plated VRM heatsink keep the power stages cool during demanding workloads, while the M.2 Shield Frozr thermal solution protects your NVMe drives from thermal throttling. High-quality 7W/mK MOSFET thermal pads and additional choke pads ensure stability when all cores are running at full speed. This MSI motherboard is built for sustained, reliable performance.

Blazing-fast storage and expansion for your most demanding builds.

Two M.2 slots — both running PCIe 4.0 x4 from the CPU — give you the bandwidth for high-speed NVMe SSDs, while four SATA 6G ports handle additional drives with RAID 0, 1, and 10 support. The Lightning Gen 4 PCIe x16 slot with MSI Steel Armor delivers double the bandwidth of PCIe 3.0, reinforced with heavy soldered connections to support heavy graphics cards and shield against electromagnetic interference. Two additional PCIe 3.0 x1 slots provide room for capture cards, sound cards, or other expansion. With Realtek ALC897 Audio Boost delivering 7.1-channel high-definition sound through isolated audio circuitry, this B650 motherboard covers every angle of a high-performance build.

Premium connectivity that keeps you ahead of the game.

The pre-installed Wi-Fi 6E module delivers tri-band wireless across 2.4 GHz, 5 GHz, and 6 GHz bands with MU-MIMO and 160 MHz channel bandwidth, while Bluetooth 5.3 ensures fast, stable connections to peripherals and accessories. The Realtek RTL8125BG 2.5Gbps LAN port provides wired networking that outpaces standard Gigabit connections. The rear I/O panel offers a comprehensive port selection: three USB 3.2 Gen 2 10Gbps Type-A ports, one USB 3.2 Gen 2 10Gbps USB Type-C port, four USB 5Gbps Type-A ports, plus HDMI 2.1 and DisplayPort 1.4 for integrated graphics output. Front panel headers add further USB 2.0, USB 5Gbps, and USB 10Gbps USB Type-C connectivity. Four EZ Debug LEDs simplify troubleshooting, and addressable RGB headers let you customise your build’s aesthetic. This motherboard with WiFi puts everything at your fingertips.

FEATURES:

  • Supports AMD Ryzen™ 9000/8000/7000 Series desktop processors on the AM5 socket with AMD B650 chipset.
  • 4× DDR5 UDIMM slots supporting up to 256GB at 7200+(OC) MHz with AMD EXPO™ and dual-channel mode.
  • 10+2+1 Duet Rail Power System with Core Boost and Memory Boost on a 6-layer 2oz copper PCB.
  • 2× M.2 PCIe 4.0 x4 with M.2 Shield Frozr, 4× SATA 6G, and RAID support for flexible high-speed storage.
  • Wi-Fi 6E (2.4/5/6 GHz), Bluetooth 5.3, and Realtek 2.5Gbps LAN for premium wired and wireless connectivity.
  • Lightning Gen 4 PCIe x16 with Steel Armor, plus 7.1-channel Audio Boost with Realtek ALC897 codec.

product.name: Xiaomi Smart Graphene Heater
product.description:
2000W Graphene + PTC Heating | 3-Second Rapid Warmth | 70° Wide-Angle Oscillation | Far-Infrared Resonance Heating | Xiaomi Home App & Google Assistant

Quick Specs

  • Feel warmth in as little as 3 seconds thanks to graphene quick-heating technology
  • Heat a wider area with 70° wide-angle oscillation that circulates warm air around you
  • Switch freely between hot, warm and natural breeze airflow modes
  • Control the heater remotely via the Xiaomi Home app or hands-free with Google Assistant
  • Stay protected with tip-over shutdown, overheating protection and V-0 flame-retardant materials

Graphene Quick Heating for Warmth in Just 3 Seconds

The Xiaomi Smart Graphene Heater brings near-instant warmth to homes across South Africa, heating up in as little as 3 seconds. A graphene coating — which conducts heat far better than copper or aluminium — works alongside a PTC ceramic heater and a powerful 2000W output to warm the surrounding air almost the moment you switch it on. The graphene-coated heating plate then spreads that heat evenly, so you get uniform, consistent warmth rather than hot and cold spots.

Far-Infrared Resonance Heating That Feels Like Sunlight

What sets this graphene heater apart is far-infrared resonance heating. The graphene coating emits 8–14µm far-infrared waves that closely match the body’s natural wavelength, creating a gentle resonant warming effect that feels much like basking in sunlight. It’s a deeper, more comfortable kind of heat that helps chase the chill from your hands and feet, making it well suited to South African winters.

Smart, Even Comfort You Can Control From Anywhere

A smart temperature control system dynamically adjusts power to hold your chosen temperature, cutting the energy waste that comes from overheating and constant fluctuations. The 70° wide-angle oscillation and centrifugal fan circulate gentle, evenly distributed airflow around the room, and you can switch between hot, warm and natural breeze modes to suit the moment. Connect it to the Xiaomi Home app to power it on or off remotely, set a target temperature, change modes or schedule on/off timers — and use Google Assistant for hands-free voice control.

Designed With Safety and Simplicity in Mind

Everyday use is effortless thanks to a large, top-mounted control panel that shows the heater’s status at a glance. Multiple safety designs give added peace of mind: the heater shuts down automatically if tilted, has overheating protection built in, and is made from V-0-rated flame-retardant materials — reassurance that matters in any busy home.

FEATURES:

  • Graphene quick-heating technology that delivers warmth in as little as 3 seconds
  • Graphene coating with superior thermal conductivity to copper or aluminium
  • PTC ceramic heater with a powerful 2000W output
  • Graphene-coated heating plate for efficient, uniform heat conduction
  • Far-infrared resonance heating emitting 8–14µm far-infrared waves
  • Smart temperature control system that dynamically adjusts power to reduce energy waste
  • 70° wide-angle oscillation for broader, wrap-around warmth
  • Centrifugal fan and microporous air grid for gentle, evenly distributed airflow
  • Multiple airflow modes: hot, warm and natural breeze
  • Smart control via the Xiaomi Home app — remote on/off, target temperature, mode and on/off timer
  • Voice control with Google Assistant
  • Large top-mounted control panel for simple, intuitive operation
  • Multiple safety designs: automatic shutdown when tilted, overheating protection, and V-0-rated flame-retardant materials

  • Rated Voltage: 220–230 V~
  • Power Consumption:
    • Networked Standby Mode: ≤2.0 W
    • Off Mode: ≤0.5 W
  • Product Dimensions: Φ17.6 × H46.7 cm
  • Product Weight: 2,300 g

Why Xiaomi?

Xiaomi designs smart, beautifully simple technology that makes everyday life more comfortable, and the Smart Graphene Heater is a perfect example — fast, efficient warmth wrapped in a clean, modern design. For South African households looking for a reliable, app-connected graphene heater to take the edge off winter, it’s an easy choice, backed by Xiaomi’s global reputation for quality and value.

product.description:
NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 | 12GB GDDR7 192-bit | 6144 CUDA Cores | Boost Clock 2542 MHz | PCIe Gen 5 | Triple Fan Cooling | 3× DisplayPort 2.1b + 1× HDMI 2.1b

Quick Specs

  • Push performance further with a factory-overclocked boost clock of 2542 MHz and Extreme Performance mode up to 2557 MHz via MSI Center.
  • Stay cool under pressure with MSI’s triple-fan TORX FAN 5.0 design, nickel-plated copper baseplate, and Zero Frozr silent idle technology.
  • Connect up to four displays simultaneously via 3× DisplayPort 2.1b and 1× HDMI 2.1b, supporting up to 8K 120 Hz with DSC.
  • Built for reliability with DrMOS power stages, additional fuse protection, and a reinforcing backplate with flow-through ventilation.

For the discerning South African gamer and creative professional, the MSI GeForce RTX 5070 Shadow 3X OC is the graphics card built to dominate.

This is not merely a component; it is the centrepiece of your gaming rig or creative workstation, engineered for those who refuse to compromise on performance. The MSI RTX 5070 Shadow 3X OC brings NVIDIA’s Blackwell architecture to your desktop with 6144 CUDA cores, 12GB of GDDR7 memory on a 192-bit bus clocked at 28 Gbps, and PCIe Gen 5 bandwidth. Whether you’re gaming at 1440p with ray tracing maxed out, rendering 3D scenes, or accelerating AI-powered workflows, this MSI graphics card delivers the raw horsepower to handle it all. A factory overclock pushes the boost clock to 2542 MHz out of the box, with Extreme Performance mode reaching 2557 MHz through MSI Center. For those who demand unflinching graphics card performance, this GPU sets a new standard.

Engineered to stay cool and quiet when it matters most.

Thermal management is critical for sustained gaming GPU performance, and the MSI Shadow 3X OC excels in this area. The triple-fan cooler features TORX FAN 5.0 technology — ring-arc-linked blades and a fan cowl that work together to stabilise high-pressure airflow across a massive heatsink. Heat is captured by a nickel-plated copper baseplate and channelled through square-profile Core Pipes for maximum GPU contact. When the card is under light loads, Zero Frozr mode stops the fans entirely for completely silent operation. A reinforcing backplate with a flow-through design adds structural rigidity while improving case ventilation. This level of cooling engineering ensures your RTX 5070 graphics card performs at its peak, session after session.

Connect, control, and customise your experience.

Three DisplayPort 2.1b outputs and one HDMI 2.1b port support up to four monitors simultaneously, with resolutions up to 8K at 120 Hz (DSC) and full G-SYNC compatibility for tear-free gaming. On the power delivery side, DrMOS stages ensure efficient voltage control, while built-in fuse protection safeguards against electrical damage. Fine-tune every aspect of your MSI graphics card with MSI Afterburner and MSI Center — monitor temperatures, adjust fan curves, and unlock Extreme Performance mode, all from one place. This graphics card puts complete control in your hands.

The MSI Shadow 3X OC advantage for serious builders.

Choosing the MSI GeForce RTX 5070 Shadow 3X OC means investing in a gaming GPU backed by decades of hardware expertise. Every element — from the custom PCB with additional fuse protection to the premium DrMOS power stages — is selected for its ability to deliver consistent, long-term performance. The single 16-pin power connector (ATX 3.1 PSU recommended) and 650W PSU requirement ensure broad compatibility with modern builds, while the 3-slot design accommodates a wide range of cases. For the South African gamer or creator who demands reliability alongside raw power, this RTX 5070 graphics card is an investment in performance you can count on.

product.name: Xiaomi Smart Air Fryer 6.5l - Black
product.description:
6.5L smart air fryer | 360° convection heating | 12 preset modes | App & Google Assistant control | Automatic warming

Quick Specs

  • Cook more with a generous 6.5L capacity — perfect for family meals and gatherings.
  • Achieve even, flip-free results with 360° convection heating technology.
  • Enjoy healthier meals with a dedicated degrease feature that reduces excess fat and oil.
  • Control your cooking from anywhere with the Mi Home / Xiaomi Home app and 24-hour scheduling.
  • Choose from 12 preset cooking modes or customise your own with the LCD smart display.

Smarter, Healthier Cooking for the Whole Family

The Xiaomi Smart Air Fryer 6.5L is designed for home cooks who want great results without the hassle. With a generous 6.5L capacity, 1800W of power, and smart app connectivity, it handles everything from weeknight dinners to weekend feasts — all with less oil, less effort, and more flavour. Whether you're roasting a whole chicken for the family or making a quick batch of crispy potato wedges, this air fryer brings versatility and convenience to the modern kitchen.

Even Cooking, Every Time — No Flipping Required

Tired of opening the drawer mid-cook to turn your food over? The Xiaomi Smart Air Fryer's upgraded circular air duct improves air circulation and airflow distribution, sending hot air directly into the frying basket for consistently even results — no flipping needed. The built-in NTC smart temperature control precisely monitors heat throughout the cooking process, spanning an ultra-versatile range of 40°C to 220°C, so your food is never undercooked or charred.

Healthier Meals with the Dedicated Degrease Feature

Eating well doesn't mean giving up on flavour. The dedicated degrease feature actively filters excess fat and oil during cooking, so you can enjoy authentic, crispy results with a fraction of the fat of traditional frying. After cooking, the fryer automatically enters a 30-minute warming mode to keep your food crisp and tender until you're ready to serve — no more rushing to the table.

Smart Control at Your Fingertips

Connect the air fryer to the Mi Home or Xiaomi Home app for full remote control from your smartphone. Schedule cooking up to 24 hours in advance, browse 100 one-touch cloud recipes, and monitor progress without leaving the couch. Compatible with Google Assistant, you can also start or adjust your fryer with a simple voice command. On the unit itself, a clear LCD display and spin-and-tap dial make selecting from 12 preset modes — or dialling in a custom setting — quick and intuitive.

  • 6.5L rated capacity — large enough to roast a whole chicken for family and friends.
  • 360° convection heating via upgraded circular air duct delivers even, flip-free cooking.
  • 12 preset cooking modes plus manual mode for full customisation.
  • NTC precise temperature control with a 40°C–220°C range covering defrosting, fermentation, baking, and high-temperature roasting.
  • Dedicated degrease feature reduces excess fat and oil for healthier meals.

product.name: ASUS GF RTX 5060 DUAL 8G OC EVO
product.description:
NVIDIA Blackwell gaming in a compact package | 8 GB GDDR7 at 28 Gbps | 2.1-slot, 225 mm design | Axial-tech dual-fan cooling | Four-display output support

Quick Specs

  • Experience NVIDIA Blackwell-generation gaming with the GeForce RTX 5060 GPU, featuring 3840 CUDA Cores and AI-accelerated performance
  • Achieve smooth, high-fidelity visuals powered by 8 GB of fast GDDR7 memory running at 28 Gbps
  • Enjoy a compact 2.1-slot form factor and 225 mm card length — perfectly suited to small-form-factor and mid-tower builds alike
  • Stay cool and quiet with two Axial-tech fans and 0dB technology that silences the fans entirely during light workloads
  • Connect up to four displays simultaneously via one HDMI 2.1b and three DisplayPort 2.1b outputs, with support up to 7680 x 4320 resolution

Flagship-tier cooling, mainstream-friendly size

The ASUS Dual GeForce RTX 5060 EVO OC Edition brings NVIDIA's Blackwell architecture to builders who refuse to compromise on either performance or physical footprint. Powered by the GeForce RTX 5060 GPU with 3840 CUDA Cores, a boost clock of 2565 MHz in OC mode, and 8 GB of GDDR7 memory, this card is engineered for gamers and creators who want genuine next-generation capability without needing a full-tower chassis to house it.

Two Axial-tech fans that work harder and last longer

Tired of larger cards running hot and loud in compact cases? The Dual's two Axial-tech fans feature a smaller hub design that allows for longer blades and a barrier ring, increasing downward air pressure directly onto the heatsink. Dual-ball fan bearings extend bearing lifespan to up to twice that of conventional sleeve-bearing designs, while 0dB technology automatically stops the fans when GPU temperature drops below 50°C and power draw is low — so your build stays silent during everyday tasks and light gaming sessions.

Built to last, built for confidence

ASUS reinforces the Dual's long-term reliability through several engineering choices. A vented backplate improves heat dissipation behind the PCB, reducing thermal build-up during sustained workloads. A protective backplate adds structural rigidity to prevent PCB flex, while a 304 stainless steel mounting bracket resists corrosion and physical stress over years of use. Auto-Extreme Technology completes all PCB soldering in a single automated pass, reducing thermal strain on components during manufacturing and resulting in a higher-quality, more consistent product.

AI-accelerated performance with DLSS 4 and full ray tracing

The Blackwell architecture underpinning the RTX 5060 delivers fifth-generation Tensor Cores for maximum AI performance, fourth-generation RT Cores for real-time ray tracing, and support for NVIDIA DLSS 4 with Multi Frame Generation — allowing the card to render dramatically higher frame rates using AI-reconstructed frames. NVIDIA Reflex 2 with Frame Warp reduces input latency based on the latest mouse input data, keeping competitive play feeling sharp and responsive. For creators, the ninth-generation NVIDIA Encoder (NVENC) accelerates video exports in applications such as DaVinci Resolve and Adobe Premiere Pro, and NVIDIA Studio drivers provide optimised stability for creative workloads.

Features

  • NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060 GPU — 3840 CUDA Cores, Blackwell architecture with fifth-gen Tensor Cores and fourth-gen RT Cores
  • 8 GB GDDR7 memory at 28 Gbps across a 128-bit interface for fast, responsive frame delivery
  • OC mode boost clock of 2565 MHz (Default mode: 2535 MHz) for out-of-the-box overclocked performance
  • Two Axial-tech fans with longer blades, barrier ring, and dual-ball bearings for superior airflow and longevity
  • 0dB technology automatically stops fans below 50°C for silent operation during light workloads
  • Vented and protective backplate improves heat dissipation and prevents PCB flex
  • Compact 2.1-slot, 225 mm design compatible with small-form-factor and compact mid-tower builds
  • Four display outputs: 1 x HDMI 2.1b and 3 x DisplayPort 2.1b, supporting up to 7680 x 4320 resolution across up to four screens
  • ASUS GPU Tweak III software for real-time clock, voltage, and fan tuning

product.name: ASUS ROG Thor 1000W Platinum III Modular Power Supply
product.description:
1000W 80 PLUS Platinum Power | PCIe Gen 5.1 Ready | GaN MOSFET Efficiency | Magnetic OLED Display | 10-Year Warranty

Quick Specs

  • Achieve elite-level power delivery with 1000W of 80 PLUS Platinum-certified output for your most demanding build
  • Experience next-gen GPU readiness with a PCIe Gen 5.1 16-pin cable capable of delivering up to 600W to your graphics card
  • Enjoy whisper-quiet operation below 15 dB thanks to Cybenetics Lambda A++ certification and 0dB fan technology
  • Monitor your system's real-time power draw at a glance with the signature magnetic OLED display
  • Build with confidence backed by a 10-year warranty and full ATX 3.1 compliance

Ultimate Power for Uncompromising Builds

The ASUS ROG Thor 1000W Platinum III is built for the discerning builder who refuses to compromise — the flagship gaming rig, the heavily overclocked workstation, the next-gen GPU powerhouse that demands every watt it can get. Fully compliant with the ATX 3.1 standard and equipped with a PCIe Gen 5.1 16-pin cable capable of sending up to 600W to a single graphics card, this PSU is engineered to keep pace with today's most power-hungry hardware without breaking a sweat.

GaN MOSFET and GPU-First Voltage Stability

Tired of voltage fluctuations robbing your GPU of its peak performance? The ROG Thor 1000W Platinum III addresses this with an innovative GaN MOSFET that delivers up to 30% more power efficiency than conventional MOSFETs, while its smaller footprint allows for a more organised internal layout with larger heatsinks and better airflow. The patented 'GPU-First' intelligent voltage stabiliser (IVS) enhances voltage stability by up to 45% by sensing and prioritising power delivery directly to your graphics card — smoothing out the demands of the most intense gaming sessions and overclocking scenarios.

Platinum-Certified Efficiency, Near-Silent Operation

Earning both 80 PLUS Platinum and Cybenetics Platinum certifications, the ROG Thor 1000W Platinum III leverages low-ESR Japanese capacitors for industry-leading efficiency, reduced heat generation, and improved acoustics. The Cybenetics Lambda A++ certification confirms noise output averages below 15 dB — practically inaudible under typical loads. The PWM-controlled dual-ball-bearing fan shuts off entirely when the PSU is operating at or below 30% load in standard mode, and a dedicated 0dB button gives you additional control over fan behaviour as your system transitions between load levels. Dual-ball bearings are rated for up to 80,000 hours of operation — twice the lifespan of sleeve bearing designs.

Magnetic OLED Display, Turbo Mode, and Aura Sync

The ROG Thor 1000W Platinum III goes beyond raw performance with a suite of experience-focused features. The signature magnetic OLED display shows real-time power draw at a glance, and because it attaches magnetically, it can be swapped to either side of the unit to suit fan-up or fan-down PSU installations. Turbo Mode unlocks support for extended power excursions, giving overclocking enthusiasts the headroom they need when pushing hardware to its limits. Etched modular cables in a pliable premium material make routing and management effortless, while Aura Sync ARGB support lets this PSU integrate seamlessly into a synchronised lighting setup.

  • Patented 'GPU-First' intelligent voltage stabiliser (IVS) enhances voltage stability by up to 45% for consistent GPU performance during demanding workloads and overclocking
  • PCIe Gen 5.1 16-pin connector supports up to 600W power delivery to next-generation graphics cards; fully ATX 3.1 compliant

product.name: ASROCK H810M-P Gen 5 Intel LGA 1851 M-ATX Motherboard
product.description:
Next-gen Intel Core Ultra support on LGA1851 | PCIe 5.0 and Dual Channel DDR5 performance | Dual M.2 slots for fast, expandable storage | 8K-capable display outputs | Compact Micro-ATX form factor

Quick Specs

  • Power next-generation Intel Core Ultra (Series 2) processors on the modern LGA1851 socket
  • Enjoy blistering PCIe 5.0 bandwidth for your graphics card and next-gen storage
  • Run up to 128GB of fast Dual Channel DDR5 memory with XMP 3.0 support
  • Connect displays in stunning clarity up to 8K 60Hz via DisplayPort 1.4
  • Build a compact, capable system with a Micro-ATX form factor that doesn't compromise on features

A Modern Foundation for Your Next Build

The ASRock H810M-P Gen5 is built for PC builders who want a capable, future-ready foundation without stepping up to a full-size ATX board. Built around the Intel H810 chipset and the LGA1851 socket, it supports Intel Core Ultra Processors (Series 2), giving you a genuine entry point into Intel's latest platform. Housed in a space-saving Micro-ATX form factor measuring 24.4 cm x 19.3 cm, it's equally at home in a compact everyday PC or a tidy first gaming rig.

Speed Where It Matters

Tired of motherboards that bottleneck your new hardware before it even gets going? The H810M-P Gen5 pairs a PCIe 5.0 x16 slot with Dual Channel DDR5 memory support across two DIMM slots, scaling up to 128GB total capacity. With XMP 3.0 support and memory speeds tuned for DDR5 performance, your CPU and graphics card get the bandwidth headroom to actually perform, rather than wait on the board around them.

Storage and Connectivity That Grows With You

Two M.2 slots give you room to expand as your needs change: a Hyper M.2 socket running at PCIe Gen4x4 (64 Gb/s) for a fast NVMe boot drive, plus a Key E slot ready for a WiFi/BT module. Four SATA3 6.0 Gb/s connectors handle additional drives, while USB 3.2 Gen1 and USB 2.0 ports front and rear keep your peripherals, drives, and accessories all connected without a scramble for adapters.

Display and Everyday Essentials, Sorted

Whether you're editing, gaming, or just running a productive desktop, the H810M-P Gen5 has the outputs to match. HDMI 2.1 delivers up to 4K at 120Hz, while DisplayPort 1.4 with DSC pushes as high as 8K at 60Hz or 5K at 120Hz, both with HDCP 2.3 support. Onboard 7.1 channel HD audio via the Realtek ALC897 codec and Gigabit LAN through the Realtek RTL8111H controller round out a board that covers the essentials without asking you to add anything extra.

Features

  • Supports Intel Core Ultra Processors (Series 2) on the LGA1851 socket
  • Intel H810 chipset in a space-saving Micro-ATX form factor
  • Dual Channel DDR5 memory, up to 128GB across 2 DIMM slots, with XMP 3.0 support
  • PCIe 5.0 x16 slot for next-generation graphics card bandwidth
  • Dual M.2 slots: a Hyper M.2 PCIe Gen4x4 (64 Gb/s) socket for NVMe boot storage, plus a Key E slot for WiFi/BT modules
  • 4 x SATA3 6.0 Gb/s connectors for additional storage drives
  • HDMI 2.1 (up to 4K 120Hz) and DisplayPort 1.4 with DSC (up to 8K 60Hz) display outputs with HDCP 2.3
  • 7.1 CH HD Audio via Realtek ALC897 codec and Gigabit LAN via Realtek RTL8111H

Specifications

  • Socket: LGA 1851

Quick Specs

  • Keep your CPU running cool with a 360mm radiator and three integrated ARGB fans delivering 90.78 CFM airflow and 3.82 mmH2O static pressure
