Serious Cooling, Seriously Clean Build

The ASUS TUF Gaming LC III 360 ARGB White Edition is an all-in-one liquid CPU cooler built for builders who refuse to compromise on performance or presentation. With a 360mm aluminium radiator, three pre-installed integrated 120mm ARGB fans, and an efficient upgraded pump, it keeps even demanding processors at optimal temperatures — all wrapped in a clean white aesthetic that pairs beautifully with TUF Gaming motherboards.

An Upgraded Pump That Goes the Distance

Tired of cooling solutions that lose efficiency over time? The LC III's pump has been redesigned with a three-phase, six-slot, four-pole architecture and a ceramic shaft, delivering up to twice the lifespan of previous generations and improving efficiency by up to 30% — while also running quieter. Combined with pre-applied thermal compound on the copper CPU plate, getting optimal contact and performance from day one has never been more straightforward.

One Cable. Three Fans. Zero Clutter.

The integrated fan design is one of the LC III's most builder-friendly improvements. All three ARGB fans connect through a single cable that carries both power and lighting — reducing cable clutter from six connections down to one. Anti-vibration rubber pads at all four corners of each fan dampen resonance, and the braided pump and ARGB header cables make routing through your chassis clean and flexible.

Aura Sync Lighting That Commands Attention

The pump top features the TUF Gaming logo illuminated with customisable Aura Sync ARGB lighting, letting you dial in the exact colour and effect that defines your build. The three integrated MF-12 fans add matching ARGB illumination across the entire radiator face, creating a cohesive visual statement. Whether your build is all-white or accented with colour, the LC III White Edition is designed to sit centre stage.

Whether you're running a high-core-count workload, pushing your CPU with an all-day gaming session, or overclocking for maximum output, the LC III 360 ARGB is built to keep temperatures in check and your system performing at its peak.

Triple-Fan Firepower, Whisper-Quiet Delivery

Tired of cooling solutions that either roar like a jet engine or fail to keep up when things get serious? The TUF Gaming LC III 360 ARGB houses three 120mm TUF Gaming MF-12 fans that spin between 650 and 2600 RPM, delivering up to 90.78 CFM of airflow and 3.82 mmH2O of static pressure — all while staying at or below 37.4 dB(A) at maximum speed. product.name: ASUS ROG Strix LC III 360 ARGB Liquid CPU Cooler - Black
product.description:
Next-gen Asetek Gen7 V2 pump cooling | 360° rotatable water block | Triple ARGB fans with 0dB mode | Full Aura Sync support | 6-year warranty

Quick Specs

  • Dominate heat with Asetek's Gen7 V2 pump, delivering up to 100W more cooling capacity than its predecessor for rock-solid stability under the heaviest workloads.
  • Install with total freedom thanks to a 360° rotatable water block with magnetic design, accommodating virtually any mounting orientation.
  • Experience whisper-quiet operation with 0dB fan technology that drops all three fans to 0 RPM during low-load moments.
  • Illuminate your build with 10+ Aura Sync lighting modes — including Smart mode that dynamically reflects real-time hardware load.
  • Enjoy broad platform compatibility across Intel LGA 1851, 1700, 1200, 115x and AMD AM5 and AM4 sockets, backed by a 6-year warranty.

Cool Beyond Limits. Build Beyond Ordinary.

The ROG Strix LC III 360 ARGB is a premium all-in-one liquid CPU cooler built for gamers and builders who refuse to compromise on performance or aesthetics. Powered by Asetek's latest Gen7 V2 pump with updated cold plate technology, it brings serious thermal headroom to high-end Intel and AMD platforms — keeping your processor cool, stable, and ready for anything you throw at it.

A Pump That Outperforms Its Generation

Tired of AIO coolers that struggle under sustained, intensive loads? The ROG Strix LC III 360 ARGB addresses that head-on with Asetek's new Gen7 V2 pump, which delivers up to 100W of additional cooling capacity and temperatures up to 0.5°C lower compared to the previous Gen7 pump. Running at 800–2,800 RPM, it moves coolant efficiently through a 400 mm sleeved rubber tube and a copper cold plate, extracting heat from your CPU before it ever becomes a problem.

Installation Flexibility Without Compromise

Fitting a liquid cooler into a custom build can be a frustrating exercise in compromise — but the Strix LC III 360 ARGB was designed to eliminate that friction. The water block features a 360° rotatable magnetic design, meaning you can orient the pump head to face any direction without fighting cables or clearance issues. Whether you're working in a compact mid-tower or a spacious full-tower, the cooler adapts to your build — not the other way around.

Silent When You Need It, Brilliant Always

Three ROG Strix AF-12S ARGB fans sit across the 360mm aluminium radiator, each 120 x 120 x 25 mm and capable of spinning between 800 and 2,200 RPM via PWM and DC control. During light workloads, 0dB technology drops them to a complete standstill — zero noise, zero distraction. When performance demands ramp up, the fans deliver up to 70.38 CFM of airflow at 3.92 mmH2O static pressure, with anti-vibration rubber corners keeping resonance noise to a minimum. Even under full load, the system tops out at just 36 dB(A). And through Aura Sync, the ARGB lighting across the fans and pump cap can be tuned to match your rig — with Smart mode even adjusting lighting dynamically to reflect hardware load in real time.

product.name: ASUS ROG RYUO IV 360 ARGB Liquid CPU Cooler
product.description:
6.67" Curved 2K AMOLED Display | Asetek Gen8 V2 Pump | 360mm Radiator | Daisy-Chain ARGB Fans | 6-Year Warranty

Quick Specs

  • Dominate thermals with the Asetek Gen8 V2 pump delivering advanced, stable cooling for high-end AMD and Intel CPUs
  • Experience an unprecedented visual centrepiece with a 6.67-inch curved 2K AMOLED display on your pump head
  • Achieve a cleaner build with daisy-chained ARGB fans that reduce six cables down to one single connection
  • Enjoy whisper-quiet operation with three ROG MF-12C ARGB fans rated at just 30.7 dB(A) at maximum speed
  • Build with confidence across AMD AM5/AM4 and Intel LGA1851/1700/1200/115x platforms, backed by a 6-year warranty

Where Extreme Performance Meets Extraordinary Aesthetics

The ROG RYUO IV 360 ARGB is built for builders who refuse to compromise — those who demand elite thermal performance from their high-end AMD Ryzen or Intel Core Ultra system, and want every component to look as impressive as it performs. A 360mm all-in-one liquid cooler powered by the Asetek Emma Gen8 V2 pump and finished with a 6.67-inch curved 2K AMOLED display, this is liquid cooling redefined for the discerning South African gaming enthusiast.

A Display Unlike Anything You've Seen on a Cooler

Tired of a blank pump head staring back at you through your case window? The ROG RYUO IV 360 ARGB changes the game entirely with its 6.67-inch curved 2K AMOLED screen — vibrant, high-resolution, and capable of displaying 3D visual effects, customised content, GIFs, images, videos, or real-time hardware information. An innovative sliding mechanism allows horizontal adjustment of the screen module, so you can optimise the viewing angle and keep things looking clean without interfering with memory modules or surrounding components. Through ASUS InfoHub software, the display supports content splitting, custom imports, and a full built-in style library — making the pump head the undisputed centrepiece of your build.

Pump Performance That Keeps High-End CPUs in Check

Underneath the spectacle is serious engineering. The Asetek Emma Gen8 V2 pump drives cooling fluid through a copper CPU plate and an aluminium 360mm radiator, maintaining stable temperatures even during sustained, heavy workloads. A Precision Mount System applies uniform contact pressure across the CPU surface — engineered specifically with Intel Core Ultra Series 2 processors in mind — while a premium metal backplate provides a more heat-resistant, rigid, and durable mount compared to plastic alternatives. Thermal compound comes pre-applied, so you're ready to install straight out of the box.

Three ARGB Fans, One Cable, Zero Clutter

The three included ROG RYUO IV MF-12C ARGB fans are pre-attached to the radiator for faster assembly, spinning at up to 2000 RPM with 56.66 CFM airflow and 3.56 mmH2O static pressure — all while remaining remarkably quiet at a maximum of 30.7 dB(A). The daisy-chain design condenses what would traditionally be six separate cables into a single connection that delivers both power and ARGB signal simultaneously. product.name: ASUS ROG STRIX 1000W 80 PLUS Platinum ATX 3.1 Fully-Modular Power Supply
product.description:
1000W of platinum-efficiency power | ATX 3.1 & PCIe Gen 5.1 ready | GaN MOSFET for cooler, quieter operation | 10-year warranty

Quick Specs

  • Achieve platinum-grade efficiency with GaN MOSFET technology delivering up to 30% superior power efficiency over conventional designs
  • Dominate next-gen builds with native PCIe Gen 5.1 support via a 12V-2x6 connector ready for the latest graphics cards
  • Enjoy near-silent operation thanks to 0dB technology that shuts the 135mm fan off completely at 40% load or below
  • Experience unwavering GPU stability with the patented GPU-FIRST intelligent voltage stabilizer enhancing voltage delivery by up to 45%
  • Build with confidence backed by a 10-year warranty and dual ball fan bearings rated for up to 80,000 hours of operation

Superior Stability. Next-Level Efficiency.

The ASUS ROG STRIX 1000W Platinum is engineered for builders who refuse to compromise — pairing a high-end gaming rig with a power supply that can genuinely keep pace. Fully ATX 3.1 compliant and certified to both 80 PLUS Platinum and Cybenetics Platinum standards, it delivers 1000W of rock-solid power while wasting as little energy as possible. Whether you're running a flagship GPU through intense gaming sessions or creative workloads, the ROG Strix Platinum is built to feed your system without flinching.

GaN MOSFET: Smaller Component, Bigger Impact

At the heart of this PSU's efficiency story is GaN MOSFET technology. By replacing conventional components with gallium nitride MOSFETs, ASUS achieves up to 30% superior power efficiency — meaning less energy wasted as heat and a more organised internal layout. That freed-up space makes room for larger ROG heatsinks and improved airflow, keeping critical components cooler and quieter than reference designs. The result is a PSU that runs leaner and lasts longer, session after demanding session.

GPU-FIRST: Power Where Your Build Needs It Most

Tired of voltage instability tanking your frame rates at the worst possible moment? The ROG Strix 1000W Platinum's patented GPU-FIRST intelligent voltage stabilizer puts your graphics card first. By connecting the included IVS cable, you activate a mode that enhances voltage stability by up to 45% to the GPU — smoothing out power delivery during overclocking and peak gaming loads. If you prefer conventional CPU-focused voltage sensing, simply disconnect the IVS cable. Either way, your build stays stable.

Ready for the Next Generation — and Built to Last

With a native 12V-2x6 connector, the ROG Strix 1000W Platinum is PCIe Gen 5.1 ready, capable of piping up to 600W to next-gen graphics cards without an adapter in sight. The fully modular cable system means you only route what you need, keeping your build clean and airflow unobstructed. Dual ball fan bearings are rated for up to 80,000 hours — twice the lifespan of sleeve bearing designs — and the Cybenetics Lambda A+ certification confirms average noise levels below 20 dB. Backed by a 10-year warranty, this is a PSU you install once and trust for the long haul.

Features

  • 1000W total output with 80 PLUS Platinum and Cybenetics Platinum certification for industry-leading efficiency
  • GaN MOSFET technology delivers up to 30% superior power efficiency and a more compact internal layout for improved cooling
  • Patented GPU-FIRST intelligent voltage stabilizer enhances GPU voltage stability by up to 45% during gaming and overclocking
  • ATX 3.1 compliant with native 12V-2x6 (PCIe Gen 5.1) connector — ready for the latest high-power graphics cards

product.description:
AMD Radeon™ RX 9070 GRE | 12GB GDDR6 | PCIe 5.0 | Boost up to 2880 MHz (OC Mode) | Triple Axial-Tech Fans | 2.5-Slot Design

Quick Specs

  • Power high-refresh 1440p gaming with the AMD Radeon RX 9070 GRE GPU
  • Enjoy 12GB of fast GDDR6 memory on a 192-bit interface
  • Stay cool and quiet with three Axial-tech fans and 0dB technology
  • Fit more builds with a compact 2.5-slot, small-form-factor-ready design
  • Tune performance or quiet operation on the fly with Dual BIOS

Primed for Power with the Radeon RX 9070 GRE

The ASUS Prime Radeon™ RX 9070 GRE EVO OC Edition brings serious performance to gaming rigs across South Africa. Built on the AMD Radeon™ RX 9070 GRE GPU with 3,072 stream processors and 12GB of GDDR6 memory, it boosts up to 2880 MHz in OC mode (via GPU Tweak III) for smooth, high-refresh gameplay. A PCI Express 5.0 interface keeps it ready for the latest platforms, while support for resolutions up to 7680 × 4320 means it’s built for the long haul.

Cool, Quiet Triple-Fan Cooling

Cooling is where the Prime EVO shines. A carefully arranged 2.5-slot design pairs three upgraded Axial-tech fans — with smaller hubs, longer blades and barrier rings — to drive more air at lower temperatures and noise. A premium phase-change GPU thermal pad melts to fill the gaps between GPU and heatsink for superior heat dissipation and long-term longevity, and 0dB technology lets the fans stop entirely during light loads for silent operation.

Compact 2.5-Slot Design for Flexible Builds

Despite its triple-fan cooler, the Prime RX 9070 GRE EVO keeps to a space-saving 2.5-slot footprint that’s certified small-form-factor (SFF) ready — so it slots neatly into compact cases as well as full-size towers. The carefully arranged shroud, heatsink and heat-pipe layout lets the fans take advantage of chassis side-panel ventilation for optimal thermal performance whatever the build.

Built Tough, Engineered to Last

Reliability is engineered in. ASUS GPU Guard secures all four corners with adhesive to reduce the risk of cracks, while a GPU bracket ensures uniform mounting pressure and extra stability. A protective backplate adds structural rigidity and shields the PCB, and a grade 304 stainless-steel mounting bracket resists corrosion. Auto-Extreme manufacturing completes all soldering in a single pass for a cleaner, more reliable, more sustainable build.

Dual BIOS and Powerful Tuning Software

A Dual BIOS switch lets you toggle between Performance mode for maximum cooling and Quiet mode for a calmer fan curve — no software needed. When you do want to dig deeper, ASUS GPU Tweak III gives you real-time control over clocks, memory frequency, voltage and fan curves, with an on-screen display to monitor it all. The card also includes a one-month membership to Adobe Creative Cloud.

  • 12GB GDDR6 memory on a 192-bit interface at 18 Gbps

product.name: Keychron C1 Pro 8K 80% Super Red Hot-swappable RGB Wired Mechanical Keyboard
product.description:
8000 Hz Polling Rate | QMK/VIA | USB Type-C Wired | TKL (80%) | Hot-Swappable | South-Facing RGB | Double-Shot PBT

Quick Specs

  • Register every keystroke with an ultra-fast 8000 Hz polling rate
  • Remap keys and macros freely with open-source QMK/VIA and the Keychron Launcher
  • Swap switches without soldering thanks to a hot-swappable PCB (3-pin and 5-pin MX)
  • Type on pre-lubed Keychron Super Red linear switches in an acoustically tuned build
  • Enjoy a classic TKL (80%) layout with durable double-shot PBT keycaps

Lightning-Fast 8000 Hz Wired Performance

The Keychron C1 Pro 8K is a wired TKL (80%) custom mechanical keyboard built for speed. An 8000 Hz polling rate — adjustable from 125 Hz right up to 8000 Hz — delivers faster input registration, near-instant triggering and ultra-low latency, so every keystroke lands with precision. Powered by an Arm Cortex-M4 chip and open-source QMK firmware, it gives gamers and typists across South Africa serious responsiveness with endless room to customise.

Program Everything with QMK, VIA and Launcher

Open-source QMK firmware with VIA support means near-limitless customisation. Using the browser-based Keychron Launcher, you can remap keys, record macros and fine-tune shortcuts on Windows, macOS or Linux — no software to install. Because the firmware is open source, the community can review it for safety, giving you complete confidence and control over your inputs.

A Refined, Acoustically Tuned Typing Experience

The C1 Pro 8K is tuned for sound and feel from the inside out. Layers of sound-absorbing foam, PET film, IXPE film, bottom-case acoustic foam and a silicone bottom pad work together for a satisfying, thocky typing sound and consistent key feel. Pre-lubed Keychron Super switches glide smoothly, plate-mounted stabilisers keep larger keys steady, and OSA-profile double-shot PBT keycaps resist shine and stop the legends fading.

Hot-Swappable and Built to Personalise

Make it truly yours. The hot-swappable PCB accepts almost any 3-pin or 5-pin MX-style switch (Cherry, Gateron, Kailh, Panda and more) with no soldering required. South-facing RGB lighting shines cleanly through from the typist’s angle — even with non-shine-through PBT keycaps — for vivid, even backlighting you can tailor key by key.

Comfortable, All-Day Ergonomics

Designed for long sessions, the C1 Pro 8K offers three adjustable typing angles (4.8°, 8.5° and 10.7°) and curved OSA-profile keycaps that work together to support your wrists. A system toggle plus included Windows and macOS keycaps let you switch seamlessly between platforms and save separate layouts for each.

product.name: Xiaomi Router BE19000 Pro
product.description:
Wi-Fi 7 tri-band performance | 30Gbps wired throughput | Dual 10GE ports | AI Mesh roaming | Built-in Bluetooth gateway

Quick Specs

  • Experience next-generation Wi-Fi 7 tri-band wireless with combined speeds of up to 18,656Mbps across 2.4GHz, 5GHz, and 6GHz bands
  • Connect up to 1,000 devices simultaneously — and up to 300 Xiaomi Bluetooth devices via the built-in Bluetooth Mesh gateway
  • Achieve blazing wired throughput with 2x 10GE and 4x 2.5GE ports delivering a total of 30Gbps aggregated bandwidth
  • Expand your storage with a USB 3.0 port and M.2 slot, turning your router into a capable NAS device
  • Enjoy seamless whole-home coverage with Xiaomi AI Mesh roaming, active dual cooling, and a Qualcomm A7 quad-core 1.8GHz processor

The Router Your Home Network Has Been Waiting For

The Xiaomi Router BE19000 Pro is built for households and home offices that demand the very best from their network. Whether you're streaming 8K content, running low-latency gaming sessions, transferring large files between devices, or managing a smart home full of connected gadgets, the BE19000 Pro handles it all without breaking a sweat. Wi-Fi 7 tri-band wireless and a powerful wired port configuration make this one of the most capable routers available for the modern connected home.

Tired of Buffering, Lag, and Wi-Fi Dead Zones?

The BE19000 Pro's tri-band Wi-Fi 7 delivers combined wireless speeds of up to 18,656Mbps across three dedicated bands — 2.4GHz for smart home devices, 5GHz for TVs and projectors, and the newly introduced 6GHz band for bandwidth-hungry devices like PCs, VR headsets, and smartphones. With 4x4 MIMO on all three bands and 12 spatial streams, dozens of devices can connect simultaneously with minimal interference. Multi-Link Operation (MLO) enables peak concurrent wireless speeds of up to 4.3Gbps, while Enhanced OFDMA and 4K QAM ensure every connection is as efficient and fast as possible.

Wired Speed That Keeps Pace with 10 Gigabit Broadband

Two 10 Gigabit Ethernet ports and four 2.5 Gigabit Ethernet ports combine to deliver a total of 30Gbps in aggregated wired bandwidth — far beyond what most routers offer. The 10GE ports are fully prepared for next-generation broadband upgrades and make light work of large file transfers, studio asset loading, and data-intensive workflows. WAN/LAN auto-sensing and dual LAN port aggregation add further flexibility, letting you configure the network to suit your exact setup.

Intelligent Routing, Whole-Home Coverage, and a Smarter Smart Home

Powered by the Qualcomm A7 quad-core 1.8GHz processor and a next-generation AI network engine, the BE19000 Pro actively manages signal interference, optimises data routing, and ensures seamless roaming between nodes when used as part of a Xiaomi AI Mesh network of up to 10 routers. The built-in Bluetooth Mesh gateway connects up to 300 Xiaomi Bluetooth devices — from door locks to humidity sensors — while a USB 3.0 port and M.2 slot offer extensive storage expansion, including NAS functionality via Samba LAN sharing. A dual cooling system with independent heat sinks and a high-speed fan keeps performance stable even under sustained heavy loads.

Features

  • Wi-Fi 7 tri-band wireless with combined speeds of up to 18,656Mbps (1,376Mbps on 2.4GHz, 5,760Mbps on 5GHz, 11,520Mbps on 6GHz)
  • 2x 10GE WAN/LAN ports and 4x 2.5GE WAN/LAN ports providing 30Gbps total aggregated wired bandwidth
  • Qualcomm A7 quad-core 1.8GHz processor with 2GB memory for reliable, high-performance routing
  • Multi-Link Operation (MLO) for dual-band aggregation with peak concurrent wireless speeds up to 4.3Gbps
  • Built-in Bluetooth Mesh 2.0 gateway — connects up to 300 Xiaomi Bluetooth devices and supports up to 1,000 network devices simultaneously
  • USB 3.0 port and M.2 NVMe SSD slot for NAS-style network storage with Samba LAN sharing support
  • Xiaomi AI Mesh roaming for seamless whole-home coverage across up to 10 routers
  • Active dual cooling system with independent heat sinks and high-speed fan for sustained performance
  • AI anti-interference, AI Mesh roaming, and AI power management via the onboard AI network engine
  • Rich software feature set including Parental Controls, IPTV support, LAN aggregation, VPN client, QoS, and WAN/LAN auto-sensing
  • WPA3 wireless security, BSS Colouring, Beamforming, MU-MIMO, and multi-band steering
  • NFC tap-to-connect and Xiaomi HyperOS integration for password-free network access

product.name: Xiaomi Smart Steam Air Fryer 7L
product.description:
Steam, air fry and more in one smart appliance | 7L family capacity | Smart app control | 130°C superheated steam

Quick Specs

  • 7L family-size capacity
  • Steam and air fry cooking
  • 1.5L top-mounted water tank
  • 130°C superheated steam technology
  • 360° cyclonic hot air circulation
  • 10 cooking functions
  • 25 preset recipes
  • 40°C–230°C adjustable temperature
  • Xiaomi Home app with 100+ online recipes
  • Xiaomi HyperOS Connect compatible

Discover a smarter way to cook with the Xiaomi Smart Steam Air Fryer 7L. Combining powerful steam technology with 360° hot air circulation, it delivers crisp, golden results while locking in natural moisture for tender, flavourful meals. With smart connectivity, versatile cooking functions and a spacious family-sized basket, it's designed to simplify everyday cooking while expanding what's possible in your kitchen.

The Xiaomi Smart Steam Air Fryer 7L redefines home cooking by combining the benefits of steaming and air frying in one intelligent appliance. Designed to go beyond traditional air frying, it uses dynamic steam together with powerful 360° cyclonic hot air circulation to create food that is crispy on the outside while remaining tender, juicy and full of flavour on the inside.

At the heart of the system is a 1.5L top-mounted water tank that provides continuous steam without frequent refilling. The professional-grade steam system quickly produces 130°C superheated steam, helping ingredients cook evenly while retaining their natural moisture. The sealed steam circulation system keeps steam inside the cooking basket, allowing condensed water to circulate internally for consistent cooking without leaving food soggy. The result is perfectly cooked vegetables, succulent meats and deliciously crisp favourites with every meal.

Its generous 7L capacity provides plenty of space for family cooking, making it ideal for preparing everything from a whole chicken to crispy chips or multiple portions in a single batch. The included cooking rack also enables convenient two-layer cooking, allowing you to maximise the available cooking space and prepare more food at once.

With a wide adjustable temperature range from 40°C to 230°C, the air fryer adapts to a variety of cooking styles. Whether steaming, air frying, roasting or drying ingredients, it offers flexibility for everyday meals and special occasions alike. Choose from 10 built-in cooking functions and 25 preset recipes for simple one-touch operation, or discover more than 100 online recipes through the Xiaomi Home app for even greater cooking inspiration.

Designed for convenience, the large 7-inch viewing window lets you monitor your food throughout the cooking process without removing the basket, helping maintain a stable cooking temperature for more consistent results. Dedicated one-touch drying and odour removal functions simplify maintenance by helping keep the cooking chamber dry and fresh after use.

Supporting Xiaomi HyperOS Connect, the Smart Steam Air Fryer 7L seamlessly integrates into your smart home ecosystem while delivering intelligent cooking performance for everyday family meals.

product.name: Xiaomi Tag Bluetooth Smart Tracker White – (1 Pack)
product.description:
Keys, wallet, backpack, check-in bag — attach a Xiaomi Tag and stop retracing your steps. It works with Apple Find My or Google Find Hub, rings out loud when your item is nearby, and shows you where it was last seen when it isn't.

Quick Specs

  • Works with your choice of Apple Find My or Google Find Hub at setup
  • Rings a built-in buzzer so you can follow the sound to nearby items
  • Shows last-seen location on a map, updated by passing phones on your network
  • Over a year of use from a replaceable CR2032 battery
  • IP67 dust and water resistance, with a keyring loop built into the body

Everything you own, easier to find

We have all done it. Keys down on an unfamiliar counter, wallet left in a jacket, the laptop bag that was definitely in the boot. The Xiaomi Tag is a small, 10 g Bluetooth finder that clips onto the things you misplace most — keys, wallets, handbags, backpacks, camera bags, remotes and check-in luggage — so finding them takes seconds instead of an afternoon.

How the Xiaomi Tag finds your things

When your item is close by, open the app and ring the Tag's built-in buzzer, then follow the sound. When it isn't, the Tag's encrypted Bluetooth signal is picked up by passing phones on your chosen finding network, which quietly update its position on your map.

That makes it very good at answering "where did I last have it" — the coffee shop, the gym, the seat pocket on the flight. The Xiaomi Tag is a Bluetooth item finder rather than a GPS tracker, so it shows you where something was last seen instead of streaming a live position. It is the right tool for everyday belongings, and location updates are quickest in busy places where plenty of phones pass by.

Your choice of the world's two biggest finding networks

Most trackers lock you into one ecosystem. The Xiaomi Tag doesn't. During setup you choose Apple Find My or Google Find Hub, and the Tag then draws on the millions of devices already on that network to report back. Apple users get the network built into every iPhone and iPad; Android users get Find Hub, which reaches Android 9 devices and later — a genuine advantage in South Africa, where Android dominates. The two networks operate independently, so you pick one at setup rather than running both.

Built to be forgotten about

Attach it once and leave it. The keyring loop is moulded into the body, so there is no separate holder to buy. IP67 dust and water resistance handles rain, spills and a soaking, and at 7.2 mm thin it disappears into a bag or pocket. The replaceable CR2032 button cell runs for over a year, and when it does run low, you swap it in seconds rather than replacing the whole Tag.

Privacy that works both ways

Location data is end-to-end encrypted and visible only to you and the people you choose to share with through Family & Friend Sharing. The Tag also supports unwanted-tracking alerts through Apple and Google's safety systems, so if an unknown Tag travels with someone, their phone lets them know. Mark an item as lost and a finder can get your contact details — by tapping the Tag with NFC on Apple Find My, or through a Find Hub prompt on Android.

Features

  • Choose Apple Find My or Google Find Hub as your finding network during setup
  • Ring the built-in piezoelectric buzzer to locate items within Bluetooth range
  • View your item's last-seen location on a map, updated by nearby network devices
  • Left-behind alerts warn you when you walk away without your item (Apple Find My)
  • Share item locations with family and friends for collaborative finding
  • End-to-end encrypted location data, visible only to you
  • NFC Lost Mode for easy return of found items (Apple Find My)
  • Unwanted-tracking alerts help protect against being followed by an unknown Tag
  • IP67 dust and water resistance for everyday conditions
  • Over a year of battery life from a user-replaceable CR2032 button cell
  • Keyring loop built into the body — no extra holder required
  • Compatible with iOS 14.5 / iPadOS 14.5 or later, and Android 9 or later

Specifications

  • Product Type: Bluetooth Item Finder
  • Connectivity: Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) v5.4
  • Finding Networks: Apple Find My or Google Find Hub (one selected at setup)
  • Positioning: Last-seen location via finding network — no GPS or cellular
  • Left-Behind Alerts: Supported on Apple Find My
  • Item Sharing: Family & Friend Sharing
  • Privacy Protection: End-to-end encrypted location data
  • NFC Support: Lost Mode (Apple Find My)
  • Dust & Water Resistance: IP67
  • Battery Type: Replaceable CR2032 button cell
  • Battery Life: Over 1 year in typical use
  • Speaker: Built-in piezoelectric buzzer
  • Sensor: Accelerometer
  • Attachment: Integrated keyring loop
  • Compatibility: iOS 14.5 / iPadOS 14.5 or later; Android 9 or later
  • Colour: White
  • Product Weight: 10 g
  • Product Dimensions: 4.65 × 3.1 × 0.72 cm

What's in the Box

  • Xiaomi Tag Bluetooth Smart Tracker ×1
  • User manual ×1

FAQ's

Is the Xiaomi Tag a GPS tracker?
No. It is a Bluetooth item finder. Instead of a GPS chip, it uses a secure Bluetooth signal that nearby phones on Apple Find My or Google Find Hub pick up and report back, showing you where your item was last seen. For live tracking of a vehicle or a pet, you need a dedicated GPS and cellular tracker.

Does it work with an Android phone that isn't a Xiaomi?
Yes. Any phone running Android 9 or later can use the Xiaomi Tag through Google Find Hub.

Can I use it to recover a stolen bag or car?
It isn't built for that. A Tag shows a last-seen location, which is unlikely to keep up with something being moved quickly. Use it for the everyday items you misplace, and a purpose-built tracking service for theft recovery.

Will it work in my bag on a flight?
Yes, and it is one of the most popular uses. Airports are dense with phones, so a checked bag usually reports back reliably at both ends of a trip.

Can I use both Apple Find My and Google Find Hub?
You choose one network when you set the Tag up. The two networks work independently of one another.

How long does the battery last?
Over a year in typical use. It takes a standard CR2032 button cell, available almost anywhere, so replacing it is quick and cheap.

Why Xiaomi

Xiaomi builds technology that fits into everyday life without asking much of you — reliable, well-made and priced so that upgrading feels easy. The Xiaomi Tag is a good example: a small, sensible piece of kit that quietly solves a daily annoyance.

product.name: Xiaomi Redmi Buds 8 Pro - Glacier Blue
product.description:
[embed]https://youtu.be/uWe6e8PrL20[/embed]

Immerse yourself in Hi-Res Audio Wireless with coaxial triple drivers; silence the world with 55 dB hybrid active noise cancellation

Quick Specs

  • Experience studio-quality sound with Hi-Res Audio Wireless and coaxial triple drivers.
  • Silence distractions with up to 55 dB of hybrid active noise cancellation.
  • Enjoy clear calls even in windy conditions thanks to triple AI microphones.
  • Seamlessly connect to your devices with Bluetooth 5.4 and dual-device connectivity.
  • Listen longer with up to 35 hours of total battery life with the charging case.

For the discerning listener in South Africa, the Redmi Buds 8 Pro offer an auditory experience that transcends ordinary listening.

These are not merely earbuds; they are finely tuned instruments designed for those who seek sonic purity and an escape from the everyday cacophony. Whether you are a dedicated audiophile demanding the fidelity of Hi-Res Audio Wireless, a commuter seeking solace from urban noise, or a professional requiring crystal-clear communication, these noise-cancelling earbuds are engineered to meet your exacting standards. The Glacier Blue finish reflects a commitment to sophisticated design, mirroring the precision within. They serve as your personal sound sanctuary, delivering an unparalleled audio journey that respects the integrity of the original recording.

Mastering sound with coaxial triple drivers and Hi-Res Audio Wireless

The heart of the Redmi Buds 8 Pro lies in its advanced audio architecture: coaxial triple drivers. This configuration features an 11 mm titanium diaphragm bass driver for deep, resonant lows, complemented by dual 6.7 mm piezoelectric ceramic tweeters for crisp, clear highs. This meticulous design ensures a balanced and detailed soundstage across the entire frequency spectrum. Coupled with Hi-Res Audio Wireless certification and support for the LDAC high-resolution audio codec, these earbuds deliver audio with exceptional clarity and richness, preserving the subtle nuances that define true high-fidelity sound. Experience music as the artist intended, with every note and texture faithfully reproduced.

Escape the noise with advanced hybrid active noise cancellation

In a world filled with distractions, the Redmi Buds 8 Pro provide a sanctuary of silence. Equipped with hybrid active noise cancellation (ANC) technology, these Bluetooth 5.4 earbuds can reduce noise by up to 55dB, effectively masking a broad range of ambient sounds. With 20 adjustable ANC levels, you have precise control over your listening environment, allowing you to tailor the noise reduction depth to your specific needs, achieving an average reduction of 28.3dB. Whether you are on a bustling train, a noisy airplane, or simply seeking focus in a busy environment, these earbuds create a personal oasis of calm, allowing you to immerse yourself fully in your audio content.

Crystal-clear communication, unimpeded performance

Make and receive calls with absolute confidence, even in challenging conditions. The Redmi Buds 8 Pro feature a sophisticated triple AI microphone system designed to intelligently isolate your voice and suppress unwanted background noise. Furthermore, robust wind noise resistance, effective up to 12 m/s, ensures that your voice remains clear and intelligible during outdoor calls or while cycling. Paired with noise-cancelling 5.4, you benefit from a stable, low-latency connection for seamless communication and uninterrupted audio playback, ensuring that every conversation is as clear as the music you enjoy.

Effortless connectivity and extended listening pleasure personalised

Simplify your audio experience with the latest Bluetooth 5.4 technology, offering enhanced stability and energy efficiency. Enjoy the convenience of Google Fast Pair for quick, one-step pairing with compatible Android devices, and benefit from dual-device connectivity, allowing you to effortlessly switch between your phone and laptop. With a substantial 480mAh charging case, the Redmi Buds 8 Pro offer a total listening time of up to 35 hours with ANC turned off, providing exceptional endurance for long journeys or extended workdays. These USB C charging earbuds weigh just 5.4g each, ensuring comfort for prolonged wear. Recharge rapidly with less than 1 hour for earbuds and less than 2 hours for the charging case via USB Type-C.

Features

  • Experience studio-grade audio with Hi-Res Audio Wireless certification and the advanced LDAC codec for unparalleled sound detail.
  • Immerse yourself in pure sound with coaxial triple drivers, including an 11 mm bass driver and dual 6.7 mm ceramic tweeters.
  • Silence the world around you with up to 55dB of hybrid active noise cancellation and 20 adjustable levels for personalised tranquillity.
  • Ensure every call is crystal clear with triple AI microphones and exceptional wind noise resistance up to 12 m/s.
  • Enjoy seamless connectivity with Bluetooth 5.4, Google Fast Pair, and the convenience of dual-device connection.
  • Adapt your listening experience with multiple modes including Standard, Music, Video, E-book, and Game modes.
  • Listen for longer with up to 8.5 hours of earbud battery life (ANC off) and a total of 35 hours with the 480mAh charging case.
  • Recharge rapidly with less than 1 hour for earbuds and less than 2 hours for the charging case via USB Type-C.

For the discerning listener in South Africa, the Redmi Buds 8 Pro offer an auditory experience that transcends ordinary listening.

These are not merely earbuds; they are finely tuned instruments designed for those who seek sonic purity and an escape from the everyday cacophony. Whether you are a dedicated audiophile demanding the fidelity of Hi-Res Audio Wireless, a commuter seeking solace from urban noise, or a professional requiring crystal-clear communication, these noise-cancelling earbuds are engineered to meet your exacting standards. The Cloud White finish reflects a commitment to sophisticated design, mirroring the precision within. They serve as your personal sound sanctuary, delivering an unparalleled audio journey that respects the integrity of the original recording.

Mastering sound with coaxial triple drivers and Hi-Res Audio Wireless

The heart of the Redmi Buds 8 Pro lies in its advanced audio architecture: coaxial triple drivers. This configuration features an 11 mm titanium diaphragm bass driver for deep, resonant lows, complemented by dual 6.7 mm piezoelectric ceramic tweeters for crisp, clear highs. This meticulous design ensures a balanced and detailed soundstage across the entire frequency spectrum. Coupled with Hi-Res Audio Wireless certification and support for the LDAC high-resolution audio codec, these earbuds deliver audio with exceptional clarity and richness, preserving the subtle nuances that define true high-fidelity sound. Experience music as the artist intended, with every note and texture faithfully reproduced.

Escape the noise with advanced hybrid active noise cancellation

In a world filled with distractions, the Redmi Buds 8 Pro provide a sanctuary of silence. Equipped with hybrid active noise cancellation (ANC) technology, these Bluetooth 5.4 earbuds can reduce noise by up to 55dB, effectively masking a broad range of ambient sounds. With 20 adjustable ANC levels, you have precise control over your listening environment, allowing you to tailor the noise reduction depth to your specific needs, achieving an average reduction of 28.3dB. Whether you are on a bustling train, a noisy airplane, or simply seeking focus in a busy environment, these earbuds create a personal oasis of calm, allowing you to immerse yourself fully in your audio content.

Crystal-clear communication, unimpeded performance

Make and receive calls with absolute confidence, even in challenging conditions. The Redmi Buds 8 Pro feature a sophisticated triple AI microphone system designed to intelligently isolate your voice and suppress unwanted background noise. Furthermore, robust wind noise resistance, effective up to 12 m/s, ensures that your voice remains clear and intelligible during outdoor calls or while cycling. Paired with noise-cancelling 5.4, you benefit from a stable, low-latency connection for seamless communication and uninterrupted audio playback, ensuring that every conversation is as clear as the music you enjoy.

Effortless connectivity and extended listening pleasure personalised

Simplify your audio experience with the latest Bluetooth 5.4 technology, offering enhanced stability and energy efficiency. Enjoy the convenience of Google Fast Pair for quick, one-step pairing with compatible Android devices, and benefit from dual-device connectivity, allowing you to effortlessly switch between your phone and laptop. With a substantial 480mAh charging case, the Redmi Buds 8 Pro offer a total listening time of up to 35 hours with ANC turned off, providing exceptional endurance for long journeys or extended workdays. These USB C charging earbuds weigh just 5.4g each, ensuring comfort for prolonged wear. Recharge rapidly with less than 1 hour for earbuds and less than 2 hours for the charging case via USB Type-C.

product.name: Xiaomi Smart Camera C500
product.description:
3.5K UHD (3200 × 1800) | 360° Pan / 116° Tilt | Flagship AI Chip with Human & Pet Tracking | Dual-Band Wi-Fi 6 | Physical Privacy Masking | Colour Night Vision

Quick Specs

  • See every detail in 3.5K ultra-HD clarity, day or night
  • Keep watch across the whole room with 360° horizontal and 116° vertical coverage
  • Get instant alerts with AI-powered human and pet detection and tracking
  • Protect your privacy with a lens that physically tucks away into the body
  • Connect faster and stream more smoothly over dual-band Wi-Fi 6

3.5K Ultra-HD Imaging That Captures Every Detail

The Xiaomi Smart Camera C500 keeps homes across South Africa under a sharp, watchful eye with 3.5K ultra-HD resolution (3200 × 1800). As Xiaomi’s first 6MP indoor camera, it pairs a professional-grade 6P high-transparency optical lens with an f/1.6 large aperture and WDR to reproduce every detail in vivid, true-to-life clarity — so faces, movement and fine detail all come through crisply.

Bright, Full-Colour Footage Even in Low Light

A 1/2.45-inch ultra-large BSI image sensor gives the C500 an expansive, highly light-sensitive surface, so it handles dim evening conditions with ease and keeps producing rich, full-colour images long after the sun goes down. When it’s truly dark, eight 940nm infrared fill lights deliver detailed night vision without any visible red glow — so a sleeping child or pet is never disturbed.

Flagship AI Chip for Smarter Detection and Tracking

At the heart of the camera is a flagship AI chip with 1T of computing power, handling fast, accurate recognition locally on the device. It detects and tracks both people and pets (cats and dogs), sending prompt notifications straight to your phone and automatically following the action before returning to its set gimbal position. A local algorithm keeps detection quick and accurate while minimising false alarms.

Built-In Privacy and Bank-Grade Security

Privacy is protected from the source. The C500 supports physical masking — the lens physically tucks up into the body to block its view, and you can set timed or scheduled masking to suit your routine. Inside, a dedicated MJA1 security chipset gives every camera a unique key and certificate, with multi-layer cloud encryption safeguarding your footage with financial-grade protection.

Fast, Flexible and Effortless Smart-Home Control

Dual-band 2.4GHz + 5GHz Wi-Fi 6 with OFDMA keeps connections fast and stable for smooth high-definition playback. The dual-motor pan-tilt design gives you 360° horizontal and 116° vertical coverage, controllable right from your smartphone. It works with Xiaomi HyperOS Connect for seamless smart-home routines — including auto-hiding the lens when you arrive home — supports two-way voice calls, and responds to Amazon Alexa and Google Assistant for hands-free viewing. Footage can be saved in three ways: microSD card (8GB–256GB), cloud storage or NAS, with efficient H.265 encoding to save space.

product.name: UGreen 14-in-1 USB Type-C TO USB/2x HDMI/DP/RJ45 Docking Station
product.description:
Triple 4K display output | 14 ports in one dock | 100W host charging | 10Gbps data transfer | 1Gbps wired Ethernet

Quick Specs

  • Command a triple 4K display setup with two DisplayPort 1.4 outputs at 4K@120Hz and one HDMI 2.0 output at 4K@60Hz — all from a single USB Type-C connection.
  • Keep your laptop powered and productive with up to 100W pass-through charging via the USB Type-C upstream port.
  • Transfer large files at speed with 10Gbps USB Type-C and USB-A ports, plus SD and TF card readers reaching up to 170MB/s.
  • Connect to a stable wired network via the built-in 1Gbps Ethernet port — ideal for video calls and large uploads.
  • Consolidate 14 ports into one compact Space Grey dock and reclaim your desk from cable clutter.

One Cable. Fourteen Ports. Triple 4K.

The UGREEN 14-in-1 USB Type-C Docking Station is built for professionals who demand a fully equipped workstation from a single USB Type-C connection. Whether you're a video editor, creative, or power user juggling multiple monitors and peripherals, this dock transforms any USB Type-C laptop into a complete productivity hub — without the tangle of cables and adapters that usually comes with it.

Expand your view across three 4K screens

Tired of working on a single cramped screen? The dock drives up to three simultaneous 4K displays — two via DisplayPort 1.4 at up to 4K@120Hz and one via HDMI 2.0 at 4K@60Hz — giving you the screen real estate to edit timelines, monitor dashboards, and reference documents all at once. Note: on macOS, external monitors will display identical content; independent multi-display mode is supported on Windows.

Power your laptop while you work

The USB Type-C upstream port delivers up to 100W of power delivery back to your host device, so your laptop stays charged throughout even the most demanding sessions. A secondary USB Type-C PD port provides up to 27W of output for charging a phone or tablet simultaneously. Note that the upstream and PD ports share a combined 100W budget, so maximum per-port output may vary when both are in use.

Fast data, fast networking, no waiting

Move large project files quickly using the two 10Gbps USB Type-C data ports and the single 10Gbps USB-A port on the front panel — none of which support display or charging, keeping data bandwidth clean and dedicated. The SD and TF card readers each reach up to 170MB/s, making offloading camera footage straightforward. A Gigabit Ethernet port rounds out the connectivity for a stable, low-latency wired network connection — far more reliable than Wi-Fi when deadlines are tight.

product.name: UGREEN 4K@60Hz HDMI KVM Switch (2 In 1 Out)-Grey
product.description:
Effortlessly manage two computers on one monitor with seamless 4K@60Hz visuals and rapid 5Gbps USB 3.0 data transfer, ideal for home or office.

Quick Specs

  • Seamlessly control two computers with a single set of peripherals.
  • Experience crisp visuals with support for 4K @ 60Hz resolution.
  • Enjoy lightning-fast data transfers up to 5Gbps with USB 3.0 ports.
  • Connect a wide range of devices including keyboards, mice, and external drives.
  • Switch between computers instantly with a convenient push-button or desktop controller.

Streamline your workspace with the UGREEN HDMI KVM Switch (2 In 1 Out)

In the modern landscape of digital interaction, efficiency and clarity are paramount. This UGREEN KVM switch is engineered for the discerning professional and the dedicated enthusiast who navigates multiple digital environments daily. It addresses the common challenge of managing separate systems, whether for work and personal use, or for distinct project workflows. This device transforms a cluttered desk into an organised command centre, allowing you to operate two computers from a single workstation with unparalleled ease. It is designed for those who value their time and demand a seamless transition between tasks, ensuring that productivity is never compromised by hardware limitations. For the South African user seeking to optimise their setup, this HDMI KVM switch represents a significant upgrade in operational efficiency and desk space management.

Uncompromised visual fidelity and speed

Visual clarity is crucial for productivity and immersive entertainment. The UGREEN KVM switch supports resolutions up to 4K @ 60Hz, ensuring that every detail is rendered with precision. Whether you are reviewing intricate designs, editing high-resolution video, or enjoying graphically demanding games, the output remains sharp and vibrant. Beyond resolution, this 4K 60Hz KVM is built for speed. With HDMI 2.0 and HDCP 2.2 support, it ensures compatibility with the latest displays and content protection standards. For gamers and power users, the capability to support 2560x1440 at 120Hz and 1920x1080 at 240Hz means that motion blur and input lag are minimised, providing a fluid and responsive experience essential for competitive play or fast-paced work.

Expansive connectivity for all your peripherals

The utility of a KVM switch extends beyond display management; it is the central hub for your essential peripherals. This UGREEN device is equipped with four USB ports, including three USB-A and one USB Type-C, all supporting the rapid USB 3.0 standard with data transfer speeds of up to 5Gbps. This allows for the swift connection of keyboards, mice, webcams, printers, scanners, external hard drives, and even USB flash drives. The inclusion of a USB Type-C port provides further flexibility for modern devices. This KVM switch USB 3.0 offers driver-free, plug-and-play operation, ensuring that setup is immediate and straightforward, eliminating the need for complex software installations, making it a truly universal solution for diverse computing needs.

Effortless switching and advanced control

Transitioning between your connected computers is designed to be instantaneous and intuitive. The KVM switch offers two distinct methods for switching: a simple push button located on the unit itself, or a more convenient desktop controller. This physical controller places the switching function within easy reach, minimising disruption to your workflow. Furthermore, the device features a power memory function, meaning that if power is interrupted, it will automatically revert to the last selected input source once power is restored. This ensures continuity and reduces the need for manual reconfiguration, a vital feature for uninterrupted work sessions or gaming marathons.

Designed for diverse environments and operating systems

Universality is key in today's interconnected world. The UGREEN 2 In 1 Out HDMI KVM Switch is engineered for broad compatibility, supporting a wide array of operating systems including Windows (XP through 11), macOS, Linux, and Chrome OS. This makes it an ideal solution for mixed-OS environments, home offices, gaming setups, corporate meeting rooms, and educational institutions. The ability to connect modern consoles like the PS5 and Xbox One, alongside traditional PCs and laptops, further enhances its versatility. Its robust plastic construction and compact dimensions ensure durability and easy placement, making it a practical and reliable addition to any setup. Experience seamless operation with this essential HDMI KVM switch.

Features

  • Instantly switch control between two computers using a single display, keyboard, and mouse with the UGREEN HDMI KVM switch.
  • Experience stunning visuals with support for 4K resolution at a smooth 60Hz refresh rate, ideal for high-fidelity displays.
  • Transfer files at high speeds with integrated USB 3.0 ports offering up to 5Gbps data transfer, essential for the KVM switch USB 3.0 functionality.
  • Connect a wide array of peripherals, from gaming keyboards to high-definition webcams, to your connected computers.
  • Effortlessly switch inputs via the physical button on the unit or the included desktop controller for user convenience.

  • Benefit from plug-and-play simplicity, requiring no driver installations for immediate operation with your KVM switch.

product.description:
Designed to empower seamless collaboration, high-speed access, and enterprise-level data security, the UGREEN NASync DXP2800 2 Bay NAS is a purpose-built solution for professionals and teams managing large, mission-critical files across networked environments.

As a dedicated network-attached storage (NAS) system, this device enables users across the same network, whether in a creative agency, architecture firm, remote working setup, or IT department, to access, store, and collaborate on data continuously and securely. The centralised storage model eliminates file version conflicts and bottlenecks, ensuring that teams operate from a single source of truth.

Built on a powerful 12th Gen Intel® N100 processor with 4 cores and 4 threads, the UGREEN NASync DXP2800 2 Bay NAS delivers responsive multi-user performance. The 8GB DDR5 RAM is expandable to 16GB, allowing smooth operation of multiple applications and services, including private cloud hosting, AI-driven media sorting, and virtualisation environments.

The Seagate IronWolf 4TB NAS Hard Drive is expertly engineered for the demanding workloads of NAS environments, offering superior reliability, endurance, and speed for home, small business, and professional data storage systems. With a powerful combination of CMR technology, AgileArray™ firmware, and IronWolf Health Management, this drive ensures 24×7 operational readiness, optimized RAID performance, and proactive drive monitoring for superior data integrity.

Supporting up to 180TB workloads per year, the IronWolf 4TB delivers sustained transfer rates of up to 202MB/s, making it ideal for file sharing, data backups, media streaming, and collaborative access in multi-user NAS systems. It supports one- to eight-bay enclosures and is tested for compatibility with top NAS brands like Synology, QNAP, and Asustor. With RV sensors, dual-plane balance, and error recovery control, it maintains consistent performance in high-vibration, multi-drive environments, preventing mechanical strain and enhancing system longevity.

As a dedicated network-attached storage (NAS) system, this device enables users across the same network, whether in a creative agency, architecture firm, remote working setup, or IT department, to access, store, and collaborate on data continuously and securely. Command Every Match with the Redragon FIZZ Magnetic+

The Redragon FIZZ Magnetic+ is a wired 60% gaming keyboard engineered for the discerning South African gamer who refuses to compromise on performance or portability. Built around Redragon's custom linear magnetic switches, it delivers a level of precision and consistency that traditional mechanical switches simply cannot match — all packed into a sleek grey and black chassis that takes up minimal desk real estate without sacrificing any competitive edge.

Precision That Reacts Before You Think

Tired of feeling like your keyboard is holding you back? The FIZZ Magnetic+ changes that. Redragon's custom magnetic switches support an astonishing 0.01mm travel adjustment, letting you dial in your actuation point with surgical accuracy. Paired with an 8000Hz maximum report rate — lowering latency to just 0.125ms — every input is registered almost instantaneously. In fast-paced competitive titles, that margin is the difference between victory and defeat.

Hot-Swappable Freedom — Your Build, Your Rules

The FIZZ Magnetic+ features fully hot-swappable sockets, meaning you can pull and replace switches in seconds without a soldering iron in sight. Four extra magnetic switches are included in the box so you can experiment immediately. Durable PBT keycaps provide a satisfying texture and long-lasting legends, while the ABS chassis keeps the overall build lightweight at just 547g.

Programmable RGB and a Personality All Your Own

Stand out from the crowd with fully programmable per-key RGB backlighting that lets you craft a light show as unique as your playstyle. Software support — including web-based configuration — means you can customise lighting profiles, key bindings, and macros without being tethered to a single PC. Compatible with both Windows and macOS, the FIZZ Magnetic+ slots seamlessly into any setup. The iconic Redragon portable strap adds a distinctive finishing touch and makes carrying your keyboard to LAN events or a friend's place effortless.

One Cable. Ten Connections. Total Command of Your Workspace.

The UGREEN Revodok Maxidok 10-in-1 Thunderbolt 5 Docking Station is built for professionals who demand both performance and order at their desk. Whether you're running a multi-monitor creative setup, managing large file transfers, or keeping a video call steady on a wired connection, this dock turns a single Thunderbolt 5 cable into a complete workstation — compatible with Windows 11 (23H2 or later) and macOS 15 or later.

Thunderbolt 5 Speed — No Waiting, No Bottlenecks

Tired of watching progress bars crawl while moving large video projects or design files? The Thunderbolt 5 host connection delivers theoretical transfer rates of up to 120Gbps, ensuring that even the most demanding workflows move at the speed you need. Two additional Thunderbolt 5 output ports extend that bandwidth to compatible peripherals and displays, so performance is never compromised further down the chain.

Crystal-Clear 8K Visuals Across Multiple Displays

The dock supports output up to 8K@60Hz through both the Thunderbolt 5 output ports and the dedicated DisplayPort, giving you the flexibility to drive high-resolution displays with sharp detail and ultra-smooth visuals. Multi-display configurations are supported on both macOS and Windows, making it straightforward to build the kind of extended screen real estate that makes multitasking genuinely productive.

Everything Else You Need — All in One Place

Three USB-A ports running at 10Gbps each handle fast storage and everyday peripherals without slowing each other down. Gigabit Ethernet via the RJ45 port provides stable, reliable wired networking for downloads, streaming, and collaboration. Built-in SD and microSD (TF) card slots — both running SD 3.0 at up to 170MB/s — let photographers and video editors pull footage quickly without reaching for a separate reader. product.name: MSI PRO B850M-P WIFI AM5 mATX Motherboard
product.description:
Experience unwavering system stability and blistering speeds with advanced cooling and PCIe 5.0, perfect for the discerning South African gamer and professional.

Quick Specs

  • Harness unparalleled system stability with a robust 7+2+1 power design and enhanced cooling solutions.
  • Ensure peak performance for extended sessions with advanced Frozr Guard cooling technology.
  • Enjoy lightning-fast data transfers and gaming with PCIe 5.0 and Lightning Gen 5 M.2 slots.

  • Immerse yourself in superior audio quality for an enhanced gaming experience.

Engineered for Steadfast Performance in South Africa

The MSI PRO B850M-P WIFI AM5 motherboard is constructed for builders who demand reliability and speed without compromise. Designed for the AM5 socket, this mATX board is a cornerstone for high-performance systems, catering to both the dedicated gamer seeking every millisecond advantage and the professional requiring stable, rapid data throughput. Its robust construction and advanced cooling mean your system will perform at its peak, even under the most demanding workloads. This is more than just a component; it is the foundation for your digital ambitions, built for the South African market.

Unshakeable Power Delivery and Cooling for AM5 Motherboards

At its core, the PRO B850M-P WIFI features a direct 7+2+1 power system, complemented by a P-PAK and an 8-pin CPU power connector. This ensures a clean, stable power supply to your processor, crucial for overclocking or sustained high-frequency operation on your AM5 motherboard. Integrated Core Boost and Memory Boost technologies further optimise power delivery and signal integrity, maximising your CPU and RAM potential. The foundation of this stability is a 6-layer PCB, utilising 2oz thickened copper and server-grade materials, providing superior heat dissipation and signal quality for an optimal DDR5 motherboard experience.

Advanced Thermal Management for Continuous Operation

Sustained performance requires superior cooling. MSI’s Frozr Guard system, featuring an extended heatsink and MOSFET thermal pads rated for 7W/mK, effectively manages heat generated by critical components. Additional choke thermal pads and the EZ M.2 Shield Frozr II ensure your M.2 SSDs remain at optimal temperatures, preventing thermal throttling and maintaining non-stop operational fluidity. This comprehensive thermal solution is designed for users who push their systems to the limit, ensuring your motherboard runs cool under pressure.

Designed for the Modern Creator and Gamer with DDR5 Support

The evolution of gaming and content creation demands cutting-edge connectivity. This AM5 motherboard is equipped with a PCIe 5.0 slot, offering double the bandwidth of PCIe 4.0, and a Lightning Gen 5 x4 M.2 slot for storage solutions that redefine speed. This means faster game loading times, quicker file transfers, and smoother performance in demanding applications. The inclusion of Wi-Fi 7 ensures you are ready for the next generation of wireless networking, offering unparalleled speed and stability for online gaming, streaming, and large file downloads, further enhanced by a 5G LAN port for wired connectivity. Experience the power of DDR5 memory with this advanced board.

Seamless Integration and User-Centric Design for Motherboards

MSI’s commitment to user experience is evident in its EZ DIY features. The EZ M.2 Shield Frozr II and EZ M.2 Clip II simplify M.2 SSD installation and removal, while the EZ PCIe Clip II makes graphics card installation straightforward. The EZ Antenna design ensures easy and secure attachment of your Wi-Fi antennas. Furthermore, Audio Boost technology rewards your ears with studio-grade sound quality, delivering an immersive audio experience that draws you deeper into your games and media. This is a truly superior motherboard.

DDR5 speed for your laptop | 8 GB SODIMM upgrade | 4800 MT/s bandwidth | 1.1 V low-voltage operation | 36-month warranty

The KingSpec 8 GB DDR5 4800 MT/s SODIMM is a straightforward notebook memory upgrade for laptops that support the DDR5 standard. Running at 4800 MT/s with a CAS latency of 40 and a low operating voltage of 1.1 V, it delivers the higher bandwidth of DDR5 while keeping power draw in check — a practical benefit for mobile use. The 262-pin SODIMM form factor fits the slot found in most modern DDR5-compatible notebooks, and the compact PCB slips in without obstruction. Backed by a 36-month warranty, it is a reliable choice for anyone looking to add or replace memory in a compatible laptop.

product.name: Asus ROG G700 Intel® Core™ Ultra 5 Windows 11 Home PC (RTX 5080 TUF | 16GB DDR5 | 1TB NVMe)
product.description:

Quick Specs

  • Game at high settings with the GeForce RTX 5080 and 16GB of GDDR7 memory
  • Power through multitasking on a 10-core Intel Core Ultra 5 225F processor
  • Load games and apps fast from a 1TB PCIe 4.0 NVMe SSD
  • Stay cool under pressure with liquid CPU cooling and optimised airflow
  • Upgrade with ease thanks to tool-less side and front panels

Ready to Play, Straight Out of the Box

The ASUS ROG G700 is a 2025 high-performance gaming desktop built to drop into your setup and go. Pairing a 10-core Intel Core Ultra 5 225F processor with an ASUS TUF Gaming GeForce RTX 5080 graphics card and Windows 11 Home, it handles modern titles, streaming and everyday multitasking with room to spare — a genuine all-rounder for gamers who want strong performance without building from scratch.

product.name: Antec FLUX SE E-ATX | ATX | Micro-ATX | ITX Mid-Tower Gaming Chassis Wood Front Panel- Black
product.description:
Command a striking build with airflow-optimised engineering, a premium wood-accented front panel, and room to grow into whatever hardware comes next.

Quick Specs

  • Enjoy powerful, near-silent cooling straight out of the box with 5 pre-installed PWM fans synced to your motherboard.
  • Make a design statement with a premium wood and metal mesh front panel that stands apart from every other black box.
  • Fit the graphics card you actually want, with clearance for GPUs up to 408mm long.
  • Push your cooling further with radiator support up to a massive 420mm at the front.
  • Stay connected on the fly with front-panel USB 3.0, 10Gbps Type-C, and a headphone/mic combo jack.

Where Style Meets Serious Airflow

The Antec FLUX SE is built for PC builders who want their rig to look as good as it performs. Its front panel blends metal mesh with genuine walnut wood, giving the mid-tower gaming chassis a warm, distinctive texture that stands out from the sea of plain black boxes on the market. Underneath that striking exterior sits a case engineered around Antec's Flux airflow platform, designed from the ground up to keep serious hardware cool without demanding a forest of extra fans.

Flux Airflow, Five Fans, Zero Compromise

Tired of buying a case only to immediately spend more on fans just to make it usable? The FLUX SE ships with 5 high-performance PWM fans already installed and synced through a built-in hub that takes its cue directly from your motherboard. Multi-directional venting at the bottom, through the PSU chamber, along the lower sides, and across the top and front mesh creates a dedicated airflow channel that pulls cool air in and pushes heat straight out, keeping your CPU and GPU running cooler under sustained load.

Room to Build Big

Whether you're running E-ATX, ATX, Micro-ATX, or Mini-ITX, the FLUX SE gives you the space to build without compromise. It takes graphics cards up to 408mm long, coolers up to 180mm tall, and supports radiators as large as 420mm up front or 360mm on top, so extreme water-cooling setups are well within reach. A removable top cooling bracket, vertical GPU mounting support, and compatibility with back-connect motherboards mean you can plan a build that's both powerful and clean, right down to the cable routing.

Built for Convenience, Not Just Looks

Dual sound-dampening side panels keep fan and coil noise where it belongs, while a bottom pull-out dust filter makes maintenance a quick, tool-free job. Up front, you get instant access to power and reset controls, two USB 3.0 ports, a 10Gbps USB Type-C connector, and a headphone/mic combo jack, so plugging in peripherals never means reaching around the back. It's the kind of everyday convenience that makes a gaming chassis genuinely liveable, not just good on paper.

Features

  • Premium wood (walnut) and metal mesh front panel for a distinctive, upmarket look
  • 5 x pre-installed PWM fans (3 front, 1 reverse on the PSU shroud, 1 rear) synced via a built-in motherboard-controlled hub
  • Multi-directional Flux airflow venting across the bottom, PSU chamber, sides, top, and front mesh
  • Supports E-ATX (up to 330mm), ATX, Micro-ATX, and Mini-ITX motherboards
  • Extensive radiator support up to 420mm front and 360mm top for serious water-cooling builds
  • Vertical GPU mounting support with removable PCI slot covers
  • Back-connect motherboard compatible for cleaner cable routing and improved airflow
  • Dual tool-free, sound-dampening side panels plus a bottom pull-out dust filter for easy cleaning

product.name: Acer Chromebook Spin 512 (R856T-TCO-C8B3) 12″ |N100 | 8GB | 64GB – Google Chrome Operating System
product.description:
360° convertible 2-in-1 design | All-day 12-hour battery | MIL-STD-810H rugged build | Wi-Fi 6E connectivity | 12" HD+ IPS touch display

Quick Specs

  • Learn and create from any angle with a 360° convertible design that transforms from laptop to tablet in seconds
  • Stay focused all day on a 12-inch HD+ IPS touchscreen with a 3:2 aspect ratio, giving you 18% more vertical screen space than standard 16:9 displays
  • Power through a full school day on a single charge with up to 12 hours of battery life
  • Connect at speed with Wi-Fi 6E (802.11ax) for fast, reliable wireless performance in busy environments
  • Built to last with MIL-STD-810H military-grade durability, a spill-resistant keyboard, and Antimicrobial Corning Gorilla Glass

Your Adaptable Classroom Companion

The Acer Chromebook Spin 512 is designed for students and educators who need a reliable, versatile device that keeps up with the demands of modern learning. Running ChromeOS on an Intel Processor N100 with 8 GB of memory, it delivers smooth everyday performance whether you are browsing, collaborating on Google Workspace, or following along in a virtual lesson. Weighing just 1.45 kg, it is easy to carry between classrooms, and its 360° convertible hinge lets you switch between laptop, tent, and tablet modes to suit whatever the lesson requires.

See More, Do More on a Taller Display

The 12-inch HD+ IPS display with a 3:2 aspect ratio gives you 18% more vertical screen space compared to standard 16:9 panels, so you can read more and scroll less. At 1366 x 912 resolution with wide viewing angles up to 170 degrees and an Antimicrobial Corning Gorilla Glass touch surface, the screen is bright, responsive, and built to survive the classroom. TÜV Rheinland Low Blue Light (Hardware Solution) certification adds an extra layer of protection for eyes during extended study sessions.

Rugged Enough for the Real World

Tired of worrying about accidental drops and spills? The Chromebook Spin 512 is built to take it. MIL-STD-810H certification covers mechanical shock, vibration, humidity, extreme temperatures, and sand and dust. Reinforced I/O ports, a honeycomb interior structure, reinforced corner design, and a shock-absorbent bumper protect against drops of up to 122 cm. The spill-resistant keyboard handles up to 330 ml of liquid, while mechanically anchored keys resist accidental removal — and can be quickly replaced with just two screws when needed.

All-Day Power, Fast Wireless

A 50 Wh battery delivers up to 12 hours of use on a single charge, easily covering a full day of lessons without needing to reach for the adapter. When it is time to recharge, the included USB Type-C 45 W Google PD AC adapter gets you back up quickly. Wi-Fi 6E (802.11 a/b/g/n/ac/ax) with 2x2 MU-MIMO technology ensures fast, low-latency connectivity whether you are in a crowded school network or at home, keeping cloud-based learning running smoothly.

Features

  • 360° convertible hinge — use as a laptop, tent, or tablet to suit any learning mode
  • 12-inch HD+ IPS touchscreen (1366 x 912, 3:2 aspect ratio) with Antimicrobial Corning Gorilla Glass
  • TÜV Rheinland Low Blue Light (Hardware Solution) certified display for reduced eye strain
  • MIL-STD-810H certified: drop protection up to 122 cm, spill-resistant keyboard (330 ml), vibration, humidity, and dust resistance
  • Intel Processor N100 with Intel UHD Graphics and 8 GB LPDDR5 system memory

  • ChromeOS with built-in security, automatic updates, and access to Google Workspace
  • Serviceable keyboard design with mechanically anchored keys for quick replacement
  • OceanGlass touchpad made from recycled ocean-bound plastic

product.name: Antec C2M ARGB Compact Micro-ATX Gaming Chassis - White
product.description:
Antec C2M Constellation | Compact Micro-ATX | 270° 4mm Tempered Glass | 240mm + 120mm ARGB PWM Fans | USB Type-C 10Gbps | White

Quick Specs

  • Show off your build through 270° of full-view 4mm tempered glass
  • Cool hard with a pre-installed 240mm reverse ARGB fan plus a 120mm rear ARGB fan
  • Fit graphics cards up to 415mm and 360mm top radiators in a compact frame
  • Build tool-free with clip-on front, side and top panels
  • Connect fast through front USB Type-C 3.2 Gen 2 (10Gbps)

A 270° View of Your Build

The C2M Constellation wraps the front and left side in 4mm tempered glass for a 270° pillar-less, full-view display. With no corner post breaking the line of sight, your motherboard, graphics card and ARGB lighting are all on show — a clean, transparent look that turns a compact Micro-ATX build into a centrepiece.

Massive Airflow in a Compact Frame

Mesh top, bottom and side panels let air move freely through the chassis, while a ventilated PSU shroud grille boosts vertical airflow for cooler, more stable temperatures. Removable top and bottom dust filters keep the interior clean and are quick to pull out and rinse, so the airflow advantage lasts.

Serious Cooling Headroom

The C2M ships ready to run, with a 240mm reverse single-frame ARGB PWM fan on the right side and a 120mm ARGB PWM fan at the rear — pushing up to 114.33 CFM at 800–1500 RPM while staying quiet at 30.4 dB(A). There's room for up to six 120mm fans in total, plus a 360mm top radiator and a 240mm side radiator, so both air and liquid builds have space to breathe. Graphics cards up to 415mm and CPU coolers up to 165mm fit comfortably — GPU clearance drops below 280mm when a side radiator is fitted.

Tool-Free Building and Tidy Cable Routing

Clip-on front, side and top panels use fixing slots and studs, so they come off and back on without tools for hassle-free installation and cleaning. Behind the motherboard tray you get 30mm of cable-routing clearance and three Velcro straps to keep wiring neat, while the front I/O — set low for desktop placement — puts USB 3.0, USB Type-C 3.2 Gen 2 (10Gbps) and a headphone/mic combo jack within easy reach.

FEATURES:

  • Compact Micro-ATX chassis supporting Micro-ATX and ITX motherboards
  • 270° full-view design with 4mm tempered glass across the front and left side
  • Pre-installed 1 x 240mm reverse single-frame ARGB PWM fan (right side) and 1 x 120mm ARGB PWM fan (rear)
  • Mesh top, bottom and side panels with a ventilated PSU shroud for high airflow
  • Supports up to six 120mm fans — top 3 x 120mm or 2 x 140mm, side 2 x 120mm, rear 1 x 120mm
  • Radiator support: 360mm top, 240mm side, 120mm rear
  • Fits graphics cards up to 415mm (under 280mm with a side radiator) and CPU coolers up to 165mm
  • Tool-free clip-on front, side and top panels
  • Removable top and bottom dust filters
  • 30mm cable-routing clearance with three Velcro straps
  • Front I/O with USB 3.0, USB Type-C 3.2 Gen 2 (10Gbps) and headphone/mic combo jack

SPECIFICATIONS:

  • Form Factor: Compact Micro-ATX
  • Motherboard Support: Micro-ATX, ITX
  • Case Material: Steel, plastic and 4mm tempered glass
  • Side Window: 4mm tempered glass
  • Front I/O: Power, USB 3.0 x1, USB Type-C 3.2 Gen 2 (10Gbps) x1, Headphone/Mic Combo Jack

Why Antec?

Antec has earned a long-standing reputation among South African PC builders for chassis that balance airflow, build quality and value. The C2M Constellation brings that pedigree to a compact Micro-ATX footprint, pairing a striking 270° tempered-glass view with real cooling headroom and pre-installed ARGB fans. For local gamers who want a small-form-factor ARGB case that still swallows a full-size graphics card and a 360mm radiator, the Antec C2M is a smart, eye-catching foundation for a tidy, future-ready build.

product.name: Antec CX MIRROR ARGB ATX Mid-Tower Gaming Chassis - Black
product.description:
Mid-Tower | ATX · Micro-ATX · ITX | 270° Panoramic Glass | 7 ARGB Fans Pre-Installed | Dual 360mm Radiator Support

Quick Specs

  • Show off your rig through a sweeping 270° panoramic tempered-glass view
  • Cool hard with 7 pre-installed ARGB fans and bottom-to-top vertical airflow
  • Sync your lighting instantly using the included 4-port ARGB controller
  • Mount serious liquid cooling with dual 360mm radiator support
  • Fit flagship hardware with up to 415mm GPU and 155mm cooler clearance

A Panoramic 270° View of Your Build

The Antec CX Mirror puts your hardware centre stage. Its wraparound tempered-glass front and side panels open up a 270° panoramic view, so every cable run, RGB accent and GPU backplate is on full display. It’s a chassis built for people who want their build seen, not hidden away in a metal box.

Vertical Cooling, Engineered for Heat

Rather than fighting gravity, the CX Mirror works with it. A vertical airflow design draws cool air in from the bottom and channels heat straight up and out, supporting up to 10 fans simultaneously for rapid heat extraction. The dual-chamber layout keeps the power supply in its own compartment with independent cooling, leaving the main chamber clear for airflow and a tidy build.

Seven ARGB Fans, Ready Out of the Box

There’s no need to buy fans separately to get the glow going. The CX Mirror ships with 7 pre-installed 120mm ARGB fans — three reverse-blade fans along the bottom, three more on the right side, and one at the rear. A 1-to-3 3-pin splitter cable and a 4-port ARGB controller are included too, so you can sync effects across the whole case from the moment you power on.

Built for High-End Water Cooling

Custom and AIO liquid cooling fit comfortably in this chassis. The CX Mirror supports 360mm radiators at both the top and bottom, plus a 240mm radiator on the right side. When pairing a right-side radiator and fans, keep the combined thickness under 70mm to avoid clashing with the graphics card. Magnetic dust filters on the top and bottom keep airflow clean without choking it.

Room for the Biggest GPUs

Lengthy modern graphics cards are no problem here. The CX Mirror clears GPUs up to 415mm long and CPU coolers up to 155mm tall, comfortably accommodating the latest RTX 50 Series cards and large air coolers alike. A removable HDD cage and up to 93.5mm of cable management space round out a layout designed to make even an ambitious build straightforward.

FEATURES:

  • Panoramic 270° wraparound tempered-glass front and side panels
  • Dual-chamber layout with a top-mounted PSU and independent cooling
  • Vertical airflow design supporting up to 10 fans for rapid heat extraction
  • 7 pre-installed ARGB fans: 3 x 120mm reverse (bottom), 3 x 120mm reverse (right), 1 x 120mm (rear)
  • Included 1-to-3 3-pin splitter cable and 4-port ARGB controller
  • Versatile water cooling with 360mm top, 360mm bottom and 240mm right-side radiator support
  • Removable HDD cage supporting 1 x 3.5" HDD and 2 x 2.5" SSDs

  • Front I/O with USB Type-C 3.2 Gen 1 (5Gbps), USB 3.0, USB 2.0, headphone/mic combo jack and LED control button
  • Up to 93.5mm of cable management space

Quick Specs

  • Show off everything through a 270° panoramic 4mm tempered-glass view
  • Cool big builds with support for up to eight 120mm fans and a 360mm top radiator
