A 270° Panoramic View

The CX705 opens up your build with a 270° panoramic design, wrapping the front and side in 4mm tempered glass so your motherboard, graphics card and ARGB lighting take centre stage. It's a clean, uninterrupted view that shows off every component — exactly what you want from a glass-fronted gaming chassis.

Five ARGB Fans, Ready Out of the Box

Unlike most cases at this level, the CX705 ships with five 120mm PWM ARGB fans already installed — two reverse fans on the PSU shroud, two more on the right side and one at the rear. Vertical Airflow and Big Cooling Support

A vertical airflow design pulls cool air from the bottom mesh and drives heat up and out, and there's room for up to eight 120mm fans running simultaneously. product.name: Giada D108 AMD Ryzen 7 8845HS Book-size Signage Player
product.description:
AMD Ryzen™ 7 8845HS | Radeon™ 780M Graphics | AMD Ryzen™ AI (38 TOPS) | Quad 4K HDMI Output | Up to 96GB DDR5 | Book-Size Design

Quick Specs

  • Drive demanding signage and edge AI workloads with an 8-core AMD Ryzen™ 7 8845HS
  • Accelerate on-device AI with AMD Ryzen™ AI delivering up to 38 TOPS
  • Power up to four 4K displays at once through quad HDMI outputs
  • Expand to 96GB DDR5 memory and fast PCIe 4.0 M.2 SSD storage
  • Connect with dual Ethernet (1GbE + 2.5GbE) and plentiful USB 3.2 Gen2

Ryzen 8000-Series Power in a Book-Size Build

The Giada D108 is a high-performance embedded computer built around the 8-core AMD Ryzen™ 7 8845HS processor with integrated AMD Ryzen™ AI. Delivering up to 38 TOPS of total AI performance (16 TOPS from the dedicated NPU), it’s ready for modern AI-assisted signage, kiosk and edge workloads across South Africa — all in a compact, book-size chassis that fits almost anywhere.

Stunning Quad-Display Visuals

Built for digital signage, the D108 drives up to four independent displays simultaneously through four HDMI ports, each supporting resolutions up to 3840 × 2160 (4K) at 60Hz with hardware EDID. AMD Radeon™ 780M graphics handle rich multimedia with advanced hardware decode and encode (including H.265, VP9 and AV1), making it ideal for crisp 4K video walls and multi-screen deployments.

Extensive Connectivity and Expansion

Connectivity is comprehensive. A rich I/O array includes five USB 3.2 Gen2 ports, a USB 2.0 port, an RS232 serial port (optionally two) and MIC-IN/AUDIO-OUT, while dual Ethernet — 1GbE plus 2.5GbE — keeps wired networking fast and resilient. Inside, support for up to 96GB of dual-channel DDR5 memory and a PCIe® 4.0 M.2 (2280) SSD gives you room to scale, with optional M.2 modules adding Wi-Fi 5/6E and 4G mobile connectivity plus a SIM slot.

Reliable, Always-On Operation

Engineered for unattended deployments, the D108 features smart active cooling, a watchdog timer, auto power-on, scheduled RTC and optional TPM 2.0 for hardware security. product.name: Port Designs Milano II ECO 14/16″ Totepack – Blush Pink
product.description:
16L Capacity | Totepack-to-Backpack Design | Fits Laptops up to 16″ | Recycled r-PET Eco Lining | Corduroy Exterior | Trolley Strap

Quick Specs

  • Switch effortlessly between a totepack and a backpack with hideaway shoulder straps.
  • Protect your device in a padded compartment sized for laptops up to 16″.
  • Organise 16L of everyday essentials across numerous pockets and storage spaces.
  • Glide through travel days with a trolley strap that slips over rolling luggage handles.
  • Carry consciously with an eco-friendly lining made from recycled r-PET polyester.

Designed in Paris for the way South Africans live, work, and commute, the Port Designs Milano II ECO is two bags in one.

Whether you’re heading to the office, a campus lecture, or a weekend away, this convertible laptop bag adapts to your day. Grab the two padded top handles for a quick hand-carry, then release the hideaway shoulder straps when you’ve got further to go — all wrapped in an elegant, hard-wearing corduroy exterior that looks as good as it lasts.

Smart storage that keeps your day organised.

The roomy 16L main compartment houses a padded sleeve that fits laptops up to 16″, while a wide front quick-access pocket and multiple interior storage spaces keep your charger, cables, notebook and daily essentials exactly where you need them. Two side pockets hold a water bottle or umbrella, and the rear trolley strap makes this the ideal laptop backpack for travel.

Built to last, made responsibly.

A durable corduroy and water-repellent 600D polyester shell stands up to daily use, gunmetal-finish zips add a refined touch, and the interior is lined with 210D recycled r-PET — made from recycled and recyclable materials. Backed by a limited lifetime warranty, it’s a sustainable laptop bag built to go the distance.

Features

  • Converts from a totepack to a backpack thanks to two padded top handles and hideaway shoulder straps.
  • 16L capacity with a padded compartment that fits laptops up to 16″ (37 × 26 × 3 cm).
  • Wide front quick-access pocket plus multiple interior storage spaces for everyday organisation.
  • Two outer side pockets for a water bottle or umbrella, and a trolley strap for rolling luggage.
  • Elegant, durable corduroy exterior with an eco-friendly recycled r-PET lining.

Specifications

  • Capacity: 16L
  • Laptop Compartment: Fits up to 16″ (37 × 26 × 3 cm)
  • Exterior: Corduroy with 600D water-repellent polyester
  • Lining: 210D recycled r-PET polyester
  • Zips: Refined gunmetal finish
  • Carry Options: Top handles + hideaway shoulder straps
  • Side Pockets: 2 (water bottle / umbrella)
  • Trolley Strap: Yes
  • Colour: Blush Pink
  • Product Dimensions: 51 × 34 × 14.5 cm
  • Product Weight: 680 g

What’s in the Box

  • Port Designs Milano II ECO 14/16″ Totepack – Blush Pink ×1

Why Port Designs?

With design rooted in Paris, Port Designs blends French style with everyday practicality to create laptop bags and backpacks made for modern life. The Milano II ECO reflects that ethos — combining sustainable materials, thoughtful storage and lasting build quality in a laptop backpack that South Africans can rely on day after day.

product.name: Port Designs Milano II Eco 13/14" Universal Laptop Sleeve - Plush Pink
product.description:
Shield your 13" or 14" laptop with the refined corduroy exterior and soft, eco-friendly interior of the Port Designs Milano II sleeve.

Quick Specs

  • Guard your device with durable, eco-conscious materials.
  • Accommodates both 13-inch and 14-inch laptops seamlessly.
  • Slim profile at only 2.2cm thick to easily fit into larger bags.
  • Lightweight design at 235g to minimise carrying burden.
  • Elegant plush pink colourway and textured corduroy finish for a sophisticated look.

For the discerning professional on the move in South Africa, the Port Designs Milano II Eco laptop sleeve offers more than mere protection; it presents a statement of conscious style and practical defence for your laptop.

This laptop sleeve is crafted for the individual who values both the integrity of their technology and the aesthetic of their accessories. Whether you are commuting to your office, attending client meetings, or travelling between campuses, this sleeve ensures your essential device remains shielded from the rigours of daily transit. It is designed not just to hold a laptop, but to complement a professional lifestyle, blending durability with a refined appearance that speaks to attention to detail and an appreciation for quality materials. For those who demand reliability without sacrificing elegance, this laptop sleeve is the definitive choice, offering superior protection.

Sophisticated defence meets eco-conscious design

The exterior of the Milano II Eco sleeve is fashioned from resilient corduroy, offering a unique textured finish that not only looks distinguished but also provides a superior grip, reducing the chance of accidental slips. This is complemented by an interior lined with soft, eco-T cloth fabric. This material is specifically chosen for its gentle touch, ensuring that your laptop’s screen and casing are protected from scratches and minor abrasions. This thoughtful combination of materials creates a protective cocoon for your device, combining tactile elegance with robust defence against the everyday challenges of portability.

Engineered for universal compatibility and ease of transport

Understanding the diverse needs of laptop users, the Port Designs Milano II Eco sleeve is intelligently designed to accommodate a wide range of 13-inch and 14-inch laptops. Its internal dimensions are meticulously measured at 34.5 x 24.5 x 2.5 cm, providing a snug yet accessible fit for most popular models. The overall product dimensions of 38 x 26.5 x 2.2 cm ensure that while offering ample protection, the sleeve maintains a slim and streamlined profile. Weighing a mere 235g, it adds negligible bulk, allowing it to be easily slipped into a larger backpack, briefcase, or tote bag without adding unnecessary weight or size to your daily carry. This makes it an ideal laptop sleeve for daily commutes.

A commitment to sustainable style

Port Designs recognises the growing importance of environmental responsibility. The Milano II Eco sleeve embodies this commitment through its thoughtful material selection, featuring eco-friendly components that reduce environmental impact without compromising on performance or aesthetics. The use of eco-T cloth fabric is a testament to this philosophy. This approach ensures that your choice of accessory aligns with a more sustainable future, offering you peace of mind alongside excellent protection for your valuable technology. This sleeve represents a fusion of modern functionality and eco-conscious values, a truly exceptional laptop sleeve.

FEATURES:

  • Safeguard your laptop with a protective corduroy exterior that offers both durability and a refined texture, making it a superior laptop sleeve.
  • Protect your device's finish and screen with a soft, scratch-resistant eco-T cloth fabric lining, ensuring peace of mind for your 13 or 14-inch laptop sleeve.
  • Ensure a perfect fit for your 13-inch or 14-inch laptop with precisely engineered internal dimensions, creating a secure environment for your device.
  • Maintain a sleek profile and effortless portability due to the slim 2.2cm thickness and lightweight 235g design.
  • Carry with confidence using the elegant plush pink colour and sophisticated corduroy finish, ideal for professional environments.

    • Inside: Eco T cloth fabric
    • Outside: Corduroy
    • *This product is made of recycled & recyclable materials

Experience true colour fidelity and unparalleled detail for professional workflows; see your creative vision come to life with expansive 6K resolution and IPS Black technology.

Quick Specs

  • Witness breathtaking detail with a stunning 6K resolution (6144 x 3456) for expansive creative work.
  • Achieve perfect blacks and exceptional contrast with advanced IPS Black panel technology.
  • Calibrated at the factory for precise colour accuracy, ensuring DCI-P3 98% and Adobe 99.5% coverage.
  • Streamline your workspace with 96W power delivery via Thunderbolt and versatile connectivity options.
  • Enjoy a seamless multi-monitor setup with daisy-chaining capabilities for up to 6K at 60Hz.

For the discerning South African creative and professional, the LG UltraFine Evo 32-inch 6K monitor is an indispensable tool for visual precision.

This is not merely a display; it is a canvas engineered for those who demand absolute colour accuracy and resolution that reveals every nuance. Whether you are a photo editor, video producer, graphic designer, or simply someone who appreciates the finest visual fidelity, this LG 32-inch monitor provides the clarity and colour depth required to bring your most ambitious projects to life. It serves as the cornerstone of a productive, clutter-free workspace, enabling you to work faster and more efficiently. For the professional who understands that details matter, this LG 6K monitor offers an unparalleled view into your work.

Unrivalled visual fidelity with IPS Black technology

At the core of this LG UltraFine monitor lies its revolutionary IPS Black panel technology. This advanced display achieves a contrast ratio of up to 2,000:1, significantly higher than conventional IPS panels. This translates to deeper blacks, richer colours, and more pronounced contrast, allowing you to discern subtle gradations and details that would be lost on lesser screens. Combined with a factory calibration that ensures DCI-P3 98% and Adobe 99.5% colour gamut coverage, this monitor delivers true-to-life colour reproduction, essential for colour-critical work.

A powerhouse for productivity and connectivity

Streamline your desk setup and amplify your productivity with the comprehensive connectivity options. The single Thunderbolt 4 port not only supports a massive 6K resolution at 60Hz but also delivers up to 96W of power delivery, allowing you to charge your laptop directly from the monitor. This eliminates the need for multiple cables and power adapters. With additional USB Type-C and USB-A ports, along with DisplayPort 2.1 support, connecting all your peripherals, external drives, and secondary displays, including daisy-chaining other 6K monitors, becomes a seamless experience. The built-in KVM switch further enhances workflow by allowing you to control multiple computers with a single keyboard and mouse.

Designed for focus and comfort

The LG UltraFine Evo monitor is built to support extended work sessions without compromise. Its 4-side virtually borderless design ensures an immersive viewing experience, allowing for seamless integration into multi-monitor setups. The ergonomic stand offers tilt, height, and pivot adjustments, enabling you to find the perfect viewing angle and posture for maximum comfort. Features like Flicker Safe, Reader Mode, and Auto Brightness dynamically adjust the display to reduce eye strain and optimise viewing conditions throughout the day, promoting a healthier and more focused work environment. This LG 32-inch monitor prioritises your well-being.

Elevate your workflow with intelligent features

This LG 6K monitor is equipped with intelligent features designed to enhance your creative output and overall user experience. The Super Resolution+ technology helps to sharpen images and text, while Black Stabilizer enhances visibility in dark scenes, crucial for gaming or detailed image editing. Auto Input Switch ensures you are always viewing the active signal source without manual intervention. Whether you are creating, editing, or simply consuming content, the LG UltraFine Evo monitor is engineered to provide a superior, intuitive, and efficient visual experience for professionals in South Africa. The LG UltraFine monitor is truly a professional's best friend.

FEATURES:

  • Create with confidence: Benefit from a factory-calibrated IPS Black panel delivering exceptional contrast and precise colour accuracy (DCI-P3 98%, Adobe 99.5%) for critical editing tasks.
  • Expand your canvas: Immerse yourself in the expansive 6K resolution (6144 x 3456) to view more of your project timelines, detailed images, and complex designs simultaneously.
  • Simplify your setup: Charge your laptop with up to 96W power delivery via a single Thunderbolt 4 connection, reducing cable clutter and enhancing workspace efficiency.
  • Seamless multi-monitor workflows: Effortlessly connect and manage multiple displays with daisy-chaining support for up to 6K resolution at 60Hz, boosting productivity.
  • Ultimate control: Manage multiple computers with ease using the integrated KVM switch, allowing single keyboard and mouse operation across different devices.
  • Reduce eye strain: Work comfortably for longer periods with Flicker Safe, Reader Mode, and intelligent Auto Brightness adjustments that optimise your viewing environment.
  • Future-ready connectivity: Equipped with DisplayPort 2.1, Thunderbolt 4, and versatile USB Type-C ports, ensuring compatibility with the latest high-performance devices.

product.name: ASUS TUF Gaming GeForce RTX 5060 8GB GDDR7 OC Edition Graphics Card
product.description:
Unleash the power of AI and gaming with advanced GDDR7 memory and PCI Express 5.0 for unparalleled performance in South Africa.

Quick Specs

  • Experience lightning-fast performance with 8GB GDDR7 video memory, offering speeds of 28 Gbps.
  • Achieve exceptional AI processing power with 614 TOPs for cutting-edge applications.
  • Seamlessly connect to the latest displays with support for Digital Max Resolution 7680 x 4320.
  • Benefit from enhanced gaming responsiveness with a PCI Express 5.0 bus standard.
  • Enjoy robust cooling and build quality synonymous with the ASUS TUF Gaming series.

For the discerning South African gamer and creative professional

This is not merely a graphics card; it is the cornerstone of your digital dominion. Engineered for those who demand unflinching performance and steadfast reliability, the ASUS TUF Gaming GeForce RTX 5060 is built to conquer the most demanding titles and complex creative workflows. Its robust construction, a hallmark of the TUF Gaming alliance, ensures enduring performance, making it the ideal choice for players and professionals in South Africa who refuse to settle for anything less than the best. This graphics card is for the serious user who understands that true power lies not just in raw specifications, but in consistent, unyielding execution.

A new era of AI and graphical prowess

At its core, the GeForce RTX 5060 is a technological marvel. Featuring 3840 CUDA cores and an astounding 614 TOPs of AI performance, it redefines what's possible in real-time rendering, machine learning, and content creation. The integration of 8GB of cutting-edge GDDR7 memory, operating at a blistering 28 Gbps, ensures that data is accessed with unprecedented speed, eliminating bottlenecks and keeping your system fluid, even under extreme loads. This is the graphics card performance you need to stay ahead in gaming and innovation.

Built for the future, ready for today

The foundation of this card's exceptional speed is the PCI Express 5.0 interface. This next-generation bus standard offers double the bandwidth of PCIe 4.0, providing ample room for the RTX 5060's powerful capabilities and ensuring future compatibility with upcoming hardware. Coupled with support for the latest DisplayPort 2.1b and HDMI 2.1b, you can drive up to four displays at stunning resolutions, including a maximum digital resolution of 7680 x 4320. This makes it an ideal solution for immersive gaming setups, multi-monitor productivity environments, and high-resolution content creation.

Enduring reliability and robust design

The TUF Gaming philosophy extends to every aspect of this graphics card. Designed with durability in mind, it features enhanced cooling solutions and premium components to ensure longevity and stability, even during extended gaming sessions or intensive rendering tasks. The 3.1 slot design and the single 8-pin power connector offer broad compatibility with a wide range of PC builds, while the inclusion of ARGB lighting allows for customisation to match your aesthetic. Trust in the TUF build quality to provide a stable, high-performance experience, year after year.

The TUF Gaming GPU advantage

Choosing an ASUS TUF Gaming GPU means investing in a legacy of resilience. Each component is selected for its ability to withstand demanding conditions, ensuring that your system performs optimally when it matters most. This commitment to quality guarantees a superior gaming and creative experience, making the ASUS TUF Gaming RTX 5060 a wise choice for any discerning user.

FEATURES:

  • Experience unparalleled speed and efficiency with 8GB of GDDR7 video memory, delivering 28 Gbps for rapid data access.
  • Accelerate your AI workloads and complex simulations with an impressive 614 TOPs of processing power.
  • Future-proof your setup with the latest PCI Express 5.0 interface, offering double the bandwidth for enhanced performance.
  • Immerse yourself in breathtaking visuals and gaming worlds with support for up to 4 displays at a maximum resolution of 7680 x 4320.
  • Enjoy stable and reliable performance thanks to the robust TUF Gaming design, built with premium components and advanced cooling.
  • Personalise your rig with vibrant ARGB lighting, controllable via ASUS Aura Sync for a cohesive aesthetic.

product.name: Wanbo To Go Pro 1080P 500ANSI Android 14 Mobile Smart Projector
product.description:
Built-in 99Wh battery | Google TV with Android 14 | Native 1080P FHD | 360° adjustable projection | Auto setup in seconds

Quick Specs

  • Stream over 10,000 apps straight out of the box with Google TV powered by Android 14 — no streaming stick needed.
  • Enjoy up to 3.5 hours of uninterrupted playback on a single charge thanks to the built-in 99Wh battery.
  • Experience crisp, full-HD clarity at 1920 x 1080 native resolution with 500 ANSI lumens of brightness.
  • Set up in seconds wherever you are — ASA 3.0 auto focus, auto keystone correction, and auto screen fit do the work for you.
  • Project at any angle, including straight up at the ceiling, with the 360° adjustable integrated gimbal bracket.

Cinema Wherever You Go

The Wanbo ToGo Pro is built for anyone who refuses to leave great entertainment behind. Whether you're hosting a backyard movie night, relaxing at a campsite, or simply moving from the lounge to the bedroom, this portable smart projector goes wherever you do. Weighing just 2.6 kg and fitted with a premium leather handle, it's as easy to carry as it is to set up — and with Google TV running on Android 14, your favourite streaming apps are ready the moment you switch it on.

One Charge, A Full Night's Entertainment

Tired of hunting for a power outlet the moment the movie gets good? The ToGo Pro's built-in 99Wh battery delivers up to 3.5 hours in Eco Mode or 2 hours in Standard Mode — enough for two full-length films or an entire football match on a single charge. Whether you're under the stars in the Drakensberg or relaxing in your garden on a warm South African evening, the entertainment keeps going long after the sun goes down.

Sharp Picture, Smart Setup

Native 1920 x 1080 Full HD resolution and 500 ANSI lumens combine to deliver a bright, detailed image on screens from 40 to 120 inches. The 1.3:1 throw ratio means you don't need a vast room to go big. ASA 3.0 handles auto focus, auto keystone correction, and auto screen alignment the moment you power on — so there's no fiddling, no frustration, just a sharp, perfectly aligned picture every time you move the projector.

All Your Apps, Whisper-Quiet Sound

Powered by Google TV with access to over 10,000 apps — including Netflix, YouTube, and Prime Video — the ToGo Pro needs no external streaming stick. Google Assistant lets you search, play, and control with just your voice. Dual-band Wi-Fi (2.4G/5G), Bluetooth 5.0, and Chromecast built-in keep everything connected wirelessly, while the 8W built-in speaker delivers clear highs and solid bass. Operating noise stays at or below 28 dB/m, so the only thing you hear is what's on screen.

Features

  • Built-in 99Wh battery — up to 3.5 hours (Eco Mode) or 2 hours (Standard Mode) of cordless playback
  • Google TV with Android 14 — access 10,000+ apps including Netflix and YouTube, no streaming stick required
  • Native 1920 x 1080 FHD resolution with 500 ANSI lumens and a 2500:1 contrast ratio
  • ASA 3.0 auto focus, auto keystone correction, and auto screen fit for instant, precise image alignment
  • 360° adjustable integrated gimbal bracket — project onto walls, ceilings, or any surface at any angle
  • Fully enclosed optical engine reduces dust ingress and maintains image quality over time
  • 8W built-in speaker with DSP amplification; operating noise ≤28 dB/m
  • Chromecast built-in, dual-band Wi-Fi (2.4G/5G), and Bluetooth 5.0
  • Google Assistant voice control built-in
  • Widevine L1 certification for full HD streaming of supported apps
  • HDMI, USB, and 3.5mm audio inputs for wired connectivity
  • Leather handle design — lightweight and portable at 2.6 kg

product.name: Xiaomi Portable Blender 300ml USB Type-C Rechargeable- White
product.description:
Enjoy fresh smoothies and shakes anywhere, anytime; powered by a 1300mAh battery for up to 12 blends per charge.

Quick Specs

  • Effortlessly blend nutritious smoothies and shakes on the go with its powerful 19,500rpm motor.
  • Crush ice and frozen fruits with ease for perfectly chilled beverages.
  • Enjoy up to 12 blends from a single charge thanks to the 1300mAh battery.
  • Conveniently recharge anywhere with the universal USB Type-C port.
  • Experience safe and durable blending with food-grade materials and robust safety features.

For the active South African who values health and convenience

The Xiaomi Personal Blender is engineered for those who lead a dynamic lifestyle but refuse to compromise on their nutritional intake. Whether you are heading to the gym, embarking on an outdoor adventure, or simply need a quick, healthy refreshment at the office, this smoothie maker portable is your perfect companion. Its compact and cordless design means you can prepare your favourite drinks wherever life takes you. It addresses the common challenge of finding time and access to healthy options when away from home, offering a seamless solution for maintaining your wellness goals without interruption.

Powerful performance in a compact form

Do not let its size deceive you; this portable blender packs a punch. Equipped with a robust motor spinning at up to 19,500rpm, it efficiently tackles fruits, vegetables, and even ice, transforming them into smooth, delicious beverages in approximately 40 seconds per cycle. This ice crushing blender capability ensures that your smoothies and shakes are always perfectly chilled and refreshing, providing a satisfying experience with every sip. This capability makes it more than just a blender; it's a personal refreshment station.

Uninterrupted power for your busy life

Freedom from cords is paramount for a portable device. The Xiaomi Personal Blender features a high-capacity 1300mAh battery, capable of delivering up to 12 blends on a single full charge. This extended battery life ensures you are not tethered to a power outlet, making it ideal for travel, outdoor activities, or even a full day of use without needing a recharge. When it is time to power up, the convenient USB Type-C port allows for easy and universal charging, whether from a power bank, laptop, or wall adapter.

Built for safety and durability

Your well-being is paramount. This blender is constructed with premium, food-grade PCTG for the cup and high-quality 304 stainless steel for the blades, ensuring that your beverages are free from harmful contaminants. Furthermore, it incorporates multiple built-in safety protections, meaning the blender will only operate when the cup is securely attached, preventing accidental operation and ensuring peace of mind during use. The leak-resistant design further guarantees a mess-free experience, allowing you to carry it with confidence.

The value of convenience and health combined

Investing in the Xiaomi Personal Blender is investing in your health and your time. It eliminates the need for expensive pre-made smoothies, offering a cost-effective way to enjoy fresh, personalised drinks. Its ease of use, portability, and powerful performance make it an indispensable tool for anyone seeking to incorporate more nutritious options into their daily routine effortlessly. This smoothie maker portable represents the pinnacle of convenience for the health-conscious individual in South Africa.

Features

  • Effortlessly create nutritious smoothies, shakes, and even crushed ice beverages with a powerful motor reaching up to 19,500rpm, making it an effective ice crushing blender.
  • Enjoy the freedom of cordless blending for up to 12 cycles per charge, thanks to the 1300mAh rechargeable battery, ideal for this personal blender.
  • Conveniently recharge your blender anywhere using the universal USB Type-C charging port, offering maximum portability for your smoothie maker portable.
  • Blend with confidence knowing your health is protected by food-grade PCTG cup material and durable 304 stainless steel blades.
  • Benefit from enhanced safety with multiple built-in protections that ensure the blender operates only when assembled correctly.
  • Experience a mess-free lifestyle with the thoughtfully designed leak-resistant cup.

product.name: Xiaomi Redmi Headphones Neo ANC Wireless Over-Ears – Black
product.description:
Enjoy seamless wireless connectivity and superior comfort on your daily commute or longest journeys.

Quick Specs

  • Experience up to 72 hours of uninterrupted listening with ANC off.
  • Silence the world around you with advanced Active Noise Cancellation.
  • Seamlessly connect to your devices with the latest Bluetooth 5.4 technology.
  • Enjoy all-day comfort with a lightweight, ergonomic design weighing only 263g.
  • Quickly recharge your headphones in under 2 hours via USB Type-C.

Experience Unrivalled Audio Clarity in South Africa

For the discerning listener in South Africa, the Redmi Headphones Neo ANC Wireless Over-Ears offer an escape into pristine audio quality. These over-ear headphones are engineered for those who demand clarity and silence in their daily lives. Whether you are navigating the bustling streets of Cape Town, focusing in a busy office, or simply seeking a moment of auditory peace at home, the Redmi Headphones Neo deliver. They are designed for extended wear, ensuring comfort throughout your longest commutes or flights. This is not merely a device for listening to music; it is a tool for enhancing focus, relaxation, and overall well-being through superior sound isolation and immersive audio. For the individual who values both performance and tranquillity, these over-ear headphones stand as a testament to thoughtful design and advanced technology.

Immersive Sound, Distraction-Free Listening with Bluetooth 5.4

At the core of the Redmi Headphones Neo is its powerful Active Noise Cancellation (ANC) technology. This feature intelligently detects and filters out ambient noise, from the low rumble of an aeroplane engine to the chatter of a crowded café. This allows you to immerse yourself completely in your music, podcasts, or audiobooks, experiencing every nuance without interruption. The effect is profound, transforming noisy environments into personal sanctuaries of sound. This level of immersion is crucial for concentration, relaxation, and simply enjoying your audio content as the artist intended, making these ANC headphones an indispensable companion for modern life.

Unrivalled Comfort for Extended Listening Sessions

Crafted with the user’s comfort as a paramount concern, the Redmi Headphones Neo feature an ergonomic design that distributes weight evenly. The earcups are plush and designed to envelop the ears, providing both comfort and an effective passive seal for sound isolation. Weighing approximately 263g, they are remarkably lightweight for over-ear headphones, reducing fatigue during prolonged use. This attention to detail ensures that whether you are on a long-haul flight or engaged in an all-day work session, your listening experience remains comfortable and enjoyable from start to finish.

Effortless Connectivity and Enduring Power

The integration of Bluetooth 5.4 ensures a stable, low-latency wireless connection to your devices, supporting a range of up to 10 meters. This means you can move freely without worrying about dropouts or stuttering audio. Furthermore, the impressive battery life of approximately 72 hours with ANC off provides weeks of listening on a single charge for most users. When it is time to recharge, the USB Type-C port allows for rapid charging, delivering a full charge in less than 2 hours. This combination of advanced wireless technology and exceptional battery performance guarantees that these Bluetooth 5.4 headphones are always ready when you are.

Transparency Mode: Stay Aware Without Breaking Your Immersion

Understanding the need to balance immersive listening with situational awareness, the Redmi Headphones Neo incorporate a Transparency Mode. With a simple activation, this mode allows external sounds to be heard clearly through the headphones, without needing to remove them. This is invaluable for conversations, listening for announcements in public spaces, or simply staying aware of your surroundings for safety. This thoughtful feature ensures you remain connected to the world when necessary, enhancing the versatility and practicality of these wireless over-ear headphones.

FEATURES:

  • Silence distractions effectively with advanced Active Noise Cancellation technology.
  • Stay connected to your surroundings when needed using the intuitive Transparency Mode.
  • Enjoy an extended listening experience with up to 72 hours of battery life (ANC off).
  • Experience stable, high-quality audio streaming thanks to Bluetooth 5.4 connectivity.
  • Recharge quickly and conveniently with the modern USB Type-C charging port.
  • Listen in comfort for hours on end with the lightweight (263g) and ergonomic design.

SPECIFICATIONS:

  • Battery Capacity: 600mAh
  • Battery Life: Approx. 72h (ANC off)
  • Charging Time: Less than 2 hours
  • Wireless Connectivity: Bluetooth 5.4
  • Bluetooth range: 10m
  • Charging Port: Type-C
  • Colour: Black
  • Headphones Size: 20.2 x 18.3 x 4.7 cm
  • Weight: Approx. 263g

  • User Manual x1

Why Xiaomi?

Xiaomi consistently delivers cutting-edge technology at accessible price points, empowering South Africans with premium audio experiences. The Redmi Headphones Neo embody this commitment, offering advanced features and reliable performance that redefine value in the personal audio market. Trust Xiaomi to bring innovation and quality directly to you.

product.description:
Experience ultra-fast drying and enhanced hair protection with 50 million negative ions, all within a compact, foldable design for effortless travel.

Unleash salon-quality results wherever life takes you

The Xiaomi Compact Hair Dryer H101 is engineered for the modern individual who values both efficiency and hair health, without compromising on portability. Whether you are preparing for an important business meeting, a weekend getaway, or simply seeking a superior drying experience at home, this portable hair dryer delivers. Its compact size and foldable handle make it the quintessential travel companion, fitting easily into any bag. For South Africans on the go, it represents a commitment to maintaining personal style and confidence, ensuring your hair looks impeccable no matter the destination. This is more than just a hairdryer; it's an essential tool for effortless grooming, a true foldable hair dryer designed for your convenience.

Intelligent airflow for superior hair care with negative ion technology

At the core of the H101 lies a potent 20,000rpm high-performance motor, capable of generating an impressive airflow of up to 15m/s. This powerful combination ensures that your hair dries remarkably quickly, significantly reducing heat exposure time. The balanced heating system, featuring conical heating coils, distributes heat evenly across your hair, preventing hot spots that can cause damage. Furthermore, the integrated 50 million negative ions work to neutralise static electricity, tame frizz, and enhance your hair's natural shine, leaving it feeling smoother and looking healthier after each use. This intelligent negative ion hair dryer design prioritises the well-being of your hair while maximising drying efficiency.

Designed for your convenience and safety

Understanding the need for practicality, Xiaomi has equipped the H101 with a smart foldable handle, transforming it from a standard dryer into an ultra-compact unit perfect for storage or travel. Its lightweight construction, weighing only 0.3kg (without nozzle and power cord), further enhances its portability as a foldable hair dryer. For tailored styling, you can select between two distinct air temperature modes and two air flow speed modes, allowing you to achieve your desired look with precision. The inclusion of a cold air function provides a finishing touch, setting your style and adding extra shine. Safety is paramount; therefore, the dryer incorporates robust overheat protection and fuse protection mechanisms, ensuring peace of mind during operation.

Versatile styling, effortless control

Take command of your hairstyle with intuitive controls designed for ease of use. The Xiaomi Compact Hair Dryer H101 offers two distinct air temperature settings, catering to different hair types and styling needs, from gentle warmth to more intense heat for faster drying. Complementing this are two air flow speed settings, allowing you to manage the intensity of the air directed at your hair. The essential cold air function is perfect for locking in your style, reducing heat damage, and adding a final touch of shine and smoothness. Coupled with the 360° rotating double-insulated nozzle, you gain precise control over airflow direction, enabling detailed styling without discomfort or risk of burns. This advanced negative ion hair dryer makes styling a breeze.

product.name: Xiaomi Electric Scooter Fast Charger 2
product.description:
268W Ultra-High Output | Charges 3× Faster | Full Charge in ~3h 20min | ERP Level VI Efficiency | Multiple Safety Protections | For Scooter 6 Max / 6 Ultra

Quick Specs

  • Charge up to three times faster than the standard charger with 268W of output
  • Reach a full 100% charge in as little as 3 hours 20 minutes
  • Gain roughly 30km of range from just 1 hour of charging
  • Protect long-term battery health with a smart segmented charging strategy
  • Charge with confidence thanks to multiple built-in safety protections

268W of Ultra-High Power for Seriously Fast Charging

The Xiaomi Electric Scooter Fast Charger 2 brings 268W of ultra-high power output to riders across South Africa, charging over three times faster than the standard charger. That means a full 100% charge in as little as 3 hours 20 minutes — and with roughly 30km of range from just one hour of charging, you spend far less time waiting and far more time riding.

Smart Segmented Charging That Protects Your Battery

This isn’t only about raw speed. A smart segmented charging strategy uses high-current fast charging to ease range anxiety, then switches to gentle low-current trickle charging once the battery is almost full to keep it safe and healthy. A built-in smart device matching chip enables two-way communication between charger and scooter, creating a dedicated, reliable electric scooter charger. With ERP Level VI energy efficiency and up to 93% output efficiency, it’s as economical as it is quick.

Comprehensive Safety, Built for Your Scooter

Charging safety is covered from every angle, with protection against output overvoltage, output undervoltage, short circuits, over-temperature and overcurrent, backed by thorough thermal decay testing. The Fast Charger 2 is purpose-built for the Xiaomi Electric Scooter 6 Max and 6 Ultra series — and future 7 Series models — equipped with a dedicated fast-charge port, so you get a perfect, dependable match every time.

FEATURES:

  • 268W ultra-high power output for rapid charging
  • Charges over three times faster than the standard charger
  • Full 100% charge in as little as 3 hours 20 minutes
  • Around 30km of range from just 1 hour of charging
  • Smart segmented charging strategy (high-current fast charge, then low-current trickle) to protect battery health
  • Built-in smart device matching chip for two-way charger-to-scooter communication
  • ERP Level VI energy efficiency, up to 93% output efficiency
  • Multiple safety protections, including output overvoltage, output undervoltage, short circuit, over-temperature and overcurrent protection, plus thermal decay testing
  • Compatible with Xiaomi Electric Scooter 6 Max, 6 Ultra and future 7 Series models with a dedicated fast-charge port

SPECIFICATIONS:

  • Name: Battery Charger

  • Max. Output Voltage: 54.6 V ⎓ (no load)

  • Storage Temperature: -30°C to 85°C

product.name: Xiaomi Buds 8 White
product.description:
Immerse yourself in pure sound with up to 50dB noise cancellation and Hi-Res Audio Wireless certification; enjoy up to 44 hours of listening time.

Quick Specs

  • Experience unparalleled silence with up to 50dB active noise cancellation.
  • Enjoy crystal-clear audio with Hi-Res Audio Wireless certification and 11mm drivers.
  • Stay connected for longer with a total playback of up to 44 hours with the charging case.
  • Navigate your audio world with advanced touch controls and smart device switching.
  • Designed for comfort and durability with IP54 water resistance, perfect for active lifestyles.

Silence the world and elevate your audio with Xiaomi Buds 8 ANC Earbuds

These are not merely Bluetooth 5.4 earbuds; they are your personal sanctuary of sound, engineered for the discerning listener in South Africa who demands clarity, immersion, and unwavering performance. Whether you are navigating the bustling streets of Cape Town, seeking focus in a busy office, or simply craving an escape into your favourite music, the Buds 8 deliver an experience that cuts through the noise of everyday life. Designed for those who appreciate superior audio fidelity and intelligent features, these in-ear headphones are built to integrate seamlessly into your dynamic lifestyle, offering a perfect blend of cutting-edge technology and enduring comfort. Prepare to rediscover your audio world with these exceptional hi-res audio earbuds.

Unrivalled immersion with intelligent noise cancellation

Step into a realm of pure audio bliss. The Xiaomi Buds 8 ANC Earbuds feature advanced Active Noise Cancellation (ANC) capable of reducing ambient sound by up to 50dB. This is not a subtle dampening; it is a profound silence that allows you to focus entirely on your audio. The ANC operates across a wide frequency range, up to 4kHz, effectively eliminating distractions from low rumbles to higher-pitched chatter. With three distinct transparency modes, you can effortlessly reconnect with your surroundings when needed, ensuring safety and convenience without removing your earbuds. This adaptive capability makes them the ideal companion for commuting, travel, or simply finding your peace.

A symphony of sound and clarity

Experience audio as the artist intended. Certified with Hi-Res Audio Wireless, these Bluetooth 5.4 earbuds unlock the full potential of high-fidelity sound, delivering richer detail, deeper bass, and clearer highs. The precisely engineered 11mm dynamic driver works in harmony with advanced Bluetooth codecs, including SBC, AAC, and LHDC, to reproduce every note with stunning accuracy. Whether it’s the subtle nuances of a classical composition or the driving beat of your workout playlist, the Xiaomi Buds 8 ensure an audio playback that is both authentic and exhilarating. Triple-Mic AI Noise Reduction further enhances your calls, ensuring your voice is heard clearly even in noisy environments.

Endurance for your longest days

Your soundtrack should not be interrupted. The Xiaomi Buds 8 ANC Earbuds are designed for marathon listening sessions. With ANC switched off, enjoy an astonishing up to 11 hours of playback on a single charge, extending to a total of up to 44 hours with the included charging case. This exceptional battery performance means your earbuds are always ready when you are, from your morning commute to your late-night wind-down. Experience the convenience of dual device connection earbuds, allowing seamless switching between your phone and laptop.

Features

  • Immerse yourself in pure audio with up to 50dB active noise cancellation and three transparency modes for situational awareness.
  • Experience breathtaking sound quality with 11mm dynamic drivers and Hi-Res Audio Wireless certification, supporting LHDC codec.
  • Enjoy uninterrupted listening with a combined battery life of up to 44 hours with ANC off, and up to 28 hours with ANC on.
  • Communicate clearly with triple-mic AI noise reduction and wind noise reduction, ensuring your calls are crisp.
  • Connect seamlessly with Bluetooth 5.4, supporting dual device connection and smart device switching for effortless transitions.
  • Designed for active use with IP54 water resistance, protecting against splashes and dust.
  • Personalise your audio experience with custom EQ settings and adaptive noise cancellation through the Xiaomi Earbuds App.

Specifications

  • Driver Size: 11mm Dynamic Driver
  • Audio Certification: Hi-Res Audio Wireless
  • Noise Cancellation: Up to 50dB Smart ANC
  • ANC Frequency Range: Up to 4kHz
  • Transparency Modes: 3 Levels
  • Microphones: Triple-Mic AI Noise Reduction
  • Wind Noise Reduction: Up to 12m/s
  • Bluetooth Version: Bluetooth 5.4
  • Wireless Range: Up to 10m
  • Water Resistance: IP54 (Earbuds)
  • Battery Life (ANC Off): Up to 11 Hours
  • Total Battery Life (ANC Off): Up to 44 Hours
  • Battery Life (ANC On): Up to 6.5 Hours
  • Total Battery Life (ANC On): Up to 28 Hours
  • Earbud Battery Capacity: 54mAh
  • Charging Case Capacity: 475mAh
  • Charging Port: USB Type-C
  • App Integration: Xiaomi Earbuds App
  • Adaptive Noise Cancellation: Supported
  • Audio Sharing: Supported
  • Dual Device Connection: Supported
  • Smart Device Switching: Supported
  • Custom EQ: Supported
  • Personalised Audio: Supported
  • Touch Controls: Supported

Xiaomi is dedicated to bringing innovative technology and exceptional audio experiences to South Africans. The Buds 8 embody this commitment, offering premium features like advanced ANC and Hi-Res Audio at a value that respects your investment. Trust Xiaomi for reliable performance and sound that moves you.

product.name: Xiaomi Desktop Speaker Pro Set with Wireless Subwoofer
product.description:
Experience rich, immersive audio with a 2.1 channel system, wireless subwoofer, and professional DSP for crystal-clear sound across all your entertainment.

Quick Specs

  • Immerse yourself in a powerful 2.1 channel audio experience with dedicated wireless subwoofer.
  • Enjoy crystal-clear sound with professional DSP processing and dual passive radiators for enhanced bass.
  • Connect seamlessly with Bluetooth 5.3, USB, AUX-In, and a low-latency wireless connection to the subwoofer.
  • Enhance your calls and gaming with a built-in microphone featuring Acoustic Echo Cancellation.
  • Personalise your setup with customizable RGB lighting and six preset effects via Xiaomi C-HUB software.

Unleash a New Dimension of Desktop Audio for the South African User

This Xiaomi Desktop Speaker Pro Set is engineered for those who demand more from their audio experience; it is for the discerning gamer seeking precise positional audio, the music enthusiast craving soundscapes, and the professional needing clear communication. It transcends the ordinary desktop speaker, offering a sophisticated 2.1 channel system that brings your digital world to life with exceptional clarity and depth. This is not merely a sound system; it is an auditory command centre designed to elevate your daily interaction with your computer, transforming routine tasks into immersive experiences. For the South African consumer who values both performance and aesthetics, this speaker set delivers an unparalleled blend of power, precision, and visual flair. The primary keyword, 'wireless subwoofer', is integrated to guide users seeking enhanced bass. This powerful addition is key to the immersive 2.1 channel experience offered by the Xiaomi Desktop Speaker Pro.

Experience Sound Engineered for Clarity and Immersion

At the core of this system lies a meticulously designed 4-driver horizontal sound system, featuring two 10W racetrack drivers for the main speakers and a powerful 96mm long-throw driver within the wireless subwoofer. This configuration is further enhanced by dual passive radiators, pushing the frequency response for bass extension down to an impressive 60Hz. The result is a rich, full-bodied sound that captures the full spectrum of audio, from the subtlest vocal nuances to the deepest basslines. This professional DSP digital audio processor ensures every sound is rendered with astonishing accuracy, creating a truly captivating audio environment for your desk. This entire system functions as a superior desktop sound system, delivering audio quality far beyond conventional setups.

A System Built for the Modern Digital Life

Connectivity is paramount in today's interconnected world, and the Xiaomi Desktop Speaker Pro Set excels in this regard. With the latest Bluetooth 5.3, you can stream your favourite music and podcasts with high fidelity and stable, low-latency connections. The wireless subwoofer connects to the main speakers using a dedicated 2.4GHz low-latency wireless link, eliminating cable clutter and ensuring perfect audio synchronisation. For wired connections, options include USB and AUX-In, providing versatility for all your devices. Furthermore, the integrated high-sensitivity microphone with Acoustic Echo Cancellation (AEC) ensures your voice is heard with pristine clarity during calls and gaming sessions, making this a complete audio solution for any desktop. This makes it an ideal desktop sound system for professionals and gamers alike.

Customise Your Sound and Your Style

This speaker set is as adaptable as your needs. Five distinct EQ modes—Music, Bass, Vocals, Game, and Movie—allow you to tailor the audio output to your specific activity, ensuring optimal sound performance whether you're deep in a gaming campaign or enjoying a cinematic masterpiece. Beyond sound, the system offers dynamic visual customisation with integrated RGB lighting. The main speakers feature 24 LEDs, and the subwoofer adds 5 more, offering six preset lighting effects that can transform the ambiance of your workspace. Control is intuitive, managed via a multifunction control knob and dedicated buttons, with full customisation available through the Xiaomi C-HUB software, allowing you to fine-tune both audio and lighting to your precise preferences. This level of customisation solidifies its status as a premier desktop sound system.

Built for Performance, Designed to Last

The build quality of this speaker set speaks to its performance-oriented design. The main speakers boast a durable metal grille and are ergonomically angled at 53° to direct sound precisely towards the listener. Anti-slip feet ensure stability on any surface. The system is powered by a robust 12V input for both the main speakers and the subwoofer, indicating a capacity for sustained high-level audio output. This robust construction, combined with professional-grade components and advanced audio processing, guarantees a long-lasting, high-fidelity audio experience for years to come. It is a truly exceptional wireless subwoofer setup that enhances any desktop audio needs.

Features

  • Experience immersive 2.1 channel sound, driven by a powerful wireless subwoofer for deep, resonant bass.
  • Achieve unparalleled audio clarity with a professional DSP digital audio processor and dual passive radiators.
  • Enjoy seamless wireless audio streaming with Bluetooth 5.3 and a dedicated low-latency 2.4GHz connection to the subwoofer.
  • Enhance your communication with a built-in high-sensitivity microphone featuring Acoustic Echo Cancellation for crystal-clear voice pickup.

AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D2: Apex Processor for South African Gamers and Power Users

For the discerning South African gamer and power user, the AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D2 processor represents the apex of desktop computing. This is not merely a component; it is the engine for those who demand the absolute best in both gaming fidelity and raw processing power. It is engineered for the enthusiast who understands that victory is often decided by milliseconds and who requires their system to keep pace with their ambition. Whether you are dominating the virtual battlefield or rendering complex creative projects, this AMD CPU is built to deliver an uncompromising experience. It transcends the ordinary, offering a performance tier that redefines what is possible in a desktop system. When your demands exceed the capabilities of lesser hardware, the Ryzen 9 9950X3D2 stands ready to meet and exceed them.

Unrivalled Gaming Performance: The Ryzen 9 Processor Advantage

At the core of the 9950X3D2's superiority lies AMD's revolutionary 3D V-Cache™ technology. This innovation dramatically increases the L3 cache, providing more data to the CPU cores at significantly higher speeds. For gamers, this translates directly into higher frame rates, smoother gameplay, and an overall more immersive experience, especially in cache-sensitive titles. Paired with a base clock of 4.3GHz and a maximum boost clock of up to 5.6GHz, this Ryzen 9 processor ensures that every frame is rendered with exceptional speed and precision, making it the ultimate weapon for competitive gaming.

Powering Productivity: 16 Cores, 32 Threads of the Ryzen 9 9950X3D2

Beyond its gaming prowess, the Ryzen 9 9950X3D2 is a productivity powerhouse. With 16 cores and 32 threads, it effortlessly handles the most demanding multitasking scenarios. Content creators, developers, and professionals will appreciate the sheer computational muscle available for tasks such as video editing, 3D rendering, compiling code, and running virtual machines. The efficient 4nm process technology for CPU cores and 6nm for the I/O die ensures that this immense power is delivered with remarkable efficiency, managing a default TDP of 200W, a hallmark of advanced AMD CPU design.

A Foundation for the Future: The AM5 Platform for your AMD CPU

Built on the modern AM5 socket, this AMD CPU leverages the latest advancements in desktop computing. It supports dual-channel DDR5 memory, offering significantly higher bandwidth and faster speeds compared to previous generations. This enhanced memory architecture complements the CPU's capabilities, ensuring that data is delivered quickly and efficiently. The AM5 platform also provides future-proofing with support for a wide range of chipsets and technologies, including NVMe support for ultra-fast storage and compatibility with modern operating systems like Windows 11 and various Linux distributions, all powered by the robust Ryzen 9 9950X3D2.

Precision Control: Maximise your Ryzen 9 9950X3D2

The Ryzen 9 9950X3D2 is unlocked for overclocking, offering enthusiasts the opportunity to push performance even further. AMD's Precision Boost 2 technology intelligently boosts clock speeds based on workload and thermal conditions, ensuring optimal performance out-of-the-box. Furthermore, features like Curve Optimizer voltage offsets and AMD EXPO™ memory overclocking technology provide granular control for fine-tuning your system. With full support for AMD Ryzen™ Master software, you have the tools to monitor, manage, and maximise your processor's potential, ensuring your AMD CPU performs at its peak.

With a GPU clearance of up to 410mm and support for PSUs up to 210mm, the CG590 Mesh 2F accommodates today's largest graphics cards without compromise. A removable drive cage adds further flexibility, while 45mm of cable management clearance keeps the interior tidy behind the right side panel.

Flexible Cooling for Air and Liquid Builds

Whether you are running an all-air configuration or planning a custom liquid cooling loop, the CG590 Mesh 2F has you covered. It supports 360mm radiators at the top, side, and bottom — giving you genuine freedom in how you route your cooling. The top accepts radiators from 120mm up to 360 mm, while the side and bottom each support up to 360mm as well. A rear 120mm radiator position rounds out the options. In full air-cooling mode, the chassis can house fans across the top, front, side, rear, and bottom positions.

Broad Hardware Compatibility and Practical Details

The spacious interior supports Mini-ITX, Micro-ATX, and ATX motherboards — including ATX and Micro-ATX boards with rear connectors — giving you flexibility across current and future platform choices. Seven PCIe expansion slots, storage for up to two 3.5-inch HDDs and three 2.5-inch SSDs, and a quick-release top panel round out a chassis that is as practical to build in as it is rewarding to own. The tempered glass side panel puts your build on display, while the front I/O provides two USB 3.0 ports, a Gen2 Type-C port, and HD Audio for everyday convenience.

The dedicated Intel® AI Boost NPU delivers 13 TOPS of AI performance, accelerating machine learning tasks directly on the processor. This means faster AI-powered features in creative software, improved efficiency in data analysis, and a glimpse into the future of AI-driven computing. Complementing this is the integrated Intel® Graphics, featuring 4 Xe-cores and a dynamic frequency of up to 1.9 GHz. This allows for competent graphical performance for everyday tasks, media consumption, and even light gaming, reducing the need for a discrete graphics card in certain builds and offering a streamlined, cost-effective solution.

Built for the future of connectivity and memory with Intel CPUs

To complement its processing prowess, the Core Ultra 5 250K is equipped with the latest connectivity standards and memory support. It features PCI Express 5.0, offering twice the bandwidth of PCIe 4.0, which is crucial for the fastest SSDs and future high-performance peripherals. Support for up to DDR5 7200 MT/s memory ensures that your system can access data at incredible speeds, significantly boosting application load times and overall system responsiveness. With Intel® Thunderbolt™ 4 support and Wi-Fi 6 readiness, you are assured of fast, reliable connections for all your peripherals and networking needs, making this Intel CPU a truly forward-thinking choice for any high-end desktop build in South Africa.

Empowering your workflow with enhanced security and manageability

The Intel Core Ultra 5 250K is built with enterprise-grade features, making it suitable not only for personal use but also for professional environments that require robust security and manageability. Technologies such as Intel® vPro® Enterprise, Intel® Threat Detection Technology, and Intel® Control-Flow Enforcement Technology provide a secure computing foundation. These features offer enhanced protection against threats, improved system stability, and streamlined management capabilities for IT administrators, ensuring peace of mind and efficient operation for businesses of all sizes. This commitment to security and manageability underscores Intel's dedication to providing comprehensive solutions for its users.

Your Living Room, Transformed into a Private Cinema

The Wanbo Vali 1 Pro is a Full HD smart projector designed for the modern South African home — one device that replaces your TV, streaming stick, and speaker system all at once. Powered by Google TV on Android 14 with official Netflix certification built in, it gives you instant access to 10,000+ apps from the Google Play Store on a screen that can stretch all the way to 260 inches. Whether you're hosting a movie night, gaming with friends, or enjoying a late-night series from the ceiling, the Vali 1 Pro delivers the picture and sound to match.

Stunning Visuals, From Every Detail to the Biggest Scene

At 900 ANSI Lumens and a 3000:1 contrast ratio, the Vali 1 Pro produces vivid, well-defined images even in a darkened room. HDR10 support brings out true-to-life colour across every scene — deep shadows stay rich, bright highlights stay crisp. And with MEMC (Motion Estimation, Motion Compensation) technology built in, fast-paced sport, racing, and action content stays silky-smooth — no blur, no stutter, just every detail exactly as it should be.

Tired of Fiddling with Projector Setup?

The Vali 1 Pro's ASA 3.0 intelligent system does it all for you. The moment you power it on, auto focus sharpens the image, auto keystone correction squares up the picture, auto screen fit adapts to your surface, and obstacle avoidance detects anything in the way. The result is a perfectly aligned, rectangular image in seconds — no manual adjustments, no frustration. The 200° adjustable gimbal lets you tilt from table to ceiling with one hand, so you're truly free to watch from wherever suits you best.

Cinematic Sound and Smart Connectivity, Built Right In

Dolby Audio through a 12W full-range speaker and a 500cc sound chamber fills the room with rich, immersive sound — dialogue is clear, and the low end has genuine weight, all without needing an external speaker. The MT9660 quad-core chip with 2GB RAM and 32GB storage keeps apps launching quickly and multitasking smooth. Connect your console or PC through HDMI 2.1 with 4K signal input support, add peripherals via USB, or plug headphones or a soundbar into the 3.5mm AUX port. Dual-band Wi-Fi and Bluetooth 5.0 keep streaming stable, while Google Cast and built-in Google Assistant via "Hey Google" voice control round out one of the most complete smart projector packages available.

product.name: UGREEN USB Type-C to DisplayPort 1.4 Cable 2m
product.description:
Experience seamless, high-fidelity visual output from your USB Type-C device to any DisplayPort monitor or display | Enjoy fluid gaming and true-to-life colours with 8K HDR support.

Quick Specs

  • Deliver stunning 8K resolution at 60Hz for unparalleled visual clarity.
  • Experience ultra-smooth motion with support for 4K at 144Hz and 240Hz.
  • Enjoy vibrant colours and enhanced contrast with HDR support.

Unlock the full visual potential of your modern devices with the UGREEN USB Type-C to DisplayPort 1.4 Cable.

This 2-meter USB Type-C to DisplayPort cable is your essential conduit for high-fidelity visual data, designed for users in South Africa who demand uncompromising clarity and performance. Whether you are a creative professional, a gamer seeking an edge, or a home user desiring an immersive cinematic experience, this DisplayPort 1.4 cable ensures your content is displayed with absolute accuracy. It expertly bridges the gap between USB Type-C enabled devices and DisplayPort monitors or televisions. For those who understand that a superior viewing experience begins with a superior connection, this cable is indispensable. This premium USB Type-C to DisplayPort connection supports the latest standards, making it ideal for demanding applications. Experience the difference a quality DisplayPort cable can make.

Engineered for breathtaking visual fidelity with DisplayPort 1.4.

At its core, this UGREEN cable supports DisplayPort 1.4 standards, enabling a maximum bandwidth of 32.4 Gbps. This substantial throughput makes achieving resolutions as high as 8K (7680 × 4320) at a smooth 60Hz, or a stunning 4K at an exceptional 240Hz, possible. This isn't an approximation of high-definition; it is the delivery of true 8K and high-refresh-rate 4K content with absolute precision. The inclusion of HDR support means that colours are more vibrant, contrast is deeper, and the overall image is more lifelike. This level of detail and colour accuracy is critical for professionals and enthusiasts alike, solidifying its status as a top-tier DisplayPort cable.

Elevate your gaming and multimedia experience with this DisplayPort cable.

For the gamer, the benefits of this USB Type-C to DisplayPort 1.4 cable are profound. Support for Variable Refresh Rate (VRR) and Auto Low Latency Mode (ALLM) synchronises your display's refresh rate with your graphics card's output, virtually eliminating screen tearing and input lag. This translates to smoother gameplay, more responsive controls, and a distinctly competitive advantage. Furthermore, AMD FreeSync and NVIDIA G-Sync compatibility ensure that this cable works seamlessly with leading adaptive-sync technologies, making it an indispensable part of any high-performance gaming setup. The ability to drive 4K content at up to 240Hz means that even the fastest-paced games will appear astonishingly fluid. This is the DisplayPort connection you need for peak performance.

Versatile connectivity for every setup using USB Type-C to DisplayPort.

Beyond gaming, this UGREEN USB Type-C to DisplayPort cable offers exceptional versatility for productivity and entertainment. It supports HDCP 2.3 for secure content playback, ensuring compatibility with the latest streaming services and Blu-ray discs. The inclusion of eARC support further enhances its multimedia capabilities, allowing for high-quality audio passthrough. Whether you need to extend your laptop display for multitasking, mirror your screen for presentations, or leverage advanced modes like Samsung DeX or MacBook Clamshell mode, this cable provides the reliable connection you need. MST (Multi-Stream Transport) support also allows for daisy-chaining multiple compatible displays, expanding your workspace efficiently with this robust DisplayPort 1.4 cable.

Features

  • Achieve ultra-smooth gameplay and motion with 4K resolution at up to 240Hz, powered by the DisplayPort 1.4 standard.
  • Enjoy lifelike colours and dynamic contrast with High Dynamic Range (HDR) support on your connected display.
  • Eliminate screen tearing and input lag with support for VRR, ALLM, AMD FreeSync, and NVIDIA G-Sync, ensuring a superior gaming experience.
  • Connect securely to protected content with HDCP 2.3 compliance, ideal for streaming and media consumption.
  • Benefit from enhanced audio return with eARC support for a richer sound experience through your DisplayPort connection.
  • Expand your workspace with MST daisy-chaining capability for multiple monitors using this versatile USB Type-C to DisplayPort cable.
  • Enjoy robust build quality featuring braided nylon and aluminium alloy construction for enhanced durability and a premium feel.

The Seagate EXOS X24 12TB Hard Disk Drive is engineered for the rigorous demands of enterprise-level data management within the South African market. Whether you are managing vast databases, critical server environments, or high-volume data analytics, this hard disk drive is built to exceed expectations. It delivers the speed necessary for seamless data access and the capacity to house your organisation’s most vital information, ensuring that your operations run without interruption and your data is always at your fingertips.

Engineered for Continuous Operation and Data Integrity

In the fast-paced digital landscape of South Africa, downtime is not an option. The Seagate EXOS X24 hard disk drive is built for relentless, 24/7 operation, boasting a Mean Time Between Failures (MTBF) rating of 2,500,000 hours and a strict reliability rating of 0.35% Annualised Failure Rate (AFR) under full operational load. This ensures that your business-critical applications and data remain accessible. Furthermore, with a non-recoverable read error rate of just 1 sector per 10E15, you can trust in the integrity of your stored information, making it the ideal choice for data centres, cloud storage, and enterprise applications where data accuracy is paramount.

product.name: DeepCool ASSASSIN VC ELITE CPU Air Cooler - White
product.description:
Experience superior cooling performance and quiet operation for your demanding PC build | Crafted for stability and efficiency with dual fans.

Quick Specs

  • Achieve optimal thermal management with seven Ø6 mm heatpipes for efficient heat transfer.
  • Benefit from versatile cooling with dual 140mm and 120mm PWM fans, adjustable for performance or quiet operation.
  • Maintain a serene computing environment with noise levels as low as 22.6 dB(A) in quiet mode.
  • Ensure broad compatibility with standard PC mounting systems and dimensions.
  • Enjoy enhanced durability and longevity with fluid dynamic bearing fans.

Engineered for enthusiasts and gamers in South Africa seeking peak processor performance

The DeepCool Assassin VC Elite CPU Air Cooler is designed for the discerning PC builder who understands that optimal performance hinges on effective thermal management. This cooler is not merely an accessory; it is a critical component that allows your processor to operate at its full potential without the detrimental effects of overheating. Whether you are pushing the limits in demanding gaming sessions, rendering complex creative projects, or running intensive simulations, the Assassin VC Elite ensures your CPU remains cool, stable, and ready for action. Its robust construction and intelligent design cater to those who demand reliability and efficiency from their hardware. This DeepCool CPU cooler is built to last.

Unrivalled cooling power for your high-performance system

At the core of the Assassin VC Elite's capability lies its advanced heat dissipation system. Seven precisely engineered Ø6 mm copper heatpipes work in unison to draw heat away from your CPU's surface with remarkable speed. These heatpipes are arranged optimally within the heatsink's fin stack, creating a large surface area for efficient heat exchange. This configuration ensures that even under sustained heavy loads, your processor's temperature remains within safe and optimal operating parameters, preventing thermal throttling and maintaining consistent system performance. The white finish ensures it complements your unique build aesthetically, making it a standout among pc air cooling solutions.

Intelligent airflow management for quiet operation

The DeepCool Assassin VC Elite features a dual-fan setup, comprising a 140mm fan and a 120mm fan. These fans are not only powerful but also intelligently designed for both performance and acoustics. With Fluid Dynamic Bearings and a 6-pole motor, they offer exceptional durability and smooth operation. The included controller allows for selection between a Performance Mode, prioritising maximum airflow and cooling, and a Quiet Mode, which significantly reduces fan speed and noise to a barely audible level (as low as 22.6 dB(A)). This adaptability means you can tailor the cooling to your immediate needs, whether for intense gaming or focused work. It truly is a remarkable DeepCool CPU cooler.

Seamless integration into your build

Understanding the importance of compatibility, the DeepCool Assassin VC Elite has been designed with standard PC dimensions and mounting systems in mind. Its heatsink measures 12 x 6 x 15.5 cm, and the overall product dimensions are 14.4 x 14.7 x 16 cm, ensuring it fits within a wide range of mid-tower and larger PC cases. The 4-pin PWM fan connectors allow for precise speed control via your motherboard, enabling dynamic adjustments based on CPU temperature. This thoughtful engineering ensures that integrating this powerful cooler into your existing or new build is a straightforward process, minimising potential complications and maximising your system's potential. Embrace efficient pc air cooling with this exceptional unit.

Built for longevity and consistent results

The commitment to quality is evident in every aspect of the Assassin VC Elite. The use of Fluid Dynamic Bearings in the fans is a testament to this dedication, providing a significantly longer lifespan compared to conventional bearings, along with quieter operation. This means your investment in superior cooling will yield reliable results for years to come. The robust construction and high-quality materials used throughout the cooler underscore its durability, making it a dependable choice for any PC enthusiast who values performance and longevity. This is the standard for CPU air coolers.

FEATURES:

  • Maintain peak processor performance by efficiently dissipating heat with seven Ø6 mm copper heatpipes, a hallmark of advanced CPU air coolers.
  • Enjoy a quieter computing experience with two PWM fans offering adjustable performance and quiet modes, operating as low as 22.6 dB(A).
  • Benefit from long-lasting reliability and smoother operation thanks to the fluid dynamic bearing and 6-pole motor in the fans, a signature of DeepCool CPU cooler engineering.
  • Adapt your cooling strategy with two fan sizes (140mm and 120mm) and selectable modes to suit your needs for optimal pc air cooling.
  • Ensure broad compatibility with your PC case and motherboard using standard mounting dimensions and PWM connectors.

  • Bearing Type: Fluid Dynamic Bearing

  • Power Consumption(Quiet Mode): 3.6 W

product.name: ASRock Challenger Pure 360 AIO Liquid Cooler - Black
product.description:
Serious 360mm liquid cooling | 0dB silent operation | Precision copper cold plate | Broad platform compatibility | 6-year warranty

Quick Specs

  • Dominate thermals with a triple-fan 360mm radiator delivering serious heat dissipation for demanding CPUs
  • Experience near-silence with 0dB Silent Cooling Technology — fans stop completely under low loads
  • Achieve superior heat transfer through a precision-machined copper cold plate and dual-side inlet cooling path
  • Connect to a wide range of platforms including AMD AM5, AM4 and Intel LGA1851, LGA1700
  • Build with confidence backed by a 6-year warranty and IIR+EPDM braided tubing built to last

Pure Performance, Zero Compromise

The ASRock Challenger Pure 360 AIO Liquid Cooler is built for gamers and builders who want maximum CPU cooling without the visual clutter of RGB lighting. A unified all-black design across the water block, aluminium radiator, and three 120mm fans delivers a bold yet understated presence that fits naturally into any clean, performance-focused build. It's the AIO for those who let temperatures — not LEDs — do the talking.

A Pump Engineered for Unwavering Flow

Tired of budget AIOs that throttle under sustained load? The Challenger Pure 360 runs a 3-phase, 6-slot, 4-pole pump built with automotive-grade components, spinning between 1200 and 3200 RPM. Its dual-side inlet cooling path delivers coolant directly to the CPU hot spot from multiple directions, shortening flow distance and evening out temperatures across the high-density micro-fin array. A precision-machined copper cold plate ensures flawless surface contact for efficient heat transfer session after session.

Quiet When You Need It, Powerful When It Counts

The three Ring-Frame Blade fans spin up to 1800 RPM, generating up to 53.9 CFM of airflow and 2.2 mmH2O of static pressure to push heat deep through the aluminium radiator. When the workload drops, 0dB Silent Cooling Technology kicks in — the fans stop entirely, giving you absolute silence and extending fan lifespan at the same time. At full tilt, noise peaks at just 27 dB(A), keeping your workspace calm even under pressure.

Built to Install Cleanly and Last

The Challenger Pure 360 ships with its three fans pre-installed and cables neatly routed for a clutter-free build from the outset. IIR+EPDM tubing resists coolant evaporation and deformation, wrapped in a braided sleeve for durability and a high-end finish. Multifunctional tube clips keep tubing tidy and secure, while a universal bracket with minimal installation steps covers AMD AM5 and AM4 as well as Intel LGA1851 and LGA1700. ASRock Therm-X1 thermal grease is included for efficient heat transfer right out of the box. The entire AIO module is backed by a 6-year warranty.

  • 360mm aluminium radiator with three pre-installed 120mm PWM fans for high-capacity heat dissipation
  • 3-phase, 6-slot, 4-pole pump (1200–3200 RPM) with dual-side inlet cooling path for balanced coolant distribution
  • Precision-machined copper cold plate maximises surface contact and thermal conductivity
  • Ring-Frame Blade fan design generates up to 53.9 CFM airflow and 2.2 mmH2O static pressure
  • 0dB Silent Cooling Technology — fans stop completely under low load for silence and extended lifespan
  • Fans operate at up to 1800 RPM with a maximum noise level of 27 dB(A)
  • IIR+EPDM braided tubing (450mm) resists coolant evaporation and deformation
  • Compatible with AMD AM5, AM4 and Intel LGA1851, LGA1700 via universal bracket
  • Includes ASRock Therm-X1 thermal grease for high-conductivity heat transfer
  • Sleek all-black minimalist design — no RGB lighting
  • 6-year warranty on the AIO cooler module

Experience visual perfection with QD-OLED technology

At the core of the PA32UCDM lies its revolutionary QD-OLED panel. This cutting-edge technology delivers true blacks, infinite contrast, and vibrant, P3 colour spectrums with unparalleled efficiency. Unlike traditional panels, QD-OLED pixels emit their own light, allowing for instantaneous pixel response times and eliminating the halo effects or blooming sometimes seen in other display technologies. This translates to images with breathtaking depth, clarity, and colour fidelity that must be seen to be believed. The anti-reflection surface further ensures that your viewing experience is not compromised by ambient light, maintaining pristine image quality in any environment. This Asus OLED monitor redefines visual standards.

Colour accuracy and calibration: The ProArt promise

Precision is paramount in professional creative work. The Asus PA32UCDM ProArt Display boasts an astounding colour accuracy of △E< 1, meaning the colours you see are true to life with minimal deviation. This is supported by comprehensive colour space coverage, including 100% sRGB and 99% DCI-P3, ensuring your work translates perfectly across different platforms and devices. For those who require absolute control, the monitor supports ASUS ProArt Hardware Calibration, allowing for precise, on-device calibration to maintain peak accuracy over time. With multiple colour presets, gamma adjustments, and ASUS OLED Care features to prevent burn-in, this monitor is a reliable and consistent partner for all your colour-critical tasks. This Asus OLED monitor delivers unparalleled fidelity.

Speed and responsiveness for demanding workflows

In the fast-paced world of content creation, every millisecond counts. The Asus PA32UCDM delivers exceptional performance with a rapid 0.1 ms GTG response time and a native 240Hz refresh rate. This combination ensures that motion blur is virtually eliminated, providing incredibly smooth visuals whether you are editing fast-paced video footage, navigating complex timelines, or engaging in high-fidelity gaming. Variable Refresh Rate (VRR) support further enhances the viewing experience by synchronising the display's refresh rate with your graphics card, preventing screen tearing and stuttering. This Asus 240Hz monitor is built to keep pace with your most demanding creative and entertainment needs.

Intelligent connectivity and user-centric design

The PA32UCDM is designed with the professional workflow in mind. Its ultra-slim bezel design maximises screen real estate, making it ideal for multi-monitor setups or simply providing a more immersive viewing experience. Connectivity is robust, featuring USB-C with 96W Power Delivery, allowing you to charge your laptop or other devices directly from the monitor, simplifying your desk setup. Additional USB 3.2 ports ensure easy connection of peripherals. Ergonomic adjustments, including tilt, pivot, and height adjustment, along with VESA mount compatibility, allow you to position the monitor perfectly for comfort during long working sessions. An ambient light sensor and proximity sensor add further intelligence, optimising settings automatically and conserving power when you step away.
