product.name: Xiaomi Mesh System AX3000 NE Whole-Home Wi-Fi 6 Router (3-Pack) – White
product.description:
Eliminate dead zones and experience uninterrupted, high-speed Wi-Fi 6 throughout your entire home with a 3-pack mesh system, seamless roaming, and AX3000 speeds.

Quick Specs

  • Eliminate Wi-Fi dead zones with a 3-unit mesh system for a wider more consistent whole-home coverage.
  • Experience blazing-fast Wi-Fi 6 speeds up to 3000Mbps for all your devices.
  • Enjoy seamless roaming as you move through your home without connection drops.
  • Connect more devices simultaneously thanks to advanced OFDMA technology.
  • Set up your entire mesh network effortlessly with the user-friendly Xiaomi Home app.

Unite your home with unwavering Wi-Fi 6

In today's connected world, a single router often struggles to reach every corner of your home. The included three mesh units work together to create a seamless Wi-Fi network that extends coverage throughout larger homes and multi-room environments. The Xiaomi Mesh System AX3000 NE is engineered to solve this, providing a unified, high-performance Wi-Fi 6 network that blankets your entire living space. This isn't merely an upgrade; it's a transformation of your digital experience, ensuring that from the furthest bedroom to the busiest home office, you have the stable, high-speed connection you demand. It is designed for the modern South African household that relies on seamless connectivity for work, entertainment, and everyday life. For those who value uninterrupted streaming, lag-free gaming, and reliable video calls, this whole home Wi-Fi system is the definitive solution.

Experience the power of AX3000 Wi-Fi 6

The AX3000 rating signifies a combined theoretical wireless speed of up to 3000Mbps, delivered across both the 2.4GHz and 5GHz bands. This dual-band capability ensures optimal performance for a wide array of devices. The 5GHz band, reaching up to 2402Mbps with a 160MHz channel width, is ideal for bandwidth-intensive tasks like 4K streaming and online gaming. The 2.4GHz band, offering speeds up to 574Mbps, provides broader coverage and better penetration through walls, ensuring even distant devices maintain a stable connection. This intelligent speed distribution ensures that your network resources are used efficiently, providing a responsive experience for every user and every application on this dual band mesh Wi-Fi.

Seamless roaming, total freedom

Forget the frustration of dropped connections as you move between rooms. The three included mesh units employ sophisticated seamless roaming technology, allowing your devices to automatically connect to the strongest signal source without interruption. This means your video calls remain clear, your music doesn't skip, and your online games stay active as you transition throughout your home. This feature is crucial for maintaining productivity and enjoyment, creating a truly unified network experience where the only thing that changes is your location, not your connection quality. It’s the freedom to move and stay connected.

Intelligent networking for a demanding world

Beyond raw speed, the AX3000 NE integrates advanced Wi-Fi 6 technologies designed to enhance network efficiency and capacity. OFDMA (Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiple Access) allows the router to communicate with multiple devices simultaneously on the same channel, significantly reducing latency and improving overall network performance, especially in environments with many connected devices. Beamforming technology focuses the Wi-Fi signal directly towards your connected devices, strengthening the connection and improving range. BSS Colouring further optimises performance by reducing interference between neighbouring networks, ensuring a cleaner signal for your devices.

Effortless setup and management

Setting up a comprehensive mesh network has never been simpler. The Xiaomi Mesh System AX3000 NE is designed for intuitive installation. Simply connect the primary router to your modem, power it on, and let the Xiaomi Home app guide you through the rest of the process. Adding additional compatible mesh nodes is equally straightforward, ensuring your entire home is covered in minutes. Through the Xiaomi Home app, you gain full control over your network, including parental controls, guest network management, and QoS settings, all from your smartphone. Remote network management capabilities mean you can monitor and adjust your network from anywhere, providing peace of mind and complete control.

Features

  • Achieve expanded whole-home coverage with three mesh units working together to eliminate Wi-Fi dead zones.
  • Experience lightning-fast internet speeds with Wi-Fi 6 AX3000, supporting up to 3000Mbps for all your streaming, gaming, and browsing needs.
  • Enjoy uninterrupted connectivity as you move around your home, thanks to seamless roaming between mesh nodes.
  • Connect a greater number of devices simultaneously and efficiently with advanced OFDMA technology.
  • Benefit from enhanced signal strength and range through intelligent Beamforming technology.
  • Reduce network congestion and interference from neighbouring networks with BSS Colouring.
  • Streamline your setup process with the user-friendly Xiaomi Home app for easy configuration and management.
  • Secure your network with advanced WPA3-SAE encryption for robust protection against unauthorized access.
  • Enjoy accelerated online gaming experiences with built-in game acceleration features.
  • Simplify network management with remote access and control via the Xiaomi Home app.

Specifications

  • Wi-Fi Standard: IEEE 802.11a/b/g/n/ac/ax
  • Network Standards: IEEE 802.3 / 802.3u / 802.3ab

product.name: Xiaomi Mesh System AX3000 NE Whole-Home Wi-Fi 6 Router (1-Pack) – White
product.description:
Eliminate dead zones and experience uninterrupted, high-speed Wi-Fi 6 throughout your entire home with seamless roaming and AX3000 speeds.

Quick Specs

  • Eliminate Wi-Fi dead zones with powerful mesh technology for consistent coverage.
  • Experience blazing-fast Wi-Fi 6 speeds up to 3000Mbps for all your devices.
  • Enjoy seamless roaming as you move through your home without connection drops.
  • Connect more devices simultaneously thanks to advanced OFDMA technology.
  • Set up your entire mesh network effortlessly with the user-friendly Xiaomi Home app.

Unite your home with unwavering Wi-Fi 6

In today's connected world, a single router often struggles to reach every corner of your home. The Xiaomi Mesh System AX3000 NE is engineered to solve this, providing a unified, high-performance Wi-Fi 6 network that blankets your entire living space. This isn't merely an upgrade; it's a transformation of your digital experience, ensuring that from the furthest bedroom to the busiest home office, you have the stable, high-speed connection you demand. It is designed for the modern South African household that relies on seamless connectivity for work, entertainment, and everyday life. For those who value uninterrupted streaming, lag-free gaming, and reliable video calls, this whole home Wi-Fi system is the definitive solution.

Experience the power of AX3000 Wi-Fi 6

The AX3000 rating signifies a combined theoretical wireless speed of up to 3000Mbps, delivered across both the 2.4GHz and 5GHz bands. This dual-band capability ensures optimal performance for a wide array of devices. The 5GHz band, reaching up to 2402Mbps with a 160MHz channel width, is ideal for bandwidth-intensive tasks like 4K streaming and online gaming. The 2.4GHz band, offering speeds up to 574Mbps, provides broader coverage and better penetration through walls, ensuring even distant devices maintain a stable connection. This intelligent speed distribution ensures that your network resources are used efficiently, providing a responsive experience for every user and every application on this dual band mesh Wi-Fi.

Seamless roaming, total freedom

Forget the frustration of dropped connections as you move between rooms. The Xiaomi Mesh System employs sophisticated seamless roaming technology, allowing your devices to automatically connect to the strongest signal source without interruption. This means your video calls remain clear, your music doesn't skip, and your online games stay active as you transition throughout your home. This feature is crucial for maintaining productivity and enjoyment, creating a truly unified network experience where the only thing that changes is your location, not your connection quality. It’s the freedom to move and stay connected.

Intelligent networking for a demanding world

Beyond raw speed, the AX3000 NE integrates advanced Wi-Fi 6 technologies designed to enhance network efficiency and capacity. OFDMA (Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiple Access) allows the router to communicate with multiple devices simultaneously on the same channel, significantly reducing latency and improving overall network performance, especially in environments with many connected devices. Beamforming technology focuses the Wi-Fi signal directly towards your connected devices, strengthening the connection and improving range. BSS Colouring further optimises performance by reducing interference between neighbouring networks, ensuring a cleaner signal for your devices.

Effortless setup and management

Setting up a comprehensive mesh network has never been simpler. The Xiaomi Mesh System AX3000 NE is designed for intuitive installation. Simply connect the primary router to your modem, power it on, and let the Xiaomi Home app guide you through the rest of the process. Adding additional compatible mesh nodes is equally straightforward, ensuring your entire home is covered in minutes. Through the Xiaomi Home app, you gain full control over your network, including parental controls, guest network management, and QoS settings, all from your smartphone. Remote network management capabilities mean you can monitor and adjust your network from anywhere, providing peace of mind and complete control.

Features

  • Achieve comprehensive whole-home coverage, eliminating Wi-Fi dead zones with robust mesh technology for your whole home Wi-Fi.
  • Experience lightning-fast internet speeds with Wi-Fi 6 AX3000, supporting up to 3000Mbps for all your streaming, gaming, and browsing needs.
  • Enjoy uninterrupted connectivity as you move around your home, thanks to seamless roaming between mesh nodes.
  • Connect a greater number of devices simultaneously and efficiently with advanced OFDMA technology.
  • Benefit from enhanced signal strength and range through intelligent Beamforming technology.
  • Reduce network congestion and interference from neighbouring networks with BSS Colouring.
  • Streamline your setup process with the user-friendly Xiaomi Home app for easy configuration and management.
  • Secure your network with advanced WPA3-SAE encryption for robust protection against unauthorized access.
  • Enjoy accelerated online gaming experiences with built-in game acceleration features.
  • Simplify network management with remote access and control via the Xiaomi Home app.

Beyond its toughness, the A16 features advanced cooling systems to maintain optimal temperatures during extended gaming sessions, preventing performance throttling and ensuring consistent power delivery. The thoughtful design extends to its connectivity, with ample ports and the latest wireless technologies to keep you seamlessly connected.

Your gateway to immersive audio and seamless connectivity

Experience sound like never before with AI noise-canceling technology and Dolby Atmos support, delivering rich, immersive audio that pulls you into the game. Whether you are coordinating with your team or enjoying the ambient sounds of a virtual world, the 2-speaker system ensures crystal-clear audio. Connectivity is paramount, and the A16 excels with Wi-Fi 6E for blazing-fast wireless speeds and minimal latency, alongside Bluetooth® 5.4. The 1080P FHD IR camera with Windows Hello provides secure and convenient login, while the 1TB PCIe® 4.0 NVMe™ M.2 SSD ensures rapid system boot-ups and game loading times. This is the ultimate gaming laptop for the discerning South African player seeking the best gaming laptop experience.

Flagship Power for Serious Gamers

The ASUS ROG Strix SCAR 18 is built for gamers and creators across South Africa who refuse to compromise. At its heart is the Intel® Core™ Ultra 9 290HX processor — 24 cores boosting up to 5.5 GHz — paired with the formidable NVIDIA® GeForce RTX™ 5090 Laptop GPU running at up to 175W via ROG Boost. With a MUX Switch and NVIDIA Advanced Optimus, plus a 13 TOPS Intel AI Boost NPU, it delivers desktop-class performance for the most demanding games and workloads.

A Breathtaking 18" 4K Mini LED Display

Visuals are every bit as serious as the silicon. The 18-inch ROG Nebula HDR display uses Mini LED technology for a dazzling 1600 nits peak brightness, a 100,000:1 contrast ratio and 100% DCI-P3 colour. A 4K (3840 × 2400) 16:10 panel runs at a blistering 240Hz with G-Sync, Dolby Vision HDR and a Pantone-validated, anti-glare low-reflection finish — so everything from fast-paced shooters to colour-critical creative work looks superb.

Memory, Storage and Room to Grow

This SCAR ships with 32GB of fast DDR5-6400 memory across two SO-DIMM slots and a speedy 2TB PCIe® 4.0 NVMe™ SSD. Thanks to dual SO-DIMM slots (expandable to 128GB) and dual M.2 slots, there’s plenty of headroom to upgrade memory and storage down the line, keeping the laptop future-ready for years of demanding use.

Next-Generation Connectivity

Staying connected is effortless. Wi-Fi 7 (triple-band, 2×2) and Bluetooth 5.4 deliver cutting-edge wireless speeds, while a 2.5G LAN port keeps competitive online play lag-free. Two Thunderbolt™ 5 ports add up to 120 Gbps of bandwidth with DisplayPort, power delivery and G-Sync support, joined by three USB 3.2 Gen 2 Type-A ports and HDMI 2.1 for high-refresh external displays.

Cool, Immersive and Built for Battle

ROG Intelligent Cooling keeps temperatures and noise in check during marathon sessions, while a per-key RGB backlit keyboard with a Copilot key and Aura Sync sets the mood. A four-speaker system with Smart Amplifier Technology, Dolby Atmos and AI noise-cancelling delivers immersive audio, and a 1080p IR camera enables quick, secure Windows Hello sign-in. A 90Wh battery with fast charging tops up to 50% in just 30 minutes — and a ROG backpack is included in the box.

Arm your battle station with robust power delivery and Wi-Fi 6E for peak AM5 performance | The foundation for uncompromising gaming.

Quick Specs

  • Power your high-performance AMD Ryzen processors with robust VRM and military-grade components.
  • Experience lag-free online gaming with integrated Wi-Fi 6E and high-speed Ethernet.
  • Benefit from enhanced audio clarity and immersion with AI noise-cancelling microphone technology.
  • Ensure system stability and durability with TUF gaming alliance components and extensive testing.
  • Connect all your essential peripherals and storage devices with ample M.2 slots and USB ports.

Engineered for victory: The ASUS TUF Gaming B850M-Plus WIFI II AM5 motherboard for the serious South African gamer

This is not merely a motherboard; it is the unyielding backbone of your high-performance gaming PC. Designed for the demanding South African PC enthusiast, the TUF Gaming B850M-Plus WIFI II is built to withstand the rigours of intense gaming sessions and overclocking. It provides the stable, reliable platform required for the latest AMD AM5 processors, ensuring that your system performs at its peak when it matters most. For those who understand that performance is built from the ground up, this M-ATX motherboard offers a clear advantage, cutting through the clutter of lesser components with its sheer resilience and capability. This robust AM5 motherboard is your first strike toward ultimate gaming dominance.

Unshakeable power delivery for uncompromising performance

At the heart of this TUF Gaming motherboard lies an enhanced power solution. Featuring 12+2 DrMOS power stages, premium alloy chokes, and durable capacitors, it is engineered to provide stable and consistent power to your AMD Ryzen™ processors. This robust power delivery system is crucial for maintaining optimal performance, especially during demanding tasks like gaming, streaming, or content creation, and it ensures that your CPU receives the clean, reliable energy it needs to perform without throttling. This attention to power integrity is a hallmark of TUF Gaming reliability for your AM5 build.

Connectivity without compromise: Future-proof your setup

The TUF Gaming B850M-Plus WIFI II is equipped for the present and the future. With integrated Wi-Fi 6E, you can harness the latest wireless technology for faster speeds, lower latency, and more reliable connections, essential for competitive online gaming and high-bandwidth activities. High-speed networking is further bolstered by a 2.5 Gb Ethernet port, offering a stable and rapid wired connection. Furthermore, a comprehensive array of USB ports, including USB 3.2 Gen 2 Type-A and Type-C®, ensures that all your peripherals, from high-speed external drives to the latest VR headsets, can be connected with ease and deliver maximum performance. This M-ATX motherboard ensures seamless integration.

Intelligent audio and AI enhancements for total immersion

Experience audio that places you directly in the game with the integrated Realtek ALC1220 codec. This high-fidelity audio solution, combined with exclusive AI noise-cancelling microphone technology, dramatically reduces background noise for crystal-clear in-game communication. Whether coordinating with teammates or enjoying immersive soundtracks, your audio experience will be unparalleled. This motherboard ensures that what you hear, and how you communicate, is as sharp and clear as your visuals. It is a crucial element for any serious AM5 gaming rig.

Built to last: TUF Gaming's commitment to durability

ASUS TUF Gaming products are synonymous with durability. The B850M-Plus WIFI II features TUF Protection, including TUF LANGuard for surge-protected networking, ESD Guards for electrostatic discharge protection, and an improved VRM heatsink for superior heat dissipation. These elements, combined with the military-grade certification of TUF components and rigorous testing, ensure that this motherboard is not just built for performance, but for longevity, providing peace of mind for years of gaming and computing. Choosing this TUF motherboard means choosing lasting power for your AM5 setup.

FEATURES:

  • Power your gaming ambitions with a robust 12+2 DrMOS power solution, fortified with TUF military-grade components for unwavering stability under load on your AM5 build.
  • Experience lightning-fast, stable wireless connections with integrated Wi-Fi 6E and enjoy swift, reliable wired networking via the 2.5 Gb Ethernet port on this M-ATX motherboard.
  • Immerse yourself in superior sound and clear communication with the high-fidelity Realtek ALC1220 audio codec and AI noise-cancelling microphone technology.
  • Safeguard your system against power surges and electrostatic discharge with TUF LANGuard and ESD Guards, ensuring enhanced component longevity for your AM5 motherboard.
  • Connect and expand with ease using multiple M.2 slots for fast storage and a comprehensive suite of USB ports, including high-speed Type-A and Type-C® options on this M-ATX motherboard.

Sitting in front of your existing 24-pin ATX cable, this 24-pin ARGB extension cable floods your case with smooth, addressable colour that flows the full length of the connector span — turning dead cable space into a deliberate design statement.

Fitted with standard 5V 3-pin ARGB connectors, the GCP06 plugs straight into your motherboard’s addressable header and falls in line with your wider lighting scheme. Whether you run ASUS Aura Sync, MSI Mystic Light, Gigabyte RGB Fusion or ASRock Polychrome, this ARGB power cable picks up the same effects, speeds and colours as the rest of your components — no separate software to wrestle with.

Built to Be Seen From Every Angle

Lighting PCB boards on both sides mean the GCP06 looks just as good whether your case is glass-on-the-left or stood on a desk in full view. The transparent PVC jacket lets every colour read true, while the 16-spindle braided sleeving in bright-coloured aluminium foil keeps the whole run crisp and tidy. The strike against system lag

This Hiksemi V310N SSD is not crafted for the fleeting speed of consumer gaming; it is forged for the unrelenting demand of continuous data capture. For the South African installer or system administrator maintaining security infrastructure, this M.2 2280 SSD represents uncompromising stability where data integrity cannot be compromised by mechanical failure or slow write speeds.

Optimised for constant surveillance

Your security recording systems require a storage medium that performs consistently under heavy, sequential write loads, day after day. This M.2 2280 SSD addresses the core weakness of traditional hard drives in this role: mechanical degradation. By utilising flash memory architecture, the V310N eliminates vibration, noise, and the risk of head crashes, ensuring your footage remains accessible when needed most.

Sustained speed when it matters

The true test of a surveillance drive is its sustained write performance, not just a momentary peak. With verified sequential write speeds of 520MB/s, this M.2 2280 SSD can comfortably handle multiple high-definition camera streams concurrently, preventing dropped frames or buffering during critical recording periods. The high IOPS figures for random 4K operations further ensure rapid access to recent footage when reviewing incidents.

Built for the long watch

Longevity is paramount in security hardware. The V310N is engineered with a robust Total Bytes Written (TBW) rating of 1776TB, providing confidence in its operational lifespan even in high-traffic recording environments. Complemented by an exceptional Mean Time Between Failures (MTBF) rating of 2,000,000 hours, this drive is built to function reliably through years of continuous service, minimising costly downtime and replacement cycles. Its M.2 2280 form factor ensures seamless physical integration.

Efficient power draw for remote sites

In installations where power consumption or heat management is a concern, the V310N excels. Drawing a maximum of only 1.2W during operation, it reduces the overall thermal load on your Network Video Recorder (NVR) or dedicated server, contributing to a cooler, more stable operational environment. This low power profile makes it an ideal M.2 2280 SSD solution.

product.name: PORT Office docking station 3 X 4 USB-C 11 devices 100W
product.description:
Triple 4K display support | 11-port connectivity | 100W USB-C Power Delivery | Plug-and-play compatibility | Built for demanding professionals

Quick Specs

  • Connect up to 11 peripherals through a single USB-C cable, keeping your desk clean and efficient
  • Drive up to three 4K displays simultaneously — two with your laptop connected, three in standalone mode
  • Charge your laptop at up to 100W via USB-C Power Delivery while powering all connected devices
  • Transfer data at up to 10 Gbps via USB-A 3.1 Gen 2 and USB-C 3.1 Gen 2 ports with fast-charge support
  • Compatible with Windows, macOS, and ChromeOS — plug-and-play setup, no drivers required

Your laptop's full potential, unlocked through one cable

The PORT Connect USB-C 3X4K Office Docking Station is built for professionals who need a commanding, clutter-free workstation without sacrificing connectivity. By connecting a single USB-C cable to your laptop, you gain access to 11 ports — spanning video outputs, high-speed data transfer, wired networking, audio, and power delivery — all from a compact, desk-friendly unit. Compatible with Windows, macOS, and ChromeOS, it integrates seamlessly into any hybrid or office environment.

Three 4K screens, one docking station

Tired of toggling between windows on a single screen? The PORT Connect docking station supports up to three simultaneous 4K displays via two DisplayPort 1.4++ outputs and one HDMI 2.0 output, using DisplayPort Multi-Stream Transport (MST) technology. With your laptop connected, you can drive two additional external screens in 4K. Disconnect the laptop and use the dock in standalone mode to extend across three 4K displays — ideal for developers, analysts, and creatives who rely on multiple active windows throughout the day.

Fast charging and rapid data transfer in a single connection

The docking station delivers up to 100W of USB-C Power Delivery to your laptop, so your battery stays charged throughout the workday without a separate power brick. For peripherals, the two USB-A 3.1 Gen 2 ports and two USB-C 3.1 Gen 2 ports each support transfer speeds up to 10 Gbps and are compatible with BC 1.2 fast charging and Apple Charging. Two USB-A 2.0 ports handle standard accessories, ensuring nothing gets left behind.

Built for professional environments — secure, smart, and space-saving

An ON/OFF power button enables intelligent energy management, reducing consumption when the dock is not in use. An integrated security slot protects your setup in shared or open-plan workspaces. For IT administrators, the dock supports PXE Boot and Wake-on-LAN for remote device management. The included 1 m USB-C cable features a screw-lock connector for a secure, rattle-free connection, and the bundled vertical foot stand keeps the dock upright on your desk to save surface space. A Gigabit Ethernet port and a 3.5 mm combo audio jack complete the picture for a fully wired, high-performance workstation.

  • Triple 4K display support — 2× DisplayPort 1.4++ and 1× HDMI 2.0 using MST technology; up to 2 external 4K screens with laptop, or 3 in standalone mode

This exceptional PC steering wheel bundle is more than just a gaming accessory; it is your gateway to authentic motorsport simulation, crafted for the dedicated sim racer. Unrivalled realism with direct drive force feedback

The core of this PC steering wheel lies in its powerful direct drive motor. Unlike traditional belt or gear-driven systems, direct drive technology connects the steering wheel directly to the motor. This eliminates any mechanical play or lag, translating every subtle change in the racing surface directly to your hands with astonishing accuracy. Feel the grip of the tyres, the unevenness of the road, and the impact of kerbs with a fidelity that redefines the sim racing experience. Precision control with magnetic Hall effect pedals

Complementing the direct drive wheel is the PD-HM Dual Pedal set. These pedals utilise Hall effect sensors, which employ magnets to detect pedal position. This contactless technology ensures exceptional durability, precision, and longevity compared to traditional potentiometer-based pedals. Experience consistent actuation, whether you are feathering the throttle on corner exit or executing a precise brake application. The dual-pedal setup provides the essential control needed for both acceleration and braking, forming the foundation of precise car control in any simulation, defining what quality racing wheels and pedals should offer.

The wheel base, steering wheel, and pedals are constructed from robust materials designed for longevity and stability. The integrated Z8 desk clamp ensures a secure mounting solution, preventing any unwanted movement even during the most intense moments on track. Seamless integration into your setup

Designed for ease of use and maximum compatibility, the PXN VD4 connects via a reliable wired connection, ensuring minimal latency and consistent performance. The operating system is designed for straightforward integration with the most popular racing simulation titles. The included Z8 clamp offers a simple yet secure way to attach the wheel base to your desk or racing rig, allowing for quick setup and dismantling if space is a consideration. This thoughtful design ensures you can spend more time racing and less time configuring your setup. Elevate your sim racing with this advanced PC steering wheel.

A rock-solid foundation for your next Intel build

The ASRock B860M Rock WiFi is designed for PC builders who want a capable, well-featured Intel platform in a compact Micro ATX footprint. Pairing the Intel B860 chipset with the LGA1851 socket, it supports Intel Core Ultra Series 2 processors — bringing Intel Turbo Boost Max 3.0, Thermal Velocity Boost, Adaptive Boost Technology, and an integrated NPU for dedicated AI acceleration. Whether you are assembling a focused gaming rig, a content creation workstation, or a productive daily driver, the B860M Rock WiFi delivers the performance headroom and modern connectivity to handle it all.

DDR5 memory and PCIe 5.0 storage — built for speed

Tired of storage bottlenecks holding back an otherwise capable system? The B860M Rock WiFi addresses this head-on with its Blazing M.2 slot — a PCIe Gen5 x4 socket capable of up to 128 Gb/s — making it one of the most capable storage configurations available at this chipset tier. A second Hyper M.2 slot running PCIe Gen4 x4 at up to 64 Gb/s provides additional high-speed NVMe capacity, while four SATA3 6.0 Gb/s connectors accommodate traditional drives. Memory runs on Dual Channel DDR5 across two DIMM slots, supporting up to 128 GB with speeds up to 8333+ MHz under XMP 3.0 overclocking profiles, and CUDIMM compatibility for added flexibility.

Stay connected — wired, wireless, and everywhere in between

The B860M Rock WiFi is equipped with an 802.11axe Wi-Fi 6E module covering 2.4 GHz, 5 GHz, and the extended 6 GHz band, backed by a 2x2 MU-MIMO antenna configuration for lower latency and higher throughput in congested environments. Bluetooth 5.3 is included for wireless peripherals. On the wired side, the Dragon RTL8125BG 2.5G LAN controller provides speeds up to 2500 Mb/s with intelligent bandwidth management software and optimised presets for gaming, browsing, and streaming. The rear I/O panel rounds out connectivity with a USB 3.2 Gen2x2 Type-C port running at 20 Gb/s, three USB 3.2 Gen1 Type-A ports, two USB 2.0 ports, HDMI 2.1 (up to 4K 120Hz), DisplayPort 1.4 (up to 8K 60Hz), and HD audio jacks.

Thoughtfully built for the DIY builder

ASRock has packed several quality-of-life features into the B860M Rock WiFi to make the build process straightforward. A pre-installed I/O shield saves time during installation, while toolless SSD installation via a quick-release latch simplifies storage setup. The reinforced PCIe 5.0 x16 steel slot provides extra anchor points and a stronger latch to keep heavy graphics cards securely seated. Onboard RGB and three addressable LED headers with Polychrome SYNC support allow lighting customisation across compatible devices. The Auto Driver Installer utility handles driver and software setup automatically on first boot, so you spend less time configuring and more time using your build.

A foundation of reliable connectivity for every South African home

The Cudy N300 is engineered for the modern household that demands stability without unnecessary complexity. It is designed for users who need a dependable internet connection for everyday tasks, from essential browsing and email to streaming your favourite shows and connecting with family. This 2.4 GHz wireless router is not for those seeking bleeding-edge speeds for extreme gaming or massive file transfers, but for individuals and families who value a consistently performing network. Its straightforward operation and versatile functionality make it an ideal choice for apartments, smaller homes, or as a supplementary network solution where a solid 2.4GHz connection is paramount.

Unwavering performance for your daily digital life

At its core, the Cudy N300 delivers a stable 300 Mbps wireless N connection. This speed is perfectly suited for a multitude of daily activities: it provides enough bandwidth for smooth video streaming on platforms like Netflix and YouTube, allows for clear video calls with loved ones, and supports responsive online browsing. The inclusion of two fixed omni-directional antennas ensures that this performance is distributed effectively throughout your space, minimising dead spots and providing a more uniform signal strength. This focus on consistent delivery means fewer interruptions and a more enjoyable online experience for everyone connected. The Cudy N300 router ensures your connection remains robust.

Adaptability to suit your evolving network requirements

The true strength of the Cudy N300 lies in its remarkable flexibility. Beyond its primary function as a router, it seamlessly transitions into several other essential roles. Use it as an Access Point (AP) to expand an existing wired network wirelessly; configure it as a Repeater (RE) to boost the signal of another router; employ its WISP mode to connect to a public Wi-Fi hotspot and share it across your devices; or integrate it into a Mesh Wi-Fi network as a Satellite to enhance coverage. This multi-functional design ensures that the N300 can adapt to your changing needs, offering a cost-effective and versatile networking solution that grows with your household. This mesh Wi-Fi capability extends your network's reach.

Security and ease of use, built-in

Your online safety is a priority. The Cudy N300 employs industry-standard WPA-PSK and WPA2-PSK encryption, safeguarding your network from unauthorised access and protecting your sensitive data. Setting up and managing your network is also remarkably simple. With compatibility across Windows, macOS, Android, and iOS, you can easily configure settings, manage connected devices, and monitor your network performance from virtually any device. The inclusion of a WPS button further simplifies the connection of compatible devices, offering a quick and secure way to join your network. This reliable 2.4 GHz wireless router prioritises your security.

Future-ready connectivity with advanced protocol support

While rooted in the reliable 2.4GHz band, the Cudy N300 is equipped with advanced features that cater to more demanding users. It supports both IPv4 and IPv6 internet protocols, ensuring compatibility with the evolving internet landscape. For those who utilise VPN services, the integrated VPN Client supporting WireGuard and OpenVPN provides a secure tunnel for your internet traffic. Additionally, features like VLAN support for IPTV and a dedicated Guest Network allow for segmenting your network, enhancing security and managing access for visitors effectively. The Cudy N300 router is a versatile addition to any home network.

Consistent, industry-leading 24x7 performance

Leveraging an all-CMR portfolio, the Seagate IronWolf Pro 10TB delivers consistent, industry-leading performance. Proactive data protection and peace of mind

Your data's security is paramount. Optimised for superior multi-bay NAS performance

product.name: MSI GeForce RTX 5050 8G GAMING OC Graphics Card
product.description:
Experience elevated gaming with the MSI GeForce RTX 5050 8G, powered by TWIN FROZR 10 cooling for peak performance.

Quick Specs

  • Experience whisper-quiet cooling with the advanced TWIN FROZR 10 system.
  • Achieve peak performance with an Extreme Core Clock of 2647 MHz.
  • Game smoothly with 8GB of GDDR6 memory and a 128-bit memory bus.
  • Future-proof your setup with PCI Express Gen 5 connectivity.
  • Drive the latest displays with support for up to 7680 x 4320 resolution.

Unleash your gaming potential with the MSI GeForce RTX 5050 8G GAMING OC graphics card

Designed for the discerning South African gamer, this graphics card is not merely a component; it is the heart of your gaming rig, engineered to deliver exceptional performance and visual fidelity. It is for those who demand smooth frame rates, vibrant colours, and immersive worlds without compromise. Whether you are diving into the latest AAA titles or engaging in competitive esports, the RTX 5050 provides the power needed to dominate. This gaming graphics card is built to offer a significant upgrade, ensuring you stay ahead of the curve in the ever-evolving landscape of PC gaming. It represents a commitment to quality and performance that MSI is known for, making it a vital addition for any serious PC enthusiast seeking a top-tier gpu.

Cooling mastery for sustained performance

The TWIN FROZR 10 thermal design is central to the RTX 5050's prowess. This advanced cooling solution features MSI's STORMFORCE Fan technology, boasting seven fan blades with a unique claw texturing and circular arc design. This engineering ensures optimal airflow while maintaining minimal noise levels, allowing you to focus on the game. A reinforcing backplate, complete with an airflow vent, further enhances cooling by allowing exhaust air to pass through directly. This meticulous attention to thermal management means your GPU can maintain its peak performance for extended gaming sessions, preventing throttling and ensuring consistent, reliable power.

A gateway to high-fidelity gaming

At its core, the GeForce RTX 5050 offers a powerful platform for modern gaming. With 2560 CUDA Cores and 8GB of GDDR6 memory operating on a 128-bit bus, it is equipped to handle demanding titles with impressive smoothness. The card's Extreme Performance Core Clock of 2647 MHz (as reported by MSI Center) ensures that you receive every possible frame, crucial for fast-paced gameplay where split-second reactions are key. This gaming graphics card is your essential tool for experiencing games as they were intended to be seen and played.

Future-ready technology for the ambitious gamer

This MSI graphics card is built with the future in mind. It supports the latest PCI Express Gen 5 interface, though it utilises an x8 electrical connection, ensuring compatibility with next-generation motherboards and providing ample bandwidth for its operations. With support for G-SYNC® technology and a digital maximum resolution of 7680 x 4320, this card is ready to drive the most advanced gaming displays and deliver breathtaking visuals. It’s an investment that promises to keep your gaming experience cutting-edge for years to come.

Connectivity and compatibility for a seamless build

The MSI GeForce RTX 5050 is designed for integration into your existing or new PC build. It features one HDMI™ 2.1b port, capable of outputting up to 4K at 480Hz or 8K at 120Hz with DSC, supports Gaming VRR, and HDR. This ensures compatibility with the latest monitors and televisions. Requiring a single 8-pin power connector and a recommended PSU of 550W, it offers efficient power delivery for its performance class. With support for DirectX 12 Ultimate and OpenGL 4.6, it is ready for all modern gaming and creative applications. This gpu is built to perform, offering a robust solution for gamers seeking reliable performance and advanced features.

This ensures a broad spectrum of performance capabilities to suit your needs. The ultrafast connectivity is a significant advantage, featuring PCIe 4.0 for lightning-fast graphics and storage, two M.2 slots for high-speed NVMe SSDs, Realtek 2.5Gb Ethernet for superior network performance, and a comprehensive array of USB ports, including a front USB 3.2 Gen 1 Type-C® for convenient device connection, all anchored by the reliable LGA 1700 socket.

Designed for stability and longevity

ASUS understands that a system built for performance must also be built to last. The PRIME B760M-A D4 CSM incorporates comprehensive cooling solutions, including VRM heatsinks to manage processor heat, M.2 heatsinks to keep storage drives at optimal temperatures, and PCH heatsinks for chipset stability. Hybrid fan headers and Fan Xpert 2+ provide intelligent and versatile fan control, ensuring that your components remain cool under load. Furthermore, ASUS OptiMem II technology meticulously optimises memory signal integrity, facilitating improved memory overclocking and stability for demanding applications on your new Intel motherboard.

Customisable aesthetics and control

Beyond raw performance, this motherboard offers avenues for personalisation. Aura Sync RGB lighting, with onboard Addressable Gen 2 headers and an Aura RGB header, allows you to synchronise lighting effects with other Aura Sync-capable hardware, creating a visually stunning and cohesive build. For professional users, ASUS Control Centre Express provides real-time IT monitoring and management software, enhancing data protection and system oversight. This makes the Asus PRIME B760M-A D4 CSM an ideal choice for both enthusiast builds and small business environments, supporting the LGA 1700 socket for robust processing power.

product.name: Asus TUF Gaming 1000W 80 PLUS Gold ATX Modular Power Supply - White
product.description:
The ASUS TUF Gaming 1000W 80 PLUS Gold ATX White Edition Modular Power Supply is engineered for serious PC builders in South Africa who demand unwavering reliability and long-term performance. Built with military-grade components and tested to exceed stringent durability standards, this PSU delivers up to twice the lifespan of conventional units, making it ideal for high-performance gaming rigs and workstations. With an impressive >120,000-hour MTBF at 40°C, it ensures consistent power delivery even under sustained loads. The integration of premium Japanese capacitors and an 80 PLUS Gold efficiency rating guarantees reduced energy waste, lower heat output, and optimised system stability—perfect for powering modern GPUs and CPUs.

Designed with both performance and practicality in mind, the ASUS TUF Gaming 1000W features upgraded PCIe connectors that improve thermal conductivity, reducing connector temperatures by up to 12.28°C. Its fully modular etched cables not only simplify installation but also enhance airflow within your chassis, operating safely up to 50°C below rated limits. The advanced Axial-tech fan design, combined with dual ball bearings, ensures superior cooling and extended lifespan, while 0dB technology allows silent operation during low loads. A protective PCB coating safeguards internal components from dust, humidity, and extreme temperatures—ideal for varying South African environments. Backed by a 10-year warranty, this PSU is a future-proof investment for any enthusiast build.

FEATURES:

  • Military-grade capacitors and chokes for enhanced durability and reliability
  • Dual ball bearing fan design for extended lifespan and improved cooling
  • Axial-tech fan with barrier ring for increased air pressure and airflow efficiency
  • Fully modular etched cables for clean cable management and improved airflow
  • Advanced PCB coating protects against moisture, dust, and extreme temperatures
  • 0dB fan mode for silent operation under low to moderate loads

product.name: Asus ROG STRIX LC III 360 ARGB LCD All-in-one CPU Liquid Cooler - Black
product.description:
The ASUS ROG Strix LC III 360 ARGB LCD All-in-One CPU Liquid Cooler is engineered for gamers, creators, and performance enthusiasts who demand elite cooling with premium aesthetics. Powered by the latest Asetek Gen7 V2 pump, this advanced liquid cooling solution delivers exceptional thermal management for modern AMD Ryzen™ and Intel® Core™ processors, ensuring your system remains stable under demanding workloads, high-FPS gaming sessions, and heavy multitasking. The enhanced cold plate design increases cooling capability by up to 100W of additional thermal headroom while achieving temperatures up to 0.5°C lower, giving your CPU the performance edge it needs to maintain peak speeds. Combined with high-performance ROG STRIX AF-12S ARGB radiator fans, the LC III 360 ensures efficient airflow, powerful static pressure, and whisper-quiet operation for a refined PC building experience.

Designed to elevate both performance and visual appeal, the cooler features a 2.1-inch full-colour IPS LCD display with 480 × 480 resolution and a smooth 60Hz refresh rate, allowing you to showcase custom animations, images, system statistics, or real-time CPU temperatures directly on the pump head. The 360° rotatable display orientation ensures perfect alignment regardless of your PC case layout, making it an ideal centrepiece for modern gaming rigs. With wide compatibility across Intel LGA 1851 / 1700 / 1200 / 115x and AMD AM5 / AM4 platforms, plus premium sleeved tubing and anti-vibration fan design, the ROG Strix LC III 360 ARGB LCD seamlessly blends cutting-edge cooling technology with the signature ROG aesthetic for a powerful and immersive PC build.

FEATURES:

  • 2.1″ Full-Colour IPS LCD Display – Customisable screen supports system information, animations, images, and real-time performance monitoring.
  • 360° Rotatable LCD Orientation – Easily rotate the display to perfectly align with your PC case layout.
  • Asetek Gen7 V2 Pump Technology – Updated pump design provides up to 100W additional cooling capacity and improved efficiency.
  • High-Performance ARGB Radiator Fans – ROG STRIX AF-12S fans deliver strong airflow and static pressure with vibrant addressable RGB lighting.
  • 0dB Technology Support – Fans can stop completely during low loads for silent operation.
  • Wide Platform Compatibility – Supports modern Intel and AMD CPU sockets for flexible PC builds.

product.description:
Power your next-generation gaming rig with the ASUS ROG Thor 1200W 80 PLUS Platinum III ATX Modular Power Supply, engineered for enthusiasts who demand uncompromising performance, efficiency, and stability. Built around cutting-edge GaN MOSFET technology, this premium PSU delivers up to 30% greater efficiency compared to traditional designs, ensuring reduced energy waste and lower operating temperatures. Designed with ATX 3.1 and PCIe Gen 5.1 compatibility, it is perfectly suited for modern high-performance GPUs and CPUs, making it an ideal choice for South African gamers, creators, and power users building future-ready systems. The innovative “GPU-First” intelligent voltage stabiliser prioritises graphics card power delivery, ensuring consistent and stable performance during demanding gaming sessions or heavy workloads.

The ROG Thor 1200W Platinum III stands out with its signature detachable magnetic OLED display, allowing you to monitor real-time power consumption with ease while maintaining optimal airflow thanks to its flexible mounting design. Combined with ROG heatsinks, 0dB fan technology, and Turbo Mode, this PSU offers silent operation under lighter loads and aggressive cooling when performance is pushed to the limit. Certified with 80 PLUS Platinum and Cybenetics Lambda A++, it guarantees exceptional efficiency and ultra-low noise levels. Built for longevity and reliability, this fully modular power supply is backed by a 10-year warranty, making it a dependable investment for high-end systems.

product.name: Asus MAX Gaming LC 360 ARGB LCD All-in-one CPU Liquid Cooler - White
product.description:
The ASUS MAX Gaming LC 360 ARGB LCD All-in-One CPU Liquid Cooler is engineered for gamers, PC enthusiasts, and creators who demand reliable thermal performance alongside premium visual customisation. Built around a high-efficiency pump and a large 360mm aluminium radiator, this advanced liquid cooling solution ensures your processor maintains optimal operating temperatures even during intense gaming sessions or heavy workloads. The copper CPU plate maximises heat transfer efficiency, while the balanced pump design delivers high coolant flow with low impedance for consistent cooling performance across modern Intel and AMD platforms. With pre-installed daisy-chainable ARGB fans, the cooler simplifies installation and cable management, allowing builders to create a clean and professional PC aesthetic with minimal effort.

A standout feature of the MAX Gaming LC 360 is its vibrant 2.4-inch full-colour IPS LCD display, which brings system monitoring and personalisation directly to your PC build. Users can display custom animated GIFs, system information, or real-time CPU metrics such as temperature, voltage, clock speeds, and fan RPM through ASUS’ intuitive control software. The integrated ARGB lighting synchronises seamlessly with ASUS Aura Sync, enabling full ecosystem lighting coordination across compatible components. Designed with both performance and convenience in mind, the ASUS MAX Gaming LC 360 ARGB LCD delivers powerful cooling, sleek aesthetics, and intelligent monitoring, making it an ideal choice for modern high-performance gaming PCs.

  • 2.4” Full-Colour IPS LCD Display – Customisable screen supports animated GIFs or real-time monitoring of CPU frequency, voltage, temperature, fan speed, or system time.
  • 360mm Aluminium Radiator – Large radiator surface area improves thermal dissipation for demanding gaming or productivity workloads.
  • Pre-Installed Daisy-Chain ARGB Fans – Simplified installation using single-cable connection with dual headers for both lighting and fan control.
  • Strong Airflow with Low Noise – High airflow and static pressure fans maintain effective cooling while keeping acoustic levels minimal.
  • ASUS Aura Sync RGB Compatibility – Fully synchronise lighting effects with compatible ASUS components for a unified PC build aesthetic.

product.name: Asus ROG Astral GeForce RTX 5090 32GB GDDR7 BTF Edition Graphics Card
product.description:
The ASUS ROG Astral GeForce RTX™ 5090 32GB GDDR7 BTF Edition Graphics Card represents the pinnacle of next-generation GPU engineering, delivering uncompromising performance for elite gaming rigs, advanced AI workflows, and ultra-high-resolution creative applications. Powered by the formidable NVIDIA® GeForce RTX™ 5090 graphics engine, this flagship card features 32GB of ultra-fast GDDR7 memory running at 28Gbps and an immense 21760 CUDA cores, enabling exceptional rendering speeds, ray tracing performance, and AI-driven workloads. Designed for modern PC builders, the innovative BTF (Back-To-the-Future) architecture introduces a revolutionary detachable GC-HPWR high-power adapter, capable of handling up to 1000W while remaining compatible with both standard and BTF motherboards, ensuring flexibility for a wide range of builds. Whether you are pushing the limits of 8K gaming, building powerful AI workstations, or creating cinematic content, the ROG Astral RTX 5090 is engineered to dominate.

Thermal performance is equally exceptional thanks to ASUS’ Quad-Fan Force cooling architecture, which creates a vertical airflow channel that increases air pressure by up to 20%, dramatically improving cooling efficiency. Combined with a patented vapour chamber, high-density heatsink fins, and a phase-change GPU thermal pad, the card maintains lower temperatures while sustaining higher clock speeds for extended workloads. The GPU reaches a boost clock of up to 2467MHz in OC mode, ensuring peak performance under demanding conditions. With PCIe 5.0 connectivity, support for up to four displays, and compatibility with HDMI 2.1b and DisplayPort 2.1b, this powerhouse is ready for the most advanced gaming monitors and professional display setups. The sleek hidden-connector design also enables a clean, cable-free aesthetic when paired with ASUS BTF components, making it the ultimate choice for enthusiasts who demand both performance and visual perfection.

FEATURES:

  • Boost Clock up to 2467MHz (OC Mode)
  • Powered by NVIDIA® GeForce RTX™ 5090 graphics engine
  • 32GB GDDR7 memory with ultra-fast 28Gbps memory speed
  • 3352 TOPs AI performance for advanced AI-enhanced workflows
  • Quad-Fan Force for up to 20% air flow and pressure
  • PCI Express 5.0 interface for next-gen bandwidth
  • Supports up to 4 displays with HDMI 2.1b & DisplayPort 2.1b
  • Detachable GC-HPWR Adapter to enable compatibility with both standard and BTF motherboards
  • Axial-tech fans with longer blades to improve airflow and dispersion

product.name: UGREEN Cat6 UTP Ethernet cable 2M - Red
product.description:
The UGREEN Cat6 UTP Ethernet Cable is a straightforward solution for anyone needing a reliable wired network connection at home or in the office. At 2 m in length, it reaches comfortably between a router, modem, switch, or network adapter and your computer, laptop, smart TV, or games console. product.name: Keychron K10 HE 100% Wireless Magnetic Gaming Keyboard Nebula Switches – Black
product.description:
Unleash lightning-fast inputs with adjustable actuation and rapid trigger technology; connect seamlessly via 2.4GHz, Bluetooth, or USB Type-C for ultimate gaming freedom.

Quick Specs

  • Experience unparalleled responsiveness with adjustable actuation from 0.2 mm to 3.8 mm.
  • Dominate your opponents with Rapid Trigger and Dynamic Keystrokes for instantaneous reactions.
  • Connect effortlessly with 2.4 GHz wireless, Bluetooth 5.2, or wired USB-C for versatile use.
  • Enjoy a full-size layout with 104 keys, featuring durable Double-shot PBT keycaps and Cherry profile.
  • Benefit from a robust 4000mAh battery offering up to 120 hours of use with the backlight off.

Engineered for Precision: The Keychron K10 HE for the Discerning South African Gamer

This is not merely a keyboard; it is an extension of your intent, forged for those who understand that in the digital arena, milliseconds dictate destiny. For the South African gamer and professional who demands absolute control and unwavering reliability, the Keychron K10 HE stands as a testament to precision engineering. It transcends the basic function of input; it refines it, offering a tactile experience and responsiveness that directly translates to superior performance. If you measure success in flawless execution and seek a tool that keeps pace with your ambition, this wireless gaming keyboard is your definitive choice.

Transform Your Input: Magnetic Switch Technology at its Finest

At the core of the K10 HE lies the revolutionary Gateron Double-Rail Magnetic Switch technology. This innovation allows for an adjustable actuation range, letting you fine-tune the sensitivity from an ultra-precise 0.2 mm for rapid-fire actions to a more deliberate 3.8 mm. Coupled with the groundbreaking Rapid Trigger and Dynamic Keystrokes features, the keyboard instantly resets switches upon release, eliminating debounce delays and ensuring every command is registered as quickly as you can think it. This adaptive magnetic switch keyboard technology empowers you to customise your input, ensuring you always have the competitive edge.

Seamless Connectivity for Uninterrupted Performance

The K10 HE offers unparalleled flexibility in how you connect your wireless gaming keyboard. Whether you prefer the robust stability of a 1000 Hz polling rate via 2.4 GHz wireless or wired USB-C, or the convenience of connecting up to three devices simultaneously via Bluetooth 5.2, this keyboard adapts to your workflow. The high polling rate ensures that your inputs are transmitted to your system with minimal latency, a critical factor in competitive gaming where every fraction of a second counts. Seamlessly switch between your gaming rig, laptop, and tablet without missing a beat, maintaining peak productivity and performance across all your devices.

Built for Durability and Ergonomic Excellence

Crafted with a premium aluminium frame and a durable ABS bottom case, the K10 HE is built to withstand the rigours of intense gaming sessions and prolonged work. The Double-shot PBT keycaps offer superior resistance to wear and shine, ensuring that your keyboard maintains its pristine look and feel over time. Combined with the carefully sculpted Cherry profile and adjustable typing angles (3.5°, 7.7°, 11°), this hot swappable keyboard provides exceptional comfort and reduces strain during extended use. This focus on ergonomic design and resilient materials means your keyboard is as dependable as your own reflexes.

The Ultimate Full-Size Keyboard for Every Need

The full-size 100% layout provides all 104 keys you need, ensuring no functionality is sacrificed for compactness. From the dedicated number pad to the function row and navigation cluster, every element is precisely where you expect it to be. This makes the K10 HE ideal not only for gaming but also for programming, content creation, and everyday productivity tasks. The vibrant RGB backlight, with its north-facing LEDs, illuminates your setup and allows for customisation to suit your mood or environment, further enhancing the immersive experience provided by this exceptional peripheral.

Features

  • Experience instant responsiveness with an adjustable actuation range from 0.2 mm to 3.8 mm, tailoring sensitivity to your precise needs.
  • Gain a competitive advantage with Rapid Trigger and Dynamic Keystrokes, ensuring zero delay between your actions and in-game responses.
  • Connect with ultimate flexibility using 2.4 GHz wireless for high-performance gaming, Bluetooth 5.2 for multi-device convenience, or wired USB-C for constant power and reliability.
  • Enjoy a comfortable and familiar typing experience with durable Double-shot PBT keycaps in the classic Cherry profile, designed for longevity and tactile satisfaction.

For the discerning South African user demanding robust multimedia and control solutions

The Giada DN24, powered by the Raspberry Pi Compute Module 4 Lite, is more than a barebone system; it is a sophisticated engine for digital displays and commercial signage. It serves those who require unwavering reliability and the flexibility to adapt. Whether you are orchestrating complex digital advertising campaigns or building custom embedded solutions, this device provides the stable foundation necessary for your vision. Its design prioritises performance and longevity, ensuring it operates efficiently within the demanding environments common in South Africa. This digital signage player is engineered for impact.

Uncompromised visual output for impactful presentations

At the core of the DN24's capability lies its dual HDMI 2.0 interfaces. Each port independently supports a maximum resolution of 3840 x 2160 pixels at a fluid 60 Hz. This enables the simultaneous display of high-definition content across two independent screens, a critical feature for dynamic advertising or sophisticated control room setups. The clarity and refresh rate provided ensure that every image, video, and data stream is presented with precision, avoiding motion blur and maintaining visual integrity even in fast-paced applications. This signage player excels at delivering stunning visuals.

Performance engineered for sustained operation

This barebone system is built around the Raspberry Pi Compute Module 4 Lite, featuring a quad-core Cortex-A72 processor. Paired with 2GB of onboard LPDDR4-3200 MHz memory, it delivers robust performance capable of handling multiple applications concurrently. The inclusion of a watchdog timer ensures system resilience; it automatically resets the device if it encounters a software freeze, guaranteeing continuous operation essential for critical applications. Furthermore, the integrated RTC (Real-Time Clock) allows for precise scheduling and independent daily or weekly cycle setup, adding another layer of operational control. This powerful digital signage media player handles complex tasks with ease.

Connectivity and reliability, built for South African conditions

The DN24 is equipped with essential connectivity for diverse operational needs. A Gigabit Ethernet port ensures high-speed, stable network performance, crucial for data-intensive tasks and reliable communication. Onboard Wi-Fi and Bluetooth modules offer flexibility for wireless connectivity, supporting both 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz bands. With three USB 3.2 Gen 1 ports and one USB 2.0 port, extensive peripheral support is readily available. A vital RS232 serial port provides compatibility with legacy industrial equipment, underscoring its versatility. The robust metal construction and defined operating temperature range (0°C to 45°C) demonstrate its suitability for deployment across various South African environments. This reliable signage player is built to last.

A smart investment for diverse applications

The Giada DN24 is an intelligent choice for businesses and enthusiasts seeking a compact, powerful, and reliable computing platform. Its combination of high-resolution dual display output, capable processing power, comprehensive connectivity, and robust build quality makes it an ideal solution for digital signage and advanced multimedia players where performance and dependability are paramount. This is the foundation for your next impactful digital deployment. Choosing this digital signage player means choosing excellence.

  • Ensure uninterrupted operation with a built-in watchdog timer, automatically resetting the system if it hangs, vital for critical applications like a signage player.
  • Benefit from the speed and capacity of 2GB LPDDR4-3200 MHz memory, ensuring smooth multitasking for your demanding applications.
  • Enjoy fast and stable network connections with the integrated Gigabit Ethernet controller and dual-band Wi-Fi/Bluetooth.

product.description:
Simultaneously charge your device with up to 15W PD while enjoying high-quality USB Type-C audio for calls, music, or gaming.

Quick Specs

Unlock true versatility for your USB Type-C device

For the modern user in South Africa, this UGREEN dual USB Type-C audio and charging adapter is an essential tool. It addresses the common limitation of devices without a 3.5mm audio jack, while allowing you to charge and listen at the same time.

Designed for seamless everyday use, it’s ideal for mobile gamers, professionals on long calls, or music enthusiasts who enjoy extended listening sessions. This adapter delivers two essential functions from a single port, expanding the capabilities of your smartphone, tablet, or laptop without compromise.

Uninterrupted audio and rapid power delivery

The core strength of this UGREEN adapter lies in its ability to perform two critical tasks simultaneously. Connect your digital USB Type-C earphones to one port for clear audio during music playback, calls, or gaming. At the same time, use the second port to power your device.

With support for USB Power Delivery 3.0 (PD3.0), it provides up to 15W of charging power (5V/3A), ensuring reliable performance even during heavy use. This dual functionality eliminates the need to switch between charging and audio accessories, making it ideal for all-day use.

Engineered for clarity and convenience

This adapter is designed for digital USB Type-C earphones, delivering high-fidelity sound along with support for inline remote controls and microphone functionality. It supports multiple charging protocols including PD 3.0, QC 3.0, FCP, and SCP for broad compatibility.

The 10cm cable length reduces clutter while remaining practical for everyday use, whether at your desk or on the move. Its compact size makes it easy to carry in a pocket, bag, or tech pouch.

The smart solution for modern devices

Many modern devices have removed the headphone jack in favour of a streamlined design. This UGREEN adapter bridges that gap by restoring audio connectivity while maintaining charging functionality.

It supports a 4-in-1 experience: charging, music playback, calling, and inline remote control operation—ensuring you retain full functionality without compromise.

product.name: UGREEN FineTrack Mini Smart Finder for Apple Devices
product.description:
Locate your essentials across South Africa with the seamless Apple Find My network; attach it to your keys, bag, or anything you can't afford to lose.

Quick Specs

  • Effortlessly locate your items using the vast Apple Find My network, offering global tracking.
  • Benefit from up to 18 months of battery life with a easily replaceable CR2032 battery.
  • Receive immediate alerts if you leave your valuables behind, ensuring peace of mind.
  • Enjoy a clear, audible alert of up to 80dB to help pinpoint your lost item.
  • Integrates directly with your Apple devices for simple setup and management via the Find My app.

For the vigilant South African who values peace of mind, the UGREEN FineTrack Mini Smart Finder offers an elegant solution to the age-old problem of misplaced belongings.

This is not a device that merely beeps; it is an extension of your awareness, designed to integrate seamlessly into your Apple ecosystem. Whether you are navigating the bustling streets of Cape Town, the sprawling landscapes of the Karoo, or simply managing the daily rhythm of home, this key finder provides a reliable tether to your most important possessions. It is for the individual who understands that time spent searching is time lost, and who seeks a smart, intuitive tool to safeguard their valuables. This finder is built for a life in motion, ensuring your keys, wallet, or backpack remain precisely where you last placed them, or can be swiftly recovered if they are not. Leveraging the immense power and reach of Apple's Find My network, the UGREEN FineTrack operates differently from a standard Bluetooth tracker. Unlike standalone trackers with limited Bluetooth range, this mini smart finder can be located anywhere an Apple device can connect. If your item is out of your immediate vicinity, it silently and securely reports its location through the millions of Apple devices worldwide, all while maintaining your privacy and Apple's robust encryption. This global network transforms a simple accessory into a powerful recovery tool, offering a level of security and convenience previously unattainable for items outside your direct line of sight. Crafted with a compact form factor, approximately 3.2 cm in diameter, the FineTrack is unobtrusive yet robust. Its design prioritises both functionality and discretion, ensuring it complements rather than complicates your belongings. The included silicone holder provides a secure and adaptable mounting solution, allowing you to attach it effortlessly to keyrings, luggage zippers, or even pet collars. Furthermore, the replaceable CR2032 coin cell battery ensures that this vigilance can continue for up to 18 months on a single charge, with battery levels conveniently monitored within the Apple Find My app, so you are never caught unprepared. Setup is as straightforward as attaching the FineTrack to your item and pairing it directly through the Apple Find My app on your iPhone or iPad. Once linked, you can trigger an audible alarm of up to 80dB to help you track my iPhone and locate nearby items or utilise the power of the Find My network for broader searches. Left-behind alerts notify you promptly if you move away from your tagged item, preventing accidental loss before it happens. Voice commands via Siri further enhance its utility, allowing for hands-free operation. UGREEN understands that the security of your belongings extends to the privacy of your location data. The FineTrack operates within Apple's secure Find My network, employing end-to-end encryption to ensure that only you can see the location of your item. Unwanted tracking is actively discouraged through Apple's privacy features, providing a secure and trustworthy solution for safeguarding your valuables without compromising your personal information.

Features

  • Pinpoint your lost items globally using the secure and expansive Apple Find My network, making it an essential key finder.
  • Enjoy extended peace of mind with a battery life of up to 18 months, easily replaceable, ensuring your Bluetooth tracker is always ready.
  • Prevent accidental loss with intelligent left-behind alerts sent directly to your Apple device, helping you track my iPhone.
  • Quickly locate nearby items with a powerful 80dB alarm that cuts through ambient noise.
  • Integrate effortlessly with your existing Apple devices and manage all your trackers within the intuitive Find My app.
  • Secure your privacy with Apple's end-to-end encrypted location protection, ensuring only you can track your item.
  • Attach your finder discreetly and securely to any item using the included silicone holder, perfect for keys and bags.

Specifications

  • Form Factor: Mini Smart Tracker Tag
  • Compatibility: Apple Find My (iOS only)
  • Supported Operating Systems: iOS/iPadOS 14.5 or later, macOS 12.5 or later
  • Connectivity: Bluetooth
  • Bluetooth Network Support: Apple Find My network
  • Tracking Coverage: Global tracking via nearby Apple devices
  • Alarm Volume: Up to 80dB
  • Voice Assistant Support: Siri
  • Battery Type: Replaceable CR2032 coin cell battery
  • Battery Life: Up to 18 months
  • Battery Monitoring: Battery level viewable in the Apple Find My app
  • Left-Behind Alerts: Supported
  • Pairing Method: Direct pairing through Apple Find My app
  • Privacy & Security: Apple Find My encrypted location protection
  • Included Accessories: Silicone holder
  • Product Dimensions: 3.2 × 3.2 × 0.8 cm

Why UGREEN

UGREEN is dedicated to empowering your digital life with reliable, high-quality accessories. Built on a foundation of innovation and user-centric design, UGREEN products consistently deliver performance and durability, ensuring your tech is always connected and protected. As a trusted brand for essential tools like the FineTrack key finder, UGREEN ensures you can track my iPhone and other valuables with confidence.

Immerse yourself in Hi-Res Audio Wireless with coaxial triple drivers; silence the world with 55dB hybrid active noise cancellation

Quick Specs

  • Experience studio-quality sound with Hi-Res Audio Wireless and coaxial triple drivers.
  • Silence distractions with up to 55 dB of hybrid active noise cancellation.
  • Enjoy clear calls even in windy conditions thanks to triple AI microphones.
  • Seamlessly connect to your devices with Bluetooth 5.4 and dual-device connectivity.

For the discerning listener in South Africa, the Redmi Buds 8 Pro offer an auditory experience that transcends ordinary listening.

These are not merely earbuds; they are finely tuned instruments designed for those who seek sonic purity and an escape from the everyday cacophony. Whether you are a dedicated audiophile demanding the fidelity of Hi-Res Audio Wireless, a commuter seeking solace from urban noise, or a professional requiring crystal-clear communication, these noise-cancelling earbuds are engineered to meet your exacting standards. The Obsidian Black finish reflects a commitment to sophisticated design, mirroring the precision within. They serve as your personal sound sanctuary, delivering an unparalleled audio journey that respects the integrity of the original recording.

Mastering sound with coaxial triple drivers and Hi-Res Audio Wireless

The heart of the Redmi Buds 8 Pro lies in its advanced audio architecture: coaxial triple drivers. This configuration features an 11 mm titanium diaphragm bass driver for deep, resonant lows, complemented by dual 6.7 mm piezoelectric ceramic tweeters for crisp, clear highs. This meticulous design ensures a balanced and detailed soundstage across the entire frequency spectrum. Coupled with Hi-Res Audio Wireless certification and support for the LDAC high-resolution audio codec, these earbuds deliver audio with exceptional clarity and richness, preserving the subtle nuances that define true high-fidelity sound. Experience music as the artist intended, with every note and texture faithfully reproduced.

Escape the noise with advanced hybrid active noise cancellation

In a world filled with distractions, the Redmi Buds 8 Pro provide a sanctuary of silence. Equipped with hybrid active noise cancellation (ANC) technology, these Bluetooth 5.4 earbuds can reduce noise by up to 55dB, effectively masking a broad range of ambient sounds. With 20 adjustable ANC levels, you have precise control over your listening environment, allowing you to tailor the noise reduction depth to your specific needs, achieving an average reduction of 28.3dB. Whether you are on a bustling train, a noisy airplane, or simply seeking focus in a busy environment, these earbuds create a personal oasis of calm, allowing you to immerse yourself fully in your audio content.

Crystal-clear communication, unimpeded performance

Make and receive calls with absolute confidence, even in challenging conditions. The Redmi Buds 8 Pro feature a sophisticated triple AI microphone system designed to intelligently isolate your voice and suppress unwanted background noise. Furthermore, robust wind noise resistance, effective up to 12 m/s, ensures that your voice remains clear and intelligible during outdoor calls or while cycling. Paired with noise-cancelling 5.4, you benefit from a stable, low-latency connection for seamless communication and uninterrupted audio playback, ensuring that every conversation is as clear as the music you enjoy.

Effortless connectivity and extended listening pleasure personalised

Simplify your audio experience with the latest Bluetooth 5.4 technology, offering enhanced stability and energy efficiency. Enjoy the convenience of Google Fast Pair for quick, one-step pairing with compatible Android devices, and benefit from dual-device connectivity, allowing you to effortlessly switch between your phone and laptop. With a substantial 480mAh charging case, the Redmi Buds 8 Pro offer a total listening time of up to 35 hours with ANC turned off, providing exceptional endurance for long journeys or extended workdays. These USB C charging earbuds weigh just 5.4g each, ensuring comfort for prolonged wear. Recharge rapidly with less than 1 hour for earbuds and less than 2 hours for the charging case via USB Type-C.

product.description:
[embed]https://youtu.be/UuTKnDK6QOc[/embed]

The Acer NITRO V 15 Gaming Laptop is engineered for gamers and creators who demand reliable power, smooth visuals, and next-generation performance in a sleek, portable design. Powered by the AMD Ryzen™ 7 170 8-core processor with boost speeds of up to 4.75GHz, this machine delivers exceptional responsiveness for modern gaming, multitasking, and content creation.

Whether you’re diving into competitive titles or handling demanding workloads, the combination of 16GB DDR5 RAM and a lightning-fast 512GB NVMe PCIe 4.0 SSD ensures rapid load times, seamless multitasking, and efficient data access. Preloaded with Windows 11 Home, the Nitro V 15 offers a refined and user-friendly experience tailored for productivity and play.

Visual performance is taken to the next level with a stunning 15.6-inch FHD (1920 x 1080) IPS display featuring a blazing-fast 165Hz refresh rate and Acer ComfyView technology, reducing glare for long gaming sessions. The inclusion of the NVIDIA® GeForce RTX™ 5060 GPU with 8GB GDDR7 memory unlocks cutting-edge graphics capabilities, including Ray Tracing, DLSS 4.5, and Max-Q technologies, delivering ultra-realistic visuals and AI-enhanced frame rates.

Built for South African gamers who value both performance and connectivity, the Nitro V 15 features tri-band Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax), Gigabit LAN, and ultra-fast USB4 connectivity up to 40Gbps, ensuring stable online gameplay and rapid data transfers. With dual-fan cooling and dual air intake, the system remains cool under pressure, making it ideal for extended gaming sessions.

Designed with practicality and immersion in mind, the Nitro V 15 includes AI-enhanced microphones and webcam features, delivering clearer communication for streaming, meetings, or online gaming. Its backlit keyboard with amber lighting adds a stylish gaming aesthetic while maintaining usability in low-light environments.

Acer’s Nitro series is renowned for offering high-performance gaming hardware at competitive value, making it a strong choice for gamers looking to maximise performance without compromise. Whether you’re upgrading your current setup or entering the gaming world, this laptop delivers the speed, visuals, and reliability needed to stay ahead.

product.name: PORT Mobile docking station 1 X 4K USB-C 9 devices 100W
product.description:
One cable. Nine ports. 4K output. | Full workstation connectivity from a single USB-C connection | 100W Power Delivery keeps your laptop charged | Triple-display support for maximum screen real estate | Plug-and-play across Windows, macOS, and ChromeOS

Quick Specs

  • Connect up to 9 peripherals through a single USB-C cable, transforming your laptop into a full workstation in seconds.
  • Drive up to three Full HD displays simultaneously, or one stunning 4K display at 60Hz — your choice.
  • Keep your laptop fully charged while you work with up to 100W USB-C Power Delivery pass-through.
  • Transfer files at up to 10 Gbps via USB-C 3.1 Gen 2, and enjoy stable wired networking through Gigabit Ethernet.
  • Compatible with Windows, macOS, and ChromeOS — plug-and-play setup, no drivers required.

Your Entire Workstation Through One Cable

The PORT Connect USB-C 1x4K Docking Station is built for professionals who need a clean, capable desk setup without the cable clutter. Connecting via a single USB-C port, it expands your laptop's connectivity to nine devices at once — displays, peripherals, storage, and wired networking — all through one compact unit. Whether you're working from a fixed office desk or setting up in a shared workspace, this docking station gives you a structured, high-performance environment the moment you plug in.

Flexible Display Output — Triple Full HD or One Stunning 4K

Tired of working on a single laptop screen when you need more? product.name: Xiaomi Oscillation Electric Toothbrush Pro - Purple
product.description:
Upgrade your daily oral care routine with the Xiaomi Oscillation Electric Toothbrush Pro, engineered with intelligent oscillation technology and precision-driven performance. Designed around the clinically recognised Bass brushing technique, this advanced electric toothbrush intelligently identifies individual tooth surfaces and automatically adjusts the brushing angle and vibration intensity for a deeper, more targeted clean. A built-in 6-axis motion sensor detects brushing orientation in real time, ensuring optimal coverage across all areas of the mouth. Whether you’re focusing on hard-to-reach gaps or polishing visible surfaces, the toothbrush dynamically adapts to your brushing behaviour for a smarter, more effective clean every time.

The integrated smart colour digital display provides instant feedback on brushing coverage, recent brushing behaviour analysis, and operational mode selection. The screen automatically activates when the toothbrush is lifted, keeping you informed and in control of your oral hygiene. Designed for South African households seeking long-term reliability, the Xiaomi Oscillation Electric Toothbrush Pro delivers an impressive ultra-long battery life of up to 180 days in Gentle Mode and 100 days in Standard Mode, supported by convenient Type-C charging. With intelligent pressure detection that automatically reduces vibration when excessive force is applied, your gums remain protected while maintaining optimal plaque removal.

  • Smart surface oscillation cleaning powered by the Bass brushing technique
  • Advanced 6-axis sensor for real-time brushing coverage detection
  • Intelligent colour digital display with behavioural analysis feedback
  • Four specialised brushing modes for personalised oral care
  • Ultra-long battery life with Type-C fast charging
  • Cushioning copper-free toothbrush heads for safe, hygienic use
