product.name: Xiaomi Robot Vacuum H50
product.description:
The Xiaomi Robot Vacuum H50 is designed to bring effortless, intelligent cleaning into modern South African homes. Combining powerful 10,000Pa suction, advanced LDS laser navigation, and a multi-functional self-cleaning base station, this smart robotic vacuum and mop takes care of everyday cleaning with remarkable precision and efficiency. Equipped with high-speed rotary dual mopping technology, the Xiaomi H50 not only vacuums dust, crumbs, and pet hair but also actively scrubs floors for a deeper clean. Its dual anti-tangle main and side brush system helps prevent hair buildup, making it especially suitable for homes with pets or long hair. The robot’s intelligent LDS laser navigation system scans and maps your home in real time, creating accurate floor plans that allow the vacuum to clean methodically instead of randomly. With support for multi-floor mapping, zoned cleaning, and virtual walls, you have full control over where and how the vacuum operates.

The multi-functional self-cleaning base station elevates convenience to a whole new level. The station features separate 4L clean and dirty water tanks, allowing the robot to automatically wash its mop pads and manage water circulation while cleaning. This reduces maintenance while ensuring hygienic floor care. Paired with a long-lasting 5200mAh battery, the Xiaomi H50 can handle large homes with ease before automatically returning to its dock to recharge.

Through the Xiaomi Home App, users can remotely schedule cleaning sessions, track cleaning progress in real time, and customise cleaning zones for specific rooms. Voice assistant compatibility with Google Assistant and Amazon Alexa allows hands-free control, seamlessly integrating the H50 into your existing smart home ecosystem. Compact yet powerful, the robot’s slim 9.3cm height allows it to reach beneath sofas, beds, and cabinets where dust typically accumulates.

As a global leader in smart home technology, Xiaomi continues to deliver reliable, high-performance products designed to simplify everyday life. The Xiaomi Robot Vacuum H50 is an excellent choice for homeowners seeking automated, intelligent cleaning with minimal effort, combining advanced technology, powerful suction, and convenient self-maintenance features.

  • Automatic mop washing and water management with 4L clean water and 4L dirty water tanks, reducing manual maintenance.
  • Advanced dual mop pads rotate at high speed to scrub floors and remove stubborn dirt and stains.

product.name: ASUS ROG CROSSHAIR X870E HERO BTF AMD AM5 ATX Gaming Motherboard
product.description:
The ASUS ROG Crosshair X870E Hero BTF AMD AM5 ATX Gaming Motherboard redefines next-generation PC building with its revolutionary hidden-connector design, purpose-built for ultra-clean AMD Ryzen™ 9000 Series gaming rigs. Designed for South African enthusiasts who demand both performance and aesthetics, this flagship ROG motherboard integrates hidden motherboard, GPU power, USB and fan connectors to eliminate visible cables when paired with BTF-compatible graphics cards and chassis. Powered by the AMD X870E chipset and supporting AMD Ryzen™ 9000, 8000, and 7000 Series desktop processors on the AM5 socket, it delivers uncompromising performance with robust power delivery, PCIe® 5.0 support and advanced DDR5 memory architecture enhanced by NitroPath DRAM Technology. With Polymo Lighting II adding dynamic RGB illumination, your build doesn’t just perform at elite levels — it looks exceptional from every angle.

Built for cutting-edge gaming, streaming and content creation, the Crosshair X870E Hero BTF supports up to 256GB of DDR5 memory with speeds reaching 8200+MT/s (OC) on Ryzen™ 9000 Series processors, alongside AMD EXPO™, AEMP and DIMM Fit technologies for optimised stability and overclocking precision. Storage flexibility is unmatched, offering up to five M.2 slots (including PCIe® 5.0 x4 support for Ryzen™ 9000 & 7000 Series CPUs) plus four SATA 6Gb/s ports with AMD RAIDXpert2 support. Connectivity is equally future-ready, featuring dual USB4® 40Gbps Type-C® ports, Wi-Fi 7 (802.11be) with 320MHz bandwidth, Bluetooth® 5.4, Intel® 2.5Gb Ethernet and Realtek 5Gb Ethernet. SupremeFX audio with the ALC4082 codec and ESS® ES9219 QUAD DAC ensures crystal-clear 32-bit/384kHz playback, making it ideal for immersive gaming and high-fidelity media experiences.

These sensors actively counteract vibrations, preventing performance degradation and ensuring data integrity even under heavy load. The 7200rpm spindle speed coupled with a substantial 256MB cache significantly boosts read and write speeds, making file transfers faster and application responsiveness sharper within your NAS environment.

product.name: Antec VCX10M ARGB Micro-ATX | ITX Mini-Tower Gaming Chassis - Black
product.description:
The Antec VCX10M ARGB Mini-Tower Gaming Chassis is purpose-built for gamers and PC enthusiasts seeking a compact yet performance-driven case. Designed to accommodate Micro-ATX and Mini-ITX motherboards, the VCX10M offers exceptional cooling and component compatibility in a space-saving footprint. With a sleek 270° panoramic glass panel design across the front and side, this chassis puts your build on full display while adding a touch of modern elegance to any setup.

Optimised for thermal performance, the dual-chamber layout separates heat-generating components like the CPU and GPU from the PSU and storage drives, improving airflow and maintaining system stability. The chassis features large mesh intake vents along the side and bottom, promoting strong vertical cooling to quickly dissipate heat. This smart layout not only ensures efficient airflow but also protects your components from thermal throttling and premature wear.

The VCX10M comes pre-equipped with three 120mm ARGB fans—two reverse-mounted at the bottom and one at the rear—ensuring vibrant lighting and excellent airflow right out of the box. With additional support for up to five 120mm fans and a 120mm rear radiator, the case is ready for both air and AIO cooling solutions. This vertical airflow design maximises intake from below while effectively exhausting hot air, keeping your compact build cool under pressure.

Despite its smaller size, the VCX10M doesn’t compromise on functionality. With support for GPUs up to 260mm in length, CPU coolers up to 165mm, and PSUs up to 190mm, it delivers versatile hardware compatibility for gaming and productivity builds. The front I/O panel includes USB 3.0, USB 2.0, LED control, and HD audio, providing convenient access to your essential peripherals. Finished with tempered glass panels, a top-mounted dust filter, and modern ARGB accents, the Antec VCX10M strikes the perfect balance between compact design, cooling efficiency, and visual appeal.

  • Compact design with powerful heat dissipation
  • Tempered front and side glass panel
  • Panoramic 270° view with dual chamber design
  • Vertical cooling with massive air intake

  • Micro ATX and Mini ITX Motherboard Support

product.name: Antec Luna 360 ARGB CPU Liquid Cooler - White
product.description:
Upgrade your PC cooling performance with the Antec Luna 360 ARGB CPU Liquid Cooler, a powerful all-in-one liquid cooling solution designed for gamers, creators, and high-performance PC builds. Featuring an eye-catching infinity mirror pump head design, the Luna 360 creates stunning multi-layered lighting effects that add depth and style to any setup while maintaining exceptional thermal performance. Whether you're pushing your CPU during intense gaming sessions or heavy workloads, this cooler delivers reliable heat dissipation and stable performance for modern processors.

Engineered for both performance and durability, the Luna 360 utilises a massive copper base plate and high-density aluminium radiator to maximise heat transfer efficiency. Paired with three PWM ARGB 120mm fans, the cooler delivers strong airflow and optimised static pressure while keeping noise levels controlled for a quieter system. With elastic high-density tubing, efficient coolant flow of ≥2000 mL/min, and broad compatibility across the latest Intel and AMD sockets, the Luna 360 provides a versatile cooling upgrade that fits perfectly into modern gaming and workstation builds.

product.name: Antec MEGA 1000W 80 PLUS Gold ATX3.1 PCIE5.1 Fully Modular Power Supply
product.description:
Experience stable, efficient power delivery for your high-performance rig | Full modular design ensures clean builds and optimal airflow.

Quick Specs

  • Deliver a robust 1000W of 80 PLUS Gold certified power for demanding systems.
  • Enjoy peak efficiency and lower energy consumption with Active PFC.
  • Build with ease and manage cables effectively thanks to the full modular design.
  • Benefit from enhanced system stability and longevity through comprehensive protection circuits.
  • Keep your system cool and quiet with the 120mm HDB silent fan.

For the discerning PC builder in South Africa, the Antec MEGA 1000W 80 PLUS Gold Modular PC Power Supply is the foundational element of a stable, high-performance system.

This 1000W power supply is not merely a component; it is the lifeblood of your creation, ensuring that every other part receives the clean, reliable energy it requires to perform at its peak. Whether you are assembling a gaming powerhouse, a professional content creation workstation, or a demanding server, this modular power supply unit (PSU) provides the unwavering support essential for sustained operation and longevity. It is designed for those who understand that a superior build begins with a superior foundation, cutting through the noise of less capable alternatives with its robust specifications and enduring quality.

Uncompromising power delivery and efficiency in this 1000W power supply

At the core of the Antec MEGA 1000W lies its commitment to performance and efficiency. With a substantial 1000W output, this 1000W power supply confidently powers high-end CPUs and graphics cards, even under heavy loads. The 80 PLUS Gold certification signifies a minimum of 87% efficiency at 20% load, 90% at 50% load, and 87% at 100% load, translating directly into reduced energy waste, lower electricity bills, and less heat generation within your system. This enhanced efficiency is crucial for maintaining optimal operating temperatures and prolonging the lifespan of your components. The 1000W power supply ensures that your system receives ample energy for all its needs.

Intelligent design for a cleaner build with a modular power supply

The full modular design of this Antec power supply is a significant advantage for builders who value aesthetics and airflow. It means you only connect the necessary cables, eliminating the clutter of unused wires that can obstruct airflow and make cable management a chore. This approach not only results in a cleaner, more professional-looking build but also contributes to better internal cooling, further safeguarding your valuable components from heat-related degradation. This modular power supply system is designed for ease of use and optimal performance.

Engineered for reliability and peace of mind with a 1000W power supply

Your investment deserves protection. The Antec MEGA 1000W is equipped with an extensive suite of protection circuits, including Over Current Protection (OCP), Over Voltage Protection (OVP), Under Voltage Protection (UVP), Short Circuit Protection (SCP), Over Power Protection (OPP), Over Temperature Protection (OTP), Surge and Inrush Current Limiter (SIP), and Non-Linear Operation (NLO). These safeguards work in concert to shield your system from power irregularities, ensuring the safety of your components and the stability of your operations. This comprehensive protection offers unparalleled peace of mind, allowing you to focus on your tasks without worrying about power-related failures from your 1000W power supply.

Silent operation meets superior cooling in this PC Power Supply

Keeping your system running smoothly requires effective cooling without adding unnecessary noise. The 120mm Hydro Dynamic Bearing (HDB) silent fan is engineered for durability and quiet operation. HDB fans offer a longer lifespan compared to traditional sleeve bearings and operate at significantly reduced noise levels, ensuring that your powerful PC power supply remains a quiet presence, whether you are gaming intensely or working on a critical project.

FEATURES:

  • Provide your PC power supply system with up to 1000 watts of stable, reliable power, certified for 80 PLUS Gold efficiency.
  • Achieve optimal power conversion and reduce energy waste with advanced Active PFC technology in this 1000W power supply.
  • Streamline your build process and enhance airflow by connecting only the necessary modular cables with this modular power supply.
  • Protect your valuable components from electrical anomalies with a complete array of industry-standard safety protections.
  • Maintain a quiet computing environment thanks to the efficient and durable 120mm HDB silent fan.
  • Ensure compatibility with the latest hardware standards with ATX12V3.1 and full modularity.

  • Type: ATX12V3.1
  • Modular: Full-Modular
  • Input Voltage: 100V-240V
  • Input Current: 12A-6A
  • Input Frequency Range: 50Hz-60Hz
  • PFC: Active PFC
  • Power Good Signal: 100-150ms
  • Protection: OCP, OVP, UVP, SCP, OPP, OTP, SIP, NLO

product.name: Xiaomi 45W Nano Turbo Power Adapter (2 port)
product.description:
The Xiaomi 45W Nano Turbo Power Adapter (2-Port) delivers powerful, efficient charging in an ultra-compact design built for modern lifestyles. Engineered with advanced GaN (Gallium Nitride) fast-charging technology, this adapter offers higher efficiency and improved thermal performance compared to traditional silicon chargers. With a maximum 45W output, it provides rapid charging for a wide range of devices, including smartphones, tablets, wireless earbuds, and other USB Type-C powered gadgets. Designed for convenience, the adapter features two USB Type-C ports, allowing you to charge multiple devices simultaneously without compromising speed. Its compact form factor makes it perfect for travel, office use, or everyday charging at home.

Built with durable PC material and supporting universal 100–240V input, the Xiaomi 45W Nano Turbo Power Adapter is ideal for users who need reliable performance both locally and internationally. The charger supports multiple fast-charging protocols, including QC2.0, QC3.0, PD (Power Delivery), and PPS, ensuring compatibility with a wide range of mainstream devices from leading brands. Despite its powerful output, the adapter remains lightweight at only 72.5g, making it easy to carry in a bag or pocket. Its space-saving design ensures it fits neatly into crowded power strips or wall sockets, while the clean white finish complements modern tech setups. For South African users seeking a versatile, travel-ready charging solution, this adapter combines speed, safety, and portability in one sleek device.

  • Dual USB Type-C ports enable simultaneous charging of two devices

product.name: Xiaomi UltraThin Magnetic Power Bank 5000 15W - Black
product.description:
The Xiaomi UltraThin Magnetic Power Bank 5000 15W is engineered for modern smartphone users who demand portable power without compromising on style or performance. Designed with an incredibly slim 6mm profile and weighing just 98g, this ultra-light power bank easily slips into a pocket, handbag, or laptop sleeve—making it ideal for commuters, travellers, and everyday users across South Africa. Its premium aluminium alloy casing combined with a glass fibre charging panel delivers a refined finish while maintaining durability and efficient wireless power transfer. Built around a high-density Silicon-Carbon Anode lithium-ion battery, the device offers improved energy efficiency and compact battery storage, ensuring reliable performance in a remarkably slim form factor.

Equipped with magnetic induction wireless charging, the power bank securely attaches to compatible smartphones, including Xiaomi devices and the iPhone 17 series, for seamless cable-free charging up to 15W. When faster charging is required, the USB Type-C wired output delivers up to 22.5W, enabling quick power top-ups for phones, earbuds, and other USB Type-C powered devices. The intelligent design also supports simultaneous wired and wireless charging, allowing two devices to be powered at once. Xiaomi integrates multiple advanced safety protections, including ESD protection and input over-voltage protection, ensuring stable charging performance while safeguarding both the power bank and connected devices.

  • Only 6mm thick with a 98g ultra-light build, finished with a durable aluminium alloy casing and glass fibre charging surface.
  • Advanced lithium-ion battery architecture provides efficient energy storage in a compact form factor.

product.description:
Build your compact gaming rig with superior airflow and flexibility; the CH160 PLUS offers ample space for high-performance components in a refined Micro-ATX form factor.

Quick Specs

  • Optimise your build with support for both Mini-ITX and Micro-ATX motherboards.
  • Install a full-sized ATX power supply for robust system power, or choose compact SFX/SFX-L options.
  • Experience exceptional thermal management with support for multiple fan configurations and liquid cooling radiators.
  • Accommodate high-performance graphics cards up to 342mm in length.
  • Enjoy a clean build with ample space for cable management and storage devices.

Unleash your gaming potential within the Deepcool CH160 PLUS Micro-ATX Gaming PC Case

Engineered for the discerning gamer who values both performance and a streamlined aesthetic, this Micro-ATX gaming PC case is the perfect foundation for a compact yet powerful gaming PC. It caters to those who understand that true performance lies not just in raw power, but in intelligent design and efficient thermal management. The CH160 PLUS is crafted for builders who demand flexibility, allowing for the integration of high-end components without sacrificing valuable desk space. Whether you are constructing your first gaming rig or upgrading a seasoned battle station, this Micro-ATX gaming PC case provides the robust support and ample room needed for a truly exceptional gaming experience.

Adaptable cooling for peak performance

Maintaining optimal temperatures is crucial for sustained gaming performance, and the CH160 PLUS excels in this regard. It supports a variety of cooling solutions to ensure your components operate at their best. The chassis accommodates up to three 120mm fans, with specific configurations available for the top and rear panels. Furthermore, it is equipped to handle liquid cooling, featuring radiator support for 120mm or 240mm options at the top, and a 120mm radiator at the rear. This versatility in cooling ensures that even the most demanding CPUs and GPUs can be kept within ideal thermal limits, preventing throttling and maximising frame rates during intense gaming sessions.

Designed for powerful components in a Micro-ATX Gaming PC Case

The Deepcool CH160 PLUS Micro-ATX gaming PC case does not compromise on compatibility with high-performance hardware. It supports CPU coolers up to an impressive 164mm in height, allowing for a wide range of air cooling solutions. For graphics, it offers a generous GPU length limit of 342mm, accommodating most modern, high-end graphics cards. Powering these components is made flexible with support for standard ATX PS2 power supplies (up to 140mm) as well as compact SFX and SFX-L power supplies. This adaptability ensures that you can build a system tailored to your specific performance needs without being constrained by the chassis size, making it an ideal Micro-ATX gaming PC case.

Streamlined storage and expansion for your Gaming PC Case

Storage and expandability are key considerations for any gaming PC, and the CH160 PLUS provides a balanced approach. It features dedicated bays for both 3.5-inch and 2.5-inch drives, offering flexibility for your operating system, games, and media libraries. With one 3.5" drive bay and two 2.5" drive bays (one standard, one combinable), you have sufficient space for essential storage. Additionally, the chassis includes four expansion slots, providing the necessary room to install your graphics card, sound card, or other PCIe devices, ensuring your build is ready for whatever challenges come your way within this gaming PC case.

A foundation for refined gaming builds with a Tempered Glass PC Case

This gaming PC case is more than just a container for your components; it is a carefully designed environment that promotes clean builds and efficient airflow. The inclusion of a tempered glass side panel offers a clear view of your meticulously assembled hardware, transforming your PC into a display piece. The strategic placement of fan mounts and radiator support ensures that heat is effectively channelled away from critical components, contributing to the longevity and stability of your system. For builders in South Africa looking for a compact, high-performance Micro-ATX solution, the CH160 PLUS represents a clear choice for their next gaming PC build.

  • Optimise your setup with support for Mini-ITX and Micro-ATX motherboards, offering broad compatibility for your preferred components within this Micro-ATX gaming PC case.
  • Install a powerful ATX PS2 power supply (up to 140mm) or choose space-saving SFX/SFX-L options to meet your system's power demands in your gaming PC case.
  • Achieve superior cooling performance with support for multiple fan installations and radiators, ensuring your components remain at optimal temperatures in this tempered glass PC case.
  • Accommodate long, high-performance graphics cards with a generous GPU length limit of 342mm, perfect for intense gaming sessions.
  • Organise your build efficiently with space for essential storage devices, including one 3.5" drive and two 2.5" drive bays.
  • Showcase your build through the elegant tempered glass side panel, offering a clear view of your internal components.
  • Ensure robust thermal management with four expansion slots, allowing for additional hardware and customisation in your Micro-ATX gaming PC case.

product.name: UGREEN FineTrack Slim Pro Smart Tracker for Android and iOS
product.description:
Locate your belongings with precision on both Android and iOS devices; never lose your valuables again with this essential home tech accessory.

Quick Specs

  • Seamlessly track items across both Android and iOS ecosystems.
  • Receive instant notifications when a lost item is nearby.
  • Benefit from a robust IP68 water and dust resistance rating for durability.
  • Enjoy peace of mind with up to 5 years of theoretical battery life.
  • Utilise a slim, card-like design that fits easily into wallets or bags.

Find what matters, effortlessly, with the UGREEN FineTrack Slim Pro

In the fast pace of modern life, misplacing essential items is an unavoidable frustration. The UGREEN FineTrack Slim Pro smart tracker is engineered to eliminate this anxiety, offering a sophisticated yet simple solution for locating your valuables. Designed for both Android and iOS users, this tracker integrates seamlessly with your smartphone, turning your device into a powerful locating tool. Whether it's your wallet, keys, or a crucial bag, the FineTrack Slim Pro provides the clarity and confidence you need to keep track of your most important possessions. This is not just an accessory; it is an indispensable companion for maintaining order and peace of mind in your daily life. For those seeking a reliable wallet tracker card, this device offers unparalleled precision.

Locate your belongings with precision and ease

The core of the FineTrack Slim Pro's capability lies in its cross-platform compatibility and advanced locating technology. For iOS users, it integrates directly with the Apple Find My network, leveraging the collective power of millions of Apple devices to help you pinpoint your tracker's location, even when it's out of your direct range. Android users benefit from the Google Find Hub, providing a similar, robust network for tracking. This dual-ecosystem support ensures that no matter your preferred device, you have access to a comprehensive system for finding your lost items. The audible location alert feature allows you to sound a chime directly from the tracker, guiding you precisely to your lost item. This makes it an exceptional smart tracker for Android devices.

Durability meets intelligent design

Life happens, and your tracker needs to keep up. The UGREEN FineTrack Slim Pro is built to withstand the elements with an IP68 water and dust resistance rating. This means it can endure submersion in water and is protected against dust ingress, making it suitable for use in virtually any environment. Its ultra-slim, card-like profile, measuring only 0.2cm in thickness, ensures it can be discreetly placed in wallets, passport holders, or attached to other items without adding bulk. This thoughtful design prioritises both resilience and practical application, ensuring the tracker is always ready when you need it most. The slim profile makes it a perfect wallet tracker card.

Long-lasting performance for unwavering reliability

One of the most significant advantages of the FineTrack Slim Pro is its exceptional battery performance. Equipped with a 540mAh Polymer Lithium-Ion Battery, it offers a theoretical operating life of up to 5 years. This means you can set it and forget it, with the assurance that your tracker will remain active and ready to help for years to come. This extended operational life underscores the tracker's reliability and its value as a long-term solution for asset tracking. This is a smart tracker that offers peace of mind through its enduring power.

Peace of mind, delivered to your door

The UGREEN FineTrack Slim Pro is more than just a tracking device; it's a commitment to safeguarding your belongings. Device sharing capabilities allow you to grant access to trusted friends or family members, so they can also help locate your items. Furthermore, the lost item notifications ensure you are alerted immediately if your tracker is detected by the network, providing an invaluable layer of security. For anyone seeking a dependable, versatile, and long-lasting solution to keep their valuables secure, this wallet tracker card is the clear choice, offering seamless tracking for both iPhone and Android users.

Features

  • Locate your lost items with ease using the extensive Apple Find My network on iOS devices, ideal for iPhone users.
  • Find your misplaced belongings efficiently via the Google Find Hub on Android devices, ensuring robust tracking.
  • Receive immediate alerts when your tracker comes within range of your paired device.
  • Easily locate items nearby by triggering an audible alert directly from the tracker.
  • Protect your tracker from the elements with its IP68 water and dust resistance.
  • Enjoy a remarkably thin, card-like design that fits discreetly into wallets and bags, functioning perfectly as a wallet tracker card.
  • Benefit from an exceptional theoretical battery life of up to 5 years for long-term tracking.
  • Share device access with trusted individuals, allowing them to help locate your items.

product.name: Cudy C200P 2-IN-1 SMB Router / AP Controller
product.description:
2-in-1 Gigabit VPN Router and AP Controller | 4 × PoE+ Ports with 60W Power Supply | Centralised Cudy AP Management | WireGuard, OpenVPN & IPsec VPN

Quick Specs

  • Consolidate your network infrastructure — the C200P serves as both a Gigabit VPN router and a centralised AP controller in a single compact unit.
  • Power up to four access points cable-free with four IEEE 802.3at/af PoE+ LAN ports and a 60W total power supply.
  • Secure your network with built-in VPN server and client support for WireGuard, OpenVPN, IPsec, ZeroTier, PPTP, and L2TP.
  • Manage up to 200 Cudy Access Points from one interface, with multi-SSID, captive portal, and seamless Cudy Mesh support.
  • Deploy flexibly — mount on a wall or sit on a desktop thanks to the compact metal chassis measuring just 190 × 100 × 28 mm.

One Device, Two Roles — Router and AP Controller in a Single Box

The Cudy C200P is designed for small and medium-sized businesses that need a clean, manageable network without deploying multiple separate devices. It operates simultaneously as a Gigabit VPN router handling your internet connection and as a centralised controller for your Cudy Access Points, letting you oversee your entire wireless infrastructure from a single unified interface. It can also run exclusively in AP Controller mode if a separate router is already in place, giving you the flexibility to slot it into an existing network without redesigning your topology.

Power Your Access Points Directly — No Extra Switches Required

Tired of hunting for spare power sockets every time you install an access point? The C200P's four Gigabit LAN ports (ports 2–5) are all PoE+ outputs compliant with IEEE 802.3at/af, delivering up to 30W per port and up to 55W total PoE budget from the built-in 60W power supply. That means you can run up to four Cudy APs — wall-plate, ceiling-mount, outdoor, or desktop form factors — directly from this unit over a single Ethernet cable each, eliminating the need for a separate PoE switch in most small-site deployments.

Serious VPN Capability Baked In

The C200P does not treat VPN as an afterthought. As VPN server it supports WireGuard, OpenVPN, IPsec, ZeroTier, PPTP, and L2TP, and as a VPN client it can tunnel outbound traffic through the same protocol range. WireGuard throughput reaches 213 Mbps upload and 152 Mbps download in server mode, while OpenVPN delivers 22 Mbps in both directions — solid figures for an SMB router at this price point. Maximum concurrent tunnels are 20 for IPSec and 16 each for PPTP/L2TP and OpenVPN, giving you ample headroom for remote staff and branch-to-branch links.

Manage Your Wireless Network from a Single Dashboard

In Main Router and AP Controller mode the C200P can manage up to 10 Cudy APs supporting up to 100 clients; in standalone AP Controller mode that ceiling rises to 200 APs. The management interface covers quick setup, AP management, multi-SSID configuration (up to 4 SSIDs per band), captive portal for guest networks, MAC filtering, IP/MAC binding, Wi-Fi time schedules, and per-device internet and VPN on/off controls. Remote management is available via HTTPS and TR-069/TR-098/TR-111/TR-181, and the dashboard surfaces internet, WAN, LAN, VPN, and DHCP server status at a glance.

Features

  • Functions as a Gigabit VPN router, centralised AP controller, or AP controller only — three deployment modes in one unit.
  • 4 × Gigabit PoE+ LAN ports (IEEE 802.3at/af, up to 30W per port) for cable-and-power delivery to Cudy Access Points.
  • 60W total power supply with 55W PoE budget (50W when a USB device is connected).
  • VPN server and client: WireGuard, OpenVPN, IPsec, ZeroTier, PPTP, L2TP — up to 20 concurrent IPSec tunnels.
  • Cudy Mesh support for seamless roaming across compatible Cudy APs (wall-plate, ceiling-mount, outdoor, desktop).
  • Captive portal and multi-SSID management (up to 4 SSIDs per band) via centralised AP controller interface.
  • 1 × USB 3.0 port with Samba server functionality and Wake on LAN support.
  • SPI firewall, DoS protection, DNS over TLS (Cloudflare, Google, Quad9, Custom), and comprehensive IPv4/IPv6 support.
  • Compact metal chassis with desktop and wall-mount installation options.

product.name: Cudy WR300S 300Mbps 5-Port Wi-Fi 4 Router – White
product.description:
Cudy WR300S 300Mbps 5-Port Wi-Fi 4 Router – White

300Mbps Wi-Fi | 5 Fast Ethernet Ports | 5-in-1 Modes | VPN Client | Ideal for Small Homes

Quick Specs

• 300Mbps Wi-Fi 4 performance on 2.4GHz
• 5 Fast Ethernet ports (1× WAN + 4× LAN)
• 5-in-1 Modes: Router / Access Point / Extender / WISP / Client
• Built-in VPN Client (WireGuard, PPTP, L2TP)
• Covers up to 90m² with 4 external antennas

Compact & Versatile for Everyday Connectivity

The WR300S is designed for apartments, small homes and offices needing stable, affordable internet coverage. With 300Mbps wireless speeds and four high-gain external antennas, it delivers reliable signal strength for browsing, HD streaming and smart home connectivity.

Its five Fast Ethernet ports allow you to connect gaming consoles, smart TVs, desktop PCs and network devices without relying entirely on Wi-Fi, helping to reduce congestion and maintain stable performance. Whether you're upgrading an older router or setting up a secondary network, the WR300S provides flexible deployment options without complexity.

Flexible 5-in-1 Multi-Mode Operation

The WR300S is designed to adapt easily to different network environments with five versatile operating modes. In Router Mode, it functions as a standard home router, sharing your internet connection across multiple wired and wireless devices. Access Point Mode allows you to add Wi-Fi to an existing wired network, making it ideal for expanding coverage in offices or larger homes. When set to Range Extender Mode, it boosts and extends an existing wireless signal to improve coverage in areas with weak reception. WISP Mode enables connection to a wireless internet service provider, making it suitable for fixed wireless setups. In Client Mode, the router can provide wired network access to devices by connecting them to an existing Wi-Fi network. This flexibility makes the WR300S a practical solution for fibre connections, fixed wireless services, or repurposing older networking equipment.

Secure & Private Networking

With built-in VPN client support for WireGuard, PPTP and L2TP, the WR300S lets you secure your entire home network through a private, encrypted connection without needing to install VPN software on every device. This means safer browsing, protected online banking, and added privacy for streaming, gaming, and remote work across all connected devices.

Advanced WPA3 Wi-Fi encryption, an integrated SPI firewall and DoS protection help safeguard your home network from hackers and cyber threats. Guest Wi-Fi access allows visitors to connect without exposing your main network, while per-device management features give you full control over who is connected and how your internet is used.

Reliable Hardware for Stable Performance

Powered by a reliable 580MHz processor and 64MB of RAM, the WR300S delivers stable, consistent Wi-Fi performance for home internet connections up to 100Mbps. It’s built to handle everyday online activities such as HD streaming, video calls, remote work, social media browsing and smart home connectivity without lag or constant buffering. Whether multiple devices are connected at once or you’re working from home while others stream, the router maintains smooth and dependable performance.

Four high-gain external antennas help extend Wi-Fi coverage throughout your home, improving signal strength and reducing dead zones in bedrooms, living areas and home offices. For users who need expanded coverage, the WR300S is compatible with Cudy Mesh systems, allowing it to function as a mesh satellite for seamless whole-home Wi-Fi coverage with better roaming and fewer connection drops.

For too long, areas of your South African home have been starved of reliable internet. This Cudy AX1500 dual-band wifi extender is designed to end that frustration. Transform your workspace with next-generation connectivity: the Cudy BE3600 Wi-Fi 7 Ceiling Access Point

Designed for the demands of modern South African businesses, the Cudy BE3600 is not merely an access point; it is the foundation for a superior network. Whether your environment is a bustling office, a sprawling campus, a busy shopping mall, or any space requiring robust connectivity for a high number of users, this Cudy PoE access point is engineered to perform. It addresses the critical need for speed, capacity, and reliability, ensuring that every user experiences seamless internet access. Forget the limitations of older Wi-Fi standards; this dual-band access point is built for the future, capable of handling the most data-intensive applications and the ever-increasing number of connected devices. The seamless integration of its PoE capabilities simplifies deployment, offering a clean and efficient network setup.

Unrivalled speed and capacity for demanding environments

At the core of the BE3600 lies Wi-Fi 7 technology, offering a total throughput of up to 3570 Mbps. This is achieved through dual-band operation, with the 5 GHz band reaching an impressive 2882 Mbps and the 2.4 GHz band providing 688 Mbps. Coupled with a 160 MHz max channel width and advanced 4K-QAM modulation, this access point significantly boosts network efficiency and speed. The inclusion of MLO (Multi-Link Operation), MRU (Multi-Resource Unit), OFDMA, and MU-MIMO ensures that the Cudy BE3600 PoE access point can communicate with multiple devices simultaneously and efficiently, minimizing latency and maximizing throughput even under heavy load. This makes it an ideal solution for environments where network congestion is a common challenge.

Extensive coverage and device support for seamless user experience

The Cudy BE3600 is designed to cover substantial areas, with a recommended coverage of up to 120 m² and a maximum range of 220 m. This extensive reach ensures that even large spaces are adequately served by a strong, stable Wi-Fi signal from this dual-band access point. Furthermore, its capacity to support up to 512 connected devices, with a recommendation of up to 200 active devices, makes it perfectly suited for high-density locations such as conference centres, lecture halls, or busy office floors. This means fewer access points are needed to achieve comprehensive coverage, simplifying installation and reducing costs, especially when leveraging its PoE functionality.

Simplified integration and robust management

Installation and management are streamlined for business efficiency. The BE3600 supports both wall and ceiling mounting, offering flexibility to suit any office layout. Powering this robust PoE access point is straightforward thanks to its support for IEEE 802.3at/af and passive PoE, allowing for a single Ethernet cable to provide both data and power. Its 2.5G Ethernet port ensures that the uplink speed is not a bottleneck, capable of supporting the high throughput of Wi-Fi 7. Management is equally accessible, with options for local web interface, app control, and TR-069 support for centralized network management, ensuring your network is always running optimally with this powerful dual-band access point.

The Value of Pure Air, Delivered Simply

Investing in the Xiaomi Mijia Smart Air Purifier 6 means investing in your health and the health of your loved ones. Its comprehensive filtration, intelligent monitoring, and user-friendly smart controls deliver exceptional value, addressing common household concerns of allergens, odours, and indoor air pollutants effectively. product.name: WINX CALL Elite ANC Ear Cub Replacements
product.description:
Restore comfort and clarity to your WINX CALL Elite ANC headset with durable TPE replacement ear pads.

Quick Specs

  • Rediscover lasting comfort for extended calls.
  • Ensure a perfect fit for your WINX WX-HS112 or WX-HS113 headset.
  • Maintain crisp audio clarity by replacing worn-out pads.
  • Enjoy the simple, robust design in classic black.
  • Equip yourself with two high-quality replacement earpads for immediate use.

Revitalise your WINX CALL Elite ANC headset for uninterrupted productivity

For the professional navigating the demands of modern communication, comfort is not a luxury; it is a prerequisite for sustained focus. Worn-out ear pads on your WINX headset can degrade both your comfort and the auditory performance crucial for clear client interactions. These replacement ear pads are engineered to restore the original comfort and audio fidelity of your WINX WX-HS112 or WX-HS113 ANC headsets. They are designed for the discerning South African professional who understands that the right tools are essential for success. Investing in these office headset ear replacement pads means investing in your productivity and the clarity of every conversation.

Engineered for enduring comfort and sound integrity

The selection of TPE (Thermoplastic Elastomer) as the primary material for these earpads is a deliberate choice, balancing durability with a soft, yielding texture. TPE offers superior resistance to wear and tear compared to traditional materials, ensuring these headset comfort pads will last through countless calls and long workdays. The material's inherent properties also contribute to effective acoustic sealing, crucial for the noise-cancelling effectiveness of your ANC headset. This means you experience less background interference and more of the conversation you need to hear, a vital benefit in any busy office environment or home workspace.

A perfect fit for your WINX headset

Compatibility is paramount. These replacement earcups are precisely designed to integrate seamlessly with the WINX WX-HS112 and WX-HS113 CALL Elite ANC headset models. The easy installation process ensures that you can quickly replace old, degraded pads without tools or technical expertise. This ensures minimal downtime, allowing you to return to your important calls with renewed comfort and confidence. The secure fit prevents slippage and maintains the headset's intended ergonomic design, ensuring it feels as good as new.

The value of a fresh start for your audio

The audible difference between worn-out ear pads and fresh ones can be significant. Degraded pads can absorb sound, muffle frequencies, and compromise the seal needed for effective noise cancellation. By replacing them with these TPE ear pads, you not only regain lost comfort but also restore the acoustic integrity of your headset. These office headset ear replacement pads are vital for maintaining the premium audio experience your WINX headset provides. For professionals in South Africa, this translates to more effective communication and fewer misunderstandings, directly impacting your work quality.

Designed for the demanding professional

These earpads are for the individual who relies on their headset day in and day out. Whether you are on back-to-back client calls, participating in long virtual meetings, or require quiet focus in a bustling environment, the comfort and performance these headset comfort pads provide are indispensable. The simple, black aesthetic ensures they blend seamlessly with the professional design of your WINX headset, maintaining a polished appearance. They are a direct solution for enhancing the longevity and effectiveness of your existing audio equipment.

FEATURES:

  • Restore original comfort with soft, durable TPE material for extended wear.
  • Maintain optimal audio clarity and noise cancellation by replacing worn earcups.
  • Ensure a precise fit for WINX WX-HS112 and WX-HS113 ANC headsets for seamless integration.
  • Benefit from easy installation, allowing you to quickly refresh your headset's comfort and performance.
  • Receive two black earpads, providing an immediate solution and a spare for future needs.

  • Material: TPE
  • Number of earpads: 2
  • Colour: Black
  • Compatibility: WINX WX-HS112 and WX-HS113

Why WINX?

WINX is dedicated to enhancing your professional audio experience. We understand the critical role of reliable communication tools in South Africa's dynamic business landscape. Our accessories are designed with precision and durability in mind, ensuring your WINX equipment performs at its best, call after call. These replacement earcups Winx are crafted to uphold our commitment to quality.

product.name: Patriot Signature Line 64GB DDR5 5600MHz Desktop Memory
product.description:
Upgrade your desktop with Patriot’s Signature Line 64GB DDR5 5600MHz UDIMM, engineered to meet the growing demands of next-generation computing. Tailored for Intel’s latest platforms, this DDR5 memory module delivers a massive leap in bandwidth and responsiveness, with a blazing 5600MT/s data rate (PC5-44800). Designed to optimize both power efficiency and thermal performance, it runs on just 1.1V, generating less heat without compromising speed—ideal for performance enthusiasts and professional-grade system builds.

The module features a Power Management Integrated Circuit (PMIC), providing precise local voltage regulation and advanced monitoring to ensure peak efficiency under heavy workloads. Integrated thermal sensors offer real-time temperature management to safeguard against overheating, while on-die ECC (Error-Correcting Code) boosts system stability by ensuring accurate data processing. Built to exacting standards and rigorously 100% tested, the Signature Line DDR5 module guarantees compatibility, reliability, and endurance under demanding conditions.

With a limited lifetime warranty and support for the latest DDR5 standards, Patriot’s Signature Line memory is the perfect drop-in upgrade for desktops seeking faster multitasking, lower latency, and long-term durability in everyday and intensive use scenarios.

FEATURES:

  • Signature Line Series
  • PC5-44800 (5600MHz) Data Rate
  • Double-sided Module

  • Non-ECC Unbuffered UDIMM
  • On-Die ECC
  • 100% Tested
  • Limited Lifetime Warranty

product.description:

The PURE MAC Mouse: Precision for the Modern Workflow

Designed for the discerning user who values both form and function, the Port Connect PURE MAC Rechargeable Wireless & Bluetooth Mouse is an essential tool for your daily tasks. Whether you are a creative professional, a student, or an office administrator, this mouse offers the reliability and precision needed to enhance your productivity. Its elegant beige finish complements any workspace, particularly those favouring the clean aesthetic often associated with Apple devices. This wireless mouse for laptop is not merely an accessory; it is an extension of your digital intent, ensuring every click and scroll is deliberate and effective. Embrace a clutter-free desk and a streamlined workflow with a device engineered for sustained performance.

Unmatched Connectivity and Control for Your Ergonomic Mouse Needs

The PURE MAC mouse offers dual connectivity options, allowing you to switch between a reliable wireless connection and seamless Bluetooth pairing. Connect to your computer, tablet, or other compatible devices within a 10-meter range without being tethered by wires. This rechargeable wireless mouse is perfect for those seeking ultimate freedom. The advanced optical sensor is adjustable, offering DPI settings from 1000 up to 3200. This adaptability ensures you can fine-tune the cursor speed to your preference, whether you are performing detailed design work or navigating large spreadsheets with speed. The four-button layout, including a tactile scroll wheel, provides intuitive control over your digital environment.

Designed for Enduring Performance and Comfort

At the core of the PURE MAC mouse is a robust 500mAh rechargeable lithium battery. This capacity ensures extended periods of use on a single charge, minimising interruptions to your workflow. When it is time to recharge, the process is simple and efficient. The mouse's construction from durable ABS/PCBA materials guarantees longevity, while its ergonomic dimensions of 11 x 6.5 x 2.5 cm and a weight of just 85g make it comfortable to hold and manoeuvre, even during prolonged work sessions. This thoughtful design reduces strain and fatigue, allowing you to focus on your work, making it an ideal wireless mouse for laptop users.

Streamline Your Setup with an Ergonomic Mouse

In today's workspace, efficiency and aesthetics go hand-in-hand. The Port Connect PURE MAC mouse helps achieve both. Eliminate the need for disposable batteries and tangled wires with this rechargeable wireless mouse. Its straightforward pairing process means you can set up and start working in minutes. The neutral yet stylish beige colour adds a touch of personality without overpowering your setup. For those seeking a dependable, versatile, and comfortable mouse that keeps pace with their demands, this rechargeable wireless and Bluetooth option is a clear choice for enhancing your daily digital interactions. The ergonomic mouse design ensures comfort for all users.

  • Built-in USB Type-C rechargeable battery up to 1 month autonomy
  • FreeWheel® technology for ultra-fast and high-precision scrolling
  • Left/right navigation with scroll wheel
  • Ambidextrous design
  • Adjustable speed optical sensor 1000/1600/2400/3200 DPI
  • Device selection mode enables connection to 2 separate devices (via Bluetooth® technology)
  • Silent clicks for a peaceful working environment
  • 4 buttons including wireless connection selection button

  • Minimalist and elegant design crafted to blend perfectly with the Apple® environment

product.name: WINX VIBE Comfort 3 Wireless Headphones
product.description:
Tune out the world, tune into your sound: the WINX VIBE Comfort 3 over ear wireless headphones for South Africa

These are not merely headphones; they are a sanctuary for your ears. Designed for the discerning listener in South Africa, the WINX VIBE Comfort 3 Wireless ENC Headphones cut through the cacophony of daily life, delivering an auditory experience of exceptional clarity and depth. Whether you are navigating the bustling streets of Cape Town, focusing in a shared office space, or simply seeking solace in your personal audio library, these over ear wireless headphones create a personal audio haven. They are for the student demanding focus, the professional requiring clarity on calls, and the music lover who appreciates every nuance of their favourite tracks. This is sound engineered for purpose, built for performance, and refined for everyday life.

Silence the noise, amplify the experience

At the core of the WINX VIBE Comfort 3 lies its sophisticated Environmental Noise Cancellation (ENC) technology. This system employs a dual-microphone array to intelligently identify and suppress distracting ambient sounds. Imagine eliminating the drone of traffic, the chatter of a busy environment, or the hum of airplane engines, leaving only your chosen audio. This is not just about passive sound blocking; it is an active process that ensures your music, podcasts, or calls remain pristine and uninterrupted, allowing for a truly immersive listening experience that respects your focus and your enjoyment. These wireless headphones with mic ensure your voice is heard clearly.

Uncompromising sound quality and connectivity

The WINX VIBE Comfort 3 headphones are driven by 40mm dynamic drivers, precisely engineered to reproduce audio across the full 20-20KHz frequency range. This ensures rich bass, clear mids, and crisp highs, faithfully recreating the artist's intended sound. Connectivity is equally robust, featuring the latest Bluetooth 5.3 for a stable, low-latency connection up to 10 meters, alongside a versatile 3.5mm AUX port for wired listening. This dual-mode capability guarantees compatibility with a vast array of devices, from the latest smartphones and laptops to older audio equipment, providing a reliable link to your sound. The 40mm drivers deliver unparalleled audio fidelity.

Designed for endurance and all-day comfort

Recognising that listening sessions can extend for hours, the WINX VIBE Comfort 3 prioritises comfort and longevity. The robust 400mAh battery delivers an exceptional operating time of up to 60 hours on a single charge, with up to 40 hours of continuous use when the microphone is active. A full charge takes a mere 2 hours via the modern Type-C port. The ergonomic design ensures that the headphones rest comfortably, making them ideal for extended wear without discomfort or fatigue.

Built for the demands of modern life

These headphones are constructed to withstand the rigours of daily use. The combination of ABS, PP, and PU materials ensures a balance of durability and light weight, with the PU earcups providing a soft, comfortable seal. Operating within a wide temperature range of -20℃ to 55℃, they are designed to perform reliably in various conditions encountered across South Africa. The thoughtful dimensions and weight of 240g contribute to a comfortable fit, making them an indispensable companion for travel, work, and leisure. These headphones 40mm driver technology ensures every note is heard.

product.name: Giada DN84 RK3576 Onboard 8GB LPDDR4 64GB EMMC (Optional: 128GB) 2xHDMI 1xSim-Card Slot Wi-fi
product.description:
Seamlessly power digital signage and robust data processing with dual 4K HDMI outputs and an energy-efficient, fanless ARM architecture for reliable operation in demanding South African environments.

Quick Specs

  • Effortlessly drive two 4K displays simultaneously for comprehensive visual output.
  • Experience silent, reliable operation thanks to its fanless, all-metal construction.
  • Benefit from energy efficiency with a low 6W TDP, reducing operational costs.
  • Adapt to diverse needs with flexible operating system choices of Android 14 or Debian 12.
  • Ensure robust connectivity with Wi-Fi 6, Gigabit Ethernet, and multiple USB 3.2 ports.

Engineered for sustained performance and visual precision

The Giada DN84 Fanless ARM Player is meticulously crafted for professionals in South Africa who require unwavering reliability and high-definition visual output. This barebone system is the foundation for digital signage, information kiosks, and industrial control applications where a stable, high-performance computing solution is paramount. Its robust, fanless metal construction ensures efficient heat dissipation and silent operation, making it ideal for environments where dust and noise are unwelcome. The Rockchip RK3576 processor, coupled with versatile connectivity options, provides the power and flexibility to meet rigorous demands without compromise. This player is a testament to Giada’s commitment to delivering exceptional barebone systems.

Uncompromising visual clarity for impactful displays

Leveraging the power of the Rockchip RK3576 chipset, the Giada DN84 supports dual HDMI outputs, each capable of delivering stunning 4K resolution at 60Hz. This dual-display capability is critical for applications requiring expansive digital signage, multi-panel information displays, or complex industrial monitoring setups. As a 4K digital signage player, it ensures that your message is delivered with clarity and impact, even in bright or demanding viewing conditions. The optional HDMI-IN port further enhances its versatility, allowing for real-time video input integration, making it a powerful solution for diverse visual needs.

Silent operation, superior durability

Built with a durable metal chassis, the Giada DN84 is designed for longevity and silent performance. The absence of a fan means no moving parts to fail, significantly reducing the risk of hardware malfunction and eliminating operational noise. This fanless media player design is crucial for deployment in sensitive environments such as retail spaces, quiet offices, or industrial control rooms where acoustic interference is unacceptable. Its operating temperature range of 0°C to 60°C ensures consistent performance across varying South African climate conditions, providing a reliable computing base.

Versatile operating systems for tailored solutions

The Giada DN84 offers the flexibility to run either Android 14 or Debian 12. This choice empowers users to select the operating system that best aligns with their specific application requirements, whether it’s the intuitive interface of Android for public-facing displays or the robust, open-source power of Debian for industrial control and data processing. This adaptability ensures the DN84 can be seamlessly integrated into existing IT infrastructures and deployed for a wide array of specialised tasks, reaffirming its status as a truly versatile barebone system.

Connectivity designed for modern infrastructure

Equipped with onboard Wi-Fi 6 and Bluetooth 5.4, alongside a Gigabit Ethernet port, the Giada DN84 ensures fast, stable network connectivity essential for real-time data transfer and remote management. It features three USB 3.2 Gen1 ports for high-speed peripheral connections and one USB 2.0 OTG port for added flexibility. This connectivity makes it an excellent 4K digital signage player for complex network environments. Optional configurations for multiple Ethernet ports or serial communication (RS232/RS485) make this player exceptionally adaptable to legacy systems and complex networking requirements, solidifying its position as a truly versatile barebone system.

FEATURES:

  • Drive two 4K displays simultaneously with dual HDMI 2.0 outputs for expansive visual presentations.
  • Achieve whisper-quiet operation and enhanced reliability with a rugged, fanless media player metal construction.

  • Ensure system uptime with Auto Power On functionality and a robust RTC for scheduled operations.
  • Connect a wide array of peripherals using three USB 3.2 Gen1 ports and a USB 2.0 OTG port.
  • Adapt to specialised industrial needs with optional dual RS232 or RS485 serial port configurations.

  • Processing Units: 4 Cores Cortex-A72 & 4 Cores Cortex-A53

  • TDP: 6W

  • Storage:

  • GPU Mali-G52MC3
  • Graphic Engine OpenGL ES3.2, OpenCL2.0, Vulkan

Unleash raw power for the discerning South African gamer and creator

This is not merely a graphics card; it is the very engine of digital performance, meticulously engineered for those who demand the apex of gaming fidelity and professional creation capabilities. It is built for those who push boundaries, who seek to render the impossible, and who require their hardware to not just keep pace, but to lead the charge. This graphics card is for you if you refuse to accept compromise and seek a tool that amplifies your skill and vision.

Engineered for sustained peak performance

The heart of this graphics card beats at an extreme performance clock of 2655 MHz, ensuring that every rendered frame is delivered with breathtaking speed. Even under the most demanding loads, the boost clock maintains an impressive 2640 MHz, providing consistent, unyielding power. This performance is sustained through intelligent thermal design. The TORX Fan 5.0, with its uniquely linked fan blades, works in concert to generate and maintain a powerful, high-pressure airflow. This critical cooling system prevents thermal throttling, allowing the card to operate at its maximum potential for extended periods, whether you are in the heat of a competitive match or rendering complex 3D scenes. The power of this advanced GPU ensures seamless operation.

Advanced cooling meets robust construction

At its core, a nickel-plated copper baseplate acts as the primary conduit for heat, swiftly capturing thermal energy directly from the GPU and memory modules. This captured heat is then efficiently transferred to the heatsink array for dissipation. Complementing this is a sturdy metal backplate. Far from being purely aesthetic, this backplate provides crucial structural rigidity to the card, preventing GPU sag and ensuring long-term stability. Furthermore, the integrated airflow vent design within the backplate actively reduces trapped heat, further enhancing the overall thermal management strategy and contributing to the card's longevity and consistent performance.

The gateway to next-generation digital experiences

This graphics card is built upon the revolutionary NVIDIA® GeForce RTX™ 5080, leveraging the sheer power of 10752 CUDA cores. It interfaces with your system via the cutting-edge PCI Express® Gen 5 slot, offering double the bandwidth of its predecessor for faster data transfer. Paired with 16GB of lightning-fast GDDR7 memory running at 30 Gbps across a 256-bit bus, this card is equipped to handle the most complex textures, datasets, and real-time rendering demands. This ensures an exceptionally smooth experience, even at the digital frontier of 7680 x 4320 resolution. This powerful GPU stands ready.

Designed for the future of visual computing

The MSI VENTUS 3X OC PLUS is more than capable of driving the latest visual technologies. With support for DirectX 12 Ultimate and OpenGL 4.6, it is ready for any modern application. It can simultaneously drive up to four displays, each capable of resolutions up to 7680 x 4320. Connectivity is paramount, featuring an HDMI™ 2.1b port that supports up to 4K at 480Hz or 8K at 120Hz with DSC, Gaming VRR, and HDR, alongside HDCP support for protected content. This ensures that whether you are gaming, creating, or consuming media, you are experiencing it at the highest possible fidelity and responsiveness. It is a testament to the advancements in graphics card technology.

product.name: WINX VIBE Pure 2 Hybrid ANC Headphones
product.description:
Immerse yourself in pure sound with up to 53dB of hybrid ANC, or stay connected with crystal-clear calls thanks to the 7-microphone array.

Escape the ordinary with WINX VIBE Pure 2 Over-ear ANC Headphones

For the discerning listener in South Africa who demands both tranquillity and auditory precision, the WINX VIBE Pure 2 Hybrid ANC Headphones offer an unparalleled escape. These over-ear ANC headphones are engineered not merely to play music, but to transform your environment. Whether you are navigating the bustling streets of Cape Town, concentrating in a shared office space, or seeking solace on a long flight, the active noise cancellation technology creates a sanctuary of sound. This is for the student needing focus, the professional requiring clarity on calls, and the audiophile who appreciates every nuance of their favourite track. The blend of cutting-edge technology and thoughtful design makes these headphones an essential tool for modern life, establishing them as the best over-ear noise-cancelling headphones available.

Unrivalled silence, unmatched clarity with Bluetooth 6.0

The core of the WINX VIBE Pure 2 experience lies in its advanced Hybrid Active Noise Cancellation. This system intelligently combines feedforward and feedback microphones to detect and counteract external noise with remarkable efficiency, achieving up to 53dB of reduction. This means the distractions of the world fade away, leaving you with pure, unadulterated audio. Complementing this silence is a sophisticated 7-microphone array, designed to isolate your voice from background noise during calls and recordings. This ensures that your voice is transmitted with exceptional clarity, making every conversation crisp and professional, regardless of your surroundings. Experience this advanced audio clarity with the seamless connectivity of Bluetooth 6.0.

Endurance for your longest days

Powering your immersion is a robust 750mAh battery, engineered for endurance. With up to 96 hours of continuous playback on a single charge, the WINX VIBE Pure 2 headphones are built to outlast your longest journeys and busiest weeks. Even with the active noise cancellation and microphone array in full use, you can expect up to 34 hours of operation, ensuring that your audio companion is always ready when you are. Recharging is swift and convenient via the included Type-C port, taking only 2.5 hours to reach full capacity, making these some of the best over-ear noise-cancelling headphones for prolonged use.

Precision sound and versatile connectivity

At the heart of these headphones are 40mm dynamic drivers, meticulously tuned to deliver a broad frequency response of 20-40KHz. This translates to rich bass, clear mids, and crisp highs, faithfully reproducing your audio with remarkable detail. Connectivity is equally impressive, featuring the latest Bluetooth V6.0 for a stable and efficient wireless connection within a 10-meter range. Compatibility is broad, extending to Windows, macOS, and Android systems, ensuring seamless integration into your existing tech ecosystem, solidifying their status as premier over-ear ANC headphones.

product.name: WINX POWER Fast 89W Car Charger

Unrivalled charging speed and versatility on the go

The heart of this power lies in its advanced 89W charging technology, enabling a compact yet potent charging solution. The Type-C Power Delivery 3.0 port delivers an impressive 65W, capable of rapidly charging even demanding laptops and the latest smartphones. Complementing this is a 24W USB-A port, providing ample power for a secondary device, be it another phone, a tablet, or your camera's battery. This dual-port capability means you and your passenger can power up simultaneously, ensuring neither of you is left with a depleted battery.

Intelligent power, unwavering safety

Engineered with Smart IC technology, this car charger does more than just deliver power; it delivers it intelligently. The charger automatically identifies the connected devices and adjusts the power output accordingly, ensuring optimal charging speeds without overcharging or damaging your valuable electronics. Safety is paramount, and this charger is equipped with comprehensive protection features, including overheat and short-circuit prevention. An integrated charging indicator light provides immediate confirmation that your devices are receiving power, offering reassurance during your travels.

Designed for the journey

Portability and durability are key considerations for any automotive accessory. The WINX POWER Fast charger boasts an ultra-compact design measuring just 51x28x28mm, ensuring it sits discreetly in your car's power outlet without obstructing other controls. Constructed from a robust combination of aluminium alloy, ABS, and PC materials, it is built to withstand the rigours of daily use. Weighing a mere 36g, its lightweight nature makes it easy to carry and store, fitting effortlessly into a glove compartment or a travel bag. This charger is a testament to functional design, blending high performance with practical, travel-friendly attributes.

FEATURES:

product.name: MSI MPG A1000GS PCIe 5 80 PLUS Gold Modular Power Supply
product.description:
Power your next-gen build with unwavering stability and peak efficiency; the 80 PLUS Gold certification ensures optimal energy usage for demanding gaming and creative workloads.

Quick Specs

  • Delivers a robust 1000W of continuous power for high-performance systems.
  • Achieve superior energy savings with 80 PLUS Gold efficiency, reducing heat and electricity costs.
  • Experience silent operation and extended lifespan with the fluid dynamic bearing 135mm fan.

  • Future-proof your setup with two PCI-E 5.1 (16-pin) connectors supporting up to 600W for next-gen GPUs.

Unleash Unrivalled Power for Your High-Demand Rig

The MSI MPG A1000GS power supply is engineered for the discerning PC builder in South Africa who demands absolute reliability and cutting-edge performance. Whether you are assembling a top-tier gaming machine capable of rendering the latest AAA titles at maximum settings, or a professional workstation for intensive video editing, 3D rendering, or complex simulations, this 1000W power supply provides the stable, clean power your components require. Its 1000W capacity is not merely a number; it is a promise of unwavering support for the most power-hungry CPUs and GPUs, ensuring that system instability becomes a relic of the past. The fully modular design means you only connect the cables you need, streamlining your build process and enhancing internal airflow for optimal cooling.

Efficiency that Matters, Performance that Endures

At the heart of the MPG A1000GS lies its 80 PLUS Gold certification, a benchmark for power supply efficiency. This designation signifies that the 80 PLUS Gold PSU operates at up to 90% efficiency under typical loads, meaning less energy is wasted as heat and more power is delivered directly to your components. This translates to lower electricity bills and a reduced thermal footprint within your PC case. The inclusion of a fluid dynamic bearing (FDB) fan, measuring a substantial 135mm, ensures that while your system is under load, the cooling remains quiet and effective, further contributing to the longevity of the power supply and the overall stability of your build. This attention to detail in both efficiency and cooling is paramount for sustained performance.

Prepared for the Future, Built for Today

In a landscape of rapidly evolving PC hardware, the MSI MPG A1000GS stands ready. It is equipped with two PCI-E 5.1 (16-pin) connectors, capable of delivering up to 600W each, specifically designed to power the most demanding next-generation graphics cards. This forward-thinking design ensures that your investment is protected, allowing you to upgrade your GPU without needing to replace your power supply. The robust protection suite, including OCP, OTP, OPP, SCP, OVP, UVP, SIP, and NLO, acts as a vigilant guardian for your valuable components, safeguarding them against power surges, short circuits, and other electrical anomalies. This comprehensive protection system provides peace of mind, knowing your hardware is secure.

A Foundation of Stability for Every Build

The power excursion capability of up to 2350W (*up to 235% of the PSU's rated power for 100μs) means this power supply can handle sudden, intense power demands from components during peak operation, such as when a graphics card accelerates rapidly. This is crucial for gaming and high-intensity workloads where transient power spikes are common. Combined with the stable power delivery and comprehensive protection mechanisms, the MPG A1000GS offers a reliable foundation that allows your high-performance components to operate at their peak potential without compromise. This is not just a power supply; it is the cornerstone of a stable, powerful, and efficient PC.

  • Reduce energy waste and lower your electricity costs with 80 PLUS Gold certified efficiency, providing up to 90% power conversion.

  • Future-proof your system with two native PCI-E 5.1 (16-pin) connectors, ready to supply up to 600W each for next-generation graphics cards.

product.description:
Tri-mode wireless freedom | QMK/VIA fully customisable | Gasket-mount comfort | Hot-swappable Gateron Jupiter Brown switches | Up to 190 hours battery life

A custom mechanical keyboard built for the serious professional

The Keychron V3 Max is an 80% TKL wireless mechanical keyboard engineered for those who refuse to compromise between functionality and craftsmanship. Whether you are a developer, writer, or power user working across multiple devices, this keyboard delivers the deep customisability of QMK/VIA firmware, the flexibility of tri-mode connectivity, and the satisfying tactile feedback of Gateron Jupiter Brown switches — all in a compact layout that reclaims desk space without sacrificing the keys that matter.

Type freely, without wires holding you back

Tired of cable clutter disrupting your workspace? The V3 Max supports tri-mode connectivity — Bluetooth 5.1, 2.4 GHz wireless, and wired via USB Type-C — so you can switch seamlessly between your laptop, desktop, and tablet. A generously sized 4000 mAh rechargeable li-polymer battery keeps you going for up to 190 hours with the backlight off, or up to 100 hours at the lowest RGB brightness. When the battery does need replenishing, a full charge takes around 5 hours via the USB Type-C charging port.

Tune every keystroke to your preference

Full QMK and VIA support means every key on the V3 Max is remappable, with support for macros, layers, and custom lighting profiles — all configured without flashing firmware mid-session. The hot-swappable PCB accepts most 3-pin and 5-pin MX-compatible switches (including Gateron, Cherry MX, and Kailh), so upgrading your switches is straightforward whenever your preferences evolve. South-facing RGB LEDs illuminate double-shot PBT keycaps in OSA profile for vivid, consistent colour across the board, and N-Key Rollover (NKRO) is active in both wireless and wired modes.

Built to absorb the hours, not fight them

The gasket-mount design suspends the plate within the chassis, producing a softer, more forgiving keypress that reduces finger fatigue during long sessions. The typing angle is adjustable across three positions — 4°, 7°, and 10° — via integrated feet, letting you dial in the ergonomic tilt that suits your posture. Screw-in PCB stabilisers provide consistent, rattle-free performance on larger keys straight out of the box, while the ABS plastic body and PC plate keep the overall weight at a practical 895 g.

Features

  • Tri-mode connectivity: Bluetooth 5.1, 2.4 GHz wireless, and USB Type-C wired — switch between up to three devices with ease.
  • Full QMK and VIA support for complete key remapping, macro programming, and layer customisation without reflashing.
  • Hot-swappable PCB accepts most 3-pin and 5-pin MX mechanical switches (Gateron, Cherry MX, Kailh, and others) for effortless switch changes.
  • Gateron Jupiter Brown tactile switches deliver satisfying feedback without excessive noise — well-suited to office and home environments.
  • 4000 mAh rechargeable li-polymer battery provides up to 190 hours of wireless use (backlight off) or up to 100 hours at lowest RGB brightness.
  • Gasket-mount construction absorbs keystroke impact for a cushioned, fatigue-reducing typing experience.
  • South-facing RGB LED backlighting on double-shot PBT keycaps in OSA profile for vivid, durable illumination.
  • N-Key Rollover (NKRO) active in both wired and wireless modes for accurate simultaneous key input.
  • Three adjustable typing angles (4° / 7° / 10°) and screw-in PCB stabilisers for out-of-the-box stability.

Precision and clarity for critical healthcare environments

The Asus HA2741A is engineered for medical professionals in South Africa who demand absolute fidelity in diagnostic imaging. This 27-inch IPS monitor delivers a substantial 3.6MP resolution, providing the fine detail necessary for accurate interpretation of X-rays, CT scans, and other vital medical visuals. The HA2741A's IPS panel offers exceptional colour accuracy and wide 178° viewing angles, ensuring consistent image quality from any perspective. With a high contrast ratio of 900:1 and 350 cd/m² brightness, it renders images with profound depth and clarity, making it easier to distinguish between different tissue densities and anomalies. The AGLR (Anti-Glare, Low-Reflection) surface further enhances viewing comfort by minimising distracting reflections, allowing for prolonged periods of focused work without eye strain. Advanced comfort and protection for professionals

Seamless integration for an efficient workflow

product.name: Antec FLUX Rear ARGB ATX Mid Tower Gaming Chassis - Black
product.description:
The Antec FLUX Rear ARGB ATX Mid Tower Gaming Chassis is built for gamers and PC enthusiasts who want premium aesthetics without compromising on airflow performance. Featuring a striking metal mesh and real wood front panel, the FLUX delivers a unique high-end look that stands out from typical gaming cases, while still ensuring unrestricted ventilation. Its recessed front design further improves airflow efficiency while helping to reduce unwanted noise, making it a smart choice for both powerful gaming rigs and sleek workstation builds.

Engineered around Antec’s Flux vertical and horizontal cooling concept, this chassis uses a multi-directional vent layout to optimise airflow throughout the entire system. It comes equipped with an impressive five-fan setup, including ARGB PWM fans and reverse airflow fans designed to push fresh air directly where it matters most. A dedicated bottom GPU air intake ensures your graphics card stays cooler under load, especially during intense gaming sessions or demanding creative workflows.

Compatibility is another major highlight, with support for ATX, Micro-ATX, and ITX motherboards, as well as full modern back-connect motherboard support for cleaner cable routing. Inside, there’s ample clearance for high-end hardware, including GPUs up to 400mm, CPU coolers up to 180mm, and power supplies up to 170mm. The front-mounted PSU chamber layout enhances internal airflow flow management while keeping the build neat and visually clean behind the included 4mm tempered glass side panel.

For builders who want both convenience and expandability, the FLUX chassis includes a tool-free panel design, a built-in GPU support bracket, and versatile storage support with bays for both 3.5” and 2.5” drives. It also supports serious liquid cooling potential, including up to a 360mm radiator at the top, making it ideal for high-performance gaming systems. With premium materials, smart airflow engineering, and a refined black finish, the Antec FLUX Rear ARGB is a standout mid-tower case built for modern performance builds.

FEATURES:

  • The front panel is crafted with a combination of metal mesh and premium wood to create a high-quality texture
  • Flux vertical and horizontal cooling with multi-directional vent design
  • Excellent airflow and 5 fans included
  • Designed with a front-mounted PSU chamber
  • The recessed front design enhances airflow while minimizing noise
  • Supports 360mm water colling at the top
  • Bottom air intake under GPU and built-in GPU Bracket for stability
  • Tool-free panel design with back-connect motherboard support

Solving the heat equation simply with the AK620

The primary function of this apparatus is to remove thermal energy generated by your processor rapidly and consistently. Users consistently choose the DeepCool AK620 for its proven build quality.

The demand for uncompromising stability
