product.name: Keychron Q6 Max 100% Full Assembled Knob Red Switch Hot-Swap Gateron Jupiter RGB Wireless Keyboard - Black
product.description:
The Keychron Q6 Max redefines the professional mechanical keyboard experience, merging high-performance hardware, open-source programmability, and premium construction in a full-size, hot-swappable layout. Built with a CNC-machined 6063 aluminium body and enhanced by a flexible PC plate and double-gasket mount design, the Q6 Max offers superior acoustics and structural integrity while reducing vibration and sound resonance for a refined typing feel.

Equipped with pre-lubed Gateron Jupiter Red tactile switches, the Q6 Max delivers a satisfying bump on actuation and smooth keystroke transitions, ideal for both typing accuracy and prolonged comfort. South-facing RGB lighting, LED diffusers, and 22 lighting presets bring immersive visual flair, whether for productivity workflows or late-night gaming sessions.

Connectivity is seamless and versatile, supporting Bluetooth 5.1 (up to 3 devices), 2.4 GHz wireless (1000 Hz polling), and Type-C wired mode, with full cross-platform compatibility across macOS, Windows, and Linux. Users benefit from dual layout support with system toggle and included Mac/Windows keycaps, ensuring fluid transitions between workstations.

Customisation is powered by QMK/VIA firmware, enabling real-time remapping, macro creation, and RGB control via the Keychron Launcher app. Backed by an ARM Cortex-M4 32-bit processor, a robust 4000 mAh battery, and hot-swappable support for both 3-pin and 5-pin MX-style switches, the Q6 Max is fully equipped for high-performance users who demand adaptability without compromise.

Finished in a sleek Carbon Black, the keyboard includes high-durability double-shot PBT keycaps (KSA profile), ensuring long-term resistance to shine and fading. Whether you’re a developer, designer, content creator or gaming enthusiast, the Q6 Max is a fully-featured solution tailored for custom workflows, competitive performance, and elevated daily use.

FEATURES:

  • Full-size layout with programmable knob (100%)
  • CNC-machined aluminium case with sandblasted, polished finish
  • Gateron Jupiter Red tactile switches (pre-lubed, exclusive to fully assembled models)
  • Double-shot PBT keycaps in KSA profile (non-shine-through)
  • South-facing RGB with 22 lighting presets and full remapping
  • VIA/QMK firmware with real-time macro and key remapping
  • Tri-mode connectivity: 2.4 GHz, Bluetooth 5.1, Type-C
  • Hot-swappable support (3-pin and 5-pin MX-compatible switches)
  • Dedicated system toggle with Mac/Windows keycaps
  • Up to 180 hours of battery life (backlight off)

The performance core is Intel’s most powerful CPU core ever. It’s also optimised for single-thread performance and responsiveness in compute-intensive workloads such as gaming and 3D design. Intel built Intel® Thread Director directly into the hardware to ensure that Performance and Efficient cores work seamlessly with the operating system. Intel® Thread Director guides the operating system by automatically monitoring and analysing on the fly, ensuring that the right thread is placed on the right core at the right time. The 14th Gen Intel® Core™ processors support the next generation of discrete graphics cards and storage devices. Direct drive power for unparalleled immersion in sim racing

The heart of the V10 Ultra is its 3.2Nm direct drive motor. This technology places the motor directly in contact with the steering shaft, eliminating gears and belts that can introduce lag and reduce fidelity. The result is a raw, unadulterated force feedback experience that accurately replicates the forces a real car experiences. Feel the subtle vibrations of the road surface, the pull of centrifugal force in corners, and the resistance of tyre scrub with a level of detail previously unattainable in this class. Hall effect pedals: Precision redefined for your gaming steering wheel

Complementing the direct drive wheel are the Hall effect pedals. Unlike traditional potentiometer-based pedals, Hall effect sensors use magnetic fields to detect position. This means no physical contact, leading to exceptional durability and, more importantly, unparalleled accuracy and consistency over time. These pedals are designed to provide precise throttle and brake inputs, crucial for smooth acceleration, controlled braking, and executing delicate driving maneuvers. The Hall effect technology ensures that your inputs are registered faithfully, allowing for finer control and more consistent performance across countless racing sessions, making it a superior choice for any serious sim racing wheel setup.

Engineered for the discerning South African gamer and power user

This Patriot Viper Steel DDR4 memory kit is forged for those who demand uncompromising performance from their desktop systems. It's built for the gamer who seeks every millisecond advantage, the content creator rendering complex projects, and the multitasking professional who requires absolute system fluidity. This is not merely an upgrade; it is a fundamental enhancement to your system's capabilities, designed to meet and exceed the rigorous demands of modern computing, powered by the reliable Patriot Viper Steel 64GB configuration.

Unleash unparalleled speed and efficiency with DDR4 3600MHz

At the core of this memory kit lies its remarkable 3600MHz frequency, meticulously tuned and tested to deliver optimal performance. Coupled with timings of 18-22-22-42 at a stable 1.35V, this DDR4 kit provides a substantial boost over standard memory modules. This speed translates directly into tangible benefits: drastically reduced game load times, smoother frame rates in graphically intensive titles, and accelerated rendering and processing speeds for creative applications. The PC4-28800 standard ensures compatibility and peak operation, making it an ideal choice for those pushing the boundaries of their hardware with fast DDR4 3600MHz.

Built for stability and peak compatibility

Patriot’s Viper Steel series is renowned for its robust construction and rigorous testing. This 64GB kit is no exception, validated on the latest high-end Intel platforms and processors. This ensures a seamless integration and reliable operation, eliminating the uncertainty often associated with performance memory. The non-ECC unbuffered DIMM format guarantees efficient data handling, preventing errors that can lead to system instability or crashes during critical operations. This reliability is paramount for long gaming sessions or intensive work periods, especially when utilizing high-speed desktop memory.

A statement of performance and style

Beyond its technical prowess, the Viper Steel memory kit makes a visual statement. The gunmetal grey sides, accented with a diamond-cut Viper logo, and a sleek black top provide a distinctive aesthetic that complements any high-performance build. Measuring just 0.7 x 31.5 x 4.4 cm and weighing a mere 96g, these modules offer a low profile design that ensures compatibility with a wide range of CPU coolers and chassis configurations. With a substantial 64GB capacity, comprised of two high-density 32GB modules, this kit is designed for the future. It not only meets today's most demanding applications but also provides ample headroom for upcoming software and operating system advancements. Whether you are a professional seeking to accelerate your workflow or a gamer aiming for the highest echelons of performance, this memory kit represents a strategic investment in your system's longevity and capability. Ensure your desktop remains a high-performing machine capable of handling complex tasks with ease, powered by the excellent DDR4 3600MHz speeds.

Move your digital life with precision and speed

Unrivalled transfer capability

At the core of the Rage R550 is its powerful USB 3.2 Gen 1 interface, delivering sequential read speeds of up to 100MB/s. Imagine transferring an entire folder of holiday photos or a complex work presentation without the frustrating lag associated with older USB standards. This speed ensures your workflow remains uninterrupted, making this USB flash drive an indispensable tool for anyone who frequently moves data.

Built for the demands of daily use

The Patriot Rage R550 is not just about speed; it is also constructed for resilience. The swing-type design ingeniously protects the USB connectors when not in use. A simple flick of the wrist deploys or retracts the connector, safeguarding it from dust, debris, and accidental damage. This thoughtful engineering extends the life of the drive and ensures it remains a dependable storage solution for years to come. Its compact dimensions and light weight mean it can be easily carried in a pocket, on a keychain, or within a laptop bag without adding unnecessary bulk. Connect to any device, anywhere

Compatibility is key in a diverse digital environment. The Rage R550 excels by featuring both a USB Type-C port, perfect for newer smartphones, tablets, and laptops, and a traditional USB Type-A port, ensuring seamless integration with older computers, car stereos, and other peripherals. This dual-interface design makes it the ultimate plug-and-play solution for cross-device data management. product.name: Patriot P400 Lite 1TB M.2 PCIe Gen 4 x4 NVMe SSD
product.description:
Unlock blazing-fast load times for your games and applications on your rig.

Quick Specs

  • Experience rapid application and game loading with PCIe Gen4 NVMe speeds.
  • Achieve consistent performance with up to 3,500MB/s sequential reads and 2,700MB/s sequential writes.
  • Benefit from exceptional endurance with a 560TBW rating for long-term reliability.
  • Enjoy smooth operation in demanding environments with an operating temperature range of 0-70°C.
  • Upgrade your system effortlessly with the compact M.2 2280 form factor.

Elevate your computing experience with the Patriot P400 Lite 1TB NVMe SSD. For the South African gamer and professional who demands speed and reliability, this 1TB M.2 PCIe Gen4 x4 NVMe SSD is the definitive upgrade. Forget the frustration of long loading screens and sluggish application launches; this drive is engineered to cut through the digital clutter, providing a seamless and responsive computing environment. Whether you are diving into the latest AAA titles, editing high-resolution video, or managing large datasets, the P400 Lite ensures that your storage is never the bottleneck. It is designed for those who understand that performance is not a luxury, but a necessity, transforming your PC into a more agile and efficient machine.

Unleash the power of PCIe Gen4. At the core of the P400 Lite lies its advanced PCIe Gen4 x4 interface, delivering substantial leaps in data transfer speeds compared to its predecessors. This means that your operating system will boot in moments, your games will load faster than ever before, and large file transfers will be completed with remarkable efficiency. The NVMe 1.4 protocol further optimises performance, ensuring that your system can communicate with the drive at maximum velocity. For users who have upgraded to a compatible motherboard, this 1TB M.2 NVMe SSD unlocks the full potential of their hardware, providing a truly next-generation storage solution.

Engineered for endurance and consistent performance. The Patriot P400 Lite is not just about raw speed; it is built to last. With an impressive Terabytes Written (TBW) rating of 560TB, this Patriot SSD 1TB is designed to handle extensive read and write cycles, making it a dependable choice for even the most demanding workloads. Its robust construction and careful thermal management, with an operating temperature range of 0-70°C, ensure stable performance even under sustained use. This commitment to durability means you can rely on your data being accessible and your system running smoothly, day after day, year after year. It offers peace of mind, knowing your investment is protected by quality engineering.

A smart choice for a faster future. Choosing the right storage is critical for optimising your PC’s overall performance. The Patriot P400 Lite 1TB NVMe SSD provides an exceptional balance of speed, capacity, and longevity, making it an outstanding value proposition. Its compact M.2 2280 form factor ensures compatibility with a wide range of modern motherboards and laptops, simplifying the upgrade process. For anyone looking to significantly enhance their system’s responsiveness and productivity without breaking the bank, this Patriot SSD is a clear and compelling option.

This MSI RTX 5060 Ti SHADOW is forged for the dedicated South African PC builder who demands precision, quiet operation, and tangible performance at the 1440p resolution standard. The MSI RTX 5060 Ti is designed not for the fleeting trend, but for sustained, reliable engagement with the latest complex software. This specific RTX 5060 Ti 16GB model delivers the core power needed for modern fidelity.

Coolness Under Pressure

When the digital battle intensifies, thermal throttling must be eliminated. The SHADOW cooling design addresses this directly. The STORMFORCE fan employs seven uniquely shaped blades with claw texturing; this is engineered specifically to push maximum air volume across the heatsink while managing the noise signature, ensuring your focus remains solely on the display, not distracting fan drone when running your MSI RTX 5060 Ti.

Engineering for Longevity

In a landscape littered with fragile components, this card stands firm. The reinforced metal backplate serves two essential purposes: it prevents unwanted PCB flex during installation and operation, and it incorporates dedicated airflow vents and thermal pads to actively draw heat away from critical components. This durability ensures superior operational lifespan for your RTX 5060 Ti 16GB.

The Pathway to Fidelity

The pairing of the MSI RTX 5060 Ti architecture with 16GB of GDDR7 memory, operating across a 128-bit bus, means textures load faster, latency drops, and high-resolution assets are handled without hesitation. This configuration, powered by the MSI RTX 5060 Ti, ensures you are ready for the next generation of graphical demands, treating frame rates as a measure of respect for your time.

The core issue solved by this device is the bottleneck of legacy storage. Portable Data Integrity

Weighing merely 56 grams and shaped to fit comfortably in a palm, this drive offers 1024GB of capacity without demanding significant physical space. Its plastic casing is engineered for resistance to the minor knocks of daily transport, ensuring that your critical data remains secure whether you are working from a remote site or a central office. A Commitment to Longevity

This is not a gesture; it is a declaration of confidence in the internal components and the assembly process, assuring you of a long service life from your 2TB portable SSD.

product.name: Hiksemi Future PRO 512GB MicroSD EXPRESS PCIE 3x1 TLC (Without Adapter)
product.description:
Achieve swift data capture in demanding 4K environments with this MicroSD Express card.

Quick Specs

  • Store five hundred gigabytes of high-resolution data.
  • Reach maximum read speeds of 900 megabytes per second.
  • Sustain write speeds up to 620 megabytes per second for continuous recording.
  • Certified A2 rating ensures fast application performance.
  • Operates reliably across severe temperature ranges.

The necessity of speed in modern capture

This Hiksemi FUTURE Pro 512GB MicroSDXC Card is forged for the professional and the enthusiast who cannot abide stagnation. In the landscape of digital creation, speed is not a luxury; it is the fundamental requirement for capturing high-bitrate 4K video, rapid-fire photography, and running demanding mobile operating systems without hesitation. This memory is built to uphold the integrity of your most critical data streams.

Who requires this uncompromising capacity

This card is designed for drones capturing sweeping aerial vistas, dedicated photographers shooting burst sequences, and advanced videographers working with high-frame-rate footage. It serves the user in South Africa who demands immediate file accessibility, eliminating the pause between action and storage. If your workflow is interrupted by slow read or write times, this 512GB MicroSDXC Card addresses that deficiency directly.

Performance redefined: The Express advantage

The true value proposition lies in the sustained performance under load. While many cards list peak theoretical speeds, the FUTURE Pro delivers exceptional real-world throughput. The 900MB/s read speed means transferring an entire day's shoot to your workstation is a brief formality, not an overnight ordeal. The 620MB/s write speed guarantees that your camera buffer clears instantly, allowing you to maintain the creative flow without dropped frames or missed opportunities. This is the precision only a MicroSD express card can offer.

Durability forged in rigorous testing

Trust in hardware requires documented resilience. This card is manufactured with TLC NAND, providing a balanced combination of speed and longevity for consistent operation. Furthermore, its physical endurance is confirmed by its specified working temperature range: it is engineered to perform consistently between freezing lows of -25celsius and intense heat reaching 85celsius, making it a reliable companion across varied environmental conditions found across the region.

The demand for uncompromising storage

Modern devices, particularly high-end smartphones and action cameras, are increasingly bottlenecked by lesser storage. Users demand the ability to install and run applications directly from the card with A2 application performance ratings, ensuring smooth, lag-free operation. This 512GB MicroSDXC Card satisfies that demand for high-density, high-velocity storage, embodying the reliable power of a MicroSD express card.

FEATURES:

  • Process large files rapidly due to the 900MB/s maximum read speed, minimising data transfer times between devices.

product.name: Intel® Core Ultra 5 225F LGA1851 3.30GHz 10-Core CPU
product.description:
Unleash next-generation performance for demanding desktops; experience superior AI capabilities and seamless multitasking for your professional and gaming needs.

Quick Specs

  • Experience intelligent processing with 10 cores (6 performance, 4 efficient) for seamless multitasking.
  • Achieve peak performance up to 4.90GHz with Intel® Turbo Boost Technology 2.0.
  • Accelerate AI workloads and modern applications with Intel® Deep Learning Boost.
  • Benefit from advanced security features for protected system operation.
  • Enjoy future-ready connectivity with support for PCI Express 5.0 and DDR5 memory.

For the ambitious South African builder, the Intel® Core™ Ultra 5 225F processor stands as the foundation of a powerful, intelligent desktop.

This is not merely a component; it is the driving force designed for those who demand efficiency without sacrificing performance. Whether you are a creative professional pushing the boundaries of design software, a developer leveraging advanced AI frameworks, or a discerning gamer seeking a competitive edge, this Intel CPU is engineered to meet your needs. It represents a leap forward in processing capability, built to handle complex tasks and provide an exceptionally responsive user experience. For the discerning South African market, this processor offers a clear pathway to a more capable and intelligent computing environment, making it the ideal choice for your next high-performance build.

Intelligent cores for peak efficiency and performance

At the heart of the Core™ Ultra 5 225F lies a sophisticated architecture comprising 10 cores: 6 high-performance cores and 4 efficient cores. This hybrid design ensures that your system intelligently allocates resources, providing maximum power for demanding applications and optimal energy efficiency for background tasks. This means smoother multitasking, faster application loading, and a more fluid overall computing experience, allowing you to work and play without compromise. The processor’s ability to dynamically manage its cores ensures that you receive the power you need, precisely when you need it. This makes it a superior choice among Intel processors.

Accelerate your workflow with advanced AI capabilities

Step into the future of computing with the Intel® Deep Learning Boost (Intel® DL Boost) integrated into this processor. This technology is specifically designed to accelerate artificial intelligence workloads, making it a powerful tool for machine learning, deep learning inference, and AI-powered creative applications. Supported by frameworks like OpenVINO™ and WindowsML, the Core™ Ultra 5 225F empowers developers and creatives to harness the power of AI, enabling faster processing of complex models and enhancing the capabilities of AI-driven software. This makes it an ideal choice for those looking to leverage cutting-edge AI technologies in their daily tasks and is a key differentiator for this Intel CPU.

Built for tomorrow's demands, today

The Intel® Core™ Ultra 5 225F is equipped to handle the evolving landscape of technology. With support for PCI Express 5.0, you can harness the full potential of the latest high-speed SSDs and graphics cards, ensuring lightning-fast data transfer and reduced load times. Furthermore, its compatibility with DDR5 memory offers increased bandwidth and efficiency, providing a substantial boost to overall system responsiveness. These forward-looking specifications ensure that your system remains at the forefront of performance for years to come, making it a wise investment for any serious PC builder. For those seeking a gaming CPU, Intel processors like this offer a robust foundation.

Reliability and security for peace of mind

Intel understands that performance must be coupled with stability and security. This processor includes a suite of advanced security features such as Intel® Trusted Execution Technology, Intel® Boot Guard, and Execute Disable Bit, designed to protect your system from threats and ensure the integrity of your data. Coupled with robust thermal monitoring technologies and a 3-year warranty, you can build with confidence, knowing your investment is protected and your system is secure. This commitment to reliability ensures that your PC performs optimally and securely, day in and day out. As a leading Intel processor, it exemplifies the brand's dedication to quality.

Please note: A dedicated graphics card is needed to use this CPU. It does not come with integrated graphics.

FEATURES:

  • Power through demanding tasks with a 10-core configuration, featuring 6 performance-cores and 4 efficient-cores for balanced multitasking, a hallmark of Intel processors.
  • Experience accelerated AI workloads and inference with Intel® Deep Learning Boost (Intel® DL Boost), enabling faster machine learning applications, making it a standout Intel CPU.
  • Benefit from enhanced system responsiveness and data transfer speeds with support for the latest PCI Express 5.0 and DDR5 memory technologies, crucial for any modern Intel processor.
  • Ensure system integrity and data protection with a comprehensive suite of Intel security technologies, including Trusted Execution Technology and Boot Guard, reinforcing its position as a secure Intel CPU.
  • Enjoy smooth and efficient operation thanks to Intel® Turbo Boost Technology 2.0, reaching frequencies up to 4.90GHz, and Intel® Thread Director for optimal task allocation, ideal for a gaming CPU.
  • Optimise gaming and content creation with support for advanced instruction set extensions like Intel® AVX2, enhancing its appeal as a gaming CPU.
  • Deploy with confidence backed by Intel's commitment to quality and a standard 3-year warranty, solidifying its reputation as a reliable Intel processor.

product.name: Intel 14th Gen Core i5-14400F LGA1700 2.5GHz 6-Core CPU
product.description:
The 14th Generation Intel® Core™ processors offer a performance hybrid architecture, allowing for the next evolutionary leap. Get the performance you need, right where you need it, whether you’re a gamer, creator, streamer, or regular user. With Intel® 14 Generation processors, you can do more of what you enjoy, whenever you want. The 14th generation Intel® Core™ processors feature a hybrid architecture that combines performance and efficiency (P-core and E-core). That translates to real-world performance, intuitively scaled to match your work.

The Performance-core is Intel’s most powerful CPU core ever. It’s also optimised for single-thread performance and responsiveness in compute-intensive workloads such as gaming and 3D design. The Efficient-core provides multithreaded performance for tasks that can run concurrently (such as image rendering), as well as efficient offloading of background tasks for modern multitasking.

Intel built Intel® Thread Director directly into the hardware to ensure that Performance and Efficient cores work seamlessly with the operating system. Intel® Thread Director guides the operating system by automatically monitoring and analysing on the fly, ensuring that the right thread is placed on the right core at the right time. And it does it all dynamically, adapting scheduling guidance to actual computing needs rather than static rules.

The 14th Gen Intel® Core™ processors support the next generation of discrete graphics cards and storage devices. These devices take advantage of the increased throughput provided by PCIe 5.0, as well as the faster speeds and bandwidth of DDR5 memory. 14th Gen Intel® Core™ processors include built-in features for noise suppression, auto-framing, and optimised bandwidth and video resolution for gaming. This saves you time and allows you to multitask in ways you couldn’t have imagined before. 14th Gen Intel® Core™ processors enable various tasks, including gaming, browsing, streaming, and creating masterpieces.

Please note: A dedicated graphics card is needed to use this CPU. It does not come with integrated graphics.

product.name: Asus ROG Strix B550-A AM4 ATX Gaming Motherboard
product.description:
Empower your AMD Ryzen build with robust power delivery and next-gen connectivity for peak gaming performance.

Quick Specs

  • Ready for AMD Ryzen 5000 series processors, enabling powerful gaming performance.
  • Experience lightning-fast data transfer with PCIe 4.0 and dual M.2 slots.
  • Benefit from stable, high-speed networking with Intel 2.5Gb Ethernet.
  • Build with confidence using a robust power delivery and DIY-friendly design.
  • Immerse yourself in superior audio with AI Noise-Canceling Microphone technology.

For the dedicated South African gamer, the Asus ROG Strix B550-A Gaming ATX Motherboard represents the foundation of a formidable gaming PC.

This ATX gaming motherboard is engineered for those who understand that true performance begins with a stable, powerful core. It’s built for the enthusiast who demands reliability, speed, and the flexibility to adapt and upgrade. Whether you are assembling your first high-performance rig or seeking to optimise an existing setup, this b550 motherboard provides the critical components necessary to push your AMD Ryzen processors to their limits. It’s not merely a component; it is the control centre for your gaming ambitions, designed to handle the most demanding titles and the most intense gameplay sessions with unwavering stability.

Unleash the full potential of your AMD Ryzen processor with this Asus ROG Motherboard

At the heart of this b550 motherboard lies its compatibility with AMD AM4 socket processors, including the latest Ryzen™ 5000 Series, 4000 G-Series, and 3000 Series. This ensures that your system is equipped with cutting-edge processing power, ready to tackle complex tasks, demanding games, and intensive multitasking. The robust power solution, featuring teamed power stages, ProCool connectors, high-quality alloy chokes, and durable capacitors, guarantees clean and stable power delivery even under heavy load. This means consistent performance and longevity for your processor, allowing you to game with confidence.

Engineered for peak gaming connectivity and speed with the Asus ROG Strix B550-A

The Asus ROG Strix B550-A Gaming ATX Motherboard is a gateway to next-generation gaming technology. It is PCIe® 4.0-ready, offering double the bandwidth of PCIe 3.0, which is crucial for high-performance graphics cards and ultra-fast NVMe SSDs. With dual M.2 slots, you can equip your system with lightning-fast storage for rapid game loading and system boot times. Connectivity is further enhanced with USB 3.2 Gen 2 Type-C® ports for high-speed data transfer and peripheral support. For those who value a seamless visual experience, the inclusion of HDMI™ 2.1 and DisplayPort 1.2 output support ensures compatibility with the latest high-resolution and high-refresh-rate displays.

Superior networking and audio for the competitive edge on your ATX gaming motherboard

Lag is the enemy of any gamer. To combat this, this Asus ROG motherboard features Intel® 2.5Gb Ethernet with ASUS LANGuard. This provides smoother, faster, and more stable network connections, crucial for online multiplayer gaming and high-bandwidth streaming. Beyond networking, the audio experience is equally vital. The SupremeFX S1220A codec, DTS® Sound Unbound™, and Sonic Studio III work in concert to deliver immersive, detailed audio. The AI Noise-Canceling Microphone technology ensures your voice commands are clear and free from background distractions, making communication in-game crystal clear.

Intuitive control and user-friendly design for your b550 motherboard

Asus understands that building a PC should be a rewarding experience. This b550 motherboard boasts several DIY-friendly features, including a pre-mounted I/O shield for easier installation, BIOS FlashBack™ for updating the BIOS without a CPU, and Q-LEDs for quick diagnostics. The UEFI BIOS is renowned for its intuitive dashboard, making it easy for users of all levels to configure their system settings. ASUS AI Networking software further simplifies network optimisation, allowing you to prioritise gaming traffic effortlessly. Personalise your build with ASUS-exclusive Aura Sync RGB lighting, which includes Aura RGB and addressable Gen 2 RGB headers, allowing for vibrant and synchronised lighting effects across your components.

FEATURES:

  • AMD AM4 socket: Ready for Ryzen™ 5000 Series/ 4000 G-Series/ 3000 Series Desktop Processors
  • Best gaming connectivity: PCIe® 4.0-ready, dual M.2, USB 3.2 Gen 2 Type-C® plus HDMI™ 2.1 and DisplayPort 1.2 output support
  • Smooth networking: Intel® 2.5Gb Ethernet with ASUS LANGuard
  • Robust power solution: Teamed power stages with ProCool power connector, high-quality alloy chokes and durable capacitors
  • Renowned software: Intuitive dashboards for UEFI BIOS and ASUS AI Networking make it easy to configure gaming builds
  • DIY-friendly design: Includes pre-mounted I/O shield, BIOS FlashBack™, Q-LEDs and SafeSlot
  • Unmatched personalization: ASUS-exclusive Aura Sync RGB lighting, including Aura RGB header and addressable Gen 2 RGB header
  • Industry-leading gaming audio: AI Noise-Canceling Microphone, SupremeFX S1220A codec, DTS® Sound Unbound™ and Sonic Studio III for immersive audio

Unleash the Power of 10 Cores with an Intel Desktop CPU

The Intel Core Ultra 5 225 processor delivers a revolutionary computing experience with its innovative hybrid architecture. Featuring 6 Performance-cores and 4 Efficient-cores, this CPU dynamically adjusts to your workload, providing exceptional performance and power efficiency. This makes it ideal for gamers, content creators, and professionals in South Africa who demand seamless multitasking and responsiveness from their Intel Desktop CPU.

Experience Blazing-Fast Speeds with your Intel CPU for Gaming

With a Max Turbo Frequency of 4.90GHz, the Core Ultra 5 225 handles demanding applications and games with ease. The Performance-cores ensure lightning-fast response times, while the Efficient-cores optimise power consumption for extended battery life on mobile platforms. Whether you are rendering complex 3D models, editing high-resolution videos, or playing the latest AAA titles, this Intel CPU for gaming delivers unparalleled speed and fluidity.

Integrated Intel Graphics for Stunning Visuals

The integrated Intel Graphics provides vibrant visuals and smooth media playback. Enjoy your favourite movies, TV shows, and games in stunning detail, with support for resolutions up to 7680 x 4320 @ 60Hz via DisplayPort. The GPU also features advanced capabilities such as H.264 and H.265 encode/decode, AV1 encode/decode, and VP9 bitstream & decoding, ensuring compatibility with the latest video formats.

Accelerate AI Tasks with Intel AI Boost NPU

The Intel AI Boost NPU (Neural Processing Unit) revolutionises AI workloads by providing dedicated hardware acceleration. With a peak throughput of 13 TOPS (Int8), the NPU significantly speeds up AI tasks such as image recognition, natural language processing, and machine learning. This allows you to leverage AI-powered applications and tools with exceptional performance and efficiency.

Future-Proof Your System with Advanced Features

The Intel Core Ultra 5 225 is equipped with a range of advanced features designed to future-proof your system. Support for up to 256GB of DDR5 memory ensures ample capacity for demanding applications, while PCI Express 5.0 and 4.0 support enables blazing-fast data transfer rates. Additionally, technologies such as Intel Thread Director, Intel Turbo Boost Technology 2.0, and Intel Virtualization Technology (VT-x) enhance performance, efficiency, and security.

product.name: Intel® Core™ Ultra 7 265KF LGA1851 5.50GHz 20-Core CPU
product.description:
The Intel® Core™ Ultra 7 265KF CPU is a robust processor tailored to power modern digital workloads, from AI-driven tasks to intense gaming sessions. Part of Intel’s Core Ultra Series, this CPU is designed for creators and gamers seeking cutting-edge performance with AI integration. With a combination of performance cores (P-cores) and eight efficient cores (E-cores), the Core Ultra 7 265KF handles multitasking seamlessly, offloading background tasks to the E-cores, which frees up the P-cores to drive demanding applications and maintain top-notch responsiveness. The processor’s powerful Intel® Smart Cache (30MB) and support for DDR5 memory (up to 6400MHz) make it a versatile choice for creators who rely on high data throughput for large files and smooth, efficient workflow.

Gamers and Esports professionals will benefit from the Core Ultra 7 265KF’s performance-focused architecture, which provides a Max Turbo Frequency of up to 5.50GHz for intense gaming moments. With 24 PCIe lanes and Thunderbolt™ 5 support, this CPU is optimized for maximum expandability and high-speed connectivity. Built-in Intel® Killer™ Networking reduces lag and packet loss, offering a more seamless online gaming experience, while AI features like Intel® Gaussian & Neural Accelerator (GNA) help ensure clear communication by filtering background noise in voice comms. The processor’s graphics capabilities also support high-resolution displays, including up to 8K resolution on DisplayPort and HDMI, making it a powerful engine for immersive gaming experiences.

For content creators, the Intel® Core™ Ultra 7 265KF’s intelligent performance shines in AI-driven applications like generative AI and video production. Intel® Deep Learning Boost enhances AI workloads directly on the CPU, speeding up AI model processing for creators working with machine learning or neural networks. The integrated Intel® Connectivity Performance Suite optimizes network performance for smoother streaming, and Quick Sync Video accelerates video encoding, making this processor ideal for creators, streamers, and freelancers aiming to elevate their productivity. Together, these features make the Core Ultra 7 265K a powerhouse for users who need reliable, top-tier performance in both creative and gaming environments.

Please note: A dedicated graphics card is needed to use this CPU. It does not come with integrated graphics.

product.name: AMD Ryzen Threadripper 9980WX 64-Core 3.2GHz CPU
product.description:
Unleash the full potential of your professional workflow with the AMD Ryzen™ Threadripper™ 9980WX, a high-end workstation CPU engineered for creators, architects, engineers, and AI developers. Featuring a 64-core, 128-thread configuration and a base clock of 3.2GHz, this powerhouse delivers extraordinary multi-threaded performance. With a boost clock speed of up to 5.4GHz, the 9980WX ensures ultra-responsive computing for demanding workloads, from real-time 3D rendering to AI model training and simulation. Built on the advanced "Zen 5" architecture and leveraging TSMC’s 4nm FinFET process, it provides superior power efficiency, scalability, and thermal performance.

The Threadripper 9980WX is optimized for workstation-class desktops and is supported on the sTR5 socket with TRX50 chipsets, enabling massive I/O bandwidth through PCIe 5.0 and high-capacity memory configurations. This processor supports DDR5 memory with AMD EXPO™ Technology, giving users access to enhanced memory tuning, reduced latency, and faster data throughput. It’s ideal for professionals working with CAD software, video editing suites, scientific computing, and other high-performance applications that require high levels of parallel processing and memory bandwidth.

Security and manageability are also top priorities. The AMD Ryzen™ Threadripper™ 9980WX includes a full suite of enterprise-grade security features such as AMD Memory Guard, Firmware TPM, DASH support, and Virtualization-Based Security (VBS). These features ensure data integrity and protection across virtual machines, sensitive workloads, and secure boot processes. Additionally, AMD’s support for Windows Secured-Core PC, Secure Boot, and Enhanced Virus Protection makes the 9980WX an excellent choice for enterprise-grade systems that require regulatory compliance and zero-compromise security.

Whether you're building a cutting-edge creative studio or a powerful local AI development environment, the Ryzen Threadripper 9980WX delivers unmatched performance, advanced virtualization support, and an exceptional computing experience. With support for the latest operating systems including Windows 11, Windows 10, Ubuntu, and RHEL, and designed for maximum scalability, this processor is your ultimate tool for accelerating creativity, innovation, and productivity.

product.name: Keychron V3 Max QMK/VIA 80% Wireless Custom Mechanical Keyboard (Red Switch) – Carbon Black
product.description:
The Keychron V3 Max QMK/VIA Wireless Mechanical Keyboard is built for enthusiasts who demand both performance and customization in a compact form. Featuring an 80% TKL layout, it strikes the perfect balance between functionality and desk space, offering a full set of keys without the bulk of a numpad. Its gasket mount design and ABS plastic body with a PC plate deliver a stable yet cushioned typing feel, while the hot-swappable design supports most 3-pin and 5-pin MX-style mechanical switches, giving you endless customization options.

Connectivity is seamless with triple-mode support: 2.4GHz wireless, Bluetooth 5.1, and USB Type-C wired. With a 1000Hz polling rate in wired and 2.4GHz modes, and 90Hz in Bluetooth, the V3 Max ensures ultra-low latency and high responsiveness across gaming, productivity, or creative tasks. You can connect and switch between up to three devices effortlessly, making it ideal for those who work or play across multiple platforms.

Typing comfort and visual appeal are at the forefront with OSA double-shot PBT keycaps, designed for durability and a premium texture. Paired with south-facing RGB backlighting, users enjoy vibrant lighting effects without interference when using custom keycap sets. The Gateron Jupiter RED switches included in the fully assembled version offer smooth actuation with a tactile bump, while screw-in PCB stabilizers ensure a quieter and more stable typing experience.

The 4000mAh rechargeable Li-polymer battery delivers up to 190 hours of use with backlighting off, or up to 100 hours with RGB on its lowest brightness, ensuring long-lasting performance. With QMK/VIA support, users have full control to program macros, remap keys, and customize lighting to suit their workflow. Compatible with Windows, macOS, and Linux, the Keychron V3 Max is a versatile powerhouse that combines modern wireless technology, premium build quality, and limitless customization.

FEATURES:

  • 80% compact layout with programmable keys
  • 2.4GHz and Bluetooth to connect up to 3 devices
  • Hot-swappable Gateron RED switches
  • OSA PBT keycaps
  • South-facing RGB backlighting
  • 1000Hz polling rate
  • QMK/VIA support
  • Mac and Windows support

Quick Specs

  • Delivers 800W of stable power for demanding components.
  • 80 PLUS Bronze certified, ensuring ≥88% efficiency at typical loads.
  • Features a quiet 120mm HYB fan for optimal cooling performance.
  • Provides complete protection against power surges and failures.
  • Offers a 5-year warranty, guaranteeing long-lasting reliability.

Power Up Your PC with Confidence

FSP's Hydro M PRO 800W semi-modular PC power supply delivers reliable and efficient power for your gaming PC or workstation. Built with high-quality components and complete protection features, this ATX power supply ensures your system runs smoothly and safely.

80 PLUS Bronze Certification for Efficiency

The 80 PLUS Bronze certification guarantees an efficiency of ≥88% at typical loads. This means less energy waste, lower electricity bills, and a cooler running system. The Hydro M PRO 800W ATX power supply is designed to provide stable power while minimising environmental impact.

Quiet and Efficient Cooling

Equipped with a 120mm HYB fan, the Hydro M PRO 800W PC power supply provides excellent cooling performance while maintaining quiet operation. The fan's intelligent speed control ensures optimal balance between cooling and noise, keeping your system stable even during intense gaming sessions.

Comprehensive Protection Features

The Hydro M PRO 800W ATX power supply includes a full suite of protection features, such as OCP (Over Current Protection), OVP (Over Voltage Protection), OPP (Over Power Protection), and SCP (Short Circuit Protection). These protections safeguard your components from damage caused by power fluctuations or failures.

Semi-Modular Design for Easy Cable Management

The semi-modular design allows you to connect only the cables you need, reducing clutter and improving airflow inside your case. This makes building and maintaining your system easier and more efficient, resulting in a cleaner and more organised build.

Built to Last with a 5-Year Warranty

FSP stands behind the quality and reliability of the Hydro M PRO 800W PC power supply with a 5-year warranty. This provides peace of mind, knowing that your ATX power supply is protected against defects and failures for years to come.

FEATURES:

  • Enjoy peace of mind with complete protection against over current, over voltage, over power, and short circuits.
  • Minimise energy waste and reduce electricity costs with 80 PLUS Bronze certified efficiency.
  • Keeps your system cool and quiet with an intelligent 120mm HYB fan for optimal performance.
  • Simplify your build with a semi-modular design for improved cable management.
  • Trust in long-lasting reliability backed by a 5-year warranty.

product.name: MSI X870E Gaming Plus WIFI AM5 ATX Gaming Motherboard
product.description:
Power your next-gen gaming setup with the MSI X870E Gaming Plus WIFI AM5 ATX Gaming Motherboard, engineered for seamless performance with AMD Ryzen™ 9000, 8000, and 7000 Series processors. Boasting DDR5 memory support up to 8200+ MT/s (OC), PCIe 5.0 slots, and blazing-fast USB4 and 5G LAN connectivity, this board is built for gamers, creators, and power users alike. With Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 5.4, it delivers unmatched wireless speed and reliability, ensuring smooth gameplay and lag-free streaming. MSI's exclusive EZ DIY features, including EZ M.2 Shield Frozr II, EZ M.2 Clip II, and EZ PCIe Clip II, simplify hardware installation, even in tight builds.

The X870E Gaming Plus WIFI offers robust performance through a 14+2+1 digital power phase VRM design, complete with dual 8-pin power connectors and 60A Smart Power Stages for clean, stable power delivery to the CPU and GPU. With Frozr Guard thermal solutions, extended heatsinks, and 7W/mK MOSFET thermal pads, it keeps your system cool under pressure. MSI's Memory Boost and Core Boost technologies further elevate system responsiveness, allowing for efficient multitasking, high frame rates, and intense overclocking potential. Whether you're gaming, rendering, or diving into AI workloads, this motherboard is your ultimate powerhouse.

Designed with creators and DIY builders in mind, the pre-installed I/O shield and clean circuit layout enhance durability while reducing setup time. The EZ M.2 Clip II Remover tool and rebounding EZ PCIe Clip II make upgrading SSDs or GPUs quick and effortless. Featuring a comprehensive Cooling Wizard via MSI Center, users can manage fan and pump speeds with precision, reducing system noise while maximizing thermal efficiency. The motherboard supports multi-zone RGB lighting with Mystic Light, allowing full customization and syncing with compatible MSI components for a personalized look.

Enjoy intuitive system tuning through the redesigned CLICK BIOS X and gain full control of your PC’s performance. With USB 4.0, HDMI 2.1 4K@60Hz support, and multiple high-speed M.2 slots including Gen5 x4 for lightning-fast storage, the MSI X870E Gaming Plus WIFI delivers future-ready connectivity and expansion. This board is optimized for next-gen gaming and productivity, making it an ideal foundation for building a powerful and aesthetically pleasing high-performance PC.

  • Supports AMD Ryzen™ 9000 / 8000 / 7000 Series Desktop Processors
  • Supports DDR5 Memory, Dual Channel DDR5 8200+ MT/s (OC)

product.name: MSI MAG X870E TOMAHAWK WIFI AM5 ATX DDR5 Gaming Motherboard
product.description:
The MSI MAG X870E TOMAHAWK WIFI AM5 ATX DDR5 Gaming Motherboard is engineered for gamers seeking the perfect blend of durability, performance, and DIY-friendly design. Built on the powerful AMD X870E chipset, it supports the latest AMD Ryzen™ 9000, 8000, and 7000 Series Desktop Processors. This future-proof motherboard delivers cutting-edge connectivity, including true Wi-Fi 7, 5G LAN, USB 40Gbps, and PCIe 5.0 compatibility. Designed under MSI’s MAG (MSI Arsenal Gaming) series, the board emphasizes military-grade construction and reliable heat dissipation, making it ideal for demanding gaming sessions and high-performance PC builds.

Optimized for convenience, the MAG X870E TOMAHAWK WIFI includes MSI’s signature EZ DIY features like the EZ M.2 Shield Frozr II and EZ M.2 Clip II, enabling quick and tool-free SSD installations. The included EZ M.2 Clip II Remover adds flexibility for repositioning drives across the M.2 slots. Additional user-friendly enhancements include an EZ PCIe Release button for seamless GPU upgrades and a pre-installed I/O shield for straightforward and aligned motherboard installations. These thoughtful features make building and upgrading your system easier, faster, and more satisfying—no tools required.

To deliver top-tier power and memory performance, this motherboard boasts a 14+2+1 Duet Rail Power System with 80A Smart Power Stages, ensuring stable CPU operation even under extreme loads. It also supports dual-channel DDR5 memory up to 8400+ MT/s (OC), enhanced by MSI’s exclusive Memory Boost and SMT welding technology. This results in faster data processing, reduced latency, and higher bandwidth, whether you're gaming, streaming, or creating. Advanced cooling features such as the extended heatsinks and MOSFET thermal pads rated for 7W/mK help maintain optimal temperatures under pressure.

The MAG X870E TOMAHAWK WIFI is also packed with premium features to elevate your gaming experience. Audio Boost 5 delivers studio-grade sound for immersive gameplay, while Mystic Light lets you customize RGB lighting across millions of color combinations. With support for PCIe 5.0 graphics and NVMe storage, four M.2 slots, RAID support, and multiple USB Type-C ports up to 40Gbps, you’re ready to tackle the most intensive games and workloads. Whether you’re building your first PC or upgrading to a high-performance AMD Ryzen system, this motherboard provides a rock-solid foundation for your next-gen setup.

product.name: MSI MPG X870E EDGE TI WIFI AM5 ATX DDR5 Gaming Motherboard
product.description:
The MSI X870E EDGE TI WIFI AM5 ATX DDR5 Gaming Motherboard is the ultimate choice for gamers and PC enthusiasts seeking a premium white-themed build with cutting-edge performance. Part of the MSI MPG (MSI Performance Gaming) Series, this motherboard blends sleek, modern aesthetics with top-tier engineering to support the latest AMD Ryzen™ 9000, 8000, and 7000 Series processors. With Wi-Fi 7, 5G LAN, USB 4.0, and full PCIe 5.0 compatibility, it delivers blazing-fast connectivity and next-gen speed for gaming and content creation. The silver-white design makes it a showstopper in any build, while Mystic Light RGB control allows you to create a custom lighting setup with millions of colors and effects.

Engineered for enthusiasts, the MSI X870E EDGE TI WIFI features EZ DIY tools like EZ PCIe Release, EZ M.2 Clip II, and EZ Antenna, ensuring effortless component installation and upgrades. With EZ M.2 Shield Frozr II, installing or removing SSDs is tool-free and hassle-free, while the pre-installed I/O shield guarantees a smooth and secure fit during assembly. Designed with professionals and power users in mind, this motherboard supports USB 40Gbps Type-C, multiple high-speed USB ports, and ultra-fast Lightning Gen 5 M.2 storage, making it ideal for large data transfers and high-performance workflows.

The 14+2+1 Duet Rail Power System with 80A Smart Power Stages ensures stable overclocking and reliable power delivery, even under heavy gaming or rendering workloads. With dual 8-pin CPU connectors, enlarged heatsinks with heat-pipes, and MOSFET thermal pads rated at 7W/mK, the board keeps your system cool while pushing the limits of DDR5 memory speeds up to 8400+ MT/s (OC). MSI Memory Boost technology and the optimized PCB design enhance bandwidth, reduce latency, and maximize stability, making it perfect for demanding applications, eSports, and streaming.

Connectivity and audio performance are equally impressive with Realtek ALC4080 codec, 7.1-channel HD sound, and Audio Boost 5 for an immersive gaming experience. With support for 4 x M.2 slots, RAID 0/1/10, HDMI, and dual Type-C display outputs, this ATX motherboard is future-proof for both gaming and professional setups. The MSI X870E EDGE TI WIFI sets a new benchmark for performance, aesthetics, and usability, making it the best white X870E ATX DDR5 gaming motherboard for high-end Ryzen builds.

product.name: Xiaomi Electric Shaver S101 Replacement Head
product.description:
Keep your grooming routine sharp and efficient with the Xiaomi Electric Shaver S101 Replacement Head. Designed with upgraded 18 precision blades, this replacement head delivers a faster, smoother shave with less effort. The dual-track foils maximize coverage per stroke, ensuring an efficient shave while reducing the number of passes required, making it ideal for busy mornings or quick touch-ups.

Engineered with three independent floating shaver heads, the S101 replacement head adapts to the natural contours of your face, easily reaching tricky areas like the jawline, chin, and neck. This ensures a clean, close shave every time without irritation. Its fully washable design makes cleaning effortless—simply rinse under running water to maintain hygiene and long-term performance.

Installation is quick and simple, allowing you to upgrade your Xiaomi S101 in seconds. With its durable build and precision engineering, this replacement head restores your shaver’s original performance, extending its lifespan and maintaining the same high-quality grooming experience you expect from Xiaomi.

Whether you’re looking to replace a worn-out head or keep a spare on hand, the Xiaomi S101 Replacement Head is the perfect solution for reliable, long-lasting shaving. Compact, durable, and easy to clean, it helps you maintain a professional and polished look every day.

product.name: V-Sol V1600G0-B 4 Port GPON Optical Line Terminal
product.description:
The V-Sol V1600G0-B 4 Port GPON Optical Line Terminal (OLT) is a compact, high-efficiency pizza-box style solution designed to meet the demands of flexible and fast FTTx broadband access. Perfect for deployments in sparse, remote, or cost-sensitive areas, as well as smart industrial parks, commercial buildings, and FTTM applications, this GPON OLT combines performance, reliability, and easy management. Supporting up to a 1:128 split ratio per port, it delivers powerful multi-user connectivity while keeping operational costs low.

Equipped with Layer 3 dynamic routing protocols including RIP and OSPF, the V1600G0-B ensures stable, intelligent routing and automatic uplink failover to safeguard data transmission. The device supports IPv4/IPv6 dual stack for future-ready networking and comes with a flexible, policy-based firewall to protect against a wide range of cyber threats. This ensures a secure, high-speed connection environment for both enterprise and service provider applications.

The V-Sol V1600G0-B simplifies deployment with template-based configuration, plug-and-play functionality, and zero-threshold, low-cost O&M—making it easy to roll out FTTH services quickly. With Cloud EMS support, operators can centrally manage, monitor, and maintain network performance from anywhere. The compact 1U rackmount design saves space in network cabinets, while the 10Gbps SFP+ uplink ports ensure ultra-fast backbone connectivity for demanding workloads.

Powered by a 104Gbps backplane bandwidth and capable of handling up to 47.616Mpps port forwarding rate, the V1600G0-B delivers stable, high-speed data transfer across the network. Despite its powerful capabilities, it maintains a low 35W power consumption, making it both eco-friendly and cost-efficient to run. Whether for small ISPs, enterprise networking, or municipal broadband projects, the V-Sol V1600G0-B 4 Port GPON OLT offers the scalability, security, and performance needed to support modern fiber-optic networks.

Whether you’re a telecom operator looking for scalable ONU solutions or an end user seeking a fast, stable, and secure fiber connection, the V-Sol V2801SG delivers performance and reliability in a sleek package.

product.name: PXN HB S Dual-mode 16-Bit USB Electronic Racing Handbrake

Achieve precise, analogue braking control essential for rally and drifting simulations across PC platforms.

The precision required for mastery with a sim racing e brake

This PXN HB S handbrake is forged for the serious sim racer in South Africa who demands true physical feedback; it is not a toy for casual play. For the dedicated enthusiast, this translates directly into the ability to modulate brake pressure exactly as required, smoothing out inputs that would otherwise cause unwanted tyre lock or unpredictable rotation. This high-fidelity input defines the best sim racing e brake.

Engineered to resist the strain of competition

Durability is not optional; it is a prerequisite for consistent performance. The chassis and lever mechanism are milled from solid aluminium alloy. This material choice resists flexing and fatigue, ensuring that the feel remains consistent across hundreds of hours of intense racing. It is built to withstand the sharp, repeated demands of competitive digital motorsport, offering a lasting return on your investment in precision. This robust build quality solidifies its place as a professional sim racing e brake.

Simple integration into your cockpit

The setup ritual is swift. Utilizing a standard wired USB connection, the handbrake is recognised immediately by Windows-based racing platforms without the need for complex driver installations or intermediary hubs. Its design anticipates the dedicated cockpit builder, featuring M5 mounting holes that allow for rigid integration into custom setups, ensuring zero unwanted movement during aggressive manoeuvres. This ease of use makes it the essential pc racing handbrake for immediate track readiness.

product.name: Patriot P400 Lite 500GB M.2 PCIe NVMe SSD
product.description:
Experience dependable high-speed storage with the Patriot P400 Lite 500GB PCIe Gen4 x4 NVMe SSD, an ideal solution for users seeking fast data access, low power consumption, and high compatibility. Engineered with the latest PCIe Gen4 x4 technology and conforming to the compact M.2 2280 form factor, the P400 Lite delivers robust read and write performance of up to 3,500MB/s and 2,400MB/s respectively—perfect for elevating your system’s responsiveness across multiple applications, from gaming to general productivity.

The P400 Lite stands out with its slim graphene heatshield, a thermally efficient design that keeps the drive cool during demanding tasks without the need for bulky heatsinks. Advanced features such as Thermal Throttling Technology and SmartECC™ ensure long-term data integrity and system stability, while End-to-End Data Path Protection further reinforces reliability during high-speed transfers. Its 280TB endurance rating (TBW) and five-year warranty promise peace of mind and sustained performance over time.

Whether you're upgrading a laptop, building a new rig, or simply enhancing your current system, the Patriot P400 Lite offers a cost-effective, energy-efficient, and easy-to-install solution backed by Patriot’s renowned commitment to quality.

product.name: Keychron Q6 HE QMK Full-size Wireless Custom Mechanical Keyboard (Nebula Switch) – Carbon Black
product.description:
Quick Specs

  • Experience ultra-responsive gaming with rapid trigger technology.
  • Customise every key with adjustable actuation points (0.2 - 3.8 mm).
  • Enjoy seamless connectivity via 2.4 GHz, Bluetooth, or Type-C wired.
  • Game for up to 100 hours wirelessly with the backlit off.
  • Personalise your setup with vibrant, South-facing RGB backlighting.

Unlock Unrivalled Speed and Customisation with a Wireless Mechanical Keyboard

Keychron's Q6 HE keyboard redefines responsiveness and control, giving you the edge in every game and task. This full-size, custom mechanical keyboard combines cutting-edge technology with ultimate customisation, ensuring peak performance tailored to your needs.

Experience Lightning-Fast Rapid Trigger Technology on a Wireless Mechanical Keyboard

The Q6 HE features rapid trigger technology, allowing for near-instantaneous key actuations. This means quicker reactions, faster inputs, and a distinct advantage in fast-paced gaming scenarios. Never miss a beat with a keyboard designed to keep up with your every move.

Precision at Your Fingertips with Adjustable Actuation

Fine-tune your gaming experience with adjustable actuation points ranging from 0.2 to 3.8 mm. Whether you prefer a feather-light touch or a more deliberate press, the Q6 HE adapts to your unique style. Optimise your speed and accuracy with unparalleled precision.

Seamless Connectivity for Any Setup

Enjoy the freedom of versatile connectivity with 2.4 GHz wireless, Bluetooth 5.2, and Type-C wired options. Switch effortlessly between devices and enjoy a stable, low-latency connection in any environment. The Q6 HE is designed to integrate seamlessly into your gaming setup or workstation.

Endless Customisation with QMK/VIA Support on Your Custom Mechanical Keyboard

Take full control of your keyboard with QMK/VIA support, allowing you to remap keys, create macros, and customise RGB lighting effects. The possibilities are endless, giving you the power to create a truly personalised typing and gaming experience. Tailor the Q6 HE to perfectly match your workflow and style.

Built to Last with Premium Materials and Design

The Q6 HE is crafted from high-quality aluminium, ensuring durability and a premium feel. The screw-in PCB stabilisers provide a stable and consistent keystroke, while the hot-swappable design allows for easy switch replacement. Invest in a keyboard that's built to withstand the rigours of daily use and provide years of reliable performance.

Vibrant RGB Backlighting to Illuminate Your Style

Enhance your gaming setup with 22 types of RGB backlight options and South-facing RGB LEDs. Customise the lighting to match your mood, game, or setup, and create a visually stunning experience. The Q6 HE doesn't just perform exceptionally; it looks the part, too.

product.name: Keychron Q3 HE QMK 80% Wireless Custom Mechanical Keyboard (Nebula Switch) – Carbon Black
product.description:
The Keychron Q3 HE QMK 80% Wireless Custom Keyboard redefines premium mechanical keyboards with its robust aluminium full-metal body and gasket mount design, delivering unparalleled durability and a refined typing feel. Its 80% compact layout strikes the perfect balance between functionality and space-saving efficiency, featuring programmable keys for maximum productivity. Built with OSA PBT keycaps, the Q3 HE ensures a comfortable, long-lasting typing experience that resists shine and wear, making it ideal for both work and gaming.

Equipped with hot-swappable double rail magnetic NEBULA switches, this custom keyboard allows users to fine-tune their typing experience with adjustable actuation points from 0.2mm to 3.8mm. Whether you prefer ultra-sensitive inputs for gaming or deeper presses for productivity, the Rapid Trigger and Dynamic Keystroke (4-in-1 action keys) technology offer unmatched responsiveness and control. Combined with N-Key Rollover (NKRO) in both wired and wireless modes, you can count on flawless performance under pressure.

The Q3 HE offers triple connectivity options: USB Type-C wired, 2.4GHz wireless, and Bluetooth 5.2, with support for up to 3 paired devices. With a 1000Hz polling rate on wired and 2.4GHz modes, and 90Hz over Bluetooth, it ensures ultra-low latency for competitive gaming and smooth multitasking across devices. Powered by a 4000mAh rechargeable battery, the keyboard delivers up to 100 hours of usage with backlighting off, making it perfect for extended sessions.

Enhancing its aesthetics, the Keychron Q3 HE comes with 22 RGB backlight modes and south-facing LEDs, providing vibrant illumination and customization to suit your setup. Compatible with both Mac and Windows, and built with a screw-in PCB stabilizer for consistent performance, the Q3 HE is the ultimate keyboard for gamers, professionals, and creators who demand flexibility, power, and a premium typing experience.

product.name: Seagate IronWolf NAS 8TB Hard Drive
product.description:
The Seagate IronWolf 8TB NAS Hard Drive is expertly engineered for the demanding workloads of NAS environments, offering superior reliability, endurance, and speed for home, small business, and professional data storage systems. With a powerful combination of CMR technology, AgileArray™ firmware, and IronWolf Health Management, this drive ensures 24×7 operational readiness, optimized RAID performance, and proactive drive monitoring for superior data integrity.

Supporting up to 180TB workloads per year, the IronWolf 8TB delivers sustained transfer rates of up to 202MB/s, making it ideal for file sharing, data backups, media streaming, and collaborative access in multi-user NAS systems. It supports one- to eight-bay enclosures and is tested for compatibility with top NAS brands like Synology, QNAP, and Asustor. With RV sensors, dual-plane balance, and error recovery control, it maintains consistent performance in high-vibration, multi-drive environments, preventing mechanical strain and enhancing system longevity.

This IronWolf drive is also power-conscious, consuming as little as 0.5W in standby mode and averaging just 4.8W during active use. Its advanced energy-efficient design minimizes heat output and operating costs without compromising data throughput. Backed by a 3-year Seagate Rescue Data Recovery Services plan, you gain extra assurance for your most valuable digital content—making it the smart choice for always-on, mission-critical NAS storage.

FEATURES:

  • High-performance NAS hard drive.
  • Experience up to 7200 RPM spin speed with high-capacity NAS drives, delivering sustained data rates up to 180MB/s and burst speeds of 6Gb/s.
  • IronWolf Health Management actively monitors drive health when used with compatible NAS systems.
  • Supports workloads up to 180TB per year with optional data recovery services for added protection.
  • Compatible with one- to eight-bay NAS systems, home media servers, personal cloud storage, small offices, and workstations.

product.name: Acer NITRO V 15 Gaming Laptop 15.6" | AMD Ryzen 7 | 16GB | 512GB | 4050 6GB | Windows 11 Home
product.description:
Step into a world of immersive performance with the Acer Nitro V 15 Gaming Laptop – engineered for gamers, creators, and multi-taskers who seek performance without compromise. Whether you're battling through your favourite AAA titles, diving into creative software, or balancing productivity and entertainment, the Nitro V 15 is your ultimate gaming companion, wrapped in a sleek, futuristic chassis that radiates power and style.

At the heart of this beast is the 8-core AMD Ryzen 7 7735HS processor, offering base speeds of 3.2GHz and Turbo boost up to an impressive 4.75GHz. Pair this with 16GB of ultra-fast DDR5 memory (upgradeable for future-proofing) and a massive 512GB PCIe Gen4 NVMe SSD, and you’re ready to tackle intensive tasks, seamless multitasking, and lightning-fast load times.

Gaming visuals come to life on the 15.6" Full HD IPS display, boasting a 165Hz refresh rate and Acer’s ComfyView technology to reduce glare and enhance comfort during extended sessions. Whether you’re immersed in fast-paced action or exploring expansive open worlds, the NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4050 6GB GPU with DLSS 3.5, Ray Tracing, and Max-Q technologies ensures stunning, real-time rendering and hyper-realistic graphics.

Staying cool under pressure is no issue thanks to dual-fan cooling, complete with dual air intake and an efficient exhaust system. This powerful thermal solution ensures optimal performance, even when gaming gets intense. Fine-tune performance and monitor your system with NitroSense, Acer’s in-built utility that places control in your hands.

Connectivity is cutting-edge, offering Tri-Band Wi-Fi 6, Gigabit Ethernet, and a USB4 port supporting up to 40Gbps data transfer, power delivery, and video output. Whether you’re gaming at home or on the move, enjoy lag-free online performance and quick data exchange.

The AI-powered Acer PurifiedView webcam and dual microphones with PurifiedVoice noise reduction make virtual meetings and in-game communications crystal clear. And with DTS:X Ultra Audio, you’ll experience immersive, spatial sound that places you right at the heart of the action.

The Nitro V 15 is not just about raw power—it's also a gateway to smarter productivity with Windows 11 Home and built-in access to Copilot, Microsoft’s AI assistant, designed to inspire creativity, enhance focus, and streamline tasks with a simple keystroke.

product.name: Keychron B2 Pro Ultra-Slim 96% Wireless Keyboard - Ivory White
product.description:
The Keychron B2 Pro Ultra-Slim Wireless Keyboard is designed for professionals, gamers, and multitaskers who value a sleek, space-saving layout without compromising on functionality. Featuring a 96% compact design with 98 keys, it delivers the full convenience of a number pad and multimedia controls in a streamlined form factor. Its ultra-slim body and lightweight ABS construction make it an excellent choice for those who need portability while maintaining a premium typing experience.

Equipped with scissor mechanism keys, the B2 Pro ensures smooth, quiet, and responsive keystrokes, perfect for both work and play. With triple-mode connectivity, you can seamlessly switch between 2.4GHz wireless, Bluetooth 5.2 (connect up to three devices), and Type-C wired modes. A 1000Hz polling rate in wired and 2.4GHz wireless mode ensures ultra-fast response times, while Bluetooth delivers stable performance for laptops, desktops, and mobile devices.

Power efficiency is a standout feature, with an 800mAh rechargeable Li-polymer battery delivering up to 300 hours of continuous use (backlit off) and charging fully in just 2.5 hours. Its compact design includes a 3.2° typing angle for ergonomic comfort, while the non-backlit layout offers distraction-free focus for productivity. Whether for the office, creative workflows, or portable setups, the B2 Pro provides reliable performance with minimal power consumption.

Optimized for Mac, Windows, and Linux, the Keychron B2 Pro offers full cross-platform support, ensuring effortless switching between systems. With its ANSI layout, 12 multimedia keys, and streamlined design, this ultra-slim keyboard is the perfect solution for those seeking versatility, performance, and portability in one device.

  • Ultra-slim design
  • 2.4GHz and Bluetooth connection
  • 1000Hz Polling rate
  • Scissor mechanism keys

product.name: PCBuilder Picometre 14.5W/m.k Thermal Paste 2g
product.description:
The PCBuilder Picometre 14.5W/m.k Thermal Paste is an ideal choice for PC builders and tech enthusiasts seeking exceptional cooling performance. This premium thermal paste is designed to enhance heat transfer between your CPU or GPU and cooler, ensuring your system stays cool even during the most demanding tasks. With outstanding thermal conductivity (14.5W/m.k) and ultra-low resistance (<0.095℃-in²/W), it delivers rapid heat transfer for next-level cooling performance.

Engineered for a balanced density (viscosity of 95000±2000mPa, specific gravity of 2.8), this thermal paste allows for smooth, precise application every time. Its formula is optimized for easy spreading, ensuring a consistent layer that fills microscopic gaps for maximum contact. Perfect for both building and maintaining PCs, this heatsink compound makes thermal paste application simple and mess-free.

Built to withstand extreme conditions, the Picometre thermal paste can handle operating temperatures from -50°C to 280°C, making it ideal for high-performance systems and overclocking. Its durable silicone-based formula combines 85% metal oxides, providing a long-lasting seal that resists drying, cracking, or degrading. As a non-conductive paste, it offers complete peace of mind, eliminating any risk of short-circuiting sensitive components.

To apply the Picometre 14.5W/m.k Thermal Paste, clean the contact surfaces of your CPU or GPU and heatsink, then add a small, even amount to the centre of the component. Secure the heatsink to spread the paste evenly, resulting in close and optimised heat transfer. This straightforward thermal paste application ensures maximum cooling efficiency and extends your components's lifespan.

Upgrade your system with the PCBuilder Picometre 14.5W/m.k Thermal Paste and experience the difference in cooling performance. Whether you’re gaming, editing, or simply looking to maintain your PC, this premium heatsink compound is a trusted choice for top-tier thermal efficiency. This thermal paste gives you cooling you can count on when your system is pushed to the limit.

product.name: Hiksemi Future 2TB Gen4 M.2 NVMe NAND SSD
product.description:
Unlock ultra-fast performance with the Hiksemi Future 2TB Gen4 M.2 NVMe SSD, a next-generation storage solution built for speed, reliability, and intelligent design. Powered by the latest PCIe Gen4x4 interface, this high-performance SSD delivers sequential read speeds of up to 7450MB/s and write speeds up to 6750MB/s, making it ideal for gamers, creators, and PC enthusiasts who demand peak responsiveness and accelerated workflows. Whether you're booting your OS, launching applications, or transferring massive files, the Hiksemi Future SSD is engineered to eliminate delays and keep your system running at full throttle.

At its core, the Hiksemi Future SSD leverages advanced 3D TLC NAND flash and a proprietary NAND Flash management system developed by Hiksemi. This ensures optimized performance, data integrity, and energy efficiency—delivering consistent high-speed operations even under demanding conditions. With 860K IOPS read and 690K IOPS write capabilities, it excels in multitasking and real-time application execution, making it the perfect choice for content creators, software developers, and professionals who need both speed and dependability.

This SSD isn’t just about raw performance—it’s designed for rugged reliability. Thanks to its solid-state architecture, the Hiksemi Future 2TB SSD is inherently shock and vibration-resistant, eliminating the risk of mechanical failure. The absence of moving parts paired with low power consumption (max 3.66W) makes it an efficient choice for both desktops and ultrathin laptops. Additionally, its thermal management system keeps your system cool under pressure, further extending the drive's lifespan and maintaining optimal performance.

Compatible with a wide range of devices including gaming desktops, laptops, and even PlayStation 5, the Hiksemi Future SSD offers versatile deployment in today’s most demanding digital environments. With an impressive 3600TBW endurance rating and 2 million hours MTBF, it's backed by Hiksemi’s renowned quality standards and a reliable after-sales support system. For users looking to future-proof their systems with blazing-fast storage, the Hiksemi Future 2TB Gen4 M.2 NVMe SSD is a high-performance, long-term investment built for modern computing.

Get ready to dominate the game with the LG UltraGear 24GS60F 24" FHD IPS Gaming Monitor, engineered for speed, clarity, and responsiveness. Whether you're locked in an intense FPS or exploring vast virtual worlds, the Full HD 1920x1080 IPS panel delivers vibrant colours and consistent image quality from edge to edge.

Experience ultra-smooth gameplay with AMD FreeSync™ and NVIDIA G-SYNC® Compatibility, reducing screen tearing and stuttering for seamless performance. Whether you're an eSports enthusiast or a casual gamer, the LG UltraGear 24GS60F delivers high-performance visuals with pro-level features — all backed by a 36-month carry-in warranty. Power your play with LG’s trusted UltraGear line and bring out the best in every game.

product.name: ASRock X870E Taichi Lite AM5 ATX Motherboard
product.description:
Harness the power of true adaptability and unmatched performance with the ASRock X870E Taichi Lite AM5 ATX Motherboard, where minimalist design meets maximum capability. Inspired by the philosophy of boundless potential, the Taichi Lite is engineered to be as fluid and adaptable as water—ready to evolve with the needs of high-performance gamers, creators, and professionals alike. Supporting AMD Ryzen™ 9000, 8000, and 7000 Series processors with the latest AMD X870E chipset, this motherboard provides top-tier specs including dual PCIe 5.0 x16 slots, DDR5 memory overclocking up to 8200+ MHz, and blazing-fast USB4 Type-C connectivity. Whether you're building a next-gen gaming powerhouse or a productivity-driven workstation, the Taichi Lite delivers unwavering stability and responsiveness.

This board is armed with four M.2 slots, including a Blazing M.2 PCIe Gen5 x4 capable of 128 Gb/s transfer speeds for next-gen NVMe SSDs, and six SATA3 ports for expansive storage options. ASRock’s exclusive 5Gb/s LAN with superior EMI resistance, Wi-Fi 7, and Bluetooth 5.4 ensure rock-solid networking whether you're streaming, gaming, or working from home. Cooling is handled with precision, thanks to smart fan speed control across multiple headers, enhanced by extra-large aluminum alloy M.2 heatsinks for consistent thermal performance. Integrated USB4 (40Gbps) and USB 3.2 Gen2x2 (20Gbps) ensure lightning-fast connectivity for external devices, while a rich rear I/O includes HDMI 2.1, multiple high-speed USB ports, and onboard BIOS Flashback and Clear CMOS buttons for easy DIY setup.

Sound and visuals are elevated with Nahimic Audio, Realtek ALC4082, and ESS SABRE9219 DAC, ensuring immersive 5.1 channel sound, 130dB SNR output, and up to 600-ohm headset support. The built-in Polychrome SYNC and SignalRGB integration offer custom RGB control with addressable headers to create a visually synchronized, reactive lighting setup across compatible components. Whether it's stunning aesthetics, efficient cooling, ultra-low latency networking, or lightning-fast storage you’re after, the ASRock X870E Taichi Lite delivers a versatile, future-ready platform built to evolve with your ambition.
