product.name: ASRock X870 Riptide AM5 Wi-Fi Phantom Gaming Motherboard
product.description:
Experience the cutting edge of gaming performance and system flexibility with the ASRock X870 Riptide AM5 Wi-Fi Phantom Gaming Motherboard, engineered for enthusiasts who demand power, precision, and personalization. Designed around the powerful AMD X870 chipset and AM5 socket, this high-performance motherboard supports the latest Ryzen™ 9000, 8000, and 7000 Series processors, delivering exceptional responsiveness across gaming, streaming, and content creation. Featuring an 8-layer PCB, the X870 Riptide ensures superior thermal and power efficiency—perfect for extreme DDR5 memory overclocking up to 8000+ MHz. Whether you're fine-tuning performance via AMD EXPO™ profiles or pushing your system to the edge, the Riptide offers rock-solid reliability with a sleek, gamer-centric aesthetic.

Connectivity and expansion are at the heart of the X870 Riptide. It supports PCIe 5.0 graphics cards and Gen5 NVMe SSDs, with a Blazing M.2 slot that achieves up to 128 Gb/s transfer rates for next-gen storage. With three M.2 slots, 4 SATA3 connectors, and a reinforced Steel PCIe x16 slot for GPU stability, the board balances power and expandability. Users benefit from USB4 Type-C ports offering up to 40 Gb/s of data throughput, along with USB 3.2 Gen2x2 front panel Type-C, making high-speed data access simple and future-proof. Networking is equally robust with Killer 2.5Gb LAN and Wi-Fi 7 + Bluetooth 5.4, delivering seamless online gameplay and ultra-low latency.

Audio and aesthetics haven't been overlooked. Nahimic 7.1 HD Audio powered by the Realtek ALC4082 codec immerses gamers with crisp, spatial sound, while Polychrome SYNC and SignalRGB support allow for synchronized, addressable RGB lighting across your entire rig. The advanced aluminum heatsink design and M.2 heatsinks ensure top-tier thermal performance, keeping even the most demanding setups cool. Whether you're building your dream gaming PC or an elite workstation, the ASRock X870 Riptide delivers everything you need—and more—to ride the wave of next-gen performance.

FEATURES:

  • AMD AM5 socket supports Ryzen 9000, 8000, and 7000 Series processors
  • PCIe 5.0 x16 Steel Slot for next-gen GPU bandwidth and durability
  • Blazing-fast Wi-Fi 7 and 2.5G LAN for ultra-low-latency connectivity
  • Supports DDR5 memory overclocking up to 8000+ MHz for extreme performance
  • Three M.2 slots, including one Hyper Gen5 x4 for lightning-fast NVMe storage
  • Extra large aluminum alloy M.2 heatsink effectively improves heat dissipation
  • Enhanced USB4 Type-C technology brings speed and versatility
  • Nahimic Audio offers you the most engaging listening experience
  • Polychrome SYNC for vivid, addressable lighting control

product.name: ASUS PRO B760M C CSM LGA 1700 M-ATX Motherboard
product.description:
The ASUS PRO B760M-C-CSM LGA 1700 mATX Motherboard is a robust and reliable business-class solution designed to meet the demands of modern enterprise computing. Built on the Intel® B760 chipset and supporting 13th and 12th Gen Intel® Core™ processors, this micro-ATX motherboard delivers advanced performance, enhanced durability, and enterprise-grade features. With support for PCIe® 4.0 and DDR5 memory, the board offers lightning-fast data throughput and improved multitasking, making it ideal for performance-driven office builds or commercial applications. ASUS’ long-standing reputation for quality and its Corporate Stable Model (CSM) program ensures long-term availability and consistent support for IT departments.

Designed with reliability in mind, the ASUS PRO B760M-C-CSM features anti-sulfur resistors, corrosion-resistant stainless steel I/O panels, and a moisture-resistant PCB coating to ensure continued operation in challenging environments such as factories or internet cafés. ASUS LANGuard and ESD Guards offer robust protection against power surges and electrostatic discharge, further extending component lifespan and network stability. The board is also tested for 24/7 durability in temperatures up to 45°C and 80% relative humidity—perfect for mission-critical deployments and demanding usage scenarios.

Customization and management are streamlined through the ASUS Control Center Express, an intuitive IT monitoring and maintenance software suite. Built-in features like Q-LED Core, COM debug headers, and event logging tools help administrators diagnose and resolve issues efficiently. The motherboard also includes a DASH LAN header for remote management, allowing IT teams to monitor and manage devices over the network, significantly improving fleet maintenance and deployment time across large-scale environments.

With a versatile feature set that includes two M.2 slots, front USB 3.2 Gen 1 Type-C®, 7.1 surround sound audio, and dual DisplayPort, HDMI®, and VGA outputs, the ASUS PRO B760M-C-CSM is as flexible as it is powerful. The consistent internal connector layout and box-style USB headers ensure easier integration, saving time on training and hardware compatibility. Whether you're upgrading your business infrastructure or building a new enterprise workstation, this motherboard offers efficiency, security, and longevity, making it a smart investment for professionals and IT departments alike.

FEATURES:

  • Intel® LGA 1700 socket: Ready for 13th Gen Intel Core™ processors
  • ASUS CSM program: A stable motherboard supply, end-of-life notifications, and IT software for business motherboards
  • ASUS Control Center Express: Integrated IT monitoring and management software that simplifies enterprise-level system administration
  • Enhanced system security: A self-recovering BIOS
  • Consistent and reliable performance: High-quality components and rigorous testing to help ensure durability in harsh environments
  • Efficient management and customization: An event log and commercial BIOS kit to enable easy maintenance
  • Better serviceability: Q-LED Core diagnostic display and COM debug header to facilitate building and support processes
  • Ultrafast connectivity: PCIe 4.0, DDR5, front USB 3.2 Gen 1 Type-C®

product.name: Hiksemi Future RGB 16GB 3600MHz DDR4 Desktop Gaming Memory White

Designed for gamers, creators, and performance enthusiasts, this high-speed memory module delivers 3600MHz transfer rates with CL18 latency, ensuring smoother gameplay, faster multitasking, and reduced loading times across demanding applications. With support for Intel XMP profiles, overclocking is made simple and stable—giving users the freedom to unlock even more power with ease.

Crafted using premium-grade DRAM chips and mature production technology, the Hiksemi Future DDR4 series guarantees enhanced reliability, system stability, and longevity. Optimized for wide compatibility with major motherboard brands, it seamlessly integrates into a variety of systems for effortless plug-and-play performance. Operating at a low 1.35V, it also contributes to improved energy efficiency and lower thermal output—ideal for extended gaming sessions or heavy workloads.

The futuristic white heatspreader design doesn’t just look good—it also aids in thermal dissipation, helping to maintain optimal performance under pressure. Complemented by vibrant RGB lighting, this module transforms your rig with fully customizable illumination. Whether you're syncing with ASUS Aura Sync, MSI Mystic Light, Gigabyte RGB Fusion, or ASRock Polychrome, the RGB effects amplify your setup with stunning aesthetics tailored to your style.

Backed by a lifetime warranty, the Hiksemi Future RGB DDR4 3600MHz White Memory is a smart, stylish, and high-performing upgrade for any desktop system. Whether you're building a sleek white gaming PC or upgrading your current setup, this module delivers a powerful combination of speed, reliability, visual flair, and overclocking potential—making it a top choice for gamers and system builders who demand both form and function.

product.name: Hiksemi Future Core 4TB Gen5 M.2 NVMe 3D NAND SSD
product.description:
Unleash next-level speed and responsiveness with the Hiksemi Future Core 4TB Gen5 M.2 NVMe SSD, engineered to deliver elite-grade performance for high-demand computing environments. Powered by a next-generation PCIe Gen5x4 NVMe 2.0 interface and cutting-edge 3D NAND flash memory, this high-performance SSD reaches astonishing sequential read speeds of up to 14,800MB/s and write speeds of up to 13,200MB/s. Designed to accelerate everything from system boot-up to high-speed file transfers, it’s the perfect storage upgrade for gamers, content creators, and power users seeking ultra-fast responsiveness.

Built on Hiksemi’s advanced SSD controller architecture and 4th-generation agile ECC error correction technology (4K LDPC), the Future Core SSD ensures not only blistering performance but also rock-solid data integrity. Its end-to-end data protection and proprietary NAND Flash management software deliver exceptional stability and reliability during intensive operations. With a rated endurance of 1900TBW and 2 million hours MTBF, users can count on this drive for long-term use in mission-critical setups and high-capacity workloads alike.

Constructed with premium-grade 3D TLC NAND and EGA patching, this M.2 2280 SSD is manufactured via automated production lines and tested under strict Hiksemi quality control processes. The result is a drive that maintains consistent thermal performance and low power draw — just 7.5W during max read operations — making it ideal for use in gaming rigs, high-end laptops, and professional workstations. Its wide compatibility also extends to desktops, laptops, and even some gaming consoles, ensuring seamless integration across multiple platforms.

Whether you’re editing ultra-high-resolution video, loading expansive game worlds, or multitasking across demanding applications, the Hiksemi Future Core 4TB Gen5 SSD offers the ultimate in speed, reliability, and energy efficiency. With support for the latest NVMe 2.0d protocol, unmatched read/write performance, and built-in security and error correction mechanisms, this SSD sets a new benchmark for enthusiast and professional storage solutions. Upgrade your system today and experience the future of flash storage with Hiksemi.

FEATURES:

  • High Rv Speed: Pole interface, Max. read speed up to 14,800 MB/s
  • 3D NAND technology helps to develop higher capacity, performance, and stability
  • End To End Data Protection: Adopts latest generation controller with fourth-generation agile ECC correction technology (4k LDPC)
  • Widely compatible with personal computers, laptops, Gaming PC, etc.
  • Lower power consumption

  • Form Factor: M.2 2280
  • Max. Seq. Read: 14,800MB/s
  • Max. Seq. Write: 13,200MB/s

product.name: MSI GF RTX 5060 VENTUS 2X OC 8GB WH
product.description:
Unlock next-generation performance and precision visuals with the MSI GeForce RTX™ 5060 VENTUS 2X OC 8GB GDDR7 Graphics Card White Edition. Built on NVIDIA’s revolutionary Blackwell architecture, this sleek dual-fan GPU is designed for gamers and creators who demand efficient cooling, cutting-edge AI enhancements, and cinematic-quality ray tracing. Whether you're building a high-performance workstation or an elite gaming rig, the neutral white aesthetic and compact dual-fan TORX 5.0 design let the VENTUS 2X seamlessly integrate into any setup while delivering maximum airflow, stability, and thermal efficiency.

The RTX 5060 VENTUS 2X OC is engineered for serious performance, boasting 2535MHz Extreme Performance Clock (via MSI Center) and 2527MHz Boost Clock speeds. With 3840 CUDA cores and a massive 8GB of ultra-fast GDDR7 memory running at 28Gbps, you’re equipped to experience high-fidelity gaming with ultra-responsive frame rates. DLSS 4 support elevates your gameplay with cutting-edge AI features like Multi Frame Generation and enhanced Ray Reconstruction, dramatically improving FPS, latency, and image clarity—even in the most graphically demanding titles.

Harnessing the power of fourth-gen Ray Tracing Cores and fifth-gen Tensor Cores, the RTX 5060 delivers stunning visuals and next-level neural rendering. The card’s reinforced backplate includes a dedicated airflow vent to support efficient thermal dissipation, while precision-engineered heat pipes and MSI’s TORX Fan 5.0 keep GPU temps low under heavy load. These technologies work together to ensure optimal performance in high-res gaming, 3D design, video rendering, and complex AI workflows.

Whether you're battling in high-FPS competitive titles or building in Unreal Engine, the RTX 5060 VENTUS 2X OC supports 4K at 480Hz or 8K at 120Hz via HDMI 2.1b and DisplayPort 2.1b outputs. With support for G-SYNC®, DirectX 12 Ultimate, and OpenGL 4.6, plus NVIDIA Reflex and Frame Warp technologies, this GPU delivers ultra-low latency and unmatched responsiveness. Upgrade your creative and gaming potential today with the MSI RTX 5060 VENTUS 2X OC – where powerful performance meets elegant, efficient design.

FEATURES:

  • Powered by the NVIDIA Blackwell architecture and DLSS 4
  • Extreme clock performance: 2535MHz (MSI Center)
  • Boost clock performance: 2527MHz
  • TORX Fan 5.0: Fan blades linked by ring arcs work to stabilize and maintain high-pressure airflow
  • Heat Pipes designed for efficient heat transfer, the heat pipes effectively draw thermal energy away from the GPU, improving overall cooling performance.
  • The reinforcing backplate features an airflow vent that allows exhaust air to directly pass through.

product.name: MSI PRO X870-P WIFI AM5 ATX DDR5 Motherboard
product.description:
The MSI PRO X870-P WIFI AM5 ATX DDR5 Motherboard is purpose-built for professionals and power users who demand both performance and reliability. Sporting a clean and modern silver design, this motherboard seamlessly complements both black and white PC builds. At its core, the PRO X870-P is optimized for the latest AMD Ryzen™ 9000, 8000, and 7000 Series processors, delivering future-ready computing with support for ultra-fast DDR5 memory, PCIe 5.0 slots, and lightning-fast M.2 storage. With MSI’s exclusive features like EZ M.2 Shield Frozr II, EZ Antenna, and Supplemental PCIe Power, this board ensures effortless installation and thermal efficiency for next-gen performance.

Connectivity is front and center with USB 4.0, 5G LAN, and Wi-Fi 7, making it an ideal choice for creators, professionals, and gamers seeking the fastest data transfer and network speeds. The Audio Boost technology enhances your sound experience with studio-grade clarity, making immersive media and gaming experiences a reality. Whether you’re building a workstation or a high-performance gaming rig, the MSI PRO X870-P WIFI delivers exceptional throughput, bandwidth, and multitasking capabilities.

Under the hood, this motherboard is engineered for extreme durability and overclocking potential. It features a 14+2+1 Duet Rail Power System, dual 8-pin CPU power connectors, and advanced thermal solutions including extended heatsinks and 7W/mK MOSFET thermal pads. The support for dual-channel DDR5 memory at 8200+ MT/s (OC), along with PCIe 5.0 and Gen5 M.2, guarantees next-level speed and responsiveness for demanding applications like AI, video editing, and high-end gaming.

Built for easy DIY assembly, the MSI PRO X870-P includes a host of convenient tools such as EZ M.2 Clip II, EZ PCIe Clip II, and a user-friendly BIOS interface powered by MSI Center AI. Whether you’re a seasoned builder or setting up your first custom PC, this motherboard simplifies the process while offering robust support and expandability. With its impressive spec sheet and pro-grade build quality, the MSI PRO X870-P WIFI ATX motherboard is your gateway to unleashing the full potential of AMD Ryzen and DDR5 technologies.

product.name: LG Essential 20" WSXGA TN Monitor 75Hz
product.description:
Quick Specs

  • Experience clear visuals on a 19.5-inch WSXGA display.
  • Enjoy smooth motion with a 75Hz refresh rate.
  • Benefit from enhanced viewing comfort with Flicker Safe technology.
  • Customise your display settings using OnScreen Control.
  • Reduce energy consumption with Smart Energy Saving features.

A clear and efficient workspace solution

Designed for professionals and everyday users, the LG Essential 20-inch office monitor delivers a balance of essential features and reliable performance. Whether you are working on spreadsheets, browsing the web, or creating content, this office monitor provides the clarity and comfort you need to stay productive.

Crisp visuals for detailed work

The WSXGA (1600 x 900) resolution ensures sharp and detailed images, making it easier to view documents, analyse data, and enjoy multimedia content. The TN panel offers a fast response time, reducing motion blur and ghosting, which is especially beneficial for fast-paced applications. With a 75Hz monitor refresh rate, enjoy smoother visuals.

Comfortable viewing for extended use

LG's Flicker Safe technology minimises screen flicker, reducing eye strain and fatigue, even after long hours of use. Reader Mode optimises screen settings for reading, reducing blue light emissions and creating a more comfortable viewing experience, similar to reading a paper document.

Customise your display with ease

OnScreen Control allows you to easily adjust office monitor settings with a few clicks of your mouse. Customise screen split options to manage multiple windows, adjust picture settings, and optimise your viewing experience for different tasks.

Environmentally conscious design

The Smart Energy Saving feature reduces power consumption without compromising image quality. This makes the 75Hz monitor an eco-friendly choice, helping you save on energy costs and reduce your environmental impact.

Smooth and responsive performance

The 75Hz monitor refresh rate delivers smoother motion and reduces input lag, enhancing your overall viewing experience. Dynamic Action Sync minimises input lag, ensuring you can react quickly in fast-paced situations, providing a competitive edge whether you're working or relaxing.

FEATURES:

  • Maximise screen visibility with a 19.5-inch display and 16:9 aspect ratio, for comfortable viewing.
  • Experience fluid visuals with a 75Hz monitor refresh rate, reducing motion blur.
  • Minimise eye strain with Flicker Safe technology, allowing comfortable extended use.
  • Optimise viewing with Reader Mode, reducing blue light emissions.
  • Customise display settings easily using OnScreen Control software.
  • React quickly with Dynamic Action Sync, minimising input lag.
  • Enhance contrast using Black Stabilizer, revealing greater detail in dark scenes.
  • Reduce energy consumption with Smart Energy Saving features, lowering your carbon footprint.
  • Mount to a wall using the 75 x 75mm VESA mount for flexible setup.

product.name: Patriot Signature Line 16GB 5600MHz DDR5 UDIMM Desktop Memory
product.description:
Upgrade your desktop with Patriot’s Signature Line 16GB DDR5 5600MHz UDIMM, engineered to meet the growing demands of next-generation computing. Tailored for Intel’s latest platforms, this DDR5 memory module delivers a massive leap in bandwidth and responsiveness, with a blazing 5600MT/s data rate (PC5-44800). Designed to optimize both power efficiency and thermal performance, it runs on just 1.1V, generating less heat without compromising speed—ideal for performance enthusiasts and professional-grade system builds.

The module features a Power Management Integrated Circuit (PMIC), providing precise local voltage regulation and advanced monitoring to ensure peak efficiency under heavy workloads. Integrated thermal sensors offer real-time temperature management to safeguard against overheating, while on-die ECC (Error-Correcting Code) boosts system stability by ensuring accurate data processing. Built to exacting standards and rigorously 100% tested, the Signature Line DDR5 module guarantees compatibility, reliability, and endurance under demanding conditions.

With a limited lifetime warranty and support for the latest DDR5 standards, Patriot’s Signature Line memory is the perfect drop-in upgrade for desktops seeking faster multitasking, lower latency, and long-term durability in everyday and intensive use scenarios.

FEATURES:

  • Signature Line Series
  • PC5-44800 (5600MHz) Data Rate
  • Double-sided Module
  • DDR5 Module Designed for Desktops
  • Non-ECC Unbuffered UDIMM
  • 100% Tested
  • Limited Lifetime Warranty

product.name: Patriot Signature Line 16GB 5600MHz DDR5 SODIMM Notebook Memory
product.description:
Unlock powerful performance in your next-generation laptop with the Patriot Signature Line DDR5 16GB 5600MHz SODIMM. Engineered to meet the increasing demands of modern computing, this high-efficiency DDR5 module brings next-level speed, energy savings, and stability to your system. With a base frequency of 5600MT/s (PC5-44800) and ultra-low 1.1V operating power, this module is the ideal upgrade for users looking to enhance multitasking, improve load times, and maximise system responsiveness in compatible Intel platforms.

Designed specifically for compact laptops and small form factor systems, this 262-pin DDR5 SODIMM utilises Single Rank, single-sided architecture for optimal compatibility. Whether you’re handling everyday productivity, intensive applications, or multitasking environments, the Patriot DDR5 ensures a smooth, reliable computing experience. Each module is 100% factory tested to ensure consistency, reliability, and top-tier performance.

The onboard Power Management Integrated Circuit (PMIC) offers granular control over voltage delivery, improving efficiency while also enabling smarter thermal and power management. Combined with on-die ECC (Error-Correcting Code), the module ensures data integrity by correcting minor errors in real time, boosting system reliability and overall operational stability—ideal for professionals, students, and system integrators.

Additionally, the integrated thermal sensors help monitor internal temperature in real time, proactively preventing overheating and enhancing the long-term durability of your device. Backed by a limited lifetime warranty, this DDR5 memory upgrade from Patriot offers peace of mind and future-ready performance, making it the smart choice for any new Intel-powered build or laptop upgrade.

Unlock powerful performance in your next-generation laptop with the Patriot Signature Line DDR5 8GB 4800MHz SODIMM. Engineered to meet the increasing demands of modern computing, this high-efficiency DDR5 module brings next-level speed, energy savings, and stability to your system. With a base frequency of 4800MT/s (PC5-38400) and ultra-low 1.1V operating power, this module is the ideal upgrade for users looking to enhance multitasking, improve load times, and maximise system responsiveness in compatible Intel platforms.

Designed specifically for compact laptops and small form factor systems, this 262-pin DDR5 SODIMM utilises Single Rank, single-sided architecture for optimal compatibility. Whether you’re handling everyday productivity, intensive applications, or multitasking environments, the Patriot DDR5 ensures a smooth, reliable computing experience. Each module is 100% factory tested to ensure consistency, reliability, and top-tier performance.

The onboard Power Management Integrated Circuit (PMIC) offers granular control over voltage delivery, improving efficiency while also enabling smarter thermal and power management. Combined with on-die ECC (Error-Correcting Code), the module ensures data integrity by correcting minor errors in real time, boosting system reliability and overall operational stability—ideal for professionals, students, and system integrators.

Additionally, the integrated thermal sensors help monitor internal temperature in real time, proactively preventing overheating and enhancing the long-term durability of your device. Backed by a limited lifetime warranty, this DDR5 memory upgrade from Patriot offers peace of mind and future-ready performance, making it the smart choice for any new Intel-powered build or laptop upgrade.

product.name: Patriot iLuxe Cube 1TB Type-C Smart Backup Solution - White
product.description:
Experience hassle-free, automatic data protection with the Patriot iLuxe Cube 1TB, the ultimate smart backup solution for your iPhone and iPad. Designed to simplify and secure your digital life, the iLuxe Cube seamlessly backs up your photos, videos, and contacts while you charge your device—no apps to manage, no buttons to press, and no interruptions to your daily routine.

Equipped with H2+ industrial-grade embedded memory, the iLuxe Cube ensures all files are backed up with precision and reliability. Whether it’s your latest family vacation or professional contacts, every piece of data is 100% restored with its original file format, resolution, date, time, and even geolocation. Its intelligent backup system only saves new or changed data—eliminating unnecessary duplicates and maximizing the Cube’s 1TB capacity.

Ideal for households with multiple devices, the iLuxe Cube automatically creates individual backup folders for each connected iPhone ID. There’s no risk of mixing up data between users, and no manual sorting required—making it a perfect solution for families. Plus, Patriot’s exclusive Trust Circle technology puts privacy first, allowing users to define who can access or share data across devices.

Backed by Apple MFi certification, the iLuxe Cube supports USB-C PD fast charging up to 30W, ensuring your device powers up while your data is securely backed up in the background. Its compact size (just 4.4 x 2.7 x 2.3 cm) and featherlight weight (15g) make it perfect for travel or bedside use.

Compatible with iOS 12 and above, macOS 10.x+, and Windows XP and above, the iLuxe Cube offers a plug-and-play backup experience that fits right into your digital ecosystem—without any subscription fees or software installation.

FEATURES:

  • Capacity: 1TB
  • USB 3.2 Gen1 Type-C 5Gbps
  • H2+ industrial-grade memory embedded. Backup data guarantee.
  • Individual folder for each iPhone ID. One family one Cube
  • Exclusively trust circle technology
  • The original backup date, time, location tag and file format when shooting are 100% restored without any differences.
  • Only backs up images and content not already loaded onto the iLuxe Cube.
  • Easily backup and restore your image from iPhone.
  • Background backup technology. Multitask during backup process
  • USB Type-C Compatible to PD fast charging (up to 30 Watts)
  • Apple MFi Certification. Made for iPhone and iPad
  • Warranty 3 Years
  • Compatible iOS12 or Above. Mac10x or Above. Win XP or Above

product.name: Patriot PDP31 1TB Type-C Portable SSD - Red / Black
product.description:
Designed for creators, professionals, and tech enthusiasts on the move, the Patriot PDP31 1TB Portable SSD delivers blazing-fast performance and next-gen portability in a compact, rugged package. Leveraging USB 3.2 Gen2 technology, this ultra-portable SSD offers sequential read and write speeds of up to 1000MB/s, enabling lightning-fast transfers of large files, videos, and project folders without skipping a beat.

Whether you’re working on 4K video editing, managing large databases, or backing up your digital life, the PDP31 provides 1TB of high-speed NVMe storage in the ultra-compact M.2 2230 form factor. Housed in a premium 100% aluminium alloy shell with a sleek transparent window, this SSD combines cutting-edge performance with modern aesthetics. It’s not just about looks—the aluminium casing also doubles as a passive heatsink, helping maintain cool operation even during intense usage.

The PDP31 is engineered with durability in mind. Its shock-proof silicone bumper provides drop protection against accidental knocks and bumps, making it a reliable companion whether you’re working from home, on location, or on the go. Its small footprint and lightweight build (only 54.7g) make it pocket-friendly and travel-ready.

Equipped with a Type-C USB 3.2 Gen 2 controller, this SSD ensures 10Gbps transfer bandwidth, and supports hot-swapping for effortless plug-and-play performance. It’s fully backward-compatible with USB 3.0 and USB 2.0, and works seamlessly across Windows, macOS, Linux, and Android platforms, making it a true plug-and-play universal storage solution.

Whether you’re a professional looking for a reliable workhorse or a student needing fast, portable storage, the Patriot PDP31 1TB SSD offers best-in-class performance in a rugged, compact design.

  • Supports PCIe M.2 NVMe SSDs in the 2230 form factor
  • USB 3.2 Gen2 (10Gbps) interface controller
  • 100% Aluminium alloy shell & transparent window
  • Supports hot swap and reversible swap
  • Convenient and portable cable
  • Silicone bumper shock-proof and drop-proof for added protection
  • Compatible with USB3.0 / USB2.0 interface
  • Compatible with Windows / Mac OS / Linux / Android platform

product.name: ASRock B860M-X WIFI Micro ATX DDR5 Motherboard (PCIe 5 and Wi-Fi 6E)
product.description:
For system builders who want performance without the bulk, the ASRock X-Series Micro ATX DDR5 Motherboard with PCIe Gen5 & Wi-Fi 6E stands out as a compact powerhouse engineered for serious productivity. It’s designed to support the latest Intel® Core™ Ultra Series 2 CPUs on the LGA1851 socket, combining next-gen processing with high-speed memory and lightning-fast connectivity.

The Micro ATX form factor makes it ideal for compact setups, but there’s nothing small about what it delivers. Dual DDR5 DIMM slots support up to 128GB with overclocking speeds north of 9066MHz. This level of headroom means smoother multitasking, faster compile times, and more responsive virtualisation—especially useful for professionals working across demanding workflows.

Storage is handled with equal ambition: a blazing PCIe Gen5 M.2 slot on the CPU lane delivers up to 128Gb/s, complemented by Gen4 M.2 and four SATA ports with RAID support. Visual output is equally robust, with support for 4K 120Hz via HDMI 2.1 and up to 8K 60Hz through DisplayPort 1.4, ideal for content creators and multi-monitor users.

Networking and I/O are where the board quietly excels. You get 2.5GbE LAN with smart bandwidth controls and Wi-Fi 6E for reliable wireless throughput—even in congested environments. Add BIOS Flashback, driver-free installation, and ASRock’s signalRGB lighting control, and you’ve got a board that’s as functional as it is forward-looking.

This is more than just a Micro ATX DDR5 motherboard with PCIe Gen5—it’s a strategic backbone for professionals who demand desktop-grade stability in a smaller footprint. If versatility, speed, and build efficiency matter, this board deserves a serious look.

FEATURES

  • PCIe Gen5 M.2 slot delivers ultra-fast 128Gb/s storage speeds for high-performance applications
  • Dual DDR5 DIMMs support up to 128GB at 9066+ MHz (OC) for enhanced multitasking and future-proof memory bandwidth
  • Intel Wi-Fi 6E and 2.5GbE LAN with smart traffic control for ultra-reliable, low-latency networking
  • Robust 7+1+1+1+1 power phase design with 6-layer PCB ensures stable performance and thermal efficiency
  • BIOS Flashback and preloaded LAN driver enable CPU-less firmware updates and seamless system setup
  • HDMI 2.1 and DisplayPort 1.4 support 4K 120Hz and 8K 60Hz output for next-gen integrated graphics workflows
  • ASRock Polychrome SYNC with RGB and addressable headers for system-wide custom lighting control
  • Smart fan tuning with auto-detection, curve configuration, and A-Tuning software for intuitive thermal management
  • Compact Micro ATX form factor balances component compatibility with space-saving design
  • Compatible with Intel® Core™ Ultra (Series 2) CPUs featuring AI acceleration and Hybrid Technology

Take your gaming to the next level with the PCBuilder Ryzen 7 7800X3D MAXIMUS Windows 11 Gaming PC. Equipped with the powerful 7th-generation AMD Ryzen 7 7800X3D processor, featuring 8 cores and clock speeds of up to 5.0GHz, this gaming rig ensures smooth and fast performance for all your gaming and multitasking needs. Combined with the Asus B840 chipset motherboard, 32GB of high-speed DDR5 gaming memory, and an 16GB Radeon RX 9070 XT graphics card, this PC is built for high-speed gaming, offering exceptional reliability and efficiency.

32GB of DDR5 6000MHz gaming memory ensures that the PCBuilder MAXIMUS Windows 11 Gaming PC ensures lightning-fast load times and seamless multitasking. The Radeon RX 9070 XT 16GB Graphics Card brings stunning visuals, allowing you to enjoy your favourite games in ultra-high detail. With a Timespy score of over 25200 points, this excellent gaming option is great for the latest game releases. Experience immersive gameplay in demanding games like Cyberpunk 2077 (3DMark FPS: 220), Ghost of Tsushima (3DMark FPS: 235), and Microsoft Flight Simulator (3DMark FPS: 205).

Featuring a spacious 1TB Gen4 NVMe solid-state drive (SSD), you’ll have plenty of room to store all your games and media, while experiencing ultra-fast data transfer and load times. Powering the system is an 750W 80 PLUS Gold Modular power supply, designed for efficiency and maximum performance for the most demanding graphics cards.

All of these components are housed in the futuristic Asus A31 PLUS Mid Tower ATX Chassis with a sleek, tempered glass side and front panels, showcasing your powerful built-in style. Plus, with Wi-Fi 6 support, you can enjoy fast and reliable internet without the hassle of cables. Whether you’re a serious gamer or a content creator, the PCBuilder Ryzen 7 7800X3D MAXIMUS Gaming PC gives you the speed, power, and style you need to excel in any challenge.

The MAXIMUS comes pre-installed with Windows 11 which has easy-to-use tools that can help you optimise your screen space and maximise your productivity. It features great tools like Microsoft Edge, the new and improved Microsoft Store, Snap Layouts to arrange your open windows into grids, Desktops for better organisation, as well as Widgets. Gaming is also now easier than ever, simply turn on your PC & game from day one.

Built in-house by our experienced technicians, each build is constructed with care and precision. They’re packaged with protective foam that secures the components while in transit, so every build arrives at its destination ready to game from day one. PCBuilder gaming PCs come with a 2-year warranty.

product.name: LG UltraFine 32" QHD IPS Monitor 100Hz with USB-C
product.description:
Experience professional-grade colour precision and performance with the LG UltraFine 32" QHD IPS Monitor. Designed for creative professionals, designers, and power users, this 31.5" display delivers stunning 2560 x 1440 QHD resolution with IPS technology, offering vivid visuals and consistent colours from virtually any angle. Boasting 99% sRGB colour gamut coverage, it reproduces colours with outstanding accuracy, making it ideal for photo editing, video production, and content creation. Add HDR10 support to the mix, and your visuals come alive with enhanced brightness and deeper contrast for lifelike realism.

Enjoy fluid motion and sharp clarity with a 100Hz refresh rate and 5ms (GtG) response time, ensuring smooth performance whether you're immersed in editing high-resolution footage or enjoying casual gaming sessions. Features like Dynamic Action Sync reduce input lag, while Black Stabilizer illuminates dark scenes to give gamers a competitive edge. Combined with Reader Mode, which reduces blue light to minimise eye fatigue, the UltraFine 32" delivers a versatile and comfortable experience for long hours of use.

Effortlessly manage your workload and entertainment with the monitor’s intuitive Switch app and Super Resolution+, which allow for intelligent multitasking, video conferencing shortcuts, and on-the-fly display optimisation. Stay productive with seamless USB Type-C™ connectivity, offering data transfer and 15W power delivery to your laptop or device — all through a single cable. Whether you’re working across multiple windows or switching between webOS streaming and PC applications, this monitor adapts to your workflow with ease.

Visually striking and functionally refined, the UltraFine 32" features a 3-side virtually borderless design, providing a sleek and immersive viewing experience that enhances any workspace. The minimalist tilt-adjustable stand helps reduce desk clutter while optimising your viewing position. With VESA 100 x 100 compatibility, it easily mounts on monitor arms or walls for ergonomic flexibility. Backed by a 3-year carry-in warranty, this monitor delivers reliability and style for professionals who expect more from their display.

product.name: ASRock Radeon RX 9060 XT Challenger 16GB OC Graphics Card (RDNA™ 4, PCIe 5.0)
product.description:
The ASRock Radeon™ RX 9060 XT Challenger 16GB OC is more than a graphics card—it’s your new performance anchor. Built on AMD’s latest RDNA™ 4 architecture and fine-tuned for uncompromising 1440p gaming, this GPU pairs raw silicon muscle with refined efficiency. Whether you're pushing frame rates in ray-traced blockbusters, accelerating AI-enhanced workflows, or streaming crisp, artefact-free footage, the RX 9060 XT delivers every frame with clarity and composure.

Under the hood, 2,048 Stream Processors and 32 Compute Units—each equipped with 3rd Gen Ray Accelerators and 2nd Gen AI Accelerators—form the computational backbone of the card. Bolstered by a Boost Clock of up to 3290MHz and a blazing-fast 16GB of GDDR6 memory running at 20Gbps, the RX 9060 XT is primed for high-intensity scenarios and multitasking madness. It supports DirectX® 12 Ultimate, OpenGL 4.6, and AMD’s FidelityFX™ Super Resolution 4, letting you game smarter, not harder—with enhanced detail, smoother performance, and jaw-dropping visuals.

Thermal control is where the Challenger earns its name. This model integrates a sophisticated dual-fan cooling system, featuring Striped Axial Fans that channel more air, a high-density fin stack with ultra-fit heatpipes, and Nano Thermal Paste that bridges every microscopic gap for optimal heat transfer. And when the system is idle? The 0dB Silent Cooling mode stops the fans entirely, keeping your setup both cool and quiet.

Structurally, the Challenger is built with finesse. A full metal backplate adds rigidity and acts as a passive heatsink, while subtle LED lighting provides ambient flair without overstatement. Prefer a darker aesthetic? Flip the onboard LED switch and keep it stealthy. With a matte black PCB, high-density glass fabric layering, and a Dr.MOS power stage delivering up to 50A per phase, this card balances engineering prowess with visual sophistication.

Optimised for AMD Ryzen™ 9000 Series processors and AM5 platforms, the RX 9060 XT takes full advantage of Smart Access Memory™ to maximise CPU-GPU bandwidth. Meanwhile, AMD’s Adrenalin Edition software puts one-click performance tuning and real-time AI-powered enhancements at your fingertips. Whether you’re a competitive gamer, creative professional, or performance enthusiast, this GPU is ready to raise the bar.

  • Powered by AMD RDNA™ 4 architecture with DirectX® 12 Ultimate support
  • Game Clock at 2700MHz, Boost Clock up to 3290MHz

product.name: PCBuilder FLEX 15.6" Full HD IPS Portable Monitor
product.description:
The PCBuilder FLEX 15.6” Full HD IPS Portable Monitor is the ultimate portable computer monitor designed for versatility, convenience, and stunning visual performance. Whether you're on a business trip, working remotely, or simply need a flexible second screen, this ultra-slim and lightweight display makes productivity and entertainment possible anywhere. It’s the perfect portable monitor for laptop users who need a reliable screen extension while traveling, at a café, or even in a hotel room.

Equipped with a crisp 15.6-inch Full HD IPS display, the FLEX delivers vibrant visuals with rich detail and colour accuracy. Its bright colour clarity and wide 178° viewing angles ensure everything from work presentations to movies looks sharp and consistent from any angle. With a contrast ratio of 1000:1 and up to 250 nits of brightness, this portable computer monitor holds its own even in brightly lit environments, making it a dependable screen in any situation.

Designed with portability in mind, the FLEX features an ultra-thin build that slides effortlessly into backpacks or laptop bags. The foldable magnetic cover doubles as a stand, allowing for instant setup wherever you are - no tools or extra gear required. This makes it a standout portable desktop monitor that adapts to your workflow on the fly, whether you're presenting to clients or extending your display space at a coffee shop.

The monitor offers universal compatibility with two Type-C ports, one Mini HDMI input, and a 3.5mm AUX audio output. Whether you're connecting to a laptop, smartphone, console, or tablet, you’ll appreciate the seamless plug-and-play experience. The two Type-C ports supports both power and video, so you can keep cables to a minimum - an ideal setup for the modern, mobile user in need of a compact portable computer monitor.

With a 60Hz refresh rate, 8ms response time (GTG), and support for HDR and FreeSync, this monitor also handles multimedia content and casual gaming with ease. If you’re in need of a second screen that doubles as a portable monitor for laptop setups or serves as a compact, efficient portable desktop monitor, the PCBuilder FLEX is your all-in-one solution.

So whether you’re jumping between client meetings, creating on the move, or simply kicking back with a movie after hours, the PCBuilder FLEX is your go-anywhere, do-anything screen. More than just a portable computer monitor, it’s your everyday advantage - helping you stay productive and inspired no matter where you are.

product.name: Acer Travelmate P4 16″ Laptop | Intel U5-125U | 8GB DDR5 | 1TB NVMe | Windows 11 Pro
product.description:
The Acer TravelMate P4 16″ is a business-class powerhouse, purpose-built for professionals and small businesses that demand reliable, high-performance computing for daily operations. Combining cutting-edge processing power with efficient design, this laptop offers the perfect blend of productivity, connectivity, and mobility — making it ideal for users who work in dynamic, fast-paced environments.

Powered by a 14th Gen Intel® Core™ Ultra 5-125U processor, this TravelMate P4 delivers exceptional computing capabilities with a base clock speed of 1.3GHz and Turbo Boost up to 4.4GHz, supported by 12MB of Intel® Smart Cache. As part of Intel’s next-generation platform, the Ultra series processor integrates advanced AI-enhanced performance, security features, and power management for smarter multitasking and higher efficiency across professional workloads. Whether you're crunching spreadsheets, attending virtual meetings, or managing multiple cloud-based apps, the TravelMate P4 keeps you performing at peak productivity.

This system includes 8GB of DDR5 RAM, with support for up to 64GB, ensuring your laptop is future-ready for more demanding applications. The high-speed 1TB PCIe Gen4 NVMe SSD provides ample space for documents, large media files, and enterprise software, while dramatically reducing load times and enabling faster data access and system boot-up.

Enjoy superior visuals on the 16-inch Full HD+ Acer ComfyView™ LED-backlit IPS display (1920 x 1200 resolution). With 400 nits of brightness, the screen delivers sharp, clear visuals in a 16:10 aspect ratio—perfect for reviewing documents, video conferencing, or streaming presentations. Integrated Intel® Graphics further ensures smooth rendering of multimedia content, business visuals, and daily productivity tasks.

Designed with modern business users in mind, the TravelMate P4 includes advanced wireless and wired connectivity. Featuring Wi-Fi 6E, Bluetooth® 5.3, and dual USB Type-C ports supporting USB4 and Thunderbolt™ 4, this laptop delivers ultra-fast data transfer, video output, and charging capabilities. Additional ports include HDMI® 2.1, two USB-A ports, and an RJ-45 Ethernet port, offering compatibility with all your devices and peripherals.

Security and collaboration tools are equally robust. The IR webcam with privacy shutter and integrated fingerprint reader support Windows Hello for quick and secure login. Two digital microphones enhanced by Acer Purified Voice™ AI noise reduction and dual stereo DTS® Audio speakers ensure clear communication during virtual meetings. The 3-cell Lithium-Ion battery provides up to 11 hours of runtime, keeping you powered throughout your workday.

With a durable chassis and business-focused design, the Acer TravelMate P4 offers unmatched reliability and functionality in its class. The multi-gesture touchpad, international keyboard layout, and Windows 11 Pro Operating System enhance usability, allowing you to work smarter and more securely across business platforms.

product.name: ASRock B850M-X WiFi AM5 Micro ATX Motherboard (DDR5, PCIe 5.0, Wi-Fi 6E)
product.description:
The ASRock B850M-X WiFi is a motherboard engineered for builders who refuse to settle. Whether you're assembling a competitive gaming rig, a streamlined creative workstation, or a compact powerhouse for daily use, this Micro ATX board delivers top-tier performance, ultra-fast connectivity, and platform versatility—all in a space-saving design.

At its core lies the AMD B850 chipset, primed for Ryzen™ 9000, 8000, and 7000 series CPUs. The AM5 socket ensures compatibility with AMD's latest innovations, including PCIe Gen5 support and DDR5 memory, pushing the boundaries of what your next-gen system can achieve. Whether you're overclocking your CPU or chasing frame-perfect gameplay, the 6+1+1 power phase design with Dr.MOS ensures rock-solid voltage delivery and thermal stability under load.

Designed to maximise memory performance, the B850M-X supports up to 128GB of DDR5 memory at a blistering 8200+ MHz (OC). Whether you're chasing faster compile times or lower latency in esports titles, Intel® XMP and AMD EXPO profiles make fine-tuning memory effortless.

Speed is nothing without storage, and here the B850M-X shines. One Gen5x4 Blazing M.2 slot (128 Gb/s) and one Gen4x4 Hyper M.2 slot (64 Gb/s) deliver lightning-fast storage options. Coupled with RAID support across both SATA and NVMe devices, your data workflow stays sharp, responsive, and resilient.

Expandability is fluid and forward-looking. A PCIe 4.0 x16 slot handles high-end GPUs with ease, while two additional PCIe 4.0 slots give headroom for capture cards, high-speed NVMe adapters, or networking upgrades. Integrated Wi-Fi 6E and 2.5G LAN ensure latency-free online gaming and ultra-responsive connectivity—whether you're leading a team in a competitive lobby or downloading an entire game library overnight.

Onboard graphics support through HDMI 2.1 and DisplayPort 1.4 opens the door for high-refresh 4K displays at up to 120Hz, perfect for creators and multitaskers leveraging integrated RDNA™ graphics. For audio purists, the Realtek ALC897 codec with Nahimic enhancements transforms your headphones or speakers into immersive surround environments—ideal for deep-focus editing, cinematic bingeing, or competitive FPS action.

The motherboard’s Polychrome RGB ecosystem offers personalisation without compromise. Sync addressable lighting across cases, fans, and peripherals, or integrate with SignalRGB to trigger in-game reactive effects and system-wide visual feedback.

Thermal management is intuitive and hands-on. With dedicated headers for CPU fans, AIO pumps, and water cooling systems, plus a full UI-driven fan tuning interface, maintaining optimal thermals is effortless and visually guided.

Feature-rich, compact, and future-ready, the ASRock B850M-X WiFi is proof that performance doesn't need a full tower to make a bold statement.

product.name: ASRock Radeon RX9070 XT Steel Legend Dark 16GB Graphics Card
product.description:
Built to command the battlefield and elevate your rig’s visual edge, the ASRock Radeon™ RX 9070 XT Steel Legend Dark 16GB Graphics Card fuses elite AMD RDNA™ 4 architecture with high-end cooling innovation and aesthetic mastery. Designed for gamers and content creators craving top-tier performance, this GPU delivers ultra-immersive gameplay, next-gen raytracing, and advanced thermal engineering—all with Steel Legend durability and visual flair.

At its core, the RX 9070 XT houses 4096 stream processors, 64 compute units, and 16GB of ultra-fast GDDR6 VRAM across a 256-bit interface, achieving a boost clock of up to 2970MHz. Whether you're pushing ultra settings in 4K or diving into competitive eSports titles, the performance ceiling is sky-high. AMD FidelityFX™ Super Resolution 4, HYPR-RX, and Smart Access Memory™ support work in tandem to sharpen visuals, lower latency, and boost FPS in thousands of titles with one-click ease.

The triple-fan cooling system incorporates Striped Ring Fans, ultra-fit heatpipes, premium copper baseplate, and Honeywell PTM7950 phase-change thermal pads, all carefully engineered to maximize heat dissipation and prolong GPU life. Smart fan control ensures silent operation during light workloads and rapid cooling when you're at full throttle. Enhanced V-shaped fins and airflow vents direct air more efficiently, while the metal backplate with ARGB lighting offers both structural integrity and customizable style, synchronizable with ASRock Polychrome SYNC.

With PCIe 5.0 x16 bandwidth support, blazing data throughput is guaranteed. Connect up to four high-resolution displays via 1x HDMI 2.1b and 3x DisplayPort 2.1a outputs, all supporting up to 8K resolution and variable refresh rate for ultra-fluid visuals. The RGB header allows you to extend lighting effects to other ARGB-compatible devices, creating a unified, personalised aesthetic. Ready for the future of gaming and creation, this GPU is your gateway to jaw-dropping fidelity, relentless speed, and a system that's as stunning as it is powerful.

  • Powered by AMD RDNA™ 4 architecture with DirectX® 12 Ultimate support
  • Game Clock at 2400MHz, Boost Clock up to 2970MHz
  • 4096 Stream Processors and 64 Compute Units with 3rd Gen Ray Accelerators
  • 16GB GDDR6 memory with 256-bit interface at 20Gbps

product.name: Cudy SM220 SFP-T 10/100/1000Mbps RJ45 Ethernet Module
product.description:
The Cudy SM220 SFP-T 10/100/1000Mbps RJ45 Ethernet Module delivers dependable and high-speed wired network connections for enterprise, SMB, and advanced home networking environments. Fully compliant with the SFP Multi-Source Agreement (MSA), this copper transceiver supports Gigabit Ethernet and 10/100/1000BASE-T standards as defined in IEEE 802.3, ensuring seamless compatibility with a wide range of switches, routers, and network interface cards. Whether upgrading infrastructure or expanding connectivity, the SM220 offers a cost-effective and flexible networking solution.

Engineered for efficiency, the hot-pluggable SFP footprint allows quick installation or replacement without service interruptions. Consuming just 1.05W typical power, the SM220 helps reduce energy costs while maintaining optimal performance. Its compact RJ45 connector assembly and fully metal enclosure not only enhance durability but also reduce electromagnetic interference (EMI) for stable and interference-free connections.

The SM220 supports bi-directional data rates up to 1.25Gbps over Cat 5 or better cabling, with 10/100/1000BASE-T operation in host systems equipped with a 1000BASE-X interface. Using the SFP's RX_LOS pin for link indication, it provides reliable connectivity feedback to network administrators. The robust electrical design ensures minimal latency and consistent throughput, making it ideal for bandwidth-intensive tasks like VoIP, video conferencing, and large-scale file transfers.

With an operating temperature range of 0°C to +70°C, the Cudy SM220 is suited for diverse networking environments, from climate-controlled server rooms to active office floors. Its RoHS-compliant, lead-free construction ensures eco-friendly operation, while the single +3.3V power supply simplifies integration into existing setups. Perfect for upgrading to gigabit speeds or enhancing network flexibility, this module offers a dependable and scalable solution for modern networking needs.

product.name: Cudy SM100GSA-20 Single Mode 1.25Gb/s SFP Module
product.description:
The Cudy SM100GSA-20 Single Mode 1.25Gb/s SFP Module delivers reliable, high-speed networking for enterprise, data centre, and telecom environments. Designed with an LC connector and operating at a 1310nm FP laser wavelength, this SFP transceiver ensures stable performance for up to 20km transmission over single-mode fiber (SMF). Fully compliant with the SFP Multi-Source Agreement (MSA), it offers seamless integration with a wide range of networking equipment, making it ideal for high-bandwidth applications such as backbone links, long-distance data transmission, and secure point-to-point connections.

Engineered for precision and durability, the SM100GSA-20 features a PIN photodetector for excellent receive sensitivity and a low jitter optical signal that complies with IEEE 802.3z and ANSI Fibre Channel standards. Its LVPECL-compatible data I/O interface and +3.3V single power supply ensure efficient operation, while low EMI and robust ESD protection provide long-term reliability in demanding environments. The module meets laser safety standard IEC-60825, ensuring safe operation in fiber optic networks.

Equipped with Digital Diagnostic Monitoring (DDM) compliant to SFF-8472, the SM100GSA-20 allows administrators to track real-time parameters such as temperature, voltage, and optical power, improving network maintenance and troubleshooting. Its signal ground isolation to case helps reduce interference, ensuring consistent and uninterrupted data transmission. RoHS compliance makes it an environmentally responsible choice without compromising on performance.

With an operating temperature range of 0°C to +60°C, the Cudy SM100GSA-20 is built for versatility, suitable for both controlled data centre environments and remote networking sites. Its compact hot-pluggable design enables quick installation and replacement without service downtime, ensuring maximum network uptime. Whether upgrading existing infrastructure or expanding network reach, this SFP module offers the stability, efficiency, and range needed for modern high-performance fiber networks.

  • Up to 20km transmission on SMF

The SHADOW 2X OC features TORX Fan 5.0 technology, a refined dual-fan cooling solution where fan blades are linked by ring arcs and tilted at 22° to boost airflow by 23% over standard axial fans. Beneath the shroud, heat is drawn away rapidly by high-efficiency heat pipes, which work in tandem with a robust heatsink and reinforced backplate with ventilation, allowing warm air to escape directly through the card. product.name: MSI H610M-S PRO LGA1700 M-ATX DDR4 Motherboard
product.description:
Built for stability, efficiency, and seamless professional productivity, the MSI H610M-S PRO LGA1700 Motherboard is the foundation of your next high-performance desktop build. Designed to support Intel® 14th, 13th, and 12th Gen Core™, Pentium® Gold, and Celeron® processors, this micro-ATX motherboard balances powerful features with everyday reliability, making it the ideal choice for system builders, office environments, and content creators alike.

Equipped with DDR4 dual-channel memory support up to 3200MHz, the H610M-S PRO ensures smooth multitasking and application performance. MSI’s Memory Boost and Core Boost technologies deliver enhanced signal integrity and optimized power delivery, giving your system the extra edge in stability and speed. The PCIe 4.0 x16 slot allows users to harness the latest GPU performance, while the M.2 Gen3 x4 slot and two SATA 6Gbps ports support ultra-fast storage solutions—ideal for reducing load times and boosting data transfer.

MSI’s hallmark design features make DIY installation straightforward and frustration-free. The inclusion of Steel Armor reinforcement on the PCIe x16 slot offers extra durability for graphics cards, while EZ Debug LEDs help simplify diagnostics by identifying potential hardware issues during boot. Fan management is made easy with Total Fan Control, allowing you to configure up to four temperature targets to optimize cooling and acoustics.

Whether you're running a compact office workstation or a custom home build, the H610M-S PRO offers flexible I/O including four USB 2.0 ports, two USB 5Gbps Type-A ports on both the front and rear, HDMI™ 1.4 output for 4K@30Hz video, and Realtek® RTL8111H Gigabit LAN for reliable network performance. The Audio Boost system with 7.1-channel HD audio delivers immersive sound, ideal for both work and entertainment.

With its robust 8-channel audio, high-speed connectivity, and support for the latest Intel CPUs, the MSI H610M-S PRO is built to power through demanding tasks, extend component longevity, and ensure seamless daily productivity.

product.name: WINX MOVE Cool High-Speed Handheld Fan
product.description:
Whether you're heading outdoors, working out, or commuting under the blazing sun, the sleek and compact WINX MOVE Cool High-Speed Handheld Fan is designed to keep you refreshed and comfortable no matter where life takes you. Styled in a bold purple and grey ABS finish, it combines modern aesthetics with serious performance. What truly sets it apart is its use of advanced thermoelectric cooling (TEC) technology - cooling the air before it even reaches your skin.

Unlike regular fans that simply blow warm air around, the MOVE Cool High-Speed Handheld Fan delivers genuinely chilled airflow using a high-speed motor that reaches up to 11000 RPM and a thermoelectric cooling plate that actively reduces the air temperature. You’ll feel the difference instantly. And for those moments when you need rapid relief, you can press the TEC cold plate directly to your forehead or neck for an immediate icy-cool sensation. It’s a feature you’ll love on sweltering days, after a workout, or while on the go.

With airflow speeds of up to 7 metres per second and 100 adjustable fan levels, you have full control over your comfort. Whether you want a light breeze or full-force cooling, it adjusts to your needs with precision. Noise levels stay comfortably between 65 and 85 decibels, making the MOVE Cool High-Speed Handheld Fan perfect for personal use in quieter environments too.

Designed for freedom and mobility, the fan features a 120° foldable hinge and a built-in lanyard, making it easy to wear around your neck or prop up hands-free while you're working, hiking, or relaxing. The combination of a wearable form factor and powerful cooling performance makes it perfect for everything from outdoor festivals to daily commutes.

The built-in 4000mAh rechargeable battery gives you up to 11 hours of cooling on a single charge, depending on your speed setting - plenty of power to keep you cool through long summer days. With USB-C charging, it’s easy to top up wherever you are.

The WINX MOVE Cool High-Speed Handheld Fan is more than just a fan - it’s a lifestyle upgrade. With real chilled airflow, direct-contact cooling, long-lasting battery life, and a go-anywhere design, it redefines what portable cooling can be. Once you’ve felt the difference, you’ll wonder how you ever got through summer without it.

product.description:
Experience superior home connectivity with lightning-fast Wi-Fi 6 and stable fibre optic performance, ensuring seamless streaming, gaming, and multitasking.

Quick Specs

  • Achieve blazing-fast internet speeds with the integrated Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax) technology.
  • Connect multiple devices simultaneously with stable, high-speed fibre optic (EPON/GPON) compatibility.
  • Stream, game, and download without interruption thanks to a robust 20KM transmission distance.
  • Enhance network security with advanced firewall protection and WPA3 encryption.
  • Expand your home network's capabilities by sharing storage and printers via the USB 3.0 port.

Unleash unparalleled speed and stability for your South African home network

The VSOL V2804AX30-A is engineered for the modern digital household, offering a powerful combination of next-generation Wi-Fi 6 and reliable fibre optic connectivity. It addresses the growing demand for high bandwidth and low latency, ensuring that every device in your home performs optimally. Whether you are a discerning gamer demanding instantaneous response times, a professional relying on stable video conferencing, or a family enjoying simultaneous HD streaming, this Home Gateway Unit (HGU) is designed to meet and exceed your expectations. This GPON router provides the foundation for a truly connected and efficient home environment, cutting through the congestion of older networks.

Experience the future of wireless and wired performance

At its core, this router is built for speed and reliability. The inclusion of Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax) delivers significantly faster speeds, improved efficiency, and better performance in crowded environments compared to previous Wi-Fi standards. This means less lag, quicker downloads, and a smoother experience for all your connected devices, from smartphones and laptops to smart TVs and gaming consoles. Paired with four Gigabit Ethernet ports, it provides a stable, high-speed wired connection for devices that require the utmost performance, ensuring that your Gigabit Ethernet router connection is never the bottleneck.

Built for resilience and ease of use

The VSOL V2804AX30-A is constructed to perform reliably in demanding conditions, with an operating temperature range of -10°C to +55°C. This resilience ensures consistent performance whether it's placed in a warm living room or a cooler, more challenging environment. Furthermore, the integrated USB 3.0 port offers a versatile extension of your network capabilities, allowing for easy sharing of storage devices or printers across all connected devices. This feature adds significant value and convenience for home and small office users alike, transforming the router into a central hub for more than just internet access.

Secure, seamless, and comprehensive connectivity

Security and ease of management are paramount. This HGU ONT supports advanced Wi-Fi encryption standards, including WPA3, to protect your network from unauthorised access. Its robust firewall capabilities, featuring anti-DDoS protection and filtering based on ACL/MAC/URL, further safeguard your online activities. With support for both IPv4 and IPv6, this high speed fibre router is future-proofed, ready to adapt to the evolving internet landscape. The intuitive interface and clear indicator lights make setup and monitoring straightforward, even for users who may not be network experts, solidifying its position as a superior solution for home networking in South Africa.

product.description:
Experience seamless connectivity with blazing fast speeds for your South African home or office | Powering multiple devices simultaneously with robust stability.

Quick Specs

  • Connect multiple devices simultaneously with four Gigabit Ethernet ports.
  • Enjoy fast and stable wireless connections with Wi-Fi 5 technology.
  • Stream, game, and work without interruption thanks to reliable high-speed internet.
  • Benefit from a robust and efficient network solution designed for modern demands.
  • Simplify your setup with an all-in-one Home Gateway Unit.

Unleash your digital potential with the V-Sol HGU ONT

Designed for the discerning user in South Africa, this V-Sol 1xPON+4xGE+Wi-Fi 5 HGU ONT is more than just a network device; it is the foundation of your digital life. It caters to the demands of the modern home or small office where speed, stability, and the capacity to connect multiple devices are paramount. Whether you are a professional requiring uninterrupted video conferencing, a gamer demanding low latency, or a family juggling streaming services and online learning, this V-Sol router ensures your connection meets your needs. It is built for those who understand that a reliable network is not a luxury, but a necessity for productivity and entertainment.

Experience unparalleled speed and stability with this PON router

At its core, this V-Sol router boasts cutting-edge Wi-Fi 5 (802.11ac) technology, delivering dual-band wireless speeds of up to 1.167Gbps. This means smoother streaming, faster downloads, and a lag-free online experience, even when multiple devices are connected. The 2x2 MIMO configuration and multiple SSID support further enhance wireless performance, allowing for dedicated networks for guests or specific devices. Coupled with its PON (Passive Optical Network) interface, it provides a high-bandwidth, low-latency connection directly to your internet service provider, ensuring you receive the full speed of your plan without compromise. This PON router is engineered for peak performance.

Versatile connectivity for every need

The V-Sol HGU ONT is equipped with four Gigabit Ethernet (GE) ports, offering robust wired connectivity for devices that demand maximum speed and stability, such as desktop computers, gaming consoles, and network-attached storage (NAS). This versatility ensures that all your essential devices can be connected efficiently. Furthermore, the inclusion of a USB 3.0 port provides enhanced functionality, allowing for shared storage or media streaming directly through the device, expanding its utility beyond a simple router. For environments requiring it, an optional CATV interface is also available, integrating your entertainment services.

Engineered for performance and longevity

Durability and consistent performance are cornerstones of V-Sol’s design philosophy. This HGU ONT is built to withstand demanding operating conditions, with an operating temperature range of -10°C to +55°C and a non-condensing humidity range of 5% to 95%. These specifications ensure reliable operation whether installed in a climate-controlled office or a less regulated home environment. The efficient power management, consuming no more than 18W, further highlights its commitment to performance without unnecessary energy waste. The device is powered by a standard DC12V, 1.5A external AC-DC power adaptor, ensuring consistent and stable power delivery for your V-Sol router.

Your gateway to a connected future

In today's interconnected world, a high-performance network device is essential. The V-Sol 1xPON+4xGE+Wi-Fi 5 HGU ONT stands ready to meet and exceed those expectations. It is the ideal solution for South African users who demand reliability, speed, and the flexibility to adapt to their evolving connectivity needs. Invest in a network that empowers your productivity, enhances your entertainment, and keeps you seamlessly connected to what matters most with this superior V-Sol router.

FEATURES:

  • Achieve exceptional internet speeds with the 1.167Gbps dual-band Wi-Fi 5 wireless interface for your V-Sol router.
  • Support multiple high-demand devices simultaneously with four 1 Gigabit Ethernet ports for robust wired connections.
  • Enhance your network capabilities with a versatile USB 3.0 port for shared storage or media.
  • Benefit from a stable and reliable connection for streaming, gaming, and productivity, powered by PON technology
  • Ensure uninterrupted operation in various environments with a wide operating temperature range of -10°C to +55°C.
  • Optional CATV interface integration allows for unified service delivery in supported setups.

SPECIFICATIONS:

  • PON interface:
    • 1XPON port (EPON PX20+ & GPON Class B+)
    • SC single mode, SC/APC connector
    • TX optical power: 0～+4dBm
    • RX sensitivity: -27dBm
    • Overload optical power: -3dBm (EPON) or -8dBm (GPON)
    • Transmission distance: 20KM
    • Wavelength: TX 1310nm, RX1490nm
  • User interface:
    • 4*GE, Auto-negotiation, RJ45 ports
    • 1*USB 3.0
  • WLAN interface:
    • Compliant with IEEE802.11b/g/n/ac
    • Wi-Fi:2.4GHz 、5.8GHz 2×2, 3dBi antenna, rate up to 1.167Gbps,Multiple SSID
    • TX power: 2.4GHz: 18dBm; 5GHz: 17dBm
    • RX power: 2.4GHz: HT40-MCS7 -71dBm; 5GHz: VHT80 MCS9 <-63dBm
  • CATV interface
    • Optical receiving wavelength: 1550±10nm
    • Optical input range: +2～-18dBm
    • Optical reflection loss: ≥40dB
    • RF frequency range: 47～1000MHz
    • RF output impedance: 75Ω
    • RF output level and AGC range:
    • ≥81±2dBuv@+1～-10dBm
    • ≥79±2dBuv@ 0～-11dBm
    • ≥77±2dBuv@-1～-12dBm
    • ≥75±2dBuv@-2～-13dBm
    • ≥73±2dBuv@-3～-14dBm
    • ≥71±2dBuv@-4～-15dBm
    • MER: ≥32dB (-14dBm optical input)
  • O&M:
    • OAM/OMCI, Telnet, WEB, TR069
    • Support full management of HGU functions by VSOL OLT
  • Multicast:
    • IGMP v1/v2/v3, IGMP snooping
    • IGMP Proxy
    • MLD v1/v2 snooping
    • MLD Proxy
  • Wireless:
    • Integrated 802.11b/g/n/ac
    • Authentication: WAP-PSK(TKIP)/ WAP2-PSK(AES)
    • Support Multiple SSID
    • Support hidden SSID
    • Support Mesh
    • Supports up to 64 maximum device connections
  • QoS:
    • Support 4 queues
    • Support SP, WRR, 802.1P and DSCP
  • L2:
    • Support 802.1D&802.1ad bridge,802.1Q VLAN
  • L3/L4:
    • IPv4, IPv6 and IPv4/IPv6 dual stack
    • DHCP/PPPOE/Static
    • Static route, DHCP Server
    • NAT/DMZ/DDNS/Virtual Server
  • Security:
    • Support Firewall
    • Support Mac filter Based on MAC or URL
    • Support ACL
    • Support Loop detection
  • System Function:
    • Support NTP (Network Time Protocol)
    • Support Scheduled device restart
    • Support Ping and Traceroute diagnosis
  • Operating condition:
    • Operating temp: -10 ~ +55°C
    • Operating humidity: 5 ~ 95% (non-condensing)
  • Storing condition:
    • Storing temp: -40 ~ +70°C
    • Storing humidity: 5 ~ 95% (non-condensing)
  • Power adapter: DC12V,1.5A, external AC-DC power adaptor
  • Power supply: ≤18W
  • Interface: 4GE + Wi-Fi 5 + USB 3.0 + CATV (optional)
  • Indicators: PWR, LOS, PON, 2.4G, 5G, WAN, WPS, USB, CATV (optional), LAN1～4
  • Product Dimensions: 18 x 12 x 3.2 cm
  • Product Weight: 280g

WHAT'S IN THE BOX:

  • V-Sol 1XPON+4GE+USB 3.0+Wi-Fi 5 HGU ONT - White x1

Why V-Sol?

V-Sol stands as a pillar of reliable networking solutions for South Africa. Committed to delivering robust performance and seamless connectivity, V-Sol products, including this high-speed internet router, are engineered to meet the demands of today's digital landscape. Choose V-Sol for a network that keeps you connected, productive, and entertained.

product.description:
Experience seamless connectivity with 1167Mbps dual-band Wi-Fi 5, robust 4xGE ports, and crystal-clear POTS voice, all powered by V-Sol's reliable fibre technology.

Quick Specs

  • Achieve lightning-fast internet speeds of up to 1.167Gbps with dual-band Wi-Fi 5.
  • Connect multiple devices simultaneously with four Gigabit Ethernet ports.
  • Enjoy clear, reliable voice calls with the integrated POTS connection.
  • Benefit from V-Sol's trusted technology, designed for robust and stable network performance.
  • Utilise the convenient USB 3.0 port for enhanced functionality and data access.

Unleash the full potential of your fibre connection with the V-Sol HG325AC-A HGU ONT router

Designed for the discerning South African household or business, this V-Sol gigabit ethernet router is the central nervous system of your digital life. It seamlessly bridges your fibre optic network to your home or office, ensuring that every connected device receives the stable, high-speed internet it demands. For families, this means smooth streaming of high-definition content, lag-free online gaming, and effortless video conferencing for remote work or education. For businesses, it translates to reliable operations, efficient data transfer, and uninterrupted communication, making it an indispensable tool for modern connectivity. The V-Sol HG325AC-A is not just a router; it is the foundation of a connected future.

Engineered for superior speed and stability

At its core, the V-Sol HG325AC-A is built upon advanced PON technology, capable of delivering data over an impressive 20km transmission distance. Its dual-band Wi-Fi 5 capability ensures that you can harness speeds of up to 1.167Gbps across both 2.4GHz and 5.8GHz bands, effectively reducing congestion and maximising performance for all your wireless devices. This high speed home router is engineered to handle the demands of high-bandwidth activities, ensuring a consistent and dependable connection for everyone, everywhere in your home or office.

Seamless integration for all your devices

The V-Sol HG325AC-A goes beyond basic routing. It features four Gigabit Ethernet ports, providing wired connections with exceptional speed and stability for your most critical devices, such as desktop computers, gaming consoles, or network-attached storage. Complementing this is a POTS (Plain Old Telephone Service) port, allowing you to retain your existing landline service over the fibre network, ensuring you don't miss important calls. The optional CATV port further enhances its versatility, consolidating multiple services into one powerful device, simplifying your setup and reducing clutter. It is the all-in-one solution designed for comprehensive connectivity.

Reliability you can count on

Constructed with robust components and adhering to strict operating parameters, the V-Sol HG325AC-A is built to last. It operates reliably within a wide temperature range of -10°C to +55°C and humidity levels of 5% to 95% (non-condensing), ensuring consistent performance even in challenging South African conditions. This fibre router is designed for efficiency, with a total power consumption of ≤12W, making it an energy-conscious choice for your network infrastructure. Trust in V-Sol for a stable and enduring connection.

Future-ready features for enhanced functionality

The inclusion of a USB 3.0 port elevates the functionality of this HGU ONT beyond simple internet access. This port can be used for network-attached storage (NAS) capabilities, media sharing, or device backups, providing added convenience and versatility for your home or office network. With support for multiple SSIDs, you can create separate networks for guests or specific device types, enhancing security and network management. The V-Sol HG325AC-A is not just about current needs; it is a forward-thinking solution designed to grow with your digital requirements.

  • Maintain your landline service with the included POTS port, ensuring reliable voice communication.

product.name: Geil Gemini RGB 64GB KIT(2X32GB) 6000MHz DDR5 Desktop Gaming Memory - White
product.description:
Prepare your system for the future of gaming and AI computing with the GeiL GEMINI RGB AMD Edition 64GB DDR5 6000MHz Desktop Gaming Memory. Designed specifically for AMD-based platforms, this next-generation DDR5 memory module delivers ultra-fast speeds of 6000MT/s, low latency (CL30 minimum), and seamless multitasking power—perfect for gaming, content creation, and AI-driven workloads. Whether you're building a next-gen gaming PC or a high-efficiency workstation, the GEMINI RGB AMD Edition ensures your system runs at peak speed and stability.

Engineered with an onboard PMIC (Power Management Integrated Circuit), the GEMINI RGB DDR5 provides precise voltage regulation for consistent, energy-efficient operation. On-Die ECC (Error Correction Code) technology enhances data integrity, reducing errors and maintaining system stability even under intense loads. With support for AMD EXPO™ and Intel® XMP 3.0 profiles, overclocking is as simple as a single click, unlocking optimised memory performance effortlessly across compatible motherboards.

With its mecha-style heat spreader in sleek Glacier White, the GEMINI RGB AMD Edition brings a bold sci-fi aesthetic to your rig. More than just a pretty face, the futuristic heatsink also provides effective thermal dissipation, ensuring your system remains cool and reliable during marathon gaming sessions. A striking 120° wide-angle RGB light bar crowns each module, delivering dynamic lighting that supports full RGB customisation. It’s fully compatible with Asus Aura Sync, MSI Mystic Light, Gigabyte RGB Fusion 2.0, ASRock Polychrome Sync, and Biostar Advanced Vivid LED DJ, giving you full control over your system’s ambience.

As generative AI and high-speed data processing become core to modern computing, the GEMINI RGB AMD Edition is equipped to meet tomorrow’s demands with high bandwidth, low latency, and high-capacity options. Backed by support from top motherboard manufacturers, this DDR5 memory module ensures broad compatibility and stable performance across a variety of platforms. Whether you’re crafting immersive game worlds or running AI-driven applications, the GeiL GEMINI RGB DDR5 gives you the performance edge you need.

FEATURES:

  • Up to 6000MHz high-speed DDR5 performance
  • Dual channel 64Gb kit (2x32Gb)
  • PMIC on the DIMM for efficient power management
  • On-die ECC for improved data integrity and system stability
  • 120° wide-angle lighting effects
  • Futuristic Mecha-style heat sink with a sci-fi pattern

SPECIFICATIONS:

  • Form Factor: Long DIMM
  • DDR Generation: DDR5
  • Frequency: 6000MT/s
  • CAS Latency: 42-48-86-96
  • Capacity: 64GB (32GB x 2)
  • Voltage: 1.35V
  • Colour: Glacier White
  • Additional Technology: Intel® XMP 3.0 (O.C)/ AMD EXPO™ (O.C)
  • Working Temperature: 0°C - 70°C
  • Product Dimensions: 13.9 x 4.5 x 0.7 cm

WHAT'S IN THE  BOX:

  • GeiL GEMINI RGB AMD Edition 32GB DDR5 6000MHz Desktop Gaming Memory - White x2
