product.name: ASUS Prime Radeon RX 9060 XT OC 16GB GDDR6 Graphics Card
product.description:
Unlock cutting-edge performance with the ASUS Prime Radeon™ RX 9060 XT OC 16GB GDDR6 Graphics Card, meticulously engineered for gamers and creators demanding power, stability, and flexibility. Powered by the advanced RDNA™ 4 architecture and boasting 2048 stream processors, this GPU delivers ultra-fast WQHD gaming, accelerated creative workloads, and exceptional multi-tasking capabilities. With 16GB of high-speed GDDR6 VRAM on a PCIe 5.0 interface, you get the bandwidth and memory headroom necessary for the next generation of games and high-resolution content production.

Designed to deliver supreme thermal performance in a compact 2.5-slot form factor, the RX 9060 XT is equipped with three Axial-tech fans, optimized by a carefully engineered shroud and heatsink layout. This setup leverages side-panel ventilation to keep the card cool even under demanding loads. The 0dB fan technology ensures silent operation during light tasks by stopping all fans below 55°C and resuming intelligently at higher temperatures. MaxContact heat spreader technology and an expansive heatsink improve thermal transfer, while a vented backplate further boosts heat dissipation for sustained performance.

Built to last, this GPU features dual-ball bearing fans for extended reliability and an ultra-durable stainless steel mounting bracket for increased structural rigidity. ASUS’s renowned Auto-Extreme manufacturing process reduces thermal stress, improves build precision, and minimizes environmental impact—all contributing to a robust and dependable product. The reinforced PCB, protected by GPU Guard and a rigid backplate, ensures durability and safeguards against flex or trace damage during installation and prolonged use.

The RX 9060 XT also offers smart flexibility with a dual BIOS switch, letting you toggle between high-performance and quiet operating modes instantly to match your preference. With native HDMI 2.1b and dual DisplayPort 2.1a outputs, support for up to three displays, and a max digital resolution of 7680 x 4320, this GPU is ready for ultra-high-definition workflows. Whether you’re building a sleek gaming rig or a professional editing station, the ASUS Prime RX 9060 XT OC blends raw power with refined cooling and build quality, all backed by the intuitive ASUS GPU Tweak III software for easy customisation and monitoring.

FEATURES

  • UP to 2760MHz in Default Mode and up to 3330MHz in OC Mode (GPU Tweak III)
  • RDNA™ 4 architecture with 2048 stream processors for ultra-fast WQHD gaming and creative workloads
  • 16GB GDDR6 VRAM and PCIe 5.0 bandwidth for high-speed data throughput and next-gen performance
  • Triple Axial-Tech fan design with 0dB tech for efficient, near-silent cooling under light loads
  • Stainless steel mounting bracket (Grade 304) and reinforced backplate for structural rigidity and enhanced cooling performance
  • Dual BIOS switch lets you toggle between performance mode and quiet mode on the fly
  • ASUS Auto-Extreme manufacturing for ultra-precise, durable, and environmentally efficient PCB assembly
  • Compact 2.5-slot form factor ensures broad chassis compatibility without sacrificing thermal headroom

SPECIFICATIONS

  • Graphic Engine: AMD Radeon™ RX 9060 XT
  • Bus Standard: PCI Express 5.0
  • OpenGL: OpenGL®4.6
  • Video Memory: 16GB GDDR6
  • Engine Clock:
    • OC mode(GPU Tweak III): up to 3330 MHz (Boost Clock)
    • Default mode: up to 2760 MHz (Game Clock)
  • Stream Processors: 2048
  • Memory Speed: 20Gbps
  • Memory Interface: 128-bit
  • Resolution: Digital Max Resolution 7680 x 4320
  • Interface:

product.name: ASUS PRIME GeForce RTX 5060 OC 8GB GDDR7 GPU – SFF-Ready Graphics Card
product.description:
If you’re after serious performance without maxing out your chassis space, the ASUS RTX 5060 OC 8GB Graphics Card is exactly the kind of smart, future-ready upgrade your build needs. Powered by NVIDIA’s Blackwell architecture and wrapped in ASUS’s high-efficiency design language, this SFF-Ready card hits the sweet spot for gamers, creators, and AI power users alike.

Let’s talk performance. You’re getting 630 AI TOPS of processing power, 5th Gen Tensor Cores with FP4 support, and full-fat DLSS 4—including Multi Frame Generation and Ray Reconstruction. The result? Sharper visuals, better frame rates, and performance that scales beautifully whether you're gaming at 1440p or pushing neural rendering in creative workflows.

Ray tracing gets a serious boost here, too. The 4th Gen RT Cores handle complex geometry without breaking a sweat, while NVIDIA Reflex 2 with Frame Warp keeps latency ultra-low, ideal for competitive shooters and fast-paced titles. Pair that with G-SYNC compatibility and VR readiness, and you’ve got a card that doesn’t just keep up, it leads.

Cooling? Dialled in. ASUS’s triple Axial-Tech fans push more air with less noise, backed by a vented backplate and a MaxContact heat spreader that shaves off critical degrees during heavy loads. The 0dB mode keeps things silent when idle, while dual ball bearings offer double the lifespan of standard fans. This isn’t just cooling—it's thermal engineering done right.

Durability and structure are equally refined. ASUS GPU Guard reinforces the PCB, the stainless steel I/O bracket resists corrosion, and a protective backplate shields your components. It’s tough, reliable, and made for the long haul.

Whether you're editing high-res footage, diving into the latest RTX-enabled games, or building a compact powerhouse, the ASUS RTX 5060 OC 8GB Graphics Card gives you the performance edge, without the size penalty.

product.name: Antec ORBIT PWM 120mm ARGB Fan 3 Pack - Black
product.description:
Transform your PC build into a futuristic masterpiece with the Antec Orbit 120mm ARGB Fan 3 Pack, designed to deliver stunning aesthetics and powerful cooling performance. Featuring an infinity mirror light effect at the centre of each fan and a dual-ring ARGB lighting system, the Orbit fans create a mesmerising wormhole-like visual that elevates your gaming setup. The curved surface front and rear covers, along with the carbon fibre-inspired diagonal pattern, offer a modern, cohesive look that complements any high-end rig.

Equipped with intelligent chip-based PWM fan control, the Antec Orbit fans dynamically adjust speed based on system demands, ramping up airflow during heavy workloads and achieving near-total silence during low-load or idle states. When the PWM duty cycle falls below 6%, the fans automatically stop, allowing for ultra-silent standby operation. This smart fan management ensures optimal performance without compromising on acoustics, making it ideal for noise-sensitive environments.

With a thicker 28mm frame, the Orbit fans increase the air inlet area and improve contact with the chassis, delivering superior cooling performance. The 9-blade design enhances static pressure and airflow efficiency, ensuring your components stay cooler even under demanding conditions. Built with fluid dynamic bearings (FDB), these fans offer extended lifespan, smoother operation, and reduced vibration—ideal for long-term reliability in high-performance builds.

To further enhance quiet operation, each fan is fitted with eight rubber anti-vibration pads that absorb operational vibrations and reduce noise output to as low as 18 dB(A). With a lifespan rated at 50,000 hours at 40°C, the Orbit fans are built to last. The package includes standard 4-pin fan connectors and 3-pin ARGB LED connectors, ensuring compatibility with most modern motherboards and lighting control software. Whether you're upgrading your cooling or completing a themed build, the Antec Orbit fans offer a perfect blend of style, silence, and performance.

  • Exquisite carbon fiber style design

product.name: Antec Dagger ARGB GPU Support Bracket - Black
product.description:
The Antec Dagger ARGB GPU Support Bracket is expertly engineered to deliver the structural support needed for today’s heavy, high-performance graphics cards. Featuring a unique five-hole steel-inspired design, this bracket mimics architectural reinforcements to lock horizontally mounted GPUs in place, preventing sagging and long-term damage to PCIe slots. Its minimalist yet robust structure enhances GPU durability, especially in rigs featuring larger RTX 40/30 and AMD RX 7000/6000 series cards.

Elevate your build's aesthetics with vivid ARGB lighting synchronisation, fully compatible with 3-pin 5V motherboard headers or dedicated controllers. The daisy-chained 3-pin ARGB extension port allows easy integration into a unified lighting system, ensuring your setup shines with consistent brilliance. Whether you're building a showpiece gaming rig or an eye-catching workstation, the Dagger bracket adds a refined lighting accent while delivering essential function.

Designed for ultimate adaptability, the adjustable support column can be set between 40mm to 65mm in height, while the slide-type arm spans 170mm to 270mm, making it suitable for a wide range of GPU sizes and case configurations. The bracket’s compatibility with popular NVIDIA and AMD models ensures easy installation across most ATX and mid-tower systems. Its tool-free, modular design makes mounting intuitive and efficient, even for first-time builders.

Crafted using a mix of durable plastic side plates and a premium all-anode aluminum process, the Antec Dagger maintains its structural integrity and surface texture even with long-term use. Its scratch-resistant finish complements modern builds with a sleek, matte black aesthetic. Lightweight yet sturdy, this GPU support bracket is not just a protective accessory — it's a smart investment in the longevity and performance of your graphics card.

FEATURES:

  • ARGB sync: Supports 3-pin 5V ARGB lighting sync through the motherboard or controller
  • Bracket: A 5-hole support arm locks into place to fit horizontally mounted heavy GPU cards
  • Sturdy construction: Prevents your GPU from bending and sagging
  • Daisy chain: Expandable 3-pin ARGB port supports an integrated lighting system
  • Adjustable support column: The support range height ranges from 40-65 mm
  • Slide-type support structure: Width support ranges from 170-270 mm
  • Durability: The combination of plastic side plates and all-anode process helps maintain the durability of the surface texture
  • Widely compatible: AMD Radeon and Nvidia graphics cards supported
  • 12 months warranty

Modern GPUs, particularly the latest RTX 40, RTX 30, and RX 7000, RX 6000 series, are substantial in both size and weight. This gpu anti sag bracket provides a sturdy, reliable support structure, preventing such damage and ensuring your investment remains secure and functional for years to come. product.name: Xiaomi Desktop Speaker (USB and Bluetooth 5.3, RGB, 4-Unit Stereo Sound, Built-in Mic)
product.description:
The Xiaomi Desktop Speaker delivers a transformative listening experience in a compact, award-winning form factor. Recognised with a Red Dot Design Award, this desktop audio solution combines premium sound engineering, intelligent digital signal processing, and refined aesthetics, making it ideal for both professional environments and personal entertainment.

Equipped with a robust 4-unit acoustic configuration, the speaker features dual full-range NIB drivers and large dual passive radiators for a balanced, full-spectrum audio performance. A runway-shaped acoustic chamber enhances clarity across treble and mids. In contrast, airtight internal chambers reduce channel interference, producing a well-defined stereo field with spatial precision, particularly advantageous during gaming or virtual conferencing.

Engineered for versatility, the Xiaomi Desktop Speaker offers five DSP-tuned EQ modes tailored for music, bass, vocals, gaming, and cinema-style content. The Game Mode delivers precise sound localisation, while Music and Movie modes create a rich, immersive soundscape. A professional-grade DSP processor dynamically adjusts audio output for optimal fidelity across any genre or application.

Positioned at a 53° angle, the speaker is designed for upward-facing sound projection – ideal for placement beneath monitors. Measuring just 43.5 × 6.7 × 6.7cm and weighing 670g, it integrates seamlessly into any workspace or entertainment setup without compromising on performance.

The integrated 16-LED RGB ambient light strip enhances visual appeal with five lighting modes – including Party Mode, which dynamically syncs lighting with the rhythm of your music via real-time DSP analysis. A multifunctional side knob offers stepless adjustment of both volume and lighting, while responsive top-mounted controls ensure intuitive operation.

Connectivity is streamlined with a single USB-A to Type-C cable for both power and data, while Bluetooth® 5.3 provides stable, low-latency wireless streaming and call functionality. An AUX IN port allows seamless connection to legacy devices, such as turntables or CD players, with uncompromised sound quality.

With a built-in microphone discreetly integrated into the body, the speaker supports clear voice communication for calls, online meetings, and in-game chat, making it a complete audio solution for the modern digital user.

Crafted with a premium mesh grille and non-slip silica gel base, the Xiaomi Desktop Speaker balances cutting-edge functionality with sophisticated design.

product.name: FSP PRO 65W Universal Laptop Adapter – Dell
product.description:
Keep your laptop fully charged with the FSP PRO 65W Universal Laptop Adapter. It features an output wattage of 65W and an output voltage of 19V. Ideal for Dell laptops, the power adapter comes with additional exchangeable tips for various laptop and notebook charging ports. This makes it more versatile than a traditional power adapter that only has one port for your laptop only. Its high-efficiency rating ensures you get constant and reliable power to your devices at all times.

For additional safety, it features 360° safety circuit protection, which means you get over-voltage protection(OVP), short circuit protection(SCP), and over-temperature protection(OTP) which helps prevent damage during use. With all these great features the FSP PRO 65W is a great choice for anyone looking to add safe, reliable power to their laptop.

This model comes with tip No.7, No.14 and No.U7 for Dell laptops only.

product.name: ASUS PRIME GeForce RTX 5080 16GB OC Edition GDDR7 Graphics Card
product.description:
Experience next-generation power and precision with the ASUS Prime GeForce RTX 5080 OC Edition Graphics Card, expertly engineered for elite gamers and creative professionals. Built on NVIDIA’s latest architecture, this premium GPU delivers outstanding AI acceleration, exceptional thermal performance, and cutting-edge display capabilities, all housed in a compact, SFF-Ready 2.5-slot design for maximum build compatibility.

Equipped with 16GB of ultra-fast GDDR7 video memory and a robust 256-bit memory interface, the ASUS Prime GeForce RTX 5080 OC Edition Graphics Card runs at memory speeds of up to 30 Gbps. With a GPU boost clock of up to 2685 MHz in OC mode and 10752 CUDA cores, it offers uncompromising speed for 4K gaming, real-time ray tracing, and high-throughput content rendering. Supporting PCIe 5.0 and OpenGL 4.6, this card ensures optimal performance across modern platforms and software environments.

AI performance is at the forefront, delivering up to 1827 TOPs, enhanced further with NVIDIA DLSS 4 and fifth-gen Tensor Cores for real-time frame generation and AI-powered graphics enhancement. The card supports a maximum digital resolution of 7680 x 4320 and accommodates up to four simultaneous displays via one native HDMI 2.1b and three DisplayPort 2.1b outputs. HDCP 2.3 support is included for protected content playback.

Thermal management is handled by triple Axial-tech fans with dual-ball bearings for extended durability, backed by a vapour chamber, vented backplate, and MaxContact technology for superior heat transfer. Silent operation is achieved with 0dB technology, while Dual BIOS allows users to select between Quiet and Performance modes based on their workload.

The ASUS Prime GeForce RTX 5080 OC Edition Graphics Card includes essential accessories such as a Velcro hook & loop, adapter cable, and Speedsetup manual. Supported by ASUS GPU Tweak III, MuseTree, and the latest Game Ready and Studio Drivers, it is an ideal choice for users who demand high-performance computing in a compact footprint.

Build small. Play big. Create without limits. Choose the ASUS Prime GeForce RTX 5080 OC Edition Graphics Card for ultimate power, reliability, and creative freedom.

FEATURES:

  • Powered by NVIDIA® GeForce RTX™ 5080 with 16GB GDDR7 for next-gen gaming and content creation
  • SFF-Ready 2.5-slot design ensures wide compatibility with compact, high-performance PC builds

product.name: Antec VCX10M RGB Micro-ATX | ITX Mini -Tower Gaming Chassis - Black
product.description:
The Antec VCX10M RGB Mini-Tower Gaming Chassis is purpose-built for gamers and PC enthusiasts seeking a compact yet performance-driven case. Designed to accommodate Micro-ATX and Mini-ITX motherboards, the VCX10M offers exceptional cooling and component compatibility in a space-saving footprint. With a sleek 270° panoramic glass panel design across the front and side, this chassis puts your build on full display while adding a touch of modern elegance to any setup.

Optimised for thermal performance, the dual-chamber layout separates heat-generating components like the CPU and GPU from the PSU and storage drives, improving airflow and maintaining system stability. The chassis features large mesh intake vents along the side and bottom, promoting strong vertical cooling to quickly dissipate heat. This smart layout not only ensures efficient airflow but also protects your components from thermal throttling and premature wear.

The VCX10M comes pre-equipped with three 120mm RGB fans—two reverse-mounted at the bottom and one at the rear—ensuring vibrant lighting and excellent airflow right out of the box. With additional support for up to five 120mm fans and a 120mm rear radiator, the case is ready for both air and AIO cooling solutions. This vertical airflow design maximises intake from below while effectively exhausting hot air, keeping your compact build cool under pressure.

Despite its smaller size, the VCX10M doesn't compromise on functionality. With support for GPUs up to 260mm in length, CPU coolers up to 165mm, and PSUs up to 190mm, it delivers versatile hardware compatibility for gaming and productivity builds. The front I/O panel includes USB 3.0, USB 2.0, LED control, and HD audio, providing convenient access to your essential peripherals. Finished with tempered glass panels, a top-mounted dust filter, and modern RGB accents, the Antec VCX10M strikes the perfect balance between compact design, cooling efficiency, and visual appeal.

FEATURES:

  • Compact design with powerful heat dissipation
  • Tempered front and side glass panel
  • Panoramic 270° view with dual chamber design
  • Vertical cooling with massive air intake
  • Pre-installed 3 x 120mm RGB fans
  • Micro ATX and Mini ITX Motherboard Support

product.name: MSI GeForce RTX 5060 Ti VENTUS 3X OC 8GB GDDR7 Graphics Card
product.description:
Unleash exceptional power and next-gen efficiency with the MSI GeForce RTX 5060 Ti VENTUS 3X OC 8GB GDDR7 Graphics Card, designed for performance-driven gamers and creators. Featuring the NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060 Ti GPU and built on a cutting-edge 5 nm process, this graphics card delivers a seamless balance between speed, power, and precision.

Equipped with 8GB of ultra-fast GDDR7 memory running at a memory speed of 28 Gbps and supported by a 128-bit memory interface, this card offers a substantial 448 GB/s memory bandwidth. It utilises 4608 CUDA cores, 144 Tensor Cores, and 36 Ray Tracing cores to drive immersive gameplay, lightning-fast content rendering, and enhanced AI-driven features.

The MSI GeForce RTX 5060 Ti VENTUS 3X OC 8GB GDDR7 Graphics Card operates via a PCIe 5.0 interface (x16 slot, x8 mode), ensuring maximum throughput for demanding workloads. It supports DirectX 12 Ultimate and OpenGL 4.6, with maximum digital resolution output of up to 7680 × 4320 (8K), allowing for advanced multi-display setups across four simultaneous outputs (3x DisplayPort 2.1b, 1x HDMI 2.1b).

With a boost clock of 2602 MHz, the GPU delivers uncompromising frame rates in AAA titles, while the efficient dual-fan VENTUS 3X thermal design ensures cool and quiet operation. The card consumes 180W of power and requires a single 8-pin PCIe power connector. Its compact build—30.6cm in length, 12.1cm in width, and 44cm in height—fits comfortably in most modern PC cases, occupying just two expansion slots.

Finished in a sleek black with a robust 793g build, the MSI GeForce RTX 5060 Ti VENTUS 3X OC 8GB GDDR7 Graphics Card is a powerhouse built for users who demand elite-level GPU technology, now and for the future.

Whether you’re upgrading a competitive gaming rig or building a workstation to handle 3D rendering and video editing, the MSI GeForce RTX 5060 Ti 8G INSPIRE 2X OC Graphics Card delivers exceptional value, performance, and efficiency in a robust, future-ready package.

The motherboard’s enhanced thermal design and optimised power delivery ensure that your system remains stable, even during extended workloads. Whether you are working on professional design software, simulations, or managing large-scale projects, the MSI PRO Z790-P WIFI provides the foundation for a high-performance, productivity-focused setup.

The Keychron Q6 Max redefines the professional mechanical keyboard experience, merging high-performance hardware, open-source programmability, and premium construction in a full-size, hot-swappable layout. Built with a CNC-machined 6063 aluminium body and enhanced by a flexible PC plate and double-gasket mount design, the Q6 Max offers superior acoustics and structural integrity while reducing vibration and sound resonance for a refined typing feel.

Equipped with pre-lubed Gateron Jupiter Banana tactile switches, the Q6 Max delivers a satisfying bump on actuation and smooth keystroke transitions, ideal for both typing accuracy and prolonged comfort. Customisation is powered by QMK/VIA firmware, enabling real-time remapping, macro creation, and RGB control via the Keychron Launcher app. Backed by an ARM Cortex-M4 32-bit processor, a robust 4000 mAh battery, and hot-swappable support for both 3-pin and 5-pin MX-style switches, the Q6 Max is fully equipped for high-performance users who demand adaptability without compromise.

Finished in a sleek Carbon Black, the keyboard includes high-durability double-shot PBT keycaps (KSA profile), ensuring long-term resistance to shine and fading. Whether you're a developer, designer, content creator or gaming enthusiast, the Q6 Max is a fully-featured solution tailored for custom workflows, competitive performance, and elevated daily use.

product.name: Asus Cobble M.2 SSD Enclosure - Grey
product.description:
The ASUS Cobble SSD enclosure combines style and performance in a sleek, cobble-stone-inspired design. Its durable aluminium-alloy top cover offers robust protection, while IP55 water and dust resistance ensures data stays safe when on the go. A USB Type-C® 3.2 Gen 2x1 connection enables superfast and reliable transfer speeds of up to 10 Gbps, while maintaining consistent data performance. An aluminium-alloy top cover and an internal thermal pad ensure efficient heat dissipation to help extend the lifespan of the SSD.

Overall, the lightweight and portable ASUS Cobble SSD enclosure is the perfect solution for fast, on-the-go storage for PCs, mobile devices, and gaming consoles. The ASUS Cobble SSD enclosure design allows for screw-free installations and can accommodate both SATA and NVMe M.2 SSDs, making it easy to repurpose older storage drives.

The nature-inspired, cobble-stone-shaped design of ASUS Cobble SSD enclosure gives it sleek, rounded curves that give users a comfortable grip. The soft tones and speckled finishes bring a touch of nature into the tech world, making it the perfect blend of style, practicality, and innovation.

The ASUS Cobble SSD enclosure is ideal for those looking for a highly customizable, compact external SSD storage solution with optimal performance and sleek aesthetics. This versatile enclosure is compatible with a wide range of SSDs to meet specific needs. Lightweight and durable, the ASUS Cobble offers on-the-go professionals and photographers a reliable and stylish way to safeguard creative projects, precious memories, and critical files, even while on the go.

The ASUS Cobble SSD Enclosure seamlessly blends aesthetics with high performance. It features robust internal and external protection mechanisms, ensuring uninterrupted data transfers even in the face of everyday spills, dust, and temperature fluctuations. ASUS Cobble is treated with a special coating that safeguards the enclosure and the SSD from minor impacts. The speckled paint finish on the robust metallic chassis makes it scratch-proof and able to resist high temperatures. The built-in thermal pad keeps the SSD cool even under heavy loads, preventing overheating and ensuring lasting performance. The ASUS Cobble is IP55-rated, offering adequate protection against dust and water.

The innovative Q-Latch, together with a simple locking mechanism, secure the drive, making it easy to install or remove an M.2 SSD without the need for tools or screws. product.name: ASUS ProArt PA401 Wood Edition ATX Chassis - Black
product.description:
Designed for creators who demand more than just performance, the ASUS ProArt PA401 Wood Edition PC Case blends natural aesthetics with precision-engineered airflow to power through intensive content creation workflows. This is not just a case, it’s a functional centrepiece for your creative build.

The standout feature is its crafted ash wood front panel, sustainably sourced and FSC® certified, finished through a meticulous six-stage process. It brings warmth and character to a traditionally cold tech space, seamlessly integrating professional-grade hardware into a creative workspace.

Cooling is where the ASUS ProArt PA401 Wood Edition PC Case truly excels. Dual pre-installed 160mm front fans and a 120mm rear fan, all with PWM control, move serious airflow with minimal noise. The 33% open front grille and ring-blade fan design maximise cooling efficiency while reducing vibration, critical when pushing CPUs and GPUs under sustained workloads.

With support for ATX motherboards, large-format GPUs (up to 31.5 cm), and CPU coolers up to 160mm tall, there’s room to build without compromise. Smart design elements like a detachable PSU bracket, tool-free drive installation, and integrated cable routing streamline the building experience from start to finish.

Connectivity is future-ready, too. The front I/O panel features a 20Gbps USB Type-C® port, two USB-A 3.2 Gen 1 ports, HD audio, and a power/reset button lock — all positioned for quick access and daily reliability.

Whether you’re editing 8K footage, working across multiple timelines, or rendering high-res assets, the ASUS ProArt PA401 Wood Edition PC Case delivers thermal headroom, functional elegance, and builder-focused design — all in a compact form that complements your creative space.

product.name: Asus A31 PLUS Mid Tower ATX Chassis - White
product.description:
Build the setup you’ve always imagined with the ASUS A31 PLUS Mid Tower, a case designed to match your ambition. Whether you're upgrading or starting from scratch, this chassis gives you the performance headroom, visual impact, and build flexibility to bring your desktop gaming rig to life.

You’ll enjoy wide motherboard support, including ATX, Micro-ATX, Mini-ITX, and BTF compatibility, giving you the freedom to build with future-ready components. The ASUS A31 PLUS Mid Tower doesn’t just house your hardware – it showcases it. With 4 mm tempered glass panels on both the front and left sides, your RGB lighting, clean cable runs, and premium components are always on full display.

Out of the box, you get four pre-installed ARGB 120 mm fans – three mounted on the side and one at the rear – delivering strong airflow and stunning lighting without the need for additional upgrades. Cooling flexibility is extensive, with support for up to three 12 mm or two 140 mm fans on the top, and space for a 140 mm or 120 mm fan at the rear. Radiator support includes 360 mm, 280 mm, 240 mm, 140 mm, and 120 mm options on the top, plus a 120 mm radiator at the rear.

Internally, there’s space to support high-performance components, including graphics cards up to 380 mm in length, CPU air coolers up to 165 mm in height, and power supplies up to 200 mm long. Two combo drive bays accommodate either 2.5" SSDs or 3.5" HDDs, giving you storage flexibility without sacrificing space. Seven expansion slots ensure full upgrade capability, whether you're adding capture cards, GPUs or high-speed networking.

The front I/O is built for speed and convenience, featuring one USB 3.2 Gen 2x2 Type-C port, two USB 3.2 Gen1 ports, and a 3.5 mm combined headphone/microphone jack. With 34 mm of cable management space and removable dust filters at the top and bottom, you’ll find it easy to keep things clean and efficient over the long run.

Measuring 23.8 x 51.1 x 43.5 cm and weighing 9100 g, the ASUS A31 PLUS Mid Tower strikes the perfect balance between size, durability and airflow — giving you a solid foundation to build a high-performance gaming PC you can be proud of.

  • Includes 4 pre-installed ARGB 120 mm fans for vibrant cooling

product.name: ASUS ProArt X870E-Creator WiFi AM5 ATX Motherboard
product.description:
Power your vision with the ASUS ProArt X870E-Creator WiFi motherboard, a next-generation platform built for creators who demand more from every render, compile and export. Designed to unleash the full potential of AMD Ryzen™ 9000, 8000 and 7000 Series processors, this motherboard transforms your PC into a precision tool for high-performance content creation.

At its core, 16+2+2 power stages rated at 80A deliver stable, efficient power to support multi-threaded workloads with ease. DDR5 memory support, up to 256GB and 8000+ MT/s (OC), ensures lightning-fast responsiveness in editing suites, simulation environments and 3D rendering applications.

Connectivity is second to none. The ASUS ProArt X870E-Creator WiFi motherboard integrates dual USB4® (40Gbps) Type-C® ports, 10Gb and 2.5Gb Ethernet, and cutting-edge WiFi 7 — enabling seamless collaboration, ultra-fast file transfers and cloud-based production pipelines. A front-panel USB-C® connector with Quick Charge 4+ (up to 30W) keeps your devices powered while you create.

Storage flexibility is extensive, with four M.2 slots (two PCIe 5.0 x4 enabled) and four SATA ports, giving creators the bandwidth and space for high-res assets, project archives and scratch disks. PCIe 5.0 x16 support enables workstation-class GPU performance, while ASUS Q-Release and SafeSlot features streamline hardware swaps.

Optimised for professional workflows, the ProArt Creator Hub offers system-level customisation, while integrated AI Overclocking, Cooling, and Networking features adapt performance in real time. Pantone® colour validation utilities ensure accuracy across your visual pipeline.

Housed in a sleek, matte-black PCB with metallic gold accents and a translucent I/O shroud, the ASUS ProArt X870E-Creator WiFi motherboard balances form and function in every detail. It’s a premium foundation for creators who won’t compromise — whether you’re building in Blender, editing in DaVinci Resolve or designing across Adobe Creative Cloud.

FEATURES:

  • Four ultra-fast M.2 slots, including dual PCIe 5.0 x4 for high-speed NVMe storage
  • WiFi 7 with Bluetooth® 5.4 for next-gen wireless performance and multi-device connectivity
  • Front Type-C® 20Gbps with Quick Charge 4+ up to 30W and USB Wattage Watcher support
  • Sleek ATX form factor with professional black-and-gold aesthetic and translucent I/O shroud
  • AI Overclocking, AI Cooling II and AI Networking for optimised, intelligent system performance
  • PCIe 5.0 x16 slots with SafeSlot and Q-Release Slim for premium GPU support and easy upgrades
  • 16+2+2 power stages (80A) engineered for reliable, high-performance content creation workloads
  • ProArt Creator Hub with Colour Control, Fan Management and CreationFirst network prioritisation
  • Supports up to 256GB DDR5 memory with speeds up to 8000+ MT/s (OC) and EXPO/AEMP profiles
  • Powered by AMD X870E chipset, supporting Ryzen™ 9000, 8000 and 7000 Series desktop processors
  • Marvell® 10Gb Ethernet and Intel® 2.5Gb LAN with ASUS LANGuard for high-speed, stable networking
  • Dual USB4® Type-C® ports with 40Gbps bandwidth for ultra-fast transfers and external display support

product.name: ASUS ProArt B650-Creator AMD AM5 ATX Motherboard
product.description:
Power Your Vision with the ASUS ProArt B650-Creator Motherboard for Content Creation. Unleash the full potential of your creative workflow with the ASUS ProArt B650-Creator motherboard for content creation, a high-performance platform built for professionals in 3D animation, film post-production, and complex media rendering. Engineered for AMD Ryzen™ 9000, 8000, and 7000 Series CPUs, this AM5-socket board delivers workstation-class stability, thermal control, and connectivity that empower content creators to move faster, think bigger, and produce more.

Harness the speed of DDR5 memory up to 7600+ MHz (OC) and AMD EXPO™ profiles for real-time multitasking, seamless timeline scrubbing, and accelerated rendering. With a dual-channel architecture and support for up to 192GB of RAM, the board ensures your system remains future-proofed for evolving creative demands.

The ASUS ProArt B650-Creator motherboard is designed with intensive content creation in mind. Featuring three ultra-fast M.2 slots, including one PCIe 5.0 x4 slot, for rapid file transfers and high-capacity NVMe storage, reducing load times on RAW 4K/8K files and complex project assets. Four additional SATA 6Gb/s ports allow for expanded archival storage, while USB 3.2 Gen 2x2 front-panel connectivity offers 20Gbps data throughput and Quick Charge 4+ up to 60W—perfect for high-speed file syncing and device charging between shoots.

Creators working in high-res workflows will appreciate DisplayPort Alt Mode support on Type-C, enabling up to 8K@60Hz output, alongside native HDMI 2.1 support. Dual LAN (2.5GbE + 1GbE) with ASUS LANGuard ensures low-latency transfers to NAS systems and remote collaboration environments.

Built on ASUS's ProArt design philosophy, this board features Creator Hub software for real-time monitoring and fine-tuning, Q-Latch for tool-free M.2 installation, and robust thermal design with oversized VRM heatsinks. Audio quality is equally professional, with 7.1-channel HD audio, premium capacitors, and optical S/PDIF out for precise sound editing.

Whether you’re colour grading, rendering effects, or streaming your workflow, the ASUS ProArt B650-Creator motherboard for content creation is your creative powerhouse—intelligently engineered for stability, performance, and artistic ambition.

FEATURES:

  • Optimised for AMD Ryzen™ 9000, 8000, & 7000 Series CPUs with AM5 socket
  • Supports up to 192GB DDR5 RAM at speeds up to 7600MHz (OC) for seamless multitasking
  • PCIe 5.0 and PCIe 4.0 slots for lightning-fast storage and GPU performance
  • Dual M.2 slots with PCIe 5.0 x4 and PCIe 4.0 x4 for high-speed data transfer
  • USB 3.2 Gen 2x2 front panel with Quick Charge 4+ support for up to 60W power delivery
  • Dual 2.5Gb Ethernet and 1Gb Ethernet ports with ASUS LANGuard for enhanced network reliability
  • DisplayPort 1.4 and HDMI 2.1 ports for 8K/4K visual output and smooth multi-display setups
  • Thermal management with oversized VRM heatsinks and M.2 heatsinks for improved cooling
  • ProArt Creator Hub software for real-time monitoring, system tuning, and custom profiles

product.name: ASUS TUF Gaming 1200W Gold PSU
product.description:
The ASUS TUF Gaming 1200W Gold PSU is engineered to meet the demanding needs of high-performance gaming PC builds, delivering consistent, efficient, and reliable power to your system. With its 80 Plus Gold certification, this power supply unit (PSU) offers up to 92% energy efficiency, ensuring minimal heat generation, reduced fan noise, and optimal performance.

Built to last, the ASUS TUF Gaming 1200W Gold PSU is equipped with military-grade components, including high-end Japanese capacitors and dual ball fan bearings that significantly extend its lifespan. The PSU’s MTBF rating exceeds 120,000 hours at 40°C, ensuring durability for long-term use. Additionally, the unit undergoes rigorous drop, vibration, and extreme temperature tests, ensuring resilience even in harsh environments.

This PSU is fully modular, allowing you to customise your cable management for a tidy and organised system. The etched cables are made from premium, flexible materials and are capable of withstanding high temperatures, ensuring safety and performance throughout your build.

The Axial-tech fan design ensures superior airflow, keeping your rig cool even under heavy loads. With a 135mm fan that operates at low RPMs, the PSU maintains quiet operation while delivering powerful cooling. Whether you're gaming or running resource-intensive applications, the ASUS TUF Gaming 1200W Gold PSU is ready to handle the power demands of next-gen hardware, including PCIe Gen 5.1 graphics cards, with its 16-pin PCIe cable that supports up to 600W of power.

Designed with ATX 3.1 compatibility, this PSU ensures seamless integration with future hardware. Plus, the 10-year warranty gives you peace of mind, knowing that your system is powered by one of the most reliable PSUs on the market.

For high-performance gaming PC builds, trust the ASUS TUF Gaming 1200W Gold PSU to deliver the power, efficiency, and durability needed for sustained success in every gaming session.

FEATURES:

  • 80 Plus Gold Certification for up to 92% energy efficiency
  • Military-grade components for enhanced durability and longevity
  • Fully modular design for clean and efficient cable management
  • Axial-tech fan design with a 135mm fan for superior cooling and quieter operation
  • ATX 3.1 compatibility for next-gen hardware support, including PCIe Gen 5.1 graphics cards
  • Dual ball fan bearings that last up to twice as long as sleeve bearing designs
  • Extensive protection features with OPP/OVP/UVP/SCP/OCP/OTP safeguards
  • 10-year warranty for long-term reliability and peace of mind

product.name: Asus ROG Ryujin III ARGB AIO Liquid Cooler - 3.5" LCD Display
product.description:
The Asus ROG Ryujin III 360 ARGB AIO Liquid CPU Cooler is engineered to redefine thermal performance and visual immersion for high-performance gaming builds and professional systems. Built with premium components and advanced cooling innovations, the Asus ROG Ryujin III Liquid Cooler delivers superior heat dissipation and unmatched personalisation.

At the heart of the cooler is the latest 8th-generation Asetek pump, driven by a 3-phase motor that delivers high flow rates with reduced impedance and minimal operational noise. This ensures reliable thermal control even under heavy CPU loads. Enhancing the cooling architecture further is an embedded fan with a new ring-shaped frame and optimised airflow channels, specifically designed to target the VRM area for enhanced motherboard longevity.

The cooler features a robust 399.5 mm aluminium radiator paired with three 120 mm ROG magnetic daisy-chainable ARGB fans. Each fan operates between 600 to 2200 RPM, delivering up to 70.07 CFM of airflow with a static pressure of 3.88 mmH₂O. These fans are equipped with Gen 2 ARGB LEDs, enabling dynamic lighting effects that can be fully customised through Armoury Crate.

A standout feature of the ASUS ROG Ryujin III 360 ARGB AIO Liquid CPU Cooler is its integrated 3.5-inch full-colour LCD screen. With double the storage of previous iterations, users can showcase system stats, custom animations, or logos directly on the CPU block. The display, fans, and pump can all be finely tuned via Armoury Crate for complete control and synchronisation.

Supporting the latest AMD AM5/AM4 and Intel LGA 1851/1700/1200/115x sockets, this cooler is future-ready and highly versatile. It also includes a free one-year AIDA64 Extreme license for advanced system monitoring.

  • 8th-gen Asetek pump delivers high-performance, low-noise cooling

  • Armoury Crate enables full control of fan, pump, and display settings

Elevate your creative workstation with the ASUS ProArt LC 360 AIO Liquid CPU Cooler—engineered to meet the thermal demands of high-performance content creation builds. Whether you're editing 4K video, rendering complex 3D models or managing intensive workflows, this premium cooling solution ensures your system remains whisper-quiet and thermally efficient, even under prolonged load.

product.name: ASUS Prime LC 360 ARGB CPU Cooler
product.description:
Level up your custom PC build with the Prime LC 360 ARGB liquid CPU cooler – an all-in-one cooling solution engineered for performance, style, and ease of installation. Whether you’re building from scratch or upgrading your current setup, this cooler is designed to meet the demands of modern processors while enhancing your rig’s aesthetics.

The specially designed copper CPU contact plate provides a larger surface area for heat transfer, enabling faster and more efficient thermal dissipation. This ensures your CPU stays cool and stable under heavy workloads, reducing the risk of thermal throttling and maintaining peak performance.

At the centre of the water block is a customisable infinity mirror lens, delivering immersive ARGB lighting with captivating visual depth. This feature pairs seamlessly with Prime motherboards and adds a futuristic edge to your PC’s overall look.

The ASUS Prime LC 360 ARGB liquid CPU cooler includes high-performance 36 cm ARGB fans pre-installed onto the radiator. With speeds ranging from 600 to 2200 RPM and an airflow of 75.7 CFM, these fans offer powerful, quiet cooling. The single Y-cable design simplifies the installation process by combining fan and lighting controls for cleaner cable management.

Durability is built in with reinforced, sleeved rubber tubing measuring 40 cm, giving you greater installation flexibility and long-term reliability. The cooler is fully compatible with a broad range of CPU sockets, including Intel® LGA 1851, 1700, 1200, 115X and AMD AM5, AM4, ensuring wide system support.

For builders prioritising both aesthetics and thermal performance, the Asus Prime LC 360 ARGB liquid CPU cooler delivers on all fronts. Backed by a 6-year warranty and AURA Sync support, it’s the ideal solution for users who demand high-efficiency cooling without compromising on design.

product.name: Asus Cobble M.2 SSD Enclosure - Black
product.description:
The ASUS Cobble SSD enclosure combines style and performance in a sleek, cobble-stone-inspired design. Its durable aluminium-alloy top cover offers robust protection, while IP55 water and dust resistance ensures data stays safe when on the go. A USB Type-C® 3.2 Gen 2x1 connection enables superfast and reliable transfer speeds of up to 10 Gbps, while maintaining consistent data performance. An aluminium-alloy top cover and an internal thermal pad ensure efficient heat dissipation to help extend the lifespan of the SSD.

Overall, the lightweight and portable ASUS Cobble SSD enclosure is the perfect solution for fast, on-the-go storage for PCs, mobile devices, and gaming consoles. The ASUS Cobble SSD enclosure design allows for screw-free installations and can accommodate both SATA and NVMe M.2 SSDs, making it easy to repurpose older storage drives.

The nature-inspired, cobble-stone-shaped design of ASUS Cobble SSD enclosure gives it sleek, rounded curves that give users a comfortable grip. The soft tones and speckled finishes bring a touch of nature into the tech world, making it the perfect blend of style, practicality, and innovation.

The ASUS Cobble SSD enclosure is ideal for those looking for a highly customizable, compact external SSD storage solution with optimal performance and sleek aesthetics. This versatile enclosure is compatible with a wide range of SSDs to meet specific needs. Lightweight and durable, the ASUS Cobble offers on-the-go professionals and photographers a reliable and stylish way to safeguard creative projects, precious memories, and critical files, even while on the go.

The ASUS Cobble SSD Enclosure seamlessly blends aesthetics with high performance. It features robust internal and external protection mechanisms, ensuring uninterrupted data transfers even in the face of everyday spills, dust, and temperature fluctuations. The ASUS Cobble SSD enclosure supports up to 4TB of storage, providing space for approximately 80 4K movies, 200,000 photos, 800,000 files, 1,777 hours of FHD videos, or 40 AAA games.

ASUS Cobble is treated with a special coating that safeguards the enclosure and the SSD from minor impacts. The speckled paint finish on the robust metallic chassis makes it scratch-proof and able to resist high temperatures. The built-in thermal pad keeps the SSD cool even under heavy loads, preventing overheating and ensuring lasting performance. The ASUS Cobble is IP55-rated, offering adequate protection against dust and water.

The innovative Q-Latch, together with a simple locking mechanism, secure the drive, making it easy to install or remove an M.2 SSD without the need for tools or screws. ASUS Cobble is compatible with both PCIe NVMe and SATA interfaces, and can accommodate 2242, 2260, and 2280 form factor SSDs. The ASUS Cobble SSD enclosure offers comprehensive compatibility with Windows 11, macOS, mobile devices, and the latest gaming consoles.

FEATURES:

  • USB Type-C 3.2 Gen2 support for high-speed data transfer

product.name: Asus PRIME H610M-R DDR5 LGA1700 Micro-ATX Motherboard
product.description:
The Asus PRIME H610M-R DDR5 LGA1700 Micro-ATX Motherboard is the ideal choice for PC DIY builders and users seeking a reliable, future-proof platform for their system. Designed to support the latest 12th, 13th, and 14th Generation Intel® Core™, Pentium® Gold, and Celeron® processors, this motherboard provides the performance and flexibility you need for both gaming and professional applications.

With a micro-ATX form factor, the Asus PRIME H610M-R DDR5 motherboard is compact, making it a perfect fit for small-to-medium PC builds while offering ample connectivity and expansion options. It features 2 x DIMM slots that support up to 64GB of DDR5 memory with speeds of up to 3200 MHz, ensuring smooth multitasking and responsiveness for demanding tasks.

Connectivity is a key strength of this motherboard, featuring 1 x PCIe 4.0 x16 slot for powerful graphics cards and 1 x M.2 slot supporting 32 Gbps data transfer speeds for fast storage. The motherboard also comes with 4 x SATA 6Gb/s ports, providing flexible storage expansion for your build.

Security and longevity are top priorities, with Asus’ 5X Protection III technology. This includes DIGI+ VRM for precise power delivery, LANGuard for network protection, and SafeSlot Core to reinforce the PCIe slots, making the ASUS PRIME H610M-R highly durable and reliable. The motherboard also offers robust network connectivity with Realtek 1Gb Ethernet and immersive audio with Realtek 7.1 Surround Sound High Definition Audio CODEC.

The Asus PRIME H610M-R DDR5 motherboard is designed to make system setup easy with an intuitive UEFI BIOS, EZ Flash 3, and CrashFree BIOS 3 for effortless BIOS updates and recovery.

Whether you’re building a gaming rig, workstation, or home PC, the Asus PRIME H610M-R offers a balanced combination of performance, connectivity, and protection, making it a perfect foundation for your next PC build.

product.name: Asus TUF Gaming B760M-PLUS WIFI II - mATX Motherboard
product.description:
The Asus TUF Gaming B760M-PLUS WIFI II is a robust micro-ATX Motherboard that delivers exceptional durability, advanced performance, and rock-solid stability for 14th,13th and 12th Gen Intel® Core™ processors. Engineered with military-grade components and TUF-tested reliability, it caters to competitive gamers, PC builders, and performance-driven users seeking a balance between next-gen features and dependable construction.

At its core, the Asus TUF Gaming B760M-PLUS Motherboard features a 12+1 DrMOS power stage VRM architecture, enlarged VRM heatsinks, and a six-layer PCB design to ensure stable power delivery under high-load conditions. It supports DDR5 memory for faster data throughput, lower power consumption, and superior multitasking capabilities. PCIe® 5.0 support unlocks future-ready bandwidth for the latest GPUs, while dual PCIe 4.0 M.2 slots with M.2 Q-Latch simplify high-speed SSD installation.

Seamless connectivity is a cornerstone with integrated Wi-Fi 6E ensuring low-latency wireless networking across the 6 GHz spectrum, while the Intel® 2.5 Gb Ethernet port offers ultra-fast wired connections. Comprehensive cooling controls include hybrid fan headers, AI-powered Fan Xpert 2+ software, and precision thermal monitoring to maintain optimal system performance.

Built for DIY ease, it includes a pre-mounted I/O shield, Q-LED diagnostic indicators, and ASUS SafeSlot Core+ for reinforced GPU retention. The rugged design aesthetic is complemented by support for ASUS Aura Sync RGB lighting, allowing users to personalise builds with unified lighting control. Whether you’re building a compact gaming rig or a high-efficiency workstation, the Asus TUF Gaming B760M-PLUS WIFI II - mATX Motherboard delivers a future-proof platform tailored for speed, stability, and endurance.

FEATURES:

  • Intel® LGA1700 socket supports 14h & 13th Gen Intel® Core™, 12th Core, Pentium® Gold, and Celeron® processors
  • 12+1 DrMOS power stages and durable components ensure reliable, stable performance for demanding workloads.
  • DDR5 memory supports advanced multitasking and gaming responsiveness
  • Next-gen PCIe® 5.0 support provides ultra-high bandwidth for the latest GPUs, enhancing visual performance and data throughput
  • Dual PCIe 4.0 M.2 slots support NVMe SSDs for ultra-fast game and application loading times
  • Wi-Fi 6E connectivity delivers high-speed, low-latency wireless networking across the 6 GHz band
  • Intel® 2.5Gb Ethernet provides high-speed wired networking ideal for streaming, competitive gaming, and heavy data transfers
  • Enlarged VRM heatsinks, hybrid fan headers, and Fan Xpert 2+ software maintain thermal efficiency under load
  • Military-grade components and six-layer PCB ensure long-term reliability and enhanced power integrity
  • DIY-friendly design includes pre-mounted I/O shield, M.2 Q-Latch, SafeSlot Core+, and Q-LED indicators
  • ASUS Aura Sync RGB support offers customisable lighting synchronisation with compatible components
  • Armoury Crate centralised software for performance tuning, RGB control, and real-time system monitoring

It’s purpose-built for gamers, streamers, and PC enthusiasts who demand precision, speed, and stability.

The Asus ROG Strix X870-F Gaming Motherboard features robust 16+2 power stages and high-grade alloy chokes to ensure consistent power under pressure. It’s designed for AM5 processors and DDR5 memory, with support for PCIe 5.0 graphics and storage, offering blistering bandwidth and unparalleled responsiveness. Connectivity reaches new heights with built-in Wi-Fi 7, 2.5 Gb Ethernet, and native USB4 support, enabling lightning-fast data transfer and low-latency networking.

Aesthetically, the Asus ROG Strix X870-F Gaming Motherboard boasts bold cyberpunk accents, customisable RGB via Aura Sync, and a pre-mounted I/O shield for streamlined installation. product.name: Asus ROG Strix B760-F Gaming WiFi Motherboard - Intel LGA1700
product.description:
Engineered for uncompromising performance and seamless integration with next-gen hardware, the Asus ROG Strix B760-F Gaming WiFi motherboard is the ideal foundation for gamers, creators, and PC enthusiasts. Powered by the Intel B760 chipset and compatible with 12th, 13th and 14th Gen Intel Core processors, it supports the LGA1700 socket and unleashes the full potential of Intel’s hybrid architecture.

With support for up to 128GB of ultra-fast DDR5 memory across four DIMM slots, the Asus ROG Strix B760-F Gaming Motherboard ensures accelerated multitasking, faster data handling, and superior bandwidth. PCIe 5.0 x16 graphics support offers next-level performance for the latest GPUs, while three M.2 slots with PCIe 4.0 deliver rapid storage with reduced latency and higher throughput. WiFi 6E and Intel 2.5Gb Ethernet provide ultra-reliable, low-latency networking for competitive online gaming and streaming.

Enhanced cooling is assured via large VRM heatsinks, hybrid fan headers, and M.2 heatsinks that maintain system stability during high-load operations. Advanced connectivity includes rear USB 3.2 Gen 2x2 Type-C®, front USB Type-C®, and HDMI® 2.1 and DisplayPort 1.4 outputs for modern displays. The ROG Strix B760-F Gaming also incorporates intuitive features like Q-LED diagnostic indicators, BIOS FlashBack™, and a pre-mounted I/O shield for streamlined assembly and maintenance.

Designed with bold cyberpunk-inspired styling, premium components, and Aura Sync RGB lighting, the Asus ROG Strix B760-F Gaming delivers a visually immersive and technically advanced platform for next-gen PC builds.

FEATURES;

  • Intel B760 chipset with LGA1700 socket supports 12th,13th and 14th Gen Intel Core, Pentium Gold, and Celeron processors
  • Up to 128GB DDR5 memory support across 4 DIMM slots, delivering faster data rates and enhanced bandwidth
  • PCIe 5.0 graphics card compatibility enables ultra-fast GPU performance for high-end gaming and creative workloads
  • Triple M.2 slots with PCIe 4.0 ensure high-speed NVMe SSD support for lightning-fast storage access
  • Integrated WiFi 6E delivers faster wireless throughput and low-latency connectivity across 6GHz spectrum
  • Intel 2.5Gb Ethernet ensures stable, high-speed wired networking for competitive gaming
  • Advanced 16+1 power stages with robust capacitors and alloy chokes for stable CPU performance
  • Comprehensive cooling design includes large VRM heatsinks, M.2 heatsinks, and hybrid fan headers
  • USB 3.2 Gen 2x2 Type-C® supports fast data transfer and versatile peripheral connectivity
  • HDMI® 2.1 and DisplayPort 1.4 high-resolution and high refresh outputs
  • Q-LED diagnostic display and BIOS FlashBack™ simplify system troubleshooting and firmware updates
  • Pre-mounted I/O shield and PCIe Q-Release streamlines installation and upgrades
  • Customisable Aura Sync RGB lighting effects with support for multiple ARGB headers
  • Striking cyberpunk design aesthetics aligned with ROG’s bold and futuristic design language

product.name: Asus ROG Strix B550-F Gaming WiFi Motherboard - AMD AM4
product.description:
The ROG Strix B550-F Gaming Wi-Fi motherboard offers a refined balance of power, performance, and premium-grade features for serious gamers and PC builders. Built to support 3rd Gen AMD Ryzen™ processors, this ATX board is powered by a 12+2 DrMOS power stage design, alloy chokes, and durable capacitors, ensuring precise voltage regulation and system stability under load or during overclocking sessions.

Equipped with dual PCIe 4.0 M.2 slots, the ROG Strix B550-F Gaming enables ultra-fast data transfer rates with support for RAID configurations and the latest NVMe SSDs. Four DIMM slots offer support for up to 128GB of DDR4 memory, optimised for high-frequency performance. Intel® I225-V 2.5Gb Ethernet delivers low-latency wired networking, while integrated Intel® Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax) ensures superior wireless speeds and responsiveness for online gameplay, streaming, and remote workloads.

SupremeFX S1220A audio with DTS® Sound Unbound and Sonic Studio III delivers high-definition audio, creating immersive in-game soundscapes. Intelligent software features such as AI Networking and Fan Xpert 4 simplify system management, while multiple hybrid fan headers, VRM heatsinks, and a PCH heatsink provide robust thermal control.

Connectivity is streamlined with USB 3.2 Gen 2 Type-A and Type-C ports, HDMI 2.1 and DisplayPort 1.2 outputs, and onboard Aura Sync RGB lighting with addressable headers for complete customisation. BIOS FlashBack™ allows safe firmware updates without a CPU, and the pre-mounted I/O shield ensures a clean, straightforward installation.

The ROG Strix B550-F Gaming Wi-Fi motherboard is an ideal foundation for high-performance AMD builds, offering future-ready architecture, aesthetic customisation, and comprehensive connectivity in one advanced solution.

FEATURES:

  • Dual M.2 slots support up to PCIe 4.0 speeds
  • 12+2 DrMOS power stages and high-quality alloy chokes ensure stable power delivery
  • Integrated Wi-Fi 6 delivers next-gen wireless speeds with increased capacity and efficiency
  • AI networking and BIOS FlashBack™, streamlined connectivity and one-click BIOS recovery
  • Pre-mounted I/O shield and reinforced PCIe slot for simplified installation and enhanced durability
  • VRM and chipset heatsinks, hybrid fan headers, and Fan Xpert 4 ensure optimal thermal performance
  • Aura Sync offers customisable RGB lighting, and addressable Gen 2 headers allow synchronised lighting
  • SupremeFX audio technology provides immersive sound powered by high-fidelity components and DTS® Sound Unbound support

Thermal management is finely tuned with expansive VRM heatsinks, hybrid fan headers, and AI Cooling II, which intelligently balances noise and thermals with a single click. DIY builders will appreciate ASUS Q-Design for simplified assembly and error-free installation. Sync your RGB components using Aura Sync to achieve a cohesive visual setup, and enjoy pristine audio with ESS® ES9219 QUAD DAC and SupremeFX Shielding Technology. Whether you're chasing competitive edge, professional-grade production, or cutting-edge AI performance, the ROG Crosshair X870E HERO delivers unrivaled control and power for next-gen PC builds.

product.name: Asus GeForce® GT 1030 2GB GDDR5 Low Profile Graphics Card
product.description:
The Asus GeForce® GT 1030 2GB GDDR5 Low Profile Graphics Card delivers an ideal balance of power, performance, and compact design, making it the perfect choice for space-constrained builds. Whether you're enhancing your desktop setup for general use or looking to boost casual gaming and multimedia experiences, this graphics card provides reliable, efficient performance without overwhelming your system.

Optimised for compact chassis, this single-slot, low-profile card ensures that your build remains sleek and functional while offering impressive visual output. The Asus GT 1030 is powered by the NVIDIA GeForce GT 1030 GPU and built on the NVIDIA Pascal architecture, providing a substantial boost in performance compared to previous generations. Featuring 2GB of GDDR5 memory and a 6008 MHz memory clock, it ensures smooth handling of everyday tasks and light gaming.

Equipped with Auto-Extreme Technology, the card guarantees high-quality components through a fully automated production process, ensuring long-lasting durability and minimal risk of failure, even in demanding environments. The Super Alloy Power II technology further enhances efficiency by reducing power loss, lowering temperatures, and minimising electrical buzzing, improving overall reliability.

For users looking to fine-tune their performance, the GPU Tweak II software offers a redesigned UI with an easy-to-use interface for overclocking. The Gaming Booster function allows for instant performance optimisation with just one click, boosting your system’s potential by disabling unnecessary processes and optimising memory without closing applications.

This graphics card is perfect for users who require dependable, space-saving solutions for multi-monitor setups, supporting resolutions up to 7680 x 4320 across two monitors. With its 1x HDMI 2.0b and 1x DisplayPort 1.4, it provides versatile display connectivity. The Asus GT 1030 is well-suited for budget-conscious gamers, content creators, and general users who value versatility, efficiency, and smooth, high-resolution visual output.

product.name: Asus ROG Astral GeForce RTX 5090 32GB GDDR7 OC Edition
product.description:
Unleash the future of gaming and content creation with the Asus ROG Astral RTX 5090, the ultimate expression of next-gen performance and thermal innovation. Engineered for elite gamers, AI developers, and creators who demand uncompromising graphics power, the ROG Astral RTX 5090 redefines what’s possible with NVIDIA’s flagship GPU architecture.

At its core lies the ultra-efficient NVIDIA Blackwell architecture, supercharged with 32GB of GDDR7 memory and cutting-edge DLSS 4 technology, delivering lifelike visuals and razor-sharp frame rates at 4K and beyond. With full support for real-time ray tracing, PCIe 5.0, and AI-enhanced workflows, this card empowers you to game, stream, and create without compromise.

Whether you're battling at the highest esports level or rendering complex 3D environments, the ROG Astral RTX 5090 delivers unprecedented speed, thermal control, and visual fidelity — setting a new benchmark for premium GPUs.

To ensure maximum stability and GPU-first power delivery, the ASUS ROG Thor III 1600W Titanium Gaming Power Supply is the perfect companion. product.name: UGREEN NASync DXP8800 Plus 8-Bay NAS
product.description:
Designed to empower seamless collaboration, high-speed access, and enterprise-level data security, the UGREEN NASync DXP8800 Plus 8-Bay NAS is a purpose-built solution for professionals and teams managing large, mission-critical files across networked environments.

As a dedicated network-attached storage (NAS) system, this device enables users across the same network, whether in a creative agency, architecture firm, remote working setup, or IT department, to access, store, and collaborate on data continuously and securely. The centralised storage model eliminates file version conflicts and bottlenecks, ensuring that teams operate from a single source of truth.

Built on a powerful 12th Gen 10-core Intel® Core™ Processor with 10 cores and 12 threads, the UGREEN NASync DXP8800 Plus 8-Bay NAS delivers responsive multi-user performance. The 8GB DDR5 RAM is expandable to 64GB, allowing smooth operation of multiple applications and services, including private cloud hosting, AI-driven media sorting, and virtualisation environments.

With eight SATA bays supporting up to 24TB each, plus two M.2 NVMe slots for high-speed caching, this NAS provides up to 208TB of scalable storage. Advanced RAID configurations (JBOD/Basic/0/1/5/6/10) and a robust thermal system protect your data while maintaining system stability.

Dual high-speed LAN ports (2x 10GbE) enable ultra-fast data transfers, while Thunderbolt 4 ports, USB ports and an SD card reader simplify external backups and file imports. UGOS Pro, UGREEN’s user-friendly OS, supports cross-platform access and intuitive data management, ensuring your workflow remains uninterrupted, no matter the device or operating system.

For businesses and creators needing always-available, high-capacity storage, the UGREEN NASync DXP8800 Plus 8-Bay NAS is the ideal foundation for a modern, collaborative data ecosystem.

product.name: Cudy LT300 4G LTE N300 Wi-Fi Router - White
product.description:
The Cudy LT300 4G LTE N300 Wi-Fi Router is a compact, plug-and-play networking solution designed for versatile scenarios including home use, office setups, surveillance systems, exhibitions, and RV travel. With a built-in Nano SIM slot and support for 4G LTE Cat. 4, this router offers uninterrupted wireless connectivity without the need for a traditional broadband contract. Its dual 10/100Mbps Ethernet ports provide reliable wired options, while 2.4GHz Wi-Fi speeds of up to 300Mbps ensure stable performance for your everyday devices.

Engineered for uninterrupted internet access, the LT300 features WAN failover, allowing it to switch between broadband, WISP, and cellular networks to maintain a stable connection. This is ideal for areas with unreliable internet or for mobile setups where consistent access is essential. Equipped with 2×2 MIMO internal antennas, the router delivers broad wireless coverage with up to 100 meters of range, making it suitable for both indoor and outdoor deployments depending on your environment.

Setting up the LT300 takes only minutes thanks to its intuitive interface and clear system status panel. Parents can regulate online activity with built-in tools like bedtime scheduling and domain blacklisting, while professionals can take advantage of robust VPN capabilities including OpenVPN, WireGuard, L2TP, and PPTP for secure and private browsing. With WPA3 encryption, your wireless communications stay protected against data breaches and unauthorised access.

Manage your network anytime, anywhere with the Cudy App, which offers both cloud-based and local control options. Monitor system activity, adjust settings, or troubleshoot remotely with ease. Designed with practical physical features like WPS and reset buttons, signal strength LEDs, and low 8W power consumption, the LT300 balances performance, security, and convenience in one streamlined unit. Certified by FCC and CE, it’s built for reliability across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa.

product.name: Cudy BE11000 Wi-Fi7 Gigabit Mesh Router
product.description:
Unlock the next generation of networking with the Cudy BE11000 Wi-Fi 7 Gigabit Mesh Router, engineered to meet the demands of modern households and power users alike. Featuring Wi-Fi 7 (802.11be) technology and tri-band connectivity, this router delivers lightning-fast wireless speeds up to 11,000Mbps across the 6GHz, 5GHz, and 2.4GHz bands. Whether you're streaming 4K content, gaming online, or handling massive file transfers, enjoy ultra-responsive performance with zero interruptions.

At the heart of the BE11000 lies a Qualcomm 1.5GHz Quad-Core 64-bit Cortex-A53 CPU paired with 512MB of DDR4 RAM, giving you an immense processing boost. This ensures smoother multi-device management and lag-free operation across dozens of connected devices, perfect for smart homes or home offices. Combined with Multi-Link Operation (MLO), the router intelligently links devices to all three bands simultaneously, reducing latency and maximizing stability.

Thanks to six high-gain fixed antennas with Beamforming and four high-power external FEMs, the BE11000 pushes strong, focused signals throughout your home—even in hard-to-reach corners. Enjoy exceptional coverage and wall-penetrating strength, ensuring stable connections no matter where you roam.

Need ultra-fast wired speeds? The BE11000 doesn’t disappoint. It features four 2.5G multi-gigabit Ethernet ports, giving your PC, gaming console, NAS, or Smart TV speeds up to 2.5X faster than traditional Gigabit. Whether you’re editing large video files or enjoying buffer-free entertainment, these high-speed ports keep up with your most demanding tasks.

Smart parental controls let you manage access, set schedules, and block inappropriate content to protect your family online. Create custom profiles for each user and enjoy seamless integration with smart home devices. The intuitive setup process via wireless pairing or auto-wired connection makes deployment quick and effortless. Plus, with mesh support, you can create a single unified network with seamless roaming—no need to manually switch between access points.

Support for Ultra-Wide 240/320MHz bandwidth, OFDMA, MU-MIMO, WPA3 encryption, and IPv6 ensures maximum performance, robust security, and future-ready networking. Whether you're an advanced user or a casual home user, the Cudy BE11000 Wi-Fi 7 Mesh Router is built to evolve with your needs.

  • Ultra-Wide 240/320 MHz Bandwidth
  • MLO, Puncturing, OFDMA, MU-MIMO

product.name: UGREEN RJ45 Splitter Adapter 2 Pack (Black)
product.description:
The UGREEN RJ45 Splitter Adapter is a practical networking solution designed to optimise cable management and connectivity. Ideal for home, office, or industrial use, this adapter allows a single network cable to be physically split into two, enabling two devices to share a single Ethernet connection. It is particularly useful in environments with limited network ports or when additional wiring is impractical.

Built for 100Mbps LAN cables, this ethernet splitter ensures a stable and reliable wired connection for devices such as PCs, laptops, routers, and switches. When used individually, it functions as a network cable extender—but when used in pairs, it effectively splits one Ethernet cable into two functional connections.

Constructed with a high-quality ABS casing, the adapter is both durable and lightweight, making it easy to carry and install. The metal shield protection structure enhances signal integrity while minimising interference, ensuring smooth data transmission. Compact and efficient, the UGREEN RJ45 Splitter Adapter provides a cost-effective networking solution for users looking to extend or optimise their Ethernet setup.

product.name: MSI GeForce RTX 5080 16GB INSPIRE 3X OC Graphics Card

The MSI GeForce RTX 5080 16GB GDDR7 INSPIRE 3X OC Graphics Card delivers exceptional performance for gamers, content creators, and professionals seeking cutting-edge graphics power. Built on the revolutionary NVIDIA® GeForce RTX™ 5080 architecture, this graphics card is engineered for high-end gaming, real-time rendering, and demanding workloads.

Featuring 16GB of GDDR7 memory, the MSI GeForce RTX 5080 ensures fast data throughput and outstanding performance in memory-intensive applications, making it ideal for 4K and 8K gaming, as well as advanced content creation. The 256-bit memory bus and a memory speed of 30 Gbps provide optimal data transfer rates, reducing lag and ensuring smooth gameplay and seamless creative workflows.

The Triple Fan cooling system, designed with Stormforce Fans, ensures that the MSI GeForce RTX 5080 operates at lower temperatures while maintaining a whisper-quiet environment. The fans are paired with Nickel-plated Copper Baseplate and Core Pipes to ensure rapid heat dissipation, keeping the GPU and memory cool during intense operations. The fans also feature Zero Frozr technology, which halts fan movement under light load conditions, further reducing noise.

For additional durability and structural integrity, the card is equipped with a robust Metal Backplate, reinforcing the GPU while promoting airflow for effective cooling. The Air Antegrade Fin and Wave Curved 3.0 technologies enhance airflow efficiency and optimise thermal management.

The MSI GeForce RTX 5080 is also ready for the future of display technology with DisplayPort x 3 (v2.1b) and HDMI™ x 1 support for resolutions up to 7680 x 4320. The G-SYNC® technology provides smooth and tear-free gameplay, making it perfect for fast-paced gaming and visually intensive tasks.

With MSI Center software for real-time monitoring and the world-renowned Afterburner overclocking tool, this graphics card offers full customisation for every user, ensuring top-tier performance tailored to specific needs.

Unleash the power of next-gen graphics with the MSI GeForce RTX 5080 16GB GDDR7 INSPIRE 3X OC Graphics Card.

product.name: Xiaomi Smart Pet Care Air Purifier
product.description:
Cleaner air, calmer pets, healthier homes | Smart odour and allergen control for pet owners | Ideal for small-to-medium spaces, multi-pet households, and allergy-sensitive environments

The Xiaomi Smart Pet Care Air Purifier redefines indoor air quality for homes with pets. Engineered with animal comfort and owner well-being in mind, this intelligent purifier merges pet-safe innovation with Xiaomi’s trusted air filtration technology. From fur and dander to odours and allergens, it actively targets airborne pollutants to create a fresher, cleaner environment, optimised for the unique needs of pet owners, children, and allergy-sensitive individuals.

At its core is a triple-layer composite filtration system, combining a primary filter, a high-efficiency Xiaomi filter, and a specialised activated carbon layer. This intelligent filtration suite effectively captures and neutralises pet hair, dander, fine particles, and odours, ensuring a consistently breathable environment. With CADR ratings of 230m³/h (particles) and 237.4m³/h (pollen), it offers high-volume purification for spaces between 16m² and 27m² — ideal for living rooms, bedrooms, or home offices.

Smart functionality underpins the purifier’s performance. Its Automatic Anti-Stress Algorithm ensures that airflow adjustments happen gradually, minimising noise and avoiding sudden changes that could startle pets. A laser particle sensor provides real-time monitoring of airborne particulates, with a large LED display offering at-a-glance pollution level updates. When it’s time to rest, Sleep Mode dims the display for uninterrupted sleep while maintaining continuous purification in near-silent operation.

Certified by SGS and tested by ITS, the Xiaomi Smart Pet Care Air Purifier is verified safe for pets and humans alike. The pet safety lock prevents accidental activation, while the one-step bottom-pull design simplifies filter replacement. All core functions — from speed adjustments to remote scheduling — can be controlled via the Xiaomi Home App or compatible voice assistants, integrating seamlessly into any smart home ecosystem.

Whether you're combating daily pet shedding, reducing allergy triggers, or simply elevating air quality, the Xiaomi Smart Pet Care Air Purifier delivers quiet, efficient, and intelligent performance — day in and day out.

product.name: Xiaomi 33W Power Bank 10000 (Integrated Cable) - Blue
product.description:
The Xiaomi 33W Power Bank 10000 (Integrated Cable) redefines portable charging with a streamlined, all-in-one design tailored for fast, on-the-go power delivery. Engineered with dual 5000mAh lithium-ion cells, this high-capacity 10,000mAh power bank supports up to 33W fast charging, ideal for smartphones, tablets, handheld consoles, and other USB-powered devices.

At the core of its design is an integrated Type-C cable that doubles as a retractable lanyard, eliminating the need for extra accessories while enhancing portability. Whether commuting, travelling, or working remotely, users benefit from fast, reliable energy replenishment without compromise.

Supporting a broad range of charging protocols—including PD 3.0, QC 3.0, and Apple 2.4—the Xiaomi 33W Power Bank ensures compatibility across Android, iOS, and other platforms. With the ability to charge up to three devices at once via the Type-C cable, Type-C port, and USB-A port, it’s a versatile solution for modern, multi-device lifestyles.

Engineered with an intelligent identification chip, the power bank automatically adapts voltage and current to each connected device for optimal charging performance. Fast recharge functionality allows the unit itself to be fully recharged at up to 30W via Type-C input, significantly reducing downtime.

Housed in a compact form factor—roughly the size of a makeup compact—the unit slips easily into a pocket or bag. Backed by comprehensive safety protocols, including temperature and overvoltage protections, the Xiaomi 33W Power Bank is as safe as it is convenient.

Designed for high-efficiency performance, mobility, and multi-device utility, this is the ultimate portable charging companion for professionals, students, and tech enthusiasts alike.

  • 33W max output with support for PD 3.0 and QC 3.0 protocols
  • Built-in Type-C cable with lanyard design for easy portability

  • Compact and travel-friendly—fits in the palm of your hand
  • Fast recharge capability up to 30W via Type-C input
  • Multiple safety features, including temperature and overcharge protection
  • Ideal for smartphones, tablets, cameras, and handheld consoles

product.description:
The Xiaomi Smart Scent Diffuser blends intelligent technology with contemporary design to elevate your space with clean, customisable fragrance and soothing ambient light. Compact and stylish in a minimalistic geometric silhouette, this smart diffuser reimagines home aromatics through seamless app control, motion detection, and whisper-quiet operation.

With manual settings and Bluetooth connectivity to the Xiaomi Home app, users can personalise up to 15 combinations of spray duration and intensity to suit any setting. Three diffusion levels are accessible via the on-device power button, while advanced app controls allow for schedule automation and real-time adjustments.

A built-in microwave motion sensor enables dynamic, on-demand fragrance dispersal—detecting nearby movement and instantly releasing a revitalising 3-second mist, ideal for transitional spaces or mood enhancement.

The integrated RGB lighting system offers stepless brightness and over 16 million colours to choose from, flickering gently like candlelight to promote relaxation, focus, or ambient charm. Battery life reaches up to 50 days (diffusion only) or approximately 6 hours with lighting enabled, making it ideal for wireless use across home and office environments.

Engineered for discretion, the diffuser operates at ≤30dB, making it virtually silent during use, perfect for bedrooms or quiet zones. A Type-C charging interface supports convenient, universal power-up.

Compact, cordless, and aesthetically versatile, the Xiaomi Smart Scent Diffuser is the ideal enhancement for wellness-driven interiors and premium lifestyle environments
