product.name: Xiaomi Handheld Steam Iron
product.description:
Effortlessly remove wrinkles and refresh garments anywhere with powerful 30kPa steam and a fast 30-second heat-up time.

Quick Specs

  • Eliminate creases quickly with a potent 30kPa steam pressure.
  • Be ready to iron in just 30 seconds thanks to rapid heating.
  • Tackle various fabrics with confidence using the safe-on-all-fabrics design.
  • Enjoy convenience with a detachable 150mL water tank for easy refilling.
  • Ensure safety with an automatic 8-minute power-off protection feature.

For the modern South African who values efficiency and presentation

The Xiaomi Handheld Garment Steamer is designed for those who demand a polished appearance without the fuss of traditional ironing. Whether you are a frequent traveller, a busy professional, or simply someone who appreciates well-kept garments, this Xiaomi iron steamer offers a swift and effective solution to wrinkles. Its compact design makes it ideal for quick touch-ups at home or for keeping your clothes looking their best while on the go. This handheld garment steamer serves as an essential tool for maintaining your wardrobe, ensuring you always step out with confidence.

Unleash the power of steam for superior wrinkle removal

At the core of this handheld garment steamer's performance is its advanced pressurisation technology, generating a powerful 30kPa of steam. This high-pressure steam penetrates deep into fabric fibres, effortlessly smoothing out even the most stubborn creases. Combined with a large ironing surface area, the Xiaomi Handheld Garment Steamer ensures efficient and thorough wrinkle removal in a single pass. Its ability to deliver continuous steam, whether used vertically for hanging garments or horizontally for more traditional ironing, offers unparalleled versatility for any travel steam iron need.

Designed for your convenience and safety

Understanding the need for speed and ease of use, this travel steam iron heats up in a mere 30 seconds, allowing you to tackle unexpected wrinkles without delay. The detachable 150mL water tank can be refilled anytime, even during use, ensuring uninterrupted ironing sessions. Xiaomi has also prioritised safety; the Xiaomi iron steamer features automatic 8-minute power-off protection, providing peace of mind. It is engineered to be safe on all fabrics, though for delicate materials like silk, using a soft cloth as a protective layer is recommended to avoid direct contact and ensure fabric integrity.

Effortless garment care for every occasion

This handheld garment steamer is your reliable partner for keeping shirts, suits, and coats looking impeccably sharp. The ceramic glaze coating on the V-shape tip ironing plate ensures smooth gliding over fabrics while providing precise control for detailing around buttons and seams. Its design supports both vertical and horizontal steaming, making it suitable for a wide range of garments and situations, from refreshing a suit jacket before a meeting to smoothing out a dress for an evening out. The 1.9m rubber power cord offers ample reach for comfortable use, solidifying its status as an essential travel steam iron.

product.name: Xiaomi Smart Camera C500 Dual (4MP, 360° PTZ, AI Detection, Night Vision)
product.description:
The Xiaomi Smart Camera C500 Dual redefines intelligent surveillance with an advanced dual-lens architecture, combining fixed wide-angle and pan-tilt-zoom (PTZ) cameras for complete 360° coverage. Equipped with dual 4MP CMOS sensors and large F1.6 aperture lenses, the camera delivers ultra-HD resolution and full-colour night vision, ensuring clarity and detail in any lighting condition. Whether you're monitoring indoor activity, checking in on pets, or safeguarding entry points, the C500 Dual offers reliable visibility and adaptive smart monitoring.

Leveraging Xiaomi’s AI-driven detection engine, the fixed camera identifies motion while the PTZ lens dynamically zooms and tracks human or pet movement in real time. Customisable virtual zones act as digital boundaries, triggering alerts upon intrusion. Pet detection (cats and dogs), crying baby recognition, and dual-screen playback further enhance situational awareness, while touch-to-focus controls via the Xiaomi Home app allow precise targeting.

The device supports dual-band Wi-Fi 6 and Bluetooth 5.3 for fast, stable connectivity, while Xiaomi HyperOS Connect enables seamless integration with other smart devices, including lights, door locks, and automation routines. With Alexa and Google Assistant compatibility, users can manage surveillance hands-free via voice commands.

Audio communication is facilitated through a built-in speaker and an independent acoustic cavity for echo-free, two-way conversations. Privacy remains paramount, supported by independent sleep modes and an embedded MJA1 security chipset with finance-grade encryption.

Efficient H.265 video compression ensures optimal storage use, with support for microSD (up to 256GB), NAS, and optional cloud storage. Flexible mounting options and cross-platform compatibility make the Xiaomi Smart Camera C500 Dual a powerful yet accessible solution for next-generation smart surveillance.

  • 4MP CMOS sensors with F1.6 large aperture

product.name: Xiaomi Vacuum Cleaner G20 Lite Filter Kit (Post-filter and 2 Pre-filters)
product.description:
The Xiaomi Vacuum Cleaner G20 Lite Filter Kit is designed to maximise the cleaning efficiency of your Xiaomi Vacuum Cleaner G20 Lite. This advanced filter kit includes a high-performance post-filter and two pre-filters, working together to ensure cleaner air and an effective cleaning experience.

The post-filter features a multi-fold composite design, which offers outstanding filtration performance. The innovative design ensures that dust and debris as small as 0.3μm are captured with up to 99.9% filtration efficiency, preventing the release of secondary pollution into your environment. Ideal for tackling fine dust and allergens, this filter helps maintain a healthier home atmosphere.

The included pre-filters play a crucial role in intercepting larger dust particles before they reach the post-filter, thereby reducing filtration pressure and enhancing the overall performance of the vacuum. This layered filtration approach improves longevity and optimises vacuum performance over time.

Both the post-filter and pre-filters are washable and reusable, offering sustainable, long-term value. Routine maintenance, including cleaning and timely replacement, ensures that your vacuum performs at its best. For optimal efficiency, it is recommended to replace the post-filter every 12 months and the pre-filters every 6 months.

Certified by Suzhou GTT Service Co., Ltd., this filter kit meets the rigorous standards of filtration, providing peace of mind and a cleaner home environment.

FEATURES:

  • Highly efficient filtration system with multi-stage filtration for cleaner air
  • 99.9% filtration efficiency for particles as small as 0.3μm
  • Folded composite post-filter design for superior filtration performance
  • Pre-filters intercept larger dust particles, reducing the load on the post-filter
  • Washable and reusable filters for sustainable, cost-effective maintenance
  • Compatible with Xiaomi Vacuum Cleaner G20 Lite, ensuring a perfect fit and optimal performance
  • Eco-friendly and long-lasting, offering both convenience and value
  • Certified performance: Tested to filter 99.9% of particulates in the 0.3–10μm range (IEC 62885-4:2020 standards)

SPECIFICATIONS:

  • Post-filter:
    • Net Weight: 88.8g
    • Dimensions: 10.6 × 10.6 × 5 cm
  • Pre-filter (each):
    • Net Weight: 12.5g
    • Dimensions: 7.9 × 7.9 × 0.9 cm
  • Filtration Efficiency: 99.9% for particles as small as 0.3μm
  • Material: Composite folded design for enhanced filtration
  • Compatibility: Xiaomi Vacuum Cleaner G20 Lite

product.name: Xiaomi Fan Heater (2000W, PTC Ceramic, 70° Oscillation)
product.description:
The Xiaomi Fan Heater delivers efficient, concentrated warmth with smart temperature control and an ultra-quiet operation, making it an ideal companion for cold mornings, focused work sessions, or personal relaxation. Engineered with a powerful 2,000W PTC ceramic heating element, this heater raises room temperatures by up to 6°C within just 10 minutes, ensuring rapid comfort when you need it most.

Designed to distribute heat evenly and quietly, the Xiaomi Fan Heater employs a centrifugal fan and micro-perforated air net to produce a fine, gentle airflow across your space. With 70° wide-angle oscillation, it ensures broad, consistent heat dispersion, reducing cold spots and enhancing ambient warmth. You can easily switch between Hot Mode for fast, powerful heating at 2000W, or Warm Mode for gentle, energy-saving warmth at 1200W, depending on your comfort needs and the room’s temperature.

Control is intuitive via dual rotary knobs, allowing precise adjustments in both temperature and output mode. The built-in thermostatic auto shut-off saves energy by switching off once the desired warmth is achieved, automatically restarting when the room cools. Its vertically elongated, compact form factor and lightweight build (approximately 2300g) make it highly portable. Designed for both tabletop and floor placement, it gels effortlessly into small to mid-sized spaces, supported by a rear carry handle for effortless repositioning.

Noise-sensitive users will appreciate its ultra-quiet operation and the absence of internal lighting, making it ideal for sleeping areas, libraries, and study nooks. Safety-first engineering ensures peace of mind with features including overheat protection, tip-over cut-off, and flame-retardant construction. A stable base further reduces the risk of accidental tipping. Simple to maintain, the unit’s soft air vent can be cleaned easily using a damp cloth, ensuring long-term reliability with minimal upkeep.

Whether you’re warming up a home office, drying winter garments, or keeping your bedside cosy, the Xiaomi Fan Heater offers a versatile, energy-smart solution for personalised comfort throughout the colder seasons.

FEATURES:

  • 2,000W high-power ceramic PTC heating
  • Rapid 6°C increase in ambient temperature within 10 minutes
  • Dual heating modes: Hot (2000W) and Warm (1200W)
  • 70° oscillation for wide-area coverage
  • Ultra-quiet fan with micro-perforated air net
  • Dual rotary knobs for mode and temperature control
  • Auto shut-off with thermostatic regulation
  • Tip-over and overheat protection with flame-retardant housing
  • Lightweight design with rear carry handle
  • No internal light – zero disturbance at night
  • Ideal for warming spaces, drying clothes (40cm clearance), or personal heating

SPECIFICATIONS:

  • Heating Element: PTC Ceramic
  • Power Output: 2,000W
  • Heating Modes: Hot Mode (2000W), Warm Mode (1200W)

  • Controls: Dual rotary knobs

product.name: Asus PRIME B840-PLUS WIFI AMD AM5 ATX Gaming Motherboard
product.description:
ASUS Prime series motherboards are expertly engineered to unleash the full potential of AMD Ryzen™ 9000 series processors. The PRIME B840-PLUS WIFI motherboard provides users and PC DIY builders with a range of performance optimizations via intuitive software and firmware features. It’s designed to be Advanced AI PC-ready, offering the power and connectivity needed for demanding AI applications.

Comprehensive memory tuning options are the cornerstone of PRIME motherboards. The PRIME B840-PLUS WIFI maximizes the potential of your DDR5 modules, from entry-level to extreme-speed kits. For entry-level modules without EXPO™ support, ASUS Enhanced Memory Profile (AEMP) automatically detects memory chips and provides optimized profiles for enhanced performance.

PRIME B840-PLUS WIFI offers a total of three M.2 slots, including two that support data-transfer speeds of up to 64Gbps via PCIe 4.0, and one that supports PCIe 3.0. This enables quicker boot-up and app load times with OS or application drives.

The PRIME B840-PLUS WIFI motherboard is engineered with multiple onboard heatsinks and an array of hybrid fan headers to help ensure your rig stays cool and stable under intense workloads. PRIME B840-PLUS WIFI features an 8+2+1 phase power design with discrete MOSFETs, ensuring efficient and stable power delivery for AMD processors plus steady performance for day-to-day use.

This motherboard offers a versatile range of connectivity, including support for Wi-Fi 6E, PCIe 4.0 slot and an arsenal of USB ports which includes Type-C® connections. Built-in Wi-Fi 6E technology takes advantage of the newly available radio spectrum in the 6 GHz band. With triple the bandwidth of the 2.4/5/6GHz band, Wi-Fi 6E delivers ultrafast wireless networking speeds with improved capacity and better performance in dense wireless environments.

Realtek 2.5 Gb Ethernet reduces CPU overhead and offers exceptionally high TCP and UDP throughput for faster, smoother data transfers. A batch of USB ports support high-end rigs loaded with peripherals, including a rear USB Type-C® connector with ultrafast USB 10Gbps for transmission speeds of up to 10Gbps.

The PRIME B840-PLUS WIFI enhances the user experience across the board, from simplifying BIOS setting adjustments to offering customizable RGB lighting controls for a uniquely personal system aesthetic.

FEATURES:

  • ATX Form Factor
  • AMD B840 Chipset
  • Supports AMD Ryzen™ 9000 & 8000 & 7000 Series Desktop Processors
  • Support for DDR5 up to 7600+MT/s, AEMP supported
  • PCIe 4.0 support for graphics cards
  • Wi-Fi 6E and 2.5Gb Ethernet support for faster data transfer
  • Aura Sync RGB Lighting

product.name: GeIL Orion RGB 16GB 6000MHz DDR5 RAM- White
product.description:
Unlock elite-tier performance and immersive aesthetics with the GeIL Orion RGB 16GB 6000MHz DDR5 RAM. Engineered for gamers, content creators, and PC enthusiasts who demand seamless multitasking and visually striking builds, the Orion V RGB series combines cutting-edge speed with synchronised RGB brilliance.

Designed to deliver lightning-fast frequencies of up to 6000MHz with tight latency timings, this high-performance DDR5 memory ensures smoother gameplay, accelerated application load times, and ultra-responsive system behaviour. Backed by Intel XMP 3.0 and AMD EXPO one-click overclocking support, optimising your rig’s memory settings is effortless and secure.

The Orion VDDR5 6000MHz Gaming RAM’s sci-fi inspired design features dual-gradient triangle patterns along its sleek aluminium heat spreaders, coupled with a honeycomb LED top-bar that diffuses customisable lighting effects. Compatible with all major motherboard RGB control platforms—including ASUS Aura Sync, MSI Mystic Light Sync, Gigabyte RGB Fusion 2.0, ASRock Polychrome, and Biostar VIVID LED DJ—you can personalise your system lighting with precision and flair.

Reliability is further reinforced with an integrated PMIC for stable power regulation and an on-die ECC mechanism for data integrity. Each module is rigorously validated using GeIL’s proprietary DYNA 4 SLT testing framework to guarantee exceptional stability across leading DDR5 platforms. Built for aesthetics. Designed for performance and tailored for creators and gamers.

product.name: MSI GeForce RTX 5070 12GB VENTUS 3X OC Graphics Card - PCIe 5.0
product.description:
Take your gameplay and creative workflows to the next level with the MSI GeForce RTX 5070 12GB VENTUS 3X OC Graphics Card – PCIe 5.0. Engineered for high-end performance, this graphics card is powered by NVIDIA’s advanced RTX™ 5070 GPU, delivering an exceptional blend of speed, efficiency, and realism.

Equipped with 12GB of ultra-fast GDDR7 memory running at 28 Gbps, the MSI GeForce RTX 5070 handles intensive gaming environments and demanding creative applications with ease. Whether you’re rendering high-resolution content, editing videos in real-time, or exploring immersive virtual worlds, you can trust its 6144 CUDA cores and 192-bit memory bus to deliver consistently smooth and powerful performance.

Thermal efficiency is a core strength of the MSI GeForce RTX 5070. The VENTUS 3X thermal design incorporates three TORX FAN 5.0 units, working alongside a nickel-plated copper baseplate and precision-machined Core Pipes to maintain optimal operating temperatures. The Zero Frozr technology ensures silent operation during low-load conditions, ideal for both late-night gaming sessions and studio environments.

Enhanced durability is provided by a robust flow-through backplate and built-in fuses for electrical protection. With support for PCIe Gen 5, DisplayPort 2.1b, and HDMI 2.1b outputs, users can drive up to four displays at resolutions up to 8K, making this card a future-ready solution for multi-monitor productivity and ultra-high-definition gaming.

Designed to meet the needs of serious gamers and creators alike, the MSI GeForce RTX 5070 12GB VENTUS 3X OC Graphics Card – PCIe 5.0 delivers a compelling combination of power, thermal mastery, and next-gen connectivity. Unlock your creative potential and dominate your favourite titles with confidence.

  • Powered by NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 for next-gen gaming and creative performance
  • 12GB of ultra-fast GDDR7 memory for high-resolution rendering and multitasking
  • Triple TORX FAN 5.0 cooling for maximum airflow and heat dissipation
  • Nickel-plated copper baseplate for efficient GPU and memory heat transfer

product.name: Cudy BE3600 Gigabit Wi-Fi 7 Router (WR3600)
product.description:
The Cudy BE3600 Gigabit Wi-Fi 7 Router marks a bold leap into the future of wireless networking. Engineered for modern digital demands, this high-performance router delivers blazing-fast speeds, unparalleled device capacity, and next-gen efficiency—all within a sleek, dual-purpose form factor suitable for both desktop and wall-mounted installations.

Harnessing the power of Wi-Fi 7 (802.11be), the Cudy BE3600 Gigabit Wi-Fi 7 Router pushes throughput up to 3570 Mbps, powered by advanced features like Multi-Link Operation (MLO), 160 MHz channel width, and 4K-QAM modulation. Whether streaming in 4K, dominating online multiplayer games, or managing a fully connected smart home, the Cudy BE3600 Gigabit Wi-Fi 7 Router ensures low latency, consistent bandwidth, and rock-solid connectivity.

At its core is a robust 2.0 GHz quad-core Broadcom ARM Cortex-A7 CPU, paired with 512 MB RAM and 128 MB flash memory, providing the muscle needed for simultaneous high-load tasks. With support for up to 512 devices, it's built for the bandwidth-hungry home or office.

The Cudy BE3600 Gigabit Wi-Fi 7 Router also goes beyond performance. It’s a comprehensive network management hub with QoS, guest networks, VPN server/client options, and powerful parental controls. Advanced diagnostics, secure remote access, and compatibility with leading DNS providers give you full control from anywhere.

In short, this is not just another wireless router. The Cudy BE3600 Gigabit Wi-Fi 7 Router is your home’s digital command centre—future-ready, gamer-approved, and streaming-optimised.

product.name: PXN V9 Gen 2 Gaming Steering Wheel
product.description:
Experience the adrenaline of professional racing with the PXN V9 Gen 2 Gaming Steering Wheel, a powerhouse sim racing solution designed for gamers seeking authentic driving precision, responsiveness, and immersive feedback. Engineered with dual-motor adaptive vibration and an advanced 16-bit magnetic encoder, the V9 Gen 2 captures every drift, bump, and turn with remarkable accuracy, ensuring you feel every nuance of the track. Whether you're engaging in high-speed circuits, rally sprints, or casual arcade racing, the V9 Gen 2 enhances your performance with seamless control and realism.

The PXN V9 Gen 2 offers physical switching between 270° and 900° steering rotation, allowing you to customise the handling based on the game or simulation. At 900°, the wheel replicates a full 2.5-turn range, accurately reflecting the behavior of real-world steering systems. The 16-bit magnetic encoder ensures ultra-precise wheel movement recognition, while the dual vibration motors dynamically adjust vibration strength in real-time, replicating vehicle feedback, road textures, and cornering forces with exceptional clarity.

Immerse yourself in race-day aesthetics and comfort with the V9 Gen 2's 28cm professional-grade wheel, wrapped in soft-touch TPU rubber grips for a secure, sweat-resistant hold during long racing sessions. The Formula-style paddle shifters, made from durable ABS material, provide smooth and responsive gear changes, offering that authentic racing feel at your fingertips. Adding a touch of futuristic flair, dual RGB light bars on either side of the wheel provide real-time visual feedback of throttle and brake pressure, enhancing immersion while elevating your gaming setup’s aesthetics.

The included hall magnetic linear pedal set delivers superior responsiveness by detecting precise pressure variations for lifelike throttle, brake, and clutch input. A folding textured surface and anti-slip base keep the pedal set firmly in place, providing a stable platform even during aggressive racing maneuvers. With plug-and-play USB connectivity, the PXN V9 Gen 2 is compatible with a wide range of platforms (refer to supported systems), ensuring seamless integration with your favorite racing titles across PC and consoles.

product.name: PXN F16 Flight Joystick for PC
product.description:
Immerse yourself in the thrill of realistic flight simulation with the PXN F16 Flight Joystick for PC. Designed for aspiring pilots and serious flight sim enthusiasts, the PXN F16 delivers a hands-on flying experience with intuitive control features and a comfortable, ergonomic design. From high-speed dogfights to precision landings, this joystick gives you full control of the skies with its manual throttle valve, programmable buttons, and precision linear potentiometer, ensuring smooth and accurate input every time.

Experience the sky like never before with dual vibration feedback, enhancing in-game realism with tactile responses to gunfire, turbulence, and aerial manoeuvres. The vibration strength can be customised through driver settings (recommended at 50% or higher for optimal effect) and toggled easily using the switch located on the joystick’s base. Paired with a rapid-fire trigger, 12 programmable buttons, and 4-axis directional control, the PXN F16 gives you lightning-fast responsiveness and versatile configuration for combat and civil flight sims alike.

Featuring an 8-way hat switch, the PXN F16 is ideal for camera control and quick directional inputs, while the onboard software allows for custom key mapping to suit any style of flying. Compatible with a broad range of flight titles—including Microsoft Flight Simulator, DCS World, War Thunder, X-Plane 11, FSX, Ace Combat, and more. Now you can tailor your setup for training missions, dogfights, or long-haul commercial flights. (Please Note: Not compatible with Windows 10, Windows 10 Home, or macOS)

Crafted for comfort and durability, the PXN F16 features a stable, weighted base with anti-slip silicone pads to keep your joystick firmly planted during intense gameplay. Its ergonomic grip and single-handed operation design make it ideal for long flying sessions, offering fatigue-free performance and tactile precision. With USB wired connectivity, plug-and-play ease, and advanced calibration support, this joystick is your ultimate co-pilot for immersive PC flight simulation.

product.description:
Take full control of your sim racing environment with the PXN CB1 Control Button Box, a feature-rich peripheral designed to enhance immersion and realism for simulation enthusiasts. With 30 fully programmable buttons, this versatile control unit lets you map a wide array of in-game functions—from wipers and turn signals to cruise control and engine start—allowing for a personalised driving experience that mirrors real-world performance. Whether you're a competitive sim racer or an enthusiast building the perfect cockpit, the CB1 offers functionality, flair, and responsiveness all in one compact, high-performance device.

Stand out on the track and set the tone for your race with 7 built-in lighting effects, easily switchable via the integrated rotary knob. When connected to a compatible wheelbase, the PXN CB1 allows for extended colour customisation through an interactive colour palette, giving you full control over both lighting colour and brightness. Constructed from high-quality ABS resin and processed through over ten refinement procedures, the PXN CB1 offers exceptional mechanical strength, low-temperature resistance, and wear durability, making it a long-lasting addition to your racing rig. The metal contact points ensure superb electrical conductivity and tactile feedback, while the highlight feature—the Linkage Lever Button system—delivers realistic operation with Engine Power On/Off functionality, simulating the actual sequence of powering up a race car. The combination of the engine toggle lever and one-button ignition brings an unmatched sense of realism to every session.

The PXN CB1 is plug-and-play compatible with PC, requiring no additional drivers for setup. With a sleek black finish and durable 14.2kg build, the PXN A9 stand is engineered for long-lasting performance and realistic racing simulation. Take control of the skies and elevate your flight simulation experience with the PXN 2119 PRO Flight Simulator Joystick, a high-performance, immersive control system designed for aviation enthusiasts and gamers alike. This professional-grade joystick offers realistic handling, enhanced precision, and customizability, giving you an authentic cockpit feel right from your gaming setup. Whether you're engaging in a casual flight or managing complex simulation software, the PXN 2119 PRO delivers the control and responsiveness you need for smooth virtual piloting.

Engineered to simulate real-world aviation, the PXN 2119 PRO features a progressive throttle with adjustable resistance, letting you fine-tune the engine output with smooth, deliberate motion. A tension dial enables you to set the throttle stiffness to your liking, mimicking the feel of real aeroplane thrust levers. The twisting rudder control built into the 4-way axis enhances manoeuvrability by allowing for precision turns and directional control. An 8-way hat switch adds an extra layer of accuracy for in-flight navigation or camera adjustments, perfect for both civilian and military simulations.

Tailor your gameplay with custom key mapping by programming up to 16 buttons, providing a highly personalised control layout for your favourite games and simulation software. Easily toggle between modes using the dedicated MODE button, which allows seamless switching between keyboard and mouse emulation for total flexibility. The PXN 2119 PRO is fully compatible with PC (Windows 7/8/10/11), making it an ideal choice for PC gamers who want a versatile gaming joystick without compromise.

Feel every turbulence, gunfire, and landing with the dual-motor vibration system, which provides dynamic feedback for an incredibly immersive experience. The rapid-fire trigger ensures quick responsiveness in critical situations, while the simulated dual-wing design offers a stylish and ergonomic structure that fits naturally in your hands during extended gaming sessions. product.name: Asus PRIME B760M-A WIFI Intel LGA1700 M-ATX Motherboard
product.description:
ASUS Prime series motherboards are expertly engineered to unleash the full potential of 13th Gen Intel® Core™ Processors. Boasting a robust power design, comprehensive cooling solutions and intelligent tuning options, PRIME B760M-A WIFI provides users and PC DIY builders with a range of performance optimizations via intuitive software and firmware features.

Comprehensive controls form the foundation of the ASUS PRIME series. The PRIME B760 motherboard packs flexible tools to tune every aspect of your system, enabling performance tweaks to perfectly match the way you work to maximize productivity.

ASUS Intelligent Control makes your PC smart. Along with taking care of complex tuning and dynamically optimizing essential aspects of your system, it offers intelligently simplified options for newcomers to PC DIY, as well as more comprehensive features for seasoned veterans. PRIME B760 series are engineered with multiple onboard heatsinks and an array of hybrid fan headers to ensure your rig stays cool and stable under intense workloads.

M.2 heatsink wards off throttling that can occur with M.2 storage during sustained transfers. The heatsink is held in place by captive screws, and these removable captive screws help reduce risk of drops or loss during heatsink removal. VRM heatsinks and thermal pads improve heat transfer from the MOSFETs and chocks for better cooling performance.

PRIME B760 series features comprehensive cooling controls that are configurable via Fan Xpert 2+ software or via the UEFI BIOS. Each header can dynamically reference three thermal sensors. Fan Xpert 2+ allows you to map the temperature of supported ASUS graphics cards to optimize cooling for GPU- and CPU-intensive tasks.

The PRIME B760 series are built to handle the high core counts and bandwidth demands of 13th Gen Intel® Core™ Processors. ASUS B760 motherboard provides all the fundamentals to boost daily productivity, so your system will be ready for action with stable power, intuitive cooling and flexible data transfer options. Stable power is essential to extract every last bit of performance out of Intel® processors. The PRIME B760M-A WIFI is geared to cater to the demands of these high-core-count CPUs.

product.name: Asus PRIME B860M-K Intel LGA1851 M-ATX Motherboard
product.description:
ASUS PRIME series motherboards are expertly engineered to unleash the full potential of the latest Intel® Core™ Ultra Processors (Series 2). Boasting a robust power design, comprehensive cooling solutions and intelligent tuning options, the PRIME B860M-K motherboard provides users and PC DIY builders with a range of performance optimizations via intuitive software and firmware features. It’s designed to be Advanced AI PC-ready, offering the power and connectivity needed for demanding AI applications.

Stable power is crucial for maximizing the performance of Intel® Core™ Ultra Processors (Series 2).The PRIME B860M-K features an 6+1+1+1 phase design with discrete MOSFETs, ensuring efficient and stable power delivery for Intel® processors plus steady performance for day-to-day use.

ASUS Enhanced Memory Profile III (AEMP III) is an advanced firmware feature that empowers users to achieve unparalleled memory performance with cutting-edge CUDIMM memory. Through a two-phase comprehensive tuning process, AEMP III first optimizes the clock driver and then the memory frequency. This results in the best balance between performance and stability, even at cutting-edge speeds of DDR5-7600 or higher.

PRIME B860M-K offers a total of two M.2 slots, including one that supports data-transfer speeds of up to 128Gbps via PCIe 5.0, one that supports 64Gbps via PCIe 4.0. This enables quicker boot-up and app load times with OS or application drives.

The PRIME B860M-K motherboard is engineered with multiple onboard heatsinks and an array of hybrid fan headers to help ensure your rig stays cool and stable under intense workloads. This motherboard offers a versatile range of connectivity, including support for PCIe 5.0 M.2, PCIe 4.0 slot and an arsenal of USB ports which includes Type-C® connection.

Realtek 2.5Gb Ethernet reduces CPU overhead and offers exceptionally high TCP and UDP throughput for faster, smoother data transfers. A batch of USB ports support high-end rigs loaded with peripherals, including a front USB Type-C® connector with ultrafast USB 5Gbps for transmission speeds of up to 5Gbps.

The PRIME B860M-K enhances the user experience across the board, from simplifying BIOS setting adjustments to offering customizable RGB lighting controls for a uniquely personal system aesthetic. The PRIME B860M-K motherboard features EZ PC DIY innovations that simplify and speed up the PC building process, making DIY easy and convenient.

  • PCIe 4.0 support for graphics cards

product.name: ASRock Radeon RX9070 XT Taichi 16G OC Graphics Card
product.description:
The ASRock AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT Taichi 16GB OC is a high-performance graphics card designed for enthusiasts who demand both cutting-edge power and premium aesthetics. Built on AMD’s RDNA™ 4 architecture, it delivers next-level gaming performance with 64 compute units, hardware-accelerated ray tracing, and AI-driven optimizations. The boost clock reaches up to 3100MHz, ensuring ultra-smooth frame rates and stunning visuals for 4K gaming and content creation. Equipped with 16GB of GDDR6 memory on a 256-bit bus, this GPU is built to handle the most demanding workloads and high-resolution gaming experiences.

The Taichi 3X Cooling System ensures superior thermal efficiency, utilizing three advanced fans to maximize airflow. The centre fan spins in reverse to reduce turbulence and enhance heat dissipation, while ASRock’s Striped Ring Fan design increases lateral air intake for improved cooling performance. V-shaped cutting fins and air vents guide airflow efficiently, reducing heat buildup and keeping temperatures low even under heavy loads. Additionally, intelligent fan control ensures silent operation when temperatures are low, automatically adjusting for optimal cooling when needed.

Heat management is further enhanced with a premium copper base heatsink, which maximizes direct contact with the GPU for efficient thermal transfer. The consolidated heat pipes and high-quality thermal pads effectively distribute heat, preventing hotspots and maintaining stable performance. ASRock’s precision screw torque assembly optimizes cooler mounting pressure, balancing thermal efficiency and component safety to extend the lifespan of the GPU. A reinforced metal backplate not only strengthens the structure to prevent PCB bending but also enhances cooling with strategically placed thermal pads and vents.

Aesthetically, the Taichi RX 9070 XT stands out with its integrated ARGB lighting, offering customizable and synchronized illumination through Polychrome SYNC. Users can further expand their lighting setup with an ARGB pin-header, connecting additional RGB strips and devices for a fully immersive build. With PCIe 5.0 support, high-speed DisplayPort 2.1a and HDMI 2.1b connectivity, and an 850W recommended PSU, this powerhouse GPU is ready to push the limits of gaming, streaming, and content creation with exceptional performance and style.

The ASUS Prime Radeon™ RX 9070 XT OC Edition 16GB GDDR6 graphics card is designed to deliver primal performance, combining advanced cooling, high-speed memory, and robust construction for gaming and content creation.

Featuring a 2.5-slot design, this card is optimized for efficient heat dissipation, with a layout that allows the triple Axial-tech fans to leverage chassis side-panel ventilation. The dual-ball bearing fans ensure durability and longevity, while 0dB cooling technology allows the fans to stop when GPU temperatures drop below 55°C, providing silent operation for lighter workloads.

For extreme performance, the sturdy metal vented backplate enhances airflow, reducing thermal strain and preventing overheating. A phase-change GPU thermal pad further improves heat transfer, ensuring stable operation under intense workloads.

Equipped with 16GB of GDDR6 VRAM, a 256-bit memory interface, and 20Gbps memory speed, the RX 9070 XT OC Edition is built for ultra-high resolutions and smooth gameplay. Powered by PCI Express® 5.0, it delivers blazing-fast bandwidth, while support for HDMI 2.1b and DisplayPort 2.1a allows for high-refresh-rate gaming at 4K and beyond.

Users can choose between Performance Mode for lower temperatures and Quiet Mode for reduced noise levels without compromising performance. ASUS Auto-Extreme Technology ensures a precision-engineered build, improving reliability while reducing environmental impact.

The ASUS Prime Radeon™ RX 9070 XT OC Edition is a powerhouse designed for next-level gaming, streaming, and content creation.

FEATURES:

  • 16GB GDDR6
  • 20Gbps Memory Speed
  • 256-bit Memory Interface
  • Triple Axial-Tech Fans
  • Sturdy Metal Vented Backplate
  • 2.5 Slot Design
  • 0dB Cooling Technology

product.name: Port Designs Portland II Eco 14/16" Backpack
product.description:
The Port Designs Portland II Eco 14/16" Backpack is the ideal everyday companion for professionals, students, and urban commuters seeking a blend of functionality, comfort, and eco-conscious design. Lightweight yet robust, this backpack is built to withstand daily wear while ensuring that your valuable devices and personal items stay secure. Its fully padded structure and quilted shoulder straps provide all-day carrying comfort, making it perfect for long commutes, business travel, or back-to-back classes. The sleek and compact design ensures that it complements a modern lifestyle without unnecessary bulk.

In line with contemporary sustainability values, the Portland II Eco is crafted from recycled and recyclable r-PET materials, offering a reduced carbon footprint without sacrificing durability or aesthetic appeal. Both the exterior 600D polyester and interior 210D r-PET linings are responsibly sourced, making this backpack a smart and stylish choice for environmentally conscious users. By selecting the Portland II Eco, you’re choosing a product that supports the planet without compromising on the features or protection you expect from a premium laptop backpack.

Functionality is at the heart of the Portland II Eco's design. It features a dedicated quilted laptop compartment that fits devices up to 16" (38.5 x 26 x 3.5 cm), offering reliable protection from shocks and scratches. A spacious 10L main compartment accommodates your documents, notebooks, and personal essentials with ease. For added convenience, a large zipped front pocket keeps frequently used items like chargers, smartphones, or stationery within easy reach. Every section of the bag is thoughtfully designed for practicality, helping you stay organised and efficient throughout your day.

Elegantly finished with refined royal blue detailing, the backpack strikes a balance between style and substance. The ergonomically padded back panel and adjustable straps enhance airflow and reduce strain, ensuring a comfortable fit during long periods of use. Whether you’re heading to the office, school, or airport, the Portland II Eco is engineered to deliver on both performance and sustainability. Backed by a lifetime limited warranty, this backpack is not only a smart investment for your tech and documents, but also for the environment.

product.name: Asus TUF Gaming Z890-PLUS WIFI Intel LGA1851 ATX Gaming Motherboard
product.description:
The ASUS TUF GAMING Z890-PLUS WIFI takes all the essential elements of the latest Intel® Core™ Ultra Processors (Series 2) processors and combines them with game-ready features and proven durability. Engineered with military-grade components, an upgraded power solution and a comprehensive cooling system, this motherboard goes beyond expectations with rock-solid and stable performance for marathon gaming. TUF GAMING motherboards also undergo rigorous endurance testing to ensure that they can handle conditions where others may fail. This platform delivers the power and connectivity that advanced AI PC applications demand.

Stable power is crucial for maximizing the performance of Intel processors. The motherboard is designed to meet the needs of high-core-count CPUs. It features 16(80A) + 1(80A) + 2(80A) + 1(80A) power stages that integrate high-side and low-side MOSFETs and drivers into packages rated for up to 80A each. This configuration ensures optimal power delivery, efficiency, stability and performance for both current and future Intel processors.

ASUS Enhanced Memory Profile III (AEMP III) is an advanced firmware feature that empowers users to achieve unparalleled memory performance with cutting-edge CUDIMM memory. Through a two-phase comprehensive tuning process, AEMP III first optimizes the clock driver and then the memory frequency.

This motherboard offers a versatile range of connectivity with PCIe 5.0, Thunderbolt™ 4 and front USB 20Gbps Type-C® connectors. PCIe 5.0 offers twice the data transfer speed of PCIe 4.0, making it robust enough to handle new data-heavy tasks. PCIe 5.0 also brings other benefits, such as electrical changes to improve signal integrity, backward-compatible CEM connectors for add-in cards and backward compatibility with previous versions of the PCIe bus.

Each port delivers up to 40Gbps of bi-directional bandwidth for the latest super-speed devices and drives. Both ports can be employed for up to two external 4K displays. This motherboard features a USB 20Gbps Type-C® front panel connector for speedy data transfers of up to 20Gbps. A physical button unlocks the first PCIe slot’s security latch with one tap, greatly simplifying the process of detaching a PCIe card from the motherboard when it’s time to upgrade to a new GPU or other compatible device.

This motherboard utilizes an audio codec designed in close collaboration with Realtek — the Realtek ALC1220P. It features an unprecedented 120 dB signal-to-noise (SNR) ratio for the stereo line out and a 113 dB SNR for the line in, providing pristine audio quality. Additionally, an impedance-sensing circuit automatically adjusts gain to ensure an optimal volume range for your headphones.

FEATURES:

  • Intel® Z890 Chipset
  • ATX Form Factor
  • Support for DDR5 up to 9066+MT/s, AEMPIII
  • PCIe 5.0 support for graphics cards (with Intel Ultra CPUs)
  • Rear Thunderbolt™ 4 support and front USB 20Gbps Type-C support
  • WiFi 7 and 2.5Gb Ethernet support for faster data transfer
  • PCIe Slot Q-release, Q-Antenna, M.2 Q-Latch, Q-LED and BIOS Flashback buttons for convenience
  • Pre-mounted I/O shield to protect your ports
  • Full RGB lighting control with Asus Aura Sync support

  • Socket: Intel Socket LGA1851
  • CPU: Supports Intel® Core™ Ultra Processors (Series 2) Desktop Processors
  • Chipset: Intel® Z890 Chipset

product.name: Giada VM23 Media Player – Fanless 4K Digital Signage Solution
product.description:
The Giada VM23 is a purpose-built compact digital signage media player engineered for high-reliability, energy-efficient performance in space-constrained environments. Powered by Intel® Apollo Lake Celeron® N3350/N3450 processors, this fanless player delivers consistent, low-power computing designed to meet the evolving needs of digital signage, kiosk, and thin client applications.

Designed for commercial deployments where silent operation and robust 24/7 performance are essential, the VM23 features a passive cooling system that enhances operational longevity and eliminates mechanical noise, making it ideal for use in retail, hospitality, education, and corporate display environments.

Despite its ultra-compact footprint, the VM23 supports dual independent displays via HDMI 1.4a and DisplayPort 1.2, enabling vivid 4K media playback and dynamic content delivery. Its support for up to 64GB of onboard eMMC storage and mSATA expansion through a full-size Mini-PCIe slot ensures deployment flexibility across diverse digital environments.

Engineered for seamless integration, this media player is compatible with both Windows 10 (64-bit) and Ubuntu Linux (64-bit), allowing for streamlined software deployment across platforms. Furthermore, its compliance with CE, FCC Class B, and UKCA certifications positions it as a trusted solution in mission-critical installations.

With its compact size, wide operating temperature range, and solid-state reliability, the Giada VM23 empowers integrators and solution providers to deliver cost-effective, scalable signage experiences with minimal maintenance.

FEATURES:

  • Fanless, ultra-compact design: Ideal for silent operation in space-constrained digital signage and embedded deployments
  • Dual display support: Simultaneously drives two independent 4K displays via HDMI 1.4a and DisplayPort 1.2
  • Energy-efficient Intel® Apollo Lake processors: Powered by Celeron® N3350 or N3450 with low 6W TDP for 24/7 stability
  • Flexible storage options: Integrated 32GB/64GB eMMC and Mini-PCIe slot supporting mSATA SSD expansion
  • Wide OS compatibility: Supports Windows 10 (64-bit) and Ubuntu Linux (64-bit) for flexible deployment
  • High reliability: Solid-state design with passive cooling ensures long-term durability and reduced failure risk
  • Industrial-grade construction: Robust housing and certified for CE, FCC Class B, and UKCA standards
  • Compact footprint: Measures only 116.6 mm x 107.4 mm x 30 mm for easy integration into kiosks, behind displays, or inside enclosures
  • High-performance graphics: Intel® HD Graphics 500 enables fluid 4K video playback and responsive content rendering
  • Low power consumption: Suitable for energy-conscious installations with minimal thermal output

  • CPU
  • Frequency: 2.40 GHz
  • Chipset: SoC
  • Processing Units: 2 Cores

product.name: Antec CSK1000 PRO ATX3.1 Semi-Modular 1000W Power Supply (80 PLUS Bronze, PCIe 5.1, ATX 3.1 Certified)
product.description:
The Antec CSK1000 PRO ATX3.1 is more than a power supply. It’s the electrical backbone of your high-performance PC, engineered with precision to support next-generation systems with unwavering reliability and operational efficiency. Drawing from Antec’s legacy of innovation, trusted by builders and gamers alike, the Antec CSK1000 PRO is designed to handle the demands of modern computing environments with intelligence, versatility, and confidence.

At its core lies a 1000W continuous power output, certified under 80 PLUS® Bronze standards to deliver up to 90% efficiency under typical loads. This translates into reduced energy consumption, lower thermal output, and ultimately, a more stable platform for your most intensive tasks—whether you're rendering large-scale assets, deep into a gaming session, or running demanding productivity suites.

The CSK1000 PRO is fully ATX 3.1 certified, meeting the latest Intel power delivery specifications. It also introduces support for PCIe 5.1, with a dedicated 12V-2x6 connector (capable of delivering up to 600W) designed to power the newest generation of graphics cards, including the NVIDIA® GeForce RTX™ 40 Series. This forward-compatible approach makes it an ideal choice for users building today with tomorrow in mind.

The semi-modular layout gives you the flexibility to customise cable routing based on your build, improving airflow and minimising clutter. Pre-attached essential cables reduce setup time, while detachable connectors provide additional configuration freedom. The result is a cleaner, more breathable system interior, particularly valuable for airflow-optimised cases and minimalist builds.

Engineered for silence as much as performance, the Antec CSK1000 PRO features a 120mm silent fan governed by Antec’s proprietary Thermal Manager system. This intelligent fan control algorithm adjusts speed in real-time based on system load and temperature, delivering the cooling you need without excessive noise, perfect for both high-performance gaming environments and creative workstations where acoustic balance is key.

Underpinning it all is CircuitShield™, Antec’s comprehensive suite of industrial-grade protections. From Over Voltage Protection (OVP) and Over Temperature Protection (OTP) to Short Circuit and Surge Protection (SCP and SIP), the Antec CSK1000 PRO actively defends both itself and your system components against irregularities and power anomalies.

Compact in size yet robust in output, the 140mm chassis ensures compatibility with a wide range of enclosures, giving builders the freedom to design without compromise. Every detail—from the clean cable layout to the reinforced components—is a reflection of Antec’s commitment to quality, dependability, and purposeful engineering.

For those seeking a PSU that matches technical excellence with system-level harmony, the Antec CSK1000 PRO ATX3.1 is a power solution you can build around, with assurance.

FEATURES

  • 1000W continuous power delivery with high-load stability
  • Certified ATX 3.1 for modern power requirements and power excursion management
  • PCIe 5.1 ready with 12V-2x6 (600W) connector for latest GPU standards
  • 80 PLUS® Bronze Certified (up to 90% efficiency at typical loads)

product.name: MSI GeForce RTX 5070 SHADOW 2X OC 12GB Graphics Card
product.description:
The MSI GeForce RTX 5070 SHADOW 2X OC 12GB is a performance-driven GPU designed for gamers seeking a powerful yet compact solution. Powered by NVIDIA’s Blackwell architecture and DLSS 4, it delivers high frame rates, AI-enhanced visuals, and smooth 4K gameplay. With a stealthy black aesthetic, the SHADOW 2X OC is an excellent choice for those looking to upgrade or build a high-performance gaming rig without sacrificing space or efficiency.

Equipped with TORX Fan 5.0 technology, the SHADOW 2X OC features an optimized dual-fan cooling system designed to maximize airflow and minimize noise. The ring arc structure links three sets of fan blades, enhancing air pressure and increasing airflow by 23% compared to traditional axial fans. These innovations work in tandem with a large heatsink, ensuring optimal cooling performance while maintaining a quieter gaming experience, even under heavy workloads.

For efficient heat dissipation, the SHADOW 2X OC is built with Core Pipes featuring a square contact design, maximizing heat transfer from the nickel-plated copper baseplate to the extended heatsink array. This ensures lower temperatures and sustained peak performance. The reinforcing backplate not only adds structural durability but also features an airflow vent, allowing hot air to pass through efficiently, further improving thermal regulation.

Designed as an SFF-Ready Enthusiast GeForce card, the SHADOW 2X OC fits seamlessly into compact PC builds while delivering desktop-class gaming power. With 12GB of GDDR7 memory, a 192-bit memory bus, and 6144 CUDA cores, this PCIe Gen 5 graphics card is ready for high-resolution gaming, content creation, and demanding AI tasks. Supporting DisplayPort 2.1b and HDMI 2.1b, it enables smooth, next-gen visuals at up to 8K resolution. For those looking for uncompromising performance in a sleek black design, the MSI RTX 5070 SHADOW 2X OC is an ideal choice.

product.name: MSI GeForce RTX 5070 INSPIRE 3X OC 12GB Graphics Card
product.description:
The MSI GeForce RTX 5070 INSPIRE 3X OC 12GB is a refined fusion of compact design and cutting-edge performance, ideal for creative professionals and gaming enthusiasts alike. Powered by NVIDIA’s Blackwell architecture and DLSS 4, it delivers exceptional rendering speeds, AI-enhanced visuals, and seamless multitasking. With a sleek Mondrian-inspired grid design, this GPU isn’t just a powerhouse—it’s a statement piece that elevates both aesthetics and productivity.

Designed for small form factor (SFF) builds, the INSPIRE 3X OC balances efficiency and high performance in a space-conscious footprint. Its triple-fan cooling system, enhanced by STORMFORCE fans, ensures optimal thermal management with minimal noise. The fans feature seven blades, claw texturing, and a circular arc, which work together to concentrate airflow, reduce turbulence, and maximize cooling efficiency. The zero-RPM fan mode allows for silent operation when temperatures are low, automatically reactivating when additional cooling is needed.

The advanced thermal system includes Core Pipes with a square contact area, ensuring maximum heat transfer from the GPU baseplate to the large heatsink array. A nickel-plated copper baseplate rapidly captures and disperses heat, while Wave-Curved 3.0 and Air Antegrade Fin technologies fine-tune airflow for faster heat dissipation and enhanced stability. These innovations help maintain low temperatures, peak performance, and quiet operation, making the INSPIRE 3X OC an excellent choice for demanding creative workloads and high-resolution gaming.

Structural integrity is reinforced by a sturdy metal backplate with integrated airflow vents, which reduces heat buildup while adding durability. With 12GB of GDDR7 memory, a 192-bit memory bus, and 6144 CUDA cores, this PCIe Gen 5 powerhouse is built for fluid 4K gaming, professional content creation, and AI-driven workflows. Supporting DisplayPort 2.1b and HDMI 2.1b, it enables next-gen visuals at up to 8K resolution. Finished in a striking gold colour, the RTX 5070 INSPIRE 3X OC delivers exceptional performance, premium aesthetics, and uncompromising efficiency for modern PC builds.

product.name: MSI B850 GAMING PLUS WIFI AM5 ATX Gaming Motherboard
product.description:
The B850 GAMING PLUS WIFI is crafted to offer extensive connectivity, versatile tools, and a premium Wi-Fi solution for gamers seeking a comprehensive experience. Featuring full-speed Wi-Fi 7, 5G LAN, PCIe 5.0 solution, Supplemental PCIe Power and exclusive EZ DIY features, it is ready for 24/7 non-stop gaming optimized for AMD Ryzen™ 9000 series processors.

MSI motherboards are designed with advanced hardware and technology, well-supporting the demanding computing usage of gaming and AI. Moreover, we also introduce AI to MSI Center and BIOS, making everything more effortless than before.

MSI's exclusive EZ M.2 Shield Frozr II and EZ CLIP II make M.2 installations seamless. Insert the SSD card into the slot and press it down to lock it in place with the clip. As you fasten the SSD, flick the clip outwards and then the SSD is removed. The process is smooth, and you don't need to use your tools like before. One finger can give you the perfect DIY experience.

The new EZ PCIe Clip II, located on the first slot, features the rebounding force mechanism that allows for easy removal of the graphics card by pressing the tail-like lock with one finger. Due to this exquisite design, users can uninstall the graphics cards effortlessly, even in the cramped case spaces.

The Pre-Installed I/O Shield offers a streamlined and hassle-free installation experience by eliminating the need to manually fit the I/O shield during motherboard setup. With its built-in design, it ensures proper alignment and a secure fit, providing both protection and convenience while enhancing the overall durability of your build. The MSI EZ Antenna makes the process effortless by simply attaching fasteners to the motherboard without rotation.

A huge step of DDR performance enhancement with the latest DDR5 memory. Combines with dedicated SMT welding process and MSI Memory Boost technology, B850 GAMING PLUS WIFI is ready to deliver the world class memory performance.

MSI motherboards prioritize safety with the embedded Overcurrent Protection (OCP), ensuring crucial components such as the USB ports, DDR memory, PWM IC, and CPU are shielded from excessive current. This proactive defense mechanism curtails the risk of damage or malfunction due to power surges, promoting long-term system stability. This commitment to safeguarding your hardware underscores MSI's dedication to producing motherboards that prioritize durability and stability.

product.name: MSI B840 GAMING PLUS WIFI AM5 ATX Gaming Motherboard
product.description:
The B840 GAMING PLUS WIFI is crafted to offer extensive connectivity, versatile tools, and a premium Wi-Fi solution for gamers seeking a comprehensive experience. Featuring full-speed Wi-Fi 7, 2.5G LAN, PCIe 4.0 solution and exclusive EZ DIY features, it is ready for 24/7 non-stop gaming optimized for AMD Ryzen™ 9000 series processors.

MSI motherboards are designed with advanced hardware and technology, well-supporting the demanding computing usage of gaming and AI. Moreover, we also introduce AI to MSI Center and BIOS, making everything more effortless than before.

MSI's exclusive EZ M.2 Shield Frozr II and EZ CLIP II make M.2 installations seamless. Insert the SSD card into the slot and press it down to lock it in place with the clip. As you fasten the SSD, flick the clip outwards and then the SSD is removed. The process is smooth, and you don't need to use your tools like before. One finger can give you the perfect DIY experience.

The new EZ PCIe Clip II, located on the first slot, features the rebounding force mechanism that allows for easy removal of the graphics card by pressing the tail-like lock with one finger. Due to this exquisite design, users can uninstall the graphics cards effortlessly, even in the cramped case spaces.

The Pre-Installed I/O Shield offers a streamlined and hassle-free installation experience by eliminating the need to manually fit the I/O shield during motherboard setup. With its built-in design, it ensures proper alignment and a secure fit, providing both protection and convenience while enhancing the overall durability of your build. The MSI EZ Antenna makes the process effortless by simply attaching fasteners to the motherboard without rotation.

A huge step of DDR performance enhancement with the latest DDR5 memory. Combines with dedicated SMT welding process and MSI Memory Boost technology, B840 GAMING PLUS WIFI is ready to deliver the world class memory performance.

MSI motherboards prioritize safety with the embedded Overcurrent Protection (OCP), ensuring crucial components such as the USB ports, DDR memory, PWM IC, and CPU are shielded from excessive current. This proactive defense mechanism curtails the risk of damage or malfunction due to power surges, promoting long-term system stability. This commitment to safeguarding your hardware underscores MSI's dedication to producing motherboards that prioritize durability and stability.

product.name: Xiaomi Desktop Heater with PTC Ceramic Heating
product.description:
Stay warm and comfortable with the Xiaomi Desktop Heater, a compact and efficient heating solution designed for small spaces. Powered by PTC ceramic heating technology, this mini heater provides instant warmth, making it ideal for quick, effective heating in rooms, offices, or personal workspaces. Featuring a 45° oscillation, it ensures even heat distribution across the area, offering a gentle breeze to circulate warmth without harsh airflow.

The lightweight design allows for easy portability, while its modern aesthetic fits seamlessly into any environment without occupying too much space. With dumping protection, the heater automatically powers off if tipped over, preventing accidents. product.name: Asus TUF B850 Gaming Plus WI-FI AM5 ATX Motherboard
product.description:
ASUS TUF GAMING B850-PLUS WIFI takes all the essential elements of the latest AMD Ryzen™ processors and combines them with game-ready features and proven durability. Engineered with military-grade components, an upgraded power solution and a comprehensive cooling system, this motherboard goes beyond expectations with rock-solid and stable performance for marathon gaming. TUF GAMING motherboards also undergo rigorous endurance testing to ensure that they can handle conditions where others may fail. This platform delivers the power and connectivity that advanced AI PC applications demand.

Stable power is crucial for maximizing the performance of AMD processors. The motherboard is designed to meet the needs of high-core-count CPUs. It features 14(80A) + 2(80A) + 1(80A) power stages that integrate high-side and low-side MOSFETs and drivers into packages rated for up to 80A each. This configuration ensures optimal power delivery, efficiency, stability and performance for both current and future AMD processors.

For those who want to fly past stock DDR5 speeds, this motherboard is primed and ready for enthusiast-grade kits, courtesy of vast AMD Extended Profiles for Overclocking (EXPO™) support. Seasoned veterans can further tweak performance via an extensive array of settings in the UEFI. Comprehensive memory tuning options are the cornerstone of TUF GAMING motherboards. With the motherboard, you can extract all the potential out of your DDR5 modules, whether they're from an extreme-speed kit or an entry-level set that would otherwise be locked.

ASUS Enhanced Memory Profile (AEMP) is an exclusive firmware feature for PMIC-restricted memory modules. AEMP automatically detects the memory chips on your kit and then presents optimized frequency, timing and voltage profiles that you can quickly apply. This motherboard also features one PCIe 5.0 M.2 slot to enjoy the fastest data transfers of up to 128Gbps, and all M.2 slots support NVMe RAID configurations to take advantage of the latest available speeds.

This motherboard offers a versatile range of connectivity with PCIe 5.0, rear USB 20Gbps Type-C® port, front USB 10Gbps Type-C® connector and Thunderbolt™ (USB4®) header support. Extensive USB support ensures connections to a wide array of external devices. This motherboard includes a USB 20Gbps Type-C® port on the rear I/O panel that delivers transfer speeds of up to 20Gbps. This motherboard features a USB 10Gbps Type-C® front panel connector for speedy data transfers of up to 10Gbps.

FEATURES:

  • Supports AMD Ryzen™ 8000/7000/9000 Series Desktop Processors

product.name: UGREEN 2.5'' SATA Hard Drive USB 3.0 Enclosure, UASP, 6Gbps

Got an old laptop hard drive lying around? Or need an easy way to back up important files? The UGREEN USB 3.0 to 2.5'' SATA Hard Drive Enclosure lets you repurpose your 2.5" HDD or SSD as a portable external drive. Simply pop in your drive, connect it to your computer, and enjoy fast, reliable storage.

With support for SATA III and UASP technology, this enclosure delivers transfer speeds of up to 6Gbps—up to 70% faster than standard USB 3.0. That means quicker file transfers, smoother backups, and better overall performance. It works with 7mm and 9.5mm 2.5" SATA drives up to 10TB, including popular models from WD, Seagate, Samsung, Kingston, and more.

No tools? No problem. The tool-free design lets you install or swap drives in seconds. Plus, it’s lightweight and compact, so you can take your files with you wherever you go. Whether you’re upgrading storage, backing up data, or recovering files, this enclosure makes the process simple and stress-free. Compatible with Windows, macOS, and Linux, it’s a plug-and-play solution for anyone who needs extra storage on the go.

product.name: UGREEN NW102 Cat6 U/UTP Flat Ethernet Cable 5m - Black
product.description:
The UGREEN NW102 Cat6 U/UTP Flat Ethernet Cable is designed for fast and stable wired internet connections, making it an ideal solution for home and office networks, gaming setups, and professional environments. Delivering speeds of up to 1000 Mbps (1 Gbps) with a 250MHz bandwidth, this UGREEN NW102 Cat6 cable ensures smooth data transfer for activities such as high-definition video streaming, online gaming, cloud computing, and business communications.

Built with 32AWG copper-clad aluminium conductors, the cable offers low interference and minimal signal loss, maintaining a reliable connection for your devices. The RJ45 connectors are precision-moulded for durability, while the unshielded twisted pairs (UTP) design helps reduce crosstalk and electromagnetic interference. A snag-less moulding makes installation easy, preventing tangles and damage when routing through tight spaces.

Whether you are linking computers via a network switch, connecting to a router, or setting up a gaming console, the UGREEN NW102 Flat Ethernet Cable provides a secure, high-speed connection for uninterrupted performance. Designed to be versatile, durable, and efficient, it is an essential networking accessory for any modern digital setup.

FEATURES:

  • High-speed 1000Mbps connectivity
  • 250MHz stable signal transmission
  • Durable and secure pure copper-plated RJ45 connectors
  • Uses 4PR UTP interference resistance
  • Secure connection with 586B wiring standard
  • Universal compatibility with all RJ45-equipped devices

  • Connection Type: RJ45
  • Cable Type: UTP Cat6
  • Conductor: 32AWG Copper-Clad Aluminium

  • Connector: Pure Copper Gold-Plated

product.name: Cudy PE10G Network Adapter - 10Gbps, PCI Express
product.description:
Elevate your network performance with the Cudy PE10G Network Adapter, engineered to meet the demands of high-speed data environments. This adapter is ideal for professionals and enthusiasts requiring ultra-fast connectivity for tasks such as large-scale data transfers, server hosting, and seamless media editing on Network Attached Storage (NAS) systems. By integrating the PE10G into your setup, you can achieve download speeds up to 10 Gbps, significantly reducing latency and enhancing overall workflow efficiency.

Designed for versatility, the PE10G is compatible with PCI-E x4, x8, and x16 slots, ensuring seamless integration with a wide range of motherboards. The inclusion of both standard and low-profile brackets allows for installation in various chassis types, catering to diverse hardware configurations. Advanced features such as Energy-Efficient Ethernet (EEE) automatically optimise power consumption by transitioning the adapter into a low-power idle state during periods of minimal data activity, promoting energy savings without compromising performance.

Furthermore, the adapter's Flow Control mechanism is instrumental in preventing packet loss and data drops when operating at peak 10 Gbps transmission rates. This is particularly crucial for maintaining reliability in server operations and surveillance systems where data integrity is paramount. With the Cudy PE10G Network Adapter, you can confidently upgrade your network capabilities to support the most demanding applications and workflows.

The Intel 12th Gen Celeron G6900 processor is an entry-level solution designed to deliver efficient and reliable performance for everyday computing tasks. The dual-core, dual-thread architecture provides reliable performance for web browsing, document processing, and media streaming. Additionally, its support for up to 128GB of RAM across dual memory channels ensures flexibility for system upgrades and improved overall responsiveness.

Ideal for students, home users, and businesses requiring an affordable computing solution, the Intel Celeron G6900 offers essential performance with modern connectivity options, including HDMI 2.1, DP 1.4a, and eDP 1.4b. product.name: Xiaomi Sport Water Bottle
product.description:
Stay on top of your hydration goals with the Xiaomi Sport Water Bottle – a premium, high-capacity companion purpose-built for fitness enthusiasts, outdoor adventurers, and professionals with an active lifestyle. Offering a generous 1-litre capacity, this bottle is the perfect companion for gym sessions, cycling, hiking, or simply staying refreshed during a demanding workday.

Constructed from high-grade, baby-safe Tritan material, the Xiaomi Sport Water Bottle is BPA-free, odourless, and impact-resistant, offering a safe and durable solution for everyday hydration. Its sleek, ergonomic design is both practical and stylish, aligning perfectly with your fitness and wellness routines.

One of its standout features is the one-touch, flip-top lid that enables swift, one-handed access — ideal for use during high-intensity activities. An integrated tea strainer adds versatility, allowing you to infuse your water with fruits, herbs, or simply enjoy tea on the go. A 360° silicone gasket combined with an automatic locking mechanism ensures a completely leak-proof experience, even when carried in bags or backpacks. Suitable for both hot and cold beverages, the Xiaomi Sport Water Bottle is engineered to withstand a wide temperature range from -10°C to +95°C.

A soft silicone carry handle adds to its portability, merging functionality with performance, offering comfort and convenience whether you’re commuting, training, or exploring outdoors. For a comprehensive approach to your health and fitness journey, pair your water bottle with a Xiaomi Smart Band/Watch, which tracks your activity, heart rate, and hydration levels. Additionally, elevate your hydration experience with the Xiaomi Smart Filtered Water Dispenser Pro, providing you with purified, on-demand water to effortlessly fill your bottle whenever you need it.

product.name: Xiaomi Straw Mug - 1L
product.description:
The Xiaomi Straw Mug is a versatile and stylish hydration solution designed to meet the needs of individuals seeking both functionality and aesthetic appeal in their drinkware. With a generous 1-litre capacity, this mug ensures you stay hydrated throughout the day, whether you're at home, in the office, or on the go.

Crafted with a 316L stainless steel interior, the Xiaomi Straw Mug offers exceptional durability and resistance to corrosion, making it suitable for a variety of beverages. The advanced vacuum insulation technology maintains your drink's temperature, keeping liquids above 55°C for up to 6 hours and below 10°C for the same duration, providing you with the perfect sip in any season.

The mug features a three-way drinking system, allowing you to choose between using the included straw, sipping directly, or pouring the beverage into your mouth. The Tritan straw is made from an environmentally friendly, odourless, and safe material, ensuring a pleasant drinking experience.

Designed with practicality in mind, the mug's shape is wide at the top and narrow at the bottom, enabling it to fit seamlessly into standard car cup holders. The 90 mm-wide mouth facilitates easy filling and cleaning, while the skin-friendly handle provides a comfortable grip. Additionally, the silicone base pad offers non-slip stability on various surfaces.

Whether you're commuting, working, or engaging in outdoor activities, the Xiaomi Straw Mug serves as a reliable companion, ensuring you have access to your favourite beverages at the ideal temperature whenever you need them.

product.name: Xiaomi Comfort Edition Wireless Mouse - Black
product.description:
The Xiaomi Comfort Edition Wireless Mouse is engineered to enhance your computing experience by combining ergonomic design with advanced functionality. Its asymmetrical shape is meticulously crafted to conform to the natural contours of the hand, providing comprehensive palm and thumb support. This thoughtful design ensures comfortable operation and alleviates fatigue during extended use, making it an ideal choice for professionals and students alike.

Available in two classic colours—black and white—the mouse seamlessly complements any workspace aesthetic. The fine sandblasted matte surface not only offers a smooth and comfortable feel but also resists fingerprints, maintaining a clean appearance. One of the standout features is its silent primary buttons, which provide a quiet click while maintaining crisp tactile feedback. product.name: Xiaomi Desk Lamp Lite – Adjustable LED Light
product.description:
Augment your workspace with the Xiaomi Desk Lamp Lite, designed for optimal eye comfort and wide-area illumination. Featuring a high colour rendering index (CRI) of Ra90, this lamp closely mimics natural light, ensuring true-to-life colours and reducing eye strain. Whether you need soft lighting for reading, focused brightness for work, or a balanced glow for relaxation, the three-level brightness adjustment allows you to customise the illumination to suit your needs.

Built for versatility and convenience, the lamp offers 25° up and down adjustment and a three-shaft flexible design, enabling precise positioning to direct light exactly where you need it. When not in use, it folds compactly for easy storage. The RG0 blue light hazard exemption level and flicker-free technology help protect your vision, minimising glare and delaying eye fatigue even during extended use.

With a large illumination area, this desk lamp provides uniform lighting across your workspace, preventing harsh contrasts between light and dark spots. The simple touch control makes operation effortless—just press to turn it on/off or hold to adjust brightness. Designed for home offices, study desks, and creative workspaces, the Xiaomi Desk Lamp Lite combines functionality with sleek, modern aesthetics, making it a must-have lighting solution.

  • Three-Level Brightness Adjustment

product.name: Xiaomi Front Pocket 20" Carry-on Luggage
product.description:
The Xiaomi Front Pocket 20" Carry-on Luggage is meticulously designed to meet the needs of modern travellers, offering a harmonious blend of functionality, durability, and style. With a generous 38-litre capacity, this carry-on luggage is ideal for both business trips and leisure travel, ensuring your essentials are organised and easily accessible.

One of the standout features is its convenient front pocket, which allows quick access to frequently used items without the need to open the main compartment. This design is particularly beneficial during airport security checks or business meetings, where swift retrieval of documents or electronic devices is essential. The front compartment is thoughtfully designed to accommodate a 15.6-inch laptop, safeguarded by a thick shock-absorbing cotton layer that protects against bumps and impacts. Additionally, it includes three multifunctional pockets for storing documents, tablets, and digital accessories, ensuring all your essentials are within easy reach.

The main compartment features a wet-dry separation design, facilitating more organised storage. Double U-shaped internal zippers prevent items from falling out and provide quick and easy access. The luggage's outer shell combines lightweight EVA material on the front and a pressure-resistant polycarbonate back shell, offering enhanced impact resistance and sturdiness. Embedded TSA-approved locks ensure your belongings remain secure during transit, while quiet caster wheels provide smooth and flexible manoeuvrability. The telescopic handle, adjustable to four levels, caters to users of different heights, and the flat-top design conveniently doubles as a temporary desk.

The Redmi Buds 6 Play combines sleek design, lightweight comfort, and powerful performance to deliver an exceptional audio experience. Weighing only 3.6g per earbud, they fit snugly in your ears without causing discomfort, making them perfect for all-day wear. The charging case features a smooth, four-sided curved design, offering a compact and elegant form factor that easily fits in your pocket or hand. Equipped with a finely tuned 10mm dynamic driver, the Redmi Buds 6 Play delivers rich and immersive sound. product.name: ASRock AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT Steel Legend 16GB Graphics Card
product.description:
The ASRock AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT Steel Legend 16GB is a powerful and visually striking graphics card designed for gamers and creators who demand top-tier performance and aesthetics. Built on the AMD RDNA™ 4 architecture, this GPU delivers exceptional frame rates at 4K and beyond, thanks to its 64 compute units, third-gen ray tracing, and AI acceleration technologies. Equipped with 16GB of GDDR6 memory on a 256-bit bus, it ensures high-speed data processing for smooth, immersive gaming experiences.

A defining feature of the Steel Legend is its customizable ARGB lighting, which allows users to create stunning, synchronised light effects through ASRock’s Polychrome SYNC. The ARGB header expands customization further, enabling the connection of additional ARGB devices for a rich and vivid lighting setup. For those who prefer a stealthier look, the lighting can be switched off with ease, providing flexibility to match any setup.

Cooling is optimized with a triple-fan design, ensuring efficient heat dissipation for sustained peak performance. ASRock’s Striped Ring Fans increase lateral intake and improve airflow, while V-shaped cutting fins and air vents guide air through the reinforced metal frame and stylish backplate, further enhancing cooling efficiency. Additionally, the premium thermal pads, precision-mounted heatsink, and consolidated heat pipes ensure optimal contact and heat transfer, keeping the GPU cool even under intense gaming loads.

Built with durability in mind, the reinforced metal frame prevents PCB bending, maintaining the structural integrity of the graphics card over time. The dual 8-pin power connectors and PCIe 5.0 support ensure high-speed data transmission and reliable power delivery. With DisplayPort 2.1a and HDMI 2.1b outputs, the RX 9070 XT Steel Legend is ready for multi-display setups and next-gen high-resolution gaming. product.name: Hikvision Buckline Power Cable 3.5M F6 Pro + B1
product.description:
The Hikvision AE-DF7351 Micro-USB Buckline Power Cable is a reliable and efficient power management solution engineered specifically for vehicle-based security setups. Designed to ensure uninterrupted power to your Hikvision dash or onboard cameras, this versatile buckline cable is ideal for applications such as parking monitoring, where the camera must remain powered even when the vehicle is turned off. With its smart and stable power regulation, it offers peace of mind by safeguarding your recordings and enhancing 24/7 security.

This durable cable features a Micro-USB connector and a robust black build to seamlessly integrate with your vehicle’s interior. Compatible with a broad range of Hikvision models—including the AE-DC2015-B1, AE-DC5113-F6S, AE-DC5013-F6PRO, and more—it delivers DC output of 5.0V–5.3V regulated from a 12–24V input. This broad compatibility and dependable voltage regulation make it a preferred choice for users looking to power dash cams or similar devices from the car’s power system.

Designed to function under extreme environmental conditions, the AE-DF7351 operates efficiently across a wide temperature range of -20°C to 65°C, with humidity resistance up to 95%. The cable also incorporates low power protection at 11.3V±0.2V, which prevents the car battery from draining excessively, ensuring your vehicle remains operational even after extended parking surveillance sessions.

With a cable length of 3.5 meters, it offers flexible installation options throughout the cabin or near the windshield. Whether you're a professional installer or an end-user, the cable’s smart design ensures easy integration and reliable performance, making it an essential accessory for maintaining your vehicle's security infrastructure.
