product.name: ASRock Intel Arc B580 Challenger OC 12GB GDDR6 192-BIT Graphics Card
product.description:
The ASRock Intel Arc B580 Challenger OC 12GB GDDR6 Graphics Card delivers a perfect balance of performance, cooling, and aesthetics. Designed for gamers and creators, this card combines powerful Intel® Arc™ B580 Graphics with a sleek design that features a stylish metal backplate. The Phantom Gaming look not only adds visual appeal but also reinforces the card’s construction. Additionally, a thermal pad on the backplate enhances heat dissipation, contributing to its overall efficiency during demanding tasks.

Optimized cooling is a key highlight of the B580 Challenger. The dual-fan design features ASRock’s custom Striped Axial Fan, which improves airflow using a stripe structure on the fan blades and a polished surface on the bottom side. These fans spin up under heavy loads to maintain optimal cooling and stop when temperatures drop for silent operation. The card’s heat pipes are designed to maximize contact with the GPU baseplate and stacked fins, efficiently transferring heat away from critical components.

ASRock has also integrated thoughtful engineering to improve thermal performance. The use of precise screw torque during assembly ensures optimal cooler mounting pressure, enhancing heat dissipation while protecting the GPU die. The innovative gap isolation between the heat pipes and stacked fins further boosts cooling efficiency, allowing the card to handle intense workloads with ease. A multi-colour LED indicator adds a touch of personalization, making the graphics card visually appealing in any setup.

Packed with cutting-edge features, the ASRock Intel Arc B580 Challenger OC boasts 12GB of 192-bit GDDR6 memory and an engine clock of up to 2740MHz. Built on Intel® Xe2-HPG Architecture, it supports advanced technologies like Intel® XeSS 2 for AI-driven upscaling and DirectX 12 Ultimate for stunning visuals. With support for resolutions up to 7680 x 4320 and multiple connectivity options, including HDMI™ 2.1a and DisplayPort™ 2.1, this card delivers exceptional performance for gaming and creative applications. Its robust build, efficient cooling, and sleek design make it a reliable choice for high-performance systems.

product.name: FSP M580 ARGB ATX Mid Tower Gaming Chassis - White
product.description:
The FSP M580 ARGB ATX Gaming Chassis is a masterclass in modern case design, featuring a striking 270° panoramic curved glass exterior that offers an unobstructed view of your build. The seamless integration of tempered glass and a rounded chamfer design gives this case a futuristic and elegant aesthetic, making it a true centerpiece for any gaming setup. Built with both style and performance in mind, the M580 enhances the gaming atmosphere by blending high-end visuals with functional engineering.

Designed for optimal cooling, the M580 comes pre-installed with four powerful ARGB fans, including three reverse ARGB fans on the side with a PWM controller and one at the rear. These fans are fully controllable via the motherboard, allowing for dynamic lighting synchronization and efficient heat dissipation. With support for up to a 360mm radiator, this chassis ensures that your high-performance components stay cool even during the most demanding gaming sessions.

The M580 is built to accommodate the latest and most powerful hardware, supporting ATX (back-connect), Micro-ATX, and Mini-ITX motherboards. It offers space for graphics cards up to an impressive 445mm in length, providing unparalleled flexibility for high-end GPUs. Additionally, the spacious interior layout allows for easy installation of custom cooling solutions and multiple storage configurations, ensuring that both current and future upgrade needs are met without limitations.

Connectivity and convenience are also at the forefront of the M580’s design. The front I/O panel includes two USB 3.0 ports and a high-speed Type-C connection for fast data transfer and seamless peripheral integration. With a well-thought-out structure that maximizes airflow, enhances aesthetics, and provides future-proofing for high-end builds, the FSP M580 ARGB ATX Gaming Chassis is an exceptional choice for gamers and PC enthusiasts looking for a case that combines style, power, and performance.

product.name: Xiaomi Bluetooth Speaker 40W - Black
product.description:
The Xiaomi Bluetooth Speaker 40W delivers an immersive and high-fidelity audio experience, combining advanced acoustic engineering with cutting-edge technology. Featuring Xiaomi’s self-developed symmetric architecture design and computational audio algorithm, this speaker produces rich, natural sound with powerful bass and crystal-clear highs. Designed for outdoor enthusiasts and music lovers, it offers high volume, portability, and seamless connectivity with Xiaomi HyperOS Connect, ensuring an exceptional audio experience no matter where you are.

With its 5-unit acoustic configuration, including dual high-frequency tweeters, a mid-low frequency woofer, and dual passive radiators, the speaker delivers 360° omnidirectional sound for a fully immersive experience. The 40W total power output provides an impressive 93dB maximum volume, ensuring broad sound coverage outdoors. Professional tuning with HARMAN AudioEFX further enhances clarity and balance, making every note resonate with precision. The Mi Home/Xiaomi Home app allows users to customize the frequency response curve, creating a unique sound profile tailored to personal preferences.

Beyond sound, the Xiaomi Bluetooth Speaker 40W boasts vibrant RGB lighting with 12 LED beads, offering four dynamic lighting effects that sync with your music. The IP67 dust and water resistance rating makes it a reliable companion for outdoor adventures, while the durable woven mesh body and impact-absorbing rubber base ensure resilience against rough conditions. With a 4800mAh battery, it provides up to 17 hours of continuous playback and supports 22.5W fast charging, keeping the music going without interruptions.

Seamless connectivity is at the core of this speaker, featuring Bluetooth 5.3 with LHDC 5.0 codec support for high-fidelity wireless audio. Xiaomi HyperOS Connect allows for one-tap NFC pairing, ensuring a hassle-free connection with Xiaomi devices. For an even richer stereo experience, two speakers can be paired for dual-device stereo playback, while up to eight speakers can be linked together for an ultimate party atmosphere. Combining premium sound quality, rugged durability, and smart features, the Xiaomi Bluetooth Speaker 40W redefines portable audio for music lovers everywhere.

product.name: Xiaomi Faucet Water Purifier
product.description:
The Xiaomi Faucet Water Purifier brings advanced 5-stage composite filtration, ensuring thorough water purification by effectively removing sand, rust, insect eggs, colloids, residual chlorine, and organic pollutants. With its high-volume water output, you can enjoy purified water instantly, making it perfect for cooking, making soup, and everyday use. Designed to provide clean and safe water, this purifier enhances both health and convenience in your home.

Built for durability and cost efficiency, the washable diatomaceous ceramic filter extends the purifier's lifespan by allowing repeated cleaning with sandpaper or a scouring pad. This clog-resistant and eco-friendly design helps save on filter replacements while maintaining high filtration performance. The purifier comes with four long-lasting filters, each capable of lasting 3 to 6 months, depending on water quality and usage levels. Inside, the naturally sourced coconut shell-activated carbon effectively adsorbs residual chlorine and organic pollutants, reducing potential skin irritation and improving overall water quality.

For maximum versatility, the Xiaomi Faucet Water Purifier features three water modes: purified water, unpurified water, and spray mode, allowing you to switch easily based on your needs. The matte translucent design not only enhances aesthetics but also ensures visibility of the filter's condition, reminding you when it's time for a replacement. The snap-rotation assembly makes installation and filter replacement quick and hassle-free, adding to its overall user-friendly experience.

Designed with efficiency and sustainability in mind, this purifier operates with no electricity consumption and no water waste, making it an eco-friendly and durable choice. Its smooth ABS surface allows for easy cleaning, while the compact, integrated design saves space, making it ideal for various home environments. Whether you're looking for cost-effective water filtration or a sleek, modern addition to your kitchen, the Xiaomi Faucet Water Purifier is the perfect solution for pure, great-tasting water every day.

product.name: Antec CX700 ARGB ATX | Micro-ATX | ITX ARGB Mid-Tower Gaming Chassis - Black
product.description:
The Antec CX700 ARGB Mid-Tower Gaming Chassis is a stunning showcase for high-performance PC builds, featuring a seamless 4mm steel-tempered glass front and side panel. With its panoramic 270° view, this case provides an unobstructed display of internal components, making it perfect for gamers and enthusiasts who want to highlight their hardware. The innovative fixing stud design simplifies assembly and disassembly while minimizing the risk of glass breakage, ensuring both durability and convenience.

Designed for superior airflow, the CX700 incorporates a bottom-up vertical cooling system with a massive air intake through the lower front, left, and right side mesh panels. This design accelerates heat dissipation, maintaining optimal temperatures even under heavy loads. With nine fan mounting positions and three pre-installed 120mm ARGB PWM fans—including two reverse fans on the right side—this chassis delivers exceptional cooling performance while enhancing aesthetics with vibrant lighting effects.

For liquid cooling enthusiasts, the CX700 supports simultaneous installation of a 360mm radiator on the top and a 240mm radiator on the side, allowing for advanced cooling configurations. However, when utilizing a 240mm side-mounted radiator, the GPU length is limited to 270mm. The case is also built to accommodate powerful RTX 40 Series GPUs up to 410mm in length, making it a future-proof choice for high-end gaming rigs. EVA anti-vibration foams at the PSU mount position reduce noise and protect hardware from operational vibrations.

Functionality meets convenience with tool-free side panels, reusable PCI slot covers, and an efficient cable management system with 23mm of routing space. The front panel offers a USB 3.0 port, a high-speed USB Type-C 3.2 Gen 2 port, and an LED control button for quick customization. With its combination of innovative cooling, sleek design, and versatile hardware support, the Antec CX700 ARGB Mid-Tower Chassis is an excellent choice for gamers and PC enthusiasts looking to build a powerful and visually striking system.

product.name: Antec VORTEX LUM 360 ARGB AIO CPU Liquid Cooler - White
product.description:
The Antec VORTEX LUM 360 ARGB AIO Liquid Cooler is designed for high-performance cooling, featuring a stunning suspended spiral pump head inspired by the swirling motion of a vortex. This unique design not only enhances aesthetics with vibrant ARGB lighting effects but also ensures superior cooling performance from multiple angles. With a 360mm aluminium radiator, this all-in-one liquid cooler efficiently dissipates heat, making it an ideal solution for gaming rigs and high-performance workstations.

Equipped with a massive copper base plate, the VORTEX LUM 360 maximizes heat transfer, ensuring optimal cooling even under heavy workloads. Its durable EPDM high-density tubing minimizes liquid evaporation, contributing to long-lasting and reliable cooling performance. The system is further supported by three powerful 120mm ARGB PWM fans, which provide exceptional airflow and efficient heat dissipation with speeds ranging from 800 to 1800 RPM.

This AIO cooler includes an advanced ARGB controller that allows users to sync and customize lighting effects with their motherboard, offering complete control over each LED’s colour and pattern. With 13 dense radiator fins and a water pump rated for a flow rate of 1300mL/min, the VORTEX LUM 360 is built for extreme cooling efficiency. Its whisper-quiet operation, with noise levels kept at a maximum of 31 dB(A), ensures a balance of power and silent performance.

Compatible with a wide range of Intel and AMD sockets, including LGA 1700, AM5, and TR4, the Antec VORTEX LUM 360 is a versatile cooling solution for modern CPUs. Whether pushing your system to its limits in gaming or intensive workloads, this AIO liquid cooler delivers high-performance thermal management with stylish ARGB customization, keeping your PC cool and visually stunning.

product.name: Cudy BE9300 Tri-Band Wi-Fi 7 | Bluetooth 5.4 PCIe Adapter
product.description:
Upgrade your PC’s wireless connectivity with the Cudy BE9300 Tri-Band Wi-Fi 7 & Bluetooth 5.4 PCIe Adapter, delivering next-generation speeds and seamless reliability. Powered by the Intel BE200 chipset, this adapter offers blazing-fast Wi-Fi 7 speeds with up to 5760Mbps on 6GHz, 2882Mbps on 5GHz, and 688Mbps on 2.4GHz, ensuring low latency and ultra-smooth streaming, gaming, and multitasking. By leveraging Multi-Link Operation (MLO), it can aggregate multiple bands for a more stable and efficient multi-gig connection when paired with an MLO-supported router. Whether you're gaming, streaming in 4K, or handling intensive workloads, the Cudy BE9300 provides superior wireless performance with minimal interference.

Beyond Wi-Fi, the integrated Bluetooth 5.4 ensures faster pairing, reduced power consumption, and improved signal reliability for all your Bluetooth devices, including keyboards, mice, headphones, and game controllers. With enhanced power efficiency, your Bluetooth peripherals benefit from longer battery life and lower latency, creating a more responsive and seamless wireless experience. This makes the Cudy BE9300 the perfect choice for users who demand both high-speed networking and stable Bluetooth connectivity in one compact package.

Designed for maximum compatibility and easy installation, the Cudy BE9300 fits into any PCIe 1x, 4x, 8x, or 16x slot on your motherboard, while Bluetooth functionality requires a USB 9-Pin connector. It supports both standard tower PCs and compact Mini-ITX or HTPC builds, thanks to its included low-profile bracket. Equipped with two high-gain detachable RP-SMA antennas, this adapter ensures superior signal reception—simply adjust and position the antennas toward your router for the best possible performance. Whether you're upgrading an aging Wi-Fi card or building a cutting-edge gaming rig, this adapter ensures rock-solid connectivity in any setup.

Compatible with Windows 11 (64-bit) on Intel-based PCs, the Cudy BE9300 provides a smooth and optimized wireless experience. While manual driver installation is required, setup is straightforward via Cudy’s Download Center. With its tri-band support, advanced MIMO technology, and cutting-edge Bluetooth 5.4, this PCIe adapter is an essential upgrade for users seeking top-tier wireless performance, reduced interference, and ultra-low latency networking. Whether you're an avid gamer, content creator, or power user, the Cudy BE9300 ensures future-proof connectivity with blazing speeds and exceptional reliability.

product.description:
Keep your home clean and your pet's grooming experience fresh with a genuine Gizzu Sponge filter.

For the meticulous pet owner in South Africa, the Gizzu Sponge vacuum filter is an essential component for maintaining a healthy and clean grooming environment.

This replacement Sponge filter is not merely a part; it is a guardian against the finer particles that escape during pet grooming. Designed specifically for the Gizzu Shear Bliss Pet Vacuum Grooming Kit, it ensures that the air expelled during grooming is as clean as possible, which is crucial for households with allergy sufferers or simply for those who value pristine air quality. Its integration means you are not just grooming your pet; you are actively contributing to a healthier living space for your entire family, including your beloved animal companion.

Precision engineering for superior air purification

The Gizzu Sponge vacuum filter is engineered to capture an impressive 99.97% of airborne particles as small as 0.3 microns. This includes microscopic dust, pet dander, pollen, and other common allergens that can be stirred up during grooming. By trapping these irritants, the fine dust filter prevents them from recirculating into your home environment, significantly reducing the potential for allergic reactions and improving overall air quality. Its precision fit within the Gizzu Shear Bliss Pet Vacuum Grooming Kit ensures no air bypasses the filtration system, guaranteeing maximum effectiveness with every use.

Longevity and performance you can rely on

Understanding the importance of consistent performance, the Gizzu Sponge vacuum filter is designed for a lifespan of 6 to 12 months, depending on usage frequency and the specific grooming needs of your pet. This extended durability means fewer replacements and reliable filtration over time. By regularly replacing your sponge filter, you ensure that your Gizzu grooming kit continues to operate at its peak efficiency, providing a clean and comfortable experience for both you and your pet, time after time.

A simple step towards a healthier pet and home

The process of replacing the sponge vacuum filter is straightforward and requires no special tools, making maintenance a seamless part of your grooming routine. This ease of care encourages regular upkeep, ensuring that your Gizzu Shear Bliss Pet Vacuum Grooming Kit always functions optimally. Investing in genuine Gizzu replacement parts like this HEPA filter is a clear demonstration of your commitment to your pet's well-being and the cleanliness of your home.

Why choose the Gizzu sponge vacuum filter?

This replacement sponge filter is the silent partner in your pet grooming endeavours. It works diligently behind the scenes, ensuring that the powerful vacuum function of your Gizzu Shear Bliss kit not only removes pet hair and debris but also purifies the air. For pet owners in South Africa who demand a hygienic grooming solution, this HEPA vacuum filter is an indispensable accessory, offering peace of mind and a tangible contribution to a healthier living space.

product.name: Antec NOVA PWM 120mm Case Fan White
product.description:
The Antec NOVA 120 PWM Fan with Speed Controller delivers exceptional cooling performance, precision control, and durability. Designed with a three-phase PWM speed controller, it offers adjustable speed modes to adapt to different hardware environments and workloads. The fan can even cease operation when the PWM signal drops below 6%, enhancing energy efficiency and reducing wear during low-demand periods. Its computational fluid dynamics (CFD)-optimized 9-blade design ensures superior airflow and cooling efficiency, while a minimized clearance between the fan frame and blades prevents backflow and boosts air pressure.

At the heart of the NOVA 120 is a three-phase six-pole drive motor, engineered for optimal performance and reduced noise. This advanced motor delivers greater output power, better torque, and faster startup while minimizing electromagnetic interference and vibration. Complementing this is a strong neodymium magnet in the frame, stabilising the fan during high-speed operation to ensure smooth and steady performance. Additional features like anti-vibration rubber pads and a dustproof structure further enhance reliability, longevity, and quiet operation.

Constructed from industrial-grade LCP material, the NOVA 120 combines durability with precision. Its robust design reduces resonance and improves structural rigidity, while its metal shaft ensures long-lasting stability. With a lifespan of 50,000 hours and an impressive airflow range of up to 95.32 CFM at high speeds, this fan is an ideal choice for demanding cooling applications. Whether optimizing your system’s thermal performance or maintaining silent operation, the Antec NOVA 120 offers unparalleled versatility and efficiency.

product.name: Keychron K1 Max QMK/VIA 80% Wireless Custom Mechanical Keyboard | BROWN Switches
product.description:
The Keychron K1 Max QMK/VIA Low Profile Wireless Custom Mechanical Keyboard is a cutting-edge, ultra-slim TKL (80%) mechanical keyboard designed for seamless wireless and wired connectivity. With support for 2.4GHz, Bluetooth 5.1, and USB Type-C wired connections, it offers versatility for both work and play. The Keychron Launcher web app allows users to remap keys, program macros, and fine-tune their setup for a fully customized experience. Built with LSA (low-profile spherical-angled) keycaps for both macOS and Windows, it ensures a comfortable and intuitive typing experience straight out of the box.

Engineered for high-performance gaming and professional use, the 2.4GHz wireless mode delivers an ultra-fast 1000Hz polling rate, ensuring near-zero latency even in competitive settings. The low-profile Gateron Jupiter Brown switches, which are 31% slimmer than standard mechanical switches, provide a responsive, tactile feel while maintaining a sleek and lightweight design. For those who love customization, the hot-swappable version enables effortless switch swapping without the need for soldering, giving users full control over their typing experience.

The K1 Max is powered by QMK/VIA firmware, offering limitless customization possibilities, including key remapping, shortcuts, and macros. The ARM Cortex-M4 32-bit MCU with 256KB Flash ensures smooth performance and long-term reliability. Designed for comfort, the keyboard features IXPE acoustic foam for silent keystrokes, latex foam for enhanced switch support, and redesigned stabilizers to minimize wobble on larger keys like space bar, Shift, Enter, and Backspace. These refinements contribute to a quieter, more stable, and premium typing experience.

Aesthetically, the K1 Max boasts double-shot PBT keycaps, offering oil resistance and durability for long-term use. The keyboard features more than 22 types of RGB backlight effects (with additional fine-tuning for hue, brightness, and speed), as well as a white backlight option for a more subtle look. With a 2000mAh battery, it provides up to 95 hours of use with backlight off or 50 hours on the lowest brightness RGB setting, ensuring long-lasting wireless performance. Whether for productivity, gaming, or daily use, the Keychron K1 Max sets a new standard for low-profile mechanical keyboards.

  • 2.4GHz & Bluetooth connection

product.description:
The ASUS TUF Gaming A520M-PLUS WiFi AM4 M-ATX Gaming Motherboard combines rugged durability with powerful gaming features to deliver a solid foundation for your next build. Designed to support AMD Ryzen™ 5000, 4000 G-Series, and 3000 Series Desktop Processors, this motherboard features the AMD A520 chipset and dual-channel DDR4 memory support for seamless performance. Engineered for gamers, the A520M-PLUS WiFi offers advanced connectivity and customization. It includes 802.11ac Wi-Fi for ultrafast wireless speeds, Realtek 1Gb Ethernet with TUF LANGuard, and TurboLAN technology for low-latency online gameplay. For added flair, the TUF Gaming A520M-PLUS WiFi features Aura Sync RGB lighting, enabling full control of onboard LEDs and connected RGB hardware. product.name: Intel Core Ultra 9 285K LGA1851 3.7Ghz 24-Core CPU
product.description:
The Intel® Core™ Ultra 9 285K CPU is a robust processor tailored to power modern digital workloads, from AI-driven tasks to intense gaming sessions. Part of Intel’s Core Ultra Series, this CPU is designed for creators and gamers seeking cutting-edge performance with AI integration. With a combination of performance cores (P-cores) and eight efficient cores (E-cores), the Core Ultra 9 285K handles multitasking seamlessly, offloading background tasks to the E-cores, which frees up the P-cores to drive demanding applications and maintain top-notch responsiveness. The processor’s powerful Intel® Smart Cache (36MB) and support for DDR5 memory (up to 6400MHz) make it a versatile choice for creators who rely on high data throughput for large files and smooth, efficient workflow.

Gamers and Esports professionals will benefit from the Core Ultra 9 285K’s performance-focused architecture, which provides a Max Turbo Frequency of up to 5.70GHz for intense gaming moments. With 24 PCIe lanes and Thunderbolt™ 5 support, this CPU is optimized for maximum expandability and high-speed connectivity. Built-in Intel® Killer™ Networking reduces lag and packet loss, offering a more seamless online gaming experience, while AI features like Intel® Gaussian & Neural Accelerator (GNA) help ensure clear communication by filtering background noise in voice comms. The processor’s graphics capabilities also support high-resolution displays, including up to 8K resolution on DisplayPort and HDMI, making it a powerful engine for immersive gaming experiences.

For content creators, the Intel® Core™ Ultra 9 285K’s intelligent performance shines in AI-driven applications like generative AI and video production. Intel® Deep Learning Boost enhances AI workloads directly on the CPU, speeding up AI model processing for creators working with machine learning or neural networks. The integrated Intel® Connectivity Performance Suite optimizes network performance for smoother streaming, and Quick Sync Video accelerates video encoding, making this processor ideal for creators, streamers, and freelancers aiming to elevate their productivity. Together, these features make the Core Ultra 9 285K a powerhouse for users who need reliable, top-tier performance in both creative and gaming environments.

product.name: Intel Core Ultra 5 245K LGA1851 4.2Ghz 14-Core CPU
product.description:
The Intel® Core™ Ultra 5 245K CPU is a robust processor tailored to power modern digital workloads, from AI-driven tasks to intense gaming sessions. Part of Intel’s Core Ultra Series, this CPU is designed for creators and gamers seeking cutting-edge performance with AI integration. With a combination of performance cores (P-cores) and eight efficient cores (E-cores), the Core Ultra 5 245K handles multitasking seamlessly, offloading background tasks to the E-cores, which frees up the P-cores to drive demanding applications and maintain top-notch responsiveness. The processor’s powerful Intel® Smart Cache (24MB) and support for DDR5 memory (up to 6400MHz) make it a versatile choice for creators who rely on high data throughput for large files and smooth, efficient workflow.

Gamers and Esports professionals will benefit from the Core Ultra 5 245K’s performance-focused architecture, which provides a Max Turbo Frequency of up to 5.20GHz for intense gaming moments. With 24 PCIe lanes and Thunderbolt™ 5 support, this CPU is optimized for maximum expandability and high-speed connectivity. Built-in Intel® Killer™ Networking reduces lag and packet loss, offering a more seamless online gaming experience, while AI features like Intel® Gaussian & Neural Accelerator (GNA) help ensure clear communication by filtering background noise in voice comms. The processor’s graphics capabilities also support high-resolution displays, including up to 8K resolution on DisplayPort and HDMI, making it a powerful engine for immersive gaming experiences.

For content creators, the Intel® Core™ Ultra 5 245K’s intelligent performance shines in AI-driven applications like generative AI and video production. Intel® Deep Learning Boost enhances AI workloads directly on the CPU, speeding up AI model processing for creators working with machine learning or neural networks. The integrated Intel® Connectivity Performance Suite optimizes network performance for smoother streaming, and Quick Sync Video accelerates video encoding, making this processor ideal for creators, streamers, and freelancers aiming to elevate their productivity. Together, these features make the Core Ultra 5 245K a powerhouse for users who need reliable, top-tier performance in both creative and gaming environments.

product.name: WANBO X5 Pro Full HD Smart Projector (1080p, 1100 ANSI Lumens, Android TV, ASA 3.0, 5GHz Wi-Fi, Autofocus)
product.description:
The WANBO X5 Pro reimagines home entertainment with intelligent projection technology and vivid visual performance, delivering a feature-rich, Android-powered experience that adapts to every setting. With 1100 ANSI lumens of brightness and native 1080p Full HD resolution, it produces sharp, vibrant visuals even in ambient light conditions—ideal for movies, sports, educational content, and gaming.

Powered by the latest ASA 3.0 Intelligent Adjustment Suite, the X5 Pro offers seamless automatic focus, auto keystone correction, screen alignment, and obstacle avoidance, enabling effortless setup in any room. Whether ceiling-mounted, placed on a desk, or angled via the adjustable desktop stand, it optimises viewing with zero hassle.

Its Android 11 TV OS gives users access to over 10,000 apps on Google Play, including native support for 1080p Netflix streaming. Voice-activated Google Assistant functionality and screen casting from mobile and laptop devices ensure a connected, user-centric interface.

Audio performance is equally compelling. Dual 5W HiFi full-band speakers, housed in a sealed 375cc acoustic chamber, produce dynamic, room-filling sound with minimal noise output (≤26dB/m). Combined with WANBO’s quiet cooling system, the X5 Pro ensures an immersive, uninterrupted viewing experience.

Designed with both form and function in mind, the projector features a high-strength crystal panel, metallic body with glass glaze finish, and eye-comfort light diffusion, making it a stylish and safe choice for family viewing, educational use, or shared content spaces.

Robust connectivity options include dual-band Wi-Fi, Bluetooth 5.0, HDMI, USB, and AUX input, making the X5 Pro highly compatible with gaming consoles, laptops, external drives, and headphones.

Whether you’re elevating your home cinema, hosting presentations, or casting from your mobile device, the WANBO X5 Pro delivers a high-impact visual and auditory experience in a sleek, premium design.

  • Native 1080p Full HD resolution
  • 1100 ANSI lumens brightness for vibrant image quality
  • ASA 3.0 suite: Autofocus, Auto Keystone, Auto Screen Alignment, Obstacle Avoidance

product.name: ASRock TRX50 WS AMD TR5 EATX Gaming Motherboard
product.description:
[embed]https://youtu.be/5eHAHQ4soHQ[/embed]

The ASRock AMD TRX50 WS AM5 EATX Gaming Motherboard is a high-performance, workstation-class motherboard engineered for intensive computing environments, providing powerful manageability and reliability. Built with a server-grade, low-loss PCB, this motherboard enhances signal integrity and supports PCIe 5.0 for both graphics cards and M.2 SSDs, unlocking extreme performance potential. Designed for demanding applications like deep learning, rendering, and simulation, the TRX50 WS is compatible with AMD Ryzen™ Threadripper™ PRO 7000 and AMD Ryzen™ Threadripper™ 7000 Series processors, bringing elite computing capabilities to professional setups. Its impressive 18+3+3 power phase design and 110A SPS for VCore ensure efficient and stable power delivery to support top-tier performance.

Equipped with an XXL aluminum heatsink, active cooling fans, and heat pipes, the TRX50 WS motherboard provides advanced thermal management to maintain peak operation under heavy loads. Supporting up to 1TB of DDR5 RDIMM ECC memory, it allows for extreme memory performance and overclocking while also automatically detecting and correcting data errors to reduce system crashes. The board’s Blazing M.2 slots accommodate PCIe 5.0 SSDs with speeds up to 128Gb/s, preparing it for next-generation storage. Additionally, SlimSAS (SFF-8654) and MCIO server-grade connectors support stable and scalable storage expansions, ideal for users who require fast, reliable access to large data files.

Networking and connectivity are robust, featuring Marvell 10 GbE and Realtek 2.5 GbE LAN ports for ultra-fast file transfer speeds to local servers, NAS, or cloud storage. With Wi-Fi 6E providing access to the 6GHz spectrum, users benefit from faster internet speeds, lower latency, and performance equivalent to 5G networks. USB 3.2 Gen2x2 Type-C delivers 20Gbps transfer rates, doubling the speed of previous generations. For audio, Nahimic technology offers vibrant, detailed sound, enhancing the experience whether using headphones, external speakers, or HDMI. The TRX50 WS also includes onboard RGB and addressable headers, fully customizable with Polychrome RGB Sync to create unique lighting effects, making it an ideal solution for gamers, creators, and power users alike.

product.description:
The Keychron V6 Max Wireless Custom Keyboard - BANANA Switch offers an 1800 compact layout, providing a full set of keys, including a numpad, in a space-efficient design. It features both 2.4 GHz wireless connectivity with a 1000 Hz polling rate and Bluetooth 5.1, allowing seamless multitasking across multiple devices. The gasket mount design, combined with sound-absorbing foam, ensures a comfortable and quiet typing experience.

Double-shot PBT keycaps provide durability and a premium feel. With QMK/VIA support, users can fully customize key functions and macros to suit their preferences. Hot-swappable sockets enable easy switch customization without soldering, and south-facing RGB LEDs offer vibrant backlighting. The V6 Max is compatible with both Mac and Windows systems, featuring a system toggle and additional keycaps for each. The Keychron V1 Max QMK/VIA Wireless Custom Mechanical Keyboard delivers peak gaming performance with a 2.4 GHz wireless connection and a 1000 Hz polling rate for ultra-low latency. product.name: Keychron Q1H-P1 QMK Wireless Custom Keyboard - White
product.description:
Engineered for professional creators, gamers, and productivity power users, the Keychron Q1H-P1 QMK Wireless Custom Keyboard delivers a breakthrough in responsive performance and customisability. Integrating rapid Hall Effect magnetic switches, this cutting-edge keyboard redefines speed, precision, and tactile feedback. It supports dynamic actuation, rapid trigger capabilities, and unparalleled keymapping flexibility, making it ideal for competitive gamers and advanced typists alike.

Crafted from premium CNC-machined aluminium, the Keychron Q1H-P1 QMK Wireless Custom Keyboard combines structural integrity with a refined aesthetic, offering an optimised typing experience through its double-gasket design. Whether in the office or on the go, users benefit from seamless connectivity via Bluetooth 5.1, 2.4GHz wireless, or wired Type-C, ensuring ultra-low latency in every scenario. With QMK/VIA support, users can tailor every key to their exact workflow—an essential feature for developers, creatives, and streamers seeking granular control.

Hot-swappable switches, south-facing RGB lighting, and a fully programmable layout empower users to adapt the keyboard to their unique preferences. Moreover, compatibility across macOS, Windows, and Linux ensures this peripheral integrates smoothly into any tech ecosystem. Designed for high-performance versatility, the Keychron Q1H-P1 QMK Wireless Custom Keyboard is more than a keyboard—it’s a command centre for those who demand the best in speed, personalisation, and design.

FEATURES:

  • Hot-swappable key switches
  • South-facing RGB backlighting
  • Rapid trigger technology enables ultra-precise, real-time input registration with minimal latency
  • QMK/VIA support across macOS, Windows, and Linux systems
  • Tri-mode connectivity between Bluetooth 5.1, 2.4GHz wireless, and wired Type-C modes
  • CNC-machined aluminium body offers durability and style
  • Double-gasket mount design enhances typing comfort with a softer keystroke feel
  • Per-key customisation: Actuation distance, dual-stage inputs, and personalise performance profiles
  • Magnetic hall effect switches provide fast actuation, enhanced responsiveness and adjustable trigger points
  • Functions seamlessly across macOS, Windows, and Linux

  • Width: 145 mm

product.name: Keychron K2 HE Wireless Special Edition Magnetic Custom Keyboard | NEBULA Switch – White
product.description:
The Keychron K2 HE Wireless Special Edition Magnetic Custom Keyboard is a revolutionary leap in gaming and typing technology, merging advanced Hall Effect magnetic switches with an elegant aluminum and wood design. A 2025 CES Innovation Award winner, this 75% layout keyboard features natural rosewood accents, available in both light wood (white version) and dark wood (black version). Engineered for precision, it exclusively supports Gateron Double-Rail Magnetic NEBULA switches, ensuring unmatched responsiveness and customizable actuation to fit any typing or gaming style. Combined with OSA profile double-shot PBT keycaps, it offers a smooth and satisfying typing experience with exceptional durability.

Built for next-level customization, the K2 HE Special Edition lets users fine-tune each key’s actuation point from 0.2 mm to 3.8 mm with 0.1 mm precision. With Rapid Trigger technology, keystrokes reset instantly upon release, while Dynamic Keystrokes (DKS) enable up to four distinct actions per key, streamlining complex inputs for seamless gameplay and efficient workflows. The keyboard also introduces Last Key Press (LKP) and Snap Click technology, optimizing directional changes and counter-strafing mechanics in competitive FPS games like Valorant. Additionally, Analog Mode mimics controller-like precision, translating keystroke depth into variable movement speeds, perfect for racing and simulation games.

The K2 HE Special Edition offers versatile connectivity options, including a 1000Hz polling rate on 2.4GHz wireless and wired modes, delivering ultra-low latency for competitive gaming. For seamless multitasking, Bluetooth 5.2 allows effortless switching between up to three devices, making it a powerful tool for both gaming and professional setups. Engineered with QMK open-source firmware, it supports extensive remapping, macros, and shortcuts, all customizable via the Keychron Launcher web app. Users can also personalize their keyboard with laser-engraved designs or text on the wooden siding, adding a unique, nature-inspired aesthetic to their setup.

Designed for an exceptionally smooth and immersive typing experience, the K2 HE Special Edition integrates pre-lubed switches, a 3.5mm thick EVA acoustic foam, EPDM foam, and a silicone pad to create a satisfying, soft, and thocky sound profile. The keyboard’s north-facing RGB LEDs provide 22+ customizable lighting effects, allowing users to fine-tune hue, saturation, brightness, and effect speeds. With hot-swappable support for Gateron Double-Rail Magnetic switches, screw-in PCB stabilizers, and adjustable typing angles (5°, 9.34°, and 12.43°), the Keychron K2 HE Special Edition offers an unparalleled blend of style, customization, and high-performance precision for gamers, creators, and professionals alike.

product.name: Keychron K2 HE Wireless Standard Magnetic Custom Keyboard | NEBULA Switch
product.description:
The Keychron K2 HE Wireless Standard Magnetic Custom Keyboard is a game-changer in both gaming and typing, seamlessly blending cutting-edge magnetic switch technology with a sleek, minimalist design. Winner of the 2025 CES Innovation Award, the K2 HE features a 75% compact layout with premium aluminum frames and rosewood accents, delivering both style and durability. Unlike traditional mechanical keyboards, it utilizes Gateron Double-Rail Magnetic NEBULA switches, powered by Hall Effect sensors, which eliminate physical contact for faster, more precise keystrokes. This means adjustable actuation points, dynamic keystrokes, and an ultra-responsive feel tailored to your exact needs.

At the core of the K2 HE is its adjustable actuation system, allowing you to fine-tune each key's engagement point from 0.2 mm to 3.8 mm with 0.1 mm precision. Whether you prefer ultra-light key presses for rapid actions or deeper, deliberate key strokes for accuracy, the choice is yours. The Rapid Trigger feature ensures instant key reset upon release, enabling fluid movement and faster reaction times in fast-paced games. Meanwhile, Dynamic Keystrokes (DKS) allow up to four actions per key, unlocking multi-layered control for complex gaming sequences or workflow shortcuts. This level of customization and precision gives gamers a competitive edge and boosts efficiency for professionals.

The K2 HE offers unmatched connectivity options, supporting 2.4GHz wireless with a 1000Hz polling rate, Bluetooth 5.2, and wired Type-C connections. This ensures a lightning-fast response time with virtually zero latency, making it ideal for competitive gaming. Its 4000mAh battery delivers up to 110 hours of use with the backlight off, and with 22+ customizable RGB lighting effects, users can create a setup that matches their style. The north-facing RGB LEDs ensure vibrant illumination, while Cherry profile double-shot PBT keycaps provide exceptional durability, oil resistance, and a premium typing feel.

With hot-swappable support (compatible with Gateron double-rail magnetic switches), users can effortlessly change switches to further personalize their experience. Screw-in PCB stabilizers enhance the stability and smoothness of larger keys, ensuring a consistent typing experience. The keyboard also offers three adjustable typing angles (5°, 9.34°, and 12.43°) for ergonomic comfort. Whether you're an eSports enthusiast, productivity-focused professional, or mechanical keyboard lover, the Keychron K2 HE redefines what’s possible with next-gen Hall Effect technology, giving you total control over every key press.

product.name: Keychron K2 HE Wireless Special Edition Magnetic Custom Keyboard | NEBULA Switch – Black
product.description:
The Keychron K2 HE Wireless Special Edition Magnetic Custom Keyboard is a revolutionary leap in gaming and typing technology, merging advanced Hall Effect magnetic switches with an elegant aluminum and wood design. A 2025 CES Innovation Award winner, this 75% layout keyboard features natural rosewood accents, available in both light wood (white version) and dark wood (black version). Engineered for precision, it exclusively supports Gateron Double-Rail Magnetic NEBULA switches, ensuring unmatched responsiveness and customizable actuation to fit any typing or gaming style. Combined with OSA profile double-shot PBT keycaps, it offers a smooth and satisfying typing experience with exceptional durability.

Built for next-level customization, the K2 HE Special Edition lets users fine-tune each key’s actuation point from 0.2 mm to 3.8 mm with 0.1 mm precision. With Rapid Trigger technology, keystrokes reset instantly upon release, while Dynamic Keystrokes (DKS) enable up to four distinct actions per key, streamlining complex inputs for seamless gameplay and efficient workflows. The keyboard also introduces Last Key Press (LKP) and Snap Click technology, optimizing directional changes and counter-strafing mechanics in competitive FPS games like Valorant. Additionally, Analog Mode mimics controller-like precision, translating keystroke depth into variable movement speeds, perfect for racing and simulation games.

The K2 HE Special Edition offers versatile connectivity options, including a 1000Hz polling rate on 2.4GHz wireless and wired modes, delivering ultra-low latency for competitive gaming. For seamless multitasking, Bluetooth 5.2 allows effortless switching between up to three devices, making it a powerful tool for both gaming and professional setups. Engineered with QMK open-source firmware, it supports extensive remapping, macros, and shortcuts, all customizable via the Keychron Launcher web app. Users can also personalize their keyboard with laser-engraved designs or text on the wooden siding, adding a unique, nature-inspired aesthetic to their setup.

Designed for an exceptionally smooth and immersive typing experience, the K2 HE Special Edition integrates pre-lubed switches, a 3.5mm thick EVA acoustic foam, EPDM foam, and a silicone pad to create a satisfying, soft, and thocky sound profile. The keyboard’s north-facing RGB LEDs provide 22+ customizable lighting effects, allowing users to fine-tune hue, saturation, brightness, and effect speeds. With hot-swappable support for Gateron Double-Rail Magnetic switches, screw-in PCB stabilizers, and adjustable typing angles (5°, 9.34°, and 12.43°), the Keychron K2 HE Special Edition offers an unparalleled blend of style, customization, and high-performance precision for gamers, creators, and professionals alike.

product.name: Keychron Coiled Aviator White Cable
product.description:
Elevate your desktop aesthetic and maximise cable functionality with the Keychron Coiled Aviator White Cable. Designed for mechanical keyboard enthusiasts, this premium coiled cable not only enhances connectivity but also introduces a sleek, tailored finish to any desk setup. Whether you are synchronising your cable with your keyboard colour scheme or ensuring optimal cable management, this solution delivers on both form and function.

Constructed using high-quality copper wiring, this cable guarantees fast, stable data transmission and long-term durability. The reversed coil design offers flexible mobility while protecting the cable from overstretching or wear, making it ideal for both compact workspaces and expansive battlestations. The integrated aviator connector allows quick detachment and modular customisation, enabling seamless transitions between setups or keyboards.

Optimised for Keychron’s expansive range, including the Q, V, and K Pro series, this cable is the ideal accessory for users who demand precision, performance, and style in their peripherals. Its gold-plated USB interface and zinc alloy fittings further reinforce the build quality, ensuring a stable connection over extended usage.

FEATURES:

  • Premium coiled design enhances flexibility
  • High-quality copper wiring for secure and quick transition
  • Metal aviation connector for quick attachment
  • Reversed coil, prevents damage and overstretching
  • Gold-plated USB interface provides improved conductivity
  • Compatible with Keychron Q, Q Pro, Q Max, V, V max, 81 Pro, K4 Pro, K10 Pro, and low-profile keyboards

Enhance your security with the Hikvision Fixed Dome Outdoor Security Camera, designed for homes, businesses, and surveillance professionals seeking a reliable, high-definition security solution. Designed for ease of use, this camera connects effortlessly via Wi-Fi, offering a hassle-free installation process and eliminating the need for complicated wiring.

With its EXIR 2.0 infrared technology, it provides superior night vision, extending up to 30 metres, making it ideal for 24/7 security coverage. The camera also supports two-way audio, enabling real-time communication for added security and convenience.

Built to withstand various environmental conditions, the camera boasts an IP66 rating, ensuring full protection against dust and water. Additionally, its onboard storage option supports up to 512 GB via microSD cards, providing flexible storage solutions for recorded footage.

Perfect for users seeking high-quality surveillance with minimal setup, the Hikvision Bullet Wireless Outdoor Security Camera is an ideal choice for homeowners, small businesses, and organisations that prioritise both reliability and ease of use.

product.name: Hikvision B1 Dashcam with 32GB Micro-SD
product.description:
The Hikvision B1 Dashcam with a 32GB Micro-SD card delivers reliable and high-quality video recording for your vehicle. It captures footage at up to 1080p resolution with a wide 166° field of view, ensuring comprehensive coverage of the road. With support for up to a 128GB SD card, the dashcam features overwriting capabilities, ensuring continuous recording without data loss.

Equipped with a built-in G-Sensor, the B1 Dashcam automatically records when it detects a crash or strong vibration. Its built-in Wi-Fi module allows easy access to live view, video playback, and configuration settings via a smartphone app. The Dashcam is designed for hassle-free installation and starts recording automatically when powered on. Offering low power consumption and high performance, the Hikvision B1 Dashcam is a reliable solution for ensuring road safety and recording important events while driving.

FEATURES:

  • Up to 1080p resolution, with 166° FOV.
  • SD card for video recording, supports up to 128GB. (Overwriting supported)
  • Built-in G-Sensor module supports video recording linkage at a car crash or strong vibration.
  • Built-in WI-FI module and WI-FI AP function supported.
  • Phone App: live view, record playback and parameter configuration.
  • Easy installation and operation.
  • Auto recording once the device is powered on.
  • Low power consumption and high performance.

The Antec P20CE Mid-Tower E-ATX Gaming Case is engineered for gamers and PC enthusiasts seeking superior cooling, exceptional compatibility, and a sleek, professional build. Pre-installed with 3 x 120mm PWM fans at the front, this case ensures efficient heat dissipation and a balanced noise profile. The Hiksemi MH2 M.2 Cooler Heatsink is engineered to prevent your SSD from overheating, ensuring consistent and stable high-performance operation. Crafted from premium aluminium alloy, it offers efficient heat dissipation, keeping temperatures under control even during demanding tasks. Designed for enthusiasts and professionals, this heatsink delivers reliable cooling, reducing SSD temperatures by up to 25°C for optimal performance and longevity.

Compatible with M.2 2280 NVMe SSDs, the MH2 features a compact and lightweight design that’s perfect for use in desktops, gaming consoles like the PS5, and other platforms. Its stylish design complements any build while providing superior thermal management. Measuring just 6.8 x 2.3 x 0.9 cm and weighing 28.8g, it’s an unobtrusive yet highly effective cooling solution.

The heatsink is easy to install, making it accessible for users of all experience levels. Whether you’re gaming, editing, or working with heavy applications, the Hiksemi MH2 M.2 Cooler Heatsink ensures your SSD remains cool and performs at its best.

product.name: Xiaomi Uniblade Trimmer Replacement Head
product.description:
Innovative three-way blade enables an easy clean shave. The two-way blade at the edge is suitable for cutting longer hair, while the middle foil is effective in removing leftover stubble. The three-way blade cuts hair of any length and thickness, as well as bent and flat-lying hair. Achieving a clean shave has never been more effortless. The full-covering foil acts as a barrier of the blade to the skin.

The foil covers the blade and captures the hair with its holes, eliminating any skin irritation during the shaving process. The flexible trimmer head is designed to follow the unique contours of your face and neck. The floating trimmer head can turn 40 degrees in both directions and will flexibly adjust for a precise shave to help shape your cheek line, jawline, sideburns, and much more.

product.name: Antec NX416L ATX | Micro-ATX | ITX ARGB Mid-Tower Gaming Chassis - Black

The Antec NX416L ATX ARGB Mid-Tower Gaming Chassis combines innovative design with exceptional cooling capabilities, making it a perfect choice for gamers and PC enthusiasts. This chassis features a swing-opening tempered glass side panel, offering convenient access to your components for easy installation and maintenance. With multi-directional vent designs and a dust filter system, the NX416L maintains excellent airflow while keeping your rig clean and dust-free.

The NX416L’s flexibility is unmatched, supporting ATX, Micro-ATX, and ITX motherboards, along with a variety of cooling and storage configurations. product.name: Xiaomi Dust Mite Vacuum Cleaner
product.description:
The Xiaomi Dust Mite Vacuum Cleaner offers an advanced four-in-one mite removal solution, ensuring pristine bedding and fabrics while safeguarding your family's health. Dust mites, a common household allergen, are a leading cause of conditions such as dermatitis and rhinitis, making their immediate removal essential. This innovative device combines beating, UV irradiation, powerful suction, and hot air drying to eliminate mites, bacteria, and allergens, delivering a deeper clean for healthier living.

With a newly designed three-zone beating system, the vacuum generates 12,000 high-frequency beats per minute to dislodge and extract deeply embedded mites and dust particles from bedding and fabrics. Its 254nm UV light sterilizes surfaces by disrupting the cellular structure of bacteria and mites, providing a cleaner and more hygienic environment for restful sleep. A powerful motor generates up to 12,000Pa cyclone suction, efficiently capturing dust, mites, hair, and debris for a thorough and effective cleaning experience.

The vacuum also incorporates 50°C hot air drying, which dries bedding and fabrics while disrupting bacterial habitats, reducing the proliferation of allergens. A sophisticated four-layer cyclone dust filtration system traps fine dust and mites, ensuring clean exhaust air and minimizing secondary pollution. The transparent dust compartment enables easy monitoring of the cleaning process and allows for quick disposal with its one-click disassembly.

Ergonomically designed for effortless use, this vacuum weighs just 1.63kg and features an open handle for comfortable, one-handed operation. A long 3.5-meter power cord adds convenience, allowing you to clean larger areas with ease. Equipped with cutting-edge technology and user-friendly features, the Xiaomi Dust Mite Vacuum Cleaner is an essential tool for maintaining a healthier and cleaner home environment.

product.name: Antec NOVA 120 PWM Fan 3 Pack with Speed Controller - Black
product.description:
The Antec NOVA 120 PWM Fan 3 pack with Speed Controller delivers exceptional cooling performance, precision control, and durability. Designed with a three-phase PWM speed controller, it offers adjustable speed modes to adapt to different hardware environments and workloads. The fan can even cease operation when the PWM signal drops below 6%, enhancing energy efficiency and reducing wear during low-demand periods. Its computational fluid dynamics (CFD)-optimized 9-blade design ensures superior airflow and cooling efficiency, while a minimized clearance between the fan frame and blades prevents backflow and boosts air pressure.

At the heart of the NOVA 120 is a three-phase six-pole drive motor, engineered for optimal performance and reduced noise. This advanced motor delivers greater output power, better torque, and faster startup while minimizing electromagnetic interference and vibration. Complementing this is a strong neodymium magnet in the frame, stabilising the fan during high-speed operation to ensure smooth and steady performance. Additional features like anti-vibration rubber pads and a dustproof structure further enhance reliability, longevity, and quiet operation.

Constructed from industrial-grade LCP material, the NOVA 120 combines durability with precision. Its robust design reduces resonance and improves structural rigidity, while its metal shaft ensures long-lasting stability. With a lifespan of 50,000 hours and an impressive airflow range of up to 95.32 CFM at high speeds, this fan is an ideal choice for demanding cooling applications. Whether optimizing your system's thermal performance or maintaining silent operation, the Antec NOVA 120 offers unparalleled versatility and efficiency.

  • 3 x 120mm PWM fans
  • PWM 3-phase speed controller
  • Quiet and efficient airflow
  • 3-phase 6-pole drive motor
  • 9 Curved Blade for Optimized Aerodynamics
  • Dustproof design for extended lifespan
  • Industrial-Grade LCP Material

product.name: Antec Connect 120 Reverse ARGB PWM Fan 3 Pack – White
product.description:
The Antec Connect 120 Reverse ARGB PWM Fan 3-pack offers a sleek and efficient cooling solution with streamlined installation and advanced design features. Its innovative interlocking system allows you to mount multiple fans with fewer screws, creating a cleaner and more organized setup. The daisy chain design reduces cable clutter, simplifying connections and ensuring a hassle-free installation process. With dynamic ARGB lighting that seamlessly syncs with your motherboard, these fans bring a vibrant and customizable aesthetic to your system.

Engineered for performance, the reverse fan blade design optimizes airflow and enhances air intake for smoother operation while maintaining a clean look. Each fan operates quietly, delivering strong and stable airflow with a maximum noise level of just 27.2 dB(A). Enlarged anti-vibration pads further minimize noise and vibration, ensuring a silent and stable cooling experience for your PC.

The Connect 120 fans are equipped with an extendable 3-pin daisy-chain ARGB connector, making it easier than ever to integrate stunning lighting effects across your system. Additionally, the fans are designed with a clear focus on user convenience—pay attention to the cable outlet positioning over the male connector during installation for optimal performance.

product.name: Antec FLUX PRO E-ATX Full Tower Gaming Chassis – White
product.description:
The Antec FLUX PRO E-ATX Full Tower Gaming Chassis is designed for high-performance gaming with its revolutionary F-LUX platform, which optimizes airflow for maximum cooling efficiency. Featuring six pre-installed high-performance PWM fans, this case delivers superior ventilation to keep high-end components running at peak performance. With a dedicated Antec FLUX airflow channel, the chassis enhances GPU cooling through a multi-directional vent design that draws air from the bottom, PSU chamber, and lower sides, ensuring exceptional heat dissipation.

Aesthetically striking, the FLUX PRO combines functionality with style by integrating a premium walnut wood finish on the front panel, creating a refined and modern look that complements any gaming setup. The front mesh design allows for unrestricted airflow, while the top and bottom vents work together to establish a smooth and efficient cooling system. With extensive radiator support, accommodating up to 420mm radiators on both the top and front, this case is ideal for enthusiasts looking to incorporate advanced liquid cooling solutions.

Designed with convenience in mind, the FLUX PRO offers tool-free access with a detachable left-side PSU chamber, making power supply installation effortless. The removable cooling brackets on the PSU shroud and front panel further simplify component installation and customization. With support for E-ATX motherboards up to 285mm wide, this full-tower chassis provides ample space for high-performance builds, allowing gamers and content creators to push their systems to the limit.

Equipped with modern connectivity options, the FLUX PRO features front-panel access to USB 3.0 ports, a high-speed Type-C 10Gbps port, and a temperature display switch for real-time system monitoring. The built-in ARGB and PWM fan controller provides seamless lighting and fan speed adjustments, ensuring both aesthetic appeal and optimized cooling. With its exceptional airflow, premium design elements, and user-friendly features, the Antec FLUX PRO E-ATX Full Tower Chassis is a top-tier choice for PC builders who demand both performance and style.

  • Vertical cooling options
  • Multi-directional vent design with top bottom and front mesh
  • 6 x pre-installed high-performance PWM fans
  • Built-in fan controller
  • Premium walnut wooden finish
  • Radiator support up to 420mm on top and 360mm in front

product.name: FSP VITA GM 850W 80 PLUS Gold Modular Power Supply
product.description:
Built to handle the demanding power requirements of tomorrow, these PSUs support total power excursion as per ATX 3.1 and PCIe Gen 5.1 specifications, ensuring they deliver peak performance for future hardware upgrades. Certified with 80 PLUS® Gold efficiency and achieving platinum-level efficiency at typical loads, these power supplies minimise power loss, heat, and noise, offering a cooler and quieter operation.

The advanced LLC resonant-converter topology with synchronous rectification reduces switching losses and keeps the output voltage stable, even under heavy loads, maximising overall system efficiency. The +5V and 3.3V DC to DC circuit design ensures consistent voltage and system stability, while premium 105°C Japanese bulk capacitors provide top-tier reliability and longevity, making them the ideal choice for high-performance PCs. Whether you’re a gamer or a power user, these PSUs deliver lasting power and performance you can count on.

The Hikvision X12 Portable All-In-One FULL HD Conference Camera delivers exceptional video and audio quality, making it ideal for seamless virtual meetings. Featuring a 2 MP CMOS sensor with WDR technology, it provides high-quality imaging at 1920 × 1080 resolution, ensuring clear visuals even in low-light environments (0.1 Lux @ F2.2, AGC ON) and strong backlight conditions with 120 dB true WDR.

The USB Type-C interface supports USB 3.0, enabling plug-and-play functionality without the need for drivers. Powered by a 2450 mAh lithium battery, it offers portability and ease of use, compatible with leading online communication platforms, making it perfect for modern conferencing needs.

product.name: Xiaomi Mesh System AC1200 - 3 Pack
product.description:
The Xiaomi Mesh System AC1200 - 3 Pack delivers seamless, whole-home Wi-Fi coverage with advanced self-developed Mesh technology. Designed to eliminate dead zones, it supports both wired and wireless networking or a combination of the two, providing flexibility for any setup. The system boasts millisecond-level link self-healing capabilities, which optimise network topology in real-time, ensuring a stable and uninterrupted connection throughout your home.

With dual-band support for 2.4GHz and 5GHz frequencies, the Xiaomi Mesh System AC1200 achieves wireless speeds of up to 1200Mbps, effortlessly handling high-bandwidth activities like streaming, gaming, and video conferencing. Its smart roaming feature automatically connects your devices to the nearest and fastest node as you move around, providing consistent, high-speed internet access no matter where you are in the house.

The system is equipped to handle up to 192 devices with the 3-pack configuration, making it an excellent choice for smart homes with multiple connected devices. Featuring two gigabit WAN/LAN auto-sensing ports, it delivers gigabit-level performance without needing to distinguish port functionality, simplifying installation. Pre-paired units make setup a breeze—just designate any router as the main unit, power on the others, and the system automatically forms a Mesh network.

Enhanced with Xiaomi’s Easy Connect for smart devices, the Mesh System integrates seamlessly with the Xiaomi Home/Mi Home app, allowing for easy password management and synchronisation. The exclusive gaming acceleration channel for Xiaomi and Redmi smartphones reduces lag, ensuring a superior gaming experience. Encased in a sleek, minimalist design, the Xiaomi Mesh System AC1200 not only enhances your home’s connectivity but also complements your living space with its compact and elegant form factor.

product.name: Xiaomi Wireless Mouse Lite 2 - Black
product.description:
The Xiaomi Wireless Mouse Lite 2 combines a sleek, minimalist design with impressive performance, making it a versatile choice for both home and office setups. Its lightweight construction, weighing just 45g without a battery, ensures effortless control and quick cursor positioning, reducing wrist strain even during prolonged use. The ergonomic curvature of the mouse body provides a comfortable grip that suits various hand sizes and grips, delivering constant support for seamless operation. Available in timeless solid colours, the mouse effortlessly complements any desktop arrangement, adding a touch of understated sophistication.

Powered by a 2.4GHz wireless connection, the Xiaomi Wireless Mouse Lite 2 offers a stable and responsive signal, freeing you from tangled wires and ensuring smooth performance. Equipped with a 1000 DPI precision sensor, it enables accurate and quick feedback, ideal for daily tasks like work, browsing, or casual gaming. The middle scroll wheel features a tactile, crisp response for both auditory and physical feedback, further enhancing usability. Designed for portability, the wireless receiver is neatly concealed in the mouse's underneath compartment, ensuring it's secure and always ready when needed.

Built for smooth operation and long-term durability, the Xiaomi Wireless Mouse Lite 2 features PTFE Teflon foot pads with a low friction coefficient, ensuring fluid movement across surfaces. The reliable TTC microswitches provide quick, responsive clicks, enhancing productivity and performance. With its streamlined aesthetic, lightweight feel, and ergonomic design, the Xiaomi Wireless Mouse Lite 2 offers a comfortable, efficient experience, perfectly blending form and function to meet the demands of modern users.

This translates into applications that open faster, smoother transitions between programs, and an overall more pleasant user interaction, especially for those with 4GB or less RAM currently installed.

A foundation for everyday computing

This Patriot memory module is built on reliable DDR3L technology, operating at a frequency of 1600MT/s. The 1.35V operating voltage is standard for DDR3L memory, ensuring compatibility with a wide range of motherboards that support this technology. This Patriot Signature DDR3L is an ideal solution for upgrading older desktops or for building a new system focused on essential daily tasks.

Dependable performance for your daily tasks

The Patriot Signature Line is synonymous with reliability. This Patriot 4GB DDR3L RAM adheres to strict quality control standards, ensuring consistent performance and stability. It is a non-ECC unbuffered module, which is standard for most consumer-grade desktop systems, providing a direct performance path without the overhead of error correction codes. The single-rank design is also a common and effective configuration for everyday use. When you need memory that simply works and contributes positively to your daily workflow, this module is a sensible choice.

Upgrade your user experience with ease using Patriot Signature DDR3L

Elevate your computing to new heights with the AMD Ryzen™ 9000 Series CPUs. These processors represent the pinnacle of desktop performance, engineered for those who demand the best from their systems. With integrated AMD Radeon™ Graphics, enjoy breathtaking visuals and seamless gameplay without the need for a separate graphics card, making these CPUs ideal for gamers and creators alike.

The AMD Ryzen™ 9000 Series features AMD EXPO™ Technology, delivering optimised settings and enhanced gaming performance. This technology ensures that your games run smoothly and look stunning, providing an immersive experience that takes your gaming to the next level.

This future-proofing ensures that your system remains cutting-edge, capable of handling the most demanding applications and games with ease.

Security and efficiency are paramount with the Ryzen 9000 Series. Integrated security features protect your system from modern threats, while advanced thermal solutions keep your CPU cool and efficient, even under heavy loads. This ensures that your system remains reliable and secure, allowing you to focus on what matters most.

product.name: WINX DOODLE Max USI 2.0 Stylus
product.description:
Unlock your creativity with 4096 levels of pressure and tilt sensitivity for natural drawing and note-taking, all while enjoying the convenience of a magnetic attachment and tail eraser.

Quick Specs

  • Experience natural writing and drawing with 4096 levels of pressure and tilt sensitivity.
  • Enjoy seamless compatibility with USI 2.0 enabled devices, plus backward compatibility with USI 1.0.
  • Benefit from palm rejection and magnetic attachment for uninterrupted workflow and easy storage.
  • Utilise the convenient tail eraser for quick corrections and the LED indicator for battery status.
  • Achieve up to 110 hours of operating time on a single charge via USB Type-C.

Unleash your digital artistry with the WINX DOODLE Max USI 2.0 Stylus

Designed for creators, students, and professionals in South Africa, the WINX DOODLE Max is more than just an input device; it is an extension of your thoughts and ideas. This USI 2.0 stylus is engineered to bring the precision and feel of traditional drawing and writing to the digital realm. Whether you are sketching a new design, annotating important documents, or taking lecture notes, the DOODLE Max offers an unparalleled level of control and responsiveness. Its robust build quality and advanced features make it the ideal companion for a wide range of USI 2.0 enabled tablets, ensuring your creative flow is never interrupted. This stylus is for the discerning user who demands accuracy, comfort, and versatility in their digital tools.

Precision and comfort for every stroke

At the core of the WINX DOODLE Max's performance lies its exceptional sensitivity. With 4096 levels of pressure and tilt sensitivity, the stylus for Chromebook translates the subtlest nuances of your hand movements into precise on-screen actions. This means that the harder you press, the thicker the line, and the angle of your stroke influences the shading, much like a real pencil or brush. This intuitive control is further enhanced by advanced palm rejection technology, which ensures that only the stylus interacts with the screen, preventing accidental marks from your resting hand. The ergonomic design, crafted from durable aluminium alloy, ensures comfort even during extended creative sessions.

Seamless integration and intuitive control

The WINX DOODLE Max is built on the universal stylus initiative (USI) 2.0 standard, offering broad compatibility with leading USI 2.0 enabled devices. This ensures that your USI stylus will work effortlessly with a wide array of popular tablets and Chromebooks. For those with slightly older devices, backward compatibility with USI 1.0 provides extended usability. Beyond its core function, the DOODLE Max features a convenient tail eraser, allowing for quick and easy corrections without needing to switch tools. The magnetic attachment offers a secure and accessible place to store your stylus when not in use, preventing loss and keeping it readily available.

Power and efficiency for uninterrupted creativity

Never be caught with a dead stylus again. The WINX DOODLE Max boasts an impressive operating time of up to 110 hours on a single charge, powered by a rechargeable battery that is easily replenished via the included USB Type-C port. Charging takes approximately 60 minutes, ensuring minimal downtime. Furthermore, intelligent power management features, including an auto power-saving mode that activates after 5 minutes of inactivity and a standby time of up to 180 days, maximise battery longevity. The integrated LED indicator provides a clear visual cue of the battery status, so you are always aware of when a charge is needed.

Features

  • Create with unparalleled accuracy thanks to 4096 levels of pressure and tilt sensitivity that mimic real-world tools.
  • Draw and write naturally without unwanted marks using advanced palm rejection technology.
  • Effortlessly attach and store your stylus with the convenient magnetic mounting feature.
  • Make quick corrections on the fly with the integrated tail eraser functionality.
  • Stay informed about your stylus's power status with the clear LED battery indicator.
  • Enjoy broad compatibility with USI 2.0 enabled devices, plus backward compatibility with USI 1.0.
  • Experience extended usage with up to 110 hours of operating time and efficient USB Type-C charging.
  • Utilise mapped custom functions for a personalised and efficient workflow. This ensures a superior experience for any user seeking a reliable USI 2.0 stylus.

product.name: MSI B650M PROJECT ZERO MotherBoard

The MSI B650M PROJECT ZERO motherboard redefines modern PC building with a unique combination of form, function, and cutting-edge technology. Tailored for gamers, content creators, and tech enthusiasts, this micro-ATX motherboard supports AMD Ryzen™ 7000 series processors, providing an efficient and high-performance platform for your next-generation build. The standout feature of the MSI B650M PROJECT ZERO is the 'Back Connect Design,' which relocates essential connectors and headers to the motherboard's rear, improving airflow and ensuring a clean and efficient front-facing build.

Built with robust thermal management in mind, it features an extended heatsink for better heat dissipation, while the M.2 Shield Frozr helps prevent SSD thermal throttling. Whether you're into competitive gaming or resource-intensive tasks, this motherboard supports high-speed networking via Wi-Fi 6E and a 2.5Gbps LAN port, ensuring uninterrupted online experiences. Additionally, the motherboard offers a vast array of USB ports, including high-speed USB 3.2 and Type-C, perfect for transferring large files swiftly.

The MSI B650M PROJECT ZERO's design not only prioritizes performance but also supports future-proofing with its DDR5 memory overclocking capabilities, empowering your system to handle the latest software and demanding workloads. This motherboard is engineered for those who demand the best in both aesthetics and performance, with every feature meticulously crafted to maximize your computing experience.

For a compatible and stylish chassis to house your components, consider pairing the MSI B650M PROJECT ZERO with the MSI MAG PANO M100R PZ Gaming Chassis (Black/White), designed to enhance both the look and functionality of your build.

product.name: V-Sol V1600GS-F Single Port GPON Optical Line Terminal
product.description:
The VSOL V1600GS-F Single Port GPON OLT is a high-performance, cost-effective optical line terminal purpose-built for delivering ultra-fast and reliable fiber optic connectivity across small to medium-sized networks. Designed in a compact 1U box form factor, the V1600GS-F integrates GPON OLT functionality with gateway and AC controller features, making it an all-in-one solution for FTTH (Fiber-to-the-Home), SOHO environments, SMBs, and rental housing network upgrades.

Equipped with one GPON port and supporting a splitting ratio of up to 1:128, this device can handle large-scale user deployments while maintaining excellent performance. With transmission distances of up to 20km, the V1600GS-F ensures stable and long-range coverage, perfect for delivering gigabit broadband services over passive optical networks.

Capable of 1.25Gbps upstream and 2.5Gbps downstream, the V1600GS-F is ideal for applications that demand high throughput such as HD video streaming, IP telephony, cloud access, and enterprise-level data management. Its flexible deployment makes it suitable for both urban and rural network topologies where performance and affordability are critical.

The device features three uplink ports — two Gigabit Ethernet RJ45 and one SFP/SFP+ combo port supporting up to 10Gbps — ensuring fast and scalable backhaul connectivity. It includes centralized network management through WEB, Telnet, CLI, and SNMP, offering streamlined deployment and simplified administration across a range of network architectures. With support for plug-and-play AP control and centralized AC management, it forms the backbone of a POL (Passive Optical LAN) setup for modern offices and enterprise parks.

Additionally, the V1600GS-F is engineered for resilience and durability, featuring 4KV lightning protection for power and 1KV surge protection on device interfaces. It also supports both AC (100~240V) and DC (12V/2A) power inputs, offering flexibility across installation scenarios.

FEATURES:

  • All-in-one Single Port GPON OLT
  • Integrated OLT, Gateway and AC Function
  • High-Speed Fiber Optic Coverage
  • Easy Installation Saves Investment
  • Centralized Management and Plug & Play
  • AC+AP Solution
  • POL Network of Small & Medium-sized Enterprises
  • Rental Housing Network Renovation

SPECIFICATIONS:

  • Rack: 1U
  • Uplink Port
    • QTY: 3
    • RJ45(GE): 2
    • SFP(GE)/SFP+(10GE): 1
  • GPON Port Specification

    • Connector: SC/UPC, TX: 7.5±0.5dBm, Sen: -32dBm
    • GPON port speed: Upstream 1.244Gbps | Downstream 2.488Gbps
    • Wavelength: TX 1490nm, RX 1310nm
    • Max splitting ratio: 1:128
    • Transmission Distance: 20KM
  • Management Ports: 1 x USB-COM(Type-C) port
  • Backplane Bandwidth: 16Gbps
  • Port Forwarding Rate: 23.808Mpps

product.name: Cudy LT400 4G LTE N300 300Mbps Wi-Fi Router
product.description:
The Cudy LT400 4G LTE N300 300Mbps Wi-Fi Router is a versatile networking solution, designed to provide reliable internet connectivity even in challenging environments. With 4G Cat. 4 support, it delivers download speeds of up to 150 Mbps and upload speeds of 50 Mbps, ideal for tasks like web browsing, video streaming, surveillance, and POS services. The N300 Wi-Fi ensures a strong and stable network, supported by Beamforming technology and two built-in antennas for enhanced coverage.

Setting up the LT400 is as simple as inserting a SIM card and connecting it to the included PoE adapter, allowing for network deployment up to 100 meters from the adapter. For larger areas, you can expand coverage by pairing the LT400 with additional Cudy access points, enabling seamless Wi-Fi connectivity across cafes, homes, or offices. The router also features flexible WAN/LAN port configurations, a USB port for storage and sharing, and SMA connectors for customizable antenna upgrades, providing adaptability to meet your networking needs.

Built with convenience and security in mind, the LT400 supports PPTP/L2TP VPN clients for secure connections and Wi-Fi scheduling for efficient management. Its 4G watchdog feature ensures automatic reconnection in case of network drops, maintaining uninterrupted service. With its robust design, user-friendly setup, and reliable performance, the Cudy LT400 is an excellent choice for a high-performance network.
