product.name: Xiaomi Sound Outdoor 30W Portable Bluetooth Speaker - Blue
product.description:
The Xiaomi Sound Outdoor 30W Portable Bluetooth Speaker offers a powerful audio experience, delivering 30W of sound output for dynamic bass and crystal-clear highs. Equipped with True Wireless Stereo (TWS) technology, this speaker provides an immersive listening experience by pairing seamlessly with multiple speakers for a richer soundstage. Its smart audio balancing feature ensures optimal sound quality, while its compact and lightweight design makes it easy to carry for outdoor adventures. With IP67-rated dust and water resistance, the speaker is built to withstand the elements, making it an excellent choice for on-the-go entertainment.

One of the standout features of the Xiaomi Sound Outdoor Speaker is its impressive battery life, providing up to 12 hours of playback on a single charge, at 50% volume. The 7.2V, 2600mAh lithium-ion battery can be fully charged in just 2.5 hours, making it ideal for extended use. Whether you’re camping, hiking, or enjoying a day at the beach, you can rely on the speaker's durable performance. Bluetooth 5.4 technology ensures a stable connection over distances of up to 25 meters in an open area, offering the freedom to move around without losing sound quality.

In addition to its robust performance, the Xiaomi Sound Outdoor Speaker features an elegant design with a silicone anti-slip pad that ensures it stays in place during use. The built-in microphone allows for hands-free calling with a simple tap, adding convenience to its versatility. For larger gatherings, the TWS combo feature supports pairing with up to 100 units, making it a perfect choice for parties or events. Overall, the Xiaomi Sound Outdoor Speaker blends functionality, durability, and style, offering a high-quality audio solution for any outdoor setting.

product.name: Xiaomi Magnetic Reading Light Bar
product.description:
The Xiaomi Magnetic Reading Light Bar combines thoughtful design with practical features to deliver exceptional illumination for a variety of settings. Its 36cm extended lamp head and 150lm wide-angle light source ensure uniform lighting across a large area, such as a desk, enhancing visibility and comfort. The specially designed textured optical lens reduces glare through multiple refractions, providing softer, more natural light. With an impressive CRI of Ra90, the lamp accurately restores true colors, making it ideal for reading, studying, or entertainment. Whether you're working late or relaxing, the light bar provides a comfortable, natural light experience even in dark environments.

Designed with eye health in mind, the RG0 blue light hazard exemption rating ensures the Xiaomi Magnetic Reading Light Bar delivers safe, flicker-free illumination. Its eye-friendly light reduces eye strain, even with prolonged use, making it perfect for long study sessions or evening work. The built-in 2000mAh battery delivers up to 4.5 hours of continuous use at maximum brightness, allowing you to bring light wherever you need it. Whether you're illuminating tight spaces, a desk, or using it on the go, the light bar’s portability and long-lasting battery life ensure reliable performance.

For added flexibility, the lamp head features a ±25° adjustable rotation, enabling you to position the light exactly where you need it. With three adjustable brightness levels, you can customize the lighting for various scenarios, from reading to relaxing. The touch-sensitive controls make operation simple and intuitive-tap to turn the light on or off, and press to adjust brightness. Additionally, the detachable lamp head can be used as a handheld torch, offering even more versatility for tasks that require mobile lighting.

Installation is seamless with the magnetic base and 3M double-sided adhesive, allowing secure attachment to any surface without drilling. product.name: WINX CAST More HDMI Wireless Display Transmitter
product.description:
Present from an additional laptop, notebook, or HDMI-enabled device during boardroom meetings with the WINX CAST More HDMI Wireless Display Transmitter. Elevate your boardroom presentations and meetings by adding an additional HDMI WINX transmitter to your WINX HDMI wireless receiver, designed to make idea and project sharing effortless.*

Whether you’re leading a meeting, hosting a workshop, or brainstorming with your team, this solution allows you to wirelessly share content from your HDMI laptop or notebook to any HDMI TV or projector display with ease. Say goodbye to complicated setups and tangled cables - this device is truly plug-and-play, letting you start sharing in seconds without the need for any apps, drivers, software, or licenses.

With crisp 1080p@60Hz resolution and a range of up to 30 barrier-free metres, this wireless HDMI transmitter delivers smooth, quality video and audio thanks to built-in 5GHz WIFI connectivity. That means your presentations, videos, and designs come across clearly and without interruptions, ensuring your ideas are communicated effectively.

This device even doubles as an HDMI extender, providing flexibility in larger rooms by extending the range between your source device and display. The HDMI receiver can pair up to 5 transmitters allowing multiple presenters to switch between sharing their displays, making it perfect for group collaboration so the whole team can contribute and present.* And when it’s time to switch between devices, it’s as simple as pressing a button - no fuss, no interruptions.

The WINX CAST More HDMI Wireless Display Transmitter is compatible with many modern laptops and devices, as well as legacy devices. Like the wireless HDMI receiver, this HDMI transmitter plugs directly into your display and conveniently powers through USB (via included Type-C to USB cable for the transmitter), keeping your device charged while you present, ensuring that your team’s workflow isn’t interrupted.

No matter if you're using Windows, Linux, macOS, Android, or iOS, this versatile HDMI to HDMI wireless transmitter system works seamlessly with all major platforms, making it an excellent choice for a wide range of users.

Designed for modern work environments, the WINX CAST HDMI Wireless HDMI transmitter and HDMI receiver are an innovative duo ideal for streamlining business meetings and creative workspaces. No subscription fees, no hidden costs - just reliable, fast, instant connection and display that provides more efficient team communication. With this additional WINX HDMI to HDMI wireless transmitter, collaborating during meetings has never been easier.

The Antec Atom V650 650W Non-Modular Power Supply is engineered to deliver reliable performance and efficiency for your PC build. Designed with a 120mm Silent Fan, it ensures quiet operation while maintaining a cool system temperature. Backed by Antec's AQ2 Quality Warranty, which includes two years of parts and labor coverage and exceptional technical support, the Atom V650 is built to meet the demands of modern computing with confidence.

Its CircuitShield™ protections—including Over Voltage Protection (OVP), Over Power Protection (OPP), Short Circuit Protection (SCP), and No Load Operation (NLO)—safeguard your system from potential damage, making it a dependable choice for a wide range of applications.

product.name: Keychron Double Shot PBT OSA Full Keycap Set - Black/White
product.description:
The Keychron Double-Shot PBT OSA Full Keycap Set is designed to bring both durability and style to your mechanical keyboard setup. Featuring an OSA profile, which combines the height of OEM keycaps with a gently spherical angled surface, this keycap set offers a comfortable and ergonomic typing experience. The double-shot legends ensure long-lasting visibility, preventing wear and fading over time while adding a unique flair to your keyboard.

Made from high-quality PBT material, these keycaps provide excellent oil resistance, preventing the glossy sheen that often appears with prolonged use. This enhances the typing feel, offering a more satisfying and consistent keystroke. The robust construction ensures that your keycaps remain in pristine condition for years to come, making them a reliable choice for any keyboard enthusiast.

With a thickness of 1.3mm, these keycaps are designed for stability and precision. The OSA profile delivers a tactile and comfortable experience suitable for both gaming and professional use. As a non-backlit keycap set, it emphasizes a clean and sophisticated aesthetic, making it perfect for those who prefer a minimalist desk setup.

This keycap set is widely compatible with a variety of Keychron keyboards, including the V, Q, K, L, P, and C series. Designed for MX-style switches, it ensures a secure and seamless fit. Whether you’re upgrading your existing keyboard or customizing a new build, the Keychron Double-Shot PBT OSA Full Keycap Set is an excellent choice for those seeking both durability and refined design.

FEATURES:

  • Double shot PBT
  • OSA profile
  • Durable material with legends that last
  • Widely compatible with V, Q, K, L, P, and C series Keychron keyboards
  • Designed for use with MX switches

product.name: Keychron M3 RGB Wireless Optical Mouse - White
product.description:
The Keychron M3 RGB Wireless Optical Mouse is engineered for gamers, professionals, and creative users who demand precision, speed, and reliable wireless performance. Built around the powerful PixArt 3395 sensor, the M3 delivers ultra-accurate tracking with a DPI range of 100 to 26,000, ensuring pixel-perfect control whether you are editing images, navigating complex workflows, or competing in fast-paced gaming environments. With IPS speeds of up to 650 and an impressive 1000Hz polling rate in wired and 2.4GHz modes, this mouse provides near-instant response times, delivering the smooth, lag-free performance expected from high-end peripherals. Its ergonomic shape and ultra-lightweight 79g design ensure exceptional comfort during long sessions, making it an excellent choice for both productivity and competitive gameplay.

Designed for versatility, the Keychron M3 supports three connection modes — USB wired, ultra-low latency 2.4GHz wireless, and Bluetooth 5.1, allowing seamless switching between devices such as laptops, desktops, and tablets. The durable Kailh GM 8.0 micro switches offer crisp tactile feedback and extended durability, ensuring reliable clicks through thousands of hours of use. A 600mAh rechargeable battery provides up to 70 hours of usage, making the mouse ideal for both office and gaming setups where uninterrupted performance is essential. Complementing its performance is customisable RGB backlighting, adding a sleek modern aesthetic that fits perfectly into any RGB-enabled workstation or gaming battle station.

FEATURES:

  • Powered by the PixArt 3395 optical sensor with adjustable 100 – 26,000 DPI for precise control across all applications.
  • Connect via USB wired, 2.4GHz wireless with 1000Hz polling rate, or Bluetooth 5.1 for maximum flexibility.
  • Supports up to 650 IPS tracking speed and 1000Hz polling rate for minimal latency and smooth cursor movement.
  • High-quality Kailh GM 8.0 micro switches provide crisp, tactile clicks and long-lasting durability.
  • Weighing only 79g, the M3 is designed for extended comfort and effortless movement.
  • Integrated RGB backlighting enhances your workspace with vibrant illumination and modern aesthetics.

product.name: Keychron CHERRY MX2A Silent Red Switch Set

Enhance your typing and gaming experience with the Keychron CHERRY MX2A Silent Red RGB Switch Set, the latest evolution of the renowned CHERRY MX switches. Designed for unparalleled precision and durability, the MX2A series features a smoother keystroke, improved actuation consistency, and a refined sound profile. Whether you are a dedicated typist, an esports professional, or a mechanical keyboard enthusiast, these switches deliver a premium feel that elevates every keystroke.

The Keychron CHERRY MX2A Silent Red Switch Set introduces an optimised lubrication process that enhances smoothness while reducing friction, resulting in a seamless and responsive performance. The gold crosspoint contact system ensures superior reliability with up to 50 million keystrokes, making these switches a long-term investment for your mechanical keyboard. Available in multiple variants, including linear, tactile, and clicky options, this set caters to every user preference, from ultra-responsive keypresses to satisfying tactile feedback. Upgrade your keyboard’s performance with the Keychron CHERRY MX2A Silent Red RGB Silent Switch Set and experience precision-engineered keystrokes with every press.

  • Barrel spring geometry reduces inner scratches
  • Unique spring-centering stem structure provides consistent actuation
  • Bottom housing design minimises scratchiness and enhances acoustics

product.name: Keychron B6 Pro Ultra-Slim 100% Wireless Keyboard – Ivory White
product.description:
The Keychron B6 Pro Ultra-Slim 100% Wireless Keyboard is a sleek, full-size keyboard designed to deliver high performance and versatility in a lightweight and ultra-thin package. It supports 2.4GHz wireless, Bluetooth, and wired modes, allowing seamless connectivity with phones, tablets, PCs, and Macs. ZMK customisation enables users to tailor settings for home, office, or on the go, offering a truly personalised experience across multiple devices. Its ultra-slim body and lightweight design strike a balance between portability and functionality, making it an excellent choice for users who need mobility and productivity.

The B6 Pro’s battery life is one of its standout features, offering up to 1200 hours of continuous use, which is about 8 months with 5 hours of daily typing. This extended battery performance ensures long-term reliability, and the keyboard can even be used while charging, allowing uninterrupted productivity. The 2.4 GHz wireless connection delivers a responsive 1000 Hz polling rate, ideal for a clutter-free setup, while Bluetooth 5.2 makes switching between devices fast and effortless. Whether for work or leisure, the B6 Pro provides a smooth, high-performance wireless experience that enhances multitasking across different devices.

Designed with both Mac and Windows users in mind, the B6 Pro maintains a Mac layout while offering full compatibility with Windows, providing the same multimedia and function key support found in Apple keyboards but with improved tactile feedback. The concave keycaps ensure precise typing, reducing errors and improving comfort during long sessions. With features like emoji shortcuts, customisable keymaps through the Keychron Launcher, and a protective silicone key skin, the B6 Pro is a versatile, user-friendly keyboard that offers a premium typing experience with enhanced protection against spills and wear.

FEATURES:

  • Ultra-slim and lightweight design
  • Scissor mechanism for switches
  • 1000Hz Polling Rate
  • 8 months battery life
  • 2.4GHz and Bluetooth connection
  • Support for Mac OS and Windows
  • ZMK support for more customisation

product.name: FSP VITA GM 850W 80 PLUS Gold Fully Modular Power Supply
product.description:
Built to handle the demanding power requirements of tomorrow, these PSUs support total power excursion as per ATX 3.1 and PCIe Gen 5.1 specifications, ensuring they deliver peak performance for future hardware upgrades. Certified with 80 PLUS® Gold efficiency and achieving platinum-level efficiency at typical loads, these power supplies minimise power loss, heat, and noise, offering a cooler and quieter operation.

The advanced LLC resonant-converter topology with synchronous rectification reduces switching losses and keeps the output voltage stable, even under heavy loads, maximising overall system efficiency. The +5V and 3.3V DC to DC circuit design ensures consistent voltage and system stability, while premium 105°C Japanese bulk capacitors provide top-tier reliability and longevity, making them the ideal choice for high-performance PCs. Whether you’re a gamer or a power user, these PSUs deliver lasting power and performance you can count on.

FEATURES:

  • Complies with ATX 12V V3.1 & EPS 12V V2.92
  • Efficiency ≧ 90% at typical load
  • 80 PLUS ® gold certified
  • 105°C Japanese bulk capacitor
  • 120mm hydraulic bearing (HYB) fan
  • Fully modular cabling design
  • Complete protections: OCP, OVP, SCP, OPP, UVP, OTP

product.name: Xiaomi AC1200 Whole Home Mesh Wi-Fi System (1-Pack)
product.description:
The Xiaomi AC1200 Mesh System Router 1 Pack is designed to provide comprehensive, high-speed Wi-Fi coverage for large homes while seamlessly blending into your home decor. Its sleek, white, minimalist design enhances the aesthetic of any living space, making it both a functional and stylish addition to your home network. The compact size ensures that it fits effortlessly in any room without taking up too much space.

Setting up the Xiaomi Mesh System is incredibly easy. All units are pre-paired before leaving the factory, allowing any unit to serve as the main router. Once the network configuration is completed on the main router, the other units can be powered on to automatically form a Mesh network. This mesh technology from Xiaomi ensures that signal blind spots are eliminated, providing strong and consistent Wi-Fi coverage even in complex housing layouts.

The Xiaomi AC1200 Mesh System supports multiple routers to form wired, wireless, or hybrid Mesh networks. It features millisecond-level roaming latency and automatic network optimisation, ensuring real-time, uninterrupted Wi-Fi throughout your home. With dual-band wireless speeds of up to 1200Mbps, the system provides fast and reliable internet. The 2.4GHz band excels at penetrating walls for better coverage, while the 5GHz band offers higher bandwidth for faster speeds.

This system is equipped with two Gigabit WAN/LAN auto-sensing Ethernet ports for flexible use and supports connectivity for over 120 devices. Whether you're streaming films, attending online classes, gaming, or controlling smart home devices, the Xiaomi Mesh System handles it all effortlessly. Additionally, you can monitor and manage your network status in real-time with the Mi Home/Xiaomi Home app. The system also prioritises Xiaomi and Redmi smartphones, providing an exclusive acceleration channel in gaming scenarios to reduce lag and latency.

product.name: Xiaomi Handheld Garment Steamer
product.description:
The Xiaomi Handheld Garment Steamer is a lightweight and compact solution for effortlessly removing wrinkles and refreshing your clothes. Weighing just 770g, it is designed for extended use without fatigue and easily folds for convenient storage or travel. The steamer's metallic soleplate, enhanced with a ceramic enamel coating, heats up in just 26 seconds, maintaining a consistent temperature for smooth and stain-free steaming. It’s versatile enough to handle a variety of fabrics, ensuring a polished look for all your garments.

Equipped with 30kPa pressurization technology, the steamer delivers powerful bursts of fine steam, effectively smoothing out wrinkles without soaking your clothes. Its 2-in-1 design supports both hanging and flat steaming, making it ideal for delicate, lightweight materials and thicker garments alike. The curved steam release button ensures precision control—steam activates with a press and stops instantly upon release, reducing the risk of accidental scalding.

The steamer includes a transparent 160ml water tank, allowing you to monitor water levels easily. With its generous capacity, you can steam up to six shirts without needing a refill. Beyond wrinkle removal, the high-temperature steam sanitizes your clothes, eliminating up to 99.99% of mites and bacteria to keep fabrics fresh, clean, and comfortable.

Practical features like the 5° angled steamer head, indicator light, and 1.9m rubber power cord make this steamer user-friendly and adaptable to any steaming task. Whether you’re preparing for a busy day or packing for a trip, the Xiaomi Handheld Garment Steamer ensures your clothes are always neat, sanitized, and ready to wear.

The Cudy AX3000 Mesh Wi-Fi 6 System is a powerful networking solution designed to meet the demands of modern homes with high-bandwidth activities like 4K streaming, online gaming, and smart home integration. With a 1.3 GHz dual-core CPU and efficient system tools, the Cudy AX3000 ensures reliable performance and easy network management. The intuitive system panel provides clear insights into network status, while the built-in diagnostic tool simplifies troubleshooting. Whether you’re managing over 200 connected devices, running simultaneous streams, or maintaining a secure and private network, the Cudy AX3000 Mesh Wi-Fi 6 System offers a dependable and versatile solution tailored for today’s connected lifestyle.

product.name: Antec P12 PWM 120mm ARGB Reverse Case Fan - White
product.description:
The Antec P12R ARGB 120 PWM Case Fan combines innovative design, powerful performance, and vibrant aesthetics to elevate your PC's cooling and style. Featuring a reverse fan blade design, it delivers smoother air intake while presenting a cleaner, more streamlined appearance. With its 9-blade structure, the fan ensures efficient ventilation and robust airflow, even under high air resistance, maintaining superior cooling performance for demanding gaming and workloads.

Dynamic ARGB lighting adds a stunning visual dimension, offering a full spectrum of customizable colours to match any gamer's setup. The vibrant illumination brings your build to life, making it a standout centrepiece for any rig. This fan also supports precise PWM control, allowing users to fine-tune their ideal balance of low noise and high performance, with a speed range from 600 to 1500 RPM.

Engineered for quiet operation and durability, the P12R features hydraulic bearings and eight anti-vibration rubber pads, which reduce noise and minimize vibrations during operation. With a noise level as low as 14.2 dB(A) and a maximum of just 29.5 dB(A), this fan delivers efficient cooling without compromising your system's acoustic profile. Its long lifespan of up to 40,000 hours at 25°C ensures reliable and consistent performance over time.

Designed with both performance and convenience in mind, the Antec P12R ARGB 120 PWM Fan is equipped with a 4-pin PWM connector for fan control and a 3-pin connector for ARGB lighting synchronization. Whether you're optimizing cooling for intense gaming sessions or enhancing your build's aesthetic appeal, this fan provides an exceptional combination of functionality, style, and quiet efficiency.

  • Reverse PWM fan design
  • 9-blade for superior heat dissipation
  • Dynamic ARGB lighting
  • Hydraulic bearing fan for long-lasting performance

product.name: Xiaomi Body Composition Scale S400
product.description:
The Xiaomi Body Composition Scale S400 is an essential tool for anyone committed to a healthy lifestyle. This advanced scale measures body fat percentage and muscle mass to provide a comprehensive analysis of your physical health. Utilising high and low dual-frequency alternating currents, it accurately assesses the electrical impedance of intracellular and extracellular fluids, delivering precise data on body fat, water content, and muscle mass.

Benchmarking against the gold standard of Dual-Energy X-ray Absorptiometry (DEXA), the Xiaomi Body Composition Scale S400 achieves a remarkable correlation coefficient of ≥0.93* for key metrics like body fat percentage and fat mass. This high level of accuracy ensures reliable data, helping you identify hidden factors that may contribute to obesity. With this detailed analysis, you can scientifically manage your body shape and overall health more effectively.

product.name: Cudy AX3000 2.5G Dual Band Ceiling Access Point- Outdoor
product.description:
The Cudy AX3000 2.5G Dual Band Ceiling Access Point - Outdoor is an excellent choice for converting LAN networks into high-speed, dependable wireless networks. This pole or wall-mounted WiFi 6 AP with eFEM provides excellent range performance, making it ideal for high-density environments like parks, farms, and parking lots. Its robust IP65 casing, Power over Ethernet (PoE), and Cudy Mesh features make it ideal for outdoor use. It achieves total throughput of up to 3 Gbps by using the highest 160 MHz channel width and 1024-QAM modulation. OFDMA and MU-MIMO technologies can support over 100 devices with low latency, with a maximum capacity of 512 devices.

The AP's five power amplifiers and 3+2 antenna structure provide excellent signal navigation through obstacles. The IP65 case protects it from rain and dust, and the 6 kV Lightning/Surge and 8 kV ESD protection ensures stability during thunderstorms. It can operate at temperatures ranging from -40°F to 158°F (-40°C to 70°C). Mesh technology provides a unified Wi-Fi name across the premises, allowing for seamless roaming without the need for manual switching. Connecting the PoE adapter's LAN port to various Cudy devices integrates the AP into the Mesh network, with the option of using Ethernet backhaul after pairing. Adaptive Routing improves network performance by switching to better paths when the original ones become congested.

Empower your home or small office network with the Cudy GS105D Gigabit Ethernet Switch.

This compact and efficient 5-port gigabit switch is designed for users in South Africa who require a reliable, high-speed connection for multiple devices. Whether you are streaming high-definition content, engaging in online gaming, or transferring large files, the GS105D provides the bandwidth and stability needed to keep your digital life running smoothly. Its plug-and-play functionality means no complex configuration is necessary; simply connect your devices and experience an immediate improvement in network performance with this versatile USB Type-C powered switch.

Engineered for consistent performance and efficiency.

The Cudy GS105D is built to deliver superior network performance without unnecessary complexity. Featuring five gigabit RJ45 ports, it offers a total switching capacity of 10 Gbps, ensuring that data flows efficiently between your connected devices. The integrated IGMP Snooping feature optimises network traffic, particularly beneficial for streaming applications. Its compact form factor and quiet operation make it suitable for any environment, from a busy office desk to a home entertainment centre. The utilisation of USB Type-C for power input simplifies connectivity and reduces cable clutter, aligning with modern user preferences for a clean setup.

Reliability and thoughtful design for everyday use.

Understanding the demands of a modern network, the GS105D incorporates thoughtful design elements. It supports IEEE 802.3 protocols, including 10/100/1000BASE-T, and offers flow control to manage network congestion effectively. The Cudy GS105D is an ideal 5-port gigabit switch for expanding your connectivity needs. It is designed to operate reliably within a standard temperature range and is built with consideration for environmental factors such as ESD and surge protection, ensuring longevity and dependable service in typical South African conditions. The low idle power consumption further enhances its appeal as an energy-conscious networking solution.

A gateway to enhanced connectivity.

For professionals and home users alike, the need for a stable, fast, and expandable network is paramount. The Cudy GS105D, a robust USB Type-C powered switch, addresses this need directly, offering a straightforward yet powerful solution. Its robust MAC address table and high forwarding rate ensure efficient data handling, even under heavy load. The inclusion of a jumbo frame size of 9 KB supports larger data packets, which can improve efficiency for certain network operations. This Ethernet switch is an essential component for anyone looking to upgrade or expand their network infrastructure with a dependable and future-ready device.

The smart choice for a connected South Africa.

Investing in the Cudy GS105D means choosing a network switch that balances performance, efficiency, and ease of use. It is designed to meet the diverse needs of a connected South Africa, from supporting remote work requirements to enhancing home entertainment experiences. Its robust build quality and adherence to essential networking standards provide peace of mind, knowing that your network is powered by a device built for consistent delivery and sustained performance. This 5-port gigabit switch is not merely an accessory; it is a foundational element for a smoother, faster digital experience.

product.name: SPATIUM S270 480GB 2.5"SSD
product.description:
From the MSI universe comes storage with blazing speeds and incredible performance. Take your system to the next level with SPATIUM. Optimized for the SATA III interface, SPATIUM S270 SSD reaches read/write speeds up to 500/450 MB/s, allowing for rapid data transfer and shortened game load times. The latest 3D NAND flash technology brings dense storage in a compact design and allows SPATIUM storage capacities up to 480GB. Built-in data security and error-correction capabilities extend the endurance and longevity of the NAND flash storage, empowering you to break records in games or take your talents to the next level.

TRIM Technology support helps to process unnecessary data efficiently and extend the life of SSD for more games or content creations. S.M.A.R.T. support helps to monitor the health of the drive and identify possible issues, letting you be free from worry in games or at work. ECC helps to maintain your important records or files intact and ensures a nonstop gaming experience from system failure. E2E Data Protection helps to enable reliable data transfer and assist you to game and create in confidence with enhanced system stability.

With the gamers’ first attitude, SPATIUM SSDs optimized for high-performance bandwidth and throughput enable you to wait less at loading games and play to win with minimal latency. SPATIUM SSDs get more done by opening up images, movies, documents, and heavy-duty applications at lightning speeds, keeping up your nonstop creativity and productivity.

  • SATA III interface

product.description:
[embed]https://youtu.be/YRgKFnlBzxo[/embed]

The Xiaomi Robot Vacuum X20+ comes with a wide variety of great features, making this brand-new flagship vacuum exceed expectations. With its powerful base station, strong vacuuming and mopping performance, agile obstacle avoidance, and intelligent interaction, it can effortlessly address all your floor cleaning needs. Now you can enjoy a hassle-free cleaning experience with the Xiaomi X20+.

With high-speed rotation, the mop pads satisfy all your floor cleaning needs by effectively by removing coffee stains, dirt, water, and other spills in the living room and kitchen areas. This versatile robot vacuum mop can also intelligently lift the mop pads to avoid secondary floor contamination.

Thanks to its advanced navigation system it comes with accurate environment perception and intelligent path planning. With millimetre-level perception, it can avoid obstacles as nimbly as a cat. Equipped with the S-Cross™ wide-area structured light obstacle avoidance system, the vacuum can detect and avoid low obstacles with wide-angle perception, even in low-light conditions.

Its LDS laser navigation creates a 360° whole house scan for intelligently planned cleaning. The LDS laser navigation system creates an accurate 360° scan of the indoor environment, quickly building a detailed home layout. With intelligent planning, the cleaning route is optimised for highly efficient and thorough cleaning.

Control the vacuum remotely and personalise cleaning with the Xiaomi Home/Mi Home app. Even when you're away from home you can control it remotely. Tell it to clean the living room, bedroom, or kitchen floors with just a click in the Xiaomi Home/Mi Home app and start vacuuming and mopping immediately.

product.name: Xiaomi Smart Watch 2
product.description:
Experience a smarter life with the Xiaomi Watch 2 and its Google Wear OS. Enjoy built-in Google apps and a wide array of fun, practical third-party apps for an optimized and ultra-smooth performance. With its 495mAh high-capacity battery and Qualcomm's hybrid architecture, the Xiaomi Watch 2 gives you power that lasts.

The dual architecture of large and small cores provides high performance and low power consumption autonomous switching, which brings long battery life, large storage, and a smoother flagship experience.

With LPDDR4X and eMMC memory, the Xiaomi Watch 2 offers impressive storage performance and space comparable to a smartphone. Download as many watch faces and third-party apps as you like, not to mention all your favorite songs to give your workouts a boost. The Xiaomi Watch 2 supports over 200 popular third-party apps, covering nearly every aspect of your life.

Thanks to Google Wallet you can now pay in style, simply leave your wallet at home and easily tap your watch to make payments on the go. This feature is already supported in many countries and regions around the globe, it's like having a wallet on your wrist.

With Google Assistant, you can complete daily tasks and to-dos, send messages, control your smart devices at home with voice commands, and much more. With Google Maps, you can enjoy voice navigation directions directly from your watch.

The Xiaomi Watch 2 supports more than 160 sports modes with an optimized professional algorithm model that provides you with more accurate workout data, so your workouts can be more scientific and productive.

Integrated with Google Maps, the Xiaomi Watch 2 also excels in navigating complex environments like high-rise buildings and jungles, providing clear movement distance, pace, and route information.

Xiaomi Watch 2 features 12-channel PPG monitoring to keep track of your heart rate, blood oxygen saturation, and stress levels faster and with more precision. It also offers stronger anti-interference capabilities to identify your sleep patterns with improved accuracy.

product.name: Xiaomi Robot Vacuum Cleaner and Mop E5 - White
product.description:
The Xiaomi Robot Vacuum E5 offers efficient vacuum and mopping functionality in one, for all-round convenient floor cleaning. The Robot Vacuum E5 is perfect for pet owners, making it ideal for maintaining a hair-free environment. Its easy-to-maintain design allows for no need for secondary hair handling. Its compact 300mm body allows the robot to easily move around in cramped spaces, easily cleaning with no missed spots. With its low body height of 70mm, it can also easily manoeuvre beneath furniture.

Equipped with advanced components such as dual side brushes, a nozzle, a dustbin filter, and a suction fan, it offers a thorough and highly efficient cleaning experience. With a maximum suction power of 2000Pa from the fan blower, you can easily meet your daily floor cleaning needs. Its three suction levels for deep cleaning of hair and its infiltrating water tank with the washable mop pad, make the Xiaomi Robot Vacuum E5 even easier and more convenient to use around the house.

The Xiaomi Robot Vacuum E5 also features multiple intelligent sensors for flexible obstacle navigation to avoid getting stuck during a cleaning session. Its zigzag cleaning path helps it stay on track to minimize uncleaned spots and maintain a high-efficiency cleaning rate.

You can even control the Xiaomi Robot Vacuum E5 remotely through the Mi Home/Xiaomi Home app to control cleaning schedules and free your hands to spend more time on what you enjoy. It is also compatible with Alexa and Google Assistant-enabled devices.

Please note Google Assistant is not available in certain languages and countries.

FEATURES:

Lightweight yet tough, it ensures your device is always shielded from accidental drops, scratches, and everyday wear. The Port Connect Triple Strong Tempered Glass is the smart solution for keeping your Galaxy Tab A8 safe and pristine.

product.name: Crucial 8GB 5600MHz DDR5 SODIMM Notebook Memory
product.description:
Crucial DDR5 Laptop Memory can empower your computer to transfer data 50% faster than DDR4 at launch, resulting in shorter load times, file transfers, downloads, lag time and improved refresh rates. Due to higher bus efficiency, DDR5 technology is not just faster than the previous generation, it’s better.

Crucial DDR5 offers 50% faster speeds than DDR4 at launch, empowering laptop users with extreme performance right out of the box. Even more impressive, Crucial DDR5 Laptop Memory is optimised for enhanced performance and multitasking, not just during testing, but in real-world conditions. Opening more browser tabs and switching between apps now feels more responsive than ever.

Significant improvements to the DDR5 channel architecture can help you get more work done in less time. With nearly 2x the bandwidth of DDR4, enabled by faster speeds, longer burst lengths, twice the banks and bank groups, two 32-bit channels, and improved refresh schemes, Crucial DDR5 still outperforms DDR4 with higher latency numbers.

For improved efficiency and stability, Crucial DDR5 introduces on-module voltage regulation with a power management integrated circuit (PMIC), which was on the motherboard with older memory technologies. This results in improved signalling and cleaner power regulation for the modules.

product.name: Intel 14th Gen Core i5-14400 LGA1700 2.5GHz 6-Core CPU
product.description:
The 14th Generation Intel® Core™ processors offer a performance hybrid architecture, allowing for the next evolutionary leap. Get the performance you need, right where you need it, whether you're a gamer, creator, streamer, or regular user. With Intel® 14 Generation processors, you can do more of what you enjoy, whenever you want. The 14th generation Intel® Core™ processors feature a hybrid architecture that combines performance and efficiency (P-core and E-core). That translates to real-world performance, intuitively scaled to match your work.

The Performance-core is Intel's most powerful CPU core ever. It's also optimised for single-thread performance and responsiveness in compute-intensive workloads such as gaming and 3D design. The Efficient-core provides multithreaded performance for tasks that can run concurrently (such as image rendering), as well as efficient offloading of background tasks for modern multitasking.

Intel built Intel® Thread Director directly into the hardware to ensure that Performance and Efficient cores work seamlessly with the operating system. Intel® Thread Director guides the operating system by automatically monitoring and analysing on the fly, ensuring that the right thread is placed on the right core at the right time. And it does it all dynamically, adapting scheduling guidance to actual computing needs rather than static rules.

The 14th Gen Intel® Core™ processors support the next generation of discrete graphics cards and storage devices. These devices take advantage of the increased throughput provided by PCIe 5.0, as well as the faster speeds and bandwidth of DDR5 memory. 14th Gen Intel® Core™ processors include built-in features for noise suppression, auto-framing, and optimised bandwidth and video resolution for gaming. This saves you time and allows you to multitask in ways you couldn't have imagined before. 14th Gen Intel® Core™ processors enable various tasks, including gaming, browsing, streaming, and creating masterpieces.

FEATURES:

  • 6 Cores
  • 16 Threads
  • Max Turbo Frequency of up to 4.7 GHz

product.name: Gizzu Hero Ultra Plus 3840Wh UPS Power Station
product.description:
Deliver power wherever and whenever you need it with the portable Gizzu Hero Ultra Plus UPS Power Station. The Hero Ultra Plus offers 3840Wh of battery capacity. It’s great for keeping your devices charged during outdoor adventures and powering most household appliances during loadshedding. The elegant design is durable, robust, and can be taken with you on any adventure.

The Gizzu Hero Ultra Plus UPS Power Station features three 220V AC plugs, two USB ports, four Type-C ports, two DC ports, a car socket port, and an XT60 port. These ensure that you can charge or power multiple devices simultaneously. Pure Sine Wave technology and the ability to function like a UPS ensures that the Gizzu Hero Ultra Plus seamlessly switches over to battery power during loadshedding or a power outage, resulting in zero downtime for your connected essential devices.

The Hero Ultra Plus UPS Power Station is compatible with most large household appliances and power tools during loadshedding. Electric chainsaws, electric irons, air conditioners, hairdryers, and air fryers are just some of the products that you can still enjoy during a blackout.

The Gizzu Hero Ultra Plus UPS Power Station features Lithium Iron Phosphate (LiFePO4) batteries that recharge from 0% to 100% within 2.2 hours and has a rated lifespan of 3500 cycles. You can recharge the Hero Ultra Plus in multiple ways – Recharge from your car, solar panel, or from traditional wall sockets at the home or office.

A battery management system helps to proactively monitor and manage the rechargeable battery. In addition, the Hero Ultra Plus also features safety features like short-circuit, over-current, over-voltage, under-voltage, over-load, and temperature protection.

Please Note:

The total power consumption for all connected appliances must be less than 3600W. If the power requirement draw exceeds 3600W, the wattage overdraw protection will provide up to 10 seconds of runtime before the unit shuts itself down. Wattage draw exceeding 7200W peak will cause the device to immediately shut down and this may cause damage.

The Hero Series Power Stations use Lithium Iron Phosphate (LiFeP04) batteries. After 2 days in UPS mode, the battery capacity will throttle between 90-100%. The Battery Management System will drop the capacity after a full charge to around 90% to prevent overcharging. (This will not affect life cycles)

FEATURES:

  • 3840Wh Lithium Iron Phosphate (LiFePO4) batteries with 3x more battery cycles than a typical lithium-iron battery
  • Ideal power solution to run a wide variety of large household appliances and power tools during loadshedding.
  • Features UPS functionality with 10milliseconds switchover
  • Recharge the battery from 0% to 100% within 2.2 hours
  • Features 15 outlets – 3x 220V South African plugs, 2x battery expansion ports, 3x Type-C PD20W ports, 1x Type-C PD100W port, 2x USB ports, 2x DC 5521 ports, 1x car socket port, and 1x XT60 port
  • Add up to 2 extra Gizzu batteries to expand capacity to 11520Wh. Great for even the most extreme outdoor adventures or extended loadshedding.
  • Battery Management System proactively monitors and protects the battery
  • Adjustable input power wattage (easily adjust your input wattage to avoid overloading your circuit)

product.name: Giada H611 I5-11300H High-end Medical Computer
product.description:
The Giada H611 High-End Medical Computer is engineered to meet the demanding requirements of today’s healthcare environments. Compliant with IEC 60601-1 and EN 60601-1 medical safety standards, this ultra-thin PC is the perfect fit for hospitals, clinics, and medical institutions seeking high-performance, secure computing in critical applications. Powered by Intel’s 11th Gen Tiger Lake UP3 processors, specifically the Core i5-11300H, the H611 delivers exceptional speed and responsiveness, supported by a robust 35W thermal design power (TDP) that balances efficiency and power for continuous medical workloads.

Integrated with Intel® Iris® Xe graphics, the H611 offers a 50% improvement over the previous generation, enabling smooth 4K and even 8K visual output for diagnostic imaging and multi-monitor setups. Display support includes one DisplayPort 1.4 for up to 8K @60Hz and dual HDMI 2.0 outputs for simultaneous 4K @60Hz playback. Whether managing medical imaging software or patient data, the H611 provides the clarity and capability required in professional medical environments.

The unit supports 32GB DDR4 3200MHz memory across dual SO-DIMM slots and integrates a PCIe M.2 SSD slot for high-speed storage, ensuring fast boot times and quick data access. For next-generation connectivity, the H611 includes support for 5G via a Quectel RM50XQ module, enabling ultra-fast mobile broadband ideal for telehealth and remote patient monitoring systems. Additionally, Wi-Fi 6 and Bluetooth® support ensures seamless wireless integration in modern hospital networks.

The H611 is fortified with Infineon TPM 2.0, delivering hardware-based encryption and secure boot functionality to protect sensitive patient data and medical records. The rugged metal chassis in medical-grade white is compact (just 18.96 x 14.83 x 2.6 cm), making it ideal for space-limited installations on medical carts or in wall-mounted solutions.

The system features comprehensive I/O ports, including USB 3.2 Gen2 Type-C, USB 3.2 Gen2 Type-A, legacy RS232 serial support, audio jacks, and robust antenna support for wireless modules. With auto power-on, watchdog timer, and customizable RTC scheduling, the H611 ensures reliability in always-on healthcare applications.

product.name: Gizzu SURF Simple 18W 55Wh LiFePO4 MINI DC UPS - Black
product.description:
Stay connected, even when the lights go out, with the Gizzu Surf Simple 18W 55Wh LiFePO₄ Mini DC UPS. Whether you’re working from home, streaming your favourite series, or just trying to keep your WhatsApp chats going during loadshedding, this compact backup power solution is here to keep your WiFi router running smoothly for up to six hours.

Thanks to its powerful 55Wh lithium iron phosphate (LiFePO₄) battery, the Gizzu Surf Simple gives you a reliable way to keep your internet online when you need it most. It’s built with four high-quality 4350mAh cells, giving you a total capacity of 17400mAh. That’s enough juice to outlast most power cuts - and because LiFePO₄ batteries are safer and longer-lasting than standard lithium-ion, you can trust it to perform over and over again. In fact, it’s rated for up to 2000 charge cycles while still holding 80% of its original capacity.

It’s also really easy to set up. Just plug your WiFi router into the DC output, and you’re good to go. The device comes with three output options - 12V, 9V, and 5V - so it can power more than just your router if needed. And with a max output of 18W, it’s perfect for low-power devices like modems, fibre boxes, or even charging your phone during a blackout.

What makes the Gizzu Mini UPS extra smart is its built-in protection features. It’s designed to guard against short circuits, overloads, temperature spikes, overcharging, and more. So not only are your devices safe, but the UPS itself stays protected too. It automatically switches over to battery power during an outage and starts charging itself again as soon as the power comes back on.

Compact, lightweight, and built for everyday convenience, the Gizzu Surf Simple fits right into your home or small office setup. If you’re tired of losing connection every time Eskom flips the switch, this is your no-fuss solution to staying online. No more dropped Zoom calls, missed emails, or buffering videos - just reliable internet, no matter what.

The Gizzu Surf Simple 18W Mini DC UPS is your go-to backup power buddy for smooth, stress-free connectivity during loadshedding.

product.name: Cudy Single Mode 1.25G LC Bi-Directional SFP 20km
product.description:
Cudy's CD-SFP-SMB is your answer for efficient and cost-effective single-mode fibre deployments! These bi-directional modules redefine connectivity standards with a powerful design optimised for 1.25 Gbps transmission over distances of up to 20km.

The CD-SFP-SMB modules are sold as a pair and feature a smart SFP package with LC connectors, ensuring cross-vendor compatibility. What distinguishes them is their novel application of bi-directional technology, which enables duplex transmission on a single fibre by utilising two distinct wavelengths for TX and RX on the same optical strand. This not only improves performance but also significantly lowers installation costs.

Choose between the SM100GSB-20A with a 1310nm FP laser and a 1550nm PIN photodetector or the SM100GSB-20B with a 1550nm DFB laser and a 1310nm PIN photodetector to meet your specific requirements.

These modules provide dependable performance because they are powered by a single +3.3V power supply and have an LVPECL-compatible data input/output interface. The CD-SFP-SMB provides a strong and secure connection thanks to its low EMI and excellent ESD protection. These modules prioritise environmental sustainability while adhering to RoHS and SFF8472 standards.

FEATURES:

  • SFP package with LC connector
  • SM100GSB-20A: 1310nm FP Laser and 1550nm PIN photodetector
  • SM100GSB-20B: 1550nm DFB Laser and 1310nm PIN photodetector
  • Up to 20 km transmission on SMF
  • +3.3V single power supply
  • LVPECL-compatible data input/output interface
  • Low EMI and excellent ESD protection
  • Compatible with RoHS
  • Compatible with SFF8472

SPECIFICATIONS:

  • Fibre Channel Speed: 1.06 Gb/s
  • Form Factor: SFP (BiDi)

Enjoy delicious low-fat food by using less oil and a smoke-free cooking experience with the Xiaomi Mi Smart Air Fryer. The 1800W heating power enables rapid temperature increase and more balanced heat distribution inside the fryer, shortening the cooking time, and offering a faster, healthier, and more convenient lifestyle.

Low temperatures are automatically paired with the low rotating speed of the dual-speed motor for a slow temperature increase. The medium to high-temperature range is automatically paired with a high rotating speed of the dual-speed motor for rapid temperature increase. It can do all of this over a cooking time of up to 24 hours, giving you more options and versatility in the kitchen. Longer continuous heating in conjunction with a broader temperate range offers more cooking possibilities. Make snacks like dried fruit, dried meat, and yoghurt for the entire family.

You can fully inflate 2 car tyres or top them up, thanks to enhancements that deliver even more inflation performance on a full charge with up to 25% faster inflation than the Air Compressor 1S. Its 19mm high-precision cylinder block supports pressures up to 150 psi making it ideal for various tyre types. Made from high-quality alloy materials, the portable air compressor inflates from 0 to 150 psi in just 20 seconds, making it suitable for use with shock absorbers on mountain bikes, as well as high-pressure tyres on road bikes.

Its highly accurate air pressure sensors mean no more fiddling with manual pumps. The digitally controlled air-pressure sensors improve inflation accuracy to ±1 psi, putting an end to back-and-forth tyre pressure checks as you inflate. It also features six preset tyre pressures, for greater ease and peace of mind. The Xiaomi Portable Electric Air Compressor 2 automatically stops inflating your tyres when your desired pre-set pressure is reached. It also remembers your pressure values, so you don't have to keep setting it up repeatedly whenever you use it.

The Xiaomi Portable Electric Air Compressor 2 features six different inflation modes, each with preset air pressure values which prevent over-inflation. This makes the Xiaomi Portable Electric Air Compressor 2 more convenient and easy for anyone to use. Say goodbye to wires, thanks to the internal lithium batteries. Lithium batteries mean no external power source is required, and no more cumbersome power cables are needed.

Weighing in at only 490g, it features a lightweight body for greater portability, making it ideal for when you want to travel light. Slip it in your bag, leave it at home, or place it in your car, this beautiful device takes up no space at all, no matter where it's stored. It also features a built-in LED light for night-time use with an SOS flashing feature in case of an emergency.

product.name: Kingbrite P55 800W BAR Grow Light with UV+IR |Samsung LM281B
product.description:
Grow what you love all year round with the Kingbrite P55 800W Quantum Bar Grow Light. This product ensures that your seedlings and plants will receive all the necessary light they require to perform photosynthesis regardless of the season, converting the light they capture into sugars necessary for growth. Ideal for horticulture, indoor gardening, plant propagation and food production, this grow light is perfect for any type of indoor growing of plants and vegetation where natural lighting is not available or consistent.

The Kingbrite P55 800W Quantum Bar Grow Light features eight highly efficient light quantum LED bars that can be rotated for the perfect lighting angle. Each quantum bar consists of 312 Samsung LM281B LEDs as well as 56 Epistar 660nm LEDs, 4 Epistar 460nm LEDs, 4 Epistar UV LEDs and 4 Epistar IR LEDs which collectively produce the light that is essential for plant photosynthesis, vegetation growth, and the flowering of plants indoors.

This LED light is also energy-efficient, consuming less electricity and giving off less heat than other lights. This means they’re better suited to meet the needs of plants grown indoors, are better for the environment and will help save you money in the long term.

The Kingbrite P55 800W Quantum Bar Grow Light is optimised for growing a variety of plants indoors, ensuring the production of established roots, healthy stems, and increased flower and leaf density. This, in turn, makes leaves grow stronger and flowers become bright and beautiful. Whatever your requirements, this grow light provides the optimal indoor growing environment for your plants to thrive.

FEATURES:

  • Beautiful design and structure
  • Easy installation and operation
  • Efficient thermal design with aluminium heatsinks
  • Rotatable quantum bars for more accurate lighting
  • More LEDs are used per quantum bar while making sure each LED works at suitable power and temp levels
  • Dimmable Driver for easy adjustment of brightness for the plant’s various growth states
  • Full-spectrum LEDs for better results – LM281B 3000K+5000K, 660nm, 460nm, 730nm, and 395nm LEDs
  • Perfect for 5*5ft grow tent
  • Widely applied in commercial growing horizontal and vertical, greenhouse cultivation, pipeline cultivation, and hydroponics.

product.name: Xiaomi Smart Space Heater S EU
product.description:
Stay warm when temperatures are low with the Xiaomi Smart Space Heater S. This innovative smart heater allows you to control your room temperature anytime and anywhere. Its Smart temperature control allows you to save power while keeping your environment at a comfortable level. When the surrounding temperature is lower than the preset temperature, it will automatically continue heating until it reaches that preset temperature at which point it will automatically reduce the power or stop heating. It can achieve this thanks to its built-in adjustable thermostat, which allows your heater to keep your home at a comfortable temperature while saving energy.

The heated air rises and the cool air comes down producing a convective effect for air circulation and room heating. The wide front and top air ducts allow for heating close areas as well as the entire room. It circulates to form convective hot air, which flows in both directions from the top and sides. The airflow is softer than that of an AC and is not as prone to dryness. As a bonus feature, it will not interfere with your sleep at night, and will not cause dry eyes and throat in the morning. With an optimized air duct, the temperature of the Xiaomi Smart Heater S rises faster and the warmth quickly spreads throughout the entire home. With its simple and practical body design, the heater is small, flexible and easy to move. It also comes with an integrated drying rack for clothing to help them dry quicker. The integrated drying rack can load up to 1.5kg of dry clothes while heating.

FEATURES:

  • Quiet and comfortable convection heating technology
  • Accurate digital thermostat with six temperature levels
  • Shut off automatically with overheating and tip-over protection
  • IPX4 splash-proof water-resistance

product.name: Cudy AC1200 WiFi 4G LTE Cat4 Outdoor Router

The LT500 Outdoor is the perfect solution for turning 4G into speedy Wi-Fi, allowing users to enjoy the convenience of Cat. 4 access anywhere. With maximum download speeds of 150Mbps and upload speeds of 50Mbps, this router provides a fast 4G connection to over 30 devices simultaneously with minimal latency. MU-MIMO and dual-band features further enhance the performance of the AC1200 Wi-Fi, ensuring users have a reliable connection with satisfactory speed and coverage.

This makes it an ideal product for anyone who needs to cover large distances with top-notch performance.

This Adapter simplifies the process of installing Wi-Fi anywhere. It comes with an adapter that allows you to plug an Ethernet cable into it and extend your network reach up to 100 m without needing an extra cable. You can also connect an AP to the adapter to equip your space with a better Wi-Fi signal, though an AP must be purchased separately. Additionally, the default 4G antennas are as sensitive as a standard phone's antennas. But if needed, they can be replaced with customized ones via the SMA connectors.

This kit has everything you need to complete a successful installation, including hardware for both wall mounting and pole mounting. With its durable and strong construction, this kit is designed to help you mount your item securely and safely in a variety of locations. It's an easy and efficient way to get the job done quickly without compromising on quality.

Users who care about productivity and efficiency can definitely count on the MSI PRO Series to assist you with multitasking and increasing efficiency. MSI lightning Gen 4 PCI-E represents the bandwidth of a x16 interface to 64GB/s that has doubled compared to its previous generation. MSI PCI Express Steel Armor slots are secured to the motherboard with extra solder points and support the weight of heavy graphics cards. When every advantage in games counts, Steel Armor shields the point of contact from electromagnetic interference.

A huge step of DDR performance enhancement with the latest DDR5 memory. Combines with dedicated SMT welding process and MSI Memory Boost technology, MSI PRO Series motherboards are ready to deliver the world class memory performance. The advanced SMT(Surface Mount Technology) welding process reduces the defect rate of slot solder joints, electromagnetism, and interference. Combining with exclusive Memory Boost technology allows MSI motherboards to deliver the clean and pure high-frequency DDR5 signal. Core Boost technology combines MSI's premium layout and optimized power design which allows for faster and undistorted current delivery to the CPU at pin-point precision. Not only supporting multi-core CPU, also creating the perfect conditions for your CPU overclocking. Add more color if you want! Mystic Light Extension pin header provides an intuitive way to control additional RGB strips and other RGB peripherals added to a system, without needing a separate RGB controller.

product.name: Gizzu Hero Pro 2048Wh UPS Power Station
product.description:
[embed]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LqQCRMYeLns[/embed]

Deliver power wherever and whenever you need it with the portable Gizzu Hero Pro UPS Power Station. The Hero Pro offers 2048Wh of battery capacity. It's great for keeping your devices charged during outdoor adventures and powering most household appliances during loadshedding. The elegant design is durable, robust, and can be taken with you on any adventure.

The Gizzu Hero Pro UPS Power Station features two 220V AC plugs, two USB ports, four Type-C ports, two DC ports, a car socket port, and an XT60 port. These ensure that you can charge or power multiple devices simultaneously. Pure Sine Wave technology and the ability to function like a UPS ensures that the Gizzu Hero Pro seamlessly switches over to battery power during loadshedding or a power outage, resulting in zero downtime for your connected essential devices.

The Hero Pro UPS Power Station is compatible with most large household appliances and power tools such as hairdryers, air fryers, coffee machines, washing machines, and electric drills.

The Gizzu Hero Pro UPS Power Station features Lithium Iron Phosphate (LiFePO4) batteries that recharge from 0% to 100% within 2 hours and has a rated lifespan of 3500 cycles. You can recharge the Hero Pro in multiple ways - Recharge from your car, solar panel, or from traditional wall sockets at the home or office.

A battery management system helps to proactively monitor and manage the rechargeable battery. In addition, the Hero Pro also features safety features like short-circuit, over-current, over-voltage, under-voltage, over-load, and temperature protection.

Please Note:

The total power consumption for all connected appliances must be less than 2400W. If the power requirement draw exceeds 2400W, the wattage overdraw protection will provide up to 10 seconds of runtime before the unit shuts itself down.

The Hero Series Power Stations use Lithium Iron Phosphate (LiFeP04) batteries. After 2 days in UPS mode, the battery capacity will throttle between 90-100%. The Battery Management System will drop the capacity after a full charge to around 90% to prevent overcharging. (This will not affect life cycles)

FEATURES:

  • 2048Wh Lithium Iron Phosphate (LiFePO4) batteries with 3x more battery cycles than a typical lithium-iron battery
  • Ideal to keep most large household appliances and power tools running during loadshedding.
  • Features UPS functionality with 10ms switchover
  • Recharge the battery from 0% to 100% within 2 hours
  • Features 12 outlets - 2x 220V South African plugs, 3x Type-C PD20W ports, 1x Type-C PD100W port, 2x USB ports, 2x DC 5521 ports, 1x car socket port, and an XT60 port
  • Multiple input charging options - recharge from your car, solar panel, or from wall sockets
  • Battery Management System proactively monitors and protects the battery
  • Adjustable input power wattage (easily adjust your input wattage to avoid overloading your circuit)
  • Intelligent safety features like over-charge, over-discharge, and short-circuit protection

SPECIFICATIONS:

The Xiaomi Rechargeable Mini Fan allows you to keep cool while on the go. It features a high-performance brushless DC motor with 4 wind speeds and a wide-angle airflow for ventilation. This wireless mini fan also comes with a built-in 4000mAh rechargeable battery to allow you wireless usage of up to 18.5 hours on the first wind speed. Not only does the rechargeable mini fan keep you cool, but it also does so quietly thanks to its low fan noise level as low as 34dB(A), so you can use it while you work or while you sleep. It also features a built-in aroma pad which can be used with your favourite aromas to relieve stress. Simply add a few drops of your favourite essential oil to the cotton pad fitted into the front fan guard. Beat the summer heat by infusing the natural breeze with a relaxing scent, or use an insect-repelling scent and sleep soundly all night.

The Built-in high-capacity battery has a long life and can be freely switched to plug-in or for wireless use on different occasions. product.name: Xiaomi Multifunctional Flash Light
product.description:
The Xiaomi Multi-Function Flashlight features a 1000lm main light with an ultra-long lighting range of up to 240m. The brightness of the master light is adjustable at high, medium, and low levels to suit different lighting situations. Its ultra-long range allows it to penetrate darkness and illuminate distant areas at night. It also features a side flashing red/fog light for emergency signals such as SOS or alerting people to be cautious. The rotatable mode adjustment ring allows you to easily switch between the two light sources so you can switch between the main master light mode and the emergency side light mode. To top it all off its 3100mAh large-capacity lithium battery can give you up to 90 hours of ultra-long battery life.

The lamp holder can also zoom in and out of focus, enabling the free adjustment between the spotlight and floodlight. This allows you to smoothly switch between low beams for night walks and high beams for searching. The multi-function flashlight also features magnetic fixation that allows you to rotate the flashlight to adjust the lighting angle, it can also be magnetically attached to cars, holders, and other metal surfaces. The rotating slide design allows 107° wide-angle rotation adjustment for more accurate lighting.

It even has an ejection-type window breaker with a press-type structure and a hidden firing pin for safe and non-intensive execution. It also comes with a seatbelt cutter with an open-buckle barb design to prevent accidental cuts. This makes the Xiaomi Multi-function Flashlight very versatile, especially in emergency situations.

product.name: FSP Dagger Pro ATX3.0 (PCIe 5.0) 850w Fully Modular PSU
product.description:
The DAGGER PRO 850W is a power supply with 80 PLUS® Gold Certification that guarantees to operate at a minimum of 90% efficiency at 50% the load of the PSU-rated power and as a result, reduces lots of electricity costs. The Fully-modular design and flat ribbon cables provide easier installation. An ideal solution for applications with space constraints, enhancing overall airflow efficiency and cable management.

The DAGGER PRO 850W comes with a native PCIe 5.0 connector for the latest graphic card and features dual CPU power connectors to support high-end motherboards for gaming enthusiasts. The VGA card is a component which needs greedy and stable power support most. The compact-sized DAGGER PRO ATX3.0 850W comes with a single +12V rail design that offers VGA cards full power individually and to avoid any overloading conditions.

It is compatible with most Mini-ITX and Micro ATX small form factor PCs. It is ideal for home computer rigs but a great alternative for mini-PC enthusiasts. It Adapts to your individual requirements, not only does it fit into cases with the SFX form factor but can also be installed in a simple step into normal ATX, Micro-ATX or Mini-ITX cases.

product.name: GIZZU Voltage Protector 16A
product.description:
[embed]https://youtu.be/skP_-nCY00E[/embed]

The Gizzu Universal Voltage Protector Plug will keep your appliances protected against damage caused by high voltage, low voltage, voltage dips, and power surges. It monitors the electricity voltage and automatically disconnects the power if the voltage is too high, or too low, protecting appliances and electronics from damage. This is an essential accessory for environments with inconsistent power supply and is rated for 16A current. It regulates voltages between 180V and 265V to provide a stable supply to your appliance. If the voltage moves outside of these limits, power is cut to protect the equipment.

Recommended for fridges, freezers, coolers, washing machines, computers, TVs, and HiFis. Simply connect your appliance to the mains via the Gizzu Universal Voltage Protector Plug to keep it safe.

product.name: Intel 12th Gen Core i5-12400F LGA1700 2.5GHz 6-Core CPU
product.description:
Take the next evolutionary leap with the performance hybrid architecture of 12th Generation Intel® Core™ processors. Get the performance you need, where you need it, whether you’re a gamer, creator, streamer, or everyday user. Whatever you’re into, do more of it, whenever you want with Intel® 12 Generation processors. With unprecedented new performance hybrid architecture, 12th Gen Intel® Core™ processors offer a unique combination of Performance and Efficient-cores (P-core and E-core). That means real-world performance, intuitively scaled to match whatever you’re doing.

The Performance-core is Intel’s highest-performing CPU core ever. And it’s designed to maximize single-thread performance and responsiveness for compute-intensive workloads like gaming and 3D design. The Efficient-core delivers multithreaded performance for tasks that can run in parallel (like image rendering), along with efficient offload of background tasks for modern multitasking.

So that Performance-cores and Efficient-cores can work seamlessly with the operating system, Intel built Intel® Thread Director right into the hardware. Automatically monitoring and analyzing on-the-fly, Intel® Thread Director guides the operating system, helping it place the right thread on the right core, at the right time. And it does it all dynamically, adapting scheduling guidance based on actual computing needs, not on static rules.

12th Gen Intel® Core™ processors also support the next wave of discrete graphics cards and storage devices. These devices take advantage of increased throughput coming with PCIe 5.0 as well the higher speeds and bandwidth of DDR5 memory. With 12th Gen Intel® Core™ processors, standard, built-in features enable capabilities like noise suppression, auto-framing, and optimization for bandwidth and video resolution while gaming. That saves you time and lets you multitask in ways you’ve only ever dreamed of, until now. From epic gaming to browsing to streaming to creating your next masterpiece, 12th Gen Intel® Core™ processors make it all entirely doable.

Please note: A dedicated graphics card is needed to use this CPU. It does not come with integrated graphics.

  • 6 Cores

product.name: GIZZU HERO MAX 1024WH/1000W UPS Power Station
product.description:
[embed]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XwetUqxsNKw[/embed]

Deliver power wherever and whenever you need it with the portable Gizzu Hero Max UPS Power Station. The Hero Max offers 1024Wh of battery capacity. It's great for keeping your devices charged during outdoor adventures and powering most household appliances during loadshedding. The elegant design is durable, robust, and can be taken with you on any adventure.

The Gizzu Hero Max UPS Power Station features two 220V AC plugs, two USB ports, two Type-C ports, a car socket port and an XT60 port. These ensure that you can charge or power multiple devices simultaneously. Pure sine wave technology and the ability to function like a UPS ensures that the Gizzu Hero Max seamlessly switches over to battery power during loadshedding, or a power outage, resulting in zero downtime for your connected essential devices.

The Hero Max UPS Power Station is compatible with most household appliances and power tools running during loadshedding. LED TV, desktop PC, microwave, washing machines and electric drills, these are just some of the products that you can still enjoy during a blackout.

The Gizzu Hero Max UPS Power Station features lithium iron phosphate (LiFePO4) batteries that recharge from 0% to 100% within 1.3 hours and has a rated lifespan of 3500 cycles to 80%. You can recharge the Hero Max in multiple ways - draw power from your car, solar panel, or from traditional wall sockets at the home or office.

A battery management system helps to proactively monitor and manage the rechargeable battery. In addition, the Hero Max also features safety features like short-circuit, over-current, over-voltage, under-voltage, over-load and temperature protection.

Please note:
The total power consumption for all connected appliances must be less than 1200W prior to connecting the device to the AC port. If the power requirement draw exceeds 1200W, the wattage overdraw protection will provide up to 10 seconds of runtime before the unit shuts itself down.

The Hero Series Power Stations use Lithium Iron Phosphate (LiFeP04) batteries. After 2 days in UPS mode, the battery capacity will throttle between 90-100%. The Battery Management System will drop the capacity after a full charge to around 90% to prevent overcharging. (This will not affect life cycles)

FEATURES:

  • 1024Wh lithium iron phosphate (LiFePO4) batteries with 3x more battery cycles than a typical lithium ion battery.
  • Ideal to keep most large household appliances and power tools running during loadshedding.
  • Features UPS functionality with 10ms switchover
  • Recharge the battery from 0% to 100% within 1.3 hours
  • Features 8 outlets - 2x 220V South African plugs, 1x Type-C PD30W ports, 1x Type-C PD100W port, 3x USB ports, 1x car socket port and 1x XT60 port.
  • Multiple input charging options - recharge from your car, solar panel or from wall sockets.
  • Battery management system proactively monitors and protects the battery.
  • Intelligent safety features like over-charge, over-discharge and short circuit protection.

product.name: Gizzu Everglow Rechargeable Warm White Emergency Downlight Bulb
product.description:
[embed]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RV-OWueWiSA[/embed]

The Gizzu Everglow Rechargeable Emergency Downlight Bulb is an ideal solution for keeping the lights on during loadshedding. The 3W lightbulb features a 10mm GU10 base connector and gives off a warm white colour when lit. Its 300mAh built-in battery allows it to stay powered during loadshedding. The light bulb takes around 5 hours to fully charge to 100% and can easily be charged by simply leaving the light turned on when there's no loadshedding. If your light is turned on and a power outage or loadshedding occurs, then the light bulb goes into emergency mode, changing to a cool white colour.

While in emergency mode, the brightness can be manually adjusted between 3 pre-configured settings and can sustain up to 5 hours of additional use during loadshedding at the 25% brightness setting. At the 50% brightness setting, you can get up to 3 hours of use while at the 100% brightness setting, you can get up to 1.5 hours of additional hours of use. When the Gizzu Everglow Rechargeable Emergency Downlight Bulb switches into emergency mode, the default brightness level is 100%. Please ensure you switch the brightness level to 50% or 25% so that the downlight bulb will last longer. The brightness can be adjusted by turning the light on and off in 1-second intervals multiple times. Each time this is done the brightness will switch between 100%, 50%, and 25%. Leaving the lightbulb off for a while will reset the brightness setting back to its default 100% brightness.

Smart Bulb Technology enables the bulb to determine if there is a power failure as opposed to the light switch being turned off. If the light switch is on and the power fails, the bulb will activate emergency mode and switch from Warm White to Cool White. If the light switch is off when the power fails the light will remain off unless turned on at the switch.

Really easy setup

  • Fit your lightbulb
  • Quickly switch your light switch on-off-on (within 1 second) to activate the LED Bulb
  • Wait for loadshedding

FEATURES:

  • Keep your lights powered for up to 5 additional hours during loadshedding or power failures (at 25% brightness level)
  • Automatically switches to emergency mode in the event of loadshedding or a power failure
  • Select between 3 brightness levels to prolong battery life (the default brightness level is 100%)
  • The 3W downlight bulb generates 250 Lumens of warm white light, switching to 90 Lumens of cool white in emergency mode.
  • Compatible with standard 10mm GU10 fixture
  • Up to 25000-hour lifespan
  • Smart Bulb Technology

SPECIFICATIONS:

  • Base Type: GU10
  • Bulb Colour: Warm White
  • Rated Power: 3W
  • Input Voltage: 230V
  • Input Frequency: 50/60Hz
  • Rated Lumens Normal (Brightness): 250lm +/-10% (100%)
  • Rated Lumens Emergency (Brightness): 90lm (100%)/45lm (50%)/23lm (25%)
  • Battery Type: Lithium-Ion
  • Battery Capacity: 300mAh
  • Dimmable Brightness Levels: (100%/ 50%/ 25%)
  • Illumination Time (Brightness): 1.5 hours (100%) /3 hours (50%)/ 5 hours (25%)
  • Charging Time: 5 Hours
  • Lifespan: 25000 hours
  • Colour Temperature (Normal): 3000K
  • Colour Temperature (Emergency): 6500K
  • Product Dimensions: 5 x 5 x 5.5 cm
  • Product Weight: 30g

The water tank features a transparent water level indicator so that you can keep an eye on the water level without lifting the lid.

The Xiaomi Smart Humidifier 2 is powered by smart technology, allowing you to maintain the perfect humidity levels. product.name: GIZZU 60W 69Wh 21600mAh Mini POE DC UPS LifePO4 - Black
product.description:
The Gizzu 60W Mini DC 69Wh UPS is simple to install and allows you to power various devices during a power outage. With multiple-voltage DC outputs, this UPS can power both your Router and ONU (Optical Network Unit) so you can continue browsing the web, working online, or streaming. CCTV cameras and VoIP phones can also be connected and powered via the Gigabit Power Over Ethernet (PoE) port. Charge mobile devices such as cell phones and tablets via USB. Featuring 12 high-capacity lithium-iron phosphate(LiFePO4) 21600mAh batteries which ensure a longer life span than traditional lithium-ion batteries.

Lithium Iron Phosphate (LiFePO4) batteries are safer thanks to their phosphate cathode cells, which make them much more stable & provide more cycles. This means LiFePO4 batteries can outlast regular lithium-ion batteries and traditional lead-acid batteries. It can safely power your ONU device for up to 23 hours, your router for up to 6.9 hours, or the combination of your router and an ONU device for up to 5.3 hours. This mini UPS also comes with safety protocols such as over-charge, over-discharge, and short-circuit protection.

Warning: Please ensure that the combined power draw of connected devices does not exceed 60W. Ensure the voltage of the device is connected to the correct voltage output before turning the UPS on. Failure to adhere to this warning may result in damage to the connected devices. Refer to your manual for additional safety information.

FEATURES:
